La rasem a yopoe wã daare, bɩ maan-kʋʋdã maag a meng n ges-a. Sã n mikame tɩ nodrã ka paasde, la a ka yalgd yĩn-gãongã zugu, bɩ maan-kʋʋdã leb n ning a soabã kɛɛng rasem a yopoe yɛsa.

Rasem a yopoe-kãens sã n pidi, bɩ maan-kʋʋdã leb n ges-a naoor a yiibẽ soaba. Sã n mik tɩ nodrã boogame, n ka yalg yĩn-gãongã zugu, bɩ maan-kʋʋdã wilg t'a soabã yaa yɩlemde. Rẽ, rat n yeelame tɩ yaa yĩn-fʋkr bala, la bɩ a soabã pegs a futu, n lebg yɩlemde.
La maan-kʋʋdã sẽn ges-a n yeel t'a yaa yɩlemdã poore, b sã n mik tɩ yĩn-fʋkrã yɛdga yĩn-gãongã zugu, bɩ a lebg n leb maan-kʋʋdã nengẽ naoor a yiibẽ soaba,
tɩ maan-kʋʋdã leb n ges-a. Sã n mikame tɩ yĩn-fʋkrã yɛdga yĩn-gãongã zugu, bɩ maan-kʋʋdã wilg t'a yaa rẽgdo, bala, yaa wãoodo.
Wãood sã n puk ned yĩn-gãong zugu, bɩ b tall a soabã n kẽng maan-kʋʋdã nengẽ,
tɩ maan-kʋʋdã ges-a. Sã n mikame tɩ nod-pɛɛlg n be yĩn-gãongã zugu, la nodrã sã n kɩtame tɩ yĩn-kõabnengã pelge, la yĩn-nemdã sã n nudgame n yi nodrã pʋga,
wilgdame tɩ yaa wãood sẽn paam pãng nin-kãng yĩn-gãongã zugu. Bɩ maan-kʋʋdã wilg t'a soabã yaa rẽgdo. B ka leb n baood n ning a soabã kɛɛng ye. Bala, a zoe n yaa rẽgdo.
La wãoodã sã n yɛdg n kẽ ned ning sẽn tar-a nodrã yĩn-gãongã zĩig fãa, n sɩng ne a zugã n tall n tɩ tãag a naoã, tɩ maan-kʋʋdã tõe n yãnd tɩ yaa zĩigã fãa,

bɩ maan-kʋʋdã maag a meng n ges-a. La sã n mikame tɩ wãoodã yɛdg n luda a yĩngã zãnga, bɩ maan-kʋʋdã wilg tɩ ned ning sẽn tar-a nodrã yaa yɩlemde. Bala, yẽnda mengã zãng lebga pɛɛlga, dẽ, a yaa yɩlemde.
La daar ninga b sẽn na n mik tɩ yĩn-nemdã nudgame wã, yaa badaar la b na n yeel t'a soabã yaa rẽgdo.
Maan-kʋʋdã sã n yãnd tɩ yĩn-nemdã nudgame, bɩ a wilg t'a soabã yaa rẽgdo. Nodr yaa rẽgdo. Bala, yaa wãood buud a to.
La yĩn-nemdã sẽn nudgã sã n tek n lebg pɛɛlga, bɩ nodrã soab kẽng maan-kʋʋdã nengẽ,
t'a ges-a. Dẽ, nodrã sã n yaa pɛɛlga, bɩ maan-kʋʋdã wilg tɩ ned ning sẽn tar-a nodrã yaa yɩlemde, a ka leb n yaa rẽgd ye.
Yĩn-gãong bãag sã n yõk ned n lebg n maage,
tɩ b wa n mik tɩ yũur n puk zĩig ning nodrã sẽn dag n zĩndã, n tẽgs-tẽgs pɛɛl-pɛɛla, la miid-miidu, bɩ a soabã kẽng tɩ maan-kʋʋdã ges-a.
Bɩ maan-kʋʋdã maag a meng n ges a zĩigã. B sã n mik tɩ nodrã zĩigã võd n kẽe pʋgẽ, tɩ yĩn-kõabnengã lebg pɛɛlga, bɩ maan-kʋʋdã wilg t'a soabã yaa rẽgdo. Rat n yeelame tɩ yaa wãood n puk nodrã zugu.
La maan-kʋʋdã sã n mik tɩ yĩn-kõaben-pɛɛlg ka tol n be tẽgsem-tẽgsmã zugu, la a ka võd n kẽ pʋgẽ, la a pʋs n maagdame, bɩ a ning a soabã kɛɛng rasem a yopoe.
La rẽ zugẽ, tẽgsem-tẽgsmã sã n yɛdg n kẽ yĩn-gãongã zugu, bɩ maan-kʋʋdã wilg t'a soabã yaa rẽgdo. Wilgdame tɩ yaa wãoodo.
La b sã n mik tɩ tẽgsem-tẽgsmã ka teke, la a ka yɛdge, wilgdame tɩ yaa nod-rãoongo. Bɩ a wilg t'a soabã yaa yɩlemde.
Bugum sã n dag n yõog neda, tɩ b wa n mik tɩ bugmã nodrã tẽgsa pɛɛl-pɛɛla, wall pɛɛl ne miidu,

bɩ maan-kʋʋdã maag a meng n ges a soabã. B sã n mik tɩ yĩn-kõabnengã sẽn be tẽgsmã pʋgã lebga pɛɛlga, la a zĩigã sã n võdame, wilgdame tɩ yaa wãood n puk bugmã nodr zugu. Bɩ maan-kʋʋdã wilg tɩ nin-kãng yaa rẽgdo. Bala, yaa wãoodo.
Maan-kʋʋdã sã n ges n mik tɩ yĩn-kõaben-pɛɛlg ka be tẽgsmã zugu, la nodrã sã n ka võde, la sã n mik t'a maagame, bɩ maan-kʋʋdã ning a soabã kɛɛng rasem a yopoe.
La rasem a yopoe wã daar sã n ta, bɩ maan-kʋʋdã ges-a. A sã n mik tɩ nodrã yɛdga yĩn-gãongã zugu, bɩ maan-kʋʋdã wilg t'a soabã yaa rẽgdo. Bala, yaa wãoodo.
La nodrã sã n kell n pa zĩ-yɛnga, la a sã n ka yɛdg yĩn-gãongã zugu, la sã n mik t'a maagame, wilgdame tɩ yaa bugum nodr bala. Bɩ maan-kʋʋdã wilg t'a soabã yaa yɩlemde, bala, yaa bugum nod-rãoongo.
Yĩn-gãong bãag sã n yõk rao bɩ pag zugu, ka rẽ bɩ a lemde,

bɩ maan-kʋʋdã maag a meng n ges bãagã sẽn beẽ wã. Sã n mikame t'a zĩigã võdame n kẽ, tɩ yĩn-koabnengã yaa kõodre, wilgdame t'a soabã yaa rẽgdo. Woto yaa sẽn wilgd tɩ yaa rasempʋɩɩga. Rẽndã yaa zug bɩ lemd wãoodo.
La maan-kʋʋdã sã n mik tɩ rasempʋɩɩgã ka võd n kẽ pʋgẽ, la a ges tɩ yĩn-koabnengã ka sablga, bɩ a ning rasempʋɩɩgã sẽn tar a soabã kɛɛng rasem a yopoe.
La rasem a yopoe wã daare, bɩ maan-kʋʋdã maag a meng n ges nodrã. La a sã n mik tɩ rasempʋɩɩgã ka yalge, la yĩn-kõabnengã sã n ka kõodr-kõodre, la nodrã zĩig sã n ka võd n kẽ pʋgẽ,
bɩ a soabã põng a zugu, la a põng n gil rasempʋɩɩgã zĩig n base. La bɩ maan-kʋʋdã leb n ning a soabã kɛɛng rasem a yopoe yɛsa.

La rasem a yopoe kãens sã n pidi, bɩ maan-kʋʋdã maag a meng n ges rasempʋɩɩgã zĩigã. La sã n mikame tɩ rasempʋɩɩgã ka yalg yĩn-gãongã zugu, la a zĩigã sã n ka võd n kẽ pʋgẽ, bɩ maan-kʋʋdã wilg t'a yaa yɩlemde. La a soabã tog n pegsa a futu, n lebg yɩlemde.
La sã n mikame tɩ b sẽn wilg t'a yaa yɩlemdã loogr zugẽ, rasempʋɩɩgã yalga yĩn-gãongã zugu,

bɩ maan-kʋʋdã leb n maag a meng n leb n ges-a yɛsa, la sã n mik tɩ rasempʋɩɩgã yalga yĩn-gãongã zugu, ka leb n yaa tɩlɛ tɩ maan-kʋʋdã bao n bãng yĩn-koabnengã sã n teka kõbg ye. Wilgdame bal t'a soabã yaa rẽgdo.
La sã n wẽnda wa rasempʋɩɩgã ka yalg n paase, la sã n mik tɩ yĩn-kõabnen-sabl n yita, wilgdame tɩ rasempʋɩɩgã maagame. A soabã yaa yɩlemde. Bɩ maan-kʋʋdã wilg t'a soabã yaa yɩlemde.
Rao bɩ pag sã n wa n tar tẽgsem-pɛɛl a yĩn-gãongã zugu,
bɩ maan-kʋʋdã maag a meng n ges a soabã. Sã n mikame tɩ zĩ-pɛɛlgã ka pɩnda, wilgdame tɩ yaa yũy n puk a soabã yĩng zugu. Dẽ, yẽnda soab yaa yɩlemde.
Ned zoobd sã n sʋʋg t'a soab lebg zu-kõogo, yẽnda yaa yɩlemde.
Ned rĩir zoobd sã n sʋʋge, yẽnda soab yaa dĩirẽ zu-kõogo. A soab yaa yɩlemde.
La nodr sẽn tẽgs pɛɛl-pɛɛl miid-miid sã n puk dĩirã sẽn kõogã zugu, wall kãarã sẽn kõogã zugu, wilgdame tɩ yaa wãood n puk a soabã zugu.
Wakat-kãnga, maan-kʋʋdã tog n maaga a meng n ges a soabã. Dẽ, b sã n mik tɩ bãagã zĩigã lebga nodre, n tar pɛɛl la miid rĩirẽ wã bɩ kãarẽ wã, n wẽnd wa wãood sẽn yaa to-to yĩn-gãong zugã,
rat n togsame t'a soabã yaa wãoore, la a yaa rẽgdo. Bɩ maan-kʋʋdã wilg t'a soabã yaa rẽgdo. Bala, wãood n yõk a soabã zugu.
Sã n wa n yaa a woto, bɩ wãoorã yeelg fu-kʋdse, la a ra leb n sãas a zug ye. Bɩ a lud a no-kõbdã n kelem n yeele: Rẽgdo! Rẽgdo!
La bãagã sẽn na n tall yẽnda wã tɛka, a na n yɩɩ rẽgdo. A soabã sẽn lebg rẽgdã yĩnga, a tog n vɩɩmda a yembre. Yẽnda tog n yii sik zĩigã pʋg n tɩ vɩɩmd kɛɛnga.
B sã n mik tɩ wãood n puk fuug sẽn wʋg ne pe-kõbd zugu, sã n ka rẽ bɩ fuug sẽn wʋg ne lamd gĩsg zugu,
a sã n bee pãnd zugu, wall gĩs-lobr zugu, wall a sã n bee gãong zugu, bɩ zapd teed zugu,

bãagã sẽn puk zĩig ningã sã n lebg kẽega, bɩ miuug fuugã zugu, wall gãongã zugu, sã n ka rẽ bɩ pãndã bɩ gĩs-lobrã zugu, wall zapdã teed zugu, wilgdame tɩ yaa wãood bãaga. Bɩ b tall-a n tɩ wilg maan-kʋʋdã.
Bɩ maan-kʋʋdã maag a meng n ges-a, la a rɩk bũmb nins wãoodã sẽn tarã n ning kɛɛng rasem a yopoe.

La rasem a yopoe wã daare, bɩ a gese. Sã n mik tɩ bãagã yalga fuugã zugu, bɩ pãnda, wall gĩs-lobrã zugu, sã n ka rẽ bɩ zapdã teed zugu, wilgdame tɩ yaa wãood sẽn sɩd yaa wẽnga. Dẽ, bõn-kãng lebga rẽgdo.

Dẽ, bɩ maan-kʋʋdã rɩk bãmb n yõog bugum. Sã n yaa fuugu, bɩ pãnde, wall gĩs-lobre, bɩ pe-kõbdo, wall lamd gĩsga, wall sã n leb n yaa zapd teed zug la bãagã be, yaa wãood sẽn yaa wẽnga. Sẽn yaa teed nins fãa, bɩ b yõog-a bugum.
La maan-kʋʋdã sã n mik tɩ bãagã ka yalg fuugã bɩ pãndã zugu, wall a ka yalg gĩs-lobrã bɩ zapdã teed zugu,
bɩ a kɩt tɩ b pek bũmb ning bãagã sẽn yõkã, t'a reeg-a n leb n ning kɛɛng rasem a yopoe.

B sã n pek bũmbã n sɛ, bɩ maan-kʋʋdã reeg-a n maag a meng n ges-a. Bãagã sã n ka tek yalẽ, la baa a sã n ka yalge, bũmbã ket n yaa rẽgdo, la a tog n yõog-a-la bugum. Bãagã sã n bee bũmbã nen-lebendẽ tɩ yaa a nen-sõngẽ, ka rẽ la yellã ye.
La maan-kʋʋdã sã n mik tɩ pekrã poore, bãagã boogame, bɩ maan-kʋʋdã wolg gĩsgã, wall zapdã teoogã zĩ-kãngã.
La bãagã sã n leb n puk fuugã zugu, sã n ka rẽ bɩ pãndã zugu, wall zapdã teoog zugu, wilgdame tɩ yaa wãoodo. Wakat-kãng bɩ b yõog bũmb ning bãagã sẽn yõkã bugum.
La b sã n pek fuugã, bɩ pãndã, sã n ka rẽ bɩ zapdã teoogã, n mik tɩ bãagã yi n bas-a lame, bɩ b leb n pek-a naoor a yiibẽ soaba, n kɩt t'a lebg yɩlemde.
Woto yaa tõogo, wãood wɛɛngẽ, sẽn kẽed ne fuugu, pãnde, gĩsga, wall zapd teed wɛɛngẽ. Tõ-kãngã kɩtdame tɩ b bãng bũmb ning b sẽn yeel tɩ yaa yɩlemde, wall yaa rẽgdo.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yeela a Moyiis yaa:
Daar ning b sẽn na n tall yĩn-gãong bãag soab n wa maan-kʋʋdã nengẽ tɩ b yɩlg-a wã, ad tõog ning sẽn kẽed bõn-kãng wɛɛngẽ.
Maan-kʋʋdã yita sik zĩigẽ wã n maag a meng n ges yĩn-gãong bãagã soaba, la a sã n mik t'a yĩn-gãong bãagã sãoogame n bas-a,
bɩ maan-kʋʋdã yeel tɩ b bao liuun-vɩɩs a yiib sẽn yaa yɩlmã, ne sɛɛdr tɩɩg raado, la peen-miuugu, ne izop tɩɩg vãad n tall n wa ne bãadã meng yɩlgr yĩnga.
La bɩ maan-kʋʋdã kɩt tɩ b kodg liuun-vɩɩg a yembr yagd laag ning ko-sõngã sẽn be a pʋgẽ wã zugu.
La bɩ a rɩk liuun-vɩɩg ning sẽn ketã, ne sɛɛdr tɩɩgã raado, la peen-miuugã n paas ne izop tɩɩgã vãadã, n suk liuul ning b sẽn kodg ko-sõngã zugã zɩɩm pʋga.
Bɩ a yãk zɩɩmã n mes ned ning sẽn dat-a yɩlgr ne a wãoodã naoor a yopoe. Dẽ poore, bɩ a wilg t'a soabã lebga yɩlemde, la a rɩk liuun-vɩɩgã n bas t'a yɩk n kẽ weoogã.

Ned ning sẽn paam-a yɩlgrã tog n pegsa a futu, la a põng a yĩngã kõbdã zãnga, la a so koom. Dẽ, a lebga yɩlemd zãnga. Rẽ sã n looge, a soabã tõe n yaool n kẽe sik zĩigã pʋga, la a tog n paa yɩng rasem a yopoe n yaool n kẽ a fu-roogẽ wã.

La rasem a yopoe wã daare, bɩ a põng a yĩngã kõbd zãnga, a põng a zugã, a toɛɛngã, ne a nin-kõbdã. Yaa a yĩngã kõbd zãng la a tog n põnge. Rẽ zugẽ, bɩ a pegs a futu, la a so koom. Dẽ, a lebga yɩlemde.

La rasem a nii wã daare, bɩ a soabã wa ne pe-ribli a yiibu sẽn ka tar zanga, ne pe-bi-sadg sẽn zems yʋʋmde, n ka tar zanga, la zom-bãaneg sẽn zems wamd pidingu, b sẽn nag ne kaam, n paas ne kaam sẽn zems litr pʋɩ-sʋka, tɩ yɩ bõn-koaadl kũuni.
Bɩ maan-kʋʋd ning sẽn get-a yɩlgrã yellã tall ned ning sẽn dat-a yɩlgrã ne a kũunã, n kolg Sẽn-Ka-Saab taoore, n yals sɛk roogã noore.

La bɩ maan-kʋʋdã reeg pe-ribl a yembre, n naag ne kaamã litr pʋɩ-sʋkã, n maan maoong tɩ yɩ kũun a beegrã sugr kũun yĩnga. La bɩ a kẽng ne bõn-kãens Sẽn-Ka-Saab taoore, n tɩ yuum-b wa sẽn zems miningã.

La bɩ maan-kʋʋdã kodg pe-riblã zĩig ning b sẽn kʋʋd beegr rũngã ne maoong sẽn yõogd bugmã, sẽn yaa zĩig sẽn welg toorã pʋgã. Bala, beegr maoongã rũngã, ne maoong sẽn yõogd bugmã rũng yaa maan-kʋʋdã n so. Yẽnda yaa bũmb sẽn welg toor wʋsgo.
Bɩ maan-kʋʋdã rɩk beegr maoongã zɩɩmã, n yãk n tẽk ned ning sẽn dat-a yɩlgrã rɩtg tʋbre, ne a rɩtg nug-raoogo, la a rɩtg nao-raoogo.
La bɩ maan-kʋʋdã rɩk kaamã litr pʋɩ-sʋkã n pʋdg a goabg nugã pʋga.
La bɩ maan-kʋʋdã tẽk kaamã sẽn be yẽnda goabg nugã pʋgã ne a rɩtg nug-bil n mes Sẽn-Ka-Saab taoor naoor a yopoe.

Maan-kʋʋdã tog n dɩka kaamã sẽn ket yẽnda nugẽ wã, n yãk bilf n tẽk ned ning sẽn dat-a yɩlgrã rɩtg tʋbre, ne a rɩtg nug-raoogo, la a rɩtg nao-raoogo. A tẽkdame n bʋʋg beegr maoongã zɩɩm yẽnda sẽn dag n tẽgsã.
Dẽ poore, maan-kʋʋdã rɩkda kaamã sẽn kell yẽnda nugẽ wã, n ning ned ning sẽn dat-a yɩlgrã zugu, n yiis nin-kãng yel-wẽnã Sẽn-Ka-Saab taoore.

Rẽ zugẽ, bɩ maan-kʋʋdã maan maoong n kos sugr a soabã yel-wẽnd yĩnga. Yẽnda tog n maana woto tɩ ned ning sẽn dat-a yɩlgrã rẽgdã tõe n paam yẽesgo. Rẽnda sã n sɛ, maan-kʋʋdã kodgda maoong sẽn yõogd bugmã rũnga.
Maan-kʋʋdã tog n dɩka maoong sẽn yõogd bugmã ne bõn-koaadl kũunã n naag taab n yõog bugum tẽn-kugrã zugu. Bɩ maan-kʋʋdã yɩlg-a, la a na n lebga yɩlemde.

Sã n mikame t'a yaa naong soab n ka tar pãn-tõog sẽn sekde, bɩ a bao pe-ribl-yend n wa ne tɩ yɩ beegr maoongã yĩnga, tɩ b yuum-a n maan paoosg yẽnda yĩnga. La a bao zom-bãaneg wam-yɛng sẽn nag ne kaam, la kaam litr pʋɩ-sʋk n wa ne tɩ yɩ kũuni.
La a wa ne wal a yiibu, wall man-wan-bi a yiib sẽn zems a pãnga, t'a yembrã yɩ maoong yel-wẽndã yĩnga, t'a to wã yɩ maoong sẽn yõogd bugmã yĩnga.
La rasem a nii wã daare, bɩ a tall kũun-kãens fãa n wa maan-kʋʋdã nengẽ, sɛk roogã noor Sẽn-Ka-Saab taoore, a mengã yɩlgr yĩnga.
Bɩ maan-kʋʋdã reeg pe-riblã ne kaamã litr pʋɩ-sʋkã n maan beegr maoongã, n yuum-a Sẽn-Ka-Saab taoore.
Bɩ maan-kʋʋdã kodg maoongã pe-riblã. La a tẽk beegr maoong rũngã zɩɩmã, n ning ned ning sẽn dat-a yɩlgrã rɩtg tʋbre, ne a rɩtg nug-raoogo, la a rɩtg nao-raoogo.
La bɩ maan-kʋʋdã rɩk kaamã n kiig a goabg nugã pʋga.
La bɩ a rɩk a rɩtg nug-bilã n tẽk kaamã sẽn be yẽnda nug-goabgã pʋgã n mes Sẽn-Ka-Saab taoor naoor a yopoe.

La maan-kʋʋdã tog n yãka zɩɩmã sẽn ket yẽnda nugẽ wã, n tẽk ned ning sẽn dat-a yɩlgrã rɩtg tʋbre, ne a rɩtg nug-raoogo, la a rɩtg nao-raoogo. A tog n tẽk-a lame n bʋʋg beegr maoongã zɩɩm yẽnda sẽn dag n tẽkã.
Bɩ maan-kʋʋdã rɩk kaam ning sẽn kell yẽnda nugẽ wã n kiig sẽn dat-a yɩlgrã zugu, n kɩt t'a paam a beegrã sugr Sẽn-Ka-Saab taoore.
Rẽ poore, bɩ a reeg wallã, bɩ man-wãn-bil a yembr ning a sẽn wa ne wa sẽn zems a sẽn maan a pãng sẽn tõe
n paamã, n maan maoong a beegrã yĩnga, la a rɩk a to wã n maan maoong sẽn yõogd bugum n naag ne bõnkoaadl kũunã. La bɩ maan-kʋʋdã maan yɩlgr tʋʋmd ned ning sẽn dat-a yɩlgrã yĩng Sẽn-Ka-Saab taoore.
Yõwã yaa ned sẽn tar wãood yɩlgr tõogo, t'a soabã paoong yaool n ka waoogẽ ye.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab leb n yeela a Moyiis ne a Aarõ yaa:
Yãmb sã n wa n ta Kana tẽngã mam sẽn kõ yãmb tɩ y soogã pʋgẽ, tɩ mam kɩt tɩ wãood bãag puk tẽngã roog zugu,
bɩ ned ning sẽn so-a roogã kẽng n tɩ togs maan-kʋʋdã n yeele: «Mam yãnda bũmb sẽn puk mam doogã zug wa bãaga.
Bɩ maan-kʋʋdã kõ noor tɩ b vaag roogã teed zãng tɩ yẽnda yaool n kẽ n maag a meng n ges bãagã. Woto, bũmb ning fãa sẽn dag n be roogã pʋgẽ wã ka rẽgem ye. Rẽ poore, bɩ maan-kʋʋdã kẽ n ges roogã.
Bɩ a ges bãagã. Maan-kʋʋdã sã n mik tɩ lond n be roogã lals zug n yaa kẽega, wall miuugu, n wẽnd wa a võda lalgã n kẽ pʋgẽ,
bɩ maan-kʋʋdã lebg n yi roogẽ wã, la a sã n ta roogã noore, bɩ a lebs roogã n pag n bas tɩ ta rasem a yopoe.
La rasem a yopoe wã daare, bɩ maan-kʋʋdã lebg n leb roogẽ wã. La a sã n tɩ mik tɩ bãagã yalga roogã lals zugu,
bɩ a kõ noor tɩ b yãk kug nins bãagã sẽn be b zutã, n tall-b n yi tẽngã kɩreng n tɩ lob zĩ-rẽgd zĩigẽ.
La bɩ maan-kʋʋdã kɩt tɩ b pẽeg roogã bolbã, n wʋk boalgã n yi tẽngã kɩreng n tɩ lob zĩ-rẽgd zĩigẽ.
Rẽ poore, bɩ b bao kug a taab n lebs b sẽn yãk-b rãmbã zĩigẽ. La b bao boalg a to n lebs n bol roogã.
La b sẽn yãgs kugã, la b pẽeg roogã boalgã, n lebs n bol-a wã poore, b sã n mik tɩ bãagã leb n pukame,
bɩ maan-kʋʋdã lebg n leb roogẽ wã, la a sã n yãnd tɩ bãagã yalga roogã lals zutu, wilgdame tɩ yaa wãood sẽn ka sɛt n tar doogã. Ro-kãng lebga bõn-dẽgdo.
Bɩ b siig roogã, la b wʋk a kugã ne a sugrã zãnga, ne roogã boalgã, n yi tẽngã kɩreng n tɩ lob zĩ-rẽgd zĩigẽ.
La roogã sẽn ket n pagã wakate, ned sã n kẽ a pʋgẽ, a soab na n yɩɩ rẽgd hal tɩ ta zaabre.
La ned ning sẽn na n gãand-a roogã pʋg tog n pegsa a futu. Ned ninga me sẽn na n dɩ-a roogã pʋg tog n pegsa a futu.
La b sẽn lebs roogã n bolã poore, maan-kʋʋdã sã n lebg n leb n tɩ mik tɩ bãagã ka yalge, bɩ a wilg tɩ roogã yaa yɩlemde. Tɩ bala, bãagã sɛɛme.
La b sã n na n yɩlg roogã, bɩ maan-kʋʋdã bao liuuli a yiibu, ne sɛɛdr tɩɩg raado, la peen-miuugu, ne izop vãado, n tall n wa.
Bɩ maan-kʋʋdã kodg liuul a yembr yagd laagẽ, ko-bundum sẽn be a pʋgẽ.
La bɩ a rɩk sɛɛdr tɩɩg raoogã, ne izop vãadã, la peen-miuugã, ne liuun-vɩɩgã, n suk bãmb liuul ning b sẽn kʋ wã zɩɩmã ne ko-bundmã sẽn be yagd laagã pʋgã. La a rɩk-a n mes roogã zug naoor a yopoe.
Maan-kʋʋdã sã n dɩk liuulã zɩɩm, ne ko-bundmã, la liuun-vɩɩgã ne sɛɛdr tɩɩgã raadã, la izop vãadã ne peen-miuugã n yɩlg roogã n sɛ,
bɩ a bas liuun-vɩɩgã t'a yɩke, n yi tẽngã n kẽ weoogo. Yaa woto la a tog n maan n yɩlg roogã, la roogã na n yɩɩ yɩlemde.
Yõwã yaa tõog wãood buud fãa ne rasempʋɩɩg buud fãa yĩnga,
la ne fut bãaga, la roog bãag yĩnga.
Yaa bã-moatga, ne nodr buud fãa sẽn pelge.
A yaa zãmsg sẽn wilg bũmb sẽn yaa rẽgdo ne bũmb sẽn ka rẽgdo. Woto yaa tõogo, wãood wɛɛngẽ.»
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yeela a Moyiis ne a Aarõ yaa:
«Yeel-y Israyɛll nebã yaa: ‹Taoor bãag sã n yõk raoa, kɩtdame t'a lebg rẽgdo.
Ad bũmb ning yĩng sẽn kɩt tɩ taoor bãagã sẽn tar a soabã lebg rẽgdã. A zɩɩm sã n yita wall ka yita, baoosg zãnga, a soabã ket n yaa rẽgdo.
Sã n wa yaa a woto, ned ning zɩɩm sẽn yitã sẽn gãand gãag ning zugu, gã-kãng lebga rẽgdo, la a soabã sẽn na n zĩnd bũmb ning zug fãa lebgda rẽgdo.
Ned sã n sɩɩs gã-kãngã, bɩ a soab pegs a futu, la a so koom, la baoosgo, a na n yɩɩ rẽgd hal tɩ ta zaabre.
Ned sã n zomb zĩig ning ned ning zɩɩmã sẽn daagdã sẽn zombẽ wã, a soabã tog n pegsa a futu, la a so koom, la baoosgo, a na n yɩɩ rẽgd hal tɩ ta zaabre.
Ned sã n sɩɩs rao ning zɩɩmã sẽn daagd a soabã yĩnga, a tog n pegs a futu, la a so koom, la baoosgo, a na n yɩɩ rẽgd hal tɩ ta zaabre.
Ned ning zɩɩm sẽn daagdã sã n tʋbs ned sẽn yaa yɩlemde, nin-kãng tog n pegs a futu, la a so koom, la baoosgo, a na n yɩɩ rẽgd hal tɩ ta zaabre.
Ned ning zɩɩm sẽn daagdã sẽn na n zomb gaar ning fãa n tog sore, gaarã lebgda rẽgdo.
Ned ning zɩɩm sẽn daagdã sã n zĩnd n bʋʋg bũmbu, baa sẽn yaa bũmb ninga, tɩ ned sɩɩs bũmbã, nin-kãng tog n pegsa a futu, la a so koom, la baoosgo, a na n yɩɩ rẽgd hal tɩ ta zaabre.
Ned ning zɩɩm sẽn yitã sã n sɩɩs neda, n ka reng n pegs a nusã ne koom, bɩ a soabã pegs a futu, la a so koom, la baoosgo, a na kell n yɩɩ rẽgd hal tɩ ta zaabre.
Ned ning zɩɩm sẽn yitã sã n sɩɩs yagd laoko, bɩ b wãag laok-kãnga, la a sã n yaa laok sẽn maan ne raoogo, bɩ b los-a koomẽ n peke.
Ned ning sẽn tar-a pend bãag t'a zɩɩm yitã sã n dat n yɩlg a menga, bɩ a rɩk rasem a yopoe tõr a yɩlgrã yĩnga. Yẽnda tog n pegs a futu, la a tɩ bao ko-bundum n so, n yaool n tõog n yɩ yɩlemde.
La rasem a nii wã daare, bɩ a bao wal a yiibu, wall man-wan-bi a yiibu, n kẽng Sẽn-Ka-Saab taoore, sɛk roogã noore, n dɩk-b n kɩs maan-kʋʋdã.
La bɩ maan-kʋʋdã reeg-b n dɩk a yembr n maan yel-wẽnã maoongo, la a rɩk a to wã, n maan maoong sẽn yõogd bugum. Bɩ maan-kʋʋdã maan a woto n yɩlg a soabã Sẽn-Ka-Saab taoore, a zɩɩmã sẽn yitã yĩnga.
Rao rogem bõn-buud koom sã n daagdẽ, a soabã tog n so a yĩngã tõr koom, la a na n kell n yɩɩ rẽgd hal tɩ ta zaabre.
Rogem bõn-buudã koom sã n daag n mad fuugu, wall gãongo, bɩ b los-b koomẽ n pegse, la b na n kell n yɩɩ rẽgd hal tɩ ta zaabre.
Rao ne pag sã n kẽ ne taaba, bɩ b so koom, la b na n kell n yɩɩ rẽgd hal tɩ ta zaabre.› »
«Pag sã n yãnd a pekre, a na n yɩɩ rẽgd hal tɩ ta rasem a yopoe tõre. La ned sã n sɩɩs-a, yẽnda soab na n yɩɩ rẽgd hal tɩ ta zaabre.
Pʋg-kãng sã n gãand gãag zug a pekrã wakate, gãagã na n yɩɩ rẽgdo, la bũmb ninga fãa zug pʋg-kãng sẽn na n zomb na n yɩɩ rẽgdo.
Ned ning sẽn na n sɩɩs-a gãag ning pʋg-kãng sẽn gãand a zugã, tog n pegs a futu, la a so koom, la a na n kell n yɩɩ rẽgd hal tɩ ta zaabre.
Ned ning sẽn sɩɩs-a bũmb ning pʋg-kãng sẽn zombã, a soabã tog n pegsa a futu, la a so koom, la a na n kell n yɩɩ rẽgd hal tɩ ta zaabre.
Pagã sẽn gãand gãag ning zugã, wall a sẽn zomb bũmb ningã, ned sã n sɩɩs-ba, a soab na n yɩɩ rẽgd hal tɩ ta zaabre.
Rao sã n gãand ne pʋg-kãngã, t'a zɩɩmã sẽn daagdã bol-a, rao-kãng na n yɩɩ rẽgd hal tɩ ta rasem a yopoe, la gãag ning fãa zug rao-kãng sẽn na n gãandã na yɩɩ rẽgdo.
Pag zɩɩm sã n daagdẽ t'a pekr wakat ka ta, wall a pekrã sã n kaoos n yɩɩg rasem sõor ning sẽn zems pekr rasmã, pʋg-kãng na n yɩɩ rẽgd hal n tãag a zɩɩmã raagr sɛɛbo, wa yẽnda sẽn yãnd a pekrã wakatã.

La yẽnda sẽn na n gãand gãag ning fãa zug na n kell n yɩɩ rẽgd wa gãag ning zug yẽnda sẽn gãand a pekrã wakatã, la bũmb ning fãa yẽnda sẽn na n zomb a zugu, a na n yɩɩ rẽgd wa yẽnda sẽn yãnd a pekrã wakatã.
Ned ning sẽn na n sɩɩs-a bãmb na n yɩɩ rẽgdo. A soabã tog n pegs a futu, la a so koom, la a na n kell n yɩɩ rẽgd hal tɩ ta zaabre.
Pagã sã n paam yɩlgr ne a zɩɩmã sẽn daagdã, na n taa rasem a yopoe, t'a yaool n yɩ yɩlemde.
La rasem a nii wã daare, bɩ a bao wal a yiibu wall man-wan-bi a yiibu, n tall n tɩ kɩs maan-kʋʋdã sɛk roogã noore.

La bɩ maan-kʋʋdã reeg-b n yãk a yembr n maan yel-wenã maoongo, la a rɩk a to wã n maan maoong sẽn yõogd bugum. Bɩ maan-kʋʋdã maan a woto n yɩlg-a Sẽn-Ka-Saab taoore, t'a paam a meng ne zɩɩmã sẽn dag n dẽgm-a wã.
Bɩ y kɩt tɩ Israyɛll nebã sã n wa be rẽgd pʋga, bɩ b zãag b mens ne sɛk-roogã. Dẽ, bãmb ka na n ki b rẽgdã yĩng ye. Yaa sẽn na n yɩlẽ tɩ bãmb da wa rẽgem mam sɛk-zĩigã sẽn be bãmb sʋkã ye.
Woto yaa tõog pend bãag yĩnga, la ne rogem bõn-buud koom sẽn daagd yĩnga.
Yaa pag sẽn yãnd a pekre, wall pag bɩ rao zɩɩm sẽn daagde, la rao sẽn na n kẽ ne pag sẽn yãnd a pekre.»
A Aarõ kom-dibli wã sẽn kẽng Sẽn-Ka-Saab taoor n ki wã loogr zugẽ, Sẽn-Ka-Saab goma ne a Moyiisi.

Sẽn-Ka-Saab yeela a Moyiis yaa: «Yeel f kẽem a Aarõ t'a ra n kẽed sɛk roogã pʋg wakat fãa ye, t'a ra lɩk fu-lillidgã sẽn be kaset koglgã sɛɛgã ye. Sẽn na n yɩlẽ t'a ra wa ki ye. Bala, mam na n puka m meng sawadg pʋg bas-taal koglgã zugu.
Ad a Aarõ sẽn na n kẽ sɛk roogã pʋg to-to. A tog n zãa loalg sẽn na n maan kongr maoongo, la a zã pe-raoog sẽn na n maan maoong sẽn yõogd bugum.

Yẽnda tog n yeelga fu-yor-wɛlgdgã b sẽn wʋg ne lamd gĩs-bãanega, la a sẽgen lamd gĩs-bãanega, la a sẽbg sẽbdg b sẽn wʋg ne lamd gĩs-bãanega, la a vil a zug ne zu-vindg b sẽn wʋg ne lamd gĩs-bãanega. Bãmbã fãa yaa te-yerdɩ sẽn welg toore, la a tog n soo koom n yaool n yeelg-ba.
A Aarõ tog n deega boees a yiib Israyɛll nebã nengẽ yel-wẽnã maoong yĩnga, la a reeg pe-raoog maoong sẽn yõogd bugmã yĩnga.
A Aarõ tog n baoo loalg n maan a mengã yel-wẽn maoongo, n maan paoosg yẽnda mengã ne a yirã rãmb yĩnga.
Yẽnda tog n dɩka boees a yiibã n yalsg-b Sẽn-Ka-Saab taoore, sɛk roogã noore.
Bɩ a Aarõ maan poeer boees a yiibã zutu, yaa poeer sẽn na n maan n bãng boɛɛg ning sẽn na n yɩ-a Sẽn-Ka-Saab rẽndã, la sẽn na n yɩ-a a Azazɛll rẽnda.
La bɩ a Aarõ rɩk boɛɛg ning poeerã sẽn yãk tɩ yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab rẽndã n maan yel-wẽnã maoongo.
La bɩ b tall boɛɛg ning poeerã sẽn yãk tɩ yaa a Azazɛll rẽndã, n wa Sẽn-Ka-Saab taoor vɩɩga, n maan paoosg tʋʋmd ne-a, la b rig-a n kẽes weoog a Azazɛll yĩnga.
Bɩ a Aarõ wa ne loalg ning sẽn na n yɩ-a yel-wẽnã maoong yĩngã, n maan paoosg yẽnda ne a yirã rãmb yĩnga. Yẽnda tog n kodga loalgã a mengã yel-wẽnã yĩnga.
A Aarõ tog n dɩka wisd laag n yãk tẽn-kugrã zug bugmã bug-saal n pids-a Sẽn-Ka-Saab taoore, la a yõng wisd-zomã nug-pidung a yiib n ningi, n tall bõn-kãens fãa n kẽ fu-lillidgã poore.
A tog n yãka wisdã n ning bugmã zug Sẽn-Ka-Saab taoore, tɩ wisdã bug-zõos lud bas-taal zĩigã sẽn be koglgã limdã zugã. Woto, yẽnda ka na ki ye.
Bɩ a tẽk loalgã zɩɩmã ne a nug-bil n mes bas-taal zĩigã yaangã. Bɩ a tẽk zɩɩmã ne a nug-bil n mes bas-taal zĩigã taoor naoor a yopoe.

La bɩ a kodg nebã yel-wẽnã maoongã boɛɛg n kok a zɩɩmã n tall n kẽ fu-lillidgã pʋga. Yẽnda tog n dɩka zɩ-kãng n maan wa yẽnda sẽn dag n maan to-to ne loalgã zɩɩmã, n yãk-a n mes bas-taal zĩigã zugu, ne a taoore.

Yaa a woto la yẽnda tog n maan zĩig sẽn welg toor n yɩɩdã yĩnga, Israyɛll nebã sẽn dẽgmã ne b tʋʋm-beedã, la b yel-wẽnã fãa yĩnga. Yẽnda tog n maana a woto me ne sɛk roogã sẽn be ne bãmb b rẽgdã sʋkã.

A Aarõ sã n wa n kẽ zĩig sẽn welg toor n yɩɩdã pʋg n na n maan yɩlgr tʋʋmdã, bɩ ned ra kẽ sɛk roogã pʋg ye, hal t'a Aarõ wa n yi be. A Aarõ tog n kosa sugr a mengã yĩnga, la a zakã rãmb yĩnga, ne Israyɛll nebã fãa yĩnga.
Bɩ a Aarõ yi n kẽng tẽn-kugrã sẽn be Sẽn-Ka-Saab taoorã n tɩ yɩlg-a. Bɩ yẽnda yãk loalgã ne boɛɛgã zɩɩm n ning tẽn-kugrã kogsã fãa zut n gilgi.
A Aarõ tog n tẽka zɩɩmã ne a nug-bil n mes tẽn-kugrã zug naoor a yopoe. Yẽnda na n maana a woto n yɩlg tẽn-kugrã la a welg-a toore, Israyɛll nebã sẽn dẽgmã yĩnga.
A Aarõ sã n yɩlg zĩig sẽn welg toor n yɩɩdã ne sɛk roogã ne tẽn-kugrã n sɛ, bɩ a tall boe-vɩɩgã n kolge.

Bɩ a Aarõ rɩk a nus a yiibã n tik boe-vɩɩgã zugu, n vẽneg n togs Israyɛll nebã kongrã fãa ne b yel-beedã zãnga, ne b yel-wẽnã fãa tɩ sig boe-vɩɩgã zugu. Yẽnda sã n sik yel-bãmb boɛɛgã zug n sɛ, bɩ a rɩk-a n kɩs rao ning sẽn pẽ yẽnda sɛɛgẽ t'a rig-a n kẽes weoogo.
La boɛɛgã na n zɩɩ bãmb kongrã fãa a zug n zoe n kẽng zĩ-zãrga. Bɩ b rig boɛɛgã n kẽes weoogo.
Dẽ, bɩ a Aarõ lebg n kẽ sɛk roogã pʋga, n yees a fut nins sẽn wʋg ne lamd gĩsã, yẽnda sẽn dag n yeelg wakat ning a sẽn wa n dat n kẽ zĩig sẽn welg toor n yɩɩdã pʋgẽ wã, n bas-b beenẽ.

Yẽnda tog n kẽe zĩig b sẽn welg toorã pʋg n so koom, la a lebs a futã n yeelge, n yi n maan maoong sẽn yõogd bugum yẽnda mengã yĩnga, la a maan maoong sẽn yõogd bugum nebã yĩnga. Woto yaa sẽn na n yɩlg a meng la a yɩlg nebã me.
Bɩ a rɩk maoongã rũng kaam n yõog bugum tẽn-kugrã zug yel-wẽnã sugr kũun yĩnga.
Ned ning sẽn dig boɛɛgã n kẽes weoog a Azazɛll yĩngã tog n pegsa a futu, la a so koom. Rẽ poore, a na yaool n kẽ sik zĩigã pʋga.
La loalg ning ne boɛɛg ning b sẽn kʋ yel-wẽnã yĩng n yãk b zɩɩmã n kẽ zĩig sẽn welg toorã pʋg n maan paoosgã, b tog n dɩka bãmb n yiis sik zĩigã pʋg n yõog bugum ne b gãndã, la b nemdã ne b pʋ-teedã.
Ned ning sẽn na n yõog-a bãmb bugmã tog n pegsa a futã, la a so koom, la rẽ poore, a na yaool n kẽ sik zĩigã pʋga.

Ad no-tũudg ning sẽn ka sɛtã, b sẽn kõ yãmb t'a tog n pa wakat fãa yĩngã. Kiuug a yopoe soabã rasem piig daare, bɩ y loe noore, la y bas y tʋʋmã fãa, sã n yaa tẽng-n-neda, wall sãan sẽn wa n be yãmb sʋka.
Bala, yaa badaar la b maand paasg tʋʋmd yãmb yĩnga, n yɩlg yãmba. Dẽ, yãmb na n paama yɩlgr ne y yel-wẽnã fãa Sẽn-Ka-Saab taoore.
Badaar na n yɩɩ vʋʋsg daar yãmb yĩnga, la yãmb tog n loee noore. Yõwã yaa no-tũudg sẽn ka sɛta.

Yaa maan-kʋʋd ning b sẽn yãk n pʋdg a zug kaam n ning maan-kʋʋr tʋʋmd a zug t'a tõe n ledg a ba zĩig maan-kʋʋrã tʋʋmd pʋgã, n na n yeelg a fut nins sẽn welg toorã sẽn wʋg ne lamd gĩsã, n maan paoosg tʋʋmdã.
Maan-kʋʋdã tog n maana paoosg tʋʋmdã zĩig sẽn welg toor n yɩɩdã yĩnga, la sɛk roogã yĩnga, la ne tẽn-kugrã yĩnga, la a maan paoosg maan-kʋʋdbã yĩnga, la Israyɛll nebã yĩnga.

No-tũud-kãngã yaa yãmb yĩng wakat sẽn kõn sa yĩnga, sẽn na n yɩlẽ tɩ yʋʋmd pʋgẽ fãa vugri, bɩ yãmb maan bõn-kãng n yɩlg Israyɛll nebã yel-wẽnã fãa.» Bãmb maana wa Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn dag n yeel a Moyiisã.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yeela a Moyiis yaa:
«Yeel a Aarõ ne a kambã, la Israyɛll nebã fãa yaa: ‹Ade, Sẽn-Ka-Saab yetame:
Israyɛll buudã ned sã n kodg naaf bɩ pesgo, wall bʋʋg sik zĩigã pʋga, wall a yɩnga,
n ka reng n tall-a n wa Sẽn-Ka-Saab sɛk roogã noor n wa rɩk-a n kõ Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, b na n soka a soabã, a sẽn daag zɩɩmã yĩnga. Yẽnda sẽn daag zɩɩmã yĩnga, b na n yiisa yẽnda a buudã sʋka.

Woto yaa sẽn na n yɩlẽ tɩ Israyɛll nebã ra tall b maoongã n tɩ maan we-kɛɛnga, la tɩ b tõe n tall-a n wa Sẽn-Ka-Saab nengẽ sɛk roogã noore, maan-kʋʋdã taoore, tɩ b maan vɩ-bãan maoong Sẽn-Ka-Saab waoogr yĩnga.
Bɩ maan-kʋʋdã rɩk zɩɩmã n mes Sẽn-Ka-Saab tẽn-kugrã zugu, sɛk roogã noore, la a rɩk kaamã n yõog bugum tɩ yɩ yũ-noog Sẽn-Ka-Saab yĩnga.
Israyɛll nebã ka tog n leb n maan b maoongã tẽn-kugã sẽn yaa boeesã zutu, bõn-kãng yaa wa yoobo. Yõwã na n yɩɩ no-tũudg sẽn ka sɛta, bãmb ne b yagensã yĩnga.
Dẽ wã, yeel-b yaa: ‹Israyɛll buudã neda, bɩ sãan sẽn be yãmb sʋkã sã n dat n maan maoong sẽn yõogd bugum wall maoong a to,
n ka reng n tall-a n wa sɛk roogã noor tɩ yɩ Sẽn-Ka-Saab rẽnda, b na n yiisa nin-kãngã soab a buudã sʋka.› »
«Israyɛll buudã neda, wall sãamb nins sẽn be bãmb sʋkã ned sã n dɩ zɩɩm, baa sẽn yaa bũmb ning zɩɩm, mam na n wẽnemda m neng n bas a soabã, a sẽn dɩ zɩɩmã yĩnga, la mam na n yiisa yẽnda a buudã sʋka.
Bala, yĩngã vɩɩm bee zɩɩmẽ wã. Mam kõt-a-la yãmb tɩ y raag-a tẽn-kugrã zugu, tɩ yãmb tõe n paam y yel-wẽnã sugri. Bala, yaa vɩɩm sẽn be zɩɩmã pʋgẽ wã yĩng n kɩt tɩ zɩɩm tõe n pek yel-wẽnã.
Yaa rẽndã yĩng n kɩt tɩ mam yeel Israyɛll nebã yaa: Bɩ yãmb ned baa a yembr da rɩ zɩɩm ye. La sãan sẽn be yãmb sʋkã me ka tog n dɩ zɩɩm ye.
Israyɛll nebã sʋk neda, bɩ sãamb nins sẽn be bãmb sʋkã ned sã n kẽng tãoosg n tɩ paam rũng bɩ bõn-yɩgdre, b sẽn tar noor n tõe n wãb a nemdã, bɩ b raag a zɩɩmã tẽng n bus-a ne tom.

Bala, bõn-vɩɩl buudã fãa vɩɩm bee a zɩɩmẽ. Yaa rẽ yĩng n kɩt tɩ mam yeel Israyɛll nebã yaa: Da rɩ-y bũmb zɩɩm ye. Bala, bõn-vɩɩl buudã fãa vɩɩm be a zɩɩmẽ. La ned sã n dɩ zɩɩm b na n yiis-a-la buudã sʋka.

Ned ning fãa sẽn na n dɩ-a rũng sẽn ki a toore, wall rũng a to sẽn kʋ, sã n yaa tẽng-n-neda, wall sãana, bɩ a soab pegs a futu, la a so koom, la yẽnda na n yɩɩ rẽgd hal tɩ ta zaabre, n yaool n lebg yɩlemde.
La a soabã sã n ka pegs a futu, la a so koom, a kongrã na n zĩnda a meng zugu.»
Sẽn-Ka-Saab goma ne a Moyiis n yeele:
«Gom ne Israyɛll nebã n yeel-b tɩ mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa yãmb Wẽnnaam.

Yãmb ka tog n maan wa Ezɩpt tẽngã nebã sẽn maandã ye, tẽng ning yãmb sẽn dag n beẽ wã ye. La da maan-y wa Kana tẽngã, zĩig ning mam sẽn tar yãmb n dabdã nebã sẽn maandã ye. Da sak-y n tũ-y bãmb noyã ye.
Bɩ y sak mam noyã, la y sak mam no-tũudsã. Bɩ y sak-ba. Bala, mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa yãmb Wẽnnaam.
Bɩ y tall mam no-tũudsã ne m noyã. Ned ning sẽn na n sak-a bãmba, b na n kɩtame t'a vɩɩmde. Mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saabo.
Bɩ yãmb ned baa a yembr da kẽ ne pag sẽn yaa a roagd ye. Mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saabo.
Bɩ f ra kẽ ne f ba, bɩ f ma ye. A sẽn yaa fo ma wã yĩnga, fo ka tog n kẽ ne-a ye.
Bɩ f ra kẽ ne f ba pag ye. Yẽnda yaa fo ba rẽnda.
Bɩ f ra kẽ ne f ba-bi-poaka, wall f ma-bi-poak ye. A sã n doga yiri, wall kɛɛnga.
Bɩ ned ra kẽ ne a bi-ribl bi-pugla, wall a bi-pugl bi-pugl ye. Bala yaa yẽnda mengã yĩn-neongo.
Bɩ f ra kẽ ne f ba pag bi-pugl sẽn yaa yẽnda ba wã meng biiga, bala, yẽnda yaa a tão-poaka.
Bɩ f ra kẽ ne f pʋgdb ye. Bala yẽnda yaa f ba wã tão-poaka.
Bɩ f ra kẽ ne f ma ba-bi-poak ye. Yẽnda yaa fo ma.
Bɩ f ra kẽ ne f saamba, wall kẽ ne a saamb pag ye. Bala yẽnda yaa f ma.
Bɩ f ra kẽ ne f bi-pag ye. Bala yẽnda sẽn yaa fo biigã pagã, fo ka tog n kẽ ne-a ye.
Bɩ f ra kẽ ne f ba-biig pag ye. Yẽnda yaa f ba-biigã rẽnda.
Bɩ f ra kẽ ne paga, la f kẽ ne pagã bi-pugl ye. La f ra peeg a bi-ribl bi-pugla, wall a bi-pugl bi-pugl n kẽ ne-a ye. Bala bãmb yaa bũmb a yembre, dẽ, bõn-kãng yaa yãnde.
Bɩ f ra peeg f pag tão-poak n paas tɩ rẽ wata ne pʋg-ta-zaba. Bɩ f ra kẽ ne-a tɩ f pagã ket n vɩ ye.
Bɩ f ra kẽ ne pag a sẽn yãnd a pekr wakat ye, tɩ rẽ t'a yaa rẽgdo.
Bɩ f ra kẽ ne f tẽng-n-bi-taag pag n dẽgem f meng ne-a ye.
Bɩ f ra rɩk f kamb n kɩs tɩ b yõog bugum n kõ wẽn-naandg a Molok n paoog fo Wẽnnaamã yʋʋr ye. Mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saabo.
Bɩ f ra kẽ ne rao wa fo sẽn kẽed ne pag to-to wã ye. Yõwã yaa yel-beedo.
Bɩ f ra kẽ ne rũng n dẽgem f meng ne-a ye. Bɩ pag me ra rɩk a meng n kõ rũng t'a gãand-a ye. Yõwã yaa yel-beedo.
Bɩ y ra maan yel-bãmbã baa a yembr n dẽgem y mens ye. Bala, buud nins mam sẽn kɩt tɩ yãmb digã rag n maanda yel-be-bãmbã.
Yaa rẽ yĩng n kɩt tɩ tẽngã rẽgem, la mam sɩbg-a-la a yel-wẽnã yĩnga, la tẽngã yiisa a nebã.
Rẽ wã, bɩ y sak mam no-tũudsã ne m noyã, la y ra maan yel-be-bãmbã baa a yembr ye, sã n yaa tẽng-n-neda, wall sãan sẽn wa n be yãmb sʋkã.
Bala, neb nins sẽn dag n deng yãmb n be tẽn-kãng pʋgã rag n maanda yel-be-bãmbã, n kɩt tɩ tẽngã lebg rẽgdo.
Woto wã, bɩ y ra leb n dẽgem tẽngã n kɩt t'a zãgs yãmb wa a sẽn dag n zãgs neb nins sẽn dag n deng yãmb n be beenẽ wã ye.
Bala, ned ning fãa sẽn na n maan-b yel-be-bãmbã a yembre, b na n yiisa a soab kɛɛng n kʋ.
Bɩ y sak mam tõogã, la y ra tol n maan yel-beed nins neb nins sẽn deng yãmbã sẽn dag n maandã ye. Bɩ y ra maan bõn-kãens n dẽgem y mens ye. Bala, mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa yãmb Wẽnnaam.»
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yeela a Moyiis yaa:
«Gom ne Israyɛll nin-buiidã n yeel-b yaa: Yɩ-y pʋ-peelem dãmba, bala, maam a Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa yãmb Wẽnnaamã yaa pʋ-peelem soaba.
Bɩ yãmb ned kam fãa waoog a ba, la a ma, la a sak mam vʋʋsg rayã. Bala, mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa yãmb Wẽnnaam.
Da waoog-y wẽn-naandse, la y ra yẽneg kut n maan wẽn-naands ye. Bala, mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa yãmb Wẽnnaam.
Yãmb sã n na n maan zems-n-taar maoong n kõ Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, bɩ y maan-a wa sẽn zemse, tɩ mam tõe n sak n deeg-a.
Yãmb tog n wãba maoongã rũng nemd maoongã daare, wall a vẽkembeoogo. La a sã n kell n ta rasem a tãabo, bɩ y rɩk-a n yõog bugum.
Ned sã n dɩ nem-kellã rasem a tãabã daare, mam ka na n deeg a soab ye. Bala, nemdã yaa bõn-dẽgdo.
Ned ning sẽn dɩt-a nem-kãng rogenda yell a meng zugu, bala, yẽnda paooga bũmb ning sẽn welg toor Sẽn-Ka-Saab yĩngã. Bɩ y yiis nin-kãng soab a buudã sʋk n kʋ.
Yãmb sã n wa n tigsd y bõn-koaadlã y tẽngã pʋga, bɩ y bas kood nins sẽn be pʋʋgã kɩrengã n da kẽeb ye. La da leb-y poorẽ n wʋk kood ning sẽn pa pʋʋgẽ wã tigsgã poorã ye.

Sẽn paas me, yãmb ka tog n tõs reezẽ-gĩnã sẽn pa wilẽ wã tigsgã poorã ye. La y ra lebg n wʋk reezẽ-bɛɛlã sẽn dʋʋgã ye. Bɩ y bas bõn-kãense, ninbãan-nebã ne sãambã yĩnga. Bala, mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa yãmb Wẽnnaam.
Bɩ y ra zu ye. Bɩ yãmb ned ba a yembr da rõd a tẽng-n-bi-taaga, la ra-y zãmb-y-yã-a ye.
Bɩ y ra wẽen zĩrẽ wẽeneg ne mam yʋʋr ye. Bala, y sã n maan woto, y paoogda mam yʋʋrã. Mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saabo.
Bɩ f ra wẽg f to, la ra zu-a ye. Da bas f tʋm-tʋmd yaood f nengẽ n vẽeg beoog ye.
Ra kãab wʋng kãab-beed ye. La ra f ning bẽdg zoang taoor t'a lak ye. Bɩ f zoe Wẽnnaam. Mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saabo.
Da kao bʋʋd kegr ye. Ra mong naong soab bʋʋm a naongã yĩnga, la f ra kõ nin-kãseng bʋʋm a sẽn yaa nin-kãsengã yĩng ye. Bɩ y kao ba-biig bʋʋd tɩrga.
Bɩ y ra kãneg taab ye. Ra rõd f to tɩ b kʋ-a ye. Mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saabo.
Bɩ f ra kisg f ba-biig f sũurẽ ye, bɩ f wilg-a a kongre, n da wa n bao yell n dogl f meng yẽnda yĩng ye.
Ra rok f sũuri ye, la f ra tall sũur ne f tẽngã ned ye. Nong f to wa f menga. Mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saabo.
Bɩ y sak mam tõodã. Bɩ f ra rɩk rũms buud toor-toor a yiib n kɩt tɩ b rʋ taab ye. Da rɩk bõn-buud buud toor-toor a yiib n bʋd f pʋʋgẽ ye. La fo ka tog n yeelg fuug sẽn wʋg ne gĩs buud a yiib ye.

Rao sã n gãand yem-poak b sẽn dag n dɩk n kõ ned t'a na n maan paga, tɩ b mik t'a soabã nan ka yaoo ligdã, wall a yem-poakã soaalã sã n nan ka kõ-a lohorem, bɩ b sɩbg-a soabã, la b ka tog n kʋ-b ye. Bala, yem-poakã nan ka paam lohorem ye.
La raoã tog n talla pe-raoog n wa ne sɛk roogã noore, Sẽn-Ka-Saab taoore, tɩ b maan paoosg maoong a beegrã sugr yĩnga.
Bɩ maan-kʋʋdã rɩk beegr pe-raoogã n maan paoosg maoong a soabã yel-wẽnd yĩnga, la b na n kõo yẽnda sugr a beegrã yĩnga.
Yãmb sã n wa n tɩ kẽ tẽngã pʋga, n sel tɩɩs buud toor-toor sẽn womd biisi, bɩ y ges tɩ-biisã wa b sẽn ka kẽ bãongo. Yãmb tog n geelg-b-la a woto hal tɩ ta yʋʋm a tãabo, n ka tol n yãk-b n dɩ ye.
La yʋʋm a naasẽ yʋʋmdã, bɩ y yãgs b biisã fãa, la y maan tigr n welg-b toor Sẽn-Ka-Saab waoogr yĩnga.
Yʋʋm a nu soabã tɛka, yãmb tõe n dɩɩ tɩɩsã biisi, la yãmb na n wobda tɩɩsã biis y meng sõngr yĩnga. Bala, mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa yãmb Wẽnnaam.
Bɩ y ra rɩ rũng ne a zɩɩm ye. Bɩ y ra yɩ tɩ-rɩtba, la y ra yɩ bag-bʋgdb ye.
Bɩ y ra põng y zut gils-gils ye. Bɩ f ra põng f toɛɛng kɩrems ye.
Bɩ y ra bog y yĩnsã kũum yĩnga, la y ra gʋl y yĩnsã me ye. Mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saabo.
Ra modg f bi-pugl n kẽes yoob pʋga, n wa kɩt tɩ tẽngã nebã maan yoobo, n kɩt tɩ tẽngã pid ne yãn-tʋʋm ye.
Bɩ y sak mam vʋʋsg rayã, la y waoog mam sɛk roogã. Mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saabo.
Da wẽnemd-y n bao-y neb nins sẽn boond sɩɩse, wall bag-bʋgdb ye. Da bao-y nin-bãmbã rãmb n wa rẽgem y meng ye. Mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-saabo, n yaa yãmb Wẽnnaam.
Bɩ y põond n waoog zoob-peend soaba, la y waoog nin-kẽema. Bɩ f zoe Wẽnnaam. Mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saabo.
Sãan sã n wa n be ne yãmb y tẽngã pʋga, bɩ y ra wẽg-a ye.

Bɩ y maan sãan sẽn be yãmb sʋkã neer wa yãmb sẽn maand tẽng-n-ned sẽn be yãmb sʋkã to-to wã. Bɩ f nong-a wa f menga, tɩ bala, yãmb me yɩɩ sãamb Ezɩpt tẽngã pʋga. Mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa yãmb Wẽnnaam.
Da maan-y tʋʋm-kɛg ye, sã n yaa bʋʋd zĩigẽ wall woglem makre wɛɛngẽ, sã n ka rẽ bɩ zɩslem makdg wɛɛngẽ, wall sã n yaa poɛɛm makr wɛɛngẽ ye.
Bɩ y tall makds sẽn yaa sõama, sã n yaa zɩslem makdga, kug makdga, wall poɛɛm-makdga. Bala, mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa yãmb Wẽnnaam sẽn yiis yãmb Ezɩpt tẽngã pʋga.
Bɩ y gũusi, n sak mam no-tũudsã ne m noyã n maan wa b sẽn yeelã. Mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saabo.»
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yeela a Moyiis t'a
wilg Israyɛll nebã yaa: «Israyɛll nebã sʋk neda, wall sãan sẽn be yãmb sʋkã sã n dɩk a biig n kɩs tɩ b kõ Moloke, a soabã sɩbgr na n yɩɩ kũum. Tẽngã nebã tog n loba a soab ne kug t'a ki.

Mam na n kisga a soabã, la m na n yiisa a soabã a buudã sʋk n kɩt tɩ b kʋ, tɩ bala, yẽnda rɩka a biig n kɩs tɩ b kʋ n kõ Moloke, n kɩt tɩ mam sɛk roogã rẽgme, la a kɩt tɩ mam yʋʋrã sẽn welg toorã paam paoogre.
Tẽngã nebã sã n yãk yam n mum b nin n bas ned ning sẽn dɩk-a a biig n kõ Molokã, la b sã n bas-a n ka kʋ,
mam meng n na n sɩbg a soabã, la m sɩbg a buudã, la mam na n yiisa a soabã a buudã sʋka, la mam na n yiisa neb nins fãa sẽn wẽnemd n bas maam n maan yoob ne a Molokã.
Ned sã n wẽnemd n bas maam n pʋʋs kɩɩmse, wall a bas n pʋg bagba, bõn-kãng wẽnda yoobo, la mam na n wẽnemdame n zab ne a soabã, la m na n yiis-a-la a buudã sʋka.
Bɩ y yɩlg y mens n yɩ pʋ-peelem dãmba, bala, maam a Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa yãmb Wẽnnaamã yaa pʋ-peelem soaba.
Bɩ y sak mam tõodã, n sak n maan wa b sẽn wilgã. Mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, la yaa maam n welg yãmb toore.
Ned sã n tʋʋs a ba, bɩ a ma, a soab sɩbgr tog n yɩɩ kũum. Yẽnda sẽn tʋʋs a ba wã bɩ a ma wã yĩnga, yẽnda zɩɩmã raagr taal be a meng zugu.
Ned sã n maan yoob ne pag sẽn tar sɩda, a sã n maan yoob ne a to paga, bɩ b kʋ pagã ne raoã sẽn yaa yoaadbã fãa.
Rao sã n kẽ ne a ba paga, n ning a ba wã yãnde, bɩ b kʋ raoã ne pagã, la bãmb zɩɩmã taal bee b meng zugu.
Rao sã n kẽ ne a bi-paga, bɩ b kʋ bãmb b yiibã fãa. Bãmb maana yel-beedo, dẽ bãmb zɩɩmã taal bee bãmb meng zugu.
Raop a yiib sã n gãand taab wa rao sẽn kẽed ne pag to-to wã, bãmb b yiibã fãa maana yel-beedo. Bãmb b yiibã fãa tog n kiime, la bãmb zɩɩmã taal be b meng zugu.
Rao sã n dɩk bi-pugl ne a ma n maan a pagba, yaa yãn-tʋʋmã. Bɩ b yõog raoã ne pagbã fãa bugum, sẽn na n yɩlẽ tɩ yãn-tʋʋm-kãngã ra leb n zĩnd yãmb sʋk ye.
Rao sã n gãand rũnga, bɩ b kʋ a soabã, la b kʋ rũngã me.
Pag sã n dɩk a meng n kõ rũng t'a gãand-a, bɩ b kʋ pagã ne rũngã fãa. Bɩ y kʋ-ba, la b zɩɩmã taal bee b meng zugu.
Rao sã n peeg a tão-poaka, n kẽ ne-a, sã n yaa a ba-biig bɩ a ma-biiga, yaa yãnde. Bɩ b rig-b b tẽngã nebã fãa nifẽ n yiis b buudã sʋka. Bala, rao-kãng kẽe ne a tão, la a kongrã taal be a meng zugu.
Rao sã n peeg pag n kẽ ne-a a pekr wakate, n yãnd pagã zɩɩmã, tɩ pagã me yã zɩɩmã, bɩ b rig bãmb b yiibã fãa n yiis b buudã sʋka.
Bɩ f ra sak n kẽ ne f ma tão-poaka, wall ne f ba tão-poak ye. Bala, f maana yãnd ne f roagdba. Neb nins sẽn maan-b woto wã kongrã taal na n zĩnda b mens zutu.
Rao sã n kẽ ne a ba kẽem paga, bɩ a ba yao paga, bãmb yel-wẽndã taal na n zĩnda b meng zugu, la bãmb na n kiime n ka paam biig ye.
Ned sã n dɩk a ba-biig pag n maan a paga, a maana rẽgdo. Bãmb ka na n tol n paam kamb ye.
Bɩ y sak mam no-tũudsã fãa ne mam noyã fãa, la y ning-b b nao-kẽndr zugu, dẽ, tẽng ning mam sẽn na n tall yãmb n kẽng tɩ y tɩ zĩnd a pʋgẽ wã ka na n zãgs yãmb ye.
Bɩ y ra sak buud nins mam sẽn na n dig yãmb taoorã no-tũudsã ye. Bala, bãmb maana tʋʋm-be-kãensã fãa tɩ mam yamã yi-ba.

Mam yeela yãmb tɩ yaa yãmb n na n deeg tẽngã n sooge. Mam mengã n na n kõ yãmb tẽngã tɩ y sooge. Beenẽ yaa tẽng sẽn tar bĩisim ne sɩɩdo. Bala, mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa yãmb Wẽnnaam sẽn welg yãmb toor buud a taabã sʋka.

Yaa rẽ yĩnga, tɩ yãmb tog n bãng rũms nins sẽn yaa yɩlmã n welg ne rũms nins sẽn ya-b rẽgdã, la y bãng bõn-yɩgdɩ nins sẽn yaa rẽgdã n welg ne sẽn ya-b yɩlmã wã, sẽn na n yɩlẽ tɩ yãmb mensã ra lebg bõn-dẽgd rũm-bãmbã yĩnga, la ne bõn-yɩgdɩ wã, la ne bũmb nins fãa sẽn saagd tẽn-gãongã zugã mam sẽn lebs kɛɛng n wilg-y tɩ b yaa rẽgdã yĩng ye.
Yãmb tog n yɩɩ pʋ-peelem dãmb mam yĩnga, bala, maam a Sẽn-Ka-Saab yaa pʋ-peelem soaba. Mam welga yãmb toor buud a taabã sʋka, tɩ yãmb tõe n yɩ mam dẽnda.
Rao bɩ pag sã n tar pãn-tõog n tõe n bool kɩɩms wall a yaa baga, bɩ b kʋ-ba. B tog n loba bãmb ne kug tɩ b ki. La bãmb zɩɩmã taal na n zĩnda b meng zugu.»
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yeela a Moyiis yaa: «Yeel a Aarõ kom-dibli wã sẽn yaa maan-kʋʋdbã yaa: ‹Maan-kʋʋd ka tog n sɩɩs a buudã ned kũum n dẽgem a meng ye.
Sã n ka tɩ mikame tɩ yaa a roagd meng-menga, rat n yeel t'a ma, a ba, a bi-ribl bɩ a bi-pugla, a kẽem bɩ a yao,
la a tão-poak sẽn nan ka bãng raoa, a sẽn dag n nan ka kẽ kãadmã, yẽnda tõe n sɩɩs-a lame, rao sẽn dag n nan ka so-a wã yĩnga. Yẽnda tõe n dẽgma a meng a tão-poakã yĩnga.
Maan-kʋʋdã sẽn yaa taoor soab a nebã sʋkã yĩnga, a ka tog n maan yaar n dẽgem a meng ye.
Maan-kʋʋdbã ka tog n põng b zug tẽn-sʋka, la b ka tog n kok b toɛɛnga, la b ka tog n bog b yĩngã ye.

Bãmb tog n yɩɩ pʋ-peelem dãmb b Wẽnnaamã yĩnga, la b ra paoog b Wẽnnaamã yʋʋr ye. Bala, bãmb n wat ne rɩɩb kũun b Wẽnnaamã yĩnga, n maand maand sẽn yõogd bugum n kõt Sẽn-Ka-Saabo. Bãmb tog n yɩɩ pʋ-peelem dãmba.
Bãmb ka tog n peeg pʋg-yoodr bɩ bi-pugl sẽn sãam n maan b pag ye. B ka tog n dɩk pag a sɩd sẽn dig n bas n maan b pag ye. Bala, maan-kʋʋd yaa pʋ-peelem soab a Wẽnnaamã yĩnga.

Bɩ y geelg maan-kʋʋd wa ned sẽn welg toore, bala, yaa yẽnda n kõt yãmb Wẽnnaamã kũunã. Yẽnda tog n yɩɩ pʋ-peelem soab fo yĩnga, bala, maam a Sẽn-Ka-Saab yaa pʋ-peelem soaba, la yaa maam n kɩt tɩ yãmb yaa pʋ-peelem dãmba.
Maan-kʋʋd bi-pugl sã n maan yoob n dẽgem a menga, a paooga a ba. B tog n lob-a-la bugmẽ.
Maan-kʋʋd ning b sẽn pʋdg a zug kaam n dogl-a maan-kʋʋr tʋʋmdã, la b yeelg-a fu-welgdsã n kɩt t'a yaa a saam-biisã kãsmã ka tog n zũndg a zoobdo, la a ka tog n pãrs a fut me ye.
Maan-kʋʋr kãsmã ka tog n pẽneg kũum n dẽgem a meng ye, baa sã n yaa a ba bɩ a ma n ki.
Maan-kʋʋr kãsmã ka tog n yi sɛk roogã pʋg ye, la a ka tog n paoog yẽnda Wẽnnaamã sɛk roogã ye. Bala, b pʋdga yẽnda zug ne a Wẽnnaamã nug-tikr kaam n welg-a toore. Mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saabo.
Maan-kʋʋr kãsmã tog n peega pag sẽn nan ka bãng rao n maan a paga.

Yẽnda ka tog n dɩk pʋg-kõore, a ka tog n dɩk pag b sẽn digi, a ka tog n dɩk pʋg-yoodre, wall a rɩk bi-pugl sẽn sãam n maan a pag ye. La a tog n peega a buudã sʋk bi-pugl sẽn nan ka bãng rao n maan a paga.
Woto, maan-kʋʋr kãsmã ka na n dog kamb sẽn ka zems n kẽes a buudã sʋk ye. Bala, yaa maam a Sẽn-Ka-Saab n welg yẽnda toore.»
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yeela a Moyiis
t'a yeel a Aarõ yaa: «Fo yagensã sẽn na n pʋgl foomã sʋka, ned baa a yembr sẽn tar zang a yĩngã pʋg ka tog n kolg n na n dɩk a rɩɩb kũun n kõ a Wẽnnaamã ye.
Ned ning yĩng sẽn tar zang t'a ka tõe n kolg n kõ kũunã la woto: Yaa zoanga, woabga, wall ned yõor sẽn golme, wall a yĩngã wil a yembr sẽn yaa koɛɛg tɩ looge, wall will a yembr sẽn yaa wok tɩ looge.
Leb n yaa ned naoor bɩ a nug sẽn kaooge,
bɩ ned sẽn yaa yẽoogo, bɩ ned sẽn yaa wagre, la sẽn tar nin-bulga, wall sẽn tar rasempʋɩɩga, bɩ nod-kʋdre, sã n ka rẽ bɩ a yaa ned lan-biis sẽn pusi.

Maan-kʋʋd a Aarõ yagensã sʋka, ned sã n be beenẽ n tar zanga, a ka tog n kolg n maan maoong sẽn yõogd bugum n kõ Sẽn-Ka-Saab ye. Yẽnda sẽn tar zangã yĩnga. Yẽnda ka tog n kolg n dɩk a rɩɩb kũunã n kõ a Wẽnnaamã ye.
Yẽnda tõe n yãka a Wẽnnaamã rɩɩb b sẽn kõ tɩ yaa bũmb sẽn welg toor wʋsgã, ne bũmb nins b sẽn welg toorã n dɩ.

La bũmb sẽn be yaa tɩ yẽnda ka tog n kolg fu-lillidgã, wall a kolg tẽn-kugrã ye. Yẽnda sẽn tar zang a yĩngẽ wã yĩnga. Bɩ yẽnda ra maan n paoog mam zĩ-sõngã ye. Bala, mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn welg bãmb toore.»
Dẽ, a Moyiis rɩka gom-kãens n togs a Aarõ ne a kom-dibli wã, la ne Israyɛll nebã fãa.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yeela a Moyiis yaa:
«Wilg a Aarõ ne a kom-dibli wã tɩ mam yeelame: ‹Gũus-y y mens ne kũun sẽn welg toorã Israyɛll nebã sẽn wat n kõt maamã n da wa paoog mam yʋʋrã ye. Mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saabo.› »

Bɩ f yeel-b yaa: «Zamaan woo zamaane, yãmb yagensã ned ning sẽn dat-a n kolg kũun ning Israyɛll nebã sẽn wa n kõ Sẽn-Ka-Saabã, n yaool n be rẽgd pʋga, bɩ b yiis nin-kãng mam taoor n tɩ kʋ. Mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saabo.

A Aarõ yagensã sʋka, yĩn-gãong bãag bɩ taoor bãag sã n tar neda, a soabã tog n gũusame n da rɩ kũun sẽn welg toorã, hal t'a wa n lebg yɩlemde. A yaa woto me ne ned ning sẽn sɩɩs ned a to sẽn sɩɩs kũum n dẽgem a menga, wall a sẽn sɩɩs neda, a soab rogem bõn-buud koom sẽn daagd wakate,
wall ned sã n sɩɩs bõn-saagdg n dẽgem a menga, wall a sẽn sɩɩs ninsaal sẽn lebg rẽgdo, n dẽgem a menga.
Ned ning sẽn na n sɩɩs-a bõn-kãng na n yɩɩ rẽgd hal tɩ ta zaabre. La yẽnda ka tog n dɩ kũun ning sẽn welg toorã ye, la a tog n soo koom,
la wĩntoogã kõom poore, a soabã na n yaool n lebga yɩlemde, la wakat-kãnga, a tõe n dɩɩ kũun ning sẽn welg toorã, bala, yaa yẽnda rɩɩbo.
Maan-kʋʋd ka tog n dɩ rũng sẽn ki a toore, wall rũng a to sẽn kʋ n dẽgem a meng ye. Mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saabo.
Bãmb tog n gũusa neer n sak mam tõogã n da wa paoog-a, tɩ yel-wẽnd lʋɩ b zug n kɩt tɩ b ki ye. Mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn welg bãmb toore.
Ned sã n ka maan-kʋʋda, a ka tog n dɩ kũun sẽn welg toorã ye. Nin-loaagdg sã n sig yãmba, wall yãmb sã n dɩk ned tʋʋmd n yaood-a, a soab ka tog n dɩ kũun sẽn welg toorã ye.
La maan-kʋʋdã sã n da yamb ne ligdi, yambã tõe n dɩɩ kũun sẽn welg toorã. Sẽn paase, yamb sẽn dog zakã pʋg me tõe n dɩɩ kũun sẽn welg toorã. Bãmb tõe n dɩɩme tɩ bala, yaa b soaal rɩɩbo.
Maan-kʋʋdã bi-pugl ning sẽn kẽ-a kãadem ne ned sẽn ka maan-kʋʋd ka tog n dɩ kũun sẽn welg toorã ye.

La sã n mikame tɩ maan-kʋʋdã bi-pugl yaa pʋg-kõore, wall a yaa pag a sɩd sẽn base, t'a ka tol n paam biiga, t'a lebg n wa be a ba wã zakẽ wa yẽnda sẽn dag n be beenẽ a pʋg-sademd wakatã, yẽnda tõe n dɩɩ a ba wã rɩɩbo. La ned sã n ka maan-kʋʋda, a ka tog n dɩ-a ye.
La ned sã n dɩ kũun sẽn welg toorã ne yĩdgu, bɩ a yao maan-kʋʋdã wa sẽn zems rɩɩbã yaoodo, la a paas yaoodã sẽn pʋɩ zĩis a nu pʋɩɩr a ye.
Maan-kʋʋdbã ka tog n maan yaar ne nebã kũun sẽn welg toorã bãmb sẽn yãk n na n kõ Sẽn-Ka-Saabã ye.
Bãmb sã n bas tɩ Israyɛll nebã rɩ kũun sẽn welg toorã tɩ yaool n ka zemse, bãmb rogenda yell Israyɛll nebã zugu. Mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, la yaa maam n welg maan-kʋʋdbã toore.»
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yeela a Moyiis yaa:

«Gom ne a Aarõ ne a kom-dibli wã, la ne Israyɛll nebã fãa n yeel-b yaa: Israyɛll ned bɩ sãan sẽn be Israyɛll tẽngã sã n dat n maan maoong sẽn yõogd bugum n kõ Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, sã n ka rẽ bɩ a sã n dat n pids a pʋlengo, wall sã n yaa yamleoog kũuni, baa sẽn yaa kũun ning fãa,
bɩ a bao rũm-daoog sẽn ka tar zang rũmsã sʋka, sã n yaa naafo, bɩ pesgo wall bʋʋga, tɩ mam yaool n sak n deege.
Bɩ y ra wa ne rũng sẽn tar zang n na n wa kõ maam ye. Bala, mam ka na n sak n deeg-a ye.

Ned sã n dat n wa ne rũm-bedr bɩ rũm-bil n maan zems-n-taar maoong n kõ Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, sã n yaa pʋleng pidsgu, wall sã n yaa yamleoog kũuni, tog n yɩɩ rũng sẽn ka tol n tar zanga, tɩ Sẽn-Ka-Saab yaool n deege. Rũngã ka tog n tar zang ye.

Yãmb ka tog n kõ Sẽn-Ka-Saab rũng sẽn yaa zoanga, nao-fiuungu, sẽn pogle, wall sẽn tar nodre, wall burguudu bɩ nod-pags sẽn tar ye. Yãmb ka tog n dɩk rũng a woto n maan maoong sẽn yõogd bugum tẽn-kugrã zug n kõ Sẽn-Ka-Saab ye.
Fo tõe n dɩka loalg bɩ pe-ribl sẽn tar nao-wogd n maan yamleoog kũun maoongo, la b ka tõe n dɩk-a n maan pʋleng pidsg maoong ye.
Da rɩk-y rũng lan-biis sẽn pogle, wall sẽn kudi, sã n ka rẽ bɩ sẽn kɩsge, wall b sẽn fiuugi, n maan maoong y tẽngã pʋg n kõ Sẽn-Ka-Saab ye.
Baa sãan sã n wa ne rũng a woto buud bɩ y ra reeg-a tɩ yɩ rɩɩb kũun yãmb Wẽnnaamã yĩng ye. Bala, yaa rũng sẽn tar zanga, n ka sõama ye. Dẽ, Wẽnnaam ka na n sak n deeg yãmb kũun-kãng ye.»
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yeela a Moyiis yaa:
«Naafo, bɩ pesgo, wall bʋʋg sã n doge, b kambã tog n paa ne b ma wã rasem a yopoe. La rasem a nii wã tɛk n tar n dabdã, a tõe n yɩɩ maoong sẽn yõogd bugum Sẽn-Ka-Saab waoogr yĩnga.
Bɩ y ra kʋ nag-yãanga, pe-yãanga wall bʋ-yãang ne a biig daar a yembr ye.
Yãmb sã n na n maan maoong n pʋʋs Sẽn-Ka-Saab barka, bɩ y maan-a wa sẽn segde, tɩ bãmb deeg yãmba.
B tog n wãba rũngã nemd zãng maoongã daar bala, la b ka tog n bas-a t'a vẽeg beoog ye. Mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saabo.
Bɩ y sak mam tõodã, n maan wa b sẽn yeelã. Mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saabo.
Bɩ y ra paoog mam yʋʋrã sẽn welg toorã ye. Kɩt-y tɩ m yʋʋrã paam pẽgr Israyɛll nebã sʋka. Mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn welg yãmb toore,
la m yiisa yãmb Ezɩpt tẽngã n na n yɩ yãmb Wẽnnaam. Mam yaa Sẽn-ka-Saabo.»
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yeela a Moyiis yaa:
«Yeel Israyɛll nebã yaa: ‹Yãmb sã n na n maan tig-bɛdã Sẽn-Ka-Saab yĩnga, bɩ y maan-b tɩ b yɩ tigind sẽn welg toore. Ad mam tig-bɛdã la woto.
Yãmb tõe n tʋma rasem a yoobe, la rasem a yopoe wã daar na n welga toor n yɩ vʋʋsg daare, la yãmb ka tog n tʋm ye. Dẽ, yãmb sẽn na n zĩnd zĩig ninga fãa, a na n yɩɩ vʋʋsg daar Sẽn-Ka-Saab yĩnga.
Ad Sẽn-Ka-Saab tig-bɛda: Yaa yãmb sẽn na n tigim taab Sẽn-Ka-Saab taoore, wa sẽn zems wakat ning yãmb sẽn yãkã.
Pipi kiuugã rasem piig la a naasã daar zaabre, yãmb na n maana Pak tigr Sẽn-Ka-Saab waoogr yĩnga.
La kiuugã rasem piig la a yoobã daare, maan-y bur sẽn ka rã-bɩll tigr n waoog Sẽn-Ka-Saabo. Rɩ-y bur sẽn ka rã-bɩllã tigr rasem a yopoe tõre.
Bɩ y maan tiging sẽn welg toor tigrã pipi daarã, la y ra tʋm tʋʋmd ba a yembr ye.
Rasem a yopoe wã fãa pʋga, bɩ y wa ne kũun b sẽn yõogd bugum Sẽn-Ka-Saab yĩnga. La rasem a yopoe wã daare, maan-y tiging sẽn welg toore, la y ka tog n tʋm badaar ye.› »
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yeela a Moyiis yaa:
«Yeel Israyɛll nebã yaa: ‹Yãmb sã n tɩ kẽ tẽng ning mam sẽn kõ yãmbã pʋgẽ, n na n tigs y bõn-koaadlã, bɩ y yãk y koodã dẽenem biis ka-gĩn n wa kõ maan-kʋʋdã.
La bɩ maan-kʋʋdã reeg-a n yuum Sẽn-Ka-Saab taoor tɩ yɩ kũuni, tɩ bãmb tõe n deeg yãmb kũunã. Yaa vʋʋsg daarã vẽkembeoog la maan-kʋʋdã tog n yuum kũunã.
La yãmb sẽn na n yuum kũunã daare, bɩ y bao pe-ribl sẽn zems yʋʋmde, n ka tar zanga, n maan maoong sẽn yõogd bugum n kõ Sẽn-Ka-Saabo.
La sẽn paase, yaa bõn-koaadl kũuni, la tog n yɩɩ zom-bãaneg wamde, sẽn nag ne kaam tɩ yɩ kũun sẽn yõogd bugum t'a yaa yũ-noog Sẽn-Ka-Saab yĩnga, n leb n paas reezẽ rãam litr a yembr la pʋɩ-sʋka.

Yãmb ka tog n wãb buri, wall ka-sãrdɩ, bɩ ka-paala, hal tɩ ta daar ning yãmb sẽn na n yãk-a n kõ y Wẽnnaamã. Bõn-kãng yaa no-tũudg sẽn ka sɛta, yãmb yagensã fãa yĩnga, la y sẽn na n tɩ zĩnd zĩig ning fãa, wakat sẽn kõn sa yĩnga.
Sẽn sɩng ne vʋʋsg dãarã vẽkembeoogo, daar ning yãmb sẽn na n tall ka-gĩnã n wa tɩ b yuuma, bɩ y sõd rasem pis-naas la a wɛ.
Bɩ y sõd rasem pis-nu sẽn yaa vʋʋsg daarã rasem a yopoeẽ soabã vẽkembeoogã, tɩ ra-kãng me yɩ tigr Sẽn-Ka-Saab yĩnga, n wa ne ka-paalg tɩ yɩ kũuni.
Yãmb sã n yit y zagsã pʋse, bɩ y zã bur a yiib sẽn na n kõ tɩ b yuume. Bur-kãens tog n yɩɩ bur sẽn maan ne zom-bãaneg sẽn ning rã-bɩll n kɩɩme. Rẽndã na n yɩɩ dẽenem biis kũun Sẽn-Ka-Saab yĩnga.

Bũmb ning sẽn tog n paas burã, yaa tɩ yãmb tog n maana maoong sẽn yõogd bugum Sẽn-Ka-Saab yĩnga, ne pe-ribli a yopoe sẽn zems yʋʋmde, n ka tar zanga, ne lol-polle, la pe-raad a yiibu, n paas ne bãmb bõn-koaadl kũunã ne kũun ning b sẽn yõogd bugum t'a yũug yaa noog Sẽn-Ka-Saab yĩngã.
Yãmb tog n kʋʋ boɛɛg yel-wẽnã sugr kũun yĩnga, la y maan zems-n-taar maoong ne pe-ribli a yiib sẽn zems yʋʋmde.
Bɩ maan-kʋʋdã reeg-b n yuum Sẽn-Ka-Saab taoor tɩ yɩ kũuni, n paas ne dẽenem biisã bur n kõ n naag ne pe-ribli a yiibã. Bɩ b rɩk-b n kõ Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, la bõn-kãens na n yɩɩ maan-kʋʋdã rẽnda.

Badaar bala, bɩ y maan tigr Sẽn-Ka-Saab waoogr yĩnga. Ra-kãng na n yɩɩ daar sẽn welg toore. Bɩ y ra maan tʋʋmd ba a yembr badaar ye. Yõwã na n yɩɩ no-tũudg sẽn ka sɛta, yãmb yagensã fãa yĩnga, la zĩig ning fãa yãmb sẽn na n tɩ zĩndẽ.

Yãmb sã n wa n na n tigs y tẽngã koodã, bɩ y bas y pʋʋgã kɩreng n da tigs ye. La y ra wʋk bũmb ning sẽn kell tɩ b tõe n yiisã ye. Bɩ y bas rẽndã tɩ nimbãan-nebã ne sãambã paame. Bala, mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa yãmb Wẽnnaam.› »
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yeela a Moyiis yaa:
«Yeel Israyɛll nebã yaa: ‹Kiuug a yopoe soabã pipi daarã na n yɩɩ vʋʋsg yãmb yĩnga. Bɩ y tigim taab n tẽegd a yelle. Yaa tigr sẽn welg toore.
Badaare, bɩ y ra maan tʋʋmd ye. Maan-y maoong sẽn yõogd bugum n kõ Sẽn-Ka-Saabo.»
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yeela a Moyiis yaa:
«Kiuug a yopoe soabã rasem piigã daare, na n yɩɩ yel-wẽnã sugr kosg daare. La yãmb tog n maana tiging sẽn welg toore, n loe noore, la y maan maoong sẽn yõogd bugum n kõ Sẽn-Ka-Saabo.
Badaare, yãmb ka tog n tʋm tʋʋmd ye. Bala, yaa yel-wẽnã sugr kosg daare. Dẽ, yãmb tog n maana bõn-kãng n yɩlg y meng Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa yãmb Wẽnnaamã taoore.
Ned ning fãa sẽn ka sika a meng badaare, b na n yiisa a soabã a nebã sʋka.
Ned ning sẽn na n tʋma tʋʋmd badaare, mam na n kɩtame tɩ b sãam a soabã a buudã sʋka.
Yãmb ka tog n tʋm tʋʋmd badaar ye. Yõwã yaa no-tũudg sẽn ka sɛta, yãmb yagensã yĩnga, zamaan woo zamaane, la yãmb sẽn na n tɩ zĩnd zĩig ning fãa yĩnga.

Badaar na n yɩɩ vʋʋsg daar yãmb yĩnga, yãmb sẽn tog n vʋʋse. La yãmb tog n loee noore. La sẽn sɩng ki-kãng rasem a wɛ wã daar zaabre, maan-y vʋʋsg daarã tigr n tɩ tãag vẽkembeoogã zaabr ning sẽn pʋgdã.»
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yeela a Moyiis yaa:
Yeel Israyɛll nebã yaa: ‹Kiuug a yopoe soabã rasem piig la a nu daarã, bɩ y maan zãn tigri. La a na n yɩɩ rasem a yopoe tigri, Sẽn-Ka-Saab waoogr yĩnga.
Tigrã pipi daarã na n yɩɩ tigin-kãseng sẽn welg toor daare. Bɩ y ra tʋm tʋʋmd badaar ye.

Bɩ y rɩk rasem a yopoe tõre, n wa ne kũun b sẽn yõogd bugum n wa kõ Sẽn-Ka-Saabo. La a rasem a niiẽ wã daare, bɩ y maan tigin-kãseng sẽn welg toore, la y wa ne kũun b sẽn yõogd bugum n wa kõ Sẽn-Ka-Saabo. Badaar na n yɩɩ tigin-kãseng daare, dẽ, yãmb ka tog n tʋm tʋʋmd badaar ye.

Ade, tigin-bãmbã n yaa tig Sẽn-Ka-Saab yĩnga. Yaa tigind yãmb sẽn na n tigim nebã, tɩ yaa tigind sẽn welg toore, n wa ne kũun b sẽn yõogd bugum, ne maand sẽn yõogd bugum, la bõn-koaadl kũuni, ne maand a taaba, la bõn-yũudl kũuni, wa sẽn zems noor ning b sẽn kõ daar fãa yĩngã wɛɛngẽ.
Sẽn paas Sẽn-Ka-Saab vʋʋsg rayã, yãmb tog n waa ne y kũunã, la y pʋleng pidsg kũunã, ne y yamleoog kũunã fãa, n wa kõ Sẽn-Ka-Saabo.

Kiuug a yopoe soabã rasem piig la a nu wã daare, yãmb sã n dɩk y tẽngã bõn-koaadlã, bɩ y maan tigr n waoog Sẽn-Ka-Saab rasem a yopoe. Pipi daarã na n yɩɩ vʋʋsgo, la rasem a niiẽ daarã me na n yɩɩ vʋʋsg daare.
Pipi daarã, bɩ y bao tɩ-sõama wã biisi, ne koms vãado, tɩɩs wil sẽn tar vãado, ne ko-soodã noor yɩlsã, n tall-b n maan sũ-noog Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa yãmb Wẽnnaamã taoor rasem a yopoe.
Yʋʋmd fãa yãmb tog n maana tig-kãngã n waoog Sẽn-Ka-Saab rasem a yopoe. Yõwã yaa no-tũudg sẽn ka sɛta, yãmb yagensã fãa yĩnga, zamaan woo zamaane. Bɩ y maan tig-kãngã kiuug a yopoe soabã pʋga.
Yãmb tog n zĩnda sẽgd pʋs rasem a yopoe. Ned ning fãa sẽn yaa-a Israyɛll tẽngã neda, a tog n zĩnda sẽgd pʋse.
Yaa sẽn na n yɩlẽ tɩ yãmb yagensã fãa tõog n bãng tɩ mam sẽn yiis Israyɛll nebã Ezɩpt tẽngã poore, mam kɩtame tɩ b zĩnd sẽgd pʋse. Bala, mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa yãmb Wẽnnaam.»
Yaa woto la a Moyiis gom ne Israyɛll nebã, n wilg-b Sẽn-Ka-Saab tig-kãsemsã.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yeela a Moyiis yaa:
«Yeel Israyɛll nebã tɩ b tall oliiv kaam bãmb sẽn wõd n wa kõ foom, tɩ f ning fɩtlã tɩ vẽenem zĩnd daar fãa.

A Aarõ tog n ninga fɩtl-dãmbã sɛk roogã pʋg n pẽneg fu-lillidgã sẽn lill kaoolã koglgã. La a tog n yõgen-b-la zaabr fãa tɩ b be Sẽn-Ka-Saab taoor n wit hal tɩ ta yibeoogo. Yõwã yaa no-tũudg sẽn ka sɛta, yãmb yagensã fãa yĩnga.
A Aarõ tog n dɩka fɩtl-dãmbã n dogl sãnem halaal fɩtl-dogendsã zut tɩ b wit Sẽn-Ka-Saab taoor daar fãa.»
«Bɩ f bao zom-bãaneg n maan bur-maas piig la a yiibu, bur-maasr fãa tog n yɩɩ wũmbl a yembre.
Bɩ f rɩk-b n tong taab sãnem taablã zugu, rulg a yiibu, yoob-yoobe, Sẽn-Ka-Saab taoore.
Bɩ f rɩk wisd zom-bãaneg n yugl rulg fãa zugu, zomã tog n zĩnda maasã zug tɩ yɩ tẽegre, la kũun b sẽn yõogd bugum Sẽn-Ka-Saab waoogr yĩnga.
Vʋʋsg daar fãa, bɩ b ning bur-kãens Sẽn-Ka-Saab taoore. B tog n yãka bõn-kãng Israyɛll nebã sẽn so wã pʋga. Yõwã yaa kaool sẽn paad wakat sẽn ka sɛt yĩnga.

Bõn-kãng na n yɩ a Aarõ ne a kom-dibli wã rẽnda, la bãmb tog n dɩ-a-la zĩig sẽn welg toorã pʋga, tɩ bala, kũun sẽn welg toor wʋsgã b sẽn yõogd bugum Sẽn-Ka-Saab waoogr yĩngã sʋka, bur-kãens n na n yɩɩ a Aarõ ne a kom-dibli wã pʋɩɩre. Yõwã yaa no-tũudg sẽn ka sɛta.»
Daar a yembre, Israyɛll neb a yiib n zab taab sik zĩigã pʋga. La a yembrã ma yaa Israyɛll bi-pugla, t'a baaba wã yaa Ezɩpt tẽng raoa. Bãmb dag n wa n kẽeda Israyɛll nebã sʋka.
Israyɛll bi-pugl-kãng biigã tʋʋsa Sẽn-Ka-Saab n paoog b yʋʋrã. La b tall-a lame n kẽng a Moyiis nengẽ. Bi-kãng ma wã yʋʋr boondame t'a Selomiti, n yaa a Dibri bi-pugla, n yaa Dan buudã neda.
B baoo zĩig n tɩ ning-a, n gũudẽ tɩ Sẽn-Ka-Saab meng noor gomd wilg yellã sẽn na n yɩ a soaba.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yeela a Moyiis yaa:
«Kɩt tɩ b yiis ned ning sẽn tʋʋs-a maamã sik zĩigã pʋga, la bɩ y kɩt tɩ neb nins sẽn wʋm tʋʋsgã rɩk b nusã n tik a zugã, tɩ nebã fãa lob-a ne kug t'a ki.
Ad fo sẽn na n yeel Israyɛll nebã to-to: ‹Ned sã n paoog a Wẽnnaamã, a yel-wẽndã taal na n zĩnda a meng zugu.
Ned ning sẽn na n tʋʋs-a Sẽn-Ka-Saab yʋʋre, a sɩbgr na n yɩɩ kũum. Nebã fãa na n lob-a-la kug t'a ki. Ba a sã n yaa sãana, wall tẽng-n-neda, a soabã sẽn tʋʋs Wẽnnaam yʋʋrã yĩnga, a tog n kiime.
Ned sã n wẽ ninsaal n kʋ, bɩ b kʋ a soabã.
Ned sã n wẽ a to rũng n kʋ, bɩ a bao rũng n lebse.
Ned sã n pogl a to, bɩ b pogl a soab pogl-kãng buud n lebse.
Sã n yaa kaoobo, bɩ b kaoog n lebse, la nifu, nif yĩnga, la yẽnde, yẽnd yĩnga. Poglg ning a soabã sẽn pogl a to wã, b na n pogl-a-la pogl-kãng n lebse.
Ned sã n wẽ a to rũng n kʋ, bɩ a bao rũng n lebse, la sã n yaa ned n wẽ a to n kʋ, bɩ b kʋ a soabã.
Tõogã tog n yɩɩ a yembr nebã fãa yĩnga, sã n yaa sãana wall tẽng-n-neda. Bala, mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa yãmb Wẽnnaam.»
A Moyiis rɩka koe-kãens n taas Israyɛll nebã. La b yiisa sẽn tʋʋs-a wã sik zĩigã yɩng n lob kug n kʋ. Israyɛll nebã maana wa Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn dag n yeel a Moyiisã.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yeela a Moyiis Sinayi tãngã zug yaa:
«Gom ne Israyɛll nebã n wilg-b tɩ b sã n wa n tɩ kẽ tẽng ning mam sẽn kõ bãmbã pʋgẽ, bɩ b bas tẽn-gãongã t'a vʋʋse, tɩ rẽndã yɩ vʋʋsgo, Sẽn-Ka-Saab waoogr yĩnga.
Yãmb tõe n bʋda y pʋtã yʋʋm a yoobã pʋga, la y yos y reezẽ tɩɩse, la y wob b biisã yʋʋm a yoobã pʋse.
La yʋʋm a yopoeẽ soabã na n yɩɩ vʋʋsg yʋʋmde, tɩ y bas tẽn-gãongã t'a vʋʋse. Rẽndã yaa vʋʋsgo, Sẽn-Ka-Saab waoogr yĩnga. Yʋʋm-kãnga, yãmb ka tog n bʋd y pʋtã, la y ka tog n yos y reezẽ tɩɩsã ye.
Yãmb ka tog n tigs ka-yogd sẽn yi wã biisi, la y ka tog n wob y reezẽ tɩɩsã y sẽn ka yosã biis me ye. Bala, yaa vʋʋsg yʋʋmde. Yʋʋm-kãng yaa tẽn-gãongã vʋʋsg yʋʋmde.
Bũmb ning sẽn na n yi weoogã pʋg vʋʋsg yʋʋmdã pʋgẽ wã n na n dɩlg yãmb ne y yem-daadã, la y yem-pogsã, ne y tʋmtʋmdbã y sẽn dɩk n yaood-b ligdã, la ne nin-loogds nins sẽn yaa sãamb n be ne yãmbã,
n paas ne yãmb rũmsã ne we-rũmsã sẽn be yãmb tẽngẽ wã. Bõn-kãng biisã fãa n na n yɩɩ b rɩɩbo.»
«Bɩ y sõd vʋʋsg yʋʋm a yopoe-poe naoor a yopoe, sẽn dat n togs tɩ yʋʋm pis-naas la a wɛ.
Kiuug a yopoe soabã rasem piigã daar sẽn yaa yel-wẽnã sugr kosg daarã, bɩ y kɩt tɩ b peeb baorg ne pãnga, bɩ y peeb baorgã t'a rãamdã ta yãmb tẽngã tɛk fãa pʋga.

La bɩ y welg yʋʋmd pis-nu yʋʋmdã toore, n moon lohorem tõog yãmb tẽngã pʋga, nebã fãa yĩnga. Yʋʋm-kãng na n yɩɩ kɩdeng yʋʋmd yãmb yĩnga. La yãmb ned kam fãa na n leb n sooga a pʋto, la a lebg n leb a meng nebẽ.
Yʋʋm pis-nu yʋʋmdã na n yɩɩ kɩdeng yʋʋmd yãmb yĩnga. Yãmb ka tog n bʋde, la y ka tog n tigs bõn-koaadl ning sẽn yi a toor pʋtã pʋsã biisi, la y ka tog n wob reezẽ tɩɩsã y sẽn ka yosã biis ye.
Bala, yʋʋm-kãng yaa kɩdeng yʋʋmde. Bɩ y welg yʋʋm-kãng toore. Bɩ y rɩ pʋtã biisi.
Kɩdeng yʋʋmdã pʋga, yãmb ned kam fãa tog n leb n deega a sẽn dag n so.
Yãmb sã n na n koos bũmb ne y saam-biiga, wall y sã n dat n da bũmb a nengẽ, bɩ y ra wẽg-a ye.
Yãmb sã n dat n da y saam-biig bũmbu, bɩ y sõd n bãng kɩdeng yʋʋmdã sẽn loog yʋʋm sõore. La a tog n sõda yʋʋm sõor sẽn ket tɩ kɩdengã yʋʋmd ta wã n yaool n koos ne foom.
Yʋʋmã sõor sã n keta wʋsgo, bɩ f yao wʋsgo. La yʋʋmã sõor sã n ket bilfu, bɩ f yao bilfu. Bala, yaa bõn-bɩʋʋngã sasa sõor la a geend n yaool n koos ne foom.
Bɩ yãmb ned ba a yembr da wẽg a ba-biig ye, bɩ y zoe yãmb Wẽnnaamã. Bala, mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa yãmb Wẽnnaam.
Bɩ y sak m tõodã, ne m noyã, la y maan wa b sẽn yeelã. Dẽ, yãmb na n zĩnda y tẽngã pʋg ne bãane.
Yãmb tẽngã bõn-koaadl na n woma biisi, la yãmb na n dɩɩ n tɩgame, la y na n zĩnda beenẽ ne bãane.
Yãmb sã n sokdẽ: ‹Yʋʋm a yopoe wã pʋga, tõnd na n dɩɩ bõe, tɩ tõnd yaool n ka bʋtẽ, la d ka tigsdẽ?
Yʋʋm a yoobã pʋga, mam na n ninga yãmb barka, n kɩt tɩ bõn-koaadlã wom yʋʋm a tãab koodo.
La yʋʋm a nii yʋʋmdã pʋga, yãmb na n bʋdame, la y na n kell n dɩ y ka-kʋdgã n tɩ tãag yʋʋm a wɛ wã pʋga. Yãmb na n dɩɩ ka-kʋdgã hal tɩ ta bõn-bɩʋʋngo.
Yãmb ka tog n koos pʋʋg tɩ b soog-a wakat fãa yĩng ye. Bala, tẽn-gãongã yaa maam n so, tɩ bala, yãmb bee mam nengẽ wa sãamba, la wa kaoos-weto.
Dẽ wã, bɩ y zĩnig tõog tẽng ning mam sẽn kõ yãmbã fãa pʋgẽ, n wilgdẽ tɩ ned sã n koos a pʋʋgo, a tõe n leb n yao n deeg-a lame.
Naong sã n yõk yãmb ba-biiga, t'a yãk a pʋʋg n koose, yẽnda buudã ned sẽn yaa a meng roagd tõe n wa yaoome n deeg a ba-biigã pʋʋgã a sẽn koosã.
La sã n mik t'a ka tar ned a buudã sʋk sẽn tõe n yao n deege, tɩ yaa yẽnda mengã n na n yao n deege,
bɩ a sõd yʋʋm nins sẽn loog pʋʋgã koosg zugẽ wã, la a yao sẽn da-a pʋʋgã ligdã n dogl yõodo, la a leb n soog a pʋʋgã.
La sã n mikame tɩ yẽnda ka tar bũmb n na n yao n deege, pʋʋgã na n kell n paa raadã nugẽ n tãag kɩdeng yʋʋmdã. La kɩdeng yʋʋmdã pʋga, pʋʋgã na n leb n lebga a soabã rẽnda.
Ned sã n dɩk a zag-gãadg sẽn be tẽng sẽn gũbg ne lals pʋg n koose, yẽnda tog n basame tɩ ta yʋʋmd t'a yaool n yao n deeg a zakã. Yaa yʋʋmd a yembrã poor la yẽnda tõe n yao n deeg a zakã.

La b sã n ka tõog n yao n deeg zakã sẽn be tẽng sẽn tar lalsã pʋgã, n bas tɩ yʋʋmdã pidsi, zakã na n lebga ned ning sẽn da-a wã ne a yagensã rẽnd wakat fãa. La baa kɩdeng yʋʋmdã sã n ta, a ka na n leb n lebs-a ye.

La sã n yaa ne zags nins sẽn be tẽn-bãoonegã sẽn ka tar-b lalsã pʋsẽ wã, b tog n maana bãmb wa b sẽn maand pʋtã to-to wã. B tõe n leb n yaoome n deeg-a, la kɩdeng yʋʋmdã sã n ta, bɩ sẽn da-a zakã lebs zakã a soaba.
La sã n yaa ne Leevi buudã tẽmsã, ne zags nins sẽn yaa bãmb rẽndã, Leevi buudã tara noor wakat fãa tɩ leb n yao n deeg-ba.
Baa sã n yaa Leevi buudã ned n da zakã, kɩdengã yʋʋmd sã n ta, bɩ a yi n bas zakã, wall tẽngã yẽnda sẽn dag n so wã, tɩ bala, Leevi buudã zagsã ne tẽmsã sẽn be Israyɛll nebã sʋkã, yaa b soolem.
La b ka tog n dɩk pʋt nins sẽn pẽ bãmb tẽmsã n koos ye. Bala, rẽndã na n yɩɩ bãmb soolem wakat fãa yĩnga.»
«Fo ba-biig sẽn be ne foom, sã n wa lebg naong soaba, n ka tar bũmb n na n yao foom f samde, bɩ f sõng-a, baa sã n yaa sãana wall nin-loaagdga, bɩ f sõng-a t'a tõog n kell n vɩɩmde.
Bɩ f ra sõng-a n bao yõodo, wall bũmb roagleng ye. Zoe fo Wẽnnaamã, tɩ f ba-biigã tõe n vɩɩmd ne-fo.
Bɩ f ra peng-a ligd n baood yõod ye, la f ra kõ-a rɩɩb n baood bũmb a to ye.
Mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa yãmb Wẽnnaam. Maam n yiis yãmb Ezɩpt tenga, n wa kõ yãmb Kana tẽngã, sẽn na n yɩlẽ n kell n yɩ yãmb Wẽnnaam.
Naong sã n yõk f ba-biig sẽn be ne foomã, t'a rɩk a mengã n koos ne foom, bɩ f ra kẽes-a yembd tʋʋmdẽ ye.
Yẽnda tog n bee ne foom wa tʋmtʋmd sẽn dɩkd yaoodo, la wa nin-loaagdga. Yẽnda tog n tʋm n kõo foom hal tɩ ta kɩdeng yʋʋmdã.
Wakat-kãnga, fo tog n basa yẽnda ne a kambã tɩ b yi n lebg n leb b nebẽ, la b mengã yaab-rãmb soolem pʋgẽ.
Bala, Israyɛll nebã yaa mam tʋmtʋmdb mam sẽn yiis Ezɩpt tẽngã. B ka tog n koos bãmb wa b sẽn koosd yembs ye.
Fo ka tog n soog yẽnda ne pãng ye. Bɩ f zoe fo Wẽnnaamã.
Yaa soolem nins sẽn gũbg yãmbã pʋs la yãmb tog n tɩ yãk y yem-daoogo, wall y yem-poaka, tɩ b yɩ yãmb rẽnda. Yaa soolem-kãens pʋs la yãmb tog n kẽng n tɩ ra y yem-daoog bɩ y yem-poaka.
Yãmb tõeeme me n da sãambã sẽn be yãmb nengẽ wã kamba, wall buud nins sẽn be yãmb tẽngẽ wã kambã sẽn dog-b rãmbã. Bãmb na n yɩɩ yãmb n so.

Yãmb tog n dɩka bãmb tɩ b yɩ yãmb kambã sẽn na n pʋgl yãmbã rogem-pʋɩɩre, n yaa b soolem. Yãmb na n kell n talla bãmb tɩ b yɩ yãmb yembs wakat fãa yĩnga. La sã n yaa sẽn kẽed ne yãmb saam-biisã sẽn yaa Israyɛll nebã wɛɛngẽ, yãmb ned ba a yembr ka tog n soog a ba-biig ne pãng ye.
Sãana, bɩ nin-loaagdg sẽn be yãmb sʋkã sã n yaa rakãagre, tɩ naong yõk yãmb saam-biig sẽn be ne-a, t'a koos a meng ne sãanã, wall ne nin-loaagdgã sẽn be yãmb sʋkã, wall ne sãanã buud neda,
b tõe n kell n yaoome n deeg-a, baa ne a sẽn koos a mengã. Yẽnda ba-biig tõe n yao n deeg-a lame.
A ba wã yao bɩ a ba wã yao biiga, sã n ka rẽ bɩ a buudã ned tõe n yaoome n deeg-a. Wall sã n yaa yẽnda mengã n tar pãn-tõogo, a yao n deeg a menga.

Bɩ yẽnda ne ned ning sẽn da-a yẽnda wã sõd yʋʋmã sõore, sẽn sɩng ne yʋʋmd ning yẽnda sẽn koos a mengã, n tãag kɩdeng yʋʋmdã n bãng a sõore. La bɩ a yao wa sẽn zems yʋʋmã sõor sẽn yaa to-to wã. La b tog n geelga yaoodã tɩ zems wa b sẽn tog n yao tʋmtʋmd to-to wã.
La sã n mikame tɩ yaa yʋʋm wʋsg n ket tɩ kɩdeng yʋʋmdã yaool n ta, bɩ a yao wa sẽn zems sẽn da-a yẽnda wã ligd-raadgã.
La sã n mikame tɩ kɩdeng yʋʋmdã ka leb n zãra, bɩ b geelg yʋʋmã sõor n yao wa sẽn zems yʋʋm-kãens sẽn ketã.
Yʋʋmd fãa yaood na n zemsa tʋmtʋmd sẽn tʋmd ned nengẽ yaoodo, la y ra sak n bas tɩ b soog y ba-biigã ne pãng tɩ y getẽ ye.
La sã n wa n mik tɩ yõwã fãa pʋga, b ka tõog n yao n deeg y ba-biigã, bɩ a bas tɩ kɩdeng yʋʋmdã sã n ta, bɩ a peeg a kambã tɩ b tũ yẽnda n yi.»
«Bala, Israyɛll nebã yaa mam yembse. Bãmb yaa mam tʋmtʋmdb mam sẽn yiis Ezɩpt tẽngã. Mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa yãmb Wẽnnaam.»
Ra maan-y wẽn-naands ye. Ra maan-y bõn-naands n kõ y mense, wall y vigl kug bɩ raad y tẽngã pʋga, n wõgemd n waoog-b ye. Bala, mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa yãmb Wẽnnaam.
Bɩ y sak mam vʋʋsg rayã, la y waoog mam sɛk roogã. Mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saabo.
Yãmb sã n sak mam noyã, la y sak mam tõodã n maan wa b sẽn yeelã,
mam na n kɩtame tɩ saag ni yãmb wa sẽn zems a wakate, la y koodã na n womame, la tɩɩsã sẽn be weoogẽ wã na n woma biisi.
La yãmb na n pãba kood hal tɩ ta tɩɩs wobr wakate, la y na n woba tɩɩs hal tɩ ta bʋdb wakate. Yãmb na n paama rɩɩb tɩ sek yãmba, la y na n zĩnda y tẽngã pʋg ne bãane.

Mam na n kɩtame tɩ vɩ-bãan zĩnd y tẽngã pʋga, la yãmb na n gãandame n gũs tɩ ned ka kẽes yãmb dabeem ye. Mam na n kɩtame tɩ we-rũm-wẽnsã menem n bas yãmb tẽngã. La zabr kõn tol n zĩnd yãmb tẽngẽ wã ye.
Yãmb na n diga y bɛɛbã, n kɛ-b ne sʋʋs n kʋ.
Yãmb neb a nu na n diga bãmb neb koabga, la yãmb neb koabg na n diga bãmb neb tus-piiga. La yãmb na n tõoga y bɛɛbã ne zabr sʋʋga.
Mam na n wẽnemd n gesa yãmb yelle, la m na n kɩtame tɩ y paam dogem, la m kɩt tɩ y lebg wʋsgo, la mam na n vigla m kaoolã ne yãmba.
Yãmb na n dɩɩ ka-kʋdgo, la y na n vaaga y ka-kʋdgã n yiis la y lebs ka-paalg n sui.
Mam na n tilga m yir yãmb sʋka, la mam ka na n kisg yãmb ye.
Mam na n kẽna yãmb sʋka, n kell n yɩ yãmb Wẽnnaam, tɩ yãmb yɩ mam nebã.
Mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa yãmb Wẽnnaam sẽn yiis yãmb Ezɩpt tẽngã, tɩ yãmb kõn leb n yɩ bãmb yembs ye. Mam kaoo yãmb balgrã ra-tuiidsã, n kɩt tɩ yãmb kẽn ne zu-zẽkre.
La yãmb sã n ka kelg maam, la y sã n ka sak mam tõodã,
la y sã n kɩɩs mam noyã, la y kisg mam koeesã, la y sã n ka n sak mam tõodã fãa, la y sã n sãamd mam kaoolã,

ad mam sẽn na n maan yãmb bũmb ninga: Mam na n kɩtame tɩ y namse, yãmb na n bẽeme n faag ne yĩn-wɩngre, la a na n kɩtame tɩ y nina pãng booge, tɩ y sũyã sãame. Yãmb na n namsa y meng n bʋd y koodã zaalem. Bala, yaa yãmb bɛɛbã n na n dɩ-a.
Mam na n wẽnemda m neng n bas yãmba, la yãmb bɛɛbã na n tõoga yãmba. Neb nins sẽn kis yãmbã na n sooga yãmba, la yãmb na n zoeeme tɩ ned ka rigd yãmb ye.
La baa ne rẽ fãa tɩ yãmb sã n kell n ka kelg maam, mam na n sɩbga yãmb naoor a yopoe n yɩɩda, y yel-wẽnã yĩnga.
Mam na n kɩtame tɩ y sẽn tar pãng n wɩkdẽ wã sɛ, la m kɩt tɩ saagã lebg wa kutu, tɩ y tẽn-gãongã lebg wa zũudu.
Yãmb na n tʋmame tɩ y pãng sɛ zaalem. Yãmb tẽn-gãongã ka na n sak kood ye, la tẽngã tɩɩsã ka na n wom biis ye.
Yãmb sã n kɩɩs maam, n ka sak n kelg maam, mam na n sɩbg yãmb naoor a yopoe n yɩɩda, wa sẽn zems y yel-wẽnã.
Mam na n tʋma we-rũms tɩ b wa zab ne yãmba, n kʋ yãmb kambã, la b kʋ y rũmsã, la b kɩt tɩ y sõorã lebg bilfu. La yãmb soayã na n lebga vɩɩdo.
La baa ne woto fãa, tɩ yãmb sã n ka sak tɩ mam dems yãmba, la yãmb sã n kɩɩs maam,
mam me na n basa yãmba, la yãmb yel-wẽnã yĩnga, mam na n sɩbga yãmb naoor a yopoe n yɩɩda.
Mam na n kɩtame tɩ b wa zab ne yãmb ne sũ-dokr zabr sʋʋga, n dok kaoolã sũuri. Yãmb sã n zoe n tɩ tigim y tẽmsã pʋse, mam na n tʋma bã-loangdg yãmb sʋka, la m bas tɩ y bɛɛbã tõog-yã.
Mam na n kɩtame tɩ kom kẽ yãmba, la pagb piig na n moee sag-rʋg-yɛng pʋga, la b na n talla rɩɩb bilf bal n wa kõ yãmba, la yãmb na n dɩɩme, la y ka na n tɩg ye.
Woto fãa pʋgẽ, tɩ yãmb sã n kell n ka kelg maam, la y ka sak maam,
mam me na n basa yãmb ne sũ-puugri, la yãmb yel-wẽnã yĩnga, mam na n sɩbga yãmb naoor a yopoe n yɩɩda.
Yãmb na n wãba y kom-dibli ne y kom-pugli nemdo.
Mam na n sãama yãmb maoong kʋʋb zĩisã, la m wã y wisd tẽn-kugã, la m wʋk y kũumã n dʋʋg wẽn-naan-kɩɩmsã zutu, la mam na n kisga yãmba.
Mam na n kɩtame tɩ yãmb tẽmsã lebg raboodo, la mam na n sãeega y pʋʋsgã zĩisi, la m ka na n leb n kok-y maandã yũ-noogã ye.
Yaa mam mengã n na n sãam tẽngã, la yãmb bɛɛbã sẽn na n wa zĩnd beenẽ wã na n yɛɛsame.
Mam na n sãeega yãmb n kẽes buud a taabã sʋka, n kɩt tɩ b rig yãmb ne zabr sʋʋga. Yãmb soolmã na n wãame, tɩ y tẽmsã lebg raboodo.
Dẽ, wakat ning fãa yãmb sẽn zĩnd sãang pʋga, n be y bɛɛbã soolmẽ wã, yãmb tẽngã na n vʋʋsame. Vʋʋs-kãng yaa sẽn na n lebs vʋʋsg yʋʋmã sẽn ka tõog n yɩ wã.
Wakat ning fãa tẽngã sẽn lebg vɩʋʋgã, a na n vʋʋsame n lebs vʋʋsg yʋʋm nins a sẽn dag n ka paam n vʋʋs wakat ning yãmb sẽn wa n ket a pʋgẽ wã.

La yãmb neb nins sẽn na n kell n vɩɩmd b bɛɛbã tẽngẽ wã, mam na n kɩtame tɩ rabeem yõk-ba, la tɩɩg vão-koɛɛng bʋrg na n diga bãmba. Bãmb na n zoee wa b sẽn digd ned ne sʋʋga, la b na n lags n lʋɩɩme tɩ ned ka rigd-b ye.
Bãmb na n kanda taab n lʋɩt taab zutu, wa b sẽn digd ned ne zabr sʋʋga, tɩ ned yaool n ka rigd-b ye. Yãmb ka na n tõog n yals n zab ne y bɛɛbã ye.
La yãmb na n kii bu-zẽmsã sʋka, la yãmb bɛɛbã tẽng n na n dɩ yãmba.
La yãmb sʋkã neb nins sẽn na n põsã na n kii yãmb bɛɛbã tẽng pʋga, bãmb kongrã, ne b ba-rãmbã kongr yĩnga.
La nin-bãmb vẽneg n togsa bãmb kongrã, ne b ba-rãmbã kongr b sẽn maan n beeg maamã, la kɩɩsg ning bãmb sẽn kɩɩs maamã.
Yaa rẽ tɩ mam me bas-b n tall-b n tɩ kẽes b bɛɛbã tẽngẽ. Woto, bãmb kɩɩsgã yĩnga, b na n paama paoogre, n deeg b kongrã yaood sẽn yaa sɩbgre.
La mam na n leb n tẽega mam sẽn maan kaool ning ne a Zakoobã, la a Izakã, la ne a Abrahaamã yelle, la m tẽeg b tẽngã yelle.
La bãmb sẽn yi n bas tẽngã yĩnga, tẽngã na n vʋʋsame, a sẽn lebg vɩʋʋgã yĩnga. Bãmb na n paama b kongrã sɩbgre. Bala, bãmb kɩɩsa mam tõodã, la b kisga mam noyã.

La bãmb sẽn wat n be b bɛɛbã tẽngẽ wã wakate, mam ka na n bas-ba, la m ka na n kisg-b hal n sãam-b zãng ye. La m ka na n sãam kaoolã sẽn be maam ne bãmb sʋkã ye. Bala, mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa bãmb Wẽnnaam.
Mam na n leb n tẽega pipi kaoolã yelle. Yaa kaool ning mam sẽn maan n yiis bãmb Ezɩpt tẽngã tɩ buud a taabã yãndã, la m lebg bãmb Wẽnnaamã. Mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saabo.
Ad yaa bõn-kãensã n yaa no-tũuds ninsi, ne noy ninsi, la tõod nins Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn vigl bãmb ne Israyɛll nebã sʋkã. Bãmb tũnuga a Moyiis n togs bõn-kãens Sinayi tãngã zugu.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yeela a Moyiis yaa:
«Yeel Israyɛll nebã yaa: ‹Ned sã n pʋlem Sẽn-Ka-Saab n yeel t'a na n kõo ninsaala, bɩ a yao ligd sẽn zems b sẽn wilgã.
Sã n yaa rao sẽn zems yʋʋm pisi tɩ ta yʋʋm pis-yoob yaoodo, bɩ f geelg sẽn zems wanzuri wakɩ-koeems pis-nu n yao, wa sẽn zems sɛk roogã bõn-makdgã.
La sã n yaa paga, bɩ f geelg sẽn zems wanzuri wakɩ-koeems pis-tã n yao.
Yẽnda sẽn dɩk a soab n pʋlmã sã n yaa ned sẽn zems yʋʋm a nu tɩ ta yʋʋm pisi, bɩ f geelg sẽn zems wanzuri wakɩ-koeems pisi bi-ribl yĩnga, la wanzuri wakɩ-koeems piiga, bi-pugl yĩnga.
La a soabã sã n zemsa kiuug a yembre, n tɩ ta yʋʋm a nu, bɩ f geelg sẽn zems wanzuri wakɩ-koeems a nu, bi-ribl yĩnga, la wanzuri wakɩ-koeems a tãabo, bi-pugl yĩnga.
La sã n yaa ned sẽn tar yʋʋm pis-yoobe, bɩ sẽn yɩɩd woto, bɩ f geelg sẽn zems wanzuri wakɩ-koeems piig la a nu rao yĩnga, la wanzuri wakɩ-koeems piiga, pag yĩnga.

La sã n mikame tɩ ned ning sẽn maan-a pʋlengã yaa naong soab wʋsg n ka tar n na n yao wa sẽn zems gɛɛlã, bɩ b tall-a n kẽng maan-kʋʋdã nengẽ, la bɩ maan-kʋʋdã geelg n zems sẽn maan-a pʋlengã sẽn tõe n yao.
La sã n yaa rũng sẽn zems b sẽn tõe n dɩk n maan maoong n kõ Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, dẽ, b sẽn pʋlem rũng ningã fãa na n kell n yɩɩ Sẽn-Ka-Saab rẽnda.

B ka tog n tek rũngã, la b ka tog n dɩk rũm-sõngã n tek ne rũng sẽn ka sõama ye. B ka tõe n dɩk rũng sẽn ka sõama n tek ne rũm-sõng ye. B sã n dɩk rũng n tek ne a to, rũms a yiibã fãa na n lebga Sẽn-Ka-Saab rẽnda.
La sã n mikame tɩ rũngã yaa rũm-dẽgdo, tɩ b ka tõe n dɩk-a n maan maoong n kõ Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, baa sẽn yaa rũng ninga, bɩ a tall rũngã n kẽng maan-kʋʋdã nengẽ.
La bɩ maan-kʋʋdã ges rũngã n wilg a sã n yaa rũm-sõng bɩ a ka rũm-sõngo, la a saag a ligdã, la maan-kʋʋdã sẽn yeel ligd ningã la b tog n yao.
La b sã n dat n leb n yao n deeg rũngã, bɩ b rogl yaoodã sẽn pʋɩ zĩis a nu pʋɩɩr a yembre, yaoodã zugu.

Ned sã n dɩk a roog n kõ Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, bɩ maan-kʋʋdã ges roogã n bãng a sã n yaa sõama wall ka sõama, n wilg a ligdã wa sẽn zems a sẽn yaa to-to wã, la roogã soab na n yaoo wa maan-kʋʋdã sẽn yeel bũmb ningã.
La roogã soab sã n dat n leb n yao n deeg a roogã, bɩ a rogl roogã ligd sẽn pʋɩ zĩis a nu pʋɩɩr a yembre, yaoodã zugu. Dẽ, roogã na n leb n lebga yẽnda rẽnda.
Ned sã n dɩk a pʋʋg n kõ Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, bɩ f geelg t'a ligdã zems wa pʋʋgã kood waooglem sẽn yaa bũmb ningã. Kood konkong piig a la a nii la bɛk ligd segd n zemsa wanzuri wakɩ-koeems pis-nu.
Sã n yaa sẽn sɩng ne kɩdeng yʋʋmdã la yẽnda rɩk a pʋʋgã n kõ Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, bɩ a yao wa sẽn zems fo sẽn geelg to-to wã.
La sã n mikame tɩ yaa kɩdeng yʋʋmdã poor la a rɩk a pʋʋgã n kõ, bɩ maan-kʋʋdã geelg ligdã tɩ zems yʋʋm sõor ning sẽn ket tɩ kɩdeng yʋʋmdã yaool n ta wã, n boog-a tɩ zems fo sẽn geelg n wilgã.
Ned ning sẽn dɩk-a a pʋʋgã n kõ wã sã n dat n yao n leb n deeg a pʋʋgã, bɩ a rogl pʋʋgã yaood sẽn pʋɩ zĩis a nu pʋɩɩr a yembr yaoodã zugu, la pʋʋgã na n kell n yɩɩ yẽnda rẽnda.
La yẽnda sã n ka yao n deeg a pʋʋgã, tɩ b rɩk-a n koos ne ned a to, b ka leb n tõe n yao n deeg-a ye.
Ned ning sẽn dag n da-a pʋʋgã sã n bas tɩ kɩdeng yʋʋmdã ta, pʋ-kãng na n lebga Sẽn-Ka-Saab rẽnda, n yaa pʋʋg sẽn welg toore. Yaa maan-kʋʋdã n so pʋ-kãnga.
La ned sã n da pʋʋgo, n dɩk-a n kõ Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, tɩ yaool n ka yẽnda meng pʋʋgo,
bɩ maan-kʋʋdã geelg yʋʋm sõor ning sẽn ket tɩ kɩdeng yʋʋmdã ta wã, n wilg a sẽn geelã ligdi, n kɩt tɩ sẽn dɩk-a pʋʋgã n kõ wã yao. La yaa badaar bal la a tog n yao. Bala, lebga Sẽn-Ka-Saab rẽnda.
La kɩdeng yʋʋmdã sã n ta, bɩ b rɩk pʋʋgã n leb n lebs ned ning sẽn dag n koos-a wã. Bala, dag n yaa yẽnda pʋʋgo.
Gɛɛl buudã fãa tog n zemsa ne sɛk roogã magdgã. Wanzuri koɛɛng a yembr yaa wakɩy piiga.
Ned ka tõe n dɩk a rũng bi-rẽeng n kõ Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, sã n yaa naafo wall pesgo, wall bʋʋg ye. Bala, bi-rẽeng fãa zoe n yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab rẽnda.

La sã n mikame tɩ yaa rũm-dẽgd bi-rẽenga, a soabã tõe n yaoo n deeg-a lame. La a tog n dogla rũngã yaood sẽn pʋɩ zĩis a nu yaood ning maan-kʋʋdã sẽn wilgã zugu. La a sã n ka tõog n yao n deeg-a, bɩ maan-kʋʋdã koos-a wa sẽn zems yaood ning yẽnda sẽn wilgã.

Bũmb ning fãa ned sẽn na n dɩk n kõ Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, b sẽn dɩk n kõ tɩ lebg Sẽn-Ka-Saab rẽnda, b ka tõe n koos-a wall b yao n deeg-a, baa sẽn yaa bũmb ning fãa. Sã n yaa ninsaala, rũnga wall pʋʋg sẽn yaa yẽnda soolem.
La b sã n dɩk ninsaal n kõ Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, b ka tõe n yao n deeg-a ye. B tog n kʋ a soabã.

Bũmb sẽn be me, b tog n yãka tẽn-gãongã bõn-koaadl biis piig pʋɩɩr n kõ Sẽn-Ka-Saabo. Sã n yaa bũmb ning b sẽn bʋt tẽn-gãongã zugu, wall tɩɩsã biisi, yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab rẽndã. Bõn-kãng yaa bũmb sẽn welg toor Sẽn-Ka-Saab yĩnga.
Ned sã n dat n lebg n deeg a piig pʋɩɩrã bɛk n da, bɩ a soabã rogl yaoodã sẽn pʋɩ zĩis a nu pʋɩɩr a yembre.

La sẽn kẽed ne rũmsã piig pʋɩɩre, sã n yaa rũm-bãooneg wall rũm-bɛda, piig fãa pʋgẽ, a yembr yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab n so. Yẽnda tog n tẽega rasaare, tɩ rũmsã fãa pɩʋʋgd rasaarã tẽngr n loogdẽ. La piigẽ soabã, a ningd-a-la bãnd t'a lebg Sẽn-Ka-Saab rẽnda.

La wakat-kãnga, rũmsã soab ka tog n tũusi, sã n yaa rũm-sõng bɩ rũm-dẽgd ye. Yẽnda sã n dɩk rũng a to n tek ne a to, bãmb b yiibã fãa na n lebga Sẽn-Ka-Saab rẽnda, la a ka leb n tõe n yao n deeg ba a yembr ye.»
Woto yaa tõod nins Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn dag n kõ a Moyiis Sinayi tãngã zug t'a kõ Israyɛll nebã.
Israyɛll nebã sẽn yi Ezɩpt soolmã tɩ yʋʋm yiiblẽ, kiuug a yiib soabã pipi daarã, Sẽn-Ka-Saab goma ne a Moyiis sɛk roogã pʋgẽ, Sinayi we-raoogẽ wã n yeele:
«Bɩ foom ne a Aarõ sõd Israyɛll nebã, n gʋls rao fãa ne a yʋʋre. Sõd-y bãmb roog-roogo, la zak-zaka.
Bɩ y sõd Israyɛll raop nins fãa sẽn ta yʋʋm pisi, la sẽn yɩɩd woto, n tõe n yɩ Israyɛll tãb-biisã. Bɩ y sõd bãmb wa sẽn zems ned kam fãa ne a buudã tãb-sika.
La buud fãa pʋgẽ, b na n yãka taoor soab a ye t'a sõng yãmba.
Ad raop nins sẽn na n sõng-b yãmbã yʋya: A Rubɛn buudã pʋgẽ, yaa a Sedewʋʋr biig a Elisʋʋre.
A Simyõ buudã pʋgẽ, yaa a Suurisadayi biig a Selumiyɛlle.
A Zʋʋda buudã pʋgẽ, yaa a Aminadaab biig a Nakõ.
A Isakaar buudã pʋgẽ, yaa a Suwaar biig a Netaneyɛlle.
A Zabulõ buudã pʋgẽ, yaa a Elõ biig a Elyaabe.
Sã n yaa ne a Zosɛf kambã, Efrayiim buudã pʋgẽ, yaa a Amiwuud biig a Elisama, t'a Manaase buudã pʋgẽ, yaa a Pedasʋʋr biig a Gameliyɛlle.
A Benzame buudã pʋgẽ, yaa a Gidoni biig a Abidãn.
A Dan buudã pʋgẽ, yaa a Amisadayi biig a Ayiyezɛɛre.
A Asɛɛr buudã pʋgẽ, yaa a Okrã biig a Pagiyɛlle.
A Gaad buudã pʋgẽ, yaa a Dewuwɛll biig a Elyazafe.
A Neftali buudã pʋgẽ, yaa a Enan biig a Ayira.»
Yaa nin-bãmbã la b yãk Israyɛll buudã pʋgẽ, tɩ bãmb ned kam fãa na n yɩ a buudã taoor soaba. La leb n yaa bãmb n yaa Israyɛll buudã fãa tãb-biisã nanambse.
A Moyiis ne a Aarõ peega raop nins yʋy b sẽn bool tʋʋm-kãng yĩnga.
A Moyiis ne Aarõ tigma Israyɛll nebã fãa kiuug a yiib soabã pipi daare, n kɩt tɩ b sõd bãmb roog-roogo, ne zak-zaka, ned kam fãa ne a yʋʋre, la yaa sẽn tar-b yʋʋm pisi la sẽn yɩɩd dẽnda wã.
A Moyiis kɩtame tɩ b sõd Israyɛll raopã Sinayi we-raoogẽ wã, wa Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn dag n yeel yẽnda wã.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yeela a Moyiis ne a Aarõ yaa:
«Israyɛll ned kam fãa tog n ti a fu-roog n yegl a buudã tãb-sikã, n pẽneg a buudã tãb-kaoorã. La bãmb tog n zãaga bilf n ti n gũbg sɛk roogã.»
Tãb-bi-sul nins sẽn gũbg Zʋʋda tãb-kaoorã tog n zĩnda yaanga. Dẽ, ad buud fãa ne a tãb-biis naaba:
Zʋʋda buudã tãb-biisã naab yaa a Aminadaab biig a Nakõ. Yẽnda tãb-biisã sõor yaa neb tus pis-yopoe la a naas la kobs-yoobe.
La Isakaar buudã tãb-biisã naab yaa a Suwaar biig a Netaneyɛlle.
Yẽnda tãb-biisã sõor yaa neb tus pis-nu la a naas la kobs-naase.
Sẽn pʋgd yaa Zabulõ. Yẽnda tãb-biisã naab yaa a Elõ biig a Elyaabe.
A Zabulõ tãb-biisã sõor yaa neb tus-pis-nu la a yopoe la kobs-naase.
Tãb-bi-sul nins sẽn gũbg Zʋʋda tãb-kaoorã yaa tãb-biis tus koabg la pis-nii la a yoob la kobs-naase. La yaa bãmb n na yɩ pipi n yiki.

Nug-goabgã, yaa tãb-bi-sull ning sẽn gũbg Rubɛn tãb-kaoorã n na n ti be. La Rubɛn buudã raop nins b sẽn sõd n yãk tɩ b na n yɩ tãb-biisã, b naab yaa a Sedewʋʋr biig a Elisʋʋre. Rubɛn buudã tãb-biisã sõor yaa neb tus pis-naas la a yoob la kobs-nu. Sɩmyõ buudã tãb-biisã naab yaa a Suurisadayi biig a Selumiyɛlle. Yẽnda tãb-biisã sõor yaa neb tus pis-nu la a wɛ la kobs-tã. Gaad buudã tãb-biisã naab yaa a Rehuwɛll biig a Elyazafe. Yẽnda tãb-biisã sõor yaa neb tus pis-naas la a nu la kobs-yoob la pis-nu.
Dẽ, tãb-bi-sul nins sẽn gũbg Rubɛn tãb-kaoorã yaa tãb-biis tus koabg la pis-nu la a ye, la kobs-naas la pis-nu. La yaa bãmb n na n pʋgl pipi sullã.
Sẽn pʋgde, yaa Leevi buudã n na n yik ne sɛk roogã n pʋgle. Dẽ, bãmb na n zĩnda sʋka. La sulã fãa me na n yikda pʋgdg-pʋgdg wa bãmb sẽn ti to-to wã, ned kam fãa ne a zĩiga la a tãb-kaoore.

Nin-taoorã yaa tãb-bi-sull ning sẽn gũbg a Efrayiim tãb-kaoorã n na n ti be. Efrayiim buudã tãb-biisã naab yaa a Amiwuud biig a Elisama. Yẽnda tãb-biisã sõor yaa neb tus pis-naas la kobs-nu. La Manaase buudã tãb-biisã naab yaa a Pedasʋʋr biig a Gameliyɛlle. Yẽnda tãb-biisã sõor yaa neb tus pis-tã la a yiib la kobs-yi. Benzame buudã tãb-biisã naab yaa a Gidoni biig a Abidãn. Yẽnda tãb-biisã sõor yaa neb tus pis-tã la a nu la kobs-naase.
Dẽ, tãb-bi-sul nins sẽn gũbg a Efrayiim tãb-kaoorã yaa tãb-biis tus koabg la a nii la koabga. Bãmb n na n yɩ sull a tãabẽ soab n yiki.

Nug-rɩtgã, yaa tãb-bi-sull ning sẽn gũbg a Dan tãb-kaoorã n na n ti be. Dan buudã tãb-biisã naab yaa a Amisadayi biig a Ayiyezɛɛre. Yẽnda tãb-biisã sõor yaa neb tus pis-yoob la yiib la kobs-yopoe. A Asɛɛr buudã tãb-biisã naab yaa a Okrã biig a Pagiyɛlle. Yẽnda tãb-biisã sõor yaa neb tus pis-naas la a ye la kobs-nu. Neftali buudã tãb-biisã naab yaa a Enan biig a Ayira. Yẽnda tãb-biisã sõor yaa neb tus pis-nu la a tãab la kobs-naase.
Dẽ, tãb-bi-sul nins sẽn gũbg Dan tãb-kaoorã yaa tãb-biis tus koabg la pis-nu la a yopoe la kobs-yoobe. Bãmb n na n yɩ yaoolem n yiki. Sull fãa na n gũbga a tãb-kaoor n kẽnda.
Israyɛll nebã fãa b sẽn sõd buud-buudu, la tãb-bi-sull-sullã fãa sõor yɩɩ neb tus kobs-yoob la a tã la kobs-nu la pis-nu.
La bãmb maana wa Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn dag n yeel a Moyiisã, n ka naag Leevi buudã ne Israyɛll buud a taabã n sõd ye.
