Zeruzalɛm kẽnd yɩɩle. Yaa a Davɩɩd yɩɩlle. B sã n wa n yeel maam tɩ m wa tɩ d kẽng Sẽn-Ka-Saab roogẽ wã, mam sũurã yaa noogo.
Zeruzalɛm, tõnd kẽn n taa f tẽngã rignoorẽ!
Zeruzalɛm, b mee fo tẽngã, b me-a lame n gũbg t'a yaa neere!
Yaa fo nengẽ la buud toay-toayã sẽn yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab nebã kẽnda, wa sẽn zems Israyɛll tõogã, n na n pʋʋs Sẽn-Ka-Saab barka.
Bala, yaa Zeruzalɛm la bʋʋdã gɛy be, yaa a Davɩɩd roogã naam gɛyã.
Pʋʋs-y tɩ Zeruzalɛm tẽngã zĩnd ne bãane. Zeruzalɛm, bɩ sẽn nong-b foomã vɩɩmd bãane.
Bɩ fo tẽngã fãa zĩnd ne bãane, la bɩ vɩ-bãan zĩnd f na-yiyã pʋse!
Mam ba-biisã ne m zo-rãmbã yĩnga, mam yetame: «Bɩ f zĩnd ne bãane!»
Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa tõnd Wẽnnaamã roogã yĩnga, mam kosg yaa tɩ f na paam naare.
Zeruzalɛm kẽnd yɩɩlle. Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, mam zẽkda m neng n get yãmb sẽn be y naamã geer zug saasẽ wã.
Ade, wa tʋmtʋmdb sẽn get b soaalã, la wa yem-poak sẽn get a zu-soaben-poakã, woto me, tõnd geta Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa tõnd Wẽnnaamã, n gũudẽ tɩ b zoe d nimbãanega.
Zoe-y tõnd nimbãanega, Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, zoe-y d nimbãanega. Bala, yaoolgã ya n seka tõndo.
Nin-wẽnsã sẽn yaand tõndã sekd-d lame. Wilg-m-mens rãmbã paoogrã ya n seka tõndo.
Zeruzalɛm kẽnd yɩɩlle. A Davɩɩd yɩɩlle. Sẽn-Ka-Saab sã n dag n ka beẽ ne tõndo, bɩ Israyɛll nebã yeele:
Sẽn-Ka-Saab sã n dag n ka beẽ ne tõnd wakat ning nebã sẽn wa n yik zabr ne tõndã,
nebã rag n na n velẽ-la tõnd vɩɩs wakat ning b sũyã sẽn yik ne tõndã.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab sã n dag n ka beẽ ne tõndo, koomã rag n na n limẽ-la tõnd n looge, ko-zoetmã rag n na n dɩẽ-la tõndo.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab sã n dag n ka beẽ ne tõndo, ko-fõtem dag n na n limẽ-la tõndo.
Bɩ Sẽn-Ka-Saab paam pẽgre, bãmb sẽn ka bas tɩ d bɛɛbã zendem tõnd ne b yẽnã yĩnga.
Tõnd põsa wa liuul sẽn põs tãoogẽ, tãoogã gĩs kaoome, tɩ tõnd põse.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa yĩngr la tẽng naandã yʋʋr n fãagd tõndo.
Zeruzalɛm kẽnd yɩɩlle. Neb nins sẽn teegd Sẽn-Ka-Saabã, wẽnda wa Sɩyõ tãngã, a ka miimda, la a paada wakat fãa.
Wa tãmsã sẽn karg n gũbg Zeruzalɛmã, Sẽn-Ka-Saab me gũbgda b nebã a woto, sẽn sɩng ne moasã, la wakat fãa.
Na-toaag kõn tol n dɩ naam nin-tɩrsã tẽng pʋgẽ, tɩ nin-tɩrsã wa ning b nug wẽngã maaneg pʋg ye.
Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, maan-y nin-sõamyã neere, la y maan sẽn kẽnd-b tɩrlem pʋgẽ wã neere.
La sã n yaa ne neb nins sẽn tũud-b so-golemsã, bɩ Sẽn-Ka-Saab naag-b ne tʋʋm-wẽns maandbã n digi! Bɩ Israyɛll vɩɩmd ne bãane!
Zeruzalɛm kẽnd yɩɩlle. Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn wa n lebs Sɩyõ a zĩigẽ wã, rag n wẽnda wa neb sẽn zãms zãmsdo.
Dẽ, tõnd noyã rag n pida ne laado, tõnd noor dag n kaasda ne sũ-noogo. La bu-zẽmsã rag n yetame: «Sẽn-Ka-Saab maana bõn-kãsems n kõ-ba!»
Sẽn-Ka-Saab maana bõn-kãsems n kõ tõndo. Dẽ, tõnd maanda sũ-noogo.
Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, leb-y n lebs-y tõnd d zĩigẽ wã, wa yãmb sẽn kɩt tɩ Negɛɛv kʋɩlsã leb n paam koomã.
Sẽn bʋt-b ne nintãmã na n kẽeba ne sũ-noog kaasgo.
Sẽn zãad-a bõn-buud n dabd bʋdb la a yãbdã na n tʋka a ka-gĩnã n kaasd ne sũ-noog n lebg n watẽ.
Kẽnd yɩɩlle. Yaa a Salmo yɩɩlle. Sẽn-Ka-Saab sã n ka me roogo, tãn-metbã tʋmda zaalem bala. Sẽn-Ka-Saab sã n ka gũ tẽnga, tẽn-gũudã gũuda zaalem bala.
Yãmb sẽn sãt n yit la y kẽed yʋn-sʋgsã yaa zaalem bala. Yãmb sẽn namsd n na n paam n dɩ wã yaa zaalem. La Sẽn-Ka-Saab nin-nongdsã, ba b sã n gõe, Sẽn-Ka-Saab kõt-b-la rɩ-kãnga.
Kamb yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab kũuni, b yaa keoor Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn kõte.
Bi-bɩɩlem wakat kamb wẽnda pɛɛm sẽn be tãb-bi-gãndaoog nugẽ.
Sẽn paam-a peem-kãens n pids a lok tara sũ-noogo! A sã n na n bʋ ne bɛyã tẽngã noore, a kõn tol n paam yãnd ye.
Kẽnd yɩɩlle. Sẽn zoet-b Sẽn-Ka-Saab la b kẽnd bãmb soayã zutã tara sũ-noogo.
Fo na n dɩ f tʋʋmdã yõodo. Fo na n paama sũ-noogo, la naar yaa foom n so!
Fo pagã wẽnda reezẽ tɩ-woamdga, n be fo roogã yaanga, tɩ fo kambã yaa wa oliiv tɩ-bãoonego, n gũbg n dɩt ne foom.
Sẽn zoet-a Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n paama bark a woto.
Bɩ Sẽn-Ka-Saab kɩt tɩ b barkã yi Sɩyõ n ta foom, la fo na n yãnda Zeruzalɛm naarã f vɩɩmã tõre.
Fo na n yãnda f kambã kamba. Bɩ Israyɛll zĩnd ne bãane!
Zeruzalɛm kẽnd yɩɩlle. Hal mam bi-bɩɩlem wakate, b zabda ne maam. Bɩ Israyɛll nebã yeele:
«Hal mam bi-bɩɩlem wakate, b zaba ne maam, la b ka tõog n maan maam bũmb ye.
Bãmb bõoda mam poorã, wa ka-koaad sẽn bẽesd a pʋʋgo.
La Sẽn-Ka-Saab yaa tɩrlem soaba, bãmb kaoo wĩy nins nin-wẽnsã sẽn tall n sẽb tõndã.
Bɩ yãnd yõk-b tɩ b tare, bɩ yãnd yõk neb nins fãa sẽn kis Sɩyõ wã.
Bɩ b yɩ wa mood sẽn yi bɛoong zugu. Bãmb kʋɩtame tɩ b nan ka võ-b ye!
Sẽn wʋrd-a yẽnda wã ka paamd tɩ pid a nug ye. Mo-sẽbdã ka tõe n paam mo-kill ye.»
La so-loaadbã ka yete: «Bɩ Sẽn-Ka-Saab bark zĩnd yãmb zut» ye. Bãmb leb n ka yeta: «Tõnd ningda yãmb bark ne Sẽn-Ka-Saab yʋʋr» ye
Zeruzalɛm kẽnd yɩɩlle. Mam bee zĩ-zulumsẽ n boond yãmb a Sẽn-Ka-Saabo!
Zu-soaba, wʋm-y m boaalã! Kɩll-y y tʋbr n kelg m se-yõkrã!
Zu-soabã Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, yãmb sã n dag n tẽegdẽ tõnd kongrã, ãnda soab n na n põse?
La sugr bee yãmb nengẽ, tɩ nebã tõe n zoe yãmba.
Mam maanda tẽeb ne Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, m tẽeda bãmb ne m sũur fãa. La mam tẽeda bãmb goamã.
Mam maanda tẽeb ne Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, n yɩɩd gũudb sẽn gũud zĩig yẽegre, n yɩɩd gũudb sẽn gũud be-vẽegre.
Israyɛll nebã, maan-y tẽeb ne Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, bala, bãmb yaa nonglem soaba. La bãmb tara soay buud toay-toay n fãagdẽ.
Yaa bãmb n na n fãag Israyɛll ne a kongrã buud fãa.
Zeruzalɛm kẽnd yɩɩlle. Yaa Davɩɩd n yɩɩle. Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, wuk-m-meng ka be m sũurẽ ye. Mam ka tar tɩtaam gesg ye. Mam ka baood bõn-kãsems sẽn yɩɩd-ma, la m ka kẽed yɛl sẽn yɩɩd-m pʋgẽ ye.
Mam gãnega m yam n zĩ sɩɩ, wa bi-sigdg sẽn be ne a ma. Mam yaa wa biig sẽn bas bĩisim.
Israyɛll nebã, maan-y tẽeb ne Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, moasã la wakat sẽn kõn sa!
Zeruzalɛm kẽnd yɩɩlle. Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, tẽeg-y-yã a Davɩɩd yelle, tẽeg-y-yã a namsgã fãa yelle.
A Davɩɩd wẽena ne Sẽn-Ka-Saabo. Yẽnda pʋlma a Zakoob Wẽnnaamã sẽn yaa pãn-kãseng soabã n yeele:
«Mam ka na n kuil m yiri, mam ka na n tɩ gãand m gãagẽ,
mam kõn bas tɩ gõeem yõk-ma, la m nin kõn tol n suusi,
sã n ka m wa n paama zĩig Sẽn-Ka-Saab yĩnga, sã n ka m wa n paama roog a Zakoob Wẽnnaamã sẽn yaa pãn-kãseng soabã yĩng ye.
Tõnd wʋmame tɩ b gomda, tɩ kaoolã koglgã paa Efrata. Tõnd tɩ yãnd-a-la Yaar tẽnga.
D kẽng Sẽn-Ka-Saab roogẽ wã, n tɩ wõgemd bãmb nao-roagendgã taoore!
Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, yik-y-yã! Wa-y n kẽ-y y vʋʋsg zĩigẽ wã, yãmb ne y kaoolã koglgã sẽn wilgd yãmb pãngã!
Bɩ yãmb maan-kʋʋdbã yeelg tɩrlem, la bɩ y nin-nongdsã kaas ne sũ-noogo!
Yãmb tʋmtʋmd a Davɩɩd maasem yĩnga, bɩ y ra zãgs y nin-tũusdgã ye!
Sẽn-Ka-Saab wẽena ne a Davɩɩde, la b kõn lebs b noor poorẽ ye.» Bãmb yeela a Davɩɩd yaa: «Mam na n kɩtame tɩ fo yageng led foom f zaoorẽ wã.
Fo kambã sã n sak n tũ mam kaoolã, ne kaset ning mam sẽn na n zãms bãmbã, bãmb kambã me na n wa zaoonda fo zaoorẽ wã wakat sẽn kõn sɛ yĩnga.
Bala, Sẽn-Ka-Saab yãka Sɩyõ, n na n kɩt tɩ beenẽ yɩ b yiri.»
Bãmb yeelame: «Zĩ-kãngã na n yɩɩ mam vʋʋsg zĩig wakat fãa yĩnga. Mam na n zĩnda ka, bala, yaa ka la m data.
Mam na n ninga Sɩyõ laogã barka, la m kɩt t'a nimbãan-nebã rɩ n tɩge.
Mam na n yeelga a maan-kʋʋdbã ne fãagre, la a nin-nongdsã na n kaasa ne sũ-noogo!
Mam na n kɩtame tɩ rĩm sẽn tar pãng puk Sɩyõ, a Davɩɩd yagensã sʋka. Mam na n segla fɩtl mam nin-tũusdgã yĩnga.
Mam na n yeelga yẽnda bɛɛbã yãnde, la yẽnda na n fõgna naam maanf sẽn pɩndã.»
Zeruzalɛm kẽnd yɩɩlle. Yaa a Davɩɩd n yɩɩle. Ade, ba-biis sã n be ne taaba, yaa sõama, la a bee yamleoogo!
A yaa wa kaam sẽn tar yũ-noogo, b sẽn dɩk n sudgd maan-kʋʋr kãsem a Aarõ zugu, tɩ sodgd n tat a toɛɛngã, n sigd n tat a fuugã loore.
A wẽnda wa Hɛrmo tãngã meenem sẽn sigd n tat Sɩyõ tãmsã zutu. Bala, Sẽn-Ka-Saab kɩtame tɩ b barkã sigd Sɩyõ, la vɩɩm bee beenẽ wakat sẽn kõn sɛ yĩnga.
Zeruzalɛm kẽnd yɩɩlle. Sẽn-Ka-Saab tʋmtʋmdbã fãa, pẽg-y Sẽn-Ka-Saabo. Yãmb dãmb sẽn be Sẽn-Ka-Saab roogẽ wã yʋng fãa wã, pẽg-y bãmba!
Zẽk-y y nus n tees zĩ-sõngã, n pẽg Sẽn-Ka-Saabo!
Bɩ Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa yĩngr la tẽng naandã zĩnd Sɩyõ n ning y zug barka!
Pẽg-y Sẽn-Ka-Saabo! Pẽg-y Sẽn-Ka-Saab yʋʋrã! Sẽn-Ka-Saab tʋmtʋmdba, pẽg-y bãmba!
Yãmb dãmb sẽn be tõnd Wẽnnaamã roogẽ wã, pẽg-y bãmba!
Pẽg-y Sẽn-Ka-Saab tɩ b pida ne sõmblem. Yɩɩl-y n pẽg-y b yʋʋrã tɩ b yʋʋrã yaa noogo.
Bala, Sẽn-Ka-Saab yãka a Zakoobe, tɩ Israyɛll lebg bãmb dẽnda.
Mam mii hakɩɩk tɩ Sẽn-Ka-Saab yaa kãsenga, tɩ tõnd Zu-soabã yɩɩda wẽnnaam-dãmbã fãa.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn dat bũmb ning fãa, b maandame, sã n yaa saasẽ, wall dũniyã zugu, sã n yaa ko-kãsengẽ wã, wall zĩ-zulumsẽ wã.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab n kɩtd tɩ sawatã zẽkd n tat dũniyã zĩig fãa, la b kɩtdẽ tɩ sa-yãgb wat ne sa-koom, n kɩtdẽ tɩ sobg yit b sẽn dag n bĩng-a zĩig ningã.
Bãmb n kʋ Ezɩpt tẽngã kom-dẽemsã, sẽn sɩng ne ninsaalb n tɩ tãag rũmsã.
Ezɩpt nebã, bãmb tʋma bãn ne bõn-bãn yãmb sʋka, n sɩbga Faarõ ne a tʋmtʋmdbã fãa.
Bãmb tõoga bu-zẽms wʋsgo, n kʋ rĩm-dãmb sẽn tar pãense.
Yaa Amoor-dãmbã rĩm a Sɩhon, ne Basã-rãmbã rĩm a Ooge, la Kana soolem dĩm-dãmbã fãa.
La b rɩka b tẽmsã n kõ Israyɛll sẽn yaa bãmb nebã tɩ lebg b soolem.
Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, yãmb yʋʋrã paada wakat fãa! Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, b na n tẽra yãmb yell zamaan woo zamaane!
Bala, Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n kao b nebã bʋʋdo, la b na n zoe b tʋmtʋmdbã nimbãanega.
Bu-zẽmsã wẽn-naands maana ne wanzuri la sãnem, bãmb yaa ninsaalb nus tʋʋmã.
Bãmb tara noore, la b ka gomd ye. B tara nini, la b ka ne ye.
Bãmb tara tʋb la b ka wʋmd ye. Pemsem buud ka tol n yit b noorẽ wã ye.
Sẽn naan-b bãmbã ne sẽn teeg-b bãmbã fãa na n yɩɩ wa bãmba.
Israyɛll buudu, pẽg-y Sẽn-Ka-Saabo! A Aarõ buudu, pẽg-y Sẽn-Ka-Saabo!
Leevi buudu, pẽg-y Sẽn-Ka-Saabo! Yãmb dãmb sẽn zoet Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, pẽg-y bãmba!
Bɩ Sẽn-Ka-Saab paam pẽgr sẽn yit Sɩyõ! Bãmb bee Zeruzalɛm! Pẽg-y Sẽn-Ka-Saabo!
Pʋʋs-y Sẽn-Ka-Saab bark b sõmblmã yĩnga, bala, bãmb nonglmã paada wakat fãa!
Pʋʋs-y wẽnnaam-dãmb Wẽnnaamã barka, bala, bãmb nonglmã paada wakat fãa!
Pʋʋs-y zu-soben-dãmb Zu-soabã barka, bala, bãmb nonglmã paada wakat fãa!
Bãmb b yembr bal n maand bõn-bãn-kãsemse, bala, bãmb nonglmã paada wakat fãa!
Bãmb n naan saasẽ ne yam, bala, bãmb nonglmã paada wakat fãa!
Bãmb n yɛdg tẽn-gãongã koomã zugu, bala, bãmb nonglmã paada wakat fãa!
Bãmb n naan yĩngr vẽen-kãsemsã, bala, bãmb nonglmã paada wakat fãa!
Bãmb n naan wĩntoog t'a soog wĩndga, bala, bãmb nonglmã paada wakat fãa!
Bãmb n naan kiuugã ne ãdsã tɩ b soog yʋngo, bala, bãmb nonglmã paada wakat fãa!
Bãmb kʋʋ Ezɩpt nebã kom-dẽemsã, bala, bãmb nonglmã paada wakat fãa!
Bãmb n yiis Israyɛll nebã Ezɩpt tẽnga, bala, bãmb nonglmã paada wakat fãa!
Bãmb tẽega b nugã n yiis bãmb ne kang sẽn tar pãnga, bala, bãmb nonglmã paada wakat fãa!
Bãmb n kɩt tɩ rudum ko-kãsengã koom pasg zĩis a yiibu, bala, bãmb nonglmã paada wakat fãa!
Bãmb n kɩt tɩ Israyɛll kambã pɩʋʋg koomã n looge, bala, bãmb nonglmã paada wakat fãa!
Bãmb n luba Faarõ ne a tãb-biisã rudum ko-kãsengã pʋga, bala, bãmb nonglmã paada wakat fãa!
Bãmb n yãag b nebã we-raoogã pʋga, bala, bãmb nonglmã paada wakat fãa!
Bãmb n kʋ rĩm-kãsemse, bala, bãmb nonglmã paada wakat fãa!
Bãmb n kʋ rĩm-dãmb sẽn tar pãense, bala, bãmb nonglmã paada wakat fãa!
Yaa Amoor-dãmbã rĩm a Sihon, bala, bãmb nonglmã paada wakat fãa!
Ne Basã tẽngã rĩm a Ooge, bala, bãmb nonglmã paada wakat fãa!
N dɩk b tẽmsã n kõ Israyɛll sẽn yaa bãmb meng nebã tɩ b sooge, bala, bãmb nonglmã paada wakat fãa!
B rɩka tẽn-bãmb n kõ b tʋmtʋmd a Israyɛll tɩ yɩ a pʋɩɩre, bala, bãmb nonglmã paada wakat fãa!
Tõnd sẽn wa n be d yembdã pʋgã, Sẽn-Ka-Saab tẽega tõnd yelle, bala, bãmb nonglmã paada wakat fãa!
Bãmb n fãag tõnd d bɛɛbã nusẽ, bala, bãmb nonglmã paada wakat fãa!
Bãmb n kõt bõn-vɩɩlɩ wã fãa rɩɩbo, bala, bãmb nonglmã paada wakat fãa!
Pʋʋs-y saasẽ Wẽnnaamã barka, bala, bãmb nonglmã paada wakat fãa!
Tõnd dag n bee Babilond kʋɩlsã noore, la tõnd sẽn zĩnd beenẽ n tẽeg Sɩyõ tẽngã yellã, tõnd yãbame.
Tõnd dag n yagenda d pendsã kʋɩlgã noor tɩɩsã zutu.
La beenẽ, sẽn dag n kẽes-b tõnd yembdã yeela tõnd tɩ d yɩɩle. Tõnd namsdbã yeelame tɩ d yɩɩl sũ-noog yɩɩla. B yeelame: «Yɩɩl-y Sɩyõ yɩɩl n kõ-do.»
Tõnd na n yɩ a wãn n tɩ be sãand weoogo, la d yɩɩnd Sẽn-Ka-Saab yɩɩla?
Zeruzalɛm, mam sã n yĩm fo yelle, bɩ mam dɩtg nugã ki.
Zeruzalɛm, mam sã n yĩm fo yelle, la m sã n ka maan sũ-noog ne foom n yɩɩd bũmb fãa, bɩ m zelemdã tabend m dagsendakã.
Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, tẽeg-y Edom nebã yelle, bala, Zeruzalɛm sãoongã daare, bãmb dag n yetame: «Kõog-y-yã-a, kõog-y tẽngã ne a yẽbgrã zãnga!
Babilond tẽn-neere, b na n sãama foom. Bark bee neb nins sẽn lebs foom wẽng ning fo sẽn maan tõndã zutu!
Bark bee neb nins sẽn na n yõg fo kom-bãoonegã n fabs pĩig zugã zutu!»
A Davɩɩd yɩɩlle. Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, mam na n pʋʋsa yãmb bark ne m sũur fãa. Mam na n yɩɩl n pẽga yãmb wẽnnam-dãmbã taoore.
Mam na n wõgemd n teesa y ro-sõngã, n pʋʋs yãmb bark y nonglmã ne y sɩdã yĩnga. Bala, yãmb pidsa y goamã n yɩɩd tõnd sẽn dag n wʋmd tɩ b gomdã.
Mam sẽn bool yãmbã, y leok-m lame, yãmb kenga mam pɛlga, n paas-m pãnga.
Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, dũniyã rĩm-dãmb sã n wʋm yãmb noorã goamã, b na n pẽga yãmba.
Bãmb na n yɩɩl n goma Sẽn-Ka-Saab tʋʋmã yelle, bala, Sẽn-Ka-Saab ziirã yaa kãsenga.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab bee hal yĩngri, la b nee sik-m-mens rãmbã. Bãmb bee yɩɩga, la b mii wuk-m-mens rãmbã n bake.
Baa mam sã n kẽnd yel-pakr pʋga, yãmb n kõt maam vɩɩm. Mam bɛɛbã sũ-yikr pʋga, y tẽegda y nugu, yãmb tẽegda y nug-rɩtg n fãag maam.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab kɩtdame tɩ bũmb fãa baas neer mam yĩnga. Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, yãmb nonglmã paada wakat fãa! Ra-y bas-y neb nins yãmb meng nus sẽn naanã ye!
A Davɩɩd yɩɩlle. Yaa yɩɩlã naab yĩnga. Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, yãmb feesda maam, yãmb mii maam.
Yãmb mii mam zĩndg la m yikr wakate, yãmb reng n bãnga mam tagsgã tɩ ket n zãra.
Yãmb feesda maam m kẽnd wakate, la m sẽn gãe n vʋʋsdẽ wakate. Yãmb mii mam manesmã fãa.
Sẽn deng tɩ gomd yi mam noorẽ, yãmb a Sẽn-Ka-Saab zoe n bãng-a-la fãa.
Yãmb gũbgda maam poorẽ la taoore, la yãmb nug bee mam zugu.
Yãmb sẽn mi maam zãng a woto wã yaa bõn-bãnd ne maam, a yaa kãseng n yɩɩd mam sẽn tõe n wʋm a võore.
Mam na n kẽnga yɛɛnẽ n zãag ne yãmba? Mam na n zoe n kẽe yɛɛnẽ n põs yãmba?
Baa mam sã n dʋ saasẽ, yãmb bee beenẽ. Ba mam sã n tɩʋ m gãagã kɩɩm-kulgu, yãmb leb n bee be.
Ba mam sã n deeg zĩ-yẽegr pɩgs n yɩk n kẽng ko-kãsengã rʋʋnde,
yãmb nug tɛta maam beenẽ me, la y nug-rɩtg gãta maam.
Mam sã n yeel likã t'a wa lill maam, yʋngã lebgda vẽenem n gũbg maam.
Baoosgo, likã ka lik ne yãmb ye, yʋngã yãgda wa wĩntoogo, la lik yaa wa vẽenem yãmb taoore.
Yãmb n naan maam wa m sẽn yalã, yãmb n yag maam m ma pʋgẽ.
Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, mam pʋʋsda yãmb barka, bala, yãmb naana maam tɩ m tar ra-sãnde, yãmb tʋʋmã yaa bõn-bãna, mam mii bõn-kãng sõama.
Mam yĩngã ka tar bũmb sẽn solg ne yãmb ye. Yãmb naana maam zĩ-soalgdgẽ. Yãmb wʋga maam tẽn-gãongã zĩ-zulumsẽ wã.
Mam sẽn wa n nan ka tar naande, yãmb dag n nee maam. Mam dasmã fãa rag n zoe n gʋlsa yãmb sebrẽ wã tɩ b ba a yembr dag n nan ka beẽ ye.
Mam Wẽnnaam, yãmb tagsdã võor wʋmb yaa toog wʋsg ne maam. Bãmb sõorã sɩd yaa wʋsgo.
Mam sã n na n sõd-ba, b sõorã yɩɩda bĩisrã. Mam sã n gũs n neke, m ket n bee ne yãmba.
Mam Wẽnnaam, m datẽ lame tɩ y sãam nin-wẽnsã! Nin-kʋʋdba, zãag-y ne maam!
Mam Wẽnnaam, nin-wẽnsã gomda yãmb yell ne sɩlem-wẽnga, yãmb bɛɛbã sã n boond yãmb yʋʋrã, yaa ne zãmbo!
Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, mam ka tõe n ka kisg sẽn kis-b yãmbã ye. Mam yam ka tõe n ka yi neb nins sẽn zabd-b ne yãmbã ye.
Mam tolg n kis-b lame. Bãmb tolg n yaa mam bɛɛba.
Mam Wẽnnaam, fees-y maam n bãng m sũ-zulmã. Fees-y maam n bãng m tagsgã.
Ges-y tɩ mam sã n dɩka so-wẽnga, bɩ y tall maam sor sẽn paad wakat sẽn ka sɛtã zugu!
A Davɩɩd yɩɩlle, yɩɩlã naab yĩnga.
Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, fãag-y maam nin-wẽnsã nugẽ. Gũ-y maam ne nen-keglem soaba.
Nin-bãmb saagda saag-wẽns b sũyã pʋse, bãmb baooda zabr daar fãa.
Bãmb sɩlsda b zɛlmã wa wiisi, bãmb noyã pida ne põeer zẽnem.
Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, fãag-y maam nin-toaag nugẽ. Gũ-y maam ne nen-keglem soaba! Bãmb baoodame n dat n lub maam!
Wuk-m-mens rãmbã bẽta maam, bãmb gãnega wĩy la gãmbr sorã kɩrenga. Bãmb dɩgla bẽdg mam yĩnga.
La mam yeela Sẽn-Ka-Saab yaa: «Yãmb yaa mam Wẽnnaam!» Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, kɩll-y y tʋbr n kelg m se-yõkrã!
Wẽnnaam Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, yãmb yaa pãng sẽn fãagd maam. Zabr sã n yik daare, yãmb n lilld maam.
Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, da-y kõ-y nin-wẽnsã b sẽn datã ye. Da-y bas-y tɩ b sẽn set ne taabã pids tɩ b wa zẽkd b mens ye.
Kɩt-y tɩ nin-wẽnsã sẽn gũbg maamã no-beed lʋɩ b mens zutu.
Bɩ bug-saal rʋʋg b zutu! Bɩ b kɩt tɩ b lʋɩ bugmẽ, bɩ b lʋɩ bog-zulung pʋg n da tõog n leb n yi ye.
Bɩ tẽn-kãn-nedã ra paam zĩig tẽng zug ye. Wẽngã na n pʋga nen-keglem soab n ka bas ye.
Mam miime tɩ Sẽn-Ka-Saab n zabd n sõngd naong soaba, la bãmb n kaood nimbãan-ned bʋʋd tɩrga.
N-yẽe! Nin-tɩrsã na n pʋʋsa yãmb barka, Nin-tɩrsã na n zĩnda ne yãmba.
A Davɩɩd yɩɩlle. Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, mam boonda yãmba. Wa-y tao-tao n wa sõng-ma! Kɩll-y y tʋbr n kelg m sẽn boond yãmba!
Bɩ m pʋʋsgã zẽk wa wisd n ta y nengẽ. Bɩ m nusã sẽn zẽk n tees yãmbã yɩ wa zaabr maoongo!
Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, gũ-y mam noorã. Gũ-y mam no-bɩmsã.
Da bas-y tɩ m sũurã tags wẽng ye. Da sak-y tɩ m naag nin-wẽnsã n tʋm tʋʋm-wẽns ye. Da bas-y tɩ m naag bãmb n maan b sẽn datã ye.
Nin-tɩrg sã n sɩbg maam, a wilga maam a nonglem. A sã n keoog maam, yaa bark m yĩnga. M ka na n tõdg ye. Mam na n pʋʋsame n kɩɩs nin-wẽnsã tʋʋmã.
B na n dɩka b nanambsã n lob pĩig kugr zugu, la nin-wẽnsã na n kelga mam goamã, bala, b yaa noogo.
Wa b sẽn gudgd tẽn-gãongã t'a pusd to-to wã, woto me, tõnd kõabã na n sãeega kɩɩm-kulg noorẽ.
Zu-soabã Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, yaa yãmb la m geta. Mam zĩ-soalgdg yaa yãmb nengẽ. Da bas-y maam tɩ m ki ye!
Fãag-y maam ne bẽdg ning b sẽn bẽt maamã, la y fãag-m ne tʋʋm-wẽns maandbã tãoogã!
Bɩ nin-wẽnsã bẽdg wẽneg n yõk-b tɩ mam paam n põse.
A Davɩɩd sũur gomde. Yaa wakat ning a sẽn wa n be tãngã bokẽ wã. Yaa pʋʋsgo.
Mam zẽkda m koɛɛg n boond Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, mam zẽkda m koɛɛg bãmb taoor n yõkd b sɛɛga.
Mam bee bãmb taoor n wilgd m kosgã, bãmb taoor la m togsd m yel-pakrã.
Mam daoodã sã n wa n sɛ zãnga, yãmb a Wẽnnaam mii mam sore. Bɛɛbã rɩgla bẽdg mam so-tũudgã zugu.
Wẽneg-y n ges-y mam nug-rɩtgo, ned ka be sẽn yet t'a mii maam ye. Mam ka leb n tar solgr zĩig ye. Ned baa a yembr toog ka be ne mam vɩɩmã ye.
Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, mam kelemd n boonda yãmba. Mam yetame: «Yãmb la mam zĩ-soalgdga, dũniyã zug ka, ninsaalb sʋka, yãmb la m fãa-fãa.»
Wʋm-y mam kɛlengã! Bala, mam pãngã sɛɛ zãnga. Fãag-y maam ne sẽn digd-b maamã. Bala, b pãngã yɩɩda maam.
Yiis-y maam bi-bees roogẽ, tɩ mam tõe n pʋʋs yãmb barka. Nin-tɩrsã na n wa gũbga maam, yãmb sẽn maan maam neerã yĩnga.
A Davɩɩd yɩɩlle. Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, wʋm-y mam pʋʋsgã, la y kɩll y tʋbr n kelg m se-yõkrã! Bɩ y leok maam y pʋ-peelmã ne y tɩrlmã pʋga.
Bɩ y ra bʋ ne y tʋmtʋmdã ye. Bala, nin-vɩɩsã sʋka, ned ba a yembr ka be n yaa tɩrg yãmb nifẽ ye.
Bɛyã pʋgd n tabda maam, n namsd mam vɩɩmã. Yẽnda kẽesa maam lik bida pʋga, wa neb nins sẽn ki daar zãrã.
Mam daoodã sɛɛ zãnga. Mam gĩinã maaga zãnga.
Mam tẽra kʋdem-wẽndẽ yelle, mam leb n gomda yãmb tʋʋmã yelle, mam tagsda yãmb nus tʋʋmã yelle.
Mam zẽkda m nus n teesd yãmba. Mam baooda yãmb wa tẽn-koɛɛng sẽn dat koom.
Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, leok-y maam tao-tao, mam sɩɩgã yɛɛme. Da solg-y y nengã ne maam ye. Sã n ka rẽ, mam na n lebga wa neb nins sẽn sigd yaoogẽ wã.
Kɩt-y tɩ m wʋm yãmb nonglem koɛɛgã yibeoog fãa! Bala, mam dɩka m teegrã n teeg yãmba. Kɩt-y tɩ m bãng sor ning m sẽn tog n dɩke. Bala, mam geta yãmba.
Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, fãag-y maam m bɛɛbã nugẽ! Mam soondeda yãmb nengẽ.
Zãms-y maam tɩ m maan yãmb daabo. Bala, yaa yãmb la mam Wẽnnaam. Bɩ yãmb maan-neer sɩɩgã tɛ maam so-sõng zugu.
Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, yãmb yʋʋrã yĩnga, bɩ y kõ-m vɩɩm! Yãmb tɩrlmã yĩnga, bɩ y yiis maam yel-pakrã pʋga!
Yãmb nonglmã yĩnga, bɩ y kɩt tɩ m bɛɛbã noy mume. Bɩ y menes mam zabd-n-taasã zãnga, bala, mam yaa yãmb tʋmtʋmda.
Yaa a Davɩɩd yɩɩlle. Bɩ Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa mam pĩigã paam pẽgre. Bãmb n zãmsd maam zabr sẽn zabd to-to, la b segend mam nus zabr yĩnga.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yaa mam maan-neer soaba. Bãmb yaa mam pãng zĩiga, la m zĩ-soalgdga, la m fãagda. Bãmb yaa mam gãongo, la m zĩ-lilldga. Bãmb n kɩtd tɩ nebã sakd maam!
Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, ninsaal yaa bõe tɩ yãmb nand-a? Ninsaal yaa ãnda tɩ yãmb get a yelle?
Ninsaal wẽnda rʋk waolg bala, la a yʋʋmã wẽnda maasem sẽn loogda.
Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, kɩll-y saasã n sigi! Sɩɩs-y tãmsã tɩ bug-zõos yi b pʋsẽ!
Bɩ y tʋm sa-tãs n sãeeg-ba! Tão-y y pɛɛmã n zũndg-ba!
Zĩnd-y yĩngr n tẽeg y nugã, n fãag-ma, fãag-y-m ko-kãsemsã pʋga, fãag-y maam bu-zẽmsã nugẽ.
Bala, b noyã yagda zĩrẽ, la b nug-rɩtg pida ne zãmbo.
Mam Wẽnnaam, mam na n yɩɩla yɩɩn-paalg yãmb yĩnga. Mam na n wãaga ruudg sẽn tar sus piig yãmb yĩnga.
Yãmb a Wẽnnaam n kõt rĩm-dãmb tõogre. Yãmb n sõngd y tʋmtʋmd a Davɩɩd t'a põs sãoong zabr sʋʋga.
Yols-y maam, la y fãag-m bu-zẽmsã nugẽ, bala, b noyã yagda zĩrẽ, la b nug-rɩtg pida ne zãmbo.
Tõnd kom-dibli wã wẽnda tɩ-poal sẽn yi n bɩtẽ. Tõnd kom-pugli wã neermã wẽnda tãn-met sẽn nags na-yir ra-lugd-bɩlma.
Tõnd bao wã pida ne bõn-koaadl buud fãa. Tõnd rũm-bãoonegã fɩɩgd n lebgda tusa, b fɩɩgd n lebgda tus piig-piig tõnd wetã pʋse.
Tõnd niigã tara pʋse. Rũm-kũum wall rũng sẽn fabd ka be be ye. Sũ-sãang kɛleng ka be tõnd sõasg zĩigẽ ye!
Bark bee neb nins sẽn paam bõn-kãensã zutu! Bark bee neb nins sẽn paam tɩ Sẽn-Ka-Saab yaa b Wẽnnaamã zutu!
Mam Wẽnnaam, mam na n waooga yãmba, tɩ yãmb n yaa mam dĩma. Mam na n pẽga yãmb yʋʋrã wakat fãa.
Mam na n pẽga yãmb n ka bas ye. Mam na n waooga yãmb yʋʋrã wakat fãa.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yaa kãsenga, la b zemsame tɩ reeg pẽgrã fãa. Ned ka tõe n bãng bãmb kaosengã tɛk ye.
Bɩ zamaan woo zamaan nebã pẽg yãmb tʋʋmã, bɩ b moon yãmb tʋʋm-kãsemsã.
Mam na n tagsa yãmb bõn-bãnã yelle, ne yãmb ziirã sẽn pɩndã yelle.
B na n goma yãmb pãn-kãsengã yelle, la mam na n moona yãmb tʋʋm-kãsemsã.
B na n tẽega yãmb tʋʋm-sõmyã yelle, n moon-ba, la b moon yãmb tɩrlmã yelle.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yaa sõmblem-soaba, la nimbãan-zoɛta, bãmb yaa sũ-mar soaba, la nonglem-kãseng soaba.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yaa sõmblem soab nebã fãa yĩnga, la b nimbãan-zoeerã yãagda bãmb tʋʋmã fãa.
Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, yãmb tʋʋmã fãa na n pẽga yãmba, la sẽn tũud-b yãmbã na n pẽga yãmba.
Bãmb na n togsa yãmb naamã ziiri, la b na n goma y pãn-kãsengã yelle,
n kɩt tɩ ninsaalb bãng yãmb tʋʋm-kãsemsã, ne yãmb naamã ziir sẽn yaa kãsengã.
Yãmb naamã ka tar sɛɛb ye, la yãmb n so zamaan-dãmbã fãa.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab kokda sẽn lʋɩtbã, la b yikd neb nins pãng sẽn sɛ wã.
Bãmb fãa wẽnemd n geta yãmb n teeg yãmba, n gũudẽ tɩ y kõ-b rɩɩb wa sẽn zems a wakate.
Yãmb sã n puk y nugã, sẽn vɩ-bã fãa paamda b sẽn dat tɩ seke.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yaa tɩrlem soab b sẽn maandã fãa pʋga, la b yaa sõmblem soab b tʋʋmã fãa pʋga.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab pẽe ne neb nins sẽn boond bãmbã, b pẽe neb nins sẽn boond bãmb ne sɩdã.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab pidsda sẽn zoet-b bãmbã ratem. B sã n bool-b n kos sõngre, bãmb wʋmdame n wa sõng-ba.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab gũuda neb nins sẽn nong bãmbã, la b sãamda nin-wẽnsã zãnga.
Bɩ mam noorã waoog Sẽn-Ka-Saabo! Bɩ bõn-vɩɩsã fãa pẽg bãmb yʋ-sõngã.
Pẽg-y Sẽn-Ka-Saabo! Mam na n pẽga Sẽn-Ka-Saabo!
Mam vɩɩmã tɛka, mam na n pẽga Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, mam sã n ket n vɩ, mam na n yɩɩl n waooga Sẽn-Ka-Saabo.
Da rɩk-y y teegrã n teeg nanambs ye. Da teeg-y ninsaalbã sẽn ka tõe n fãagã ye.
Bãmb vɩɩmã loogdame, b lebsda tẽngã a tom, la badaar bala, b saagrã tũud-b lame n menem.
Bark bee ned ning sẽn paam t'a Zakoob Wẽnnaamã yaa a sõangdã zugu. Sẽn teeg-a Sẽn-Ka-Saab tɩ b yaa a Wẽnnaam tara barka.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab n naan yĩngr la tẽnga, la b naan ko-kãsengã ne bũmb nins fãa sẽn be a pʋgã. Bãmb maanda sɩd wakat fãa!
Bãmb bʋʋda sẽn namsdbã bʋʋd tɩrga. Bãmb n kõt kom sẽn tar-b rãmbã rɩɩbo. Sẽn-Ka-Saab n kõt yembs lohorem.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab n pugsd zoens nini. Sẽn-Ka-Saab n doogd sẽn kɩll-bã. Sẽn-Ka-Saab nonga nin-tɩrsã.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab n gũud sãamba. Bãmb sõngda kɩɩb ne pʋg-kõore, la b kɩtdẽ tɩ nin-wẽns saagr kẽed moogo.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n dɩɩ naam wakat fãa. Sɩyõ nebã, bãmb yaa yãmb Wẽnnaam zamaan woo zamaane! Pẽg-y Sẽn-Ka-Saabo!
Pẽg-y Sẽn-Ka-Saabo! Bala, yaa sõama tɩ d yɩɩl n pẽg d Wẽnnaamã, a yaa noogo, la neere, tɩ d pẽg bãmba.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab lebs n meta Zeruzalɛm. B lebs n tigimda Israyɛll neb nins sẽn dag n sãeegã.
Bãmb belsda sũ-sãang rãmbã, la b tɩpd b poglgã.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab tara ãdsã sõore, la b mii ãdg fãa ne a yʋʋre.
Tõnd Zu-soabã yaa kãsenga, n tar pãn-kãsenga, bãmb bãngrã ka tar tɛk ye.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab zẽkda naong rãmba, la b sikda nin-wẽnsã n tãag tẽnga.
Pʋd-y yɩɩll n pʋʋs Sẽn-Ka-Saab barka, Wẽ-y pɛndg n pẽg tõnd Wẽnnaamã!
Bãmb n lud sa-gãongã ne sawato, bãmb n segend saag tẽn-gãongã yĩnga. Bãmb n kɩtd tɩ mood yit tãms zutu.
Bãmb n kõt rũmsã b rɩɩbo, la gãabg kamb sã n kelme, bãmb kõt-b-la rɩɩbo.
Ka wed-moaag pãng n noogd bãmb sũuri, la ka ninsaal yãoog pãng n kõt-b sũ-noog ye.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab sũur nooma ne sẽn zoet-b bãmbã, la ne neb nins sẽn maand tẽeb ne bãmb nonglmã.
Zeruzalɛm, kils Sẽn-Ka-Saabo! Sɩyõ, pẽg f Wẽnnaamã!
Bala, b paasda fo kʋɩlemsã kʋɩlen-kuyã pãnga. B ningda kambã sẽn be fo pʋgẽ wã barka.
Bãmb kɩtdame tɩ vɩ-bãan zĩnd fo soolmã pʋga. Bãmb n kõt foom bõn-koaadl tɩ seke.
Bãmb kɩtame tɩ b noorã saag dũniyã gilli. Bãmb gomdã saaga ne tʋʋlem.
Bãmb kɩtame tɩ neez rʋʋg wa pe-kõbdo, bãmb yɛdga meenem wa tompeglem.
Bãmb fẽrgda b sapɩlem-zeremse. Ãnda soab n tõe n yals bãmb waoodẽ wã?
Bãmb tʋmda b gomdã t'a yẽneg-ba. Bãmb sã n kɩt tɩ sebgã yiki, koomã zoetame.
Bãmb vẽnega b goamã ne a Zakoobe, la b vẽneg b noyã ne b no-tũudsã ne Israyɛlle.
Bãmb ka maan bũmb a woto n kõ buud a taabã fãa ba a yembr ye. Bu-bãmb ka mi bãmb no-tũudsã ye. Pẽg-y Sẽn-Ka-Saabo!
Pẽg-y Sẽn-Ka-Saabo! Zĩnd-y saasẽ n pẽg Sẽn-Ka-Saabo! Pa-y yĩngr n pẽg bãmba!
Yãmb fãa sẽn yaa bãmb malegsã, pẽg-y bãmba! Yãmb fãa sẽn yaa bãmb tãb-biisã, pẽg-y bãmba!
Bɩ wĩntoogã ne kiuugã pẽg bãmba! Bɩ ãdsã fãa sẽn kõt vẽneemã pẽg bãmba!
Bɩ sẽn be-b hal saasẽ-saasẽ wã pẽg bãmba, la bɩ koomã sẽn be sa-gãongã yĩngrã, pẽg bãmba!
Bɩ bãmb fãa pẽg Sẽn-Ka-Saab yʋʋrã! Bala, yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab n gome, n naan bãmba.
Bãmb vigl-b-la wakat sẽn kõn sa yĩnga. Bãmb vigla noor sẽn paad wakat fãa.
Tẽng zug rãmba, pẽg-y Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, la bɩ koom pʋgẽ parwẽnã, ne zĩ-zulumsã fãa pẽg bãmba.
Bugum ne sapɩlem, la neez ne wulgu, foom a sobg sẽn sakd bãmb noore,
tãmse, yãmb a kunkubã fãa, tɩɩs sẽn womd biisi, yãmb a sɛɛdr tɩɩse,
rũmsi, yãmb a we-rũmsã fãa, bõn-vuudsi, liuuli,
dũniyã nanambse, ninsaalbã fãa, na-biisi, dũniyã bʋ-kaoodb gilli,
kom-bɩɩs ne pʋg-sadba, nin-kẽemba, kom-bãoonego,
pẽg-y Sẽn-Ka-Saab yʋʋrã! Bala, bãmb yʋʋrã bal n yaa kãsenga. Bãmb yʋʋrã ziir buiida yĩngr la tẽnga.
Bãmb paasa b nebã pãnga, tɩ yaa pẽgr bãmb nin-nongdsã fãa yĩnga, la Israyɛll sẽn yaa buud ning sẽn pẽ bãmbã yĩnga! Pẽg-y Sẽn-Ka-Saabo!
Pẽg-y Sẽn-Ka-Saabo! Yɩɩl-y yɩɩn-paalg Sẽn-Ka-Saab yĩnga! Yɩɩl-y n pẽg-y Sẽn-Ka-Saab bãmb nin-nongdsã nebã sʋka!
Bɩ Israyɛll nebã maan sũ-noog b naandã yĩnga! Bɩ Sɩyõ kom-dibli wã kɩdem b rĩmã yĩnga!
Bɩ b sao n pẽg bãmb yʋʋrã. Bɩ b wẽ gãngãoogo, la b wẽ pɛndg n pẽg bãmba!
Bala, Sẽn-Ka-Saab sũur nooma ne b nebã. Bãmb fãaga naong rãmbã, n waoog-ba.
Bɩ Wẽnnaam nin-nongdsã kɩdem n waoog-ba. Baa b sã n wa be b gãasẽ, bɩ b kaas ne sũ-noogo!
Bãmb noyã pida ne Wẽnnaam pẽgre, tɩ zabr sʋʋg sẽn tar noy a yiib be bãmb nugẽ.
Bãmb dat n doka b sũur ne bu-zẽmsã, la b sɩbg buud toay-toayã,
n sẽb b rĩm-dãmbã ne bãense, la b balg b nin-kãsemsã ne kutu,
n kɩt tɩ b reeg sɩbgr ning sẽn dag n gʋls b yĩngã! Bõn-kãng na n yɩɩ Wẽnnaam nin-nongdsã fãa zu-zẽkre. Pẽg-y Sẽn-Ka-Saabo!
Pẽg-y Sẽn-Ka-Saabo! Pẽg-y Wẽnnaam b ro-sõngã pʋga! Pẽg-y bãmb sa-gãongã sẽn be yĩngrã pʋga, zĩig ning bãmb pãngã sẽn beẽ wã!
Pẽg-y bãmb b tʋʋm-kãsemsã yĩnga! Pẽg-y bãmb wa sẽn zems b kãosengã!
Peeb-y baorg n pẽg bãmba! Pẽg-y bãmb ne wɩɩga, la ruudga, ne pɛndga!
Wẽ-y gãngãoogo, la y sao n pẽg bãmba! Pẽg-y bãmb ne yʋʋm-teed sẽn tar susi, la ne meenem!
Pẽg-y bãmb ne kɛm sẽn yaa noogo! Pẽg-y bãmb ne waag sẽn tar bʋr-noogo!
Bɩ bũmb nins fãa sẽn vʋʋsd ne yõorã pẽg Sẽn-Ka-Saabo! Pẽg-y Sẽn-Ka-Saabo!
A Davɩɩd biig a Salmo sẽn yaa Israyɛll dĩmã yel-bũna.
Yel-bõn-kãensã yaa sẽn na n yɩlẽ tɩ ninsaal tõe n paam yam, la remsgo, n tõog n wʋm yam goam võore.
La a paam yam vẽnegr zãmsg sẽn yaa: zemsgo, sɩda, la tɩrlem.
La sẽn na n yɩl n kõ zɩtbã minim, la kom-bɩɩsã yam la bãngre.
Yam soab sã n kelge, a na paam yam n paase, la sẽn tar-a bãngr me sã n kelge, a na tõog n tɛ neb a taaba.
La a tõog n wʋm yel-bũnã ne yel-soalmã võyã, la yam dãmbã goamã ne b yel-solgdsã.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab zoees yaa bãngr sɩngre. La yalembã kisa yam la remsgo.
M biiga, sak f ba remsgo, la f ra kɩɩs f ma zãmsg ye.
Bãmb na n yɩɩ maanf sẽn yaa neer sẽn be f zugẽ, la kĩndi sẽn be f loorẽ.
M biiga, yel-wẽn-maandb sã n dat n belg foom tɩ f maan wẽnga, bɩ f ra sak ye.
Bãmb sã n yeel foom: «Wa tɩ d bao zĩig n soond n paam ned zɩɩm n daage. Wa tɩ d bẽd neb sẽn ka tar b toorẽ yell zaalem yĩng bala,
n vel bãmb vɩɩs wa kɩɩm-kulg sẽn vend kũum to-to wã. D vel-b mum wa neb sẽn sigd yaoogẽ.
Woto, tõnd na n paama laog buud toor-toore, n pids d dotã ne paoongo.
Bɩ f wa tɩ fo me na n paama f pʋɩɩr ne tõndo, La d laogã na n naaga taab zĩ-yende.»
M biiga, ra tũ bãmb ye, zãag f meng ne sor ning nin-bãmbã sẽn tũudã.
Bala, bãmb zoetame n na n tɩ maan wẽnga, la bãmb yãgd n na n tɩ raaga zɩɩm.
Bõn-yɩgdr kõn yã tãoog bẽdb tɩ leb n yõk-a ye.
La nin-bãmbã wẽnegd n bẽta b mense, n daagd b mens zɩɩm.
Fãad yel-manesem yaa a woto. Yẽnda bẽta a menga, la a vɩɩmã na n sãamame.
Yam bee soay zut n kelemdẽ, n zẽkda a koɛɛg n gomd daasẽ.
La a bee kʋʋng sʋk n zẽkd a koɛɛg n kelemdẽ, la a be tẽngã noor n yetẽ:
«Zɩtba, yãmb na n pa y zɩɩlmã pʋgẽ hal tɩ ta dabʋre? La yãmb a nin-paoogdbã, y na n kell n paooga y taab hal tɩ ta dabʋre? La yãmb a yalembã, dabʋr la y na n bao bãngre?
Reeg-y m saglsã, la m na pʋdg m sɩɩgã y zutu, n kɩt tɩ y bãng m goamã.
Mam sẽn bool yãmb tɩ y zãgsã yĩnga, la m tud m nug tɩ ned ba a yembr ka tol n gesã,
la y sẽn zãgs m saglsã, n ka geelg m keoogrã baa bilfã,
yãmb me sã n wa n be toog pʋgẽ, mam me na n la-y lame. La rabeem sã n wa yõk-y tɩ y rigda, mam na n yaal-y lame.
Rabeemã sã n wa kẽ yãmb wa saag sebgo, tɩ sãoongã wa y zut wa sɩlmande, yel-pakrã ne sũ-sãangã sã n wa wa y zutu,
wakat-kãnga, y na n boola maam, la m ka na n leok-y ye. Y na n bao maam la y ka na n yãnd-m ye.
Bala, yãmb kisga bãngre, la yãmb ka yãk yam n na n zoe Sẽn-Ka-Saab ye.
Yãmb sẽn dag n ka reeg m saglsã, la y sẽn kisg m keoogrã fãa wã yĩngã,
y na n dɩ y tʋʋmã biisi, la y na n tɩga ne y mens saglse.
Bala, zɩt kõn deeg yellã n na n kʋ-a, la yalembã sẽn ka tagsdã n menesd-ba.
La sẽn kelgd-a maam zĩi ne bãane. Yẽnda na n vɩɩmda ne bãane, n ka tol n yɛɛsdẽ tɩ yel-beed na n wa paam-a ye.»
M biiga, fo sã n sak n deeg mam goamã, la f sã n bĩng m tõodã f sũurẽ,
fo sã n yok f tʋbr n kelg yam zãmsgã neere, la f sak n bao tɩ wʋm a võore,
n yẽe! Fo sã n bao bãngre, la fo sã n zẽk f koɛɛg n bao yam-sõngo,
fo sã n bao-a wa f sẽn baood wanzuri to-to wã, la f sã n maag f yĩng n bao-a wa f sẽn baood arzegsã,
woto, f na wʋm Sẽn-Ka-Saab zoees võore, la f bãng Wẽnnaam.
Bala, yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab n kõt yam, la bãngr ne yam-sõng yita bãmb noorẽ.
Bãmb tara sõngr nin-tɩrsã yĩnga. La bãmb yaa gãong burkĩmbã yĩnga.
Bãmb kogenda neb nins sẽn kẽnd zemsgã soay zutã, la b gũud pʋ-peelem dãmbã.
Woto la f na n bãng zemsgo, ne sɩd la tɩrlem võore, sẽn dat n togs tɩ soay nins fãa sẽn dabd naar zĩigẽ wã.
Bala, fo na n paama yam, la bãngrã na n kõo foom sũ-noogo.
Tagsgã na n kogla foom, la bãngrã na n gũ-f-lame,
n fãag foom so-wẽngã zugu, la ne ned ning sẽn gomd gom-yoodo,
la ne neb nins sẽn basd-b tɩrlem soayã, n kẽnd soay sẽn yaa lik pʋgẽ wã.
Nin-bãmb maanda sũ-noog ne wẽngã maanego, la b kɩdemd b tʋʋm-yoodã maaneg yĩnga.
Nin-bãmb yel-manesmã yaa kɛga, la b tʋʋmã fãa yaa goalmã.
Rẽndã n na n fãag foom ne pʋg-yoodre, la a fãag-f ne pʋg-sãang sẽn gomd no-noom goamã.
Sẽn bas-a a bi-bɩɩlem wakatẽ sɩdã, la a yĩm yẽnda ne a Wẽnnaamã kaoolã.
Ade, yẽnda yel-manesmã rabda ne-a kũum zĩigẽ, la a soayã tar-a lame n dabd kɩɩm-kulgu.
Neb nins fãa sẽn kẽnd-b yẽnda nengẽ wã ka lebgd ye. Bãmb ka leb n tõe n yãnd vɩɩm sor n tũ ye.
Dẽ wã yĩnga, bɩ f rɩk nin-sõamyã mamsgo, la f rɩk nin-tɩrsã mamsgo.
Bala, yaa nin-tɩrsã n na n vɩɩmd dũni zugu, La yaa burkĩmbã n na n pa be n vɩɩmde.
B na n menesa nin-wẽnsã tẽngã pʋga. La b võ zãmb dãmbã wa mood n yiis tẽngã.
M biiga, ra yĩm m zãmsgã ye, tall m noyã neer f sũur pʋgẽ.
Tɩ woto n na n kõ-f yõ-woko, n kɩt tɩ f vɩɩmd n zĩnd ne bãane.
Ra sak n bas maan-sɩd la pʋ-peelem ye, pid bãmb f loorẽ, la f gʋls bãmb f sũur pʋgẽ.
Woto, Wẽnnaam ne nebã na n pẽga foom, la b sũur na n yɩɩ noog ne-fo.
Bɩ f teeg Sẽn-Ka-Saab ne f sũur fãa, la f ra teeg f meng bãngr ye.
Bɩ f tẽeg Sẽn-Ka-Saab yelle, bũmb nins fãa f sẽn maandã pʋgẽ, la bãmb n na n manega f soayã.
Ra tags tɩ f tara yam tɩ sek ye. Zoe Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, la zãag f meng ne wẽnga.
Bõn-kãng n na n kõ f yĩnsã laafɩ, la a kõ f kõabã keelem.
Waoog Sẽn-Ka-Saab ne f paoongo, la f koodã dẽenem biisi.
Woto, f baoã na n pida ne koodo, la f sĩmsã fãa na n pida ne reezẽ rãam.
M biiga, ra kɩɩs Sẽn-Ka-Saab remsgã ye, la f ra kisg bãmb keoogrã ye.
Bala, Sẽn-Ka-Saab keoogda b sẽn nong-a soaba, wa ba sẽn keoogd a bi-nongr to-to wã.
Bark bee ned ning sẽn tar-a yamã zugu. Bark bee ned ning sẽn paam-a bãngr zugu.
Bala, yam tara yõod n yɩɩd wanzuri, la a tara nafr n yɩɩd sãnem.
Yam tara yõod n yɩɩd kĩndi halaale. La bõn-neebã fãa ka tõe n dɩk n mak ne-a ye.
Yõ-wok bee yam dɩtgo, tɩ arzegs ne ziir be a goabga.
Yẽnda soayã yaa neeba, la a so-bugsã fãa yaa vɩ-bãane.
Yam yaa vɩɩm tɩɩg ned ning sẽn tar-a wã yĩnga, la ned sã n tar yam, a tara sũ-noogo.
Yaa ne yam la Sẽn-Ka-Saab yẽbg dũniyã, la yaa ne bãngr la b lugl sa-gãongã.
Yaa ne b bãngrã la b kɩt tɩ koom bund n yit tẽngã zugu, la b kɩt tɩ sawatã sikd sa-koom.
M biiga, gãd yam ne bãngr neere, la f ra bas-b tɩ b zãag ne-f ye.
Bala, b na n kõ-f-la vɩɩm, la b na n gũu foom.
Woto, fo na n kẽndame n ka yɛɛsdẽ ye, la f naoor me kõn lak bũmb ye.
Fo sã n kẽ gãaga, rabeem kõn yõk-f ye, la f sã n gãe, f gõeem na n yɩ-f-la noogo.
Da zoe rabeem ne yell na n wa ling-f ye, wall nin-wẽns sẽn na n wa rat n zab ne foom ye.
Bala, Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n yɩɩ fo sõangda, la b na n gũu foom tɩ f ra lʋɩ bẽdg pʋgẽ ye.
Fo sã n tar pãn-tõog tɩ sõnge, bɩ f ra zãgs tɩ sõng neb nins sẽn tog ne sõngrã ye.
Fo sã n tar n tõe n kõ ned dũndã, bɩ f ra yeel a soab t'a kẽng la a wa beoog ye.
Ned sã n vɩ bãan ne foom, bɩ f ra bao tɩ maan-a wẽng ye.
Ra zab ne ned zaalem, t'a yaool n ka maan-f bũmb ye.
Ra maan sũ-kiir ne nin-wẽnga, la f ra togs a manesmã ye.
Bala, Sẽn-Ka-Saab kisa nin-wẽnga, la b yaa nin-tɩrsã zoa.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab kãab-wẽng bee nin-wẽng yirẽ, la bãmb ningda nin-tɩrg soolem barka.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab paoogda nin-paoogdbã, la bãmb maanda sik-m-mens rãmbã neere.
Yam dãmbã na n paama waoogr tɩ yɩ b pʋɩɩre, la yalembã na n paama paoogre.
M kamba, sak-y y ba remsgo, Kelg-y neer n paam bãngre.
Bala, mam kõo yãmb zãms-sõngo, dẽ, bɩ y ra bas-y m zãmsgã ye.
Sɩdã, mam me rag n yaa biig tɩ m ba so-ma, la m yɩɩ m ma bi-yend a sẽn dag n nonge.
La m ba rag n sagenda maam n yetẽ: «Bĩng m noyã neer f sũurẽ. Tall m tõodã n paam n vɩɩmde.
Bao yam ne bãngre, ra yĩm mam goamã, la f ra wẽnemd n bas-b ye.
Bɩ f ra bas yam t'a na n gũ-f lame. Nong-a t'a na n kogl-f lame.
Fo sã n dat n yɩ yam soaba, bɩ f bao yam. La f maan f sẽn tõe tɛk fãa n bao bãngre.
Waoog-a t'a na n kɩtame tɩ f yɩ nin-kãsenga. Fo sã n gãd-a neere, a na n kõ-f-la ziiri.
A na n fõgna f zugã ne sõmblem maanfo, la a fõgen f zugã ne maanf sẽn tar ziiri.
M biiga, kelg la f reeg m goamã, n paam yõ-woko.
Mam zãmsa foom yam sore, Mam tall-f lame n tɩ kẽes tɩrlem soay zutu.
Woto, bũmb kõn gɩdg f kẽnd ye, la f sã n zoetẽ, f kõn lak bũmb ye.
Sak m demsgã neere, n da bas-a ye. Tall-a t'a na n kõ-f-la vɩɩm.
Ra maan wa nin-wẽnsã ye, la f ra rɩk tʋʋm-wẽns maandbã sor ye.
Gil-a, la f ra tũ-a ye, loog la f bas-a!
Bala, bãmb ka gãanded n gũs tɩ b ka reng n maan wẽng ye. Bãmb sã n ka maan ned pʋ-toogo, b ka tõe n gũs ye.
Bala, wẽng maaneg yaa bãmb dɩɩbo, la pʋ-toogã yaa bãmb bõn-yũudla.
La nin-tɩrsã sor wẽnda wa sõor sẽn pukdi, t'a vẽenemã paasdẽ, hal n wa ta wĩnto-sʋka.
La nin-wẽnsã sor yaa wa yʋngo, bãmb ka mi bũmb ning sẽn na n lub bãmbã ye.
M biiga, kelg m goamã neere, la f yok f tʋb n kelg m saglsã,
Ra tol n yĩm m saglsã ye, tall bãmb f sũurã pʋgẽ kãenkãe.
Bala, b kõta neb nins fãa sẽn deegd bãmbã vɩɩm, la b kõt yĩnsã fãa laafɩ.
Maan gũusg ne f sũurã tagsg n yɩɩd bũmb fãa, bala, ninsaal vɩɩm yita a sũur pʋgẽ.
Da sak tɩ f noor gom zĩrẽ goam ye, la bɩ f zãag f noorã ne zãmb goamã.
Bɩ f ninã ges f taoore, la bɩ f gesgã tees tɩrg f taoore.
Maneg sor ning fo sẽn tũudã, tɩ f soayã fãa tõe n yɩ sõama.
Ra bʋdg n leb goabg bɩ rɩtg ye, zãag f meng ne wẽnga.
M biiga, kelg m yam-goamã neere, la f yok f tʋb n kelg m sẽn sagend-f ne bãngrã,
n tõog n paam gũus-m-menga, la tɩ f noorã tõe n gom pĩnd-n-bãngr goamã.
Bala, pʋg-yoodr noor goam yaa wa sɩɩdo, la a bʋgsame n yɩɩd kaam.
La baoosgo, a wat n lebga toog liga, n wãagd wa zabr sʋʋg sẽn tar noy a yiibu.
Yẽnda kẽnd n dabda kũum zĩigẽ, la yẽnda sorã rɩka kɩɩm-kulg sor tɩrga.
Yẽnda ka manegd vɩɩmã sor ye, yẽnda bee tudgr pʋgẽ n ka miẽ ye.
Dẽ wã yĩnga m kamba, kelg-y maam. Ra zãag-y mens ne m goamã ye.
Zãag-y y mens ne pagb a woto buudu, La y ra tol n pẽneg b roogã noor ye.
Sã n ka rẽ, bõn-kãng na n kɩtame tɩ neb a taab paoog-fo, la b kɩt tɩ nin-toaag sãam f vɩɩmã,
la a kɩt tɩ sãamb wa soog f paoongã, tɩ neb fo sẽn ka mi wa rɩ f tʋʋmã yõodo,
la a kɩt tɩ f wa gãe n wõosdẽ, fo yĩnsã sẽn sãamdã yĩnga.
Wakat-kãnga, fo na n yeelame yaa: «Kato! Bõe yĩng tɩ mam kisg remsgã? Bõe yĩng tɩ mam ka sak n deeg keoogrã?
Mam maana a wãn n ka kelg m karen-saam-dãmbã noore, la m ka yok m tʋb me n kelg b zãmsgã?»
La kellẽ-la bilf tɩ yel-beed paam maam, nebã tiging la buudã sʋka.»
Yũ fo bulgã koom, yũ koom ning sẽn yit f bãkã pʋgã,
Fo na n basame tɩ f kʋɩlgã koom raagd raasẽ? Bɩ f na n basame t'a zoet soayã zutu?
Bɩ f pagã yɩ foom f yembr dẽnd bala! Da sak tɩ nin-sãams naag foom n lagm-a ye.
Bɩ f kɩt t'a paam naare, la f maan sũ-noog ne f bi-bɩɩlem wakatẽ paga.
Bala, yẽnda tara nonglem wʋsgo, la a pida ne bʋgsem. Bɩ yẽnda bĩisã kõ foom sũ-noog wakat fãa, la bɩ yẽnda nonglmã soog foom.
M biiga, yaa bõe tɩ f na n nong pag a to? Bõe yĩng tɩ f na n mogs pʋg-sãang bĩisa?
Bala, Sẽn-Ka-Saab nee ninsaal yel-manesem, la bãmb geta a sẽn dabd zĩig ning fãa.
Nin-wẽng lʋɩta a meng kongr pʋga. Yẽnda meng yel-wẽnã n wẽnegd n yõk-a.
Yẽnda kiida a sẽn ka paam remsg yĩnga, la yẽnda menemda a yalemdã sẽn yaa wʋsgã yĩnga.
M biiga, fo sã n dɩk sard n yeel f to t'a samdã foom n na n yao, wall f sã n dɩk sard tɩ f na n yaoo sãan samde,
n wa mik tɩ f gom n yõka f menga, fo noorã goam sã n yõk-f wa bẽdgo,
ad fo sẽn tog n maan n fãag f menga. Fo sẽn lʋɩ f zoa wã nugẽ wã yĩnga, kẽng n tɩ yãnd f zoa wã, n sik f meng n bõos-a ne pẽdgre, n yeel-a t'a bas f taale.
Da bao gõeem bɩ suusg baa bilf ye,
Bɩ f fãag f meng wa walg sẽn fãag a meng tãoos nugẽ, la wa liuul sẽn tõog n fãag a meng tãoogẽ.
Kʋɩɩma, kẽng n tɩ ges gũuri. Ges a sẽn maandã n dɩk yam.
Bãmb ka tar naaba, la b ka tar taoor soaba, tɩ b sokd kãsem ye.
La baoosgo, sɩpaolgo, bãmb tigsda b rɩɩbo. La bõn-bɩʋʋng wakate, b wʋkda b rɩɩb n bĩngdẽ.
Kʋɩɩma, fo na n pa f gãagẽ hal tɩ ta wakat-bʋgo? Wakat-bʋg la f na n nek n yiki?
Fo yetame tɩ f rat n gũsa bilfu, tɩ f na n suusa bilfu, n kalemd f nus n gãe.
Woto, naong na n soos n linga foom wa wagdre, la pɛtã na n linga foom wa fãada.
Sẽn gomd-a zĩrẽ goam ka nin-tɩrg ye, a yaa nin-yaalga.
Yẽnda wẽgsda a nin n gomd ne a nao, la a bilsd ne a nusi.
Yẽnda sũurã pida ne tʋʋm-dẽgdo, yẽnda tagsda wẽng maaneg wakat fãa, la yẽnda wata ne zaba.
Yaa rẽ n kɩte, tɩ sãoongã na n wa ling-a. La yẽnda na n sãamame tɩ tɩɩm kaẽ ye.
Bũmb a yoob n be Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn kisi, la a yopoe soabã yaa yel-beed bãmb nifẽ.
Yaa tɩtaam-gesgo, ne zelemd sẽn gomd zĩrẽ goamã, la nus sẽn daagd bʋʋm soab zɩɩm,
n paas sũur sẽn tagsd n dat n maan wẽnga, ne nao sẽn yãgd n na n tɩ maan wẽnga,
la kaset zĩrẽ soab sẽn yagd zĩrẽ, ne ned sẽn wat ne zab ba-biis ne taab sʋka.
M biiga, sak f ba noore, la f ra zãgs f ma zãmsg ye.
Bĩng zãms-kãens f sũurẽ wakat fãa, la f rɩk-b n pid f loorẽ.
La gom-kãens na n yãaga foom f kẽnã pʋgẽ, la b na n gũu foom f gõeem wakate, fo sã n wa yik f gãagẽ, gom-kãens na n sagl-f lame.
Bala, noyã yaa wa fɩtla, la zãmsgã yaa wa vẽenem, la remsgã ne keoogrã yaa vɩɩm sore.
B na n gũu foom ne pʋg-yoogo, la ne pʋg-sãang sẽn gomd no-noom goamã.
Bɩ f ra tʋlg pag a woto buud a neermã yĩng ye, la f ra bas t'a ninã gesg kɩt t'a ratmã kẽ-f ye.
Bala, bur-gɩrg sekda pʋg-yoodr yaoodo, la pag sã n tar sɩd la a yood ne-fo, yaa f vɩɩmã la a rat n sãame.
Ned tõe n sagla bugum a gɩfẽ t'a fuug ka rɩ bugum bɩ?
Bɩ ned tõe n taba bug-saall tɩ bugmã ka yõog a naoã?
A yaa woto me ne ned sẽn dood a to paga. Ned ning sẽn na n sɩɩs-a a to pag paamda sɩbgre.
Kom sã n tar ned t'a zuk rɩɩb n na n dɩ, bɩ b ra kisg-a t'a yaa wagdr ye,
La b sã n ling yẽnda n yõke, a na n yaoo bũmbã a sẽn dɩkã naoor a yopoe. La a na n kɩsa bũmb ning fãa a sẽn tar a zakẽ wã.
La sẽn yood-a ne a to pag yaa yam-kaalg soaba. Yaa sẽn dat-a n sãam a meng vɩɩm n maand a woto.
Yẽnda na n paama pãbr la paoogre, la a yãndã ka na n tol n sɛ ye.
Bala, pʋg-sɩd sũ-kiir wata ne a sũ-puug-kãsenga, la yẽnda sũ-dokrã daare, nimbãan-zoeer ka na n zĩnd ye.
La a ka na n sak yaood ye. Ba b sã n kõ yẽnda kũun wʋsgo, a ka na n tol n sak ye.
M biiga, tall m goamã neere, la f ra yĩm m noyã ye.
Bɩ f tall m noyã neer n paam vɩɩmde, la f gũus ne m zãmsgã neer wa f nin-beellã.
Pid bãmb f nug-biẽ, la f gʋls bãmb f sũurẽ.
Yeel yam yaa: «Fo yaa mam tão-poaka,» la f bool bãngr tɩ f roagda.
Woto, b na n gũu foom ne f to paga, la ne pʋg-sãang sẽn gomd no-noom goamã.
Mam dag n yɛsa m doog võorẽ, n lɩkdẽ n get yɩnga.
La mam yãnda kom-bɩɩsã sʋk ned a yembr sẽn yaa yam-kaalg soaba. Mam yãame tɩ ned a yembr bãmb sʋkã ka tar yam ye.
Yẽnda rag n tũuda sor sẽn yeg pʋg-yoodrã sẽn beẽ wã. Yẽnda bʋdgame n dɩk pʋg-yoodrã zak sore.
Rag n yaa zaabre, zĩ-sobd wakate. Zĩigã rag n sobgame tɩ lebg lika.
La ade, pag n yi n seg yẽnda, la a futã yermã yaa pʋg-yoodr fut yerem, n tar sɩlem tagsg a sũurẽ.
A nonga goam n ka zoet yãnd ye, la a ka tõe n zĩnd zakẽ ye.
A sã n ka be soayã zutu, a bee raasẽ wã, bɩ sotiisẽ n gũudẽ.
Ade, yẽnda gãda bi-bɩɩgã n moka, la a kenga a sũur n yeel bi-bɩɩgã yaa:
«Mam dag n pʋlmame n na maan zems-n-taar maoongo. Dẽ, yaa rũndã la mam pids pʋlen-kãnga.
Yaa rẽnda yĩng la m sẽn yi n na n seg foomã. Mam dag n baood-f lame la m yãnd-f lame.
Mam manega m gãagã n tɩʋ, yaa peen-neeb sẽn wʋg ne lamd gĩs sẽn yi Ezɩpte.
La mam yuga m gãagã ne parfẽ buud toor-toor sẽn tar yũ-noogo.
Bɩ f wa tɩ d maan nonglem ne taab tɩ beoog vẽege, la d maan nonglem sũ-noog ne taaba.
Bala, mam sɩdã ka be yir ye, a toga so-woko.
A zɩɩ ligd wʋsg ne korg n looge, la a ka na n wa tɩ ka ki-peoolgã sasa ye.
A no-noomã yĩnga, a tõoga bi-bɩɩgã, la a no-minimã yĩnga, bi-bɩɩgã saka a sẽn datã.
Dẽ, tao-tao bala, bi-bɩɩgã wẽnemdame n pʋg-a n looge, wa naaf b sẽn tar n dabd kʋʋbo, la wa b sẽn sẽb yalem n dabd sɩbgre,
hal tɩ peemd n wa kõs yẽnda n sãag t'a ki, wa luiil sẽn yɩk n tɩ lʋɩ tãoogẽ, n ka mi tɩ na n tũ ne a yõor ye.
Dẽ wã yĩnga, m kamba, kelg-y maam neere, la y tags m goamã yell neere.
Bɩ f ra bʋdg n tũ pag a woto buud ye, la f ra tũ soay nins a sẽn tũudã n wa menem ye.
Bala, yẽnda kɩtame tɩ neb wʋsg lʋɩ. La neb nins yẽnda sẽn kʋ wã rag n tara pãense.
La yẽnda zakã yaa kɩɩm-kulg sore, la yaa sor sẽn dabd kũum zĩigẽ.»
Yam boondame, la bãngr zẽkda a koɛɛga.
Yam yasa kunkubã zutu, la soayã noyã, ne so-palen-paasẽ,
la a yas tẽngã rignoyẽ, ne so-badsẽ n kelemdẽ n yetẽ:
«Ninsaalba, yãmb la m sẽn boondã! Ãdem biisi, yaa yãmb la m gomd ne!
Yãmb a zɩtba, bao-y bãngre! La yam-ka-sek-b rãmba, bao-y yam.
Kelg-y neere, bala m tara koe-kãseng n na n togs-yã, la mam noorã na n togsa tɩrlem goamã.
Bala, mam noorã gomda sɩda, la gom-wẽns goam yaa yel-beed ne maam.
Mam noorã goam fãa yaa tɩrse, la sɩlem bɩ gom-yood ka be b sʋk ye.
B fãa yaa vẽenes ne ned ning fãa sẽn tar-a yam, la ned sã n paam bãngre, a mikdame tɩ mam goamã yaa sɩda.
Sak-y m demsgã la y bas wanzuri, bao-y bãngr n yɩɩd sãnem halaale.
Bala, maam a yam tara yõod n yɩɩd kĩndi halaale, la bõn-sõama ba a yembr ka tõe n dɩk n mak ne maam ye.»
Maam a yam bee gũus-m-meng pʋgẽ, mam miime tɩ tags n paam bãngre.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab zoees yaa wẽng kisgri. Maam a yam kisa tɩtaam ne wuk-m-menga, la tʋʋm-wẽnse, ne zĩrẽ.
Maam n kõt saglg la m wilgd sẽn yaa neere. Yaa maam la bãngre, la pãng yaa maam n so.
Yaa maam la nanambsã tar n dɩt b naam, la yaa maam la bʋ-kaoodbã tar n vigind tõod sẽn yaa tɩrse.
Yaa mam maasem yĩng la nanambsã so b soolmã, tɩ kãsem-dãmbã ne bʋ-kaoodbã kaood bʋʋdã tɩrga.
Mam nonga sẽn nong-b maamã. La sẽn baood-b maamã na n yãnda maam.
Arzegs ne ziir bee ne maam, la paoong sẽn ka sɛta, ne tɩrlem.
Mam biisã yaa sõama n yɩɩd sãnem, b yɩɩda sãnem halaale. La b tara yõod n yɩɩd wanzuri halaale.
Mam kẽnda tɩrlem sor zugu, la yaa pʋ-peelem soay pʋsẽ la m kẽnda.
Mam dat n kõo sẽn nong-b maamã paoong tɩ b sooge, la m pids b rotã ne arzegse.
Hal kʋdemd wẽndẽ, Sẽn-Ka-Saab reng n naana maam pipi, n yaool n naan bũmbã fãa.
Bãmb naana maam tɩ bũmb baa fɩ nan ka be ye. B naana maam hal sɩngr wakate, sẽn deng dũniyã sẽn nan ka naane.
B roga maam tɩ ko-kãsemsã rag n nan ka be ye, la rẽ tɩ kʋɩls sẽn bund koom me rag n nan ka be ye.
La bãmb sẽn wa n dog maamã, tɩ b nan ka naan tãmsã ye, la rẽ tɩ kunkubã me rag n nan ka be ye.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn wa n naan maamã tɩ tẽn-gãongã ne wetã rag n nan ka be ye, la rẽ tɩ b rag n nan ka naan pipi tom-beell ba a yembr ye.
Bãmb sẽn wa n yɛdgd sa-gãongã tɩ mam dag n zoe n beeme. B sẽn wa n kargd zĩ-zulumsã ko-ninã toadgã tɩ mam dag n beeme.
Bãmb sẽn wa n kɩt tɩ sawatã tigimd yĩngrã, la b kɩt tɩ zĩ-zulumsã ko-ninã pus n yi ne pãngã,
Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn wa n yãkd ko-kãsengã todsã, n yeel ko-kãsengã tɩ b ra long n yi b todsẽ wã, b sẽn wa n na n yẽbg dũniyã n ning-a a zĩigẽ wã,
mam dag n bee bãmb sɛɛgẽ wa tʋʋmdã soaba, n kõt bãmb sũ-noog daar fãa, n kɩdemd b taoor wakat fãa.
Mam dag n deemda dũniyã bãmb sẽn naanã zugu, la m sũurã rag n nooma m sẽn vɩ ninsaalbã sʋkã yĩnga.
Dẽ wã yĩnga, m kamba, kelg-y maam! Neb nins sẽn sakd-b mam saglgã paamda sũ-noogo.
Sak-y m demsgã n lebg yam dãmba, la y ra zãgs-a ye.
Sẽn kelgd-a maam paamda sũ-noogo. Yẽnda bee mam dignoorẽ beoog fãa, yẽnda yɛsa mam digno-koakẽ n gũudẽ.
Bala, ned sã n paam maam, a paama vɩɩm, la a paamda Sẽn-Ka-Saab nonglem.
La ned sã n beeg maam, a maanda a meng wẽnga, la sẽn kis-b maamã nonga kũum.
Yam me a roogo, n lugl a ra-lugds a yopoe,
Yẽnda kʋ a rũng la a segl a reezẽ rãam, la a maneg a rɩɩb taabl n dɩgle.
Yẽnda tʋma a tʋmtʋmd-pogsã tɩ b kẽng tẽngã kunkubã zut n moondẽ n yetẽ:
«Yãmb a zɩtba, wa-y-yã!» La a yet yalembã yaa:
«Wa-y n dɩ-y m dɩɩbã, la y yũ m reezẽ rãamã m sẽn seglã.
Bas-y y yalemdã n paam n vɩɩmde. Bɩ y tũ-y bãngr sore.
Sẽn sagend-a nin-paoogdbã paamda paoogre, la sẽn keoogd-a nin-wẽng paamda tʋʋsgo.
Ra keoog nin-paoogd t'a na n kisg-f lame, bɩ f keoog yam soab t'a na n nong-f lame.
Wilg yam soaba, t'a na n paama yam n paase. Zãms nin-tɩrga, la a na n paama bãngr n paase.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab zoees yaa yam sɩngre, la ned sã n mi Pʋ-Peelem-Soabã, a tara bãngre.
Bala, yaa maam n na n kɩt tɩ f rasmã sõor yɩ wʋsgo, la m kɩt tɩ f paam yõ-woko.
Fo sã n tar yam, f yamã nafda f menga, la f sã n yaa nin-paoogda, yaa foom bal la na n wʋme.
Pʋg-yalem yaa fir-firi. A ka mi baa fɩ, a ka wʋmd baa fɩ.
Yẽnda zĩ a roogã noore, yẽnda zaoo tẽngã kunkubã zut ne a goeele,
n boond so-loaadbã sẽn dɩk-b sorã n loogdẽ wã n yetẽ yaa:
Yãmb a zɩtbã, lebg-y n wa-y ka!» La yẽnda yeta yam-kaalg rãmbã yaa:
«Wagdem bõn-yũudl noomame, la rɩɩb sẽn soosd n dɩtẽ me sakda velbo.»
La nin-bãmb ka mi tɩ b rigda kũum zĩigẽ ye. Bãmb ka mi tɩ pʋg-kãngã sẽn dag n bool-b rãmbã bee kɩɩm-kulg ye.
A Salmo yel-bũna Biig sẽn tar yam kõta a ba sũ-noogo, la bi-yalem kõta a ma sũ-sãanga.
Arzɛk sẽn paam ne zãmb ka tar yõod ye, la tɩrlem fãagda ned ne kũum.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab ka basd tɩ kom yõk nin-tɩrg ye. La bãmb mongda nin-wẽng a sẽn date.
Ned sã n tʋmd yaal-yaale, naong n yõkda, La sẽn tʋmda ne-a sũur fãa paamda arzegse.
Sẽn tigsd-a sɩpaolg yaa gũus-m-meng soaba, la sẽn basd-a tigsg n gãe n gõe yaa nin-yaalga.
Bark bee nin-tɩrg zugu, la nin-wẽns noy solgda b wẽnem.
Nin-tɩrg yell tẽegr wata ne barka, la nin-wẽng yʋʋr ka zɛɛd meneng ye.
Sẽn tar-a yam deegda noore, la sẽn gomd-a yalem-goam wãada a menga.
Sẽn kẽnd-a ne burkĩnd vɩɩ ne bãane, la ned sã n dɩkd so-wẽnga, yẽnda soab yɛlã na n wa pukame.
Sẽn wẽgsd-a a nin wata ne toogo, la sẽn gomd-a gom-wẽns wãada a menga.
Nin-tɩrg noor yaa vɩɩm bulga, la nin-wẽns noy solgda wẽnem.
Kisgr wata ne zaba, la nonglem luta kongre.
Nin-yẽeseng noor yiisda yam goamã, la dasaar yaa yam-kaalg soab poor yĩnga.
Yam soab tigsda bãngrã wa arzɛka, la yalem zelemd n wat ne a sãoongo.
Arzɛk soab arzɛk n yaa a pãnga, la naong soab naong n wãad-a.
Nin-tɩrg tʋʋm yaood yaa a vɩɩm yĩnga, la nin-wẽng sẽn paamdã yaa a yel-wẽn yĩnga.
Sẽn sakd-a remsg rɩka vɩɩm sore, la sẽn zãgsd-a keoogr na n menemame.
Sẽn solg-a kisgr gomda zĩrẽ goamã, la sẽn yaa tẽn-kãn-ned yaa yalma.
Sẽn gomd-a wʋsg ka tõe n ka kong ye, la sẽn gũusd-a a meng ne a goam tara yam.
Nin-tɩrg zelemd yaa wa wanzuri halaale, la nin-wẽns tagsg ka tar yõod ye.
Nin-tɩrg goam nafda neb wʋsgo, la yalembã kiida b yalemdã yĩnga.
Yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab barkã n wat ne arzɛka, tɩ yɩɩr ka naag ye.
Yalem geta wẽng maaneg wa reem, la yam soab geta yam baoob wa reem.
Nin-wẽng sẽn zoet bũmb ningã n paamd-a, la nin-tɩrg sẽn dat bũmb ningã la a paamda.
Sob-kãseng sã n fug n looge, nin-wẽng tũud n loogame. La nin-tɩrg sẽn yẽbg bũmb ningã paada wakat fãa.
Miisim sẽn yaa bũmb ning ne yẽnã, la bug-zõos me sẽn yaa bũmb ning ne ninã, kʋɩɩm me yaa a woto ne neb nins sẽn tʋmd yẽnda wã.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab zoees kõta yõ-woko, la b na n kʋʋga nin-wẽng yʋʋmã.
Nin-tɩrs tẽeb baasda ne sũ-noogo, la nin-wẽns tẽeb na n sãamame.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab tũudmã yaa gũudum burkĩmbã yĩnga, la tʋʋm-wẽns rãmbã na n sãamame.
Nin-tɩrg ka na n tol n vigs ye. La nin-wẽnsã ka na n pa dũni ye.
Nin-tɩrg noor yiisda yam goamã, la b na n wõrga gom-wẽns soab zelemde.
Nin-tɩrg noor gomda sẽn sakd kelgre, la nin-wẽng noor yiisda gom-yood bala.
Zãmb zɩslem makdg yaa yel-beed Sẽn-Ka-Saab nifẽ. La b sũur nooma ne pʋ-peelem zɩslem makdga.
Wuk-m-meng sã n wa, yaa paoogr n pʋgda, la sik-m-meng soab tara yam.
Nin-tɩrg burkĩndlim n tɛt-a, la sɩlem soab sɩlmã n wãad-a.
Arzɛk ka tõe n sõng ned sũ-puugrã daar ye, la tɩrlem fãagda ned ne kũum.
Burkĩn tɩrlem n manegd a soayã, la nin-wẽng wẽnem n lubd-a.
Nin-tɩrs tɩrlem n fãagd-ba, la zãmb dãmbã yão-beedã n yõkd-b wa bẽdgo.
Nin-wẽng sã n ki, bũmb ning a sẽn dag n tẽedã me sɛtame, la tẽeb ning a sẽn dag n tar ne a arzegsã me sãamdame.
Nin-tɩrg paamda yolsg ne yel-pakre, la nin-wẽng n let yẽnda zĩigẽ n deeg toogo.
Sẽn ka mi-a Wẽnd wãada a to ne a noor goamã, la nin-tɩrg bãngr n fãagd-a.
Nin-tɩrs sã n tar sũ-noogo, tẽngã neb fãa naagd n kɩdemdame. Nin-wẽns sã n sãamdẽ, tẽngã neb fãa kaasda ne sũ-noogo.
Nin-tɩrs bark yĩng kɩtdame tɩ tẽng lebgd kãsenga, la nin-wẽns no-goam wãada tẽnga.
Sẽn paoogd-a a to yaa yam-kaalg soaba, la sẽn tar-a yam sĩndidame.
Tẽn-kãn-ned pugsda yɛla, la sɩd soab luta yɛla.
Tẽng sã n ka zã ne yam, a nebã sãamdame, la sagendb sã n yaa wʋsgo, tõogr beeme.

Bala, Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n zab n sõng-b lame, la b na n sãama neb nins sẽn sãamd-b bãmbã vɩɩm.
Ra yõg zood ne sũ-tʋʋl-neda, la f ra rɩk sũ-pu-ned n maan f tũud-n-taag ye.
Sã n ka rẽ, f wat n dɩka a zʋgdã tɩ wa lebg bẽdg f mengã yĩnga.
Da rɩk sard n yeel tɩ f na n yaoo ned a to samd ye.
Bala, fo sã n ka tõog n yao, b na n wa sik-f lame la b rɩk f gãagã n looge.
Da yẽrg kʋdem wẽndẽ toadg kugrã fo yaab-rãmbã sẽn dag n viglã ye.
Ned sã n maand a tʋʋmd sõama, a ka na n tʋm nin-zaals yĩng ye, a na n tʋma rĩm-dãmb yĩnga.
F sã n zĩ n dɩt ne nin-naaba, bɩ f maan gũusg ne bũmb ning sẽn be f taoorã.
Fo sã n yaa yão-be-ned bɩ f yõk f menga.
Da tʋlg a rɩ-noodã ye, tɩ yaa belgr dɩɩbo.
Da nams f meng n pʋg arzegs ye, la ra sak tɩ bõn-kãng lebg f zu-loɛɛg ye.
Fo yonga f nin n get arzegse? Bãng tɩ b na n wa loogame, bala, b mii pɩgs pusbu, la b na n yɩka wa sɩlga, n loog saasẽ.
Ra rɩ nin-wẽng rɩɩb ye, la f ra tʋlg a rɩ-noodã ye.
Bala, a yel-manesmã yaa wa a tagsgã sẽn yaa to-to wã. Yẽnda na n yeela foom tɩ f rɩ la f yũ, t'a sũurã yaool n ka be ne foom ye.
Woto, fo na n wʋba bũmb ning fo sẽn dɩ wã, la f na n sãama gom-nood nins fo sẽn dag n gomã.
Da gom ne yalem ye, bala, yẽnda na n kisga fo yam goamã.
Da yẽrg kʋdem-wẽndẽ toadg kugr ye, la f ra reeg kɩɩbs pʋʋg n soog ye.
Bala, bãmb gũudã tara pãnga, la b na n zab n sõnga bãmba.
Segl f sũur n deeg remsgo, la f wɩng ne bãngrã goam kelgre.
Da bas biig n ka rems-a ye, bala, wẽed ka kʋʋd biig ye.
Fo sã n wẽ-a, f na n fãag-a-la ne kɩɩm-kulgu.
M biiga, fo sã n paam yam, mam me sũur na n yɩɩ noogo.
Fo noorã sã n togsd sɩd goamã, mam na n kɩdma ne sũ-no-kãsenga.
Da maan sũ-kiir ne yel-wẽn-maandbã ye, la bɩ f zoe Sẽn-Ka-Saab daar fãa.
Bala, daar n be, tɩ bũmb ning fo sẽn tẽedã ka na n vaal ye.
M biiga, kelg n paam yam, la f tũ sor sẽn yaa tɩrga.
Ra tũ sẽn yũud-b rãam n tɩgdã, la f ra tũ sẽn wãbd-b nemd n tɩgdã ye.
Bala, rã-yũud ne yão-be-ned kẽesda a meng naongo. La sẽn nong-a gõeem na n yelga fu-kʋdse.
Kelg f ba tɩ yaa yẽnda n dog foom, la f ra paoog f ma, a sẽn lebg pʋg-yãang yĩng ye.
Bao sɩdã, la f ra bas-a ye, la f bao yam, ne zãmsg la bãngre.
Nin-tɩrg ba kɩdemdame, la sẽn dog-a yam soab maanda sũ-noogo.
Bɩ f ba ne f ma maan sũ-noogo, la bɩ pag ning sẽn dog-a foomã kɩdem ne sũ-noogo!
M biiga, kɩs sɩd ne maam, la f rɩk m mamsg ne sũ-noogo.
La f bãng tɩ pʋg-yoodr yaa wa bog-zulunga, la pʋg-sãang yaa wa bul-sẽka.
Yẽnda solgd n bẽta neb wa fãada, la yẽnda kɩtdame tɩ neb wʋsg lebg zãmb dãmb n tudgdẽ.
Ãnda rãmb la toog paamda? Ãnda rãmb n maand m bãngẽ? Ãnda rãmb la zabã? Ãnda rãmb n yẽgemd n ka sɛtẽ wã? Ãnda rãmb n paamd poglg zaalem yĩnga? Ãnda rãmb la nin-moaama?
Yaa sẽn kaoosd-b reezẽ rãam yũub zĩigẽ wã, la sẽn yũud-b reezẽ rãam toay-toay sẽn kalemd taabã.
Ra ges reezẽ rãamã sẽn moogã ye, ra ges a sẽn yaa neer wamdã pʋgã ye, la f ra yeel t'a sakda yũub ye.
A wat n baas n dũma wa waafo, n kɛ wa põeere.
Fo na n yãnda bõn-sãamse, la f na n yɩɩ mo-be-neda.
Fo na n wa lebga wa ned sẽn gãe ko-kãsengã sʋka, wa ned sẽn zao tɩɩg wil-gɛlengɛɛg zugu, tɩ sobg lengdẽ.
Yẽnda bee beenẽ n yetẽ: «B wẽe maam, la ka zab-m ye. B pãba maam, la m ka bãng ye. Mam na n neka wakat-bʋgo? M sã n neke, m na n leb n yũume!»
Ra maan sũ-kiir ne nin-wẽns ye, la f ra bao tɩ naag-b ye.
Bala, bãmb tagsda sãoong yell bala, la b noyã sẽn yiisdã fãa yaa wẽnga.
Yam n met yiri, la yaa ne bãngr la yirã yalsd kãenkãe.
Yaa ne bãngre, la a ro-pʋsã fãa pit ne te-sõama buud toor-toor sẽn tar yõodo.
Ned yam n kõt-a pãnga. Ned sã n tar bãngre, a paamda pãng n paase.
Bala, yaa ne magb la f tõe n kẽng zabrẽ. Sagendb sã n yaa wʋsgo, f paamda tõogre.
Yam zãra ne yalma, Yaa rẽ t'a ka tõe n yaag a noor tẽngã rignoorẽ ye.
Ned sã n tagsd n dat n maan wẽnga, b boond-a lame tɩ zãmb naaba.
Yalem tagsg yaa yel-wẽn bala, la sẽn yaa yel-beed nebã nifẽ yaa nin-paoogda.
Fo sã n bas tɩ f raood boog yel-pakr wakate, f pãngã fãa lebga zaalem bala.
Fãag neb nins b sẽn yõg n dabd kʋʋbã. Gɩdg tɩ b ra kʋ b sẽn lengd-b rãmb n dabd kʋʋbã ye.
Fo sã n wa yeele: «Tõnd dag n ka bãng ye!» Bɩ f bãng tɩ sẽn feesd-a sũyã miime, ned ning sẽn gũud-a fo vɩɩmã neeme, la bãmb na n yaoo ned kam fãa wa sẽn zems a tʋʋmde.
M biiga, rɩ sɩɩdo, bala sɩɩd yaa noogo, la sɩ-vak nooma noorẽ.
Woto me, bãng yam f meng yĩnga. F sã n paam-a, daar n be, tɩ f tẽebã ka na n vaal ye.
Da soos n dɩgl bẽdg nin-tɩrg yiri, n na n maan a wẽng ye, la f ra sãam a vʋʋsgã zĩig ye.
Bala, nin-tɩrg tõe n lʋɩɩ naoor a yopoe, la a na n leb n yikame. La toog na n luba nin-wẽnga.
Fo bɛ sã n lʋɩ, bɩ f ra maan sũ-noog ye. A sã n lak n na n lʋɩ bɩ f ra kɩdme,
tɩ Sẽn-Ka-Saab wa yã rẽ, tɩ b sũur sãam tɩ b bas n ka sɩbg-a ye.
Ra yik f sũur ne nin-wẽns ye, la f ra maan sũ-kiir ne-b ye.
Bala, nin-wẽnsã ka na n paam beoog neer ye. Bãmb vɩɩmã yaa wa fɩtl sẽn na n wa ki.
M biiga, zoe Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, la f zoe rĩma, la f ra naag neb nins sẽn baood tɩ yɛlã fãa tegsã ye.
Bala, toogã na n ling-b-la vugr bala, la ãnda n mi sɩbgr ning Wẽnnaam, bɩ rĩmã sẽn na n sɩbg bãmbã?
Woto me yaa yam dãmb goam a taaba: Bʋʋd zĩigẽ, b ka tog n ges ned sẽn yaa-a soab n yaool n bʋ a bʋʋd ye.
Ned sã n yeel nin-wẽng t'a yaa tɩrga, b kãabd-a-la kãab-beedo, la nebã sũy yikda ne yẽnda.
La sẽn keoogd-b nin-wẽngã maanda neere. B na n paama bark la sũ-noogo.
Leokr sẽn leokd ne sɩd yaa zood hakɩɩk bãnde.
Tʋm f tʋʋmã yɩng fãa n sɛ, la f segl f pʋʋg neere, n yaool n me f zaka.
Da rõd f to zaalem yĩng ye. Fo rat n yaga zĩrẽ la?
Da saag n yeele: «A zagl sẽn maan maam to-to wã, m na n maan-a-la woto me n lebs ye. Bala, mam na n dola ned kam fãa wa sẽn zems-a tʋʋmde.»
Mam tũu kʋɩɩm a ye pʋʋg sɛɛgẽ n looge, mam pɩʋʋga yam-kaalg soab reezẽ tɩɩs pʋʋg noore.
La ade, gõos n dag n yit zĩig fãa, tɩ mo-yoodã gãneg zĩig zãnga, la a lalgã sẽn me ne kugã rag n lʋɩɩme.
Mam maaga m yĩng n tags bũmb ning mam sẽn yã wã yelle, la m paama zãmsgo.
Gõeem bilf bala, suusg bilf bala, la gãand n tẽeg f nao n kalemd f nus bilf bala,
tɩ naong wa n soos n yõk-f wa wagdre, tɩ kom me soos n sig-f wa fãada.
Ad a Salmo yel-bũn a taaba, Zʋʋda rĩm a Ezekɩyaas nebã sẽn tigsi.
Wẽnnaam waoogrã yaa b sẽn solgd b yɛlã. La rĩm waoogr yaa a sẽn veesd n bãng yɛlã n yaool n tʋma.
Ned sẽn ka tõe n bãng yaa yĩngr zãntlmã, tẽngã zulum sẽn yaa to-to, la bũmb ning sẽn be rĩm sũurẽ.
Bɩ b yiis wanzuri rẽgdo, la yõak na yõg laok sẽn yaa neere.
Bɩ rĩm yiis nin-wẽng a taoore, la tɩrlem na kɩt t'a zaoorã paam pãnga.
Da pẽg f meng rĩm taoore, la f ra ning f meng nin-bɛd zĩigẽ ye.
Bala, b sẽn na n yeel foom yaa: «Wa rʋ ka,» n são b sẽn na n sik foom naabã taoore.
Da yãg ne f to boolg bʋʋd zĩigẽ ye. Bala, a sã n gom n lub-fu, f na n maana a wãna?
Fo sã n tar yell ne f to bɩ f bʋ ne-a, la f ra luk ned a to bãong ye.
Ka rẽ, a na n wa wʋmame n tʋʋd-fo, tɩ f ka leb n tõe n lebs f zelemd poorẽ ye.
Gomd sẽn gom a wakat yaa wa b sẽn dõog sãnem tɩ-biis wanzuri zugu.
Yam soab saglg tara yõod ne ned ning sẽn deegd-a n yɩɩd sãnem zũuri, la sãnem halaal yãndo.
Koe-toagsd sẽn togsd sɩd kengda a soaal pɛlga. Yẽnda wẽnda pems-maasg sẽn wẽed ned tigsg wakate.
Ned sã n wukd a meng n pʋlemdẽ t'a na n kõo kũun n yaool n ka pidsdẽ, a wẽnda wa sawat la sobg sẽn yikdi, tɩ saag yaool n ka niid ye.
Sũ-mar tõe naaba, la gomd sẽn gom ne sũ-mar wãada kõaba.
F sã n yãnd sɩɩdo, bɩ f yãk sẽn na n sek f rɩɩbo, la f gũus n da wa rɩ tɩ loog-f tɩ f wa wʋbdẽ ye.
Da nong n kẽnd f to zakẽ wakat fãa ye. Sã n ka rẽ, a yamã wat n yi-f lame t'a kisg-fu.
Ned sã n kɩt kaset zĩrẽ a to zugu, a wẽnda wa guug bɩ sʋʋga, wall peemd b sẽn sɩlse.
Ned sã n teeg zãmb soab yel-pakr wakate, wẽnda wa ned sẽn dat n wãb ne yẽnd sẽn vigsdi, wall ned sẽn dat n tik kar-kɩɩng n kẽne.
Ned sã n yɩɩnd sũ-sãang soab taoore, wẽnda wa a sẽn pilg a fuug waood wẽnde, la wa b sẽn dɩk zẽem n kalem miisim.
Kom sã n tar f bɛ bɩ f kõ-arɩɩb t'a rɩ, la ko-yũud sã n tar-a bɩ f kõ-a koom t'a yũ.
Fo sã n maan a woto, yaa wa fo sẽn dɩk bug-saall n dogl a zugu, la Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n dola foom.
Nug-rɩtg sobg wata ne saaga, la zĩrẽ-beed wata ne nen-gãnenga.
F sẽn na n gãe bɛoong zugu, n são f sẽn na n gãe ro-yɛng pʋg ne pʋg-zab-zabda.
Kiba-noog sẽn yi tẽn-zãrgẽ n wa, wẽnda wa ned sẽn yɛ tɩ b kõ-a ko-maasg t'a yũ.
Nin-tɩrg sã n zoe nin-wẽng nif n tũ-a, wẽnda wa bãk koom sẽn bendge, wall bulg koom sẽn põoge.
Ka sõama tɩ ned rɩ sɩɩd wʋsg tɩ loog ye, la ka sõama me tɩ ned bao a meng waoogr ye.
Ned sẽn ka tar yõk-m-meng wẽnda tẽng lalg sẽn lʋɩ n bas-a.
Wa sapɩlem sẽn ka tog ne tʋʋlg wẽndã, tɩ saag me ka tog ne tigsg wakatã, woto me, waoogr ka tog ne yalem ye.
Wa luiil bɩ sɩlaall sẽn yɩkd n loogdẽ wã, woto me, ned sã n ka maan bũmb tɩ b kãab a wẽnga, yaa zaalem.
Sãbsg yaa weef yĩnga, wĩir yaa bõang yĩnga, la dasaar yaa yalem poor yĩnga.
Da leok yalem wa sẽn zems a yalemdã ye. Ka rẽ, fo meng wat n wẽneg-a lame.
Leok yalem wa sẽn zems a yalemdã, t'a ra wa tẽed t'a tara yam ye.
Ned sã n tʋm yalem t'a tɩ togs koɛɛga, yaa wa a sẽn fiu a nao, n bao toog n kõ a menga.
Yalem sã n wẽed yel-bũna, wẽnda wa woabg sẽn kẽnd wobendo.
Ned sã n pẽg yalma, yaa wa a sẽn dɩk kugr n sẽbg loaabgẽ.
Yalem sã n wẽed yel-bũna, wẽnda wa ned sẽn tɩg rãam n zãad gõpayãndg a nugẽ.
Ned sã n dɩk yalem bɩ so-loaad a tʋʋmdẽ, a wẽnda tãb-tãood sẽn tãood n pogend neb a taaba.
Yalem lebda a yalem-tʋʋmẽ, wa baag sẽn lebd a wʋbdẽ.
F sã n yãnd ned sẽn tagsd t'a tara yam, bãng tɩ yalem n são nin-kãngã.
Kʋɩɩm yetame: «Rũm-toaag n yas sorẽ wã, gɩgemd n be sorã zugu.»
Kʋɩleng sẽn be a lugrẽ n yilimd to-to wã, kʋɩɩm me bilimda a gãagẽ a woto.
Kʋɩɩm tʋmda a nug laagẽ, la a getame tɩ zẽk a nugã n wa a noorẽ wã yaa toogo.
Kʋɩɩm tagsdame tɩ yẽnda tara yam, n yɩɩd neb a yopoe sẽn mi tɩ leok ne yam.
So-loaad sẽn kẽed zabr sẽn ka a zabre, wẽnda wa ned sẽn yã baag n baood n gãd a tʋba.
Ned sã n tudg a to n yaool n yetẽ t'a reemdame, a wẽnda wa gãeeng sẽn wʋkd bugum n lobd yaare, la a tãood pe-zẽnem sẽn tõe n kʋ.
Raad sã n kae, bugum kiidame. Tẽn-kãn-ned me sã n ka be, zabr sɛtame.
Bug-saal bɩ ra-giis sẽn paasd bugum pãng to-to wã, zab-pirs me yãngda zabr a woto.
Tẽn-kãn-ned goam yaa wa rɩ-noodo, tɩ f sã n dɩt-a bɩ a sigd n tat hal f pʋgẽ.
Ned sã n gomd gom-nood t'a sũurã yaool n yaa wẽnga, a wẽnda wa b sẽn dɩk wanzuri sẽn ka yɩlge, n bolg tãnd laaga.
Sẽn kis-a a to solgda a meng ne no-noom goamã, t'a sũurã yaool n pid ne zãmbo.
Baa yẽnda sã n wa bʋk a koɛɛg n gomda, bɩ f ra tẽ-a ye. Bala, tags-beed wʋsg n be a sũurẽ wã.
Yẽnda tõe n maana sɩlem n lud a kisgrã, la baoosgo, a wẽnemã na n wa puka nebã fãa nifẽ.
Ned sã n tu bok n bẽd neda, a na n wẽneg n lʋɩ a pʋgẽ, la ned sã n bilg kugr tɩ zãb neda, kugrã na n lebg n zãb-a lame.
Ned sã n yagd zĩrẽ, a kisa a sẽn dõt-b rãmbã, la no-noom goam wata ne wãabo.
Ra pẽg f meng ne beoog yell ye, bala, fo ka mi rũndã daarã sẽn na n yɩ-a soab ye.
Bas tɩ ned a to pẽg-fo, la ra yɩ fo meng noor n pẽgd-f ye. Bas tɩ nin-zẽng pẽg-fo, la f ra pẽg f meng ye.
Kugr zɩsame, bĩisr zɩsame, la yalem sũ-puugr zɩslem yɩɩda bãmb fãa.
Sũ-puugr yaa wẽnga, la sũ-yikr ka sõama ye. La ãnda soab n tõe n yals sũ-ki-ned taoore?
Keoogr sẽn yaa vẽenega, n são nonglem sẽn solge.
F zoa sã n togs-f sɩd tɩ zab-fo, a wilgda foom a nonglem. La f bɛ sã n mok-fo, yaa zãmb n be be.
Ned sã n dɩ n tɩge, a zãgsda sɩɩdo, la kom sẽn tar-a soab getame tɩ bõn-tɩɩsg buudã fãa yaa noogo.
Ned sẽn bas a yir yaa wa luiil sẽn bas a tʋko.
Kaam ne parfẽ kõta sũ-noogo, la f zoa sẽn sagend-f ne bʋgsem, n são f sẽn na n sagl f menga.
Da bas f zoa bɩ f ba zoa ye. La f ra kẽng f ma-biig nengẽ f yel-pakr wakat ye. Bala, f yak sẽn pẽ ne-f n são f ba biig sẽn zãr ne-fo.
M biiga, paam yam n noog m sũuri. Dẽ, ned sã n tʋʋs-ma, m na tõog n leok a soaba.
Gũus-m-meng soab yãta yell n zoe n soonde, la zɩtbã zãgsda soondgo, n bao yell n kõ b mense.
Ned sã n dɩk sard ne foom ned a to yĩnga, bɩ f reeg a fuugu. La sã n yaa sãan yĩng bɩ f kɩt t'a gãneg bũmbu.
Ned sã n sãd tõd-beoog n zẽk a koɛɛg n pʋʋs a yaka, b geelgda a pʋʋsgã wa kãab-beedo.
Pʋg-zab-zabd wẽnda wa saag sẽn minisd n ka sɛtẽ ye.
Ned sã n baood n gɩdg-a, wẽnda ned sẽn baood n gɩdg sebgo, wall ned sẽn baood n zã kaam a nug pʋgẽ.
A wa kut sẽn saasd kutã, ninsaal yam me n zulgd a to rẽnda.
Sẽn get-a kankang yell n dɩt a biisi, la sẽn get-a a soaal yell neer n paamd waoogre.
Wa ned sẽn get koomẽ n ne a nengã, woto me, f sã n get f to, f bãngda f menga.
Wa kɩɩm-kulg ne a zĩ-zulumsã sẽn ka tõe n pidã, woto me, ninsaal zɩ n yeel t'a raab pidame ye.
B yɩlgda wanzuri la sãnem boaagẽ. Woto me, ninsaal yʋ-noog n wilgd a sẽn yaa ned ninga.
Ba b sã n naag yalem ne bɩle n to teoogẽ, b ka na n tõog t'a yalemdã yi n bas-a ye.
Bãng f piisã sõma, n ges f peosg fãa yell neere.
Bala, arzɛk ka paad ne a soab wakat fãa ye, la maanf me ka bũmb sẽn paad zamaan woo zamaan n ka teemdẽ ye.
B wʋrda yamd tɩ mood leb n yita. B wʋrda yam-maas tãmsã zut n bĩngdẽ.
Woto, f na n paama f piisã kõbdo, n wʋg fuug n yeelge, la f na n koosa f boeesã, n da pʋ-paalle.
Fo bʋʋsã na n kõ-f-la bĩisim wʋsgo, tɩ f paam n dɩlg f menga, la f rɩlg f zak rãmba, ne f tʋmtʋmd-pogsã.
Nin-wẽng zoetame tɩ ned yaool n ka rigd-a ye, la nin-tɩrs pɛlg kegma ne b mens wa gɩgem-polle.
Tẽng neb sã n ka sakd b naaba, nanambsã lebgda wʋsgo. La tẽng naab sã n tar yam la bãngre, tẽngã zĩndida bãan n kaoose.
Naong soab sã n namsd ka-pãens rãmba, wẽnda wa sa-kẽeng sẽn niid n sãam koodo.
Sẽn kɩɩsd-b zãmsg pẽgda nin-wẽnse, la sẽn sakd-b zãmsg zabda ne nin-wẽnse.
Nin-wẽns ka wʋmd no-tũudr võor ye. La sẽn baood-b Sẽn-Ka-Saabã wʋmda a fãa võore.
Naong soab sẽn kẽnd ne burkĩndlim, n são arzɛk soab sẽn tũud so-golemse.
Biig sẽn sakd wilgr tara yam, la sẽn tũud-a yão-be-neb ningda a ba yãnde.
Ned sã n dɩkd a ligd n pengd n baood yõodo, a baood n bĩngda sẽn zoet-a naong rãmb nimbãanega.
Ned sã n yẽd a tʋb n ka rat n kelg zãmsgo, a pʋʋsgã meng yaa yel-beedo.
Ned sã n tudg nin-tɩrg n kɩt t'a rɩk so-wẽnga, a na n wẽneg n lʋɩɩ bok ning a sẽn tu wã pʋgẽ. La burkĩmbã na n paama naar tɩ yɩ b pʋɩɩre.
Arzɛk soab tagsdame t'a tara yam, la naong soab sẽn tar yam mii a yamã tɛka.
Nin-tɩrs sã n paam tõogre, yaa waoogr meng-menga. La nin-wẽns sã n deeg naam, ned fãa zoet n baooda a menga.
Sẽn solgd-a a kongr ka na n paam tõogr ye. La ned sã n vẽneg n togs a kongr n bas-a, a paamda nimbãan-zoeere.
Sẽn zoet-a Wẽnnaam wakat fãa tara barka! La sẽn kengd-a a sũur na n paama toogo.
Na-wẽng sã n maand nimbãan-dãmb pãnga, wẽnda wa gɩgemd sẽn kelemde, wa rigd-n-yĩidg sẽn yɩk n na n bir bũmbu.
Naab sẽn ka tar yam dɩkda weer bal tɩ yaa nebã fãabo. La sẽn kis-a zãmb paoong na n paama yõ-woko.
Nin-kʋʋd zoetame n na n tɩ lʋɩ bokẽ. Bɩ ned da gɩdg-a ye.
Sẽn kẽnd-a ne burkĩnd na n paama fãagre, la sẽn tũud-a so-golems na n wa lʋɩ a yembr zugu.
Sẽn kood-a a pʋʋg na rɩ n tɩge, la naong na sek sẽn pʋgd-a yel-yaalse.
Sẽn maand-a sɩd paamda barka, la sẽn dat-a n lebg arzɛk soab tao-tao na n wa paama sɩbgre.
A ka neer tɩ b tũus neb ye, la neb n be n maand wẽng rɩɩb bilf yĩnga.
Sũ-ki-ned zoet n pʋgda arzegse, la a ka mi tɩ pɛt n na n yõk-a ye.
Sẽn keoogd-a ned paamda bark n yɩɩd no-noom goam soaba.
Ned sã n zu a ba bɩ a ma, la a bas n yetẽ tɩ rẽ ka yel-wẽnde, yẽnda soab yaa sãamd tũud-n-taaga.
Rat-wʋsg soab wata ne zaba, la sẽn teeg-a Sẽn-Ka-Saab bee naar pʋga.
Ned tõe n tagsdame t'a rɩka so-sõngo, n mik yaool n yaa sor sẽn dabd ne-a kũum zĩigẽ.
Sẽn kõt-a naong rãmb kõn kong bũmb ye, la sẽn yãt-a naong soab n mumd a nin n loogdẽ na n paama kãab-wẽnga.
Nin-wẽns sã n soog tẽnga, nebã fãa zoet n baooda b mense. La b sã n wa ki, nin-tɩrsã lebgda wʋsgo.
B sã n keoogd ned t'a nakd a kãare, sãoong n na n wa ling-a tɩ sẽn maand kae ye.
Nin-tɩrs sã n lebgd wʋsg tẽngẽ, ninbuiidã maanda sũ-noogo. La nin-wẽns sã n dɩt naam, ninbuiidã yãbdame.
Sẽn nong-a yam kõt-a ba sũ-noogo, la sẽn pʋgd-a pʋg-yoaadb sãamda a paoongo.
Rĩm sã n maand sẽn yaa tɩrga, a paasda tẽngã paoongo, la a sã n nong n deegd kũun wʋsgo, a sãamda tẽnga.
Ned sã n belgd a to ne no-noom goamã, yaa bẽdg la a ningd a meng nao tẽngre.
Nin-wẽns yel-wẽnã yaa bẽdg b mens yĩnga, la nin-tɩrsã kaasda ne sũ-noogo.
Nin-tɩrg tẽegda naong rãmb yelle, la nin-wẽng toog ka be ne-b ye.
Nin-paoogdb rãmbda tẽnga, la yam soab sigsda sũuri.
Yam soab sã n bʋʋd ne yalma, a gãnema a neng woo, a laadame woo, laafɩ kõn tol n zĩnd ye.
Nin-kʋʋdb kisa pʋ-peen-neda, la nin-tɩrsã gũuda b vɩɩmã.
Yalem wilgda a sũ-yikr zãnga, la yam soab gũusda a menga, n ka rat t'a rẽnd puk ye.
Naab sã n kelgd zĩrẽ goamã, a poorẽ dãmbã fãa lebgda nin-wẽnse.
Naong soab ne sẽn maand-a neb pãng tara bũmb sẽn wẽnd taaba: Sẽn-Ka-Saab n kõt b yiibã fãa vɩɩm.
Rĩm sã n bʋʋd naong rãmb bʋʋd ne sɩda, a na n paasa a naamã pãng wakat fãa yĩnga.
Wẽed ne keoogr kõta biig yam, la biig sẽn ka yã wubr ningda a ma yãnde.
Nin-wẽns sã n lebgd wʋsgo, yel-kɛgã me paasdame. La nin-tɩrsã na n yãnda bãmb lʋɩɩse.
Rems f biiga, t'a na n kɩtame tɩ f paam vɩ-bãane, la a kõ-f sũ-noogo.
Vẽnegr sã n ka tẽngẽ, ned kam fãa maanda a sẽn date. La bark bee ned ning sẽn sakd zãmsgã zugu.
Ka ne goam la b sagend yamb ye, bala, ba a sã n wʋmdẽ me, a ka sakd ye.
Ned sã n ka tagsd n yaool n gome, b sẽn kelgd yalem n são.
Fo sã n põneg f yamb t'a paoodẽ, a wat n yɩɩ kʋɩɩma.
Sũ-pu-ned wata ne zaba, la Sũ-tʋʋn-ned maanda yel-wẽn wʋsgo.
Waoog-m-meng wata ne paoogre, la sik-m-meng wata ne waoogre.
Sẽn sõngd-a wagdr kis-a a menga, bala, yẽnda wʋmda kãab-wẽngã la a sĩnda.
Ninsaal zoees wata ne yelle, la yell kõn paam sẽn teeg-a Wẽnnaam ye.
Neb wʋsg baooda sõm ne nanambse, la yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab n kaood ned kam fãa bʋʋd wa sẽn zemse.
Nin-tɩrs sẽn kis n yɩɩd fãa yaa nin-wẽnse. La nin-wẽng me sẽn kis n yɩɩd fãa yaa nin-tɩrse.
Woto yaa a Yake biig a Agʋʋr goamã, a Agʋʋr goma ne a Itiyɛlle, yaa ne a Itiyɛll ne a Ukalle.
Sɩda, mam yaa yalem n yɩɩd nebã fãa, la m ka tar ninsaalbã yam baa bilf ye.
Mam ka zãms tɩ bãng yam ye, la mam ka tar pʋ-peelem dãmbã bãngr ye.
Ãnda n dʋ yĩngr n lebg n sigi? Ãnda n kogl a nus n kok pemsem? Ãnda n yondg koom a fuugẽ? Ãnda n naan tẽn-gãongã? A soab yʋʋr la a bõe, la a biigã yʋʋr la a bõe? Fo sã n miẽ, bɩ f togs-ma.
B makame n mik tɩ Wẽnnaam goamã fãa yaa sɩda, la a yaa gãong neb nins sẽn baood zĩ-lilldg bãmb nengẽ wã yĩnga.
Da paas bũmb Wẽnnaam goamã zug tɩ b wa zab ne-fo, la b ges-f wa zĩrẽ-be-ned ye.
Mam Wẽnnaam, m kot-y-la bũmb a yiibu. Kõ-y-b maam tɩ m na n ket n vɩ:
Zãag-y-m ne zãmbo, la ne zĩrẽ-beedo. Da bas-y tɩ m yɩ naong soaba, la y ra bas tɩ m yɩ arzɛk soab me ye. Bɩ y kõ maam sẽn sekd m dɩɩbo,
tɩ m dɩ-n-tɩkã pʋgẽ, bɩ m da wa yeel tɩ m ka mi yãmb a Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, wall tɩ m naongã ra wa kɩt tɩ m zu, n paoog yãmb a Wẽnnaamã yʋʋrã ye.
Ra kãneg tʋmtʋmd ne a zu-soab ye, ka rẽ, a sã n kãab-fo, tũud-f lame.
Neb n be n kãabd b ba-rãmb wẽnse, la b ka ningd b ma-rãmb bark ye.
Neb n be n yetẽ tɩ b yaa yɩlma, n yaool n nan ka paam pekr ne b rẽgdã ye.
Neb n be n ka nand-b taaba, n get-b ne wuk-m-menga.
Neb n be tɩ b yẽnã yaa wa zabr sʋʋse, tɩ b yɛyã yaa wa sʋʋse, n dat n wãb nimbãan-dãmbã, ne naong rãmbã, n menes-b dũniyã zugu.
Dendeoog n tar a kom-pugli a yiibu: «A kõ maam, ne a kõ maam.» Bũmb a tãab n be n ka tɩgd ye, la naasẽ soabã zɩ n yeel tɩ sekame ye!
Yaa kɩɩm-kulgu, la pʋg-kiiri, la tẽn-koɛɛng sẽn dat koom, la bugum sẽn zɩ n yeel tɩ «Sekame» ye.
Ned nif sã n sãag a ba, la a ka rat n sak a ma noore, ko-soog gãabd n na n feo yẽnda nini, la yɩbr-bi n na dɩ yẽnda nemdo.
Yel-soalem a tãab n be n yɩɩd mam tagsgo, la a naas n be mam sẽn ka wʋmd b võor ye:
«Yaa pa-nand-tugr sẽn tũud sor ning yĩngr n yɩgda, waaf sẽn tũud sor ning pĩig zugu, koom koglg sẽn tũud sor ning ko-kãsengã zugu, la rao sẽn tũud sor ning n kẽngd pʋg-sad nengẽ.»
Pʋg-yoodr manesem yaa a woto: Yẽnda maanda wẽng n bas n yetẽ t'a ka maan bũmbu, tɩ yaa wa a sẽn dɩ n sɛ, n bas n yẽes a noore.
Bũmb a tãab n be n tõe n kɩt tɩ dũniyã rigimdi, la a naas n be dũniyã sẽn ka tõe n sak n deeg ye:
Yaa yamb sẽn lebg rĩma, yalem sẽn paamd n dɩt n tɩgda,
pʋg-sad b sẽn kis sẽn paam sɩda, la yem-poak sẽn deeg a zu-soben-poak zĩiga.
Bõn-vɩɩlɩ a naas n be tẽng zug n paoodẽ, n yaool n tar yam:
Yaa gũuri. Bãmb ka pãng ye, la sɩpaolgo b tigsda b rɩɩbo.
Yaa kɩɩse. Bãmb pãngã paoodame, la b maanda b yiy pĩis bogdẽ.
Yaa sʋyã. Bãmb ka tar naab ye, la b yaool n yɩgda sull-sulli.
La bãngenlegsr f sẽn tõe n gãda f nugẽ, t'a yaool n be rĩm-dãmb zagsẽ.
Bũmb a tãab n be, m yet t'a naase, tɩ b sã n kẽnd bɩ be ra-sãnde.
Yaa gɩgemde. Rũmsã fãa sʋka, yaa yẽnda n yaa gãndaoogo. A ka targd bũmb baa fɩ taoor ye.
Yaa no-raoog sẽn dong a zugu, n gengd no-yãans sʋka, la boɛɛga, la rĩm sẽn lʋɩ a tãb-biis taoor n kẽnda.
Fo sã n dag n maana yalemdo, n baood n zẽk f menga, n lebg n tagse, bɩ f pĩ f noore.
B sã n fɩr bĩis-naare b yãkda kaam, b sã n wẽ ned yõore a yũnda zɩɩm, la sũur sã n yiki, wata ne zabre.
Woto yaa sagls rĩm a Lemuwɛll ma sẽn sagl-a.
M biiga, m na n yeela foom tɩ bõe? Mam meng bi-nongre, m na n yeela foom tɩ bõe? Mam pʋleng biiga, m na n yeela foom tɩ bõe?
Da sɛɛs f pãng ne pagb ye, la f ra rɩk f meng n kõ sẽn wãad-a rĩm-dãmb ye.
Lemuwɛlle, ka segd tɩ rĩm yũ rãam, la ka segd me tɩ nanambs me yũ rã-toos ye.
B sã n yũ, b tõe n wa yĩma no-tũuds nins b sẽn viglã, n ka zoe naong rãmb nimbãaneg ye.
Bɩ b bao rã-toos n kõ sẽn dɩk-b kũum sore, la b kõ sẽn zĩ-a ne sũ-toogã reezẽ rãam,
tɩ bãmb yũ n yĩm b naongã, la b ra leb n tẽeg b sũ-sãangã yell ye.
Yaag-f noor n gom n sõng muka, la sẽn ka tar-a sõangda.
Yaag-f noor n kao bʋʋd tɩrga, n sõng ka-pãens rãmbã ne naong rãmbã.
Pʋg-sõng yɩɩda sãnem, la a ka paamd naana ye.
A sɩdã kɩsa sɩd ne-a, la a na n dɩ a yõodo.
A ka maand a sɩdã wẽng ye, A vɩɩmã fãa tɛka, a maanda a sɩdã neere.
Yẽnda baooda pe-kõbd ne lamdo, n wĩid ne sũ-noogo.
Yẽnda yaa wa toandb koom kogendo, a kɩtdame tɩ b talld rɩɩb n yit zĩ-zãrsẽ n watẽ.
Yẽnda yikdame tɩ zĩig nan ka yẽeg ye, n kõt a zak rãmb dɩɩbo, n wilgd tʋmtʋmd-pogsã b tʋʋmde.
Yẽnda sã n yãnd pʋʋg sẽn ta a yam, a raad-a lame. A yiisda a meng ligd n kɩtẽ tɩ b sel reezẽ tɩɩse.
Yẽnda sẽbgda a kalle, n tʋmd a tʋʋma.
A neeme t'a tʋʋmdã tara nafre, la yẽnda ka kiisd a fɩtl yʋng ye.
Yẽnda rɩkda a gendre, n sɩng wĩibu.
Yẽnda sõngda naong rãmba, la a kõt nimbãan-dãmba.
Yẽnda ka yɛɛsd tɩ waood na n wa yõk a zak rãmb ye, bala, a zakã ned kam fãa yera fu-tagdo.
Yẽnda wʋgda fu-gobs a meng yĩnga, yẽnda yera fut sẽn wʋg ne peen-neeba, la ne gĩsg sẽn yaa miuugu.
A sɩdã sã n yi tẽngã rignoorẽ, n be kãsem-dãmbã sʋka, a tara waoogre.
Yẽnda wʋgda fut n koosdẽ, la lɛɛbdbã wat n tonda sɛɛg sẽbds a nengẽ.
Yẽnda tara pãng la ziiri, la a ka maand dabeem ne beoog yell ye.
Yẽnda gomda yam goamã, la a zãmsd nebã ne sõmblem.
A geta a zakã yell neere, la a ka rɩt kʋɩʋʋng rɩɩb ye.
A kambã gomda a yelle, n yetẽ t'a tara barka, la a sɩdã pẽgd-a lame n yetẽ:
«Pagb wʋsg beeme n tar yel-manesem-sõamyã, la foom yẽe, m noanga, fo yɩɩda b fãa gilli!»
Nagem tudgdame, la neerem yaa zaalem, la yaa pag ning sẽn zoet-a Sẽn-Ka-Saabã la b na n pẽge.
Bɩ b kõ-a tʋʋmã biis yõodo, la bɩ a tʋʋmã kɩt t'a paam pẽgr tẽngã rignoorẽ.
Woto yaa Koɛɛg soabã gomde. Yẽnda yaa a Davɩɩd biiga, n yaa Zeruzalɛm dĩma.
Koɛɛg soabã yeelame yaa: «Zaalem woo zaalem, bũmb fãa yaa zaalem.
Ninsaal sẽn maand tʋʋm nins fãa dũniyã zugã yõod bee yɛɛnẽ?
Zamaan loogdame, tɩ zamaan a to wa, la dũniyã paada woto wakat fãa.
Sõor pukdame, la wĩndg lʋɩtame, la a yãgdame n dat n ta zĩig ning a sẽn na n leb n pukã.
Sebg kẽngda goabga, n wẽnemded n dabd rɩtgo. Sebgã gilgdame n gilgdẽ, la a lebd n dɩkda a pĩnd sorã n wẽnemdedẽ.
Kʋɩlsã fãa koom zoetame n kẽngd ko-kãsengã pʋgẽ, la ko-kãsengã ka pit ye. A zoet n dabda zĩig ning ko-zoetem sẽn kẽngdẽ wã, n gilgdẽ n lebgd n wat be yɛsa.
Bũmb fãa tʋʋmd yaa toogo. Ned goam ka sekd-a ye. Bũmb nins nin sẽn yãtã ka sekd-a ye, la tʋbr sẽn wʋmd bũmb ninsã ka sekd-a ye.
Bũmb ning sẽn dag n zĩnd pĩndã n na n zĩndi. La bũmb ning sẽn dag n maan pĩndã n na n maane. Bõn-paalg ka be dũniyã zug ye.
Bũmb beeme tɩ neb gomd a yell n yetẽ tɩ b ges bõn-paalg bɩ? Bũmb ning sẽn dag n zĩnd pĩndã n be tõnd zamaanẽ.
B ka tẽegd bũmb nins sẽn dag n zĩnd pĩndã yell ye. La bũmb ning sẽn na n wa maanã, neb nins sẽn na n wa wã ka na n tẽeg bõn-kãens yell ye.»
Maam a koɛɛg soab yɩɩ Israyɛll rĩm n zĩnd Zeruzalɛm.
Mam tagsame n na n bao ne yam n bãng bũmb nins fãa sẽn maand saasã tẽngrã võore. Wẽnnaam dɩka tʋʋm toog n kõ ninsaalbã.
Mam yãnda tʋʋm nins fãa sẽn maand saasã tẽngrã. Fãa yaa zaalem. Fãa yaa wa ned sẽn digd sobg bala.
Bũmb ning sẽn golem ka tõe n tẽeg ye. La bũmb ning sẽn paoog ka tõe n sõd ye.
Mam dag n tagsdame tɩ mam tara yam n yɩɩd neb nins fãa sẽn deng maam n soog Zeruzalɛmã. Mam yãnda yam la bãngr wʋsgo.
Mam dag n tagsdame n dat n bãng yam ne zu-kaalgo, la yalemd võore. La mam mikame tɩ yõwã me yaa wa ned sẽn digd sobg bala.
Bala, ned yam sã n waoogẽ, a tara sũ-sãang wʋsgo. La ned sẽn paasd a meng bãngre, a paasda a meng toogo.
Mam tagsa m sũur pʋgẽ tɩ mam na n makame n maan sũ-noogo, la m bãng sũ-noog sẽn yaa-a soaba. La ade, yõwã me yaa zaalem.
Mam yeelame tɩ laad yaa zu-kaalgo, la sũ-noog yõod yaa bõe?

Mam yãka yam n na n noog m sũur ne reezẽ rãam, la m gũus m meng n kẽn ne yam, la m loe m meng ne yalemd ning mam sẽn maandã, n tõog n bãng ninsaalbã sẽn maand bũmb ning dũniyã zug b vɩɩmã wakatã sã n zemsame.
Mam tʋma tʋʋm-kãsemse: Mam mee rot m mengã yĩnga, la m sel reezẽ tɩɩs m mengã yĩnga.
Mam maana zẽed ne tɩɩs zĩisi, la m sel tɩɩs buud fãa sẽn womd biisã bãmb pʋse.
Mam maana bãgs sẽn na n zãgs tɩ-poalã bõeeb zĩiga.
Mam daa yem-daad la yem-pogse, ne b kamb nins b sẽn dog mam zakẽ wã. Mam daa baa rũm-bɛd ne rũm-bãooneg wʋsgo, n yɩɩd neb nins fãa sẽn deng maam n zĩnd Zeruzalɛmã.
Mam paama wanzuri ne sãnem wʋsgo, yaa rĩm-dãmbã ne soolem wʋsg laogo. Mam daa pagb ne raop sẽn yaa yɩɩn-yɩɩndba, la pʋg-bi wʋsg ninsaalb kambã sẽn nonge.
Woto, mam lebga kãseng n yɩɩd neb nins fãa sẽn da reng maam Zeruzalɛmã. Sẽn paase, mam yamã kell n paa ne maam.
Bũmb ning fãa mam ninã sẽn yãnd n datã, mam ka mong-b ye. Sũ-noog ning fãa mam sũurã sẽn dag n datã, mam ka mong-a ye. Bala, mam sũur yɩɩ noog ne m tʋʋmdã fãa. La mam tʋʋmdã fãa yõod yaa a woto.

La mam tagsa tʋʋm nins fãa mam nus sẽn dag n maanã, la namsg nins fãa mam sẽn dag n namsã yelle. La ade, fãa yaa zaalem. A wẽnda wa ned sẽn digd sebgo. Bũmb sẽn tar yõod ka be dũniyã zug ye. Yam la yalemd ka võor ye.
Woto kɩtame tɩ mam tags n ges yam, la zu-kaalg ne yalemd yelle. Ges-y wɛ! Ned ning sẽn na n wa reeg-a rĩmã zĩigã na n wa maana bõe? Yaa bũmb ning b sẽn dag n zoe n maanã bala.
La mam yãndame tɩ yam yõod yɩɩda yalemdo, wa vẽenem yõod sẽn yɩɩd likã.
Yam soab tara nin n getẽ, la yalem kẽnda lik bida pʋgẽ. La baa sẽn yaa woto wã, mam miime tɩ bãmb b yiibã fãa baoosg yaa bũmb a yembre.
La mam tagsa m sũur pʋgẽ tɩ yalem baoosg sẽn yaa bũmb ningã, mam me baoosg na n yɩɩ a woto. Dẽ, mam yamã yɩɩdem nafr yaa bõe? La mam tagsa m sũur pʋgẽ tɩ yõwã me yaa zaalem.
Bala, b ka na n tẽeg yam soab yell n yɩɩd yalem ye. La wakat n wat tɩ b na n yĩm bãmb fãa yelle. Yalmã me na n kii wa yam soab sẽn na n ki wã.
Dẽ, mam kisga vɩɩmã, bala, tʋʋm nins fãa sẽn maand dũniyã zugã yaa wẽnse. Bala, fãa yaa zaalem, a wẽnda wa ned sẽn digd sebgo.
Mam kisga tʋʋm nins fãa mam sẽn tʋm dũniyã zug ka wã, bala, mam na n loogame n bas-a ne ned ning sẽn na n wa reeg-a mam zĩigã.
La ãndã n mi nin-kãng sã n na n yɩɩ yam soab wall yalma? Baoosgo, yaa yẽnda n na n soog mam tʋʋmã fãa, tʋʋm nins mam sẽn dag n tʋm ne yam dũniyã zugã. Woto me yaa zaalem.
Woto yĩnga, mam sũurã sãama ne tʋʋm nins fãa mam sẽn dag n maan dũniyã zug ka wã yĩnga.
Bala, nina tʋmda ne yẽesem la bãngr la tõogre, n bas a yõodã tɩ ned a to sẽn ka maan tʋʋmdã wa rɩke. Woto me yaa zaalem, la a yaa wẽng wʋsgo.
Ninsaal tʋʋmdã ne a namsgã fãa dũniyã zug ka wã yõod yaa bõe?
Yẽnda rasmã fãa yaa sũ-sãanga. La yẽnda yɛlã fãa yaa toogo. Baa yʋngo, yẽnda sũurã ka tar vʋʋsg ye. Yõwã me yaa zaalem.
Bũmb ka be sẽn yaa noog ne ninsaal n yɩɩd a sẽn na n paam n dɩ la a yũ, n maan sũ-noog ne a tʋʋmd ye. La ne yõwã me, mam yãame t'a yita Wẽnnaam nengẽ.
Bala, ãndã n tõe n dɩ n maan sũ-noogo, sã n ka maam?

Ned manesem sã n tat Wẽnnaam yam, bãmb kõta a soab yam la bãngre, la sũ-noogo. La bãmb kõta yel-wẽn soab namsgo, t'a tʋm n wʋk n bĩng ned ning sẽn tat Wẽnnaam yamã. Woto me yaa zaalem, la a wẽnda wa ned sẽn digd sebgo.
Bũmb fãa tara a wakate. Bũmb nins fãa sẽn maand dũniyã zugã tara b wakate.
Rogem tara a wakate, la kũum me tara a wakate. Selb tara a wakate, la võob me tara a wakate.
Kʋʋb wakat beeme, la tɩpg wakat me beeme. Siigr wakat beeme, la meeb wakat me beeme.
Yãbr wakat beeme, la laad wakat me beeme. Wiisg wakat beeme, la saoog wakat me beeme.
Kug lobr wakat beeme, la b wʋkr wakat me beeme. Mobg taab wakat beeme, la zãag taab wakat me beeme.
Baoob wakat beeme, la meneng wakat me beeme. Zãab wakat beeme, la lobr wakat me beeme.
Fuug kẽegr wakat beeme, la a sẽeb wakat me beeme. Sĩndim wakat beeme, la goam wakat me beeme.
Nonglem wakat beeme, la kisgr wakat me beeme. Zabr wakat beeme, la vɩ-bãan wakat me beeme.
Tʋmtʋmd sẽn tʋmdã, bõe yõod la a paamda?
Mam yãnda tʋʋmd ning Wẽnnaam sẽn kõ ninsaalbã tɩ b maanã.
Wẽnnaam maana bũmb fãa sõama n zems a wakate. Bãmb ninga wakat sẽn ka sɛt tagsg ninsaal sũur pʋgẽ, baa ne yẽnda sẽn ka tõe n tags n bãng tʋʋmd ning Wẽnnaam sẽn maan hal sɩngr tɩ ta sɛɛbã.
La mam miime tɩ bũmb ka be sẽn noom ninsaal n yɩɩd yẽnda sẽn na n paam sũ-noog la naar a vɩɩmã wakat ye.
Ned sã n dɩtẽ la yũuda, la a paam sũ-noogo, a bãng tɩ yaa Wẽnnaam kũuni.
Mam miime tɩ bũmb ning fãa Wẽnnaam sẽn maan paada wakat sẽn ka sɛta. Bũmb ka be n na n paas-a wall boog-a ye. Wẽnnaam n maan-a t'a yɩ woto tɩ nebã zoe bãmba.
Bũmb ning sẽn be wã rag n zĩnda pĩnda. La bũmb ning sẽn na n wa zĩndã rag n zoe n zĩndame. Wẽnnaam kɩtdame tɩ bũmb nins sẽn dag n loogã leb n wa.
