La sẽn paase, mam yãndame tɩ dũniyã ka, b basda bʋ-sɩdã n maand wẽnga, b basda tɩrlem n maand wẽnga.
Mam tagsa m sũur pʋgẽ tɩ Wẽnnaam na n kaoo nin-tɩrg la nin-wẽng bʋʋdo. Bala, yɛlã fãa tara b zĩiga, la tʋʋmd fãa tara a wakate.
Mam tagsa ninsaal yell m sũur pʋgẽ, n yeel tɩ Wẽnnaam rag n makda ninsaalbã n na n ges tɩ b mensã tõe n bãng tɩ b yaa wa rũms bala.

Bala, bũmb ning sẽn paamd ninsaalbã ne bũmb nins sẽn paamd rũmsã yaa bũmb a yembre. A yembr kiida wa a to. Bãmb b yiibã fãa yõy vʋʋsem yaa bũmb a yembre. Ninsaal ka yɩɩd rũng ye. La bũmbã fãa yaa zaalem
Bãmb fãa rabda zĩ-yende. B fãa maana ne tẽng tom, la b fãa na n leba tẽng tomẽ.
Ãnda n mi ninsaal yõy vʋʋsem sã n kẽngda yĩngr tɩ rũms rẽnd sigd tẽnga?

Mam yãame tɩ bũmb ka be sẽn noom ninsaal n yɩɩd a sẽn na n maan sũ-noog ne a tʋʋmã ye. Yaa woto la yẽnda rẽnda. Ãnda n na n kɩt tɩ yẽnda lebg n wa yãnd bũmb ning sẽn na n wa zĩnd yẽnda loogr poorẽ wã?
Mam leb n tagsa neb nins b sẽn maand pãng dũniyã pʋg ka wã yelle. Gese, b sẽn namsd-b rãmbã nintãm yitame, la ned ka belsd bãmb ye. Bãmb namsdbã tara pãnga, la ned ka belsd bãmb ye.
Maam, mam yetame tɩ neb nins sẽn ki wã tara sũ-noog n yɩɩd neb nins sẽn ket n vɩ wã.
La ned ning sẽn nan ka be wã ne sẽn nan ka yãnd-a tʋʋm-wẽns nins sẽn maand dũniyã pʋg ka wã n são bãmb fãa.
Mam yãndame tɩ tʋʋm nins fãa nebã sẽn maandã, la tõogr ning nebã sẽn tõogd b tʋʋmã pʋgã, yaa sũ-kiir la ned kam fãa maand ne a to. Woto me yaa zaalem, la a wẽnda wa ned sẽn digd sebgo.
Yalem kalemdeda a nugu, la yaa a meng la a sãamda.
Nug-pʋg pʋgẽ vʋʋsg n são nug pʋs a yiib pʋgẽ tʋʋmd sẽn wẽnd f sẽn digd sebgo.
Mam leb n yãnda bũmb a to sẽn yaa zaalem dũniyã pʋga.

Yaa ned sẽn yaa a yembr n ka tar doagd ye. Yẽnda ka tar bi-ribl wall ba-biig ye. La baoosgo, yẽnda tʋʋmdã ka tar tɛk ye. Yẽnda ninã ka tɩgd arzegs ye. Yaa ãnda yĩng la mam sẽn tʋmd n mongd m meng sũ-noog woto wã? Woto me yaa zaalem la a yaa tʋʋmd sẽn yaa wẽnga.
Neb a yiib n são nin-yende. Bala, bãmb paamda b tʋʋmdã yõod sõama.
Bãmb ned a yembr sã n lʋɩ, a to wã yikd-a lame. La nin-yend tara toogo. Bala, yẽnda sã n lʋɩ, ned a to ka be sẽn na n yik yẽnda ye.
Woto me, neb a yiib sã n gãe ne taaba, b wɩngda taab yĩnsi. La ned sã n yaa a yembre, a na n yɩɩ wãn n wɩng a yĩnga?
Ned sã n tar pãng n tõe n tõog nin-yende, b sã n yaa b yiibu, b tõogr yaa toogo. La wĩir sã n kal a tãabo, a ka tõe n kaoog nana ye.
Biig sẽn yaa naong soab n tar yam n são rĩm-kʋdr sẽn yaa nin-yaalg n ka leb n deegd saglgo.
Bala, ned tõe n yii bi-bees roog n lebg rĩmã, wa ned sẽn dog ne naam n yaool n yaa naong soab a meng soolmẽ wã.
Mam yãnda nin-vɩɩs nins fãa sẽn kẽnd dũniyã pʋg ka wã tɩ b tũud biig ning sẽn na n wa reeg yembrã zĩig n lebg rĩmã.
Neb nins fãa sẽn pʋgd-b yẽnda, tɩ yẽnda be b taoorã sõor yaa wʋsgo. Baoosgo, neb nins sẽn na n yaool n wa wã ka na n paam sũ-noog yẽnda yĩng ye. Woto me yaa zaalem la a wẽnda ned sẽn digd sebgo.
Fo sã n dabd Wẽnnaam doogẽ wã, bɩ f maan gũusg ne f nao-kẽndre. Kolg n kelge, tɩ rẽ n são yalembã maand maanego. Bala, bãmb ka mi tɩ bãmb sẽn maandã yaa wẽng ye.
Ra yɩ yãg-yãg n yiis gomd f noorẽ ye. Ra yɩ tao-tao n yiis f sũur tagsg gomd Wẽnnaam taoor ye. Bala, Wẽnnaam bee saasẽ, la fo bee dũniyã zugu. Dẽ wã, bɩ f ra gom wʋsg ye.
Sɩd me, yɛl wʋsg tagsg sẽn wat ne zãmsdã, woto me, yaa goam wʋsgã pʋg la b bãngd yalem koɛɛg n bake.
Fo sã n pʋlem Wẽnnaam bũmbu, bɩ f pids-a n da bas tɩ kaoos ye. Bala, nin-yaalg ka tat Wẽnnaam yam ye. Bɩ f pids pʋleng ning fo sẽn pʋlmã.
Fo sẽn ka pʋlem n são fo sẽn na n pʋlem n yaool n ka pids ye.
Ra sak tɩ f noor kɩt tɩ f maan yel-wẽnd ye, la f ra yeel b sẽn tʋm-a soab fo nengẽ wã tɩ fo rag n tudgame ye. Wẽnnaam sũur sã n puug ne fo koɛɛgã tɩ b sãam f nug tʋʋmdã, a yõod yaa bõe?
Bala, zãmsd sã n yaa wʋsgo, yel-yaalsã me yaa wʋsgo. Woto me, goam sã n yaa wʋsgo yel-yaalsã me yaa wʋsgo. Dẽ wã, bɩ f zoe Wẽnnaam.

Fo sã n yãnd tɩ b maand naong rãmb pãng soolem pʋgẽ, n ka maand sẽn zemse, la b ka kaood bʋʋd tɩrga, bɩ f ra bas tɩ bõn-kãng ling foom ye. Bala, ned sã n yaa nin-kãsenga, nin-kãseng n kogend yẽnda, la nin-kãsems a taab n be n yɩɩd bãmb fãa.
Tẽn-gãongã yõod yaa nebã fãa yĩnga. Baa rĩm meng teega pʋʋg sẽn kõt bũmb ningã.
Ned sã n nong ligdi, ligd ka sekd-a ye. Ned sã n nong naar wʋsgo, a ka na n paam paoong ye. Woto me yaa zaalem.
Paoong sã n paasdẽ, a rɩtbã me sõor paasdame. Paoong yõod yaa bõe ne a soaadbã, sã n ka bãmb ninã sẽn getã bala?
Tʋmtʋmd sã n tar dɩɩb bilf wall wʋsgo, a gõeem noom-a lame. La arzɛk soab tɩgrã ka basd-a t'a gũs ye.
Mam yãnda toog sẽn wat ne namsg dũniyã pʋga. Yaa ned sẽn bĩngd arzegs sẽn na n wa ne toog a meng yĩnga.
Yẽnda arzegsã tũnugda tʋʋm-beed n menem zãnga. Yẽnda sẽn dog bi-ribl ningã ka tar bũmb baa fɩ a nugẽ ye.
Yẽnda sẽn dag n yi a ma pʋgẽ to-to wã, yẽnda na n leb n looga zaalem wa yẽnda sẽn dag n wa wã. Yẽnda ka na n tol n zã a tʋʋmã yõod baa a yembr n loog ye.
Woto me leb n yaa toog sẽn wat ne namsgo. Yẽnda na n looga wa yẽnda sẽn dag n wa to-to wã. Bõe yõod la yẽnda na n paam a sẽn tʋmd sobg yĩngã pʋga?
Sẽn paase, yẽnda vɩɩmã rayã fãa bee lik bida pʋga, la yẽnda paamda sũ-sãang wʋsgo, la yĩns toogo, la sũ-toogo.
Ad mam sẽn yãnde: Mam yãndame t'a yaa sõama tɩ ned rɩ la a yũ, la a paam naar a tʋʋmã fãa yẽnda sẽn maand dũniyã zugã pʋga, hal a vɩɩmã Wẽnnaam sẽn kõ yẽnda wã tɛka. Yẽnda pʋɩɩr la woto.
Baoosgo, Wẽnnaam sã n kõ ned arzegs la paoongo, la b leb n kõ-a pãn-tõog t'a tar n dɩtẽ, n tar a meng rẽnda, la a maand sũ-noog ne a tʋʋmdã, bõn-kãng yaa Wẽnnaam kũuni.
Sɩd me, yẽnda ka na n tol n tags a vɩɩmã rasem sõor yell wʋsgo, Wẽnnaam sẽn kɩt tɩ yẽnda sũurã pid ne sũ-noogã yĩnga.
Mam yãnda toog a yembr dũniyã pʋga, la a namsda ninsaala.

Wẽnnaam kõta nina arzegse, paoongo, la ziiri, hal tɩ bũmb baa a yembr ka paoog yẽnda a sẽn datã pʋg ye. La Wẽnnaam yaool n ka kõ yẽnda pãn-tõog t'a rɩ b yõod ye. Yaa sãan n dɩt a yõodã. Woto me yaa zaalem, n yaa toog sẽn namsd ninsaala.
Ned sã n dog kom-dibli koabga, n vɩɩmd n kaoose, baa yẽnda yʋʋmã sẽn ta to-to, a sã ka paam naar tɩ seke, la a sã n ka paam yaoogo, mam yetame tɩ sẽn dog-a kɩɩmd sũ-noog yɩɩda yẽnda.
Bala, a wata zaalem la a loogda lik bida pʋgẽ, la lik bida lillda a yʋʋrã.
Bala, pa-tarã ka yãnd wĩndgã n bãng bũmb yell ye. Dẽ, pa-tarã paamda vʋʋsg n yɩɩda.
Baa yẽnda sã n kaoos yʋʋm tus a yiibu, yẽnda sã n ka tar sũ-noogo, bãmb fãa ka rabd zĩig a yembr la?
Ninsaal tʋʋmdã fãa yaa a noorã yĩnga. La baoosgo, bũmb ka sekd yẽnda ye.
Yam soab sãoo yalem ne bõe? La naong soab sẽn mi n tõe kẽn nin-vɩɩs taoorã yõod yaa bõe?
Ned sẽn na n maand sũ-noog ne a sẽn tar bũmb ningã n são a sẽn tagsd n dat n paam bũmb ningã. Yõwã me yaa zaalem la a wẽnda wa ned sẽn digd sebgo.
Bũmb ning sẽn be moasã wã rag n pĩnd n tara a yʋʋre, la b mii ninsaal sẽn yaa bũmb ninga. B miime t'a ka tõe n mao ne sẽn tar-a pãng n yɩɩd yẽnda wã ye.
Goam sã n yaa wʋsgo, gom-vɩɩd wʋsg me bee be. La a nafda ninsaal ne bõe?

Dẽ wã, ãnda soab n mi sẽn yaa sõama ninsaal yĩng a vɩɩm wakate? A vɩɩm ning rasem sẽn tar sõorã, n yaa zaalem n loogd wa sulunsukã wakate? Ãnda n tõe n togs ninsaal bũmb ning sẽn na n wa zĩnd dũniyã pʋg ka yẽndã loogr poorã?
Yʋ-sõng n são kaam sẽn tar yũ-noogo. La ned kũum daar n são a rogem daare.
Sũ-sãang roogẽ kõom n são tigr doogẽ kõom. Bala, yaa woto la ninsaal fãa baoosgo. La nin-vɩɩsã fãa tog n tagsa a yelle.
Sũ-sãang n são laado. Bala, nen-gãneng manegda sũuri.
Yam dãmb sũur bee sũ-sãang roogẽ, la yalembã sũur bee sũ-noog roogẽ.
Yam soab keoogr kelgr n são yalem yɩɩl kelgre.
Bugum sẽn dɩt gõos raad rʋk tẽngr t'a bʋrg yit to-to wã, yalem laad me wẽnda a woto. Woto me yaa zaalem.
Pãn-maaneg kɩtdame tɩ yam soab lebg yalma, la kũun menesda yam.
Bũmb baoosg n são a sɩngre, la sũ-mar soab n são tɩta-neda.
Ra sak tɩ f sũur yik tao-tao ye. Bala, sũ-yikr paada yalembã pʋsẽ.
Bɩ f ra sok tɩ yaa wãn tɩ wakat sẽn loog poorẽ wã yaa sõama n yɩɩd moasã ye. Bala, fo sã n sok woto, ka yam sokr ye.
Yam yaa sõama wa pʋɩɩre, la a nafda nin-vɩɩs dũniyã ka.
Bala, yam maasem yaa wa ligd maasem. La bãngr yõodã, yaa t'a fãagda neb nins sẽn tar-b yamã.
Bɩ f tags Wẽnnaam sẽn maand bũmb ningã yelle. Bala, bũmb ning bãmb sẽn gõde, ãndã n tõe n tẽeg-a?
Sũ-noog daare, maan sũ-noogo. La toog daare, bɩ f tagse. Bala, Wẽnnaam maana bãmb b yiibã fãa tɩ b yaa bũmb a yembre, sẽn na n yɩl tɩ ninsaal da bãng bũmb ning sẽn be taoor n watẽ ye.
Mam yãnda bõn-kãensã fãa mam vɩɩm sẽn yaa zaalmã pʋga. B tõe n yãnda nin-tɩrg sẽn kiid a tɩrlem yĩnga, la nin-wẽng sẽn paam yõ-wok a yel-wẽnã pʋgẽ.
Bɩ f ra yɩ nin-tɩrg tɩ loog nug ye, la f ra yɩ yam soab tɩ loog nug me ye. Bõe yĩng tɩ f na n sãam f menga?
Ra yɩ nin-toaag tɩ loog nug ye, la f ra yɩ yalem me ye. Bõe yĩng tɩ f na n ki tɩ f wakat ka ta?
Yaa neer tɩ f gãd a yembre, la f ra bas a yembrã me tɩ loog ye. Bala, ned ning sẽn zoet Wẽnnaamã na n paama sor n põs yel-bãmb fãa.
Yam soab yam kõta yẽnda pãng n yɩɩd nanambs piig sẽn be tẽng a yembr pʋgẽ.
Sɩda, nin-tɩrg ka be dũniyã zug n maand tɩrg n ka maand yel-wẽnd ye.
Ra kelg goam nins fãa b sẽn gomdã, n wa wʋm f tʋmtʋmd sẽn tʋʋd foom ye.
Bala, fo miime tɩ naoor wʋsgo, fo me tʋʋ neb a taaba.
Mam maka yõwã fãa ne yam. Mam yeelame tɩ mam na n paama yam. La a zãaga ne maam.
Bũmb ning sẽn be wã zãrame, la a zulma wʋsgo. Ãnda n tõe n paam-a?
La mam maaga m meng n na n vees n bao n bãng yam, la m bãng bũmb ning sẽn be wã võore. La m bãngame tɩ nin-toolem yaa yalemdo, la gãeemd yaa zu-kaalgo.
La mam yaool n yãndame tɩ pag ning sẽn yaa wa kuusrã, t'a sũurã ne a nusã yaa wa sẽbdsã, toolem yɩɩda kũum. La ned ning sẽn tat Wẽnnaam yamã põsda yẽnda. La yẽnda yõkda yel-wẽn-maandã.
Koɛɛg soabã yetame: «Mam tagsa bõn-kãens fãa yell yembr-yembre, n dat n bãng b võore.
Mam baoo ne m sũur fãa n ka yãnd ye. Mam yãnda rao a yembr bal raop tusr sʋka. La mam ka yãnd pag ba a yembr pagbã fãa sʋk ye.
Ade, yaa bũmb a yembr bal la mam yãnd yã. Yaa tɩ Wẽnnaam naana ninsaalbã tɩrse, la nebã baoo sɩlem wʋsgo.»
Ãnda n zem yam soaba? Ãnda n mi yɛlã võor bilgri? Ned yam kɩtdame t'a neng pɩnda, la yẽnda nin-toolem tekdame.
Mam yeta foom tɩ f sak rĩmã noore, fo sẽn dag n wẽen ne Wẽnnaamã yĩnga.
Da yɩ yãg-yãg n zãag f meng ne yẽnda ye. Ra yals yell sẽn yaa wẽng pʋgẽ n kaoos ye. Bala, yẽnda maanda bũmb ning fãa sẽn noom-a.
Bala, baa rĩm sẽn yeel bũmb ninga, yẽnda n so pãnga. Dẽ wã, ãndã n tõe n sok yẽnda t'a maanda bõe?
Yell kõn paam ned ning sẽn sakd tõogã ye. La yam soab miime tɩ bũmb fãa tara a wakate, la bʋʋdã me tara a wakate.
Bala, yell fãa bʋʋd tara a wakate. Ninsaal toog yaa zɩsg ne-a.
Sɩd me, yẽnda ka mi bũmb ning sẽn na n wa zĩnd ye. Ãnda n tõe n wilg yẽnda sẽn na n wa yɩ to-to?
Ned ka be n so a vɩɩm n tõe n gɩdg-a ye. La ned me ka be n tar pãng ne a kũum daar ye. Yolsg ka be zabr pʋgẽ ye. Nin-toolem ka sõngd nin-toaag t'a põs ye.
Mam yãnda bõn-kãens fãa wakat ning mam sẽn tags n ges tʋʋm nins fãa sẽn maand dũni zug ka wã yellã. Wakat n be tɩ ninsaal tõe a to n maand-a wẽnga.
Mam yãndame tɩ b yãbd nin-wẽns yĩnga. Tẽngã nebã dag n yita zĩig sẽn welg toorã pʋgẽ n watẽ, la b lebdẽ, bãmb yĩma nin-wẽnsã sẽn dag n maan bũmb ninsã yelle. Woto me yaa zaalem.
Bãmb sẽn ka yãgd n kao tʋʋm-wẽns bʋʋd tao-tao wã yĩnga, ninsaalbã sũyã pida ne wẽng maaneg ratem.
Baa yel-wẽn-maand sã n maand wẽng naoor koabg n vɩɩmd n kaoose, baoosgo, mam miime tɩ sẽn zoet-b Wẽnnaamã na n paama sũ-noogo, bãmb sẽn zoet Wẽnnaamã yĩnga.
La nin-wẽng ka na n tol n paam sũ-noog ye. Yẽnda ka na n vɩɩmd n kaoos n yɩɩg sulunsuk ye. Yẽnda sẽn ka zoet Wẽnnaamã yĩnga.

Bũmb a yembr n be dũniyã pʋg n yaa zaalem. Yaa tɩ nin-tɩrs n be n paamd sẽn zems nin-wẽns tʋʋmd yaoodo. La nin-wẽns me n be n paamd sẽn zems nin-tɩrs tʋʋmd yaoodo. La mam yetame tɩ woto me yaa zaalem.

Dẽ, mam yeelame tɩ sũ-noog yaa sõama. Bala, bũmb ka be n yaa sõama ninsaal yĩng dũniyã ka, sã n ka t'a rɩ la a yũ la a maan sũ-noog ye. Yẽnda tog n paama woto, yẽnda tʋʋmã pʋgẽ dasem nins fãa Wẽnnaam sẽn kõ yẽnda t'a vɩɩmd dũniyã zug ka wã yĩnga.
Mam sẽn wa n dat n bao n bãng yam sẽn yaa bũmb ningã, la m na n tags yell ning sẽn maand dũniyã zug ka wã yelle, tɩ ninsaal ka tõe n gũs wĩntoog ne yʋngã,

mam tagsa Wẽnnaam tʋʋmã fãa yelle. La mam yãndame tɩ ninsaal ka tõe n bãng tʋʋmd ning fãa sẽn maand dũniyã zug ka wã yell ye. Bala, baa ninsaal sã n maood n dat n bãng a võore, yẽnda ka na n tol n yãnd-a ye. La baa yam soab sã n yeel t'a miime, yẽnda ka tõe n bãng a võorã ye.
Mam tagsame n dat n bãng bõn-kãens fãa yelle. La yõwã fãa yɩɩ vẽeneg tɩ nin-tɩrs la yam dãmb ne b tʋʋmã fãa bee Wẽnnaam nugẽ. Ninsaal ka mi nonglem ne kisgri n bak ye. Bãmb fãa bee yẽnda taoore.

Yẽnda geta a yiibã fãa wa zaalem. Yel-bãmb fãa paamda nebã fãa. Yell ning sẽn paamd nin-tɩrg paamda nin-wẽnga. Yell ning sẽn paamd ned ning sẽn yaa-a yɩlemdã paamda ned ning sẽn ka-a yɩlemdã. Yell ning sẽn paamd ned ning sẽn maand-a maand paamda ned ning sẽn ka maand-a maando. Yell ning sẽn paamd nin-sõngã paamda yel-wẽnã soaba. Yell ning sẽn paamd ned ning sẽn wẽendã paamda ned ning sẽn ka wẽend-a wã.

Bõn-kãngã fãa yaa wẽnga, la a bee bũmb nins fãa sẽn maand dũniyã zugã pʋgẽ. Bala, yɛlã paamda nebã fãa. La sẽn paase, ninsaalbã sũyã pida ne wẽnga, la yalemd bee b sũyã pʋsẽ, b vɩɩmã wakate. Dẽ poore, bãmb rabda kũum zĩigẽ.
La ned ning sẽn ket n vɩ ne yõor nin-vɩɩs sʋkã ket n tara saagre. Bala, ba-vɩɩg n são gɩgemd sẽn ki.
Bala, nin-vɩɩs miime tɩ b na n kiime. La sẽn ki-bã ka leb n mi bũmbu, la b ka leb n paamd b tʋʋmd yaood ye. Bala, b ka leb n tẽr bãmb yell ye.
Bãmb nonglmã, bãmb kisgrã, ne bãmb sũ-kiirã me fãa sɛɛme. Bãmb ka leb n tar pʋɩɩr ne bũmb nins fãa sẽn maand dũniyã zugã ye.
Bɩ f kẽng n tɩ rɩ f rɩɩbo, la f yũ f reezẽ rãam ne sũ-noogo. Bala, Wẽnnaam zoe n sak n deega fo sẽn maandã.
Bɩ f yeelg fu-peels wakat fãa, la f ra sak n bas f zug n ka sõog kaam ye.
Maan sũ-noog ne pag ning fo sẽn nongã, vɩ-zaalg ning Wẽnnaam sẽn kõ foom dũniyã zugã wakate. Bala, yõwã la fo pʋɩɩr f vɩɩmã pʋga, la tʋʋmd ning fo sẽn maand dũniyã zugã pʋga.
Bũmb ning fo nug sẽn tõe n maan ne fo pãngã, bɩ f maan-a. Bala, tʋʋmde, tagsgo, la bãngr ne yam ka be kɩɩm-kulgu, zĩig ning fo sẽn dabdẽ wã ye.

Mam leb n yãndame tɩ dũniyã zug ka, ka neb sẽn zoet tao-tao n tõogd zoees ye. La ka gãndaadã n tõogd zabr ye. Ka yam dãmb n paamd rɩɩb ye. Ka bãngdbã n paamd arzegse, la ka nin-yẽesems n paamd pẽgr me ye. Bala, bãmb fãa paamda toog wall noogo.
Bala, ninsaal ka mi a wakate, walla b sẽn yõg zĩm ne gãmbrã, Toog me lingda ninsaalbã a woto, toog paamda bãmb b sabaab wakate, la wa b sẽn bẽd liuul ne nakalebtong n yõke.
Mam leb n yãnda bũmb a to me dũniyã zug sẽn yaa yam mamsgo, la a yaa bõn-kãseng mam nifẽ.
Yaa tɩ tẽn-bil n dag n be tɩ neb bilf be a pʋgẽ. La rĩm-kãseng n wa n na n zab ne-a, n me lal-bɛd n gũbg-a n dat n deeg-a.
La naong soab a ye n be tẽngã pʋgẽ n tar yam. Yẽnda yamã yĩng kɩtame t'a tõog n fãag tẽngã. La ned ba a yembr ka tol n leb n tẽeg naong soabã yell ye.
La mam yeelame: Yam n são pãnga. La baoosgo, b paoogda naong soab yam n ka kelgd yẽnda goam ye.
Yam dãmb sẽn maag b meng n gomd tɩ b kelgdẽ, n são yalemb naab kɛlenga.
Yam n são zab-teedo, la yel-wẽn maand a yembr sãamda bõn-sõama wʋsgo.
Zõos sẽn kiid parfẽ-maand kaam pʋgẽ, t'a yũug ka leb n yaa sõama wã, a kɩtdame tɩ kaamã põoge. Yalemd bilf me woogda yam la ziiri.
Yam soab sũur takd-a lame n lebd rɩtgo, la yalem sũur takd-a lame n lebd goabga.
Baa yalem sã n kẽnd sor zugu, yam ket n paoogd-a lame, yẽnda togsda nebã fãa t'a yaa yalma.
Naab sũur sã n yik ne foom, bɩ f ra zoe n bas f zĩig ye. Bala, sũ-maasem gɩdgda yel-wẽn-bɛda.
Mam yãnda wẽng a yembr dũniyã pʋga, a wẽnda taoor soab tudgr sẽn puki.
Yalemb zĩi zĩ-bɛdẽ, la arzegs rãmb zĩi paoogr zĩisẽ.
Mam yãnda yembs sẽn zao wiidi, tɩ nanambs kẽnd ne nao wa yembse.
Ned ning sẽn tuud-a boko, a na n wẽneg n lʋɩɩ bog-kãng pʋga. La ned ning sẽn lubd lalga, waaf na n zĩnda beenẽ n dũm-a.
La ned ning sẽn lagsd kuga, kugã na n pogl-a lame. Ned sã n wesd raado, a tõe n paama toog raadã wesb pʋgẽ.
Lar noor sã n mudi, tɩ b ka saas-a, a soab tog n wɩka a meng n kɛ. La yam yõodã, yaa a sẽn sõngd tɩ b tõogdẽ wã.
Ned sã n mi waaf saolgr n bas tɩ waafã kɛ-a, sẽn mi-a waaf saolgrã goam ka leb n tar yõod ne-a ye.
Yam soab noor goam bee barka, la yalem noor kɩtdame t'a meneme.
Yẽnda goamã sɩngr yaa yalemdo, la yẽnda koɛɛgã baoosg yaa gãeemdo.
Yalem gomda wʋsgo. Ninsaal ka mi bũmb ning sẽn na n wa zĩndã ye. Ãnda n na n wilg yẽnda bũmb ning sẽn na n wa zĩnd yẽnda loogr poorẽ wã?
Yalem tʋʋmd yɛɛda yẽnda. Bala, yẽnda ka mi a sẽn na n tũ zĩig ning n kẽng tẽng pʋgẽ ye.
Foom a tẽng sẽn tar dĩm sẽn yaa bi-bɩɩga, tɩ f nanambsã rɩt yibeoog pĩndã, toog bee fo zugu!
Foom a tẽng sẽn tar dĩm sẽn yaa na-biigã, bark bee fo zugu! Bala, fo nanambsã rɩta wakat sẽn zemse. Bãmb dɩt n baooda pãnga, b ka baood n kɩt tɩ b neng yilim ye.
Ned nus sã n ka maand bũmbu, a roog sugr bõrgdame. La ned sã n bas t'a nus ka tʋmdẽ, a roog sugr yũundame.
B maanda rɩɩb n dɩtẽ, n maand sũ-noogo. Reezẽ rãam kõta vɩɩm sũ-noogo, la f sã n tar ligdi, f maanda f sẽn dat fãa.
Ra tʋʋs rĩmã, baa f sũur pʋgẽ ye. Ra tʋʋs arzɛk soab f ro-gãagẽ ye. Bala, yĩngr liuuli na n dɩka a rãamdã n looge, la bõn-yɩgdɩ na n dɩka yellã n tɩ togse.
Lob f bur koom zugu, bala, wakat sẽn wate, fo na n leb n paam-a lame.
Yãk fo sẽn tarã n pʋɩ ne neb a yopoe wall a nii, bala, fo ka mi toog ning sẽn na n wa zĩnd dũniyã zugã ye.
Saag sã n kʋɩ, a niida dũniyã zugu. Tɩɩg sã n lʋɩ rɩtg wall goabga, a paada zĩig ning a sẽn lʋɩẽ wã.
Ned sã n gũusd sebgo, yẽndã ka na n bʋd baa fɩ ye. La ned sã n get sawato, yẽndã ka na n tigs baa fɩ ye.
Fo sẽn ka mi sobg sẽn tũud zĩig ningã, wall kõab sẽn sũgd taab to-to pag sẽn tʋt pʋgẽ wã, woto me, fo ka tõe n bãng tʋʋmd ning Wẽnnaam sẽn maandã fãa ye.
Bʋd f bõn-buud yibeoogo, la f ra bas f nus tɩ yɩ zaalem zaabr ye. Bala, fo ka mi bõn-buud ning sẽn na n sake, wall a yiibã fãa sã n na n yɩɩ sõama ye.
Vẽenem yaa noogo, la ned nin sã n yãt wĩndga, a sũur yaa noogo.
Ned sã n vɩ n kaoos yʋʋm wʋsgo, bɩ a maan sũ-noog yʋʋm-kãens fãa pʋgẽ. La bɩ a tẽeg tɩ likã rasem na n yɩɩ wʋsgo. Bũmb ning fãa sẽn na n wa wã yaa zaalem.
Bi-bɩɩga, maan sũ-noog f bi-bɩɩlmã wakate, la f noog f sũur f bɩʋʋngã wakate, n tũ soay nins f sũurã sẽn date, la f ninã sẽn getã. La bɩ f bãng tɩ Wẽnnaam na n bʋʋ ne foom bõn-kãens fãa yĩnga.
Rẽ yĩngã, rig sũ-pa-noaang t'a loog n bas-fo, la f zãag f meng ne wẽnga. Bala, yãadem ne bi-bɩɩlem wakat yaa zaalem.
Tẽeg f naandã yell f bi-bɩɩlem wakate, tɩ f toogã wakat nan ka ta, tɩ yʋʋm nins fo sẽn na n wa yeel tɩ f ka tar sũ-noogã wakat nan ka kolge,
la sẽn deng wĩndgã ne vẽenemã, la kiuugã ne ãdsã sẽn na n sobge, la sawat sẽn na n pʋgl saag n wa wã.

La daar ning roog gũudbã sẽn na n digi, la gãndaadã sẽn na n ku, la pagb sẽn dag n be neerẽ n werdã sẽn na n bas werbo, b sẽn ka leb n waoogã yĩnga, la zĩig sẽn na n sobg tɩ neb sẽn dag n be roog võorẽ n getẽ wã ka leb n tõe n yãndã,
la ki werb rãamd sẽn nan ka booge, tɩ kʋɩlems sẽn tees sor kɩrengã page, la ned sẽn nan ka wʋm liuul kɛleng t'a pɛleng yɩke,

la pʋg-sadb nins fãa sẽn yɩɩndã koees pãng sẽn na n booge, la ned sẽn yɛɛsd zĩ-zãonglgo, tɩ sorã fãa pid ne rabeem, la amand tɩɩg sẽn ningd a puudu, tɩ sʋʋr lebg zɩsg a yĩnga, tɩ kapr tɩɩg biis ka leb n tar noosem ye. Bala, ninsaal dabda a roog sẽn ka sɛt zĩigẽ, la yãbdbã zoet n pɩʋʋmda soayã,
tɩ wanzuri wĩirã nan ka tõsge, la tɩ sãnem tʋkã nan ka wãage, la tɩ yʋʋrã nan ka wã ko-bundmã zĩigẽ, la gʋlgã sẽn nan ka lʋɩ n kaoog bulgã pʋgã,
la tomã sẽn nan ka lebg n leb tẽng tomẽ wã, wa a sẽn dag n yaa bũmb ning pĩndã, tɩ sɩɩgã leb n leb Wẽnnaam ning sẽn dag n kõ yẽnda wã nengẽ.
Koɛɛg Soabã yetame: «Zaalem fasɩ! Bũmb fãa yaa zaalem bala.»
Koɛɛg soabã rag n tara yam. La sẽn paase, yẽnda zãmsa nebã tɩ b paam bãngre. Yẽnda tagsa yel-bũn wʋsg yɛla, n fees n bãng b võyã, la yẽnda manega bãmba.
Koɛɛg soabã maoome n paam gom-noodo. B gʋlsa gom-kãens wa sẽn zemse, la b yaa goam sẽn yaa sɩda.
Yam dãmbã goam wẽnda wa fu-pĩim, la seb-gʋlsdbã yaa wa kaads b sẽn ka. B yaa pe-kɩɩm dasaare.
M biiga, bũmb ning sẽn keta, gũus f meng n paam zãmsg bõn-kãens pʋga. B sã n baood n gʋls sɛb wʋsgo, b kõn tol n gʋls n sɛ ye. La zãmsg wʋsg yaamsda yĩnga.
Kelg koɛɛgã fãa baoosgo. Zoe Wẽnnaam la f sak bãmb tõodã, bala, yaa woto la ninsaal fãa tog n maane.
Bala, Wẽnnaam na n bʋʋ tʋʋmã fãa bʋʋdo, la yɛl nins fãa sẽn dag n solgã, yel-sõama wã ne yel-wẽnsã bʋʋdo.
A Salmo yɩɩll sẽn yɩɩd yẽnda yɩɩl a taabã fãa.
Bɩ a mogs maam ne a noore! Bala, fo saagrã n são reezẽ rãam.
Fo parfẽ-rãmbã yũug nooma wʋsgo! Fo yʋʋrã yaa wa parfẽ yũ-noom sẽn sãeegde. Yaa rẽ n kɩt tɩ pʋg-sadbã fãa nong foom.
Wa peeg maam tɩ d zoe. Rĩmã talla maam n kẽ a ro-pʋsẽ wã. Tõnd na n maana sũ-noog fo yĩnga, tõnd na n kɩdma fo yĩnga. Tõnd na n pẽga fo saagrã n yɩɩd reezẽ rãam. A zemsame tɩ b nong foom.
Zeruzalɛm kom-pugli, mam yaa sablga, la m yaa neer wa Kedaar fu-roto, la a wa a Salmo fu-bʋgsã.
Ra ges-y maam m sablmã yĩng ye. Yaa wĩntoog n wʋm maam. M ma-bi-raopã sũy yika ne maam tɩ b kɩt tɩ m kẽng b pʋtẽ n tɩ tʋme. Mam ka tʋm m meng pʋʋgẽ ye.
Kelg wɛ, m yam neda, fo wãbenda f piisã yɛɛnẽ? Fo gãnegda bãmb yɛɛnẽ tɩ b vʋʋsd wĩntoogo? Ra bas maam tɩ m yɩ wa gõaada, n bʋdg n tũ fo tũud-n-taasã rũms ye.
Pagbã fãa sʋka, foom bal la pʋg-neere, fo sã n ka mi, bɩ f kẽng n dɩk piisã naoã, n kɩɩm f bʋʋsã pe-kɩɩmbã yiyã sɛɛga.
M noanga, mam makda foom ne wed-yãang ning sẽn takd Faarõ saar-dãmbã.
Fo yɛgã yaa neeb n be fo tʋblondã sʋka. La fo yublã toga ne lo-yɛrga.
Tõnd na n maana sãnem yãnd sẽn tẽgs ne wanzuri n kõ foom.
Wakat ning rĩmã sẽn zĩ n dɩtẽ wã, mam parfẽ wã kaam yũug piuugame.
M noangã yaa wa yolg sẽn pid ne parfẽ n be mam bĩisã sʋka.
M noangã yaa wa tɩ-puud sẽn be Ɛn-Gedi reezẽ tɩɩs pʋtẽ.
M noanga, fo yaa neere, fo yaa neer wʋsgo. Fo ninã yaa wa wall nini.
M noanga, fo yaa neer wʋsgo. Sɩda, fo noogda m sũuri. Yaa mood bal n yaa tõnd pĩiri.
Tõnd dotã sug-raad yaa sɛɛdr tɩɩs raado, la tõnd dotã lals luda ne sɩprɛs tɩɩs raado.
Mam yaa wa Saaron kũnkubã zut tɩ-puudu, la rulg lɛlem sẽn be tãn-lond pʋsẽ.
Rulg-lelemd sẽn yaa bũmb ning gõos sʋkã, m noangã me yaa woto kom-pugli sʋka.
Pom tɩɩg sẽn yaa bũmb ning tʋgr tɩɩs sʋkã, m noangã me yaa woto kom-bɩɩsã sʋka. Mam nong n zĩnda yẽnda maasmẽ, la yẽnda biisã nooma maam.
Yẽnda talla maam n kẽ reezẽ rãam doogẽ, la tãb-kaoor ning yẽnda sẽn zẽk mam zugẽ wã yaa nonglem.
Keng-y maam ne reezẽ gila, la y paas maam pãng ne pom-dãmba, bala, yaa nonglem bãag n tar maam.
Bɩ a bas tɩ m kʋgl a goabg nugã, la a mobg maam ne a rɩtgã.
Zeruzalɛm kom-pugli, mam kota yãmb tɩ y zoe yãgsã la y zoe walsã sẽn be weoogẽ wã, la y ra sak n nek nonglem t'a wakat nan ka ta ye.
Kelg-y-yã! Yaa m noangã rãamde. Ade, a watame. A yɩgda tãmsã zutu, n tĩimd kunkubã zutu.
M noangã yaa wa yãk la wal-bila. Gese, yẽnda yasa tõnd dapoorã. Yẽnda lɩkda peem-lɛɛgẽ wã n getẽ. Yẽnda bee rigno-pĩirẽ wã n lɩkdẽ.
M noangã goma ne maam n yeel yaa: «M zoa, m yam neda, yɩk n wa!
Bala, waood wẽnd loogame, saag yoogame, a loogame.
Tɩɩs ningda puud tẽng zugu. Yɩɩl wakat taame, la b wʋmda wall sẽn yãbd tõnd tẽngã pʋga.
Kankang womda pipi biisi, la reezẽ tɩɩs puud yũug yitame. M zoa, m yam neda, yɩk n wa!
M walle, fo bee pĩis bogdẽ n solgd f meng pẽgsẽ. Sak tɩ m yãnd f neng la m wʋm f koɛɛga. Bala, fo koɛɛg yaa noogo, la fo neng yaa neere.»
Yõg-y we-baasã, we-ba-bi nins sẽn sãamd reezẽ tɩɩsã. Bala, tõnd reezẽ tɩɩsã ningda puudu.
M noangã yaa mam dẽnda, la mam yaa m noangã rẽnda. Yẽnda wãbenda a rũmsã rulg-lɛlmã sʋka.
M noanga, zoe n wa wa yãka, la wa wal-poal sẽn zoet to-to tãmsã pẽgsẽ wã, tɩ zĩigã nan ka maag ye, tɩ maasmã nan ka kɩll ye.
Mam sẽn be m gãagẽ wã ne yʋngã, mam baoo mam sẽn nong-a soabã. Mam bao-a lame la m ka yãnd-a ye.
Moasã, mam na n yikame n gilg tẽngã n tũ a soayã la m kẽng nebã sẽn sõsdẽ wã, n bao m sẽn nong-a soabã. Mam bao-a lame la m ka yãnd-a ye.
Gũudb nins sẽn gũud tẽngã sega maam tɩ mam sok-b yaa: «Yãmb ka yãnd mam sẽn nong-a soabã?»
Mam sẽn loog gũudbã bal yee, la m sẽn yãnd m sẽn nong-a soabã. Mam gãda yẽnda, la m kõn tol n bas-a, hal tɩ m wa tall-a n tɩ kẽ m ma roogẽ, n kẽ sẽn dog-a maamã ro-gãagẽ.
Zeruzalɛm kom-pugli, mam kota yãmb tɩ y zoe yãgsã la y zoe walsã sẽn be weoogẽ wã, la y ra sak n nek nonglem t'a wakat nan ka ta ye.
Yaa ãnda n yit we-raoogẽ wa miir ne parfẽ la wisd buud wʋsg bug-zõos sẽn nusdã n watẽ?
Ad a Salmo gãagã. Israyɛll tãb-bi-gãndaadã sʋka, sẽn yaa-b gãndãad n yɩɩdã pis-yopoe n gũbg yẽnda.
Bãmb fãa boba sʋʋse, n mi zabre. Ned kam fãa lulga zabr sʋʋg a sɛɛgẽ, b sẽn zoet tɩ neb na n wa ling bãmb ne yʋngã yĩnga.
Rĩm a Salmo maana a gãagã ne Libã tɩɩs raado.
B maana a ra-lugdsã ne wanzuri, la b maan a zugã ne sãnem, la b pil a zaoondedgã ne peen-miuugu. La Zeruzalɛm pagbã manega a pʋgã ne nonglem.
Sɩyõ kom-pugli, yi-y n ges-y rĩm a Salmo sẽn fõgen maanf ning a ma wã sẽn fõgen yẽnda a pʋg-peegrã daar sẽn yaa yẽnda sũ-noog daarã.
Ad fo sɩd yaa neere, m zoa, fo sɩd yaa neere! Fo ninã yaa wa wal sẽn be fu-bil ning fo sẽn pil f nengã pʋga. Fo zoobdã yaa wa bʋʋs sẽn be Galaad tãngã zug n sigda.
Fo yẽnã yaa wa pe-bi b sẽn dat n wõrse, n tall-b n tɩ so koom n lebg n watẽ. Peosg fãa tara a kĩnkir-taaga, peosg ka be n ka tar a kĩnkir-taag ye.
Fo no-bɩmsã yaa wa gĩs-miuugu, la fo goamã yaa noogo. Fo yɛgdgã yaa wa gernaad b sẽn boke, n be fu-bil ning fo sẽn pil f nengã pʋga.
Fo yublã yaa wa a Davɩɩd gãosgã b sẽn me n na n bĩng zab-teedo. Gãnd tusrã yaga beenẽ, Gãndaadã gãnd fãa yaga beenẽ.
Fo bĩis a yiibã yaa wa yãg-bi a yiib sẽn yaa kinkirsi, n wãbd yamd rulg lɛlmã sʋka.
Sẽn deng zĩig maagre, zĩigã fãa sẽn na n lebg maasem, mam na n zoee n kẽnga tãng ning miir sẽn beẽ wã, la kunkubr ning parfẽ yũug sẽn beẽ wã.
M noanga, fo yaa neere. Fo ka tar zang ye.
M pʋg-paala, wa tɩ d loog n bas Libã! Wa tɩ d yi Libã! Yals Amana tãngã zugu, ne Seniir la Hɛrmo tãmsã zutu, n ges gɩgma wã sẽn gãe zĩis ninsã, la tãms nins ãbs sẽn beẽ wã.
M pʋg-paala, m tão, fo noogda mam sũur wʋsgo. Fo sã n ges maam vugr bal tɩ mam yãnd fo lo-yɛrg a yembr bala, mam sũur yaa noogo.
M pʋg-paala, m tão, fo nonglmã yaa noogo. Fo nonglmã sãoo reezẽ rãam, fo kaam toay-toayã yũug yaa noog n yɩɩd parfẽ-rãmb buud a taabã fãa.
M pʋg-paala, fo no-bɩmsã tokda sɩɩdo. Sɩɩd ne bĩisim bee fo zelemdã tẽngre. Fo futã yũug wẽnda Libã yũ-noogã.
M pʋg-paala, m tão, fo wẽnda zẽed zĩig sẽn tar yãgre, la ko-bundum zĩig sẽn tar lalga, la bulg sẽn page.
Fo tɩ-tobendã yaa wa gernaad tɩɩs sẽn womd bi-noodo, n tar puud ne kaam.
A tara parfẽ ne safran la rudum sẽn tar yũ-noogo, la sinamon ne tɩɩs nins b sẽn tar n maand wisdu, la miir ne alowɛs la bũmb nins fãa yũug sẽn yaa noog wʋsgã.
Fo yaa wa ko-bundum sẽn be zẽed zĩisẽ, la bulg koom sẽn kõt vɩɩm, la ko-zoetem sẽn yit Libã.
Rɩtg sebgo, yiki! Goabg sebgo, wa! Wa-y n fug-y mam zẽedã zug t'a yũugã piuugi. Bɩ m noangã wa a zẽedã zĩigẽ n dɩ a tɩ-bi-noodã.

M tãoã, m pʋg-paala, mam dabda m zẽedã zĩigẽ. Mam gẽemda m miir ne m bõn-noodã. Mam dɩta m sɩ-vakã ne m sɩ-kaamã, la m yũud m reezẽ rãamã ne m bĩismã. M zo-rãmba, rɩ-y la y yũ-y-yã! Nin-nongdse, tɩgs-y y meng ne nonglem!

Mam dag n gõeeme la m sũurã rag n ka gõe ye. Mam wʋmda m noangã sẽn kabsd n yetẽ: «M tão, m noanga, m walle, m yam neda, pak tɩ m kẽ tɩ meenem madga mam zugu. Mam zoobdã pida ne yʋng meenem.» Mam pidga m fuugu.
Mam na n maana a wãn n leb n yeelg-a? Mam waasa m nao. Mam na n yɩ a wãn n leb n dẽgem-ba?
M noangã tʋma a nug kʋɩlengã võorẽ, tɩ m sũur yɩ noogo.
Mam yikame n na n pak tɩ m noangã kẽ, la miir madga mam nusã. Miir kaamã sẽn be m nus-biẽ wã sõoga kʋɩlen-kurã.
Mam pakame tɩ m noangã kẽ, la m noangã wẽnemdame n zoe n looge. Yẽnda sẽn dag n gom ne maamã, mam dag n ka leb n so m meng ye. Mam bao-a lame, la m ka yãnd-a ye. Mam bool-a lame, la a ka sak ye.
Gũudb nins sẽn gilgd tẽngã yãnda maam. Bãmb pãba maam n pogle. Gũudb nins sẽn gũud tẽngã lalsã rɩka fuug ning mam sẽn tar n pind m nengã.
Zeruzalɛm kom-pugli, mam kota yãmb tɩ y sã n yãnd m noangã, bɩ y togs-a tɩ nonglem bãag n tar maam.
Fo sẽn yaa neer n yɩɩd pagb a taabã, fo noangã tara bõe n yɩɩd a taabã? Togs tõndo! Fo noangã tara bõe n yɩɩd a taabã tɩ fo gomd ne tõnd woto?
M noangã yaa pɛɛlg n pɩnda. Yẽnda sã n be raop tus piig sʋka, b ne-a lame.
Yẽnda zugã wẽnda sãnem halaale. Yẽnda zoobdã bɩrame n sob wa gãabgo.
Yẽnda ninã yaa wa wal sẽn be ko-soog noor n sood bĩisim, yaa bĩisim sẽn yaa wʋsg pʋga.
Yẽnda yegdsã yaa wa b sẽn sel tɩ-puudu, la tɩ-bãooneg sẽn tar yũ-noog kaalem pʋgẽ. Yẽnda no-bɩmsã yaa wa rulg lɛlem sẽn tosd miir koom.
Yẽnda nusã wẽnda sãnem-gils b sẽn ning kirzolit kug b pʋsẽ. Yẽnda yĩngã yaa wa wobg yẽn b sẽn maneg n pẽeg t'a pɩnda, n ning safɩɩr kug a pʋgẽ.
Yẽnda karsã wẽnda marbr kug ra-lugds sẽn lugl sãnem halaal nao zutu. Yẽnda nengã yaa wa Libã n yaa neer wa sɛɛdr tɩɩse.
Yẽnda goamã bʋgsame. Yẽnda yaa neer zãnga. Zeruzalɛm kom-pugli, ade, m noangã n yaa a woto, ade, m zoa wã n yaa a woto.
Fo sẽn yaa neer n yɩɩd pagb a taabã, fo noangã kẽnga yɛɛnẽ! Togs tõndo! Fo noangã kẽnga yɛɛnẽ togs tɩ d sõng-f n bao-a?
M noangã kẽnga a zẽedẽ wã n ta zĩis nins b sẽn sel tɩ-bãooneg sẽn womd biis sẽn tar yũ-noodã zĩigẽ n na n tɩ wãben a rũmsã zẽedã zĩisẽ, la a bao rulg lɛlma.
Mam yaa m noangã rẽnda, tɩ m noangã yaa mam dẽnda. Yẽnda wãbenda a rũmsã rulg lɛlem sʋka.
M noanga, fo tara ra-sãnd wa Tɩrsa tẽngã, fo yaa neer wa Zeruzalɛm. Nebã zoeta foom wa tãb-biis wʋsg sẽn zãad b tãb-kaoore.
Ra ges maam ye. Bala, fo ninã geosg namsda maam. Fo zoobdã yaa wa bʋʋs sẽn be Galaad tãngã zug n sigda.
Fo yẽnã yaa wa b sẽn tɩ so piis koom n lebg n watẽ. Peosg fãa tara a kĩnkir-taaga. Peosg ka be n ka tar a kĩnkir-taag ye.
Fo yegdsã wẽnda wa b sẽn bok gernaade, n be fu-bil ning fo sẽn pil f nengã pʋgẽ.
Rĩm-pogs yaa bãmb pis-yoobe, la pʋg-rɩkdsã yaa bãmb pis-nii, la b ka tõe n sõd pʋg-bi wã n sɛ ye.

A yembr bal n yaa m walle, n yaa m yam ned menga. Yẽnda yaa a ma bi-pugl-yende. Yẽnda yaa sẽn dog-a yẽnda wã bi-nongre. Pʋg-bi wã yãnd-a lame n yeel t'a tara sũ-noogo, la rĩm-pogsã ne pʋg-rɩkdsã me pẽg-a lame n yeele:
Ãnda n pukd wa zĩ-yẽegre, n yaa neer wa kiuugu, n yãgd wa wĩntoogo, tɩ nebã zoet-a wa tãb-bi-kʋʋng sẽn zãad b tãb-kaoore?
Mam kẽnga zẽed zĩigẽ sẽn tar nobse, n na n tɩ ges ko-soodẽ tɩ-tobendã, la m ges reezẽ tɩɩsã sã n tobdame, la gernaad tɩɩsã sã n ningda puudu.
Mam dag n ka mi ye, la mam wa n mikame tɩ m bee m nebã nin-kãsems saar-dãmb pʋsẽ.
Sulamit-poaka, lebg n wa, lebg n wa, lebg n wa ka, lebg n wa tɩ d ges-fo. Yaa bõe tɩ y rat n ges Sulamit-poakã wa sul a yiib neb sẽn tigim taab n saoodẽ?
Nin-kãseng bi-pugla, fo naoã sẽn be fo neooda wã pʋsã yaa neere! Fo gɛy wã yaa gils wa tʋʋm-mitb sẽn maan lo-yɛrg sogdse.
Fo taoorã yaa wa la-gilg b sẽn ning reezẽ rãam sẽn kalem ne bũmb sẽn tar yũ-noog a pʋga. Fo pʋgã wẽnda ka-rʋr sẽn be rulg lɛlem sʋka.
Fo bĩis a yiibã yaa wa yãg-bi a yiib sẽn yaa yãk a yembr kamba.
Fo yublã wẽnda gãosg sẽn me ne wob-yẽna. Fo ninã wẽnda Ɛsbon bãgsã koom sẽn be Bat-Rabim tẽngã rignoore. Fo yõorã wẽnda Libã gãosg sẽn teesd Damaas sẽnẽ.
Fo zugã wẽnda Karmell tãngã, fo zoobdã yaa wa gĩs sẽn yaa kẽeg haoo. Fo zoobdã bɩrame n vind rĩmã.
M noanga, m yam neda, fo yaa neere, foom n kõt maam yamleoogo.
Fo yasrã wẽnda koang tɩɩga, fo bĩisã wẽnda reezẽ-gĩna.
Mam tagsame tɩ m na n dʋʋ koang tɩɩgã n gãd a wilã. Bɩ f bĩisã yɩ wa reezẽ-gĩna, tɩ fo vʋʋsmã yũug yɩ wa pom tɩɩg biis yũugu,
tɩ fo noorã goam yɩ wa rã-noogo, t'a pʋdgr yaa naana m noangã yĩnga, n sedgd gõen-gõetba no-bɩmsẽ.
Mam yaa m noangã rẽnda, la yẽnda yam loee ne maam.
M noanga, wa tɩ d kẽng weoogẽ n tɩ zĩnd tẽn-bãooneg pʋs ne yʋngo.
Bɩ d yik pĩnd n kẽng reezẽ tɩɩs pʋtẽ wã, n tɩ ges reezẽ tɩɩsã sã n tobdame n ningd puudu, la gernaad tɩɩsã sã n ningda puudu. Yaa beenẽ la mam na n saag-fo.
Mandragoor yũug yitame, la tɩ-bi-nood nins fãa sẽn yaa paals la kʋdã bee tõnd dignoyẽ wã. M noanga, mam bĩnga bãmb fo yĩnga.
Fo sã n dag n yaẽ mam tão-raoogo, n yẽsem m ma bĩisã, mam sã dag n yãndẽ-la foom yɩnga, mam dag n na n mokẽ-la foom tɩ ned ka paoog maam ye.
Mam dag n na n tallẽ-la foom n wa m ma zakẽ tɩ f zãms maam, tɩ mam kõ foom reezẽ rãam sẽn yaa noogo, sẽn maan ne mam gernaad biis koom.
Bɩ a bas tɩ m kʋgl a goabg nugã, la a mobg maam ne a rɩtgã!
Zeruzalɛm kom-pugli, mam kota yãmb tɩ y ra nek nonglem t'a wakat nan ka ta ye.
Ãnda la sẽn yit we-raoogẽ wã n kogl a noangã n watẽ wã? Mam neka foom pom tɩɩgã tẽngre. Yaa beenẽ la f ma rɩk f pʋga. Yaa beenẽ la yẽnda rɩk pʋg n dog foom.
Kɩt tɩ m yɩ wa bãnd fo sũurã pʋgẽ, la wa bãnd fo kangã zugu. Bala, nonglem tara pãng wa kũum, la nonglem-kãseng yaa toog wa kɩɩm-kulgu. A bug-witmã ka rɩt n kell ye. A zabda wa Sẽn-Ka-Saab bugum.
Ko-kãsemsã ka tõe n kiis nonglem ye, la kʋɩlsã ka tõe n dɩ-a ye. Ned sã n dat n dɩk a yir paoong fãa n tek ne nonglem, yẽnda ka na n paam bũmb tɩ ka paoogr ye.
Tõnd tara tão-poak sẽn yaa bilfu, a nan ka pus bĩis ye. Ned sã n bao tõnd tão-poakã n na n kẽ kãadem, d na n maana bõe n kõ tõnd tão-poakã?
Yẽnda sã n yaa wa lalga, tõnd na n mee wanzuri gãosg a zugu. Yẽnda sã n yaa wa rignoore, tõnd na n pag-a-la ne sɛɛdr da-peko.
Mam yaa wa lalga, la mam bĩisã yaa wa gãsdo, la mam yaa wa ned sẽn paam vɩ-bãan yẽnda nifẽ.
A Salmo rag n tara reezẽ tɩɩs pʋʋg Baall-Hamon. Yẽnda rɩka pʋtã n kɩs neb tɩ b gũ. Bãmb ned a yembr fãa wa n kɩsa a Salmo wanzuri ligd-koeems tusr a tɩ-biisã yĩnga.
Mam reezẽ tɩɩs pʋʋg ning mam sẽn tarã bee mam taoore. Wanzuri ligd-koeem tusrã yaa foom a Salmo n so, la ligd-koeems kobessi wã yaa reezẽ tɩɩs gũudb n so.
Fo sẽn be zẽed zĩisẽ wã, neb n kelgd foom: Kɩt tɩ m wʋm f koɛɛgã!
M noanga, zoe wa yãka, zoe wa wal-bil tãms nins sẽn tar yũ-noodã zutu!
Ad vẽnegr ning a Amots biig a Ezayi sẽn paame, sẽn kẽed ne Zʋʋda la Zeruzalɛm wɛɛngẽ. Yɩɩ Zʋʋda rĩm-dãmb a Oozɩyaas ne a Zotam la a Akaaz ne a Ezekɩyaas zamaanẽ.
Saasẽ kelge, dũniyã, yok f tʋbr n kelge! Bala, yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab n gomde. Mam wuba kamba, la m zãms-ba, la b yik n kɩɩsa maam.
Naaf mi a soaala, la bõang mii zĩig ning yẽnda soaalã sẽn ningd yẽnda rɩɩbã. La Israyɛll ka mi baa fɩ ye, mam nebã yaa tʋb-pa-wʋmdba.

Toog bee bu-kãngã sẽn yaa yel-wẽn-maandã zugu, bãmb yaa koangdba, bãmb yaa tʋʋm-wẽns rãmba, bãmb yaa kom-wegemse! Bãmb basa Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, bãmb paooga Israyɛll Pʋ-Peelem-Soabã, bãmb wẽnemd n basa bãmba.
Yãmb sẽn ket n kɩɩsdẽ wã, y ratame tɩ b leb n wẽ yãmb zĩ-bʋgo? Zugã zãng ka tar laafɩ ye. Sũurã zãng bẽedame.
Sẽn sɩng ne nao-sɩlpamã n tãag zugã, zĩig ka leb n be sẽn tar laafɩ ye. Yaa sãmpoaga, yĩng bugbu, la noad sẽn wõsge, tɩ ned ka tɩpd-ba, wall a vil-b peende, wall a sõogd-b kaam me ye.
Yãmb tẽngã sãama zãnga. B yõoga yãmb tẽmsã bugum, sãamb wa n sãamda yãmb tẽn-gãongã y nifẽ. Yaa sãoong sẽn wẽnd sãamb sẽn wa n sãame.
Sɩyõ tẽn-neerã kell n paame n yaa wa pʋʋg roog sẽn be reezẽ tɩɩs pʋʋg pʋga. A wẽnda sẽok sẽn be kõnkõmbr pʋʋgẽ. Awẽnda wa tẽnga, bɛɛb sẽn gũbgi.
Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã sã n dag n ka basẽ tɩ neb bilf põse, tõnd dag n na n lebgẽ-la wa Sodom tẽngã, tõnd dag n na n wẽnegẽ-la Gomoore.
Sodom tẽngã taoor dãmba, kelg-y Sẽn-Ka-Saab koɛɛga! Gomoor nebã, yok-y y tʋb n kelg tõnd Wẽnnaamã tõodo!
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yetame: «Mam toog ka be ne yãmb maandã waooglem ye?» Mam ya n tɩga yãmb pe-raad maand sẽn yõogd bugmã ne y rũm-bɛdã kaamã. Yãmb lolsã ne y pe-bi wã la y boeesã zɩɩm ka noogd mam sũur ye.
Yãmb sẽn wat n yalsd mam taoorã, ãnda n kos yãmb tɩ y tabg mam samandẽ wã?

Da-y leb-y n tall-y kũun sẽn ka yõod n wa kõ maam ye. Yãmb wisdã kũun yaa bõn-wẽng mam taoore. Yãmb wẽngã maaneg yĩnga, mam sũur ka noom ne yãmb ki-paalgã tigã, ne y vʋʋsg rayã, la ne y nebã tigindã ye.
Mam kisa yãmb kiu-paalsã ne y tigindã. Bãmb namsda maam, mam yamã yii bãmba.
Yãmb sã n zẽk y nusã n tees maam, mam mumda m nin n ka rat n yãnd yãmb ye. Baa ne yãmb sẽn pʋʋsd n yɩlemdẽ wã, mam ka kelgd ye. Yãmb nusã pida ne zɩɩm.
So-y koom, la y yɩlg y mense! Yiis-y tʋʋm-beedã mam taoore. Bas-y y tʋʋm-wẽnsã maanego.
Zãms-y tɩ maan sẽn yaa sõama. Bao-y tɩrlem, la y sõng b sẽn maand-b rãmb pãngã. Kao-y kɩɩb bʋʋd tɩrga, la y zab n sõng pʋg-kõore.

Sẽn-Ka-Saab yetame: «M kotame tɩ y wa tɩ d yẽs ne taaba. Baa yãmb yel-wẽnã sã n yaa miuug wa saag-pag-a-minamina, b na n lebga pɛɛlg wa lampalga. La baa b sã n yaa miuug wa monem, b na n lebga pɛɛlg wa pe-kõbdo.
Yãmb sã n sak n kelg maam, yãmb na n dɩɩ tẽngã bõn-sõamyã fãa.
La yãmb sã n zãgs n kɩɩs maam, zabr sʋʋg n na n kʋ yãmba!» Maam a Sẽn-Ka-Saab meng noor n yeele.
Maana a wãn tɩ tẽng ning sẽn dag n yaa sakdã lebg yoob tẽnga? A rag n yaa tẽng sẽn pid ne zemsgo, la tɩrlem dag n bee beenẽ, la moasã, a pida ne nin-kʋʋdba.
Fo wanzuri wã lebga wãyã, yãmb reezẽ rãamã pula koom.
Fo nanambsã lebga kɩɩsdba, la b lebg wagda tũud-n-taase. Bãmb fãa nongame tɩ b kõt-b kũuni, la b zoet n pʋgd zãmb keoore. Bãmb ka kaood kɩɩb bʋʋd tɩrga, la pʋg-kõap yell gesg ka pak-b ye.
Woto yĩng kɩtame tɩ Saasẽ-pãng-soabã sẽn yaa Israyɛll Wẽnnaam sẽn tar pãngã yetẽ: «Ad na n yɩɩ toogo! Mam na n maana m zabd-n-taasã wẽng n lebse, la m na n doka m sũur ne m bɛɛbã.

Zeruzalɛm, mam na n leb n tẽega m nugã fo zugu. Mam na n ninga foom boaagẽ n yiis f rẽgdã, wa b sẽn yẽnegd kugr boaagẽ n yiisd kut n basd wãyã, wa b sẽn dɩk zẽem n pek bũmbu. Mam na n yiisa fo tʋʋm-beedã wa namdo.
Mam na n leb n kõo foom bʋ-kaoodb wa pĩndã, la m kɩt tɩ sagendb zĩnd wa sɩngrẽ wã. Rẽ poore, b na n boola foom tɩ: tɩrlem tẽnga, la sɩd tẽnga.»
Sɩyõ sã n kẽn zemsg pʋga, a na n paama fãagre, la neb nins sẽn na n bao tɩrlmã, na n paama fãagre.
La sãoong n na n paam kɩɩsdbã ne yel-wẽn-maandbã. Neb nins sẽn basd Sẽn-Ka-Saabã na n menemame.
Tɩ-bɛd nins yãmb sẽn dag n nongã yãnd na n yõka yãmba. Yãmb zẽed zĩisã y sẽn nongã yãnd na n yõka yãmba.
Bala, yãmb na n yɩɩ wa terebẽnt tɩɩg vãad sẽn zelge, wa zẽed zĩig sẽn ka leb n tar koom.
Sẽn tar-a pãngã na n yɩɩ wa gʋmdo, la a tʋʋmã na n yɩɩ wa bug-pãrga. Bãmb b yiibã fãa na n naaga taab n dɩ bugum tɩ ned ka be n na n kiis-a ye.
Woto yaa a Amots biig a Ezayi koɛɛga, a sẽn yãnd vẽnegr pʋgẽ, sẽn kẽed Zʋʋda ne Zeruzalɛm wɛɛngẽ.
Wakat n wate, tɩ tãng ning Sẽn-Ka-Saab roogã sẽn tilg a zugã na n lug n yɩɩg tãms a taabã, a na n zẽkame t'a zãntlmã yɩɩg kunkubã zãntlem. La buud toay-toay fãa na n zoe n waa beenẽ.

Neb kʋʋng na n dabda beenẽ la b yetẽ: «Wa-y tɩ d rʋ Sẽn-Ka-Saab tãngã zugu, a Zakoob Wẽnnaamã roogẽ! Bãmb na n wilga tõnd b soayã, la tõnd na n tũu bãmb so-bugsã. Bala, tõogã na n yii Sɩyõ n wa, Sẽn-Ka-Saab gomdã na n yii Zeruzalɛm n wa.

Bãmb na n yɩɩ buud toay-toayã bʋ-kaooda, bãmb na n yɩɩ neb kʋʋng zab-paasda. B na n dɩka b zabr sʋʋsã n kud wãgse, la b rɩk b kãnã n kud goeto. Buud kõn tol n leb n yik zabr ne a to ye. La b kõn leb n zãms zabr sẽn zabd to-to ye.»
«A Zakoob yagense, wa-y tɩ d kẽn Sẽn-Ka-Saab vẽenemã pʋga.»
Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, yãmb basa a Zakoob buudã sẽn yaa y nebã, a sẽn pid ne yaang nebã manesmã, la a pid ne neb sẽn bʋgd bagr wa Filistẽ-dãmbã, la a maan zems-n-taar ne sãambã yĩnga.
A tẽngã pida ne wanzuri la sãnem, la yẽnda arzegs sẽn ka tõe n sõd n sɛ ye. A tẽngã pida ne wiidi, la ne saar-dãmb sẽn ka tõe n sõd n sɛ ye.
Yẽnda tẽngã pida ne wẽn-naandse, nebã wõgemdedame n waoogd bãmb nus tʋʋmã, b wõgemdeda bãmb mengã nus sẽn maanã taoore.
Ninsaalbã na n paama yãnde. Nebã na n paama paoogre. Da-y kõ-y bãmb sugr ye!
Ninsaalba, zoe n tɩ kẽ-y pĩis bogdẽ, la f solg f meng tẽng tomẽ, n zãag f meng ne Sẽn-Ka-Saab yɛɛsgã, la ne bãmb naam-kãsengã pukri.
Tɩtaam dãmbã na n paama paoogre, la zẽk-m-mens rãmbã na n paama yãnde. Badaare, yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab yʋʋrã bal n na n paam zẽkre.
Bala, yaa Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã daare. Bãmb na n sika tɩtaam la zẽk-m-meng fãa, la b sik bũmb ning fãa sẽn wukd a menga.
Bãmb na n sika Libã sɛɛdr tɩ-wogdã sẽn lugã, ne Basã tẽng sɛn tɩɩsã fãa.
Bãmb na n sirga tãms nins fãa sẽn lugi, la b sirg kunkub nins fãa sẽn zẽkã.
Bãmb na n siiga gãs-wogdã fãa, la b siig lals nins fãa sẽn tar pãngã.
Bãmb na n kɩtame tɩ Tarsɩɩs koom kogendã lisi, koom kogl-bɛd sẽn yaa neebã lisi.
Woto, b na n sika ninsaalbã tɩtaamã, la zẽk-m-mens rãmbã na n paama paoogre. Badaare, yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab bal n na n paam waoogre.
Bãmb na n menesa wẽn-naandsã fãa.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab sã n wa n na n yik n kẽes dũniyã rabeem, bãmb na n zoe n tɩ kẽe pĩis bogdẽ, la b solg b meng tẽng tomẽ, n zãag b meng ne Sẽn-Ka-Saab yɛɛsgã, la ne bãmb naam-kãsengã pukri.
Badaare, ninsaalbã na n dɩka b wanzuri ne b sãnem wẽn-naandsã bãmb sẽn wõgemded n waoogdẽ wã n lob laoos ne zankiti.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab sã n wa n na n yik n kẽes dũniyã rabeem, bãmb na n zoe n tɩ kẽe pĩis bogdẽ, la b solg b meng pĩis pẽgsẽ, n zãag b meng ne Sẽn-Ka-Saab yɛɛsgã, la ne bãmb naam-kãsengã pukri.
Dẽ wã, bɩ f ra leb n teeg ninsaal sẽn vʋʋsd ne yõ-bogdã ye. Ninsaal yõod zema bõe?
N-yẽe! Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa Zu-soaba, n yaa Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã na n yiisa bõn-teegds nins fãa Zeruzalɛm ne Zʋʋda sẽn teegã. Bãmb na n yiisa rɩɩbã ne koomã fãa.
Bãmb na n yiisa gãndaoogã ne tãb-biigã la bʋ-kaoodã ne Wẽnnaam no-rɛɛsã, ne bagã la kãsmã,
ne tãb-biis pis-nunu naabã la nin-kãsengã, ne sagendã, la yam soabã ne tɩ-rɩtã.
Mam na n kɩtame tɩ kom-bãooneg yɩ bãmb nanambse, la m kɩt tɩ yãas soog bãmba.
Nebã sʋka, nebã na n maana taab pãnga. Bi-bilf na n zaba ne nin-kẽema, nin-yaalg na n zaba ne nin-kãsenga.
Hal tɩ ned gãd a saam-biig a ba zakẽ n yeele: «Foom n tar kasaabo, foom n na n yɩ tõnd naab n soog raboogã.»
Badaare, nin-kãng me na n kelmame n yeele: «Mam ka logtore, m ka tar dɩɩb m yiri, la m ka tar kasaab ye. Da maan-y maam tɩ m yɩ y naab ye.»
Ade, Zeruzalɛm lagsdame, la Zʋʋda sirgdame. Bala, bãmb goamã ne bãmb tʋʋmã kɩɩsda Sẽn-Ka-Saabo. La bãmb paoogda Sẽn-Ka-Saab ziirã.
Bãmb nensã gãneng kɩta kaseto, tɩ bãmb ka zems ye. Bãmb sẽn maand b yel-wẽnã wa Sodom nebã sẽn dag n maandã, n ka solgdẽ wã yĩnga. Ad yaa toog n na n paam-ba! Bala, bãmb n segl to-kãng b mens yĩnga.
Yeel-y tɩ bũmb fãa na n yɩɩ neer nin-tɩrg yĩnga, bala, yẽnda na n dɩɩ a tʋʋmã yõodo.
Nin-wẽng na n paama toogo! Ka na n yɩ sõama yẽnda yĩng ye. Bala, yẽnda na n deega a nus tʋʋmã yaoodo.
Kom-bãooneg bal n tar mam nebã n namsdẽ, la yaa pagb n so bãmba. Mam nebã, yãmbã tɛtbã kẽesda yãmb moogo, bãmb menesda sor ning yãmb sẽn tũudã.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yikame n na n bool bʋʋdo, bãmb yikame n na n kao nebã bʋʋdo.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n bʋʋ ne b nebã kãsem-dãmba, la ne b nanambsã n yeele: «Yãmb sãama reezẽ tɩɩs pʋto! Yãmb zɛɛ naong rãmb teed n pids y roto.
Bõe yĩng tɩ yãmb wõrd mam nebã? Bõe yĩng tɩ y paoogd naong rãmbã? Yaa maam a Zu-soab a Sẽn-Ka-Saab n yeele.»
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yetame yaa: «Sɩyõ kom-pugli wã sẽn yaa tɩtaam dãmbã yĩnga, bãmb sẽn nak b nens yĩngrã yĩnga, bãmb sẽn nagd ne b ninã yĩnga, la b sẽn kẽnd n tĩmsd b nao tɩ b buglã maand bʋʋrã yĩnga,
Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n kɩtame tɩ Sɩyõ kom-pugli wã yɩ zu-kõodo. La b kɩt tɩ b rĩy lebg koɛɛla.»
Badaare, Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n yãgsa fan-teedã fãa: yaa naoã buglã, zut gãmba wã ne pɛɛm sẽn send zutã,
b tʋblondã ne b nug-zũyã ne pɛɛlã b sẽn lut b nensã,
b zu-vindsã ne b kalembãensã sẽn be b naoẽ wã, la b yãgs bãmb sɛɛg kĩnkĩndi wã ne b parfẽ wã tʋgdã, la b se-gãnã,
b nugbĩnsã ne nugbĩnsã b sẽn ning yõyã.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n yeesa bãmb tigã fut ne b fu-bɛdã, la b yees b fu-yer-bɛdã, la b rees b nusẽ kordã.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n yiisa b nen-getsã ne b fu-faasensã la b peen-teegdsã ne b bãg-paasã.

Bõn-põosg yũug n na n deeg parfẽ-rãmb sẽn tar yũ-noog zĩiga, wĩy n na n deeg sɛɛg sẽbds zĩiga. Zu-koɛɛl n na n deeg zut sẽn pãnem zĩiga, bot na n deega nagem fu-yer-bɛd zĩiga. Bãnd sẽn ningd-b yãnd n na deeg b neermã zĩiga.
Fo raopã na n paa tãpẽ, la fo gãndaadã na n paa zabrẽ.
Zeruzalɛm tẽngã noy na n pida ne yãbr la wiisgu. Yẽnda nebã kaalem yĩnga, a na n zĩnda tomẽ n yãbe.
Badaare, pagb a yopoe na n gãda rao a yembr n yetẽ: «Tõnd na n dɩlgda d mense, la d yeelgd d mens futu. Yãmb we n sak tɩ d reeg yãmb yʋʋrã bala! Yiis d yãndã kõ-do.»
Badaare, Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn na n kɩt bũmb ning bul n yi wã na n waa ne neerem la ziiri. Tẽngã koodã na n paama waoogr la ziir Israyɛll bu-kellã yĩnga.
Dẽ, neb nins sẽn kell Sɩyõ wã, sẽn dat n togs tɩ sẽn kell-b Zeruzalɛmã, b na n boola bãmb tɩ pʋ-peelem dãmb Sẽn-Ka-Saab yĩnga. B na n gʋlsa neb nins fãa sẽn na n paam vɩɩm Zeruzalɛm pʋgẽ wã yʋya.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab sã n dɩk b bʋ-kaoorã ne b pãngã n pek Sɩyõ kom-pugli wã n yiis b rẽgdã n sɛ, la b pek Zeruzalɛm ne zemsg sɩɩga, la ne sãoong sɩɩg n yiis zɩɩmã sẽn be yẽnda pʋgẽ wã n sɛ,

Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n maana sawaodg ne bug-zõos t'a yɛdg n pid Sɩyõ tãngã zĩig fãa, n zĩnd b nebã tigind zut wĩndga, n yɩ bugum sẽn wit n kõt vẽenem yʋngo. Bala, Sẽn-Ka-Saab belmã na n yɩɩ wa zãnd n zĩnd bũmbã fãa zugu.
A na n yɩɩ wa sẽok sẽn kõt maasem wĩndga, tʋʋlg wakate, la a yɩ zĩ-soalgdga, ne solgr zĩiga, sobg wall sa-bɛd wakate.
Mam kotame tɩ y bas tɩ m yɩɩl m zoa wã yĩnga. Mam na n yɩɩla yɩɩll m noangã reezẽ tɩɩs pʋʋg yĩnga. Mam zoa wã rag n tara a reezẽ tɩɩs pʋʋg sẽn be tãngã sigdgã zĩ-sõngẽ.

Mam zoa wã gudga tẽngã n vigs kugã n lebs n sel reezẽ tɩɩs bu-sõngo, la a me gãosg pʋʋgã sʋka, n tu reezẽ rãam wẽkr boko. Yẽnda rag n tagsdame t'a pʋʋgã na n woma reezẽ tɩɩs bi-sõama, la a woma bi-põaasa!
Moasã, Zeruzalɛm ne Zʋʋda nebã, m kotame tɩ y yɩ bʋ-kaoodb maam ne m reezẽ tɩɩs pʋʋgã sʋka!
Bõe la mam dag n tog n maan m reezẽ tɩɩs pʋʋgã yĩng n ka maane? Bõe yĩng tɩ mam tags t'a na n woma reezẽ-sõama t'a wa womd bi-põaasa?
Moasã, m kotame tɩ y bas tɩ m wilg-y mam sẽn na n maan m reezẽ tɩɩs pʋʋgã bũmb ninga. Mam na n yãka a yãgrã n bas-a tɩ b sãam-a. Mam na n wura a lalgã tɩ b kẽ n tab-a ne nao.
Mam na n kɩtame t'a lebg raboogo. B ka na n leb n yos-a wall b ko-a ye. Gõos ne gõpayãnds n na n yi a pʋga. Mam na n kõo sawatã noore, n kɩt tɩ b ra leb n bas saag t'a ni beenẽ ye.

Ade, Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã reezẽ tɩɩs pʋʋgã yaa Israyɛll nebã. La tɩɩs nins bãmb sẽn dag n nongã yaa Zʋʋda nebã. Sẽn-Ka-Saab rag n tagsdame tɩ b na n yãnda zemsg beenẽ, la b mika zɩɩm daagr bala! Bãmb dag n tagsdame tɩ b na n yãnda tɩrlem beenẽ, la b mikame tɩ yaa b sẽn kʋʋd-b rãmbã kelems n be beenẽ.
Tood bee neb nins sẽn baood rot n paasd b rotã, la sẽn baood pʋt n paasd b rẽndã, hal tɩ zĩig ka leb n beẽ wã zugu. Zĩig ka leb n be tẽngã pʋgẽ neb a taab yĩng tɩ ka yãmb bal ye!
Ad wẽeneg ning Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã sẽn wẽen tɩ mam wʋme: «Hakɩɩka, ro-bãmbã sẽn yaa wʋsgã na n sãamame, ned kõn leb n zĩnd ro-bɛd-bãmbã sẽn yaa neebã pʋs ye.
Baa reezẽ tɩɩs pʋʋg yalem sã n ta nao-yakem tus piiga, a ka na n wom tɩ yɩɩg konkong la pʋɩ-sʋk ye. La bõn-buud konkong piig na n woma bõn-koaadl konkong a ye la pʋɩ-sʋka.»
Toog bee neb nins sẽn yikd yibeoog pĩnd n baood rãam sẽn yilimd nengã zugu, la sẽn yũud reezẽ rãam n lengd ne zaabrã zugu!
Bãmb tigã zĩisẽ, yaa pends wẽebo, ruuds wãagre, gãngãad pãbre, wɩɩs peebgo, la rãam yũubu. La bãmb yaool n ka ne Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn maand bũmb ningã ye. Bãmb ka ne Sẽn-Ka-Saab nus tʋʋmã ye.
Yaa rẽ n kɩte, tɩ b na n yiis mam nebã n tɩ kẽes yembdo, b sẽn ka tar bãngrã yĩnga. Kom na n kʋʋ bãmb nanambsã, la ko-yũud na n kʋʋ mam nebã sẽn yaa kʋʋngã.
Rẽ n kɩte, tɩ kɩɩm-kulg pak a kokoayã wʋsgo, n yaag a noorã yaolengo, tɩ tẽngã nanambsã ne b neb kʋʋngã na n sig beenẽ ne b bʋrgã la ne b sũ-noog kaasgã.
Ninsaal na n paama yãnde. Ninsaal na n paama paoogre, la tɩtaam dãmbã na n paama paoogre.
Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã na n paama waoogr b bʋʋdã kaoob sẽn yaa tɩrgã pʋgẽ. Wẽnnaam sẽn yaa pʋ-peelem soabã na n wilga b pʋ-peelmã b bʋʋdã kaoob pʋga.
Piisã na n zĩnda beenẽ tɩ yɩ b wãbneg zĩiga, la sãamb n na n wa soog arzegs rãmbã sẽn zoe n basã.
Toog bee neb nins sẽn tɛt yel-wẽnã ne zãmb wĩyã, la sẽn tɛt yel-wẽnã wa b sẽn takd terok ne wĩirã zugu.
Bãmb yetame: «Bɩ Israyɛll Pʋ-Peelem-Soabã maan b tʋʋmdã tao-tao tɩ tõnd yãnde! Bɩ saagr ning bãmb sẽn saagdã paam pidsg tɩ tõnd bãnge!»
Toog bee neb nins sẽn boond wẽng tɩ sõama la b boond sõama tɩ wẽngã zutu. Bãmb geelgda lik wa vẽenem, la b geelgd vẽenem wa lika. Bãmb geelgda toog wa noogo, la b geelgd noog wa toogo!
Toog bee neb nins sẽn tagsd tɩ b yaa yam dãmba, la sẽn tẽed tɩ b yaa bãngdbã zutu.
Toog bee neb nins sẽn yaa gãndaad ne reezẽ rãam yũubã, la neb nins sẽn mi rãam kaolengã zutu.
Bãmb deegda kũun n kõt nin-wẽng bʋʋm, la b mongd bʋʋm soab bʋʋm!

Woto yĩnga, bug-witim sẽn dɩt mood to-to wã, la bugum sẽn dɩt wudg to-to wã, bãmb yẽgã na n yɩɩ wa bõn-põosgo, la bãmb puudã na n sʋʋga wa wubsgu. Bala, bãmb kɩɩsa Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã tõogo, la bãmb paooga Israyɛll Pʋ-Peelem-Soabã gomdã.

Woto n kɩte, tɩ Sẽn-Ka-Saab sũur yik ne b nebã. Bãmb zẽka b nug n wẽ-ba. Tãmsã rigimdame, kũumã rʋra tẽngã soay zut wa sagdo. La baoosgo, ne yõwã fãa, Wẽnnaam sũurã kell n ka sig ye. Bãmb nugã ket n zẽkame.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab zẽka tãb-kaoor neb nins sẽn be tẽn-zãrsẽ wã yĩnga. Bãmb fɩɩl n boola bãmb tɩ b yi dũniyã kɩremsã n wa. La gese, bãmb yãgdame n wat tao-tao.
Ned ka be bãmb sʋkã n yɛ, wall n keoosdẽ ye. Ned ka be bãmb sʋkã n suusdẽ, wall a gõe ye. Ned ka be bãmb sʋkã t'a sɛɛg sẽbdg loke, wall t'a neooda sẽbds kao me ye.
Bãmb pɛɛmã yaa sɩlemse, la b tãbdã rʋʋsame. Bãmb wiidã nao-bendã wẽnda kuga, la b saar-dãmbã nao wẽnda seb-kãsenga.
Bãmb kɛlengã yaa wa gɩgem-yãang kɛlenga. Bãmb kelemda wa gɩgem-poala, bãmb wũusdame, bãmb yõkda rũng n tall n loog n kẽng zĩig ning ned sẽn ka tõe n ta, tɩ ned ka tõe n yõk n deeg ye.
Badaare, b na n guglma bãmb zut wa ko-kãsengã sẽn guglumdã. B na n gesa tẽngã, la yaa lik ne toog bala. La sawad-taok n na n wa kɩt t'a vẽenemã lebg lika.
Rĩm a Oozɩyaas kũumã yʋʋmde, mam yãnda Sẽn-Ka-Saab vẽnegr pʋga, tɩ b zao naam geer sẽn zẽk wʋsg zugu. La bãmb fuugã tẽngr yɛdg n pida Wẽnd doogã.
Serafẽ-rãmb n dag n yas bãmb zugẽ wã. Bãmb ned kam fãa rag n tara pɩgs a yoobe. Bãmb tara a yiib n lut b nenga, la b tara a yiib n lut b naoã, la b tar a yiibã n yɩgda.
Bãmb dag n zẽkda b koees n yet taab yaa: «Pʋ-Peelem-Soaba, Pʋ-Peelem-Soaba, Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã yaa Pʋ-Peelem-Soaba. Dũniyã fãa pida ne bãmb ziirã.»
Bãmb koeesã rãamd rag n kɩtame tɩ Wẽnd doogã kʋɩlems tẽngr rĩmda, la roogã rag n pida ne bug-zõose.
Dẽ, mam yeelame yaa: «Mam paama toog bala! Mam ki yã! Bala, mam yaa nobɩn-dẽgd soaba, la mam bee neb sẽn yaa nobɩn-dẽgd rãmb sʋka. La mam nin yãnda rĩmã sẽn yaa Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã!»
Serafẽ a yembr yɩkame n wat mam sẽnẽ, la a rag n yãka bug-saall ne yɩʋʋg tẽn-kugrã zug n zãad a nugẽ.
Yẽnda sɩɩsa mam noorã ne bug-saallã n yeele: «Yõwã sẽn sɩɩs fo nobɩmsã, b yiisa fo kongrã, la b kõo foom f yel-wẽndã sugri.»
Dẽ, mam wʋma Zu-soabã sẽn yet yaa: «Ãnda la mam na n tʋme? Ãnda n na n kẽng tõnd yʋʋr yĩnga? La mam leokame: ‹Ad maam, tʋm-y maam!› »
La bãmb yeelame yaa: «Kẽng n tɩ yeel nin-bãmbã yaa: ‹Yãmb kelgdame, la y ka wʋmd ye! Yãmb getame, la y ka ne ye!›

Riglim nin-bãmbã sũyã, n kɩt tɩ b yɩ tʋb-pa-wʋmdba, n kɩt tɩ b ninã mume, tɩ b ninã ra leb n yãnd ye, tɩ b tʋbã ra tõog n wʋm me ye, tɩ b ra wa tõog n wʋm a võor ye. Maan a woto tɩ b ra wa tek yam n paam maagr ye.»

La mam sokame yaa: «Zu-soaba, na n yɩɩ a woto hal tɩ ta dabʋre?» Bãmb leoka maam yaa: Hal tɩ ta wakat ning b sẽn na n sãam tẽmsã tɩ neb ka leb n be b pʋsẽ, la b sẽn na n sãam dotã tɩ neb ka leb n be b pʋsẽ, la b sẽn na n sãam tẽn-gãongã t'a lebg zĩ-vɩʋʋgã,
hal tɩ ta wakat ning Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn na n kɩt tɩ nebã zãag zĩiga, n bas tẽngã zãngã.
Baa tẽngã neb piig sʋk ned a yembr sã n kelle, bugum n na n dɩ-a, la wa b sẽn kɛɛd terebẽnt tɩɩg ne sɛn tɩɩg t'a viukã ketẽ wã, a viukã na n toba yagens sẽn welg toore.

Zʋʋda rĩm a Akaaz sẽn yaa a Zotam biiga, n yaa a Oozɩyaas yagengã wakatẽ, Siiri rĩm a Retsin ne Israyɛll dĩm a Peka sẽn yaa a Remaliya biigã kẽng n na n tɩ zaba ne Zeruzalɛm, la b ka tõog n zab ne-a ye.
B togsa a Davɩɩd doogã neb n yeel yaa: «Siiri tãb-biisã kẽng n tɩ yãmba Efrayiim tẽngã.» Dẽ, a Akaaz ne a nebã sũy sɩnga rigb wa sobg sẽn miimd tʋgr tɩɩse.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yeela a Ezayi yaa: «Mam kot-f lame tɩ foom ne f biig a Seyaar-Yasuub yi n seg a Akaaz ko-bao-kãsengã ko-sor noore, ga-loasdã pʋʋgã sor zugu.

Yeel-a yaa: ‹Gãneg f yam, da zoe rabeem ye. Ra bas tɩ f sũur kiuus nin-bãmbã b yiibã sẽn yaa ra-giis sẽn nukd bug-zõosã yĩng ye. Ra bas tɩ f sũur kiuus Siiri rĩm a Retsin ne a Remaliya biigã sũ-puugrã yĩng ye!
Bala, Siiri ne Efrayiim la a Remaliya biigã saagd n dat n maana foom wẽnga.› » Bãmb yetame:
«Wa-y tɩ d kẽng n tɩ zab ne Zʋʋda nebã, d na n kẽesa tẽngã rabeem, tõnd na n pãb-a lame n wã, n modg-a t'a sak-do, la d yãk a Tabeyɛll biigã n kɩt t'a yɩ rĩm n soog Zʋʋda.»
Ade, Zu-soab a Sẽn-Ka-Saab yetame: «Bõn-kãng kõn tõog ye, rẽndã ka tõe n yɩ ye.
Bala, Siiri na-tẽng yaa Damaase, la a Retsin yaa Damaas tẽngã zug-soaba. A keta yʋʋm pis-yoob la a nu, tɩ Efrayiim sẽn sãamã ka leb n yɩ soolem ye.
Efrayiim na-tẽng yaa Samaari, la a Remaliya biigã n yaa Samaari tẽngã zug-soaba. Yãmb sã n ka tall tẽebo, yãmb ka na n tõog n yals ye!»
Sẽn-Ka-Saab leb n yeel a Akaaz yaa:
«Kos Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa fo Wẽnnaamã bãnde. Ba a sã n yaa kɩɩm-kulg zĩ-zulumsẽ wã, wall a sã n yaa hal yĩngr zĩ-zãrsẽ.»
A Akaaz leokame: «Mam ka na n kos bũmb ye, mam ka na n mak Sẽn-Ka-Saab n ges ye.»
Dẽ, a Ezayi yeelame: «Dĩm a Davɩɩd yagense, m kotame tɩ y kelge! Yãmb sẽn maan tɩ ninsaalbã yam yi yãmbã ka sek-y tɩ y rat n maan tɩ mam Wẽnnaamã me yam yi-yã?
Rẽ kɩtame tɩ Zu-soabã meng na n kõ yãmb bãnde. Ade, pa-kuil na n dɩka pʋga, n dog bi-ribla, n pʋd a yʋʋr t'a Emanuwɛlle, sẽn dat n togs tɩ ‹Wẽnd-be-ne-do.›
Yẽnda na n yũuda bĩis-gõeem la a rɩt sɩɩd hal n wa n bãng tɩ zãgs wẽng n maan neere.
La sẽn deng biigã sẽn na n bãng tɩ zãgs wẽng n maan neere, nebã na n zoe n basa rĩm-dãmb a yiib nins sẽn kẽesd yãmb dabeem-kãsengã tẽng t'a lebg vɩʋʋgo.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n kɩtame tɩ foom ne f nebã, la f ba wã roog neb yãnd ray buud sẽn nan zɩ n zĩndi, hal sẽn sɩng daar ning Efrayiim sẽn welg ne Zʋʋda wã. Yaa Asiiri rĩmã n na n wa ne yel-kãnga.
Badaare, Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n fɩɩl n boola zõos nins sẽn be Ezɩpt tẽngã Nill kʋɩlgã ko-soayã sẽn be kɩremsã, la sĩ wã sẽn be Asiiri soolmẽ wã.
Bãmb fãa na n wa siga tãn-londã sẽn be tãn-lug-lugã sʋkã, la pĩisã sẽgsẽ, la tuudã ne yam-maasã fãa zutu.
Badaare, Zu-soabã na n talla barg b sẽn tɩ peng Efrat kʋɩlgã rʋʋnde, yaa Asiiri rĩmã yell la b sẽn gomdã, n kõog yãmb zugã, ne y kar-kõbdã la b kõog y toɛɛngã.
Badaare, ned kam fãa na n gʋʋla nag-sãdg a yembr ne rũm-bãooneg a yiibu.
La bĩisim sẽn na n yɩ wʋsgã yĩnga, b na n dɩɩ bĩis-gõeem. Neb nins fãa sẽn na n pa tẽngẽ wã na n dɩɩ bĩis-gõeem ne sɩɩdo.
Badaare, zĩis nins fãa sẽn dag n tar reezẽ tɩɩs tusr sẽn zem wanzuri ligd tusrã na n lebga gõos la gõpayãndse.
Nebã na n kẽnga beenẽ ne tãp la pɛɛm n tɩ tãoose, bala, tẽngã na n lebga gõos la gõpayãndse.

La b sẽn dag n kood kunkub nins fãa sigdsẽ ne wãgsã, fo ka na n leb n saag n kẽng beenẽ, fo sẽn zoet gõosã ne gõpayãndsã yĩnga. B na n basda niig tɩ b kẽnd n wãbd beenẽ, beenẽ lebga piis ne bʋʋs gõob zĩiga.»
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yeela maam yaa: «Rɩk wal-bedre, n gʋls a zug ne gʋls-biis kaoreng sẽn yaa naana. Gʋls a woto: ‹Mahɛɛr-Salall-Has-Baaze.›
La mam dɩka wal-bedrã n wilg kaset dãmb a yiib sẽn yaa sɩd dãmba. Yaa maan-kʋʋd a Uuri ne a Yeberekiya biig a Zakari.
Mam kẽe ne Wẽnnaam no-rɛɛs-poakã, la a rɩka pʋg n dog bi-ribla.» La Sẽn-Ka-Saab yeela maam yaa: «Pʋd biigã yʋʋr t'a Mahɛɛr-Salall-Has-Baaze.
Bala, sẽn deng biigã sẽn na n bãng tɩ bool a ba bɩ a ma wã, b na n wa wʋka Damaas arzegsã, la b zɛ Samaari laogã n tall n kẽng Asiiri rĩmã nengẽ.»
Sẽn-Ka-Saab leb n yeela maam yaa:
«Nin-bãmbã sẽn zãgs Sɩloe koomã sẽn zoet bãanem-bãanemã, n bas n maand sũ-noog Siiri rĩm a Retsin ne a Remaliya biigã sẽn yaa Israyɛll rĩmã yĩngã,
kɩtame tɩ Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n kɩt tɩ koom sẽn tar pãngã, Efrat kʋɩlgã koom sẽn yaa Asiiri rĩmã yik ne a ziirã fãa n zab ne bãmba. Yẽnda na n pida ko-soayã fãa n puugi, n gãndg a kʋɩl-kogsã fãa n loogdẽ.
Ko-kãng na n kãaga Zʋʋda, yẽnda na n lim-a lame n tãag a kokoayã. A Emanuwɛll na n yɛdga a pɩgsã n pid fo tẽngã zĩigã fãa.»

Nebã, kaas-y-yã! B na n kẽesa yãmb dabeem! Yãmb dãmb fãa sẽn be dũniyã zĩ-zãrsẽ wã, yok-y y tʋb n kelge! Segl-y y mens zabr yĩnga. Rabeem-kãseng na n yõka yãmba! Segl-y y mens zabr yĩnga. Rabeem-kãseng na n yõka yãmba!
Yãmb dat bɩ y maan saagre, a ka na n tõog ye, yãmb dat bɩ y gome, a ka na n pids ye. Bala, Wẽnnaam bee ne tõndo.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab nugã sẽn wa n gãd maamã, bãmb sagla maam tɩ m da wa maan wa nin-bãmbã ye. Bãmb yeela maam yaa:
«Nin-bãmbã sẽn set n dat n maan bũmb ning fãa wã, bɩ y ra geelg bõn-kãng wa bũmb sẽn na n tõog ye. Ra-y zoe-y bũmb nins bãmb sẽn zoetã ye. Ra-y yɛɛs-y bõn-kãng ye.
Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã bal la yãmb tog n ges tɩ b yaa pʋ-peelem soaba. Bãmb bal la yãmb tog n zoe, yaa bãmb la yãmb tog n yɛɛse.
Bãmb na n yɩɩ zĩig sẽn welg toore, la b leb n na n yɩɩ kugr neb sẽn lakda, bãmb yaa pĩig kugr sẽn lubda, Israyɛll buud a yiibã yĩnga. Bãmb yaa bẽdg ne tãoog Zeruzalɛm nebã yĩnga.
Neb wʋsg na n laka bãmb n lʋɩ, bãmb na n lʋɩɩme n wã, bẽdgã na n yõka bãmba, tɩ b gãd-ba.
Bĩng kaset-kãngã, sog tõ-kãngã n bĩng m karen-biisã sʋka.
Mam gũuda Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, bãmb wẽnemd n basa a Zakoob buudã. Mam maanda tẽeb ne bãmba.
Mam mengã ne kamb nins Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn kõ maamã yaa bãnde, la bõn-bãnd sẽn wilgd bũmb ning sẽn na n wa maan Israyɛll pʋgẽ, bõn-kãng yita Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã sẽn be Sɩyõ tãngã zugã nengẽ.»
B sã n wa yeel yãmba: «Kẽng-y n tɩ bao-y neb sẽn sogsd kɩɩmse, la y sok kinkir-bagbã sẽn walemd la b yẽgemdẽ wã. Buud fãa ka sokd a Wẽnnaam sɩda? B ka sokd kɩɩms nin-vɩɩs yĩng sɩda?»
Bɩ y leok yaa: «D tog n wẽnemd n gesa Zu-soabã tõogã ne b kasetã.» Nebã sã n ka sak n gom a woto, b ka na n yãnd beoogã vẽegr ye.
Bãmb na n pɩʋʋga tẽngã ne namsgo, la kom. Kom sẽn na n nams bãmbã yĩnga, bãmb sũyã na n yikame, la b na n kãaba b rĩmã ne b Wẽnnaamã wẽnga. Bãmb na n wẽnemd n nak n gesa yĩngri,
la bãmb na n sulg n gesa tẽnga, n mik tɩ yaa sũ-sãanga, lik bida la yel-pak-kãsems bala. B na n tusa bãmb n kẽes lik bida pʋga.

Lik bida wã ka na n zĩnd tẽng ning sẽn paamd toog moasã wã pʋgẽ wakat fãa ye. Wakat sẽn loogã, Zu-soabã sã n kɩtame tɩ Zabulõ ne Neftali tẽngã paam yãnde, wakat sẽn watã, b na n kɩtame tɩ sor ning sẽn yegd ko-kãsengã, ne tẽng ning sẽn be Zʋrdẽ kʋɩlgã rʋʋndã sẽn yaa buud toay-toayã soolmã paam ziiri.
Neb nins sẽn dag n kẽnd lik bida pʋgẽ wã, yãnda vẽen-kãsenga. Vẽenem yãga neb nins sẽn zĩ lik bida tẽngẽ wã zugu.
Zu-soaba, yãmb kɩtame tɩ nebã fɩɩge, yãmb kɩtame tɩ b paam sũ-no-kãsenga. Bãmb kɩdemda yãmb taoor wa neb sẽn kɩdemd tigsg wakate, b maanda sũ-noog wa neb sẽn pʋɩt te-zɛɛdem.
Bala, yãmb yiisa bãmb yembd ning b sẽn dag n be wã pʋga, yãmb kaooga rasaar ning b sẽn dag n tar n pãbd bãmb poayã, yãmb kaooga bɛyã gʋlgã, wa yãmb sẽn maan Madiyã-rãmbã lʋɩɩs daarã.
B na n loba neooda nins fãa b sẽn tab tẽng zabr wakatã bugmẽ, la b lob fut nins fãa zɩɩm sẽn bolã bugmẽ, tɩ bugmã rɩ-b zãnga.

Bala, b roga biig n kõ-do, b kõo tõnd bi-ribla. B kõo yẽnda noor t'a na n soog soolem. La b na n boonda yẽnda tɩ sagend sẽn yaa sõama wʋsgo, Wẽnnaam sẽn tar pãnga, ba sẽn paad wakat sẽn ka sɛta, la vɩ-bãan naaba.

Yẽnda naamã na n yalgame, yẽnda na n waa ne vɩ-bãan sẽn ka sɛta, a Davɩɩd naam geerã ne yẽnda soolmã yĩnga. Yẽnda na n paasa a soolmã pãnga, la a na n zã-a-la ne zemsgo la tɩrlem, sẽn sɩng ne moasã la wakat sẽn kõn sɛ yĩnga. Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã nonglem-kãsengã n na n kɩt t'a yɩ a woto.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab tʋma koɛɛg a Zakoob yagensã yĩnga. Koɛɛgã siga Israyɛll soolmã zugu.
Nebã fãa na n bãnga bõn-kãnga. Efrayiim soolmã nebã ne Samaari nebã na n bãngame. Nin-bãmb dag n gomda ne wuk-m-meng la zẽk-m-meng n yetẽ yaa:
Tãn-koɛɛmã lalg lʋɩɩme, tõnd na n me-a-la ne kug-peesdɩ. B kɛɛ wom-sees tɩɩsã, la tõnd na n ledga bãmb ne sɛɛdr tɩ-bɛdã.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n kɩtame t'a Retsin zabd-n-taasã tõog bãmba. Sẽn-Ka-Saab paasa bãmb bɛɛbã pãnga.
Siiri nebã na n bee yaangã, tɩ Filistẽ-dãmbã be nin-taoore, la bãmb na n yaaga b noy n vel Israyɛlle. La ne rẽ fãa, Sẽn-Ka-Saab sũ-yikrã ka na n sig ye. Bãmb nugã na n ket n zẽkame.
Baoosgo, Israyɛll nebã ka na n lebg n wa Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa soab ning sẽn pãbd bãmbã nengẽ ye. Bãmb ka na n wẽnemd n bao Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã ye.
Dẽ, daar a yembr pʋgẽ, Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n fiuuga Israyɛll zugã, la b kʋʋg a zʋʋrã, b na n kʋʋga koangã willi, la b kʋʋg tãnwiigã.
Zugã yaa kãsem-dãmbã ne nanambsã, tɩ zʋʋrã yaa no-rɛɛsdbã sẽn kõt zĩrẽ zãmsgã.
Nin-bãmbã taoor-dãmbã kẽesd-b-la moogo, la neb nins bãmb sẽn tɛtã menemame.

Rẽ kɩtame tɩ Zu-soabã sũur ka na n yɩ noog ne bãmb kom-bɩɩsã ye. Bãmb ka na n zoe b pʋg-kõapã ne b kɩɩbsã nimbãaneg ye. Bala, bãmb fãa yaa wẽn-kɩɩsdba, la nin-wẽnse. Bãmb noyã fãa gomda yalem-goamã. La ne rẽ fãa, bãmb sũ-yikrã ka sig ye. Bãmb nugã ket n zẽkame.
Bala, wẽnemã rɩta wa bugum, a rɩta wa bugum sẽn dɩt gõos ne gõpayãndse, a rɩta weoogã kãgrã tɩ bug-zõ-taok zẽkdẽ.
Saasẽ-Pãng-soabã sũ-kãbrã kɩtame tɩ tẽngã kok bugum, la nebã lebga bugum dɩɩbo. Ned baa a yembr ka zoet a to nimbãaneg ye.
B wãbda rɩtgo, la kom ket n tara bãmba. Bãmb dɩta goabga, la b ket n ka tɩgd ye. Ned kam fãa wãbda a nug nemdo.
Manaase wãbda Efrayiim, tɩ Efrayiim me wãbd Manaase. Bãmb b yiibã naaga taab n zabd ne Zʋʋda. La ne rẽ fãa, Sẽn-Ka-Saab sũ-yikrã ka sig ye. Bãmb nugã ket n zẽkame.
Toog na n paama neb nins sẽn vigind wẽng maaneg tõodã, la sẽn gʋlsd pãn-maaneg noyã,
la sẽn mongd ka-pãens-rãmbã bʋʋm, sẽn wẽgd naong rãmbã sẽn be mam nebã sʋkã, la sẽn dɩkd pʋg-kõapã tɩ lebg b paoongo, la b fãad kɩɩbsã!
Yãmb na n maana a wãn n põs sɩbgrã daare, daar ning sɩbgrã sẽn na n yi zĩ-zãrg n wa wã? Yãmb na n zoe n kẽnga ãnda nengẽ n tɩ paam sõngre? Yãmb na n tɩ bĩnga y arzegsã yɛɛnẽ?
Yãmb sẽn tõe n maan bũmb ning bala, yaa tɩ y naag yembsã n kuudẽ, wall y ki n naag b sẽn kʋ-b rãmbã. La ne rẽ fãa, Sẽn-Ka-Saab sũ-yikrã ket n ka sig ye. Bãmb nugã ket n zẽkame.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yeelame: «Toog na n paama Asiiri nebã, bãmb yaa mam sũ-yikrã dasaare! Asiiri nug n zãad guugã mam sẽn tar n wilgd m sũ-yikrã.
Mam bas-a lame n zabd ne nin-wẽnsã. Mam tʋmd-a lame t'a tɩ zab ne neb nins sẽn yikd mam sũurã, t'a kẽng n tɩ zɛ teed wʋsgo, la a tab bãmb wa sor zug begdo.
La Asiiri ka tagsd tɩ yaa maam n tʋm-a ye. Asiiri ka tol n tagsd a woto ye. Yẽnda tagsg yaa tɩ sãame, yẽnda tagsd n na n menesa buud wʋsgo.»
Bala, yẽnda yetame: «Dẽ yĩnga, mam tãb-biis nanambsã ka zem dĩm-dãmb la?
Bũmb ning sẽn paam Kalno tẽngã ka paam Karkemiis tẽngã la? Bɩ sẽn paam Hamat tẽngã ka paam Arpaad tẽngã? Bɩ sẽn paam Samaari tẽngã ka paam Damaas tẽngã?
Mam nugã sẽn tõog n ta soolem nins sẽn dag n pʋʋsd wẽn-naandsã, tɩ bãmb bõn-naandsã sõor yaool n dag n yɩɩd Zeruzalɛm ne Samaari bõn-naandsã,
woto me, mam sẽn maan Samaari ne a wẽn-naandsã to-to wã, mam kõn maan Zeruzalɛm ne a bõn-naandsã me a woto sɩda?»
La Sẽn-Ka-Saab sã n wa n pids b tʋʋmdã fãa Sɩyõ tãngã zug Zeruzalɛm n sɛ, bãmb na n sɩbga Asiiri rĩma a wuk-m-mengã ne a tɩtaamã tagsg yĩnga.
Bala, yẽnda yeelame: «Yaa ne mam kangã pãnga, ne m yamã la m bãngrã, la m tõog n sãam neb wʋsg tẽms todse, n wʋk b arzegsã, la mam yɩɩ gãndaoog n sik rĩm-dãmb b naamẽ.
Mam nug paama neb wʋsg arzegse, wa gɛl sẽn be tʋkẽ, la mam wʋka dũniyã zãnga, wa b sẽn wʋkd gɛl bũmb sẽn zãndg n base. La ned ba a yembr ka pigimdid a pɩgsa, wall a yaag a noor n yeel tɩ bũmb ye.
Rẽ yĩnga, lar tõe n wuka a meng ne sẽn tar-a yẽnda n kɛɛdẽ wã la? Ra-wãad-sʋʋg tõe n zẽka a meng ne sẽn tar-a yẽnda n wãadẽ wã la? Yaa wa dasaar sẽn yuumd a zãada! Yaa wa guug sẽn zẽkd a zãada!
Rẽ kɩtame tɩ Zu-soabã sẽn yaa Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã na n kɩt tɩ Asiiri soolmã neb nins sẽn nobã faage. La yẽnda nin-kãsemsã sʋka, toog n na n widgi, n dɩt wa bugum sẽn dɩt to-to wã.
Israyɛll vẽenemã na n lebga bugum, tɩ yẽnda Pʋ-Peelem Soabã lebg bug-witim, n dɩ Asiiri gõosã ne a gõpayãndsã n sãam-b zãng daar a yembr pʋgẽ.
Bãmb na n sãama Israyɛll kãgrã ne a tɩɩs zĩigã sẽn yaa ziirã zãnga. Yẽnda na n lebga wa bãad pãng sẽn sɛ.
Yẽnda kãgrã tɩɩs nins sẽn na n kellã sõor na n yɩɩ bilfu, tɩ baa bi-bilf tõe n sõd-ba.»
Badaare, Israyɛll bu-kellã ne a Zakoob buudã neb nins sẽn põsã ka na n leb n teeg soab ning sẽn dag n pãbd-a bãmbã ye. Bãmb na n teega Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa Israyɛll Pʋ-Peelem-Soabã ne sɩda.
Bu-kell n na n lebg n wa Pãng-Soab a Wẽnnaam nengẽ: yaa a Zakoob buudã neb nins sẽn kellã.
Baa Israyɛll sẽn yaa fo nebã sã n yaa wʋsg wa ko-kãsengã noor bĩisrã, yaa neb bilf bal n na n kelle, n lebg n wa. B zoe n yãka yam tɩ sãoongã na n zĩndame. Yaa tɩrlem bal n na n pid n puugi.
Bala, sãoongã sẽn na n zĩndã yaa Zu-soab a Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã n yãk yam n na n kɩt t'a zĩnd tẽngã zãng fãa pʋga.

Bõn-kãng yĩnga, Zu-soab a Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã yetame yaa: «Mam nebã, yãmb dãmb sẽn be Sɩyõ, da-y zoe-y Asiiri nebã ye! Bãmb pãbda yãmb ne guugu, bãmb zẽkda b rasaar n pãbd yãmb wa Ezɩpt nebã sẽn dag n maan yãmbã.
La keta bilf bala, tɩ mam sũ-yikrã sɛ. Mam sũ-yikrã na n sãama bãmba.
Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã na n zẽka b kalwaas n pãb bãmb wa b sẽn dag n pãb Madiyã nebã Orɛɛb pĩigã kugr zĩigẽ wã. Sẽn-Ka-Saab zẽka b dasaarã ko-kãsengã zug wa b sẽn dag n zẽk-a Ezɩpt tẽngã.
Badaare, bãmb na n sika b zɩɩbã n bas f bãgdã, la b yiis b yubl balgrã n bas f yublã. Fo na n nobame hal tɩ f yubl balgrã kaooge.»
Asiiri nebã taa Ayat n pɩʋʋg Migron n tɩ bas b teedã Mikmaase.
Bãmb wẽdga kunkubã sʋk n yeel yaa: «Tõnd na n gãanda Geba!» Rama tẽng nebã rigda ne rabeem, tẽng ning b sẽn boond t'a Sayull Gibeya wã ninga tĩiga.
Bat-Galim tẽnga, kelme! Layiisa tẽnga, maan gũusgu! Anatot tẽnga, m yãbd-fo!
Madmena nebã zoet n kẽeda moogo, Gebim tẽng nebã baooda soondg zĩiga.
Badaar bala, Asiiri nebã tɩ yalsa Noob tẽnga, n zẽk b nug n na n zab ne Sɩyõ tẽn-neerã, n na n zab ne kunkubr ning Zeruzalɛm sẽn be a zugã.
Zu-soabã sẽn yaa Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã na n kaoo wilã ne pãng n lubi. B na n kɛɛ tɩɩs nins sẽn yaa lug-lugã, b na n luba sẽn lug-b n yɩɩdã tẽnga.
B na n kɛɛ kãgrã tɩɩs ne lar n lubi, la Libã tɩɩsã ne b ziirã na n lʋɩɩme.
La wil-poll n na n tão n yi a Izayi viukẽ wã, yẽnda yẽgã na n tãoo tɩ-tobengo.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab Sɩɩgã na n siga yẽnda zugu: yaa yam ne bãngr sɩɩga, la saglg ne raood sɩɩga, ne minim la Sẽn-Ka-Saab rabeem zoees sɩɩga.
Yẽnda na n zoee Sẽn-Ka-Saab rabeem ne sũ-noogo, yẽnda ka na n kao bʋʋdã wa sẽn zems yẽnda ninã sẽn ne wã ye. Yẽnda ka na n welg yɛlã wa sẽn zems yẽnda tʋb sẽn wʋm ye.
Yẽnda na n kaoo ka-pãens rãmbã bʋʋd ne zemsgo. A na n bʋʋ tẽngã nimbãan-nebã bʋʋd wa sẽn zemse. Yẽnda na n wẽe dũniyã ne a noorã dasaare, la a kʋ nin-wẽnsã ne a noorã pemsem.
Tɩrlem na n yɩɩ yẽnda sɛɛg sẽbdga, la maan-sɩd na n yɩɩ yẽnda kur-wĩiri.
Rigd-n-yĩidg ne peosg na n vɩɩmda ne taaba, ãbg na n naaga bull n gãande, nag-bil ne gɩgem-polle, la rũm-nobds na n zĩnda ne taaba, la bi-bilf n na n yɩ bãmb pe-kɩɩma.
Rigd-n-yĩidg ne nag-yãang na n wãba yamd ne taaba, la b kambã na n naaga taab n gãande. Gɩgemd na n wãba yamd wa naafo.
Biig sẽn ket n yẽsemdẽ na n deema ruruug bok noore, la bi-sigdg na n tʋma a nug põeer bokẽ.
Mam tãn-sõngã fãa zugu, bãmb ka na n maan to bũmb ye, sãoong buud kõn tol n leb n zĩnd ye. Bala, dũniyã gill na n pida ne Sẽn-Ka-Saab bãngre, wa ko-kãsengã sẽn pidã.
Badaare, a Izayi yẽgrã na n tilga wa tãb-kaoor nebã yĩnga. Bu-zẽmsã na n baoo yẽnda, la yẽnda vʋʋsg zĩigã na n talla ziiri.

Badaare, Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n leb n tẽega b nug n fãag b buud ning sẽn kellã, yaa neb nins sẽn pa Asiiri ne Ezɩptã, la sẽn pa-b Patroos ne Kuusã, la Elam ne Sineyaar la Hamatã, ne tẽms nins koom sẽn gũbg tɩ b be ko-kãsengã sʋkã.
B na n zẽka tãb-kaoor buud toay-toayã yĩnga, la b kɩt tɩ Israyɛll neb nins b sẽn dag n digã tigme, b na n leb n deega Zʋʋda neb nins sẽn sãeeg n be dũniyã ween-vɩɩs a naasã.
Efrayiim nebã sũ-kiirã na n sɛɛme, la b na n menesa Zʋʋda bɛɛbã. Efrayiim nebã ka na n leb n maan sũ-kiir ne Zʋʋda nebã ye. La Zʋʋda nebã ka na n leb n zab ne Efrayiim nebã ye.
Bãmb na n naaga taab n zab ne Filistẽ-dãmbã sẽn be nin-taoorã, la b naag taab n zɛ neb nins sẽn be yaangã. Bãmb na n sooga Edom ne Moaab nebã, la Amo-rãmbã na n saka bãmba.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n kʋɩɩsa Ezɩpt ko-kãsengã. Bãmb na n tẽega b nug Efrat kʋɩlgã zugu, n fʋʋs-a ne pãng n kɩt t'a welg ko-soay a yopoe, tɩ b tõe n pid neooda n pɩʋʋg-a.
B na n tuka sor bãmb neb nins sẽn ketã yĩnga, yaa bãmb neb nins sẽn pa Asiiri wã yĩnga. Wa b sẽn dag n tuk sor Israyɛll nebã yĩnga, daar ning bãmb sẽn yi Ezɩpt tẽngã.
Badaare, fo na n yeelame yaa: «Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, mam pʋʋsda yãmb barka. Bala, yãmb sũur dag n yika ne maam, la yãmb sũurã leb n sigame, yãmb belsa maam.
Gese, Wẽnnaam yaa mam fãagda, mam maanda tẽebo, la m kõn zoe rabeem ye. Bala, Sẽn-Ka-Saab yaa mam pãnga, la b yaa mam pãn-kãsenga. Bãmb yaa mam fãagda.»
Yãmb na n kẽnga fãagr bulgẽ wã n tɩ toog koom ne sũ-noogo.
Badaare, yãmb na n yeelame yaa: «Pʋʋs-y Sẽn-Ka-Saab barka, bool-y bãmb yʋʋrã, n moon bãmb tʋʋm-kãsemsã nebã sʋka. La y tẽeg tɩ bãmb yʋʋrã yaa kãsenga.
Yɩɩl-y n pẽg-y Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, bala, bãmb maana tʋʋm-neeba. Bɩ y kɩt tɩ dũniyã gill fãa bãng tʋʋm-bãmba.
Sɩyõ tẽng nebã, kaas-y sũ-noog ne kɩdeng kaasgo! Bala, Israyɛll Pʋ-Peelem-Soabã sẽn be yãmb sʋkã yaa kãsenga!»
Woto yaa Sɩbgr koɛɛg Babilond tẽngã yĩnga. Yaa koɛɛg a Amots biig a Ezayi sẽn deege.
Tilg-y tãb-kaoor tãn-beellã zugu, la y zẽk y koɛɛg tɩ b wʋme, n zẽk y nug n kams-b tɩ b wa tũ nin-kãsemsã rignoyẽ n kẽ.
Mam kõo neb nins sẽn welg toor mam yĩngã noore, mam leb n boola sũ-yikrã gãndaadã me, sẽn maand-b sũ-noog mam tõogrã yĩngã.
Bʋrg n yit tãmsã zutu, la yaa wa neb kʋʋng bʋrgo! Yaa buud toay-toayã sẽn tigim taabã bʋʋre! Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã n tigimd b tãb-biisã zabr yĩnga.
Tãb-biisã yita tẽms sẽn be zĩ-zãrsẽ, b yita saasã kɩremsã fãa n watẽ, yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab n wat ne b sũ-puugr zab-teedã n na n sãam tẽngã zãnga.
Yãb-y n wiis-yã, bala, Sẽn-Ka-Saab daarã kolgame. Ra-kãng wata wa sãoong sẽn yit Sẽn-Tõe-Fãa wã nengẽ.
Rẽ kɩtame tɩ nebã fãa gĩin maage, tɩ ned kam fãa raood sɛ.
Rabeem-kãseng na n yõka bãmba, toog la namsg na n paama bãmba, la bãmb na n wẽndgda wa pag sẽn kũmd dogem. Bãmb na n yɛɛsame n ges taaba, bãmb nemsã midgame.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab daarã watame, yaa to-kãseng daare, la sũ-kãbr ne sũ-yik-kãseng daare. Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n kɩtame tɩ tẽngã lebg zĩ-vɩʋʋgo, la a menes yel-wẽn-maandbã.
Bala, ãdsã sẽn be yĩngrã ne b sulã kõn leb n kõ b vẽenem yɛs ye. La wĩntoogã pukr wakate, a na n sobgame, la kiuugã vẽenem kõn leb n tãoos ye.
Mam na n sɩbga ninsaalbã, wẽng ning b sẽn maanã yĩnga, la m sɩbg nin-wẽnsã b kongrã yĩnga. Mam na n kɩtame tɩ tɩtaam dãmbã wuk-m-mengã sɛ, Mam na n sika nin-toosã b zẽk-m-mengã pʋga.
Mam na n kɩtame tɩ sãnem halaal yãab sẽn yaa toog to-to wã, bɩ ninsaal yãab toolem yɩɩg rẽnda. Mam na n kɩtame tɩ ninsaal yãab lebg toog wa Ofɩɩr tẽng sãnem.
Rẽ n kɩte, tɩ mam na n miim saasã, la tẽn-gãongã yẽbgr na n digimdame, Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã sũ-kãbrã yĩnga, la b sũ-yik-kãsengã daar yĩnga.
Dẽ, b sẽn lingd walg t'a yɛɛs n zoet to-to wã, la wa piis sẽn ka tar ned sẽn na n tigim-bã, ned kam fãa na n lebg n kuila a nebẽ, ned kam fãa na n zoe n leba a tẽngẽ.
Bãmb sẽn na n paam neb nins fãa, b na n kõs-b lame n kʋ, la b na n kʋʋ neb nins b sẽn yõgã ne zabr sʋʋga.
B na n kʋʋ bãmb kambã n dʋʋg b nifẽ, b na n zɛ b rotã teedo, la b gãand bãmb pagbã ne pãnga.
Mam na n kɩtame tɩ Meed-rãmbã tɩ zab ne bãmba. Meed-rãmb ka baood wanzuri, la b toor ka ne sãnem me ye.
Bãmb na n tãoo kom-bɩɩsã ne b tãbdã n kʋ, la b ka na n zoe kamb sẽn nan yi b ma pʋgẽ nimbãaneg ye. Bãmb ka na n maan nimbãan-zoeer ne kom-dibli ye.

Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n kɩtame tɩ Babilond sẽn yaa tẽn-neer n yɩɩd tẽmsã a taabã lebg a woto. Tẽn-kãng sẽn tar ziirã yĩnga a yaa Kalde rãmbã waoog-m-meng tẽnga. A na n lebga wa Wẽnnaam sẽn dag n sãam Sodom ne Gomoor tẽmsã.
Ned kõn tol n leb n tilg a yir Babilond tẽngã, la neb kõn leb n zĩnd a pʋgẽ zamaan woo zamaan ye. Araab-rãmbã kõn leb n tilg b fu-roog beenẽ, la pe-kɩɩmbã me kõn leb n gãneg b rũms beenẽ ye.
Beenẽ na n lebga we-rũms gãag zĩiga. Yẽnda ro-vɩɩdã na n pida ne vitu, la naneoond na n gãee beenẽ, tɩ boees yɩgd n tirsd beenẽ.
Kata na n yãba tẽngã na-yiyã pʋse, la we-baas na n yãba a tẽngã ro-neebã pʋse. Babilond sãoongã daar kolgdame, la a rasmã ka na n kaoos ye.
Bala, Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n zoe a Zakoob yagensã nimbãanega, bãmb na n leb n yãka Israyɛll n kõ-b vʋʋsg b tẽngẽ wã. Sãamb n na n naag bãmb tɩ b tɩ lagem a Zakoob roogã nebã.

Bu-zẽms n na n deeg Israyɛll nebã n tall-b n tɩ kẽes b tẽngẽ wã, la Israyɛll nebã na n sooga bãmb beenẽ Sẽn-Ka-Saab tẽn-gãongã zugu, n kɩt tɩ b yɩ yem-daado, la yem-pogse. Neb nins sẽn dag n kẽes Israyɛll nebã yembdã, Israyɛll na n kẽes-b-la yembdo, Israyɛll nebã na n sooga neb nins sẽn dag n namsd bãmbã.
Dẽ, daar ning Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn na n kõ yãmb vʋʋsg y namsgã ne y toogã, la y yembdã b sẽn dag n namsd yãmbã loogr poore,
pʋd-y yɩɩll Babilond dĩmã wɛɛngẽ n yeel yaa: «Maana a wãna? Dĩm-toaagã menemame! Wuk-m-meng soabã ka leb n beẽ ye!
Sẽn-Ka-Saab kaooga nin-wẽnsã rasaare, b kaooga nanambsã naam dasaarã.
B menesa sẽn dag n pãbd-a nebã ne sũ-kãbr n ka basdẽ wã. B menesa sẽn dag n so-a buud a taabã ne sũ-yikr tɩ vʋʋsg ka beẽ wã.
Tẽngã zãng paama vʋʋsg la vɩ-bãane. Nebã kaasda ne sũ-noogo.»
Sɩprɛs tɩɩsã ne sɛɛdr tɩɩsã la Libã tɩɩsã maanda sũ-noog yẽnda wɛɛngẽ n yetẽ: «Fo sẽn lʋɩ wã tɛka, tɩ-kɛɛdbã ka leb n wat n kɛɛd tõnd ye.»
Kɩɩm-kulg sẽn be tẽngrã rigimdame n na n deeg foom f waoongã daare. Fo yĩng kɩtame tɩ b nek sẽn ki-bã, b neka dũniyã nin-kãsemsã, la b kɩt tɩ bu-zẽmsã rĩm-dãmb fãa yik b naam gɛyã zutu.
Bãmb fãa goma ne foom n yeel yaa: «Fo me pãngã sɛɛ wa tõndo, fo me lebga wa tõnd bala!»
B sika foom ne f wuk-m-mengã, la f ruudsã wãagr kɩɩm-kulgu. Lebga zũnzũy n be fo gãagẽ wã, zũnzũy wã n lebg fo fu-goabga.
Kayto! Ãdg sẽn yãgda, tõd-beoog ãdga, fo yii saasẽ n lʋɩ tẽnga! Fo sẽn dag n kɩt tɩ buud a taabã sakd foomã, b luba foom!
Fo rag n yetame: «Mam na n dʋʋ n taa saasẽ, mam na n zẽka m naamã geer n zʋʋg Wẽnnaam ãdsã, Mam na n zaoonda sɛk tãngã zugu, tãng ning sẽn be rɩtg hal zĩ-zãrgẽ wã.
Mam na n dʋʋ yĩngr hal sawatẽ, mam na n yɩɩ wa Sẽn-Ka-To.»
La b sika foom kɩɩm-kulgu, b sika foom bog-zulungã pʋga.
Neb nins sẽn na n yãnd foom na n yonga b nin n get foom. B na n maaga b meng n ges foom n yeele: «Rẽ yĩnga, ka rao-kãngã n dag n kɩtd tɩ dũniyã miimdẽ, la a kɩtdẽ tɩ soolem-dãmbã rigd ne rabeemã la?
Ka yẽnda n dag n kɩtd tɩ dũniyã lebgd we-raoogo, la a wãad a tẽmsã n ka basd yembsã tɩ b loogã wɛɛ?»
N-yẽe, buud toay-toayã rĩm-dãmb fãa gãanda b yaadẽ ne ziiri, bãmb ned kam fãa kẽ a roogẽ.
La foom yẽ, b loba foom yɩng n zãag f yaoogã, wa b sẽn lob tɩɩg wil-yooko, wa neb b sẽn kʋ ne zabr sʋʋg n wʋk n tɩ lob bog-zulungã kug zutu, wa kũum b sẽn tabe.
B ka na n mum foom n naag bãmb yaoogã pʋgẽ ye. Bala, fo sãama f tẽngã, fo kʋ f nebã. B kõn tol n leb n pʋd nin-wẽnsã yʋʋr ye.
Segl-y kom-dibli wã kʋʋbo, b ba-rãmbã kongr yĩnga! Tɩ b ra tol n yik n deeg tẽngã n yãmbe, n pids dũniyã gill ne sãoong ye.
Maam a Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã yetame: «Mam na n yik n zaba ne bãmba, mam na n menesa Babilond yʋʋrã, ne a nebã sẽn kellã ne a kambã la a yagensã. Maam a Sẽn-Ka-Saab n yeele.
Mam na n kɩtame t'a lebg yʋgempɛl zĩiga la bãoogo, mam na n pɩɩs-a-la ne sãoong saaga. Maam a Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã n yeele.»
Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã wẽename n yeele: Mam sẽn yãk yam n na maan bũmb ningã ka na n vaal ye, mam sẽn saagd n dat n maanã na n pidsame.
Mam na n wãa Asiiri m tẽngẽ wã, mam na n tab-a-la m tãmsã zutu. B na n yiisa a yubl balgrã, la b sik a zɩɩbã sẽn be mam nebã bãgdẽ wã.
Woto yaa saagr ning mam sẽn saagd n na n maan dũniyã gillã, yaa nug sẽn n na n zab ne soolem dãmbã fãa wã la woto.
Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã n maan saag-kãnga. Ãnda n tõe n gɩdg-a t'a ka pidsi? Bãmb nugã zẽkame. Ãnda n na n kok-a t'a ka wẽ?
B togsa sɩbgr koe-kãngã rĩm a Akaaz kũumã yʋʋmd n yeele:
Filistẽ-dãmbã fãa, da-y maan-y sũ-noogo, dasaar ning b sẽn dag n tar n pãbd yãmbã sẽn kao wã yĩng ye! Bala, waafã yagensẽ wã, põeer n na n yi beenẽ, la a biigã na n yɩɩ wag-bɛɛg sẽn yɩgda.
Dẽ, sẽn ya-b nimbãan-neb n yɩɩd fãa wã na n paam n dɩ n tɩgame, naong rãmbã na n gãee ne bãane. Mam na n kɩtame tɩ fo yagensã ki kom, ne fo neb nins sẽn na n kellã.
Rig-noore, kelme! Tẽnga, yãb n wiisi! Filistẽ-dãmbã fãa, rig-y-yã! Bala, bug-zõos n yɩt n watẽ, la ned kõn serg n bas a zĩig ye.
B na n leoka bu-kãngã koe-toagsdbã tɩ bõe? B leok tɩ yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab n yẽbg Sɩyõ, tɩ bãmb nebã nimbãan-nebã na n paama zĩ-soalgdg beenẽ.
Sɩbgr koɛɛg Moaab tẽngã yĩnga. B sãam-a-la yʋn-yɛng bala! Aar-Moaab lebga sɩddd... B sãam-a-la yʋn-yɛng bala! Kɩɩr-Moaab lebga sɩddd...
B rabda pʋʋsg roogẽ wã ne Dibõ, la b kẽnd maoong kʋʋb zĩisẽ wã n na n tɩ yãbe. Moaab yãbd n wiisda Nebo tẽngã, ne Medba tẽngã yĩnga. Zutã fãa põngame, la toeemsã fãa wõrsame.
Moaab tẽngã soayã zutu, nebã yeelga bot n kẽnda. La tẽngã bɛɛnd zut ne raasã pʋse, ned kam fãa yãbda nintãm n wiisd wʋsgo.
Hɛsbon ne Eleyall nebã kaasdame, la b wʋmda b koees hal Yahats tẽnga. Rẽ kɩtame tɩ Moaab tãb-biisã kelemdẽ, Moaab pɛlengã yɩkame.

Mam kelemda Moaab yĩnga. Neb n zoe n ta hal Soaar tẽnga, b taa hal Eglat-Selisiya tẽnga. Bala, bãmb bee Luyit tãngã rʋʋdg zugu, n kẽnd la b yãbda. Bãmb bee Horonayim tẽngã sor zug n kẽnd la b wiisd sãoongã yĩnga.
Bala, Nimrim kʋɩlgã koom kʋɩɩme, tɩɩsã kʋɩɩme, mo-maasã kʋɩɩme, la yam-maas ka tol n leb n beẽ ye.
Woto yĩng n kɩte, tɩ b wʋkd b paoongã sẽn ketã, b sẽn dag n tõog n bĩng laog ninsã n na n tall n kẽng Solɛɛs ko-soogã rʋʋndã.
Bala, kelemsã pida Moaab soolmã gilli. Yẽnda kelemsã zẽk n tata hal Eglayiim tẽnga, a kelemsã zẽkame n tat Beer-Elim tẽnga.
Dimon kʋɩlsã koom mooga ne zɩɩm. Mam na n kɩtame tɩ tood a taab leb n paam Dimonde. Mam na n tʋma gɩgemd t'a zab ne Moaab neb nins sẽn põsã, la a zab ne neb nins sẽn kell tẽngã pʋgã.
Tʋm-y neb tɩ b tall pe-ribl n tɩ kõ tẽngã soaalã. Tʋm-y bãmb tɩ b yi Sela n pɩʋʋg we-raoogã, n kẽng Sɩyõ tẽn-neerã tãngẽ wã.
Moaab kom-pugli wã na n tigma taab Arno kʋɩlgã zĩ-rʋʋgdgẽ wã, wa liuul sẽn yɩk n baood a menga, la wa liuun-bi sẽn sãeeg n bas b tʋko.
Moaab kom-pugli wã yetame: «Maan-y tigingu, yãk-y yam, yɛdg-y y maasmã wĩnto-sʋka, n lud b sẽn digd b rãmbã wa yʋngo, la y ra luk zoɛtbã bãong ye.

Bas-y Moaab nebã sẽn zoetã tɩ b wa zĩnd yãmb sʋka, sak-y n yɩ-y zĩ-soalgdg bãmb yĩnga, tɩ sẽn sãamd-a fãa wã ra wa paam-b ye! Bala, sẽn maand-a neb a taab pãngã sɛɛb wakat taame, sãoongã sɛɛme, sẽn wõrd-a neb a taabã menema tẽngã pʋgẽ.
Maan-sɩdã na n kɩtame tɩ naam geerã paam pãnga. La sẽn na n zaoond-a beenẽ wã na n yɩ a Davɩɩd yageng sẽn yaa sɩd soaba. Yẽnda na n yɩɩ bʋ-kaood sẽn baood zemsgo, la sẽn kaood bʋʋd ne tɩrlem.»
Tõnd wʋma Moaab nebã wuk-m-mengã kibare. Bãmb wuk-m-mengã yaa n looga nugu. Tõnd wʋma bãmb sek-m-mengã ne b wuk-m-mengã, la b tɩtaamã ne b pẽg-m-mengã sẽn ka yõodã.
Rẽ n kɩt tɩ Moaab nebã wiisd b mensã yĩnga, bãmb ned kam fãa wiisdame. Yãmb sidgda Kɩɩr-Haresɛt sẽn lebg raboodã yĩnga, n maand sũ-sãan-kãsenga.

Bala, Hɛsbon tẽngã bõn-koaadl kiidame. Buud toay-toayã taoor dãmb kɛɛ Sibma tẽng reezẽ tɩ-sõamyã. Reezẽ tɩɩgã rag n tẽeme n tãag Yazɛɛre, n tud n kẽ we-raoogã. A wilã tẽeme n gãndg yamsem kʋɩl-kãsengã.
Woto kɩtame tɩ mam na n yãb Sibma reezẽ tɩɩgã, wa Yazɛɛr sẽn yãbd-a wã. Hɛsbon ne Eleyale, mam na n madga yãmb ne m nintãm, bala, yãmb bõn-koaadlã rɩkr ne reezẽ tɩɩsã wobr wakat kelemsã sɛɛme.
Sũ-noogã ne kɩdengã sɛɛ pʋtẽ wã. Sũ-noog kaasg ne kilsg ka leb n be reezẽ tɩɩs pʋtẽ wã ye! Reezẽ-woabdb ka leb n wẽkd reezẽ rãam sĩmsẽ ye. Mam kɩtame tɩ sũ-noog kaasg sɛ.
Rẽ kɩtame tɩ mam sũurã sidgd Moaab yĩng wa pɛndg n zãeede. Mam sidgda Kɩɩr-Harɛɛs yĩnga.
Moaab leb n kẽnga maoong kʋʋb zĩisẽ wã. A kẽnga a zĩ-sõngẽ wã la a ka tõe n paam bũmb ye.
Ad koɛɛg ning Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn togs hal kʋdem-wẽndẽ Moaab wɛɛngẽ wã.

La moasã Sẽn-Ka-Saab yetame: «Yʋʋm a tãab sẽn wate, wa sẽn zems yʋʋm sõor ning tʋmtʋmd sẽn tʋmd yaood yĩngã, Moaab ziirã na n lebga paoogre. Baa yẽnda neb kʋʋngã sẽn yaa to-to wã, neb nins sẽn kellã na n yɩɩ bilf bala, la b ka na n zeng bũmb ye.»
Sɩbgr koɛɛg Damaas yĩnga. Damaas ka na n leb n yɩ tẽng ye, a na n lebga tom-dʋre.
B na n basa Arowɛɛr tẽmsã wakat fãa yĩnga, Tẽn-bãmb na n lebga rũms zĩiga, tɩ b gãe beenẽ tɩ ned ka maan bãmb bũmb ye.
B na n sãama Efrayiim pãng zĩigã, ne Damaas soolmã, la Siiri neb nins sẽn ketã baoosg na n yɩɩ wa Israyɛll nebã ziir sẽn loogã. Maam a Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã n yeele.
Badaare, a Zakoob yagensã ziir na n woogame, la b sẽn nobã, b na n faagame.
Yẽnda na n yɩɩ wa b sẽn tigsd bõn-koaadl zĩ-yɛnga, la wa bõn-koaadl tigsd nug sẽn tigsd ka-zutu. Na n yɩɩ wa b sẽn yiisd bɩle Refayit longẽ wã.

Biis bilf nins sẽn ket a pʋgẽ wã na n zemsa wa b sẽn pãb oliiv tɩɩg will ne raado, tɩ biis a yiib bɩ a tãab kell a wil-gelengeesẽ wã, la wa a biis a naas wall a nu sẽn be tɩɩg zugu. Maam a Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa Israyɛll Wẽnnaamã n yeele.
Badaare, ninsaalbã na n nak n gesa b naandã, bãmb na n wẽnemda b nens n ges Israyɛll Pʋ-Peelem Soabã.
Bãmb kõn leb n ges tẽn-kugã sẽn yaa bãmb nus tʋʋmã, wall b ges Aseera ra-lugdsã ne wisd yõogr zĩisã bãmb mens nus sẽn maanã ye.

Badaare, b na n basa Israyɛll tẽms nins sẽn gũbg ne lalsã wa Israyɛll nebã sẽn dag n dig buud nins sẽn dag n vɩ tɩɩsã tẽngrã, la tãmsã zutã tɩ b zoe n bas b tẽmsã wakat sẽn loogã. La tẽn-bãmb fãa na n lebga zĩ-vɩʋʋdo.
