Bala, fo yĩma Wẽnnaam ning sẽn fãag-a foomã yelle, la fo ka tẽeg pĩig ning sẽn yaa fo pãngã yell ye. Woto n kɩte, tɩ fo send tɩɩs sẽn yaa neeba, fo sela bu-zẽms tɩɩse.
La daar ning meng fo sẽn sel-bã, fo yãndame tɩ b tobame. Vẽkembeoog yibeoogo, fo sẽn bʋd bũmb ningã ninga puudu. Ka-keemã daare, tigsg ka leb n beẽ n ye. La ka-keemã ka tar tɩɩm ye.
Toogo! Neb kʋʋng bʋrg n sãt wa ko-kãsengã sẽn guglumdã. Neb kʋʋng kelems n sãt wa ko-kãsems sẽn tar pãng bʋrgo.
Yaa neb kʋʋng bʋrg sẽn wẽnd ko-kãseng bʋrgo. La Sẽn-Ka-Saab lengd-b lame tɩ b zoet n zãagd yɩɩga. B rigda bãmb wa tãng zug seb-kãseng sẽn dɩkd ka-fɩɩba, la wa sɩlmand sẽn dɩkd wudgu.
Zaabr sã n ta b kẽesda rabeem, la sẽn deng beoogã vẽegre, b ka leb n beẽ ye! Neb nins sẽn fãad tõndã pʋɩɩr la woto. Neb nins sẽn zɛɛd tõnd teedã pʋɩɩr n yaa a woto.
Toog bee tẽng ning sẽn be Kuus kʋɩlgã rʋʋnd tɩ b wʋmd bõn-yɩgdɩ wã pɩgs rãamdã zugu!

Fo sẽn tʋmd neb tɩ b kẽnd ne koom kogend sẽn maan ne tãnwĩis n pɩʋʋgd ko-kãsengã! Koe-toagsdb sẽn tʋʋle, kẽng-y buud nins neb sẽn yaa nin-wogd n tar da-sãndã nengẽ, kẽng-y neb nins b sẽn yɛɛsd hal b sɩngr wakatã nengẽ, bãmb yaa buud sẽn tar pãng n tõe n sãam fãa, la b tẽngã pɩʋʋma ne kʋɩlse.
Yãmb fãa sẽn be dũni zugu, yãmb dãmb sẽn be tẽng zugu, b sã n wa tilg tãb-kaoorã tãngã zugu, yãmb na n yãame. La b sã n wa peeb baorgã, yãmb na n wʋmame.
Bala, ade, Sẽn-Ka-Saab yeela maam yaa: «Mam bee m sẽn beẽ wã ne bãan n getẽ, mam yasa kɛpɩ wa wĩntoog sẽn tãoosd a vẽenemã, la wa sawaodg sẽn sikd meenem tigsg wakatã.
Dẽ, sẽn deng bõn-koaadl tigsgu, reezẽ tɩɩsã sã n wa ning puud n sɛ, puudã sã n lebg biis n mooge, b na n yosa reezẽ tɩɩsã wil-poalã ne goeto, la b yãgs-ba, n yolem tobendã.
B na n basa b fãa n kõ tãms zut yɩbrendo, ne we-rũms sẽn be tẽng zugu. Sẽoogo, beenẽ na n yɩɩ yɩbrend zĩiga, la waood wẽnde, we-rũmsã fãa na n wa zĩnda be.»

Wakat-kãnga, buud neb sẽn yaa nin-wogd n tar da-sãnde, neb b sẽn yɛɛsd hal b sɩngr wakate, buud sẽn tar pãng n tõe n sãam fãa, tɩ b tẽngã pɩʋʋm ne kʋɩlsã, na n waa ne kũun n wa kõ Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã. B na n talla kũun-kãens n kẽng zĩig ning Saasẽ-Pãng-Soaba yʋʋrã sẽn beẽ wã, Sɩyõ tãngã zugu.
Sɩbgr koɛɛg Ezɩpt nebã yĩnga. Sẽn-Ka-Saab zomba sawaodg kẽnd sẽn tʋʋle, la b wata Ezɩpte. Ezɩpt tẽng wẽn-naandsã rigda ne rabeem bãmb taoore, la Ezɩpt nebã pɛleng yɩgdame.
Mam na n kɩtame tɩ Ezɩpt nebã zab taaba, ned ne a ba-biig na n zaba taaba, la ned ne a zoa na n zaba taaba, tẽng na n yika zabr ne a to, la soolem na n zaba ne soolem a to.
Ezɩpt tẽng nebã yam na n menemame, mam na n zũndga bãmb saagrã. Bãmb na n tɩ soka wẽn-naandse, la b sok kɩɩmse, b na n kẽnda kinkir-bagb ne bag-bʋgdb nengẽ.
Mam na n kɩtame tɩ zu-soben-toos soog Ezɩpte, la rĩm sẽn yaa nen-keglem soab n na n soog bãmba. Maam a Zu-soabã sẽn yaa Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã n yeele.
Ko-kãsengã koom na n kʋɩɩme, kʋɩlgã koom na n sɛɛme n lebg koɛɛnga.
Ko-soayã koom na n põogame, Ezɩpt tẽng Nill kʋɩlgã ko-soayã koom na n yõbgame n kʋɩ, la tãnwĩisã ne rudmã na n zelgame.
Nill kʋɩlgã noorã ne a sɛtmẽ wã na n lebga vɩʋʋgo! B sẽn na n bʋd bũmb ning fãa Nill kʋɩlgã koom noor na n kʋɩɩme. Sebg n na n kãag-a n loog t'a meneme.
Zĩm-yõagdbã na n yãbame n wiisi, neb nins fãa sẽn lobd zĩm-leoos Nill kʋɩlgẽ wã fãa na n yãbame. Sẽn lobd-b zĩm-gãmba koomã pʋgẽ wã sũy na n sãamame.
Neb nins sẽn tʋmd ne lẽ gĩsã na n paama yãnde, sẽn gursd-b lamdã ne sʋn-wʋgdbã gĩin na n maagame.
Tẽngã sʋn-wʋgdbã na n paama sũ-sãanga. Tʋmtʋmdb nins fãa sẽn tʋmd n deegd yaoodã sũy na n sãamame.

Sowan tẽng nanambsã tolg n yaa yalemba, Yam dãmb nins sẽn sagend Faarõ wã yaa nin-yaals sulli. Maana a wãn tɩ yãmb saag n na n yeel Faarõ a woto: «Mam yaa sẽn tar-b yamã biiga, n yaa kʋdem-wẽndẽ rĩm-dãmbã yagenga!
Ezɩpt rĩma, fo yam dãmbã bee yɛɛnẽ? Kɩt tɩ bãmb wilg-f bũmbã fãa, la b wilg saagr ning Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã sẽn dat n maan Ezɩptã!
Sowan tẽng nanambsã ka tar yam ye. Noof tẽng nanambsã belgda b mense. Yẽnda buudã taoor dãmbã kẽesda Ezɩpt nebã moogo.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab kɩtame tɩ nen-yiling yõk Ezɩpt nebã, n na n kɩt tɩ Ezɩpt ka leb n mi a sẽn maand ye. A wẽnda wa rã-yũud sẽn lengd la a wʋbdẽ.
La Ezɩpt ka na n tõog n maan bũmb ning zugã ne zʋʋrã sẽn maandã, ne koang tɩɩgã will ne tãnwĩigã sẽn maandã ye.»
Badaare, Ezɩpt nebã sã n yãnd Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã sẽn zẽk b nugã n na n zab ne bãmbã, bãmb na n diga ne rabeem wa pagba.
Zʋʋda tẽngã na n kẽesa Ezɩpt tẽngã rabeem. Wakat ning fãa b sẽn na n tẽeg Zʋʋda tẽngã yell bãmb taoore, bãmb na n diga ne rabeem, saagr ning Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã sẽn saagd n dat n sɩbg Ezɩpt tẽngã yĩnga.

Badaare, tẽms a nu n na n zĩnd Ezɩpt soolmã pʋg n gomd Kana-rãmbã buud goamã, la b na n wẽena ne Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã yʋʋre. Tẽn-bãmb tẽng a yembr yʋʋr na n boondame tɩ Ɩɩr-Herɛɛse, sẽn dat n togs tɩ ‹sãoong tẽnga.›
Badaare, tẽn-kugr n na n zĩnd Ezɩpt soolmã tẽn-sʋka, Sẽn-Ka-Saab yĩnga, la kug-vigindg n na n zĩnd soolmã toadgẽ Sẽn-Ka-Saab yĩnga.

Bõn-kãng na n yɩɩ Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã bãnde, la b kaset Ezɩpt soolmã pʋga. Wakat ning bãmb namsdbã sẽn namsd bãmbã, b sã n kelem n bool Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, b na n tʋma fãagd t'a wa bãmb nengẽ n wa zab n fãag-ba.

Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n kɩtame tɩ Ezɩpt nebã bãng bãmba. Ezɩpt nebã na n bãnga Sẽn-Ka-Saab badaare. Bãmb na n pʋʋsa Sẽn-Ka-Saab n maan maando, la b kõ bãmb kũuni, n maan pʋleng ne Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, la b na n pidsa b pʋlengã.
Dẽ, Sẽn-Ka-Saab sã n sɩbg Ezɩpt nebã, bãmb n na n leb n maag-ba. Ezɩpt nebã na n lebg n waa Sẽn-Ka-Saab nengẽ, la Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n sak n deega b kosgã n maag-ba.
Badaare, sor na n yi Ezɩpt n dabd Asiiri. Asiiri nebã na n kẽnda Ezɩpt tẽnga, la Ezɩpt nebã na n kẽnda Asiiri, la Ezɩpt nebã ne Asiiri nebã na n naaga taab n pʋʋsd Sẽn-Ka-Saabo.
Badaare, Israyɛll na n yɩɩ tãabẽ soab n naag Ezɩpt ne Asiiri n paam bark dũniyã zugu.
Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã na n ninga bãmb bark n yeele: «Bark bee Ezɩpt sẽn yaa mam nebã zugu, bark bee Asiiri sẽn yaa mam nug tʋʋmdã zugu, la bark bee Israyɛll sẽn yaa mam meng rẽndã zugu.»
Yʋʋmd ning Asiiri naab a Sargon sẽn tʋm a tãb-biis nanambs naab ningã sẽn ta Asdood tẽngã, a zaba ne Asdood tẽngã n deeg-a.

Wakat-kãnga, Sẽn-Ka-Saab rag n goma ne a Amots biig a Ezayi n yeel-a yaa: «Kẽnge! Sẽk botã sẽn be fo sɛɛgẽ wã, la f piid f neooda wã n bas nao-zaala.» Dẽ, a Ezayi maana a woto. Yẽnda kẽna beelle, la nao-zaala.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yeelame: «Mam tʋmtʋmd a Ezayi sẽn kẽn beelle, la a kẽn nao-zaal to-to wã, na n yɩɩ bãnde la makr Ezɩpt ne Kuus yĩnga, yʋʋm a tãab tõre.

Woto me, Asiiri rĩma na n yõga Ezɩpt nebã ne Kuus tẽng nebã n tall-b n tɩ kẽes yembdo. B na n yõga b kom-bɩɩsã ne b nin-kẽembã n kɩt tɩ b kẽn bɛɛla, la nao-zaala, tɩ b kɩgbã be yɩnga. Rẽ na n yɩɩ yãnd Ezɩpt nebã yĩnga.
Dẽ, rabeem ne yãnd na n yõka neb nins sẽn dag n teeg Kuusã, la Ezɩpt sẽn dag n yaa bãmb zu-zẽkrã.»

Badaare, soolem ning sẽn be koom noorã neb na n yeelame: «Ges-y bũmb ning sẽn paam tõnd sẽn dag n teeg-b rãmbã, tõnd sẽn dag n kẽngd-b rãmb nengẽ tɩ b sõngd tõnd la b fãagd tõnd Asiiri rĩmã nugẽ wã. Moasã, tõnd na n maana a wãn n põse?»
Sɩbgr koɛɛg we-raoog ning sẽn be ko-kãseng noorã yĩnga. Sãamdã yii tẽng sẽn kẽesd rabeem pʋgẽ n tũud we-raoogã n wat wa sob-kãseng sẽn pɩʋʋgd Negɛɛve.
Ad vẽnegr sẽn yaa wẽng mam sẽn paame: Zãmb soabã zãmbdame, la sãamdã sãamdame. Elam soolem nebã, yik-y n zãb-y-yã! Gũbg-y Medi! Mam na n kɩtame tɩ sidgrã fãa sɛ.
Rẽ kɩtame tɩ mam põaagã bondge, toog tara maam, toog tara maam wa pag sẽn dat n doge. Bõn-kãng sãama mam sũur tɩ m ka leb n wʋmdẽ ye. Toogã kɩtame tɩ mam ninã ka leb n neẽ ye.
Mam yamã menemame, mam pɛlengã yɩkame tɩ rabeem kẽ maam. Mam sẽn dag n nong zĩ-sobdã, zĩ-sobd lebga rabeem ne maam.
B waa ne rɩɩbo, gũudbã gũudame, lebga rɩɩbo, la yũubu. Nanambse, yik-y-yã! Sõog-y gãndã kaam!
Bala, Zu-soabã goma ne maam n yeel yaa: «Kẽng n tɩ kɩt tɩ tẽn-gũudã yals a zĩigẽ, n togs a sẽn ne bũmb ningã.
Yẽnda na n yãnda saar-dãmb sẽn sog wiid sẽn yegl taab yiib-yiib n watẽ, ne bõens sẽn tong taaba, la yʋgmã sẽn tong taaba, bɩ a maan gũusgu, a gũus neere.»
Dẽ, tẽn-gũudã kelma wa gɩgemd n yeel yaa: «Zu-soaba, mam bee gãosgã zug daarã tõr wakat fãa, la mam yasa m gũubã zĩigẽ yʋngã tɛk fãa.
Ade, mam nee neb sẽn zao saar-dãmb sẽn sog wiid sẽn yegl taab yiib-yiib n watẽ!» Yẽnda leb n yeelame yaa: «A lʋɩɩme, Babilond lʋɩɩme! Bãmb luba Babilond wẽnnaam-dãmbã bõn-naands fãa tẽng tɩ b wã!»
Mam nebã, b pãba yãmb wa b sẽn pãbd kood zɛɛgẽ, la mam togsa yãmb bũmb ning mam sẽn wʋm Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã sẽn yaa Israyɛll Wẽnnaamã nengẽ wã.
Sɩbgr koɛɛg Duma yĩnga. Koɛɛg n zẽkd Seyɩɩr n yet maam yaa: «Gũuda, yʋngã kibar yaa a wãna? Gũuda, yʋngã kibar yaa a wãna?»
La gũuda leokame yaa: «Yibeoog watame la yʋng me watame. Yãmb sã n dat n sok bɩ y soke! Lebg-y n wa-y-yã, n-yẽe, wa-y-yã!»
Sɩbgr koɛɛg Araabi tẽngã yĩnga. Dedan neb sẽn tũud taab wʋsg n kẽnda, yãmb na n gãanda Araabi wetã pʋs yʋn-kãngã!
Tema tẽng nebã, wa-y ne koom n wa kõ ko-yũud sẽn tar-b rãmbã, la y yi ne rɩɩb n seg neb nins sẽn zoetã.
Bala, b rigda bãmb ne zabr sʋʋga, b wõoga zabr sʋʋg n pʋgd-ba, tɩ tãp rʋʋs n pʋgd bãmba. Bãmb zoet n na n põsa zabr yel-beedo.
Bala, ad Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yeel maam: «Keta yʋʋmde, wa sẽn zems yʋʋmd tʋmtʋmd sẽn tʋmd yaood yĩngã, tɩ Kedaar ziirã zãng meneme.
La Kedaar tãb-biis nins sẽn yaa tãb-tãood-gãndaadã sõor na n kella bilf bala.» Maam a Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa Israyɛll Wẽnnaamã n yeel t'a na n yɩɩ woto.
Sɩbgr koɛɛg vẽnegr tãng longã yĩnga. Bõe yĩng tɩ foom ne f nebã fãa zoet n dʋʋd bɛɛnd zutu,
Fo sẽn yaa tẽng sẽn pid ne bʋrgo, la ne neb wʋsg rãamde, tẽng sẽn kɩdemd n maand sũ-noogo? Fo nebã sẽn ki wã ka zabr sʋʋg n kʋ-b ye, bãmb ka ki zabr pʋgẽ ye.
Fo tãb-biis nanambsã fãa naaga taab n ning tĩiga. Tãb-tãoodbã yõga bãmb n maan yembse. Zeruzalɛm, b kɩtame tɩ fo nebã fãa lebg yembse, bãmb yaool n dag n zoeeme n zãag zĩiga.
Rẽ n kɩte tɩ mam yetẽ: «Wẽnemd-y y nens n da leb n ges maam ye. Bas-y maam tɩ m yãb n wiisi. Da bao-y tɩ bels maam, Zeruzalɛm sẽn yaa mam nin-nongdsã sãoong yĩng ye.

Bala, yaa pelen-yɩk daare, bedsg daare, la sũ-sãang daare, Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa Saasẽ-Pãng-Soaba sẽn tʋm vẽnegr tãng longã pʋgẽ, b na n pãba lalsã n lubi, la b na n kelemdame tɩ tat tãmsã n kot sõngre.
Elam boba loko. Zabr saar-dãmb sẽn pid ne neb tɩ wiid tatẽ n wate. Kɩɩr tẽng nebã yiisa b gãndã.
Zeruzalɛm, fo tãn-lond nins sẽn yaa neeb n yɩɩdã pida ne zabr saar-dãmba, la wed-rʋʋdbã yasa f tẽngã rignoorẽ n dat n zab ne-fo.
B yiisa bũmb ning sẽn dag n kogend Zʋʋda wã.» Badaare, fo wẽnemdame n teeg zab teed nins sẽn be roog ning sẽn boond tɩ ‹Libã tɩɩs roogã› pʋgã.
La yãmb tɩ mikame t'a Davɩɩd tẽngã lals wura zĩis wʋsgo. Yãmb koka koom n bĩng ko-bao-bilã pʋga,
yãmb sõda Zeruzalɛm dota, n pãb rot kẽer n wã n wʋk b tãndã n yẽd lalgã võyã.

Yãmb mee ko-baoor lals a yiibã sʋka, n na n dɩk ko-bao-kʋdrã koom n ning be. La yãmb ka wẽnemd y neng n ges soab ning sẽn maan-a bõn-kãensã ye, yãmb ka ne soab ning sẽn dag n deng n naan bãmb hal daar zãrã ye.
Badaare, Zu-soabã sẽn yaa Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã boonda yãmb tɩ y wa yãb n wiisi, la y põng y zut n sẽgen boto.
La gese, yãmb bas n maanda sũ-noog n kɩdemdẽ! La y kʋʋd rũm-bɛda, la y koot rũm-bãoonego, n wãbd nemd la y yũud reezẽ rãam n yetẽ: «Bɩ d rɩ la d yũ, bala, beoogo, d na n kiime!»
Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã vẽnega maam bõn-kãng n yeele: «Yãmb na n kiime n ka tol n paam sugr y kong-kãngã yĩng ye.» Maam a Zu-soabã sẽn yaa Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã n yeele.
Ade, Zu-soabã sẽn yaa Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã yetame: «Kẽng balem-naab a Sebna sẽn get na-yirã yellã nengẽ n tɩ yeel-a yaa:
Fo soo bõe ka, la fo kĩi ne ãnda ka, n wa tol n yik n tuud f yaoog ka? Ned fãa yik n tuuda a yaoog kunkubr zugu. Ned fãa yik n tuuda a vʋʋsg zĩig pĩig zugu!
Gese, Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n lobga foom hal yɩɩga, bãmb na n vila foom,
n lobg-f tɩ f bilim wa kuit-n-giling sẽn bilimd zĩ-yaleng zugu. La fo na n paa beenẽ n ki. Fo saar-dãmbã sẽn tar ziirã na n paa beenẽ. Fo sẽn yaa f zu-soabã zak yãndã yĩnga.
Mam na n diga foom n yiis f zĩigẽ wã. Mam na n võoga foom n yiis f tʋʋmdẽ wã.
Badaare, mam na n boola mam tʋmtʋmd a Eliyakim sẽn yaa a Hilkiiza biigã.
Mam na n dɩka fo fuugã n yeelg yẽnda, mam na n dɩka fo sẽbdgã n sẽbg yẽnda, la m dɩk f naamã n ning a nugẽ. Yẽnda na n yɩɩ Zeruzalɛm nebã, ne Zʋʋda buudã ba.
Mam na n dɩka a Davɩɩd roogã kʋɩlen-bil n ning yẽnda nugẽ. Yẽnda sã n pake, ned kõn tõog n pag ye. Yẽnda sã n page, ned kõn tõog n pak ye.
Mam na n kaa yẽnda wa baaf zĩig sẽn tar pãng zugu, la yẽnda na n yɩɩ wa geer sẽn tar ziir a buudã yĩnga.»
Bũmb ning fãa sẽn yaa yẽnda buudã ziirã na n wa yagla yẽnda zugu, wil-kãsemsã ne wil-bãoonegã, baa ne te-bãoonegã fãa, hal ne sĩmsã n tɩ tãag yʋyã.

Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã yetame: «Badaare, b na n feooga baaf ning sẽn be zĩig ning sẽn tar pãngã zugã, b na n kɛ-a lame t'a lʋɩ, la b na n sãama zɩɩb ning sẽn dag n be yẽnda zugã. Yaa maam a Sẽn-Ka-Saab n yeele.»

Sɩbgr koɛɛg Tɩɩr tẽngã yĩnga. Tarsɩɩs koom kogendo, yãb-y n wiis-y-yã, bala, b sãama y tẽngã! Rot ka leb n beẽ ye! Kõom zĩig ka leb n beẽ ye! Bãmb sẽn wa n yi Sɩpr n watẽ wã la b wilg bãmb bõn-kãense.
Yãmb dãmb sẽn be tẽms koom sẽn gũbgã pʋga, tɩ Sɩdõ toandbã rag n kẽnd ko-kãsengã zug n wat n pit beenẽ wã, bɩ rabeem kẽ-yã, tɩ y lebg mugsi!
Sihoor bõn-koaadlã, Nill kʋɩlgã koodã sẽn dag n pɩʋʋgd ko-kãsengã yaa yẽnda paoongo! La yẽnda rag n lebga bu-zẽmsã raaga.
Sɩdõ, fo sẽn yaa ko-kãseng pãng zĩigã, zoe yãnde! Bala, ko-kãsengã gomdame n yetẽ yaa: «Mam ka paam dogem toog ye, mam ka rog ye, la m ka wub kom-dibli wall kom-pugli ye.
Koɛɛgã sã n ta Ezɩpt tẽngã, b na n diga ne rabeem, wa b sẽn dag n wʋm Tɩɩr yellã.»
Pɩʋʋg-y n kẽng-y Tarsɩɩse. Koomã sʋk tẽms nebã, yãb-y n wiis-y-yã.
Tẽng ning sẽn dag n kõt yãmb sũ-no-kãsengã la woto bɩ? Tẽn-kãngã sɩng n bee hal kʋdem-wẽndẽ, yẽnda naoã rag n kẽnda ne yẽnda zĩ-zãrgẽ.
Ãnda n yãk yam n na n sɩbg Tɩɩr a woto? Tɩɩr yaa tẽng sẽn dag n tar naam n pʋɩta, tɩ yẽnda toandbã yaa nanambse, la dũniyã nebã fãa rag n waoogda a lɛɛbdbã.
Yaa Saasẽ-pãng-soabã n yãk yam-kãngã, n na n kɩt tɩ bũmb ning fãa sẽn tar dasãndã wuk-m-meng sɛ, la b kɩt tɩ bũmb ning fãa sẽn tar waoogr dũniyã zugã lebg zaalem.
Tarsɩɩs tẽn-neere, pɩʋʋg f tẽngã wa b sẽn pɩʋʋgd Nill kʋɩlgã, zɩɩb ka leb n be tẽngã ye.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab tẽega b nugã ko-kãsengã zugu. Bãmb kɩtame tɩ soolem-dãmb rigimdi. Bãmb kõo noor tɩ b sãam Kana pãng zĩisã.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yeelame: «Sɩdõ tẽn-neere, da leb n maan sũ-noog yɛs ye, b maana foom pãng wa b sẽn yõg pa-kuili. Yik n pɩʋʋg n kẽng Sɩpr sẽnẽ! Baa beenẽ, yãmb ka na n paam vʋʋsg ye.»
Ad Kalde rãmbã tẽnga, ned ka leb n ket beenẽ ye. Asiiri nebã kɩtame tɩ tẽngã lebg we-rũms zĩiga. Bãmb mee gũudb gãsd zabr yĩnga, bãmb sarma Tɩɩr tẽngã na-yiyã, n kɩt t'a lebg tom-dʋya.
Tarsɩɩs koom kogendo, yãb-y n wiis-y-yã! Bala, b sãama yãmb pãng zĩigã zãnga!

Wakat-kãnga, b na n yĩma Tɩɩr tẽngã yell hal tɩ ta yʋʋm pis-yopoe, wa sẽn zems rĩm yʋʋm sẽn kaoosd to-to wã. La yʋʋm pis-yopoe wã loogr poore, Tɩɩr tẽngã na n lebga wa yɩɩll b sẽn yɩɩnd pʋg-yoodr wɛɛngẽ n yetẽ:
Pʋg-yoodr b sẽn yĩm f yelle, rɩk pɛndg n gilg tẽngã! Wẽedẽ la f yɩɩnd f yɩɩlã, tɩ nebã tõe n leb n tẽeg f yelle!

Yʋʋm pis-yopoe wã poore, Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n leb n gesa Tɩɩr tẽngã yelle, la Tɩɩr tẽngã na n leb n sɩng n deegda yaood a tʋʋm-dẽgdã yĩnga. Yẽnda na n maana yoob ne dũniyã soolem-dãmbã fãa sẽn be tẽng zugã gilli.

B na n dɩka yẽnda sẽn paam bũmb ningã ne a yaoodã n kõ Sẽn-Ka-Saabo. La b ka na n tigs bõn-kãnga, b ka na n bĩng-a me ye. Yõod ning yẽnda sẽn paamã na n yɩɩ neb nins sẽn be-b Sẽn-Ka-Saab taoorã n na n sooge, n dɩt n tɩgda, la b yeelgd fu-neeba.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n sãama tẽngã n kɩt t'a lebg weoogo. Bãmb na n zũndga tẽngã n sãeeg a nebã.

Yell ning sẽn na n paam maan-kʋʋdã na n paama nin-zaalga. Yell ning sẽn na n paam zu-soabã na n paama yamba. Yell ning sẽn na n paam zu-soben-poakã na n paama yem-poaka. Yell ning sẽn na n paam koaasdã na n pama raada. Yell ning sẽn na n paam sẽn kõt-a samdã na n paama sam-soaba. Yell ning sẽn na n paam sẽn tar-b n pengdẽ wã na n paama sẽn tog n yao-a wã.
B sãama tẽngã zãnga, la b zɛɛ a teedã zãnga. Yaa maam a Sẽn-Ka-Saab n yeele.
Tẽnga bee sũ-sãang pʋga, a yɛɛme. Dũni gill yɛɛme n sãamdẽ. Tẽngã nin-kãsemsã me pãng sɛɛme.
Tẽngã nebã n wẽneg n sãam tẽngã. Bala, bãmb kɩɩsda tõodã, b tõdga Sẽn-Ka-Saab noyã, la b sãama kaool ning sẽn be wakat fãa wã.
Rẽ n kɩte, tɩ kãab-wẽngã sãamd tẽngã, la tẽngã nebã tog n paama sɩbgre. Bõn-kãng n kɩt tɩ bugum dɩ tẽngã nebã, la sẽn kell-bã sõor ka leb n yaa wʋsg ye.
Reezẽ rãam ka leb n wẽkdẽ ye, reezẽ tɩɩs zelgame. Neb nins fãa sẽn dag n maand sũ-noogã wẽeda siri.
Gãngãoog ka leb n maand noog ye, sũ-noog bʋrg sɛɛme, pɛndg ka leb n maand noog ye.
Neb ka leb n yũud reezẽ rãam la b yɩɩndẽ ye, rãam noor lebga toog ne rã-yũudbã.
Tẽng ning sẽn wã-a wã sãama zãnga. Rotã fãa pagame tɩ ned ka leb n kẽed be ye.
Nebã yãbda tẽngã soay zutu, bala, reezẽ rãam ka leb n be ye. Sũ-noog buudã fãa loogame. B riga kɩdeng t'a yi tẽngã.
Lebga sãoong bal n be tẽngã pʋga, b luba kʋɩlemsã tɩ lebg raboogo.
Bala, bũmb ning sẽn be tẽngã pʋgã, bũmb ning sẽn be nebã sʋkã, yaa wa oliiv wobr wakate, wa b sẽn wob reezẽ n loog tɩ lebg yiisgu.
Nin-bãmb zẽkda b koeese, bãmb kaasda ne sũ-noogo, sẽn be-b nin-taoorã kilsda ne sũ-noogo, Sẽn-Ka-Saab naamã yĩnga.
Dẽ wã, waoog-y Sẽn-Ka-Saab zĩis nins wĩndg vẽenem sẽn tãoosdã pʋgẽ, waoog-y Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa Israyɛll Wẽnnaamã yʋʋr tẽms nins sẽn be koom sʋkã pʋgẽ!

Tõnd wʋmda yɩɩl sẽn yit dũniyã kɩrems fãa n yetẽ: «Bɩ tɩrlem soabã reeg ziiri!» La mam yetame: «Mam menemame! Mam menemame! Ad yaa toog mam yĩnga! Zãmb dãmbã zãmbdame. Lebga zãmbgo! Zãmb dãmbã zãmbdame.
Dũni-rãmba, pelen-yɩk ne boko, la gãmbr na n yõka yãmba!
Sẽn zoet-a n na n põs pelen-yɩkã, a na n lʋɩɩ bokã pʋga, la sẽn be-a bokã pʋg n dat n yi wã, gãmbrã n na n yõk-a. Bala, saasẽ kʋɩlems pakame, la dũniyã yẽbgr rigimdame.
Tẽngã maana mugnum, tẽngã wãame, tẽngã miimdame,
tẽngã lengda wa ned sẽn yũ rãam n tɩg n lengdẽ, a kɩllda wa pʋʋg roogo. Yẽnda beegrã zɩsg-a lame, yẽnda lʋɩɩme n ka na n leb n yik ye.»
Badaare, Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n sɩbga saasẽ pãens rãmbã sẽn be saasẽ wã, la b na n sɩbga tẽng zug rĩm-dãmbã sẽn be tẽng zugã.
B na n tigma bãmb wa bi-bees n kẽes bokẽ. B na n tɩ paga bãmb bi-bees roog pʋga, la sã n wa kaoose, b na n sɩbga bãmba.
Kiuugã na n paama paoogre, wĩndgã me na n paama yãnde. Bala, Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã n yaa rĩm Sɩyõ tãngã zug Zeruzalɛm, la b ziirã pukda bãmb kãsem dãmbã taoore.

Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, yãmb yaa mam Wẽnnaam. Mam na n pʋʋsa yãmb barka, la m na n pẽga yãmb yʋʋrã, bala, yãmb pidsa tʋʋm-kãsems nins yãmb sẽn dag n yeel hal daar zãr tɩ y na n maaname wã. B yaa bũmb sẽn ka viigda la sẽn ka vaanda.
Bala, yãmb kɩtame tɩ tẽngã lebg kug-rʋre. Tẽng ning sẽn dag n tar pãngã lebga tom-dʋre. Sãambã na-yirã menema tẽngã pʋga, la b kõn tol n leb me-a ye.
Rẽ n kɩte, tɩ pãens rãmbã waoogd yãmba, la buud toay-toayã sẽn yaa nin-toosã tẽng zoeta yãmba.

Bala, yãmb yɩɩ pãng zĩig ka-pãens rãmbã yĩnga, la y yɩ zĩ-soalgdg nimbãan-nebã yĩnga, b yel-pakr wakate, n yaa soondg zĩig saag sẽn niid ne pãng wakate. Yãmb yaa maasem tʋʋlg wakate. Bala, nin-toosã vʋʋsem wẽnda sa-kẽeng sẽn pãbd lalga.
Yãmb sẽn kɩtd tɩ tʋʋlg sɛ zĩ-koɛɛngẽ wã, yãmb tõogame tɩ sãambã bʋrg sɛ, Sawaodg maasem sẽn sɛɛsd tʋʋlg to-to wã, yãmb kɩtame tɩ nin-toosã tõogr yɩɩl sɛ.
Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã na n maana tigr sẽn tar rɩ-nood tãn-kãngã zug nebã fãa yĩnga. Na n yɩɩ tigr sẽn tar reezẽ rã-kʋdgo, la rɩ-nood ne nemd sẽn tar kaam, ne reezẽ rã-kʋdg sẽn yɩlge.
Tãn-kãng zug la bãmb na n sãam peen-lill ning sẽn lud-a nebã fãa wã. Peen-kãng rag n luda buud toay-toayã fãa.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n sãama kũum pãng wakat sẽn ka sɛt yĩnga. Zu-soab a Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n yẽesa nemsã fãa nintãmã. Bãmb na n kɩtame tɩ bãmb nebã yãndã sɛ dũniyã fãa pʋga. Maam a Sẽn-Ka-Saab n yeele.

Badaare, b na n yeelame yaa: «Yaa bãmb la tõnd Wẽnnaam! Tõnd dɩka d teegrã n teeg bãmba, la bãmb fãaga tõndo. Bãmb yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, tõnd sẽn teeg a soabã, wa-y tɩ d maan sũ-noogo, d kɩdem bãmb fãagrã yĩnga!
Bala, Sẽn-Ka-Saab nugã bee tãn-kãngã zugu!» B na n taba Moaab zĩig pʋgẽ, wa b sẽn tabd mood bir-bok pʋga.
Yẽnda bee beenẽ n tẽegd a nus wa ko-rugd sẽn tẽegd a nus n dugd koom. Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n kɩtame t'a wuk-m-mengã sɛ, la b kell n kɩt t'a nusã bẽds me sɛ.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n tusa fo lalsã sẽn me n zẽk n tar pãngã n lubi. Bãmb na n siig-b lame, b na n lub-b-la tẽngã tom pʋga.
Badaare, b na n yɩɩla Zʋʋda tẽngã pʋg n yeele: «Tõnd tara tẽng sẽn tar pãnga. Sẽn-Ka-Saab maana lalg ne pãng zĩig n na n fãag tõndo.
Pak-y kʋɩlemsã tɩ buud ning sẽn yaa tɩrg n maand sɩdã kẽ.
Ned ning yam sẽn ka yuusdã, yãmb kõta a soab vɩ-bãane. Yãmb kõt-a-la vɩ-bãan a sẽn dɩk a teegrã n teeg yãmbã yĩnga.
Rɩk-y y teegrã n teeg Sẽn-Ka-Saab wakat fãa. Bala, Sẽn-Ka-Saab bal n yaa pĩig kugr wakat fãa.
Bãmb sika neb nins sẽn dag n be tãn-lug-lug zugã. Bãmb n lub tẽng ning sẽn dag n be tãng zugã. Bãmb lub-a-la tẽnga, bãmb lub-a-la tomẽ.
B taba yẽnda ne naoã. Naong rãmbã taba yẽnda ne b nao. Nimbãan-nebã na n taba yẽnda n looge.»
Tɩrlem yaa nin-tɩrg sore. Yãmb sẽn yaa tɩrlem soabã, yãmb manega nin-tɩrg sore.
Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, yãmb tõogã sẽn tuk sor ningã zugu, tõnd maanda tẽeb ne yãmba. Tõnd sẽn dat fãa yaa tɩ bool yãmb yʋʋrã.
N-yẽe! Yʋngo, mam data yãmba, mam sũ-zulmã pʋga, mam baooda yãmba. Bala, yãmb bʋ-kaoorã sã n wa maand a tʋʋmd dũniyã zugu, dũniyã neb zãmsda tɩrlem.
B sã n zoe nin-wẽng nimbãanega, a ka zãmsd tɩrlem maaneg ye. Yẽnda maanda wẽng tɩrlem tẽngã pʋga, la a toog ka be ne Sẽn-Ka-Saab naamã ziir ye.
Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, yãmb nugã zãntame hal tɩ bãmb ka ne-a ye. Bãmb na n yãnda yãmb sẽn tar nonglem-kãseng ning y nebã yĩngã, tɩ bõn-kãng yãnd yõk-ba. Woto, bugum n na n dɩ yãmb bɛɛbã.
Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, yãmb vigla vɩ-bãan tõnd yĩnga. Sɩd me, tʋʋm nins fãa tõnd sẽn maanã, yaa yãmb n maand-b n kõt tõndo.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa tõnd Wẽnnaam, zu-soben-dãmb a taab sẽn ka yãmb sooga tõndo, la yaa yãmb y yembr yʋʋrã bal la tõnd ket n boondẽ.
Zu-soben-bãmb kiime n ka na n leb n vʋʋg ye. Bãmb lebga wa maasem bala, b ka na n leb n yik ye. Sɩda, yãmb kẽesa y toog n sãam bãmba, yãmb menesa bũmb ning sẽn tõe n kɩt tɩ b tẽeg b yellã!
Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, yãmb paasa y nebã sõore, yãmb fɩɩga y nebã n waoog y yʋʋrã. Yãmb yalga tẽngã todsã fãa.
Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, bãmb yel-pakrã pʋga, b baoo yãmba. Yãmb sẽn dems bãmbã yĩnga, b pʋʋsame n kos sugri.
Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, wa tʋtr-pʋg sẽn dat n dog n kũmd dogem toog to-to wã, tõnd me bee yãmb taoor n maand a woto!
Tõnd dɩka pʋg n nams ne rogem toogo, tõnd sẽn dogã, yaa wa sobg bal la d dog yã. Tõnd ka maan bũmb sẽn wat ne fãagr dũniyã yĩng ye, la d ka wa ne neb dũniyã pʋg ye.

Fo kũumã na n leb n paama vɩɩm, sẽn ki-bã na n leb n vʋʋgame. Yãmb dãmb sẽn be tẽng tomẽ wã, nek-y-yã, kaas-y ne sũ-noogo! Bala, yãmb meenemã yaa meenem sẽn kõt vẽenem. La tẽn-gãongã na n basa sẽn dag n be-b lik pʋgã tɩ b wa vẽenemẽ.
Mam nebã, kẽng-y n tɩ kẽ-y y rotẽ, la y lebs kʋɩlemsã n pag n be pʋgẽ. Solg-y wakat bilf pʋgẽ, hal tɩ sũ-puugrã wakat looge.

Bala, Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n yi b zĩigẽ wã, n wa sɩbg dũniyã nebã b kongrã yĩnga. Tẽn-gãongã na n basa zɩɩm ning yẽnda sẽn dag n daagã tɩ puki, la a ka na n leb n tõog n solg neb nins yẽnda sẽn dag n kʋ wã ye.
Badaare, Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n dɩka b zabr sʋ-bedrã sẽn dɩte, la sẽn tar pãngã, n sɩbg parwẽndã sẽn yaa wag-zoɛtgã, parwẽndã sẽn yaa wag-gõdem-gõdmã, la b na n kʋʋ wag-bɛɛgã sẽn be ko-kãsengẽ wã.
Badaare, pʋd-y yɩɩll reezẽ tɩɩg sẽn kõt reezẽ-rã-noogã yĩnga.
Maam a Sẽn-Ka-Saab n yaa a gũuda, mam zãgsda yẽnda koom wakat fãa. Mam gũuda yẽnda wĩndg la yʋngo, tɩ b ra wa n maan-a bũmb ye.
Mam sũur ka leb n puud ne yẽnda ye. Gõpayãnds ne gõos sã n be beenẽ, mam na n võ-b lame, la mam na n ninga b fãa bugum.
Bũmb sẽn be yaa tɩ b wa soond mam nengẽ, yaa tɩ b bao vɩ-bãan ne maam, yaa tɩ b bao tɩ vɩɩmd bãan ne maam!
Wakat sẽn wate, a Zakoob yagensã na n kɩɩ yẽga, Israyɛll buudã na n pusa yagense, la a na n womame t'a biisã pid dũniyã.
Rẽ yĩnga, Sẽn-Ka-Saab wẽ b nebã wa b sẽn wẽ neb nins sẽn dag n pãbd bãmbã bɩ? Sẽn-Ka-Saab kʋʋ bãmb nebã wa b sẽn kʋ neb nins sẽn dag n kʋʋd bãmb nebã bɩ?
Yãmb kaoo bãmb bʋʋdo, n tus-ba, n dig-b tɩ b looge. Bãmb fʋʋs-b-la ne sob-kãseng n dig-ba, yaa yaang sob-kẽeng sẽn yik daar a yembr n dɩk-ba.

Yaa woto n na n kɩt t'a Zakoob yagensã paam b kongrã sugri. Ad b sẽn na n paam b yel-wẽnã sugrã sẽn na n wa ne bũmb ninga: Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n kɩtame tɩ tẽn-kugã kug fãa lebg zom wa b sẽn wer goore. Aseera ra-lugdsã ne wisd yõogr zĩisã ka na n leb n yals ye.
Bala, tẽng ning sẽn tar pãngã lebga zĩ-vɩʋʋgo, yaa zĩig b sẽn base, t'a lebg wa we-raoogo. Nag-bi wã wat n wãbda beenẽ, la b gãe beenẽ n sɛɛsd tɩɩsã vãado.
Wilã sã n kʋɩ, b kaood-b lame. La pagbã wat n ning-b-la bugum. Bala, bãmb yaa neb sẽn ka mi võor ye. Rẽ kɩtame tɩ b naandã ka zoe bãmb nimbãaneg ye. Sẽn naan-a bãmbã ka paam nimbãan-zoeer b yĩng ye.
Badaare, Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n miima tɩɩsã, sẽn sɩng ne Efrat kʋɩlgã n tɩ tãag Ezɩpt ko-soogã. La b na n wʋka yãmb a Israyɛll nebã yembr-yembre!

Badaare, b na n peeba baor-bedre, dẽ, neb nins sẽn dag n menem n be Asiiri tẽngã, ne neb nins sẽn sãeeg n be Ezɩpt tẽngã na n waame. Bãmb na n wõgemda Sẽn-Ka-Saab taoore, tãn-sõngã sẽn be Zeruzalɛmã zugu.
Kayto! Efrayiim rã-yũudbã naam puglã na n paama toogo, tɩ-puud nins sẽn yaa yẽnda ziir n be kunkubr ning sẽn tar long sẽn bʋgs zugã zelgame. Yaa neb nins reezẽ rãam sẽn lubdã, bãmb na n paama toogo!
Zu-soabã gãndaoog sẽn tar raood n wate, a wata wa sob-kãseng sẽn tũnug sapɩlma, yaa sob-fugdg sẽn sãamda, wa sa-kẽeng sẽn niid ko-bɛd sẽn tar pãnga. Yẽnda na n luba tẽngã ne pãnga.
B na n taba Efrayiim rã-yũudbã naam puglã ne nao,
la tɩ-puud nins sẽn yaa neeb n be kunkubr ning sẽn tar long sẽn bʋgs zug n zelgã na n yɩɩ wa kankan-dẽeng sẽn bɩ, tɩ bõn-bɩʋʋng nan ka ta ye. Ned sẽn fãsg-a yee, la a sẽn leems-a.
Badaare, Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã na n yɩɩ b nebã sẽn kellã naam pugla la, b waoogr maanfo.
Bãmb na n yɩɩ zemsg sɩɩga, n soog ned ning sẽn zaoond-a n na n kao bʋʋdã, la b yɩ pãng n soog neb nins sẽn zabd ne bɛyã, tɩ b rig-a n tɩ tãag tẽngã noore.

Bãmb me yũu reezẽ rãam n zʋbsdẽ, rã-toosã kɩtame tɩ bãmb nens yilimdẽ. Maan-kʋʋdbã ne sẽn yãt-b vẽnegrã yũu reezẽ rãam n zʋbsdẽ, rãamã sooga bãmb zãnga, rã-toosã kɩtame tɩ bãmb nens yilimdẽ. Bãmb yãabã kɩtame tɩ b zʋbsdẽ, b yamã yuusda b yam-yãkrã pʋga.
Bãmb taabl-dãmbã fãa pida ne b wʋbdã, la b rẽgdã, tɩ vɩʋʋg ka leb n beẽ ye.
Bãmb yetame: «Ãnda la a Ezayi rat n zãms bãngre? Ãnda la yẽnda rat n kɩt t'a wʋm koɛɛgã võore? Sã n ka kamb sẽn nan bas bĩisim, yaa kamb sẽn nan sig n bas b ma.
Yaa noor ne noore, yaa tõog ne tõogo, toadg ne toadga, yaa bilf ka, la bilf ka sẽnẽ.
Beneere, yaa bɩ-bɩt-bɩte, goam sẽn ka tar võore, yaa goam buud a to la bãmb na n gom ne nin-bãmbã.»
Bãmb dag n yeel-b lame yaa: «Ad vʋʋsgo! Bas-y sẽn yɛɛ-a wã t'a vʋʋse. Ad yaa vʋʋsgo!» La bãmb ka sak n kelg ye.

Ne nin-bãmbã, Sẽn-Ka-Saab goamã na n yɩɩ wa: Yaa noor ne noore, yaa tõog ne toogo, toadg ne toadga, yaa bilf ka, la bilf ka sẽnẽ. Sẽn na n yɩlẽ tɩ b sã n kẽnd bɩ b lagsd n lʋɩt zãmbɛɛl n kaoodẽ, bɩ bẽodgã paam-b n yõke.
Nin-tʋʋdba, kelg-y Sẽn-Ka-Saab koɛɛga, yãmb-dãmb sẽn so Zeruzalɛm nebã!

Yãmb yetame: «Tõnd maana kaool ne kũum, tõnd maana yẽsg ne kɩɩm-kulgu. Sẽn na n yɩl tɩ sãoongã sã n wa, wa ko-pɛm sẽn fõt n wat ne pãnga, bɩ a ra paam tõnd ye. Tõnd dɩka zĩrẽ tɩ yaa tõnd zĩ-lilldga, la d rɩk belgr tɩ yaa d solgr zĩiga.»

Bõn-kãng yĩng kɩtame tɩ Zu-soab a Wẽnnaam yetẽ: «Ade, mam vigla kugr sẽn tar pãng Sɩyõ. Yaa kugr sẽn yaa sõama n be soakã zĩigẽ, yaa kugr sẽn tar yõodo, la a vigla kãenkãe. Sẽn teeg-a kug-kãng ka baood n zoe ye.
Mam vigla zemsg tɩ yaa magdga, la tɩrlem tɩ yaa zemsg makdga. Sapɩlem na n looga ne zĩrẽ-beed zĩ-lilldgã, ko-zoetmã na n kãaga zĩ-solgdsã fãa n looge.»
Yãmb sẽn maan kaool ning ne kũumã na n vaalame. Yãmb sẽn maan yẽsg ning ne kɩɩm-kulgã ka na n tõog ye. Sãoongã sẽn fõt n wat ne pãng wa ko-pɛmã sã n wa, a na n sãama yãmba.
A sẽn na n pɩʋʋg wakat ning fãa, a na n kãaga yãmba. Bala, a na n pɩʋʋga yibeoog fãa, la ne wĩndg la yʋngo, la a bʋrgã bal na n kẽesa rabeem.
Gãagã na n yɩɩ koɛɛg wʋsg tɩ ned ka tõe n tẽeg a meng a zug ye. La fu-goabgã na n yɩɩ bilf tɩ ka sekd pilb ye.

Bala, Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n yika zabr ne bãmb wa Paratsim tãngã sɛɛgã. Bãmb na n yik n maana b tʋʋmd wa b sẽn dag n maan Gabawõ tẽn-nabdrẽ wã, yaa tʋʋm-kãseng ning bãmb sẽn maanã, b na n yik n maana tʋʋm-bãnde, b na n pidsa tʋʋmd sẽn yaa bõn-lingdga.
Moasã, da yɩ-y nin-tʋʋdba, tɩ b ra wa tak yãmb sẽbdsã tɩ lebg kãenkãe ye. Bala, b yãka yam n na n sãam tẽnga zãnga. Yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã n togs maam.
Yok-y y tʋb n kelg maam! Gũus-y y meng n kelg mam koɛɛgã!
Ka-koaad sã n dat n war a pʋʋg n bʋde, a tara warb bal n ka basdẽ la? Yẽnda koodame la a bẽesdẽ n ka basdẽ la?
Yẽnda sã n maneg a zĩigã n sɛ, a fẽrgda siili la a fẽrg kĩu, a bʋta ki runug-runuga, n yãk zĩig n bʋd orze, la a bʋd bõn-koaadl a taab kɩremsã.
Yẽnda Wẽnnaam zãmsa yẽnda a sẽn tog n maane, Wẽnnaamã zãms-a-la bõn-kãnga.
B ka tog n pãb siil ne rasab ye, la b ka tog n tab kĩu ne sarɛt ye. B fʋkda kĩu teoogẽ, la b pãbda ki ne dasaare.
B tog n wera bɩle n maan buri, la b ka tog n pãbd-a n ka basdẽ ye. B sã n bilimd sarɛtã ne te-sogdɩ wã, bɩle wã zugu, a ka wãad ye.
Bõn-kãng fãa yita Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã nengẽ. Bãmb saagrã yaa sõama, la b sẽn tar yam ningã yaa kãsenga.
Ariyɛlle, Ariyɛlle, tẽng ning pʋg a Davɩɩd sẽn tilg a tãb-sikã, fo na n paama toogo. Yʋʋmd loogdame tɩ yʋʋmd a to wa, bas-y tɩ tigã watẽ la b loogdẽ.
Mam na n namsa Zeruzalɛm, tɩ lebg sidgr la wõosgo. La tẽngã na n lebga maoong kʋʋb bug-toaalg ne maam.
Mam na n tilga m tãb-sikã n gũbg foom. Mam na n gɩda foom ne tãb-biisi, la m zam tom-dʋy n zab ne foom.
B na n sika foom tɩ f be tẽng n gomda. Fo goamã ka leb n zẽkd n yɩɩd wubsg ye. Fo koɛɛgã rãamd na n yita wa kɩɩm koɛɛg sẽn walemde, la fo na n paa tẽng tomẽ n walemdẽ.
Fo bɛɛbã sẽn yaa wʋsgã sõor na n yɩɩ wa tom-bãanega. Nin-bãmbã sẽn yaa nin-toosã na n yɩɩ wa wudg sẽn zẽkda. La tao-tao bala, wakat yɛng pʋgẽ,
Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã na n waa ne sa-kelemse, la tẽn-digimdgu, la bʋr-kãsenga, ne seb-kãsenga, la sa-kẽenga, la ne bug-witim sẽn dɩta.
Zãmsd sẽn yaa to-to wã, la ned sẽn paam vẽnegr to-to yʋngã, neb wʋsg nins sẽn zabd ne Zeruzalɛmã me na n yɩ a woto. Yaa neb nins fãa sẽn na n zab ne-a, n sãam a pãng zĩisã n baood n nams-a wã.

Dẽ, wa kom sẽn tar ned t'a zãms n dɩtẽ wã, n yaool n nek n mik t'a pʋg yaa vɩʋʋgã, la ko-yũud sẽn tar ned t'a zãms n yũud koomã, n wa nek n mik t'a yɛɛme t'a koees yaa koɛɛngã, a na n yɩɩ woto me ne buud toay-toay wʋsgã sẽn na n zab ne Sɩyõ tãngã.
Kell-y n pa-y yɛɛsg pʋg n kaoose! Mum-y y ninã n lebg zoense! Bãmb nens yilimdame la b yaool n ka yũ reezẽ rãam ye. Bãmb lengdame la b yaool ka yũ rã-toaag ye.
Bala, Sẽn-Ka-Saab lobga yãmb gõe-kãseng pʋga, bãmb muma yãmb a no-rɛɛsdbã nini, la b pil yãmb a yãtbã zut ne peen-lilli.

Ne yãmba, b sẽn vẽneg yel-kãensã fãa wã wẽnda wa sebr b sẽn gʋls goam a pʋgẽ n yaool n sog-a, n dɩk-a n kõ ned sẽn mi kaorengo, n yeel-a: «M kotame tɩ f karem sẽn gʋlsã,» t'a leoke: «Mam ka tõe n karm-a ye, bala, b sog-a lame.»
Wall wẽnda wa b sẽn dɩk sebr n kõ ned sẽn ka mi kaorengo, n yaool n yeel-a: «M kotame tɩ f karem sebrã!» T'a leoke: «Mam ka mi kaoreng ye.»
Zu-soabã yetame: «Nin-bãmbã me sã n kolg maam, b waoogda maam ne noor bala, la b sũyã zãra ne maam, bãmb sẽn zoet maamã yaa zãmsg b sẽn deeg ninsaalb nengẽ bala.
Rẽ n kɩte, tɩ mam na n kell n maan bõn-bãn tɩ yɩ lingr ne lingr nin-bãmbã yĩnga. Yam-dãmbã yamã na n sɛɛme, la bãngdbã bãngr na n zoe n baoo zĩig n solge.»
Toog na n paama neb nins sẽn solgd b mens n na n zãag ne Sẽn-Ka-Saabã, sẽn na n yɩl n solg b saagrã! Bãmb maanda b tʋʋmã likẽ, la b yetẽ: «Ãnda n ne tõndo? Ãnda soab n mi tõnd sẽn maandã?»
Yãmb sẽn maandã yaa lebende! A zemsame tɩ b ges yagbã wa yagd bɩ? Bũmb tõe n yeela a naandã tɩ ka yẽnda n naan-a sɩda? Rʋk tõe n yeela sẽn yaga yẽnda wã t'a ka tar bãngre?
Yãmb ka mi tɩ keta bilf bala, tɩ Libã tek n lebg tɩɩs zĩiga, tɩ b geelg tɩɩs zĩigã wa kãgre.
Badaare, wʋms na n wʋma sebrã goamã. Zoens nin na n pukame tɩ b yi lik ne lik bida pʋg n neẽ.
Sik-m-mens rãmbã na n paama sũ-no-kãseng Sẽn-Ka-Saab pʋga, la sẽn yaa-b naong rãmbã n tɩ yɩɩd ninsaalbã sʋkã na n kɩdma Israyɛll Pʋ-Peelem-Soabã yĩnga.
Bala, nin-toaag ka na n leb n zĩnd ye. La wẽnem soabã na n menemame, b na n menesa neb nins fãa sẽn dag n wũg n dat n maan wẽngã.
Yaa neb nins sẽn dag n balgd nebã bʋʋd zĩigẽ, la b bẽt bʋ-kaoodbã tẽngã noorã, n kɩtdẽ tɩ b paalgd bʋʋm soab zaalmã.
Bõn-kãng yĩnga, Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn fãag a Abrahaamã yeta a Zakoob yagensã yaa: «Moasã, yãnd kõn leb n yõk a Zakoob yagensã ye. Bãmb neng kõn tol n leb n sulg ye.
Bala, bãmb kambã sã n yãnd mam nus tʋʋm nins mam sẽn maan bãmb sʋkã, bãmb na n waooga mam yʋʋrã. Bãmb na n waooga a Zakoob Pʋ-Peelem-Soaba, b na n zoee Israyɛll Wẽnnaamã.
Neb nins yam sẽn dag n menema na n paama bãngre, la sẽn dag n yẽgemd-bã na n deega zãmsgo.»
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yetame yaa: «Kom-tõtsã na n paama toogo! Bãmb maanda yam-yãkr sẽn ka yit mam nengẽ ye. Bãmb maanda kaool mam sẽn ka yeel tɩ b maane, n paasd bãmb yel-wẽnã waooglem.
Bãmb kẽngda Ezɩpt n ka yals n sok maam ye, n na n tɩ kẽ Faarõ pãng zĩigẽ wã n soonde. La b baooda zĩ-soalgdg Ezɩpt tẽnga.
Faarõ pãng zĩigã na n wẽneg n yɩɩ yãmb yãnde. La zĩ-soalgdg ning y sẽn baood Ezɩpt tẽngã na yɩ y paoogre.
Bãmb nanambsã zoe n bee Soan, tɩ b koe-toagsdbã zoe n ta Haneese.
Bãmb fãa na n dɩɩ yãnd buud ning sẽn ka tõe n sõng bãmbã yĩnga, buud ning sẽn ka tõe n wa sõng-ba, la sẽn ka tõe n wa kõ-b sõngrã, bu-kãng na n yɩ bãmb yãnd la b paoogre.»

Sɩbgr koɛɛg Negɛɛv we-rũmsã yĩnga. Bãmb dɩka b arzegs n zɩlg b bõense, la b rɩk b paoong n zɩlg b yʋgma, n na n pɩʋʋg tẽng ning sẽn tar sũ-sãang la yel-pakrã, zĩig ning gɩgem-yãang ne gɩgem-daoog sẽn yitẽ wã, la ruruug ne wag-toaag sẽn yɩgd n yitẽ wã, n na n tɩ kõ neb sẽn ka na n tol n yɩ sõngr bãmb yĩngã!
Bala, Ezɩpt tẽng sõngrã yaa zaalem la vɩʋʋgo. Rẽ n kɩt tɩ mam boond tẽn-kãng tɩ ‹Rahaab sẽn ka maand bũmbu.›
Moasã, kẽng n gʋls bõn-kãngã wals zut bãmb nifẽ, la f gʋls-a sebr pʋga, tɩ wakat sẽn wate, bɩ bõn-kãng yɩ kaset wakat fãa.
Bala, bãmb yaa nin-tõtse, b yaa zĩrẽ-be-neb kamba, n yaa neb sẽn ka rat n kelg Sẽn-Ka-Saab tõogã ye.

Bãmb yeta yãtbã yaa: «Bɩ y ra leb n paam pĩnd-n-bãngr goam ye!» La b yet sẽn paamd-b vẽnegrã yaa: «Da leb-y n paam-y vẽnegr sẽn zems tõnd yĩng ye. Gom-y ne tõnd gom-noodo, la y paam vẽnegr sẽn ka sɩd ye!
Bʋdg-y n bas-y sorã, bʋdg-y n bas-y so-bukã, Da leb-y n gom-y ne tõnd Israyɛll Pʋ-Peelem-Soab a Wẽnnaam yell ye!»
Rẽ kɩtame tɩ Israyɛll Pʋ-Peelem-Soab a Wẽnnaam yetẽ yaa: «Yãmb sẽn zãgs gom-kãngã wã yĩnga, la yãmb sẽn dɩk y teegrã n teeg y pãngã ne y yel-kɛgã yĩnga, n dɩk bãmb tɩ lebg yãmb bõn-tɛɛgdgã,
kong-kãng na n lebga wa võor sẽn be lal-zãonglg sẽn kɩll n dat n lʋɩ zugu, la a na n lʋɩɩ tao-tao wakat a yembr pʋgẽ.
A na n wãa zõg-zõg wa yagb rʋko. A na n zõgsame n lebg peese, la b ka na n bas-a t'a põs ye. A pedsã ka na n kell tɩ sek tall n mok bugum bug-toaalgẽ, wall b tall n tɩ toog koom bulgẽ ye.»

Bala, Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa Israyɛll Pʋ-Peelem-Soab a Wẽnnaam yetame: «Yaa yãmb sẽn na n tek yam n zĩnd bãane, la yãmb na n paam fãagre, yaa vɩ-bãan ne kɩs sɩd pʋg la yãmb na n paam pãnga. La yãmb ka tʋlg bõn-kãng ye!»
Yãmb yetame: «Ayo! Tõnd na n zomba wiid n zoe!» Yãmb sɩd na n zomba wiid n zoe! Yãmb yetame: «Tõnd na n zomba wed-tʋʋls n zoe!» Rẽ kɩtame tɩ sẽn digd-b yãmbã na n zoe ne tʋʋlem.

Nin-yend bala, bɛɛbã nin-yend na n tãsa bãmb neb tusr tɩ b zoe. Bãmb neb a nu sã n tãs yãmba, yãmb na n zoeeme. Yãmb na n zoeeme hal n tɩ yals wa tãb-kaoor sẽn lugl tãng zugu, la wa tãb-kaoor sẽn be kunkubr zugu.

Rẽ kɩtame tɩ Sẽn-Ka-Saab gũud wakat n na n ning yãmb barka, rẽ n kɩte, tɩ b na n yik n zoe yãmb nimbãanega. Bala, Sẽn-Ka-Saab yaa Wẽnnaam sẽn yaa bʋ-tɩrg soaba. Bark bee neb nins fãa sẽn tẽed bãmbã zugu!
N-yẽe! Sɩyõ nebã, yãmb dãmb fãa sẽn be Zeruzalɛm, yãmb ka na n leb n yãb yɛs ye! Yãmb sã n kelme, b na n wʋmame, la b na n zoee yãmb nimbãanega. Bãmb sã n wʋm yãmb kelemsã bala, b na n leoka yãmba.
Zu-soabã na n kõ-y-la rɩɩb y yel-pakr wakate, la b kõ yãmb koom y namsg pʋga. Yãmb Karen-saambã kõn leb n zãag n bas yãmb ye. Yãmb meng nin na n yãnda y Karen-saambã.
Yãmb sã n dabd goabg bɩ rɩtgo, yãmb tʋbr na n wʋma koe-kãngã y poorẽ sẽn yete: «ad sorã, tu-y-yã-a.»

Ges-y wanzuri wã b sẽn bolg yãmb wẽn-naandsã wa bõn-dẽgdo, la y ges sãnemã b sẽn bolg yãmb wẽn-naandsã b sẽn maan ne kutã wa bõn-dẽgdo. Yãmb tog n fãeega b pedsã wa bõn-dẽgdo. Yeel-b tɩ b yi kaanẽ n looge.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n kɩtame tɩ saag ni bõn-buudã yãmb sẽn bʋd tẽn-gãongã zugã yĩnga. La tẽn-gãongã sẽn na n kõ yãmb rɩɩb ninsã na n yɩɩ wʋsgo, la rɩ-noodo. Badaare, yãmb rũmsã na n tɩ wãba zĩ-yalemsẽ.
Niigã ne bõens nins sẽn kood yãmb pʋtẽ wã na n paama yamd sẽn ning yamsem, na n yɩɩ yamd b sẽn yelg ne kaorgo.
Kʋʋbã daar sã n ta tɩ gãsdã siigdẽ, ko-soay ne ko-zoetem n na n zĩnd tãn-lug-lugã ne kunkub-zãonglsã zutu.
Daar ning Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn na n tɩp b nebã poglgã, la b maag b sẽn dag n pãb bãmbã noadã, kiuugã vẽenem na n yɩɩ wa wĩntoog vẽenem, la wĩntoogã vẽenem na n paasa naoor a yopoe wa rasem a yopoe vẽenem.
Ade, Sẽn-Ka-Saab yʋʋrã yita zĩ-zãrg n watẽ. Bãmb sũ-yikrã yaa kãseng n wat ne toogo. Bãmb noorã pida ne sũ-yikri, la b zelemdã yaa wa bugum sẽn dɩta.
Bãmb vʋʋsmã yaa wa koom sẽn zoet ne pãng n limd n tat kokoayã. Bãmb na n goo buud toay-toayã ne sũ-sãang goaadga. La b ning tudgr salbr nebã noyã pʋse.
Yãmb na n yɩɩla wa b sẽn yɩɩnd tigr daar yʋngo, yãmb na n maana sũ-noog wa ned sẽn peebd wɩɩg la a kẽnda, n dabd Sẽn-Ka-Saab tãngẽ wã, n dabd Israyɛll pĩigẽ wã.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n kɩtame tɩ b koɛɛg sãd ne pãnga, la b na n wilga b kangã sẽn na n wẽ ne sũ-yik-kãsenga, la ne bug-witim sẽn dɩta, ne sa-kẽenga la sob-kãseng sẽn fẽrgd sapɩlma.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab koɛɛgã rãamd sã n yi, rabeem na n yõka Asiiri nebã. Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n wẽe bãmb ne b rasaarã.
Wakat ning fãa Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yãk yam n na n wẽ bãmbã, b na n wʋma gãngãoong ne pɛndg rãamde. Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n zẽka b kangã n zab ne-ba.
Bala, b zoe n segla wʋngã n sɛ. B vigla wʋngã rĩmã yĩnga, wʋngã zulmame, a yalmame. Yẽnda wʋngã pida ne bugum la raad wʋsgo. Sẽn-Ka-Saab vʋʋsmã rɩt-a-la wa kidbr ko-soogo.

Toog bee neb nins sẽn kẽnd Ezɩpt n baood sõngrã zutu. Bãmb dɩka b teegrã n teeg wiidi, b teega b saar-dãmba sẽn yaa wʋsgã, la b teeg b wed-rʋʋdbã sẽn tar pãngã, n ka wẽnemded n get Israyɛll Pʋ-Peelem-Soabã, la b ka baood Sẽn-Ka-Saab ye!
Baoosgo, bãmb me yaool n tara yam, n tõe n kɩt tɩ toog wa. Bãmb ka lebsd b noor poorẽ ye. Bãmb zabda ne nin-wẽns yiri, la b zabd ne wẽng maandbã sõngrã.

Ezɩpt nebã yaa ninsaalb bala, b ka Wẽnnaam ye. Bãmb wiidã yaa nemd bala, b ka sɩɩs ye. Sẽn-Ka-Saab sã n tẽeg b nugã bala, sẽn wat-a n na n sõngã lakd n lʋɩɩme, b sẽn sõngd a soabã na n lʋɩɩme, la bãmb fãa na n naaga taab n sãame.

Bala, Sẽn-Ka-Saab yeela maam yaa: «Wa gɩgemde, la wa gɩgem-poll sẽn yõkd rũng n gãe n wũundẽ, tɩ baa pe-kɩɩmbã sã n boond taab la b kelemd n dat n zab ne-a bɩ a ka yɛɛsdẽ wã, la baa bãmb wʋsg sã n bugsd-a bɩ rabeem ka tar-a wã, woto me, Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã na n siga Sɩyõ tãngã ne kunkubrã zug n zabe.»
Liuuli sẽn yɛdgd b pɩgs to-to wã, woto me, Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã na n kogla Zeruzalɛm. Bãmb na n sõng-a lame la b fãag-a, b na n kogl-a lame la b gũ-a.
Israyɛll nebã, lebg-y n wa-y yãmb sẽn kɩɩs a soab wʋsgã nengẽ!
Badaare, yãmb ned kam fãa na n basa a wanzuri wẽn-naandsã ne a sãnem wẽn-naandsã sẽn yaa yãmb nusã sẽn pid ne yel-wẽnã sẽn maanã.
Zabr sʋʋg sẽn ka ninsaalb rẽnd n na n kʋ Asiiri nebã, yaa zabr sʋʋg sẽn ka ninsaal sʋʋg n na n sãam-ba. Bãmb na n zoeeme n dat n põs zabr sʋʋga. La b na n kẽesa bãmb kom-bɩɩsã tʋʋm-wɛgl pʋga.
Rabeem na n yõka bãmb pĩigã t'a zoe, la yẽnda nanambsã na n yɛɛsame n zoe n bas b tãb-kaoorã. Yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab n yeele. Bãmb bugmã bee Sɩyõ la b wʋngã bee Zeruzalɛm.
Dẽ, rĩma na n dɩɩ naamã ne tɩrlem. La nanambsã na n sooga soolmã ne zemsgo.
Bãmb ned kam fãa na n yɩɩ wa zĩ-lilldg sobg wakate, la wa soondg zĩig sa-kẽeng wakate, bãmb na n yɩɩ wa ko-soay sẽn zãgsd zĩig sẽn kʋɩ, la wa pĩ-kãseng maasem sẽn buiid tẽn-gãong sẽn yaa koɛɛnga.
Woto, neb nins sẽn ne wã nin ka na n leb n mum ye, la neb nins tʋb sẽn wʋmdã na n kell n wʋmdame.
Neb nins sẽn ka yalsd n wʋm yell n tɩg n yaool n goma na n yaas n bao n wʋma a võore. Bidsã zɛlmã na n lakame tɩ b gomd tʋʋlg-tʋʋlga la sõama.
B kõn leb n bool yalem tɩ nin-sõng ye. La b kõn bool zɩtbã tɩ nin-sõamyã ye.

Bala, yalem gomda yalem goamã, t'a sũurã tagsd wẽng maanego, la a maanda tʋʋm-dẽgdo, n gomd n paoogd Sẽn-Ka-Saabo. Yẽnda basda kom sẽn tar b rãmbã tɩ b gãe kom, la a mongd ko-yũud sẽn tar-b rãmbã koom.
Zãmb soab zab-teed yaa sɩlem-wẽnse. Yẽnda saagda sɩlem saagr n dat n yag zĩrẽ n sãam nimbãan-nebã yelle, baa ne naong rãmb nins sẽn be b bʋʋm zugã.
La nin-sõng saagda saag-sõmyã, la a ka basd saag-sõmyã tɩ vaal ye.
Pagb nins sẽn sek b mensã, kelg-y maam! Kom-pugli nins sẽn nand b mensã, yok-y y tʋb n kelg mam koɛɛgã!
Ka ne yʋʋmd la rasem bilf sẽn wate, yãmb sẽn nand y mengã, y na n digame. Bala, reezẽ wobr na n sɛɛme, la tigsg kõn leb n zĩnd ye.
Yãmb a nand-m-mens rãmba, zoe-y rabeem! Yãmb a nand-m-mens rãmba, rig-y ne rabeem! Yees-y y futã n bas y zaala, n dɩk bot n sẽgen y sɛɛga!
B yãbdame n wiisdẽ n pĩisd y yãad pʋ-sõama wã yĩnga, la reezẽ tɩɩsã sẽn womdã yĩnga.
B yãbd n wiisda gõosã ne gõpayãndsã sẽn yit mam nebã tẽn-gãongã zugã yĩnga. B yãbd n wiisda tẽng ning sẽn maand sũ-noog ne a zags nins fãa sẽn dag n kɩdemdã yĩnga.
Bala, b basa na-yirã, b basa tẽng ning sẽn dag n pid ne nebã, Ofɛll ne gãosgã na n lebga bogd wakat fãa yĩnga. Bãmb na n lebga we-bõens ne rũms wãbneg zĩiga.
Na n yɩɩ woto hal n tãag Sẽn-Ka-Saab sɩɩgã sẽn na n yi yĩngr n sig tõnd zugu, tɩ we-raoog lebg zẽed zĩiga, tɩ zẽed zĩig pag wa kãgre.
Dẽ, zemsg na n zĩnda we-raoogẽ wã, la tɩrlem na n zĩnda zẽedã zĩigẽ.
Tɩrlmã tʋʋmd na n yɩɩ vɩ-bãane, la tɩrlmã tʋʋmd biis yaa yam-gãnega, la vɩ-bãan wakat sẽn ka sɛt yĩnga.
Mam nebã na n zĩnda vɩ-bãan zĩig pʋga, n vɩɩmd rot sẽn tar gũudum pʋga, n zĩnd zĩis sẽn tar vʋʋsgo, la yĩn-maasem pʋga.
La sapɩlem n na n sãam kãgrã, la tẽngã na n lʋɩɩ tẽng zãnga.
Yãmb na n paama sũ-noogo, yãmb na n bʋda koom sẽn be zĩig ning fãa, la yãmb na n basa y niigã ne y bõensã n ka loe ye.

Fo sẽn sãamd neb a taaba, tɩ b yaool n ka sãam foomã, la f zãmbd neb a taab tɩ b ka zãmb foomã, fo na n paama toogo! Fo sã n wa sãam neb a taabã n sɛ, b na n sãama foom. Fo sã n wa zãmb neb a taabã n sɛ, b na n zãmba foom.
Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, zoe-y tõnd nimbãanega! Tõnd dɩka d teegrã n teeg yãmba. Bɩ y yɩ tõnd pãng yibeoog fãa, la y yɩ tõnd fãagr d yel-pakr wakate!
Bʋrgã rãamd kɩtame tɩ nebã zoetẽ. Yãmb sã n yiki, buud toay-toayã sãeegdame.
B zɛɛda yãmb paoongã wa sʋy sẽn dɩt koodo. B rengda taab wa sʋy sẽn dengd taab to-to wã.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab zẽkame n yɩɩd fãa, bala, bãmb bee hal yĩngri. Bãmb pidsa Sɩyõ ne zemsgo la tɩrlem.
Yãmb a Sẽn-Ka-Saab nebã, yãmb na n vɩɩmda ne bãane. Yam ne Wẽnnaam bãngr na n yɩɩ arzɛk sẽn fãagd yãmba. La Sẽn-Ka-Saab zoees yaa laogo.
Ade, gãndaadã bee yɩng n wiisdẽ. Vɩ-bãan koe-toagsdbã yãbdame n wiisdẽ.
Soayã kell n paa vɩɩdo. So-loaadb ka leb n beẽ ye. Na-toaagã sãama kaoolã, yẽnda paooga tẽmsã, la a ka nand ned ba a yembr ye.
Tẽngã bee sũ-sãang pʋga, la a sãamdame. Yãnd tara Libã tãngã t'a kʋɩtẽ. Saaron tẽn-nabdrã lebga wa rasempʋɩɩga. Basã ne Karmell tɩɩsã vãad sʋʋgame.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yetame: «Moasã, mam na n yikame, moasã, mam na n yalsa yĩngri, moasã, mam na n paama zẽkre.
Yãmb dɩka mo-pui pʋga, yãmb na n doga moogo. Yãmb vʋʋsmã yaa wa bugum, la a na n dɩɩ yãmba.
Nebã na n yɩɩ wa kõab sẽn dɩ bugum wʋng pʋga, b na n yɩɩ wa b sẽn kɛ gõos n ning bugmẽ.
Yãmb dãmb sẽn be zĩ-zãrgẽ, kelg-y mam sẽn maan bũmb ningã! La yãmb dãmb sẽn pẽ wã, ges-y mam pãngã sẽn tõe n maan bũmb ninga!

Rabeem kẽe yel-wẽn-maandbã sẽn be Sɩyõ wã, wẽn-kɩɩsdbã rigdame. Ãnda n be tõnd sʋkã n tõe n yals bugum ning sẽn dɩt-a wã taoore? Ãnda n be tõnd sʋkã n tõe n yals bug-saal ning sẽn ka tol n kiidẽ wã taoore?

Yaa ned ning sẽn kẽnd-a ne tɩrlem, la a gomd sɩda, n ka baood n maan zãmb n paam paoongo, la a pĩmsd a nus n ka rat n deeg zãmb kũuni, n yẽt a tʋb n ka rat n wʋm tɩ b gomd zɩɩm daagr yelle, la a mumd a nin n ka rat n ges sẽn yaa wẽng ye.
Nin-kãngã soab na n zĩnda zĩ-zãonglsẽ. Pĩis sẽn tar pãng na n yɩɩ yẽnda pãng zĩiga. B na n kõo yẽnda rɩɩbo, la koom kõn paoog-a ye.»
Fo nin na n yãnda rĩma b ziirã pʋga, bãmb na n yãnda tẽngã ne a yalmã fãa.
Fo na n tagsa bũmb ning sẽn kẽes foom dabeemã yelle. Seb-gʋndã bee yɛɛnẽ? Yaood dɛɛgdã bee yɛɛnẽ? Sẽn dag n gilgd-a n get gãsdã bee yɛɛnẽ?
Fo kõn leb n yãnd buud ning sẽn yaa tɩta-nedã ye, buud ning sẽn gomd tɩ ned ka wʋmdẽ wã, buud sẽn gomd gom-zẽng tɩ ned ka wʋmdẽ wã.

Ges Sɩyõ, tẽng ning pʋg tõnd sẽn maand d tigã! Fo nin na n yãnda Zeruzalɛm sẽn yaa yam-gãneg tẽngã. Yaa fu-roog sẽn kõn tol n viigi, b kõn tol n leb n vigs biili wã ye. La b kõn tol n leb n logs a wĩyã ye.

Sɩdã, yaa tẽn-kãng pʋg la Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n wilg b sõmblem tõnd yĩnga. Bãmb na n kɩtame tɩ d zĩigã lebg kʋɩlse, n tar ko-so-yalemse, n yaa zĩig zabr koom kogend sẽn kõn tũ ye, la koom kogl-bɛd ka na n pɩʋʋg-a ye.
Bala, Sẽn-Ka-Saab n yaa tõnd bʋ-kaooda, Sẽn-Ka-Saab n yaa tõnd naaba, yaa bãmb n yaa tõnd dĩma. Bãmb n yaa tõnd fãagda.
Fo wĩyã yolsame. B ka leb n sẽb kãenkãe ne tãb-kaoor daoogã ye, b ka leb n tar bãmb n loet kogendã pɛɛlã n tẽegdẽ ye. Dẽ, b na n pʋɩɩ taab te-zɛɛdem wʋsgo. Koms-rãmbã meng na n naag n zɛɛ teedã.
La tẽngã ned kõn yeel t'a ka keem ye! Neb nins sẽn be tẽn-kãng pʋgã na n paama b kongrã sugri.
Buud toay-toayã, kolg-y n kelg-y-yã! Neba, yok-y y tʋb n kelge! Bɩ tẽngã ne bũmb ning fãa sẽn be a pʋgẽ wã kelge, la bɩ dũniyã ne bũmb ning fãa sẽn yit yẽnda pʋgẽ wã kelge!
Bala, Sẽn-Ka-Saab sũ-puugrã na n siga buudã fãa zugu, la bãmb sũ-kãbrã na n siga b tãb-biisã fãa zugu. Bãmb na n sãam-b-la zãnga, b na n kʋʋ bãmba.
B na n wʋka bãmb kũumã n lobe, bãmb kũumã yũug rukdame, la bãmb zɩɩmã na n zoee tãmsã zutu.
Ãdsã sẽn be yĩngrã fãa na n far n dʋʋgame. B na n pila sa-gãongã wa seb-vãoogo, la yẽnda tãb-biisã na n sʋʋga wa reezẽ tɩɩg bɩ kankang vãad sẽn sʋʋgdã.
Bala, mam zabr sʋʋgã tɩga zɩɩm saasẽ, la a sigda Edom zugu, a sigda neb nins mam sẽn na n sãam zãngã zugu, n kao b bʋʋdo.

Sẽn-Ka-Saab zabr sʋʋgã pida ne zɩɩm, kaam mad-a lame, yaa pe-ribli wã ne boeesã zɩɩm, kaamã yaa pe-raadã yiim kaam. Bala, b na n maana maoong Bosra Sẽn-Ka-Saab yĩnga, la koodg wʋsg n na n zĩnd Edom tẽngã.
We-niigã na n naaga bãmb n ki, la nag-yãansã ne lolsã na n kiime. Bãmb tẽn-gãongã yũu zɩɩm, la kaam madga a tomã.
Bala, yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab sũ-dokr daare, yaa yʋʋmd b sẽn na n sɩbg sẽn nams-b Sɩyõ wã n lebse.
Edom ko-soodã na n gãnega sũudu, t'a tẽngã tom rɩ bugum wa kidbri. A tẽn-gãongã na n koka bugum wa sũudu sẽn dɩt bugum.
La a na n wita wĩndg ne yʋng n ka kiidẽ ye. Tẽngã bug-zõosã na n dukda wakat fãa. Tẽn-kãng na n kell n yɩɩ raboog zamaan woo zamaane, la ned kõn leb n pɩʋʋg a pʋgẽ ye.
Tẽngã na n lebga bakard ne yʋgempɛl zĩiga. Be na n lebga viut ne gãabd gãag zĩiga. Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n tẽega sãoong wiirã n mak-a, la b kɩt t'a lebg vɩ-raoogo.
Nanambsã kõn leb n zĩnd beenẽ n kos rĩm ye. B nanambsã fãa ba a yembr kõn leb n zĩnd ye.
Gõos na n yi a na-yiyã pʋse, sɩlg-nao-yẽes ne gõpayãnds na n yii b tãn-soben-dotã pʋse. Beenẽ na n lebga we-baas zĩiga, la naneend gãag zĩiga.
We-yũus ne kata na n segda taab beenẽ, la boees na n yãbda beenẽ n boond taaba. Zĩ-kãng na n lebga yʋng zĩn-dãmb sõasg zĩiga, b na n kẽnd n vʋʋsda beenẽ.
Waaf na n maana a põk beenẽ n lob a gɛla, a na n põgend-b lame n wek a kamba. Yɩbrendã na n tigma taab beenẽ.
Bao-y Sẽn-Ka-Saab sebrã n karme! Gom-bãmb ba a yembr ka na n paoog ye. Bala, yaa bãmb meng noor n yeele, la yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab sɩɩgã n na n tigim-ba.
Yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab n maan poeer bãmb yĩnga, la yaa bãmb meng nug n dɩk wĩir n mak tẽn-kãngã. Bãmb na n soog-a-la wakat fãa yĩnga, la b na n paa beenẽ zamaan woo zamaane.
We-raoogã ne tẽng ning sẽn kʋɩ wã na n maana sũ-noogo. Zĩ-koɛɛngã na n kɩdma ne sũ-noog n ning puud wa sõse.

A na n ninga puud wʋsg n kɩdem n lange, n yɩɩl kɩdengo, la ne sũ-noog kaasgo. B na n kõo yẽnda Libã ziirã, la a na n paama Karmell ne Saaron neermã. Bãmb na n yãnda Sẽn-Ka-Saab ziirã, b na n yãnda tõnd Wẽnnaamã neermã.
Keng-y nus nins sẽn ka tar pãngã, la paas-y rũm nins sẽn keoosdã pãnga.
Yeel-y neb nins pelens sẽn yɩgdã yaa: «Keng-y y mens n da zoe rabeem ye. Ade, yãmb Wẽnnaamã bee ka! Sũ-dokrã ne Wẽnnaam keoorã watame. Bãmb na n waa b toor n wa fãag yãmba.
Dẽ, zoens nin na n pugsame, la wʋms tʋb na n yoosame.
Dẽ, woabg na n yɩk n tiimsa wa yĩisri, la mugs zɛlmã na n lakame tɩ b kaas ne sũ-noogo. Bala, koom na n pusga we-raoogẽ, la ko-soay na n zoee zĩ-koɛɛngã pʋga.
Rasempʋɩɩg na n lebga bãoogo, la tẽn-koɛɛng na n lebga ko-budum zĩiga. Zĩig ning sẽn dag n yaa we-baas gãag zĩigã, a na n lebga tãnwĩis ne rudum zĩiga.
B na n tuka so-kõodr beenẽ, n pʋd sorã yʋʋr tɩ ‹sor sẽn welg toore. Ned ning sẽn yaa rẽgd ka rɩkd so-kãng ye. So-kãng yaa sẽn tũud-b yẽnda wã yĩnga, la yalembã sã n dɩk so-kãnga, b ka na n menem ye.
Gɩgmã ka na n leb n zĩnd so-kãng zug ye. Rũm-toos ka na n wa so-kãng pʋg ye, b kõn tol n leb n yãnd bãmb beenẽ ye. Yaa neb nins sẽn paam fãagrã bal n na n kẽn beenẽ.

Woto, Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yols-b rãmbã na n lebg n waame. Bãmb na n lebg n waa Sɩyõ ne sũ-noog kaasgo. Bãmb nensã na n pɩla ne sũ-noog wakat sẽn kõn sa. Kɩdeng ne sũ-noog na n wa sega bãmba, la sũ-pa-noaang ne sidgr na n zoe n baoo zĩiga.»
Rĩm a Ezekɩyaas sẽn deeg a naamã tɩ yʋʋm piig la a naaslẽ, Asiiri rĩm a Senakeriib wa n zaba ne Zʋʋda tẽms nins sẽn gũbg ne lalsã n deeg-ba.
Asiiri rĩmã zĩnda Lakiis n tʋm a tãb-biis naabã ne tãb-biis wʋsgã rĩm a Ezekɩyaas nengẽ Zeruzalɛm. La tãb-biis naabã kẽng n tɩ yalsa ko-bao-kãsengã sẽn beẽ wã, ga-loasdã pʋʋg sor zugu.
Dẽ, a Hilkiiza biig a Eliyakim sẽn yaa rĩm a Ezekɩyaas balem-naabã, ne a Sebna sẽn yaa seb-gʋndã, la a Azaf biig a Yoa sẽn yaa seb-bĩngdã yiime n seg Asiiri rĩmã tãb-biis naabã.
La tãb-biis naabã yeela bãmb yaa: «M kotame tɩ y yeel a Ezekɩyaas woto: ‹Ade, rĩm-kãsengã sẽn yaa Asiiri rĩmã yetame: Fo teega bõe?
Mam yeta foom, fo tẽedame tɩ gom-vɩɩd kõta sagls ne pãng tɩ f tõe n kẽng zabr bɩ? Moasã wã, yaa ãnda la fo teeg n yik n dat n kɩɩs maam?›
Gese, fo rɩka f teegrã n teeg Ezɩpte, Ezɩpt yaool n yaa wa tãnwĩ-kaoongo, n kõsd ned ning fãa sẽn tik yẽnda wã nugu. Ezɩpt rĩm a Faarõ maanda a woto ne neb nins fãa sẽn dɩk b teegr n teeg yẽnda wã.»

Daar ninga, fo na n yeela maam yaa: «Yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa tõnd Wẽnnaamã la tõnd teeg yã. La ka Wẽnnaam-kãng maoong kʋʋb zĩisã ne a tẽn-kugã la a Ezekɩyaas sẽn dag n sãam n bas tẽn-kugr a yembr n yeel Zʋʋda ne Zeruzalɛm nebã tɩ yaa tẽn-kug-kãng taoor la b na n wõgemded n waoogd Wẽnnaamã la!
Moasã, mam kota foom, tɩ f maan sard ne mam soaalã sẽn yaa Asiiri rĩmã, la sã n mikame tɩ yãmb tara wed-rʋʋdb sẽn tõe n zomb wiidi, mam na n kõo yãmb wiid tus a yiibu.
Rẽ yĩnga, yãmb tõe n diga mam soaalã tʋmtʋmd ning sẽn yaa-a bilf n yɩɩdã meng t'a serge? Yãmb sẽn teeg Ezɩptã yaa b sẽn tar saar-dãmb ne wed-rʋʋdbã yĩnga.
Sẽn paas me, yãmb tẽedame tɩ maam n soog m meng n wa zab ne tẽn-kãngã n sãam-a tɩ ka tũ ne Sẽn-Ka-Saab raab la? Yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab n yeel maam yaa: ‹Zab ne tẽn-kãngã n sãam-a.› »

A Eliyakim ne a Sebna la a Yoa yeela sõgen-kãsengã yaa: «Tõnd kotame tɩ y gom ne tõnd ne Aram-dãmbã goamã, tɩ tõnd wʋmdame. Da gom-y ne tõnd ne Zʋʋda nebã goam tɩ neb nins sẽn be lalgã zugã wa wʋm ye.»

Sõgen-kãsengã yeela bãmb yaa: «Yãmb tẽedame tɩ mam soaalã koɛɛgã yaa yãmb ne y soaalã yĩng bal la? Koɛɛgã yaa neb nins sẽn be-b lalgã zugã me yĩnga. Bãmb ne yãmb na n dɩ y bĩndã la y yũ y rʋʋd-koomã.»
Dẽ, sõgen-kãsengã yaasa yĩngr n zẽk a koɛɛg n gom ne Zʋʋda buudã goam n yeele: «Kelg-y Asiiri rĩmã sẽn yaa rĩm-kãsengã koɛɛga.
Asiiri rĩmã yetame: ‹Ra sak-y t'a Ezekɩyaas belg yãmb ye. Bala, yẽnda ka tõe n fãag yãmb ye.
Da bas-y t'a belg yãmb tɩ y wa tẽed tɩ y sã n teeg Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, b na n fãaga yãmba, la b ka na n sak tɩ Asiiri rĩmã tõog yãmb tẽngã ye.
Da kelg-y rĩm a Ezekɩyaas ye.› Asiiri rĩmã yetame: ‹Bɩ y bao zems-n-taar ne maam. Bas-y tɩ m soog-yã. Woto, yãmb ned kam fãa na n dɩ a reezẽ tɩɩsã biis ne a kankamã, la a tõog n yũ a bulgã koom,
hal tɩ mam wa tall yãmb n kẽng tẽng sẽn wẽnd yãmb tẽngã. Yaa tẽng sẽn tar bɩle ne reezẽ rãam, la rɩɩb ne reezẽ tɩɩse.
Da sak-y t'a Ezekɩyaas belg yãmb n yeel tɩ Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n fãag-y lame ye. Rẽ yĩnga, buud a taabã wẽnnaam-dãmb tõog n fãag-b-la Asiiri rĩmã nugẽ sɩda?
Hamat-rãmbã ne Arpaad nebã wẽnnaam-dãmb bee yɛɛnẽ? Sefarvayim wẽnnaam-dãmbã bee yɛɛnẽ? Wẽnnaam-kãens tõog n fãaga Samaari tẽngã mam nugẽ sɩda?
Tẽn-bãmb wẽnnaam-dãmbã sʋka, Wẽnnaam bʋg n tõog n fãag a tẽng mam nugẽ, tɩ Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n wa tõog n fãag Zeruzalɛm mam nugẽ?»
Dẽ, bãmb sĩnda b noore, n ka leok yẽnda tɩ bũmb ye. Bala, rĩm a Ezekɩyaas rag n yeelame yaa: «Da leok-y-yã-a ye.»

A Hilkiiza biig a Eliyakim sẽn yaa na-yirã zak naabã, ne a Sebna sẽn yaa seb-gʋndã ne a Azaf biig a Yoa sẽn yaa seb-bĩngdã pãrsa b futu, n lebg n leb rĩm a Ezekɩyaas nengẽ, n tɩ togs-a goam nins fãa Asiiri rĩmã sõgen-kãsengã sẽn gomã.
Rĩm a Ezekɩyaas sẽn wʋm gom-kãensã wã, a pãrsa a fut n yeelg boto, n kẽng Sẽn-Ka-Saab roogẽ wã.
Rĩm a Ezekɩyaas tʋma a Eliyakim sẽn yaa na-yirã zak naabã ne a Sebna sẽn yaa seb-gʋndã, la maan-kʋʋdbã kãsem-dãmbã, a Amots biig a Ezayi sẽn yaa Wẽnnaam no-rɛɛsã nengẽ. La b fãa yeelga bot n kẽnge.
Bãmb yeela a Ezayi yaa: «A Ezekɩyaas yeelame: ‹Rũndã daarã yaa yel-pakr daare, sɩbgr la yãnd daare. Bala, rogem daar taame, la pãng ka be n na n dog ye.

Daar ninga, Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa yãmb Wẽnnaamã na n wʋma goamã Asiiri rĩmã sõgen-kãsengã b sẽn tʋm t'a wa tʋʋs Wẽnnaam sẽn vɩ wã to-to wã. Tõeeme tɩ Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa yãmb Wẽnnaamã na n sɩbg-b-la goam nins yẽnda sẽn gom tɩ bãmb wʋma yĩnga. Woto wã, bɩ y pʋʋs Wẽnnaam neb nins sẽn ketã yĩnga.»
Dẽ, rĩm a Ezekɩyaas sẽn tʋm b rãmbã kẽnga Wẽnnaam no-rɛɛs a Ezayi nengẽ.
La a Ezayi yeela bãmb yaa: «Ad yãmb sẽn na n kẽng n tɩ yeel y soaalã bũmb ninga: ‹Sẽn-Ka-Saab yetame: Da zoe rabeem ne goam nins Asiiri rĩmã tʋmtʋmdbã sẽn gom n paoog maam tɩ fo wʋmã ye.
Gese, mam na n tʋma sɩɩg yẽnda nengẽ. Yẽnda na n wʋma yell kibare n lebg n leb a tẽngẽ wã, la mam na n kɩtame tɩ b kʋ yẽnda beenẽ ne zabr sʋʋga.› »
Asiiri rĩmã sõgen-kãsengã wʋmame t'a soaalã yii Lakɩɩse, n na n tɩ zab ne Libna tẽngã. La yẽnda kẽng n tɩ paam-a-la beenẽ.
Dẽ, Asiiri rĩmã wʋmame tɩ b yetẽ tɩ Kuus tẽng rĩm a Tiraka watame n na n wa zab ne yẽnda. La Asiiri rĩmã sẽn wʋm woto, a tʋma koe-toagsdb rĩm a Ezekɩyaas nengẽ tɩ b tɩ yeel-a yaa:
«Kẽng-y n tɩ yeel-y Zʋʋda rĩm a Ezekɩyaas yaa: Ra bas tɩ Wẽnnaam ning fo sẽn teegã belg foom, n yeel tɩ Asiiri rĩmã kõn tõog n deeg Zeruzalɛm ye!»
Fo mengã wʋma Asiiri rĩm-dãmbã sẽn dag n maan tẽms a taabã fãa bũmb ningã. B sãam-b-la zãnga. Tɩ fo tagsdẽ tɩ f na n põsame!
Dẽ yĩnga, Goozã ne Haarã la Retsɛf ne Edɛn nebã sẽn be Telasaarã, sẽn yaa buud toay-toay nins mam ba-rãmbã sẽn sãamã wẽnnaam-dãmb tõog n fãag-b lame sɩda?
Hamat rĩmã ne Arpaad rĩmã la Sefarvayim tẽng rĩmã ne Hena rĩma la Iva rĩmã bee yɛɛnẽ?
Rĩm a Ezekɩyaas reega sebrã koe-toagsdbã nugẽ n karme, la a yik n kẽng Sẽn-Ka-Saab roogẽ wã n tɩ lak sebrã Sẽn-Ka-Saab taoore.
Rĩm a Ezekɩyaas pʋʋsa Sẽn-Ka-Saab n yeel yaa:
«Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã sẽn yaa Israyɛll Wẽnnaam, n zao serubẽ-rãmb zugu, yaa yãmb y yembr bal n yaa dũniyã soolem-dãmbã fãa Wẽnnaam, yaa yãmb n naan yĩngr la tẽnga.
Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, kɩll-y y tʋbr n kelge! Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, puk-y y nin n gese! Kelg-y goam nins fãa a Senakeriib sẽn tʋm n tʋʋsd yãmb a Wẽnnaam sẽn vɩ wã!
Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, yaa sɩd tɩ Asiiri rĩm-dãmbã sãama soolem-dãmbã ne b tẽmsã zãnga,
n wʋk b wẽnnaam-dãmbã n yõog bugum, n menes-b zãnga. Sɩdã, wẽnnaam-bãmb rag n ka wẽnnaam-dãmb sɩd-sɩd ye. Bala, rag n yaa raad ne kug wẽn-naands ninsaalb nus sẽn maane.
Moasã, Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa tõnd Wẽnnaam, fãag-y tõnd a Senakeriib nugẽ, tɩ dũniyã soolem-dãmbã fãa bãng tɩ yaa yãmb a Sẽn-Ka-Saab y yembr bal n yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saabo!»
Dẽ, a Amots biig a Ezayi tʋmame tɩ b tɩ yeel rĩm a Ezekɩyaas yaa: «Ad koɛɛg ning Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa Israyɛll Wẽnnaamã, fo sẽn pʋʋs a soab Asiiri rĩm a Senakeriib wɛɛngẽ wã la woto:
Ad sɩbgr gomd Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn gom yẽnda wɛɛngẽ n yetẽ: ‹Sɩyõ tẽn-neere, a yaanda foom, la a paoogd foom, Zeruzalɛm tẽn-neere, a bee fo poorẽ n gõmsda a zugu.
Yaa ãnda la fo sẽn tʋʋs la f paoogã? Yaa ne ãnda la fo sẽn zẽk f koɛɛgã? Fo zẽka f neng yĩngr n zabd ne Israyɛll Pʋ-Peelem-Soabã!

Fo tũnuga f tʋmtʋmdbã n paoog Sẽn-Ka-Saab n yeele: Mam sẽn tar saar-dãmb wʋsgã yĩnga, mam tõog n dʋʋ tãms sẽn lug zutu, n tõog n ta hal Libã yaangã. Mam kɛɛ yẽnda sɛɛdr tɩ-wogdã, ne a sɩprɛs tɩɩs nins sẽn yaa neeb n yɩɩdã, mam tãaga a yaoolem tʋg-bɛdã sẽn be tãmsã zutã.
Mam tuu buls n yũ b koom, mam nao na n kʋɩɩsa Nill kʋɩlgã ko-soayã fãa koom.
Fo ka bãng tɩ yaa hal daar zãr la mam segl bõn-kãensã, la mam maana bãmb hal kʋdem-wẽndẽ? Moasã, mam kɩtdame tɩ b paamd pidsgu, fo tʋʋmd yaa f kɩt tɩ tẽms nins sẽn tar pãngã lebg raboodo.
Tẽn-bãmb nebã ka tar pãng ye, rabeem la yãnd n tar-ba. Bãmb wẽnda wa moog sẽn be weoogẽ, la wa mo-maasa, la wa gãosg zug moogo, la wa weoog pʋgẽ moog sẽn kʋɩ n ka paam n bɩ ye.
Gese, mam mii fo zĩndg wakate, la f yiib ne f kõom wakate. Mam leb n mii wakat ning fo sẽn gʋngde, n dat n zab ne maamã.
Bala, fo yika f sũur ne maam, la fo wuk-m-men-goamã zẽk n taa mam tʋbẽ, mam na n dɩka m bãngã n sog fo yõorã, la m ning fo noorã salbre, n kɩt tɩ f lebg n tũ sor ning fo sẽn tũ n wa wã n lebe.› »
Ad bãnd ning mam sẽn kõt foom a Ezekɩyaase: Rõandã, nebã na n dɩɩ ka-yiisdim, la vẽere, b na n dɩɩ ka-yogdo, la yʋʋm-yɩta, bʋd-y-yã la y tigsi, la y sel reezẽ tɩɩs n dɩ b biisi.
Neb nins sẽn põs Zʋʋda buudã sʋk n ketẽ wã, na n kɩɩ yẽg tẽn-gãongã pʋga, la b na n woma biis b wilã zutu.
Bala, Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã nonglem-kãsengã na n kɩtame tɩ bu-kell yi Zeruzalɛm, la tɩ neb sẽn põs yi Sɩyõ tãngã zugu.

Bõn-kãng yĩng kɩtame tɩ Sẽn-Ka-Saab gom Asiiri rĩmã wɛɛngẽ n yeele: ‹Yẽnda ka na n kẽ tẽn-kãngã pʋg ye, la a kõn tol n tão peemd ye. Yẽnda kõn tol n zẽk a gãong ye, la a kõn tol n zam tom-dʋr n zab ne-a ye.
Yẽnda sẽn tũ sor ning n wa wã, a na n lebg n tũu so-kãng n lebe, la yẽnda kõn tol n kẽ tẽn-kãngã pʋg ye. Maam a Sẽn-Ka-Saab n yeele.
Mam na n kogla tẽn-kãngã n fãag-a, mam mengã yʋʋrã yĩnga, la m tʋmtʋmd a Davɩɩd yĩnga.›
La Sẽn-Ka-Saab malɛɛkã yiime n kẽng Asiiri nebã tãb-sikẽ, n tɩ kʋ raop tus koabg la pis-nii la a nu. B sẽn yik yibeoogo, b mikame tɩ bãmb fãa yaa kũum n dʋrẽ!
Dẽ, Asiiri rĩm a Senakeriib lebg n kẽng n tɩ zĩnda Niniivi.

La yẽnda sẽn wa n be a wẽn-naandg a Nisrok pʋʋsg roogẽ wã, yẽnda kambã, a Adarmelɛk ne a Sarɛtsɛɛr kẽng n tɩ kʋ-a-la ne zabr sʋʋga, la b bas n zoe n kẽng Araara tẽnga. La a biig a Asaradon n led yẽnda zĩigẽ n lebg rĩma.

Wakat-kãnga, rĩm a Ezekɩyaas lʋɩɩ bãag sẽn dat n kʋ-a. La a Amots biig a Ezayi sẽn yaa Wẽnnaam no-rɛɛsã wa n yeel-a lame yaa: «Ade, Sẽn-Ka-Saab yetame: Maneg f zakã yɛla. Bala, fo ka na n leb n vɩɩmd ye. Fo na n kiime.»
Rĩm a Ezekɩyaas wẽnemda a neng n tees roogã lalgã, n pʋʋs Sẽn-Ka-Saab n yeele:
Yẽnda pʋʋsame n yeele: «Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, m kotame tɩ y tẽeg m yelle, m kotame tɩ y tẽeg tɩ mam dag n tũuda yãmb ne sɩda la ne m sũur fãa, la mam maana sẽn noom yãmba!» La a Ezekɩyaas yãba nintãm wʋsgo.
Dẽ, Sẽn-Ka-Saab goma ne a Ezayi n yeele:
«Kẽng n tɩ yeel a Ezekɩyaas tɩ Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa yẽnda ba a Davɩɩd Wẽnnaamã yetame: ‹Mam wʋma fo pʋʋsgã, mam yãnda fo nintãmã. Mam paasda fo vɩɩmã yʋʋm piig la a nu.
Mam na n fãaga foom ne tẽn-kãngã Asiiri rĩmã nugẽ. Mam na n kogla tẽn-kãngã.› »
A Ezayi yeelame: «Ad bãnd ning Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn kõt foom n wilgdẽ tɩ b na n maana wa b sẽn yeelã:
‹Mam na n kɩtame tɩ wĩndgã targe, tɩ maasmã leb poorẽ nao-yakem piig a Akaaz rʋʋdgã zugu. La wĩndgã targ n leba poorẽ nao-yakem piig rʋʋdgã zugu.› »
Zʋʋda rĩm a Ezekɩyaas sũur gomde. Yaa yẽnda sẽn lʋɩ bãagã n ka ki wã poore.
Mam dag n yeta m meng yaa: «Mam vɩɩmã sẽn wa n noomẽ wã, la mam na n loog n kẽng kɩɩm-kulg rignoorẽ. Mam ka paam m yʋʋmã sẽn ketã ye!»
Mam dag n yetame: «Mam ka na n tol n leb n yãnd Sẽn-Ka-Saab nin-vɩɩs sʋk dũni ka ye. Mam ka na n leb n yãnd ned ninsaalb sʋk dũni ka ye!
B viiga mam doogã n zãag ne maam, wa b sẽn viig pe-kɩɩm fu-roogo. Mam vɩɩmã tata a tɛk wa sʋn-wʋgd sẽn wãagd a gĩsga. B yiisa maam m tʋʋmd pʋga. Wĩndg sẽn wat n na n kẽ tɩ yãmb baasa maam!
Beoogã ne a na n vẽege, tɩ yãmb baasa maam. Bãmb wõra mam kõabã wa gɩgemd sẽn wõrd kõaba. Wĩndg sẽn wat n na n kẽ tɩ yãmb baasa maam!
Mam fɩɩnda wa sɩlaalle, mam wũusda wa manwalle. M nimbãanega pʋga, mam zẽkda m neng yĩngri. Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, sõng-y maam tɩ m namsdame!
Mam na n yeelame tɩ bõe? Bãmb leoka maam, la yaa bãmb mengã n maane. Mam na n kẽna ne sik-m-meng m vɩɩmã tɛka, toog sẽn tar maamã yĩnga.
Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, yaa yãmb sõmblmã n kɩtd tɩ nebã vɩ. Bãmb yĩng n kɩt tɩ mam tar vɩɩm. Yãmb leb n vigla maam n kõ maam vɩɩm.
Mam sũ-sãangã tekame n lebg vɩ-bãane. Yãmb yamã loee ne maam hal tɩ y fãag-m ne yaoogo, bala, yãmb loba mam yel-wẽnã y zãnkuidgẽ.
Bala, ka kɩɩm-kulg n na pẽg yãmb ye, leb n ka kũum n na n waoog yãmb ye. Neb nins sẽn sigd-b bokẽ wã ka leb n maand tẽeb ne yãmb sɩdã ye.
Ad yaa nin-vɩɩsã bal n tõe n pẽg yãmb wa mam sẽn pẽgd yãmb dũndã wã. Ba-rãmb na n kɩtame tɩ b kamb bãng yãmb sɩdã.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab fãaga maam! Tõnd na n wẽ d yʋʋm-teedã Sẽn-Ka-Saab roogã pʋg daar fãa n tãag d vɩɩmã tɛka.»
A Ezayi rag n yeelame: «Bao-y kankam-koeems n to n wa bɛ nod-kɛgengã, la a Ezekɩyaas na n põsame.»
A Ezekɩyaas rag n sokame tɩ bãnd ning sẽn wilgd tɩ yẽnda na n leb n kẽnga Sẽn-Ka-Saab roogẽ wã yaa bʋgo.
Wakat-kãnga, a Baladan biig a Merodak-Baladan sẽn yaa Babilond dĩmã tʋma neb a Ezekɩyaas nengẽ ne sebre, la kũuni. Bala, yẽnda wʋmame t'a Ezekɩyaas lʋɩɩ bãaga, la a leb n paama laafɩ.

A Ezekɩyaas sũur yɩɩ noog ne bõn-kãnga. Yẽnda wilga b sẽn tʋm-b rãmbã yẽnda arzɛkã bĩngr zĩisã, wanzuri wã ne sãnemã, la parfẽ-rãmb sẽn tar yũ-noogã, ne kaam toay-toayã, la ne a zab-teedã fãa bĩngr zĩiga, ne teed nins fãa sẽn be yẽnda laogã bĩngr zĩigẽ wã. Bũmb ka be a Ezekɩyaas zakẽ wã ne a soolmẽ wã, t'a ka wilg neb nins Babilond dĩmã sẽn tʋmã ye.

Dẽ, Wẽnnaam no-rɛɛs a Ezayi waa rĩm a Ezekɩyaas nengẽ n wa yeel-a yaa: «Nin-bãmbã wa n yeelame tɩ bõe? La b yii yɛɛnẽ?» A Ezekɩyaas leokame yaa: «Bãmb yii tẽn-zãrga, b yii Babilond soolmẽ wã n wa n na n yãnd maam.»
A Ezayi leb n sokame yaa: «Bãmb yãnda bõe fo zakẽ wã?» La a Ezekɩyaas leokame: «Bãmb yãnda bũmb ning fãa sẽn be mam zakẽ wã. Bũmb ka be mam laogã bĩngr zĩigẽ mam sẽn ka wilg-b ye.»
Woto, a Ezayi yeela a Ezekɩyaas yaa: «Bɩ y kelg Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã koɛɛga!
Daar n wate, tɩ b na n wʋk bũmb ning fãa sẽn be fo zakẽ wã, ne fo yaab-rãmbã sẽn dag n bĩng bũmb ning hal tɩ ta rũndã wã n tall n kẽng Babilonde. Bũmb kõn tol n kell ye. Yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab n yeele.»
B na n yõga kom-dibli nins sẽn yaa yãmb meng kom-dogdsã n tall n loog tɩ b tɩ lebg zu-soben-dãmb Babilond dĩmã na-yir pʋga.
A Ezekɩyaas leoka a Ezayi yaa: «Sẽn-Ka-Saab koɛɛg ning fo sẽn togsã yaa sõama.» A leb n yeelame: «Bala, mam sẽn ket n vɩ wã wakate, na n yɩɩ vɩ-bãane, la laafɩ.»
Yãmb Wẽnnaamã yetame: «Bels-y mam nebã, bels-y-ba.
Gom-y n paas-y Zeruzalɛm daoodo, moon-y n yeel-y t'a yembdã sɛɛme, t'a paama a kongrã sugri, t'a zoe n deega a yel-wẽnã sɩbgr naoor a yiib Sẽn-Ka-Saab nengẽ.»
Ned n kelemd n yetẽ: «Tuk-y Sẽn-Ka-Saab sor we-raoogã pʋga! Kõog-y so-kõodr tẽn-nabd-koɛɛngẽ wã tõnd Wẽnnaamã yĩnga!
Bɩ y sĩd londã, la y sarem tãmsã ne kunkubã fãa! Kɩt-y tɩ tãn-bɛda lebg zĩ-pɛɛla, la y kɩt tɩ tãmsã sẽgsã lebg zĩ-yalemse!
Dẽ, Sẽn-Ka-Saab ziirã na n pukame, tɩ nebã fãa naag taab n yãnd-a.» Yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab meng noor n yeele.
Koɛɛg n yet yaa: «Moone!» Tɩ b soke: «M moon n yeel tɩ bõe?» T'a yeele: «Moon n yeel tɩ ninsaal buud fãa yaa wa moodo, la a neermã fãa wẽnda weoog mo-pui.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab sebgã sã n wẽ moodã, a kʋɩtame, la a mo-pui wã zelgdame. Sɩd-sɩdã, nebã wẽnda moodo.
Mood kʋɩtame, la mo-pui zelgdame. La tõnd Wẽnnaamã gomd paada wakat fãa!»

Sɩyõ-rãmba, yãmb sẽn yaa b rãmb sẽn wat ne koe-noogã, rʋ-y tãn-lug-lug zugu. Zeruzalɛm, zẽk f koɛɛg ne pãnga, fo sẽn wat ne koe-noogã. Zẽk f koɛɛg la f ra zoe rabeem ye. Yeel Zʋʋda tẽmsã yaa: «Yãmb Wẽnnaamã beeme!»
Zu-soab a Sẽn-Ka-Saab wata ne pãnga, bãmb yãoog pãng tõeeme tɩ b rɩ naam. Ade, bãmb zãada b yaood n watẽ, bãmb keoor dengda bãmb taoore.
Bãmb dɩlgda b nebã wa pe-kɩɩm sẽn wãbenegd a rũmsi, bãmb na n tẽega b nug n tigim b piisã, n kãag-b n mobg b menga. Bãmb lekda pe-yãansã sẽn yẽsemd kambã.
Ãnda soab n mak ko-kãsengã ne a nug pʋga? Ãnda n mak yĩngr ne nug-yakemde? Ãnda n mak tẽn-gãongã tom fãa ne makdga? Ãnda n dɩk tãmsã ne kunkubã n ning zɩslem makdg pʋg n make?
Ãnda n mak Sẽn-Ka-Saab Sɩɩgã, la ãnda n yaa bãmb sagenda?
Wẽnnaam zĩnd n yẽsa ne ãnda n na n paam n wʋm bũmb võore? Ãnda n zãms bãmb zemsgo? Ãnda n zãms bãmb bãngre? Ãnda n kɩt tɩ bãmb bãng yam sore?
Bu-zẽmsã wẽnda wa koom sẽn be yʋʋr pʋg n tosdẽ, bãmb sõorã zemsa wa wubsg sẽn be zɩslem makdg zugu. Tẽms nins koom sẽn gũbgã yaa faasg wa wubsg sẽn dukda.
Libã tɩɩsã raad ka sekd bugum yõgneg ye. La a rũmsã ka sekd maoong sẽn yõogd bugum maaneg ye.
Bu-zẽmsã fãa yaa zaalem bãmb taoore. Bãmb geta bu-zẽmsã wa zaalem la vɩʋʋgo.
Ãnda la yãmb na n dɩk n mak ne Wẽnnaam? Yãmb na n dɩka bõe n wẽneg Wẽnnaam?
Tʋʋm-mit n maand bõn-naandga, tɩ yõak bolg-a ne sãnem n bao wanzuri yãmd n ning-a.
Ned sã n yaa naong soab tɩ looge, n ka tõe n maan kũun-kãnga, a baooda raoog sẽn ka põogda, n kɩs tʋʋm-mit t'a maan bõn-naandg sẽn ka yẽrgda.
Yãmb ka mi la? Yãmb ka wʋm la? B ka reng n togs yãmb bõn-kãens hal sɩngr wẽndẽ la? Yãmb ka wʋm dũniyã yẽbgr võor la?
Bãmb bee dũni gilgã zugẽ, n get dũni-kãngã nebã tɩ b yaa wa sʋyã. Bãmb yɛdga sa-gãongã wa peen-faasga, bãmb yɛdg-a lame tɩ lebg wa fu-roog n na n zĩnd a pʋgẽ.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab n kɩt tɩ nanambs lebg zaalem, n kɩt tɩ dũni bʋ-kaoodb lebg ka võore.
B sẽn nan ka sel bãmba, la b sẽn nan ka bʋd bãmba, la bãmb sẽn nan ka kɩ yẽga, Sẽn-Ka-Saab fʋʋs bãmb zug tɩ b kʋɩ. Sob-kãseng n wa n dɩk bãmb wa moodo.
Pʋ-Peelem-Soabã sokdame yaa: «Ãnda la y na n dɩk n mak maam, n tags tɩ mam wẽnda a soaba?
Zẽk-y y nens n ges yĩngri! Ãnda soab n naan bõn-kãensã fãa n kɩt tɩ b fãa pukd wa tãb-biisi? Bãmb boonda ned kam fãa ne a yʋʋre, la yaa ne bãmb pãn-tõ-kãsengã ne b pãn-kãsengã.»
A Zakoob yagense, Israyɛll buudu, bõe yĩng tɩ yãmb yetẽ tɩ: «Mam beoog vɩɩmã solga ne Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, mam sẽn segd n paam bũmb ningã loogdame tɩ mam Wẽnnaamã ka miẽ ye?»

Fo ka mi bõn-kãng la? Fo ka wʋm bõn-kãng la? Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa Wẽnnaamã sẽn paad wakat fãa wã n naan dũniyã ween-vɩɩsã fãa. Bãmb pãng ka sɛta, la b ka yɛɛd me ye. Ned ka tõe n bãng bãmb yamã tɛk ye.
Bãmb kõta ned ning sẽn yɛ wã pãnga, la ned ning pãng sẽn booge, bãmb paasda a soab pãnga.
Kom-pogd pãng boogdame tɩ b yɛ, kom-bɩɩs wat n baas n lʋɩɩme.
Sẽn tẽed-b Sẽn-Ka-Saabã pãng palemdame. Bãmb yɩgda wa pa-nand-tugri, bãmb zoetame n ka yɛɛdẽ ye, bãmb kẽndame la b pãng ka sɛt ye!
Tẽms nins koom sẽn gũbgi, bas-y bʋʋr n kelg maam! Bɩ nebã keng b pelse, bɩ b kolg n gome! Bɩ d kolg n bʋ ne taaba.

Yaa ãnda n yik yaang raoã sẽn yaa soab ning sẽn paamd tõogr zĩig ning fãa yẽnda naoor sẽn tabgẽ wã? Ãnda n dɩk soolem-dãmb n ning yẽnda nugẽ, la b sik rĩm-dãmbã? Yẽnda zabr sʋʋgã neema bãmb wa wubsgu, yẽnda tãpã kɩtame tɩ bãmb lebg wa mood sobg sẽn dɩkda.
Raoã rigd-b lame n pɩʋʋg b sʋk n loog ne tõogre, n tũ sor ning yẽnda naoor sẽn zɩ n tabgẽ wã.
Ãnda n tʋme, ãnda n maan bõn-kãnga? Yaa soab ning sẽn kɩt-a tɩ zamaan fãa be hal sɩngr wẽndẽ wã. Maam a Sẽn-Ka-Saab yaa dẽenem soaba, la mam bee ne yaoolem-dãmbã me.
Tẽms nins koom sẽn gũbgã yãnd-b lame tɩ rabeem yõk-ba. Dũniyã ween-vɩɩsã fãa rigdame. Bãmb fãa kolgdame, b watame.
Bãmb sõngda taaba, tɩ ned kam fãa yet a to yaa: «Keng f pɛlga!»

Tʋʋm-mit paasda sẽn yẽnegd-a kutã raoodo. Sẽn zãad-a zãar n kutẽ wã paasda a to pãnga. Yẽnda yeta sẽn sũgunda wã yaa: «Yaa sõama» La bãmb kaada wẽn-naandgã ne põent-rãmba, sẽn na n yɩl t'a ra miim ye.
La foom a Israyɛll sẽn yaa mam tʋmtʋmdã, foom a Zakoob mam sẽn yãkã, fo yaa mam zoa a Abrahaam yagenga!
Maam n yãk foom dũniyã ween-vɩɩsã fãa pʋgẽ, la m bool foom tɩ f yi zĩ-zãrsẽ n wa, n yeel foom yaa: «Fo yaa mam tʋmtʋmda, maam n yãk foom, mam kõn bas foom ye!
Da zoe rabeem ye, bala, mam bee ne foom. Da maan yɩɩr ye, bala, mam yaa fo Wẽnnaam. Mam kõta foom pãnga, la m na n wa sõnga foom, mam na n tebenda foom ne m nug-rɩtg sẽn tõogdã.
Neb nins fãa sũy sẽn puud ne foomã na n paama yãnd ne paoogre. Sẽn zabd-b ne foomã na n lebga zaalem n meneme.
Fo na n gẽesa f zabd-n-taasã n ka yãnd ye, B na n sãama bãmb tɩ b lebg zaalem la vɩʋʋgo.
Bala, mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa fo Wẽnnaam, soab ning sẽn gãta fo nug-rɩtg n yet-f yaa: Da zoe rabeem ye. Mam wat n na n sõnga foom.
Zakoobe, fo sẽn yaa wa zũnzuur balã, da zoe rabeem ye, Israyɛlle, fo yaa zũnzuur bala. Mam wa n na n sõnga foom. Yaa maam a Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa fo fãagda, n yaa Israyɛll Pʋ-Peelem-Soabã n yeele.
Gese, mam na n kɩtame tɩ fo yɩ wa soang b sẽn toose, n yaa paalle, n tar noy a yiib sẽn dɩte. Fo na n wãame, la f neem tãmse, fo na n kɩtame tɩ kunkub lebg wa wudgu.
Fo na n yelga bãmb tɩ sobg rɩk n looge, sob-kãseng na n sãeega bãmba. La sã n yaa ne foom, fo na n maana sũ-noog Sẽn-Ka-Saab yĩnga. Fo na n kɩdma Israyɛll Pʋ-Peelem-Soabã yĩnga.
Nimbãan-nebã ne naong rãmbã baooda koom n ka paamdẽ ye. Ko-yũud kʋɩɩsa bãmb zɛlma. Maam a Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n leoka bãmba. Maam a Israyɛll Wẽnnaamã ka na n bas-b ye.
Mam na n kɩtame tɩ kʋɩls ko-zoetem pus n yi soay kɩremse, la m kɩt tɩ ko-budum yi tãms lond pʋse. Mam na n teka we-raoogã t'a lebg kʋɩlga, la m tek tẽn-koɛɛngã t'a lebg ko-budum zĩiga.
Mam na n sela sɛɛdr tɩɩse, ne akasɩya tɩɩse, la miir la oliiv tɩɩs we-raoogã pʋga. Mam na n lagma sɩprɛs tɩɩse, orme tɩɩs ne tɩɩs buud toay-toay n sel Araba tẽn-nabd-koɛɛngẽ zugu.
Tɩ bãmb fãa tõe n yãnd la b bãnge, la b naag taab n tags n bãng tɩ yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab nug n maan bõn-kãng fãa, la b tõe n bãng tɩ yaa Israyɛll Pʋ-Peelem-Soabã n naan yẽnda.»
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yeelame: «gom-y n fãag-y y menga. A zakoob rĩmã yetame yaa: ‹wa-y ne kaseto.
Bɩ b kolg n gome. La bɩ b togs tõnd bũmb ning sẽn na n wa zĩndi. Togs-y sẽn loog pĩnda, Togs-y tõnd bũmb ning sẽn zĩnd pĩnda, dẽ, tõnd na n tags n bãnga sẽn wate. Wall y wilg tõnd yɛl nins sẽn wate.
Togs-y bũmb nins sẽn nan be taoor n watẽ wã, dẽ, tõnd na n bãngame tɩ yãmb yaa wẽnnaam-dãmba. Bɩ y maan bũmb sẽn yaa sõama bɩ wẽnga, tɩ tõnd fãa tõe n puk d nin n yãnde.
Gese, yãmb yaa zaalem bala, la yãmb tʋʋmã me yaa zaalem tɩ ned ka mi-b ye. Sẽn yãk-a yãmb tɩ y yaa a wẽnnaamã maana yel-beedo.
Mam kɩtame tɩ ned yi hal nug-rɩtg sẽnẽ n wa. Sẽn yit-a hal yaangã pʋʋsda ne mam yʋʋre, yẽnda na n taba nanambsã wa tãndo, a na n tab-b-la wa yagb sẽn tabd yagd to-to wã.
Ãnda n togs-a hal sɩngr wẽndẽ tɩ tõnd bãng tɩ ket n zãra? Ãnda n togs bõn-kãng tɩ tõnd bãng n yeel tɩ yaa tɩrga? Ned ba a yembr ka togs-a ye, ned ka maan tɩ d wʋm ye, la ned ka wʋmd yãmb goam ye.»
Soab ning sẽn yɩ-a pipi n wa Sɩyõ wã yetame: «Bãmb bee ka!» Mam tʋma ned Zeruzalɛm t'a tɩ togs koe-noogo.
Mam gesame la ned ka be ye. Ned ka be bãmb sʋkã n tõe n kõ saglg ye. Mam dag na n sokẽ-la bãmb tɩ b leok-ma!
Bãmb fãa yaa zaalem, bãmb tʋʋmã yaa zaalem. Bãmb wẽn-naandsã yaa wa sobg la vɩʋʋgo.
Ad mam tʋmtʋmd mam sẽn sõngda, yaa mam nin-tũusdg mam sẽn nonge. Mam ninga m sɩɩgã yẽnda zugu. Yẽnda na n kɩtame tɩ tɩrlem zĩnd bu-zẽmsã sʋka.
Yẽnda ka na n kelem wall zẽk a koɛɛg ye. Ned kõn wʋm yẽnda koɛɛg soay zut ye.
Yẽnda ka na n kaoog tãnwĩig ning sẽn gõdã ye. Yẽnda ka na n kiis fɩtl bugum sẽn dat n ki ye. La a na n kɩtame tɩ bʋ-kao-tɩrg zĩndi.
Yẽnda pãng ka na n sɛ, la a raood ka na n booge, hal t'a wa kɩt tɩ tɩrlem zĩnd dũni zugu. Bala, tẽms nins koom sẽn gũbgã gũuda yẽnda tõogã.

Ade, Wẽnnaam Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn naan saasẽ n ning a zĩigẽ wã, la b yɛdg tẽn-gãongã ne a pʋgẽ teedã, n yaa soab ning sẽn kõt nebã sẽn be a pʋgẽ wã vɩɩmã, la b kɩt tɩ bũmb nins sẽn saagd tẽn-gãongã zugã tar vʋʋsmã yetame:
«Maam a Sẽn-Ka-Saab n bool foom tɩrlem yĩnga, la mam gãda fo nugu, la m gũuda foom n na n kɩt tɩ f yɩ kaool buud a taabã yĩnga, la f yɩ vẽenem bu-zẽmsã yĩnga,
n kɩt tɩ zoens nin pugsi, la f yiis yembs bi-bees roogẽ, la f yiis b sẽn balg b rãmb lik-bida pʋgẽ wã.
Mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, mam yʋʋr la woto. Mam kõn dɩk m ziirã n kõ ned a to ye, la m kõn dɩk m waoogrã n kõ wẽn-naands ye.
Bũmb nins sẽn zĩnd pĩndã loogame, moasã, mam togsda yãmb yel-paala, la mam wilgd-b-la yãmb tɩ b nan ka wa ye.»
Yɩɩl-y yɩɩn-paalg Sẽn-Ka-Saab yĩnga, yɩɩl-y n pẽg-y bãmb dũni ween-vɩɩsã fãa pʋga. Bɩ sẽn kẽnd-b ko-kãsengã zugã, la yãmb dãmb sẽn be tẽms koom sẽn gũbg pʋgẽ wã ne y nebã, pẽg-y Sẽn-Ka-Saabo!
Bɩ we-raoogã ne a tẽmsã, ne Kedaar nebã sẽn be tẽn-bãoonegã pʋgẽ wã zẽk b koeese! Bɩ Sela tẽng nebã kaas ne sũ-noogo! Bɩ b pa tãmsã zut n kaas tõogr kaasgo!
Bɩ b waoog Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, la bɩ b pẽg bãmb tẽms nins koom sẽn gũbgã pʋga!
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yita wa gãndaoogo, bãmb yaa wa tãpsoab sẽn nong zabre. Bãmb kaasda zabr kaasgo, bãmb kelemdame, bãmb tõogda b bɛɛbã.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yeelame: «Mam sĩnda m noor hal daar zãra, mam yõka m meng n ka gom ye. Mam dag n yãbda wa pag sẽn kũmd dogem. Mam dag n sesdame tɩ mam vʋʋsmã rat n yõke.
Mam na n kɩtame tɩ tãmsã ne kunkubã lebg we-raoogo, mam na n kɩtame tɩ mo-maasã fãa kʋɩ. Mam na n kɩtame tɩ tẽn-koɛɛng puk kʋɩlg pʋgẽ, la m kɩt tɩ kʋɩlsã koom kʋɩ.

Mam na n kɩtame tɩ zoens kẽn sor b sẽn dag n ka mi zugu. Mam na n tall-b lame n tũ so-bugs b sẽn dag n ka mi pʋga. Mam na n kɩtame tɩ lik-bida lebg vẽenem bãmb taoore, la m kɩt tɩ so-rʋdã lebg saalga. Mam na n maana bõn-kãngã, la m ka na n tol n bas bãmb ye.
Neb nins sẽn dɩk b teegr n teeg bõn-naandsã, ne neb nins sẽn get wẽn-naandsã b sẽn naan ne kutã n yetẽ tɩ bãmb n yaa b wẽnnaam-dãmbã na n targame n paam yãnde.»
Wʋmse, kelg-y-yã! Zoense, puk-y y nin n gese!
Ãnda n yaa zoang tɩ sã n ka mam tʋmtʋmdã? Ãnda n yaa wʋng wa koe-toagsd ning mam sẽn tʋmã? Ãnda n yaa zoang wa soab ning sẽn paam vɩ-bãanã, n yaa zoang wa Sẽn-Ka-Saab tʋmtʋmdã?
Fo yãnda bũmb wʋsgo, la fo ka maan gũusg ye. Fo yoka f tʋb n yaool n ka wʋm ye.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab tɩrlmã yĩnga, taa bãmb yam tɩ b kɩt tɩ tõogã yɩ kãsenga, n yaa sõama.

B fãa nin-kãense, la b zɛ b teedã! B bẽda bãmb fãa n yõg n tɩ pag bokẽ, b tɩ pʋga bãmb bi-bees roogẽ. B fãa bãmba, tɩ ned ka be n na n fãag-b ye! B zɛɛ bãmb teedã, tɩ ned ka be n na n yeel tɩ b lebs ye!
Ãnda n be yãmb sʋkã n na n sak n kelg bõn-kãnga? Ãnda soab n na n yok a tʋbr n kelg sẽn wat beoogã?

Ãnda n bas a Zakoob yagensã fãadb nugẽ, la ãnda n bas tɩ b zɛ Israyɛll nebã? Ka Sẽn-Ka-Saab la? La ka tõnd n beeg bãmb la? Woto fãa yaa bãmb sẽn ka tʋlg n na n tũ Sẽn-Ka-Saab soayã, la b ka kelg bãmb tõodã.
Rẽ kɩtame tɩ Sẽn-Ka-Saab sik b sũ-puugrã Israyɛll nebã zugu, la b tʋm zabr bãmb yĩnga. Zabrã widga zĩig fãa tɩ bãmb ka wʋmd a võor ye. A sãama bãmba, la bãmb ka bao yam ye.
Moasã, Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa soab ning sẽn naan-a foom a Zakoobã, sẽn naan-a foom a Israyɛllã yetame: «Da zoe rabeem ye. Bala, mam fãagda foom. Mam boonda foom ne f yʋʋre, fo yaa maam dẽnda!
Fo sã n pɩʋʋgd koom, mam na n zĩnda ne foom. Fo sã n dʋʋgd kʋɩlse, koomã ka na n loog ne foom ye. Fo na n kẽna bugum pʋga, la bugmã kõn dɩ foom ye, bug-witmã kõn sãam foom ye.
Bala, mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa fo Wẽnnaam, Israyɛll Pʋ-Peelem-Soabã yaa fo fãagda. Mam dɩka Ezɩpt n yao n deeg foom, la m dɩk Kuus ne Seba n kɩs fo zĩigẽ.
Fo sẽn tar yõod mam nifẽ wã yĩnga, b sẽn waoog foomã, la mam sẽn nong-fã yĩnga, mam dɩka neb n kɩs fo zĩigẽ, n dɩk buud n yao fo vɩɩmã yĩnga.
Da yɛɛs ye. Bala, mam bee ne foom. Mam na n talla fo yagensã sẽn be yaangã n wa, la m kɩt tɩ fo nebã yi nin-taoor n wa tigim taaba.
Mam na n yeela rɩtg rãmbã tɩ b kɩs-yã! La m yeel goabg rãmbã tɩ b ra gɩdg-y ye! B kɩt tɩ mam kom-dibli wã yi tẽn-zãrsẽ n wa, la f kɩt tɩ m kom-pugli wã yi dũniyã kɩremsã n wa.
Yaa neb nins fãa sẽn boond mam yʋʋrã, mam sẽn naan-b rãmb mam waoogr yĩngã, neb nins sẽn yaa mam nus tʋʋmdã.»
Bɩ b kɩt tɩ nin-bãmb sẽn yaa zoensã wa! Baa ne b sẽn tar ninã, b ka ne ye. Baa ne b sẽn tar tʋbã, b ka wʋmd ye.

Bɩ soolem-dãmbã fãa wa tigim taaba. La bɩ buudã naag taaba! Bãmb sʋkã ned a bõe n togs bãmb bõn-kãnga? La nin-bʋg bãmb sʋkã n wilg tõnd sẽn yɩ to-to pĩndã? Bɩ b wa ne b kaset rãmb tɩ b wilg tɩ yaa sɩda! Bɩ nebã kelg-b n yeel tɩ yaa sɩda!

Sẽn-Ka-Saab yetame: Yãmb yaa mam kaset dãmba, la yãmb yaa mam tʋmtʋmdb mam sẽn yãke, sẽn na n yɩl tɩ yãmb bãng tɩ y tẽeda maam, n miẽ tɩ yaa maam, la sẽn deng maam, Wẽnnaam a to ka be b sẽn naanẽ, la a to me ka be sẽn na n leb n zĩnd ye.
Yaa maam bala, maam m yembr bal n yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saabo. Sã n ka maam, fãagd a to ka be ye.
Maam n wilgi, maam n fãage, ka wẽnnaam-sãang n be yãmb sʋkã ye. Dẽ wã, yãmb yaa mam kaset dãmba, tɩ yaa maam la Wẽnnaam. Maam a Sẽn-Ka-Saab n yeele!
Hal sẽn sɩng badaare, yaa maam, la ned ka tõe n deeg bũmb mam nugẽ ye. Mam sã n maan tʋʋmde, ãnda n tõe n kɩɩse?

Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa yãmb fãagda, n yaa Israyɛll Pʋ-Peelem-Soabã yetame: «Yaa yãmb yĩng la mam sẽn tʋm ned t'a zab ne Babilondã. Mam n na n kɩt t'a zoɛtbã lisi. Kalde-rãmbã na n lisa ne b koom kogendã sẽn kõt bãmb tõogrã.
Mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa yãmb Pʋ-Peelem-Soabã, yaa Israyɛll naandã n yaa yãmb dĩma.»
Ade, Sẽn-Ka-Saab yetame: «Bãmb n tukd sor ko-kãsengã pʋgã, bãmb n tukd so-buk koom sẽn tar pãngã zugu,
bãmb n dag n kɩt tɩ saar-dãmb ne wiid la tãb-bi-sull naag taab n zabe. Bãmb lʋɩɩme n ka na n tol n leb n yik ye. B kiime, bãmb dɩɩ bugum wa fɩtl gĩsga.
Da-y leb-y n tags-y sẽn loogã yelle, la y ra leb n geelg bõn-kʋdã ye.
Ade, mam na n maana bõn-paalse, bõn-kãng sɩngame n pukdẽ, yãmb ka ne bõn-kãng la? Mam na n pãrga sor we-raoogã pʋga, la m kɩt tɩ kʋɩls zĩnd zĩ-peen-daagẽ.
We-rũmsã na n waooga maam, yaa we-baasã ne naneendã. Bala, mam kɩtdame tɩ koom zĩnd we-raoogẽ, la m kɩtdẽ tɩ kʋɩls zĩnd zĩ-peen-daasẽ, tɩ mam nebã mam sẽn yãkã tõe n yũ.
Mam neb nins mam sẽn naanã na n pẽga maam.»
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yetame: A Zakoob yagense, ka maam la yãmb sẽn boolã ye! Israyɛll nebã, yãmb yam yii ne maam!

Yãmb ka tall y maoong peosg wall y maoong bʋʋg n wa maan maoong sẽn yõogd bugum n kõ maam ye. Yãmb maandã ka waoogd maam ye. Mam ka modg yãmb n kɩt tɩ y tall kũun n wa, m ka nams yãmb n kɩt tɩ y tall wisd n wa ye.
Yãmb ka ra parfẽ sẽn tar yũ-noog ne ligd n kõ maam ye. La y ka kõ maam yãmb maandã kaam tɩ sek-m ye. La sẽn be yaa tɩ yãmb modga maam n kẽes yembd y yel-wẽnã yĩnga, mam yɛɛ ne yãmb kongrã.
Maam m yembr bal n tõe n yẽes yãmb beegrã. La m ka na n leb n tẽeg yãmb yel-wẽnã yell ye.
Bɩ y tẽeg yell ning yãmb sẽn tar ne maamã, tɩ d bʋ ne taaba. Bɩ yãmb mengã gom n yiis y menga.
Yãmb pipi yaabã kongame, yãmb no-rɛɛsdbã kɩɩsa maam.
Dẽ, mam kɩtame tɩ y zĩ-sõngẽ nanambsã lebg bõn-dẽgdo. Mam basame tɩ kãab-wẽng paam a Zakoob yagensã, la m bas tɩ Israyɛll nebã paam tʋʋsgo.
Mam tʋmtʋmd a Zakoobe, Israyɛll nebã mam sẽn yãkã, kelg-y moasã!
Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa soab ning sẽn naan-a foomã, la a yag foom f ma pʋgẽ wã, soab ning sẽn sõngd foomã yetame: «Mam tʋmtʋmd a Zakoobe, Israyɛll nebã mam sẽn yãke, da zoe rabeem ye.
Bala, mam na n pʋdga koom tẽn-gãong sẽn kʋɩ zugu, la m kɩt tɩ kʋɩls koom zoe tẽn-koɛɛng zugu. Mam na n pʋdga m sɩɩgã yãmb kambã zugu, la m pʋdg m barkã yãmb yagensã zugu.
Bãmb na n bulame n yi moogã sʋka, wa tãnwĩis sẽn be bãoog noore.»

Ned a yembr na n yeelame yaa: «Mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab rẽnda!» Tɩ ned a to rat tɩ b bool yẽnda t'a Zakoobe. La ned a to na n gʋlsa a nug zug yaa: «Mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab n so,» la a yeel tɩ b bool yẽnda t'a Israyɛlle.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa Israyɛll nebã rĩm la b fãagdã, n yaa Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã yetame: «Mam yaa dẽenem la yaoolem. Sã n ka maam, Wẽnnaam a to ka be ye.

Ãnda soab n yaa wa maam? Bɩ a zẽk a koɛɛg n togse! A yik n yals mam taoor n togs sẽn yɩ to-to, bɩ a wilg bũmb ning sẽn zĩnd hal kʋdem-wẽndẽ, wakat ning mam sẽn vigl ninsaalbã! La a togs bũmb ning sẽn na n wa zĩndã, la a wilg bũmb ning sẽn be taoor n watẽ wã!

Da-y yɛɛs-y ye, Da-y zoe-y rabeem ye. Mam ka togs yãmb bõn-kãng hal daar zãra, la m wilg yãmb sẽn na n yɩ to-to sɩda? Yãmb yaa mam kaset dãmba. Dẽ yĩnga, Wẽnnaam a to beeme tɩ ka maam sɩda? Pĩig a to ka be ye. Mam ka mi pĩig a to sẽn be ye.

Neb nins sẽn naand-b bõn-naandsã fãa yaa zaalem. La bãmb tʋʋm nins ligd sẽn yaa toogã ka na n leb n tall nafr ye. Bãmb yaa b bõn-naandsã kaset dãmba, bõn-naandsã ka tar nini, b ka tar bãngre, la rẽ n na n yɩ b yãnde.
Ãnda n maand wẽnde wall a rõog bõn-naandg n yaool n ka na n paam nafr ne-a?
Ade, yẽnda poorẽ dãmbã fãa na n dɩɩ yãnde. Sẽn naan-b bãmbã yaa ninsaalb bala. Bɩ bãmb fãa naag taaba, bɩ b naag taab n wa, n naag taab n yɛɛs la b rɩ yãnde.
