Samaari nebã na n zoee rabeem Bet-Avɛn nag-sadsã poorẽ. Nebã na n yãb n kaasa a yĩnga. La maan-kʋʋdb nins sẽn waoogd-a wã na n diga ne rabeem a yĩnga, la a ziirã sẽn na n yi n bas-a wã yĩnga.
B na n dɩk-a lame n kõ Asiiri, t'a yɩ yaood rĩm-kãsengã yĩnga. Yãnd na n yõka Efrayiim buudã, Israyɛll saag-wẽnsã yãnd na n yõk-a lame.
Samaari wãame, la a rĩmã yaa wa tɩɩg will sẽn daeed koom zugu.
B na n sãama maoong kʋʋb zĩis nins Israyɛll sẽn dag n maand yel-wẽn-kãsemsã b zutã. Gõos ne tuud na n yii b tẽn-kugã zutu. Bãmb na n yeela tãmsã tɩ b bus-ba, la b yeel kunkubã tɩ b lʋɩ n yẽeg-ba.
Hal sẽn sɩng Gɩbeya, foom a Israyɛll maana yel-wẽna. Bãmb paa yel-wẽn-kãens pʋga, la zabrã na n paama nin-wẽnsã Gɩbeya.
Mam na n sɩbg-b-la wa m sẽn date. B beegr a yiibã yĩnga, buud toay-toay na n tigma taaba n zab ne bãmba.
A Efrayiim dag n yaa nag-sad-wubdg sẽn nong n tabd koodo. La maam n balg a yublã sẽn yaa neerã. Mam soga Efrayiim buudã ne wãka, Zʋʋda na n koome. La Zakoob buudã na n taka wãkã.
Israyɛll nebã, maan-y sẽn yaa tɩrga, la y maan sẽn zems sɩda. Tuk-y pʋ-paalle! Wakat taame tɩ y tog n bao Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, hal tɩ b wa kɩt tɩ tɩrlem zĩnd yãmb sʋka.
Yãmb bʋda wẽnga, n tigs zãmbo, Yãmb dɩɩ zĩrẽ yagb rɩɩbo. Israyɛlle, fo sẽn teeg f meng pãngã, la f teeg f gãndaadã sõorã yĩnga,
bʋr-kãseng na n yii fo nebã sʋka, la fo tẽms nins sẽn gũbg ne lalsã na n sãama wa a Salman sẽn zab ne Bɛt-Arbɛlle, n sãam-a wa b sẽn kʋ ma n naag a kambã.
Yaa woto n na n paam Betɛlle, wẽng ning yãmb sẽn maanã yĩnga. Zĩigã sã n yẽege, Israyɛll dĩmã na n sãamame.
Israyɛll sẽn dag n yaa bi-bɩɩgã wakate, Mam dag n nong-a lame. Mam zĩnda Ezɩpt n bool m biigã.
La b zãaga b mens ne sẽn boond-b bãmbã. Bãmb maana maand a Baall yĩnga. La b yõog wisd bõn-naandsã yĩnga.
Mam meng n gãd Efrayiim nebã nusi n zãms-b kẽna, la b rag n ka mi tɩ maam n tɩp-b ye.
Mam tɛɛ bãmb ne ninsaalb loeese, la mam loee bãmb ne nonglem loeese. Mam yaa soab ning sẽn sikd bãmb zɩɩbã, la mam dag n kõt-b-la rɩɩbo.
Bãmb ka na n lebg n leb Ezɩpt ye. Bãmb sẽn zãgs tɩ b ka na n lebg n wa mam nengẽ wã yĩnga, Asiiri nedã n na n yɩ bãmb dĩma.
Zab na sãama bãmb tẽmsã, la b na n menesa b kʋɩlemsã. Zabrã na n sãam-b lame, bãmb sẽn maan b mens raabã yĩnga.
Mam nebã ka rat n bas b kɩɩsgã ye. B boonda bãmb tɩ b naag taab n yiki, La bãmb ka yik ye.

Efrayiim nebã, mam na n basa yãmb wãn-wãna? Israyɛll nebã, mam na n fãaga yãmb wãn-wãna? Mam na n maana yãmba. Mam sẽn maan Adma tẽngã nebã bɩ? Mam na n kɩtame tɩ yãmb yɩ wa Seboyim nebã bɩ? Mam yam leebdame. Mam nimbãan-zoeerã paasame.

Mam ka na n maan wa sẽn zems m sũ-puugrã ye, mam ka na n lebg n wa n sãam Efrayiim nebã ye, bala, mam ka ninsaal ye, mam yaa Wẽnnaam. Mam yaa pʋ-peelem soab n be yãmb sʋka, Mam ka na n lebg n wa tẽngã pʋg ne sũ-puugr ye.
Bãmb na n tũu Sẽn-Ka-Saabo. Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n kelma wa gɩgemde, La b kambã na n yii yaang n wa ne rabeem.
Bãmb na n yɩga Ezɩpt wa liuuli, n wa ne rabeem, Bãmb na n yii Asiiri n wa wa manwalle. La m na n kɩtame tɩ b zĩnd b tẽngẽ wã. Sẽn-Ka-Saab n yeta.
Efrayiim nebã gũbga maam ne zĩrẽ, la Israyɛll nebã gũbga maam ne zãmbo. Zʋʋda nebã yam ket n yuusda Wẽnnaam taoore, la b sakda pʋ-peelem soabã.
Efrayiim nebã kɩɩmda sebgo, la b rigd yaang sogbo. Daar fãa, bãmb zãmbã ne b wẽngã paasdame. Bãmb maanda kaool ne Asiiri, la b maand kaam n talld n kẽngd Ezɩpte.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab bʋʋda ne Zʋʋda nebã. La b na n kaoo a Zakoob bʋʋdo, n maan-a wa sẽn zems a yel-manesmã ne a tʋʋmã.
A Zakoob sẽn dag n nan ket n be a ma pʋgẽ, yẽnda soga a kẽem nao-kãsenkãare, la yẽnda sẽn wa n lebg raoa, a maoo ne Wẽnnaam.
Yẽ maoo ne malɛk n tõoge. Yẽnda yãbame n kos-a sõngre. Yẽnda yãnda Wẽnnaam Betɛlle. La yaa beenẽ la bãmb gom ne tõndo.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yaa Saasẽ-Pãng-Soaba. La b miime tɩ bãmb yʋʋr yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saabo.
La foom, fo na n lebg n wa f Wẽnnaamã nengẽ. Kell n pa f sɩdã pʋga, la f maan sẽn yaa tɩrga. Teeg f Wẽnnaamã wakat fãa!
Kana nebã zãada zãmb makds b nusẽ. Bãmb nong n belgda nebã.
Efrayiim nebã yetame: Sɩda, tõnd lebga arzegs rãmba. Tõnd paama arzegse, la yaa ne tõnd nus tʋʋmã. B kõn yã kongr tõnd zug sẽn yaa yel-wẽnd ye.
Mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab n yaa yãmb Wẽnnaam, Hal Ezɩpt tẽnga. Mam na n leb n kɩtame tɩ yãmb zĩnd fu-rotẽ, wa ray nins yãmb sẽn maand y tigã wakate.
Mam goma ne no-rɛɛsdbã. Mam kɩtame tɩ bõn-makdsã lebg wʋsgo, la m tũnug no-rɛɛsdbã n wẽ yel-bũna.
Galaad nebã maana wẽnga, la bãmb ka zem baa fɩ ye. Bãmb maanda lols maand Gilgalle. La bãmb tẽn-kugã na n yɩɩ wa kug rʋy sẽn be pʋt vũgsẽ,
A Zakoob zoe n kẽnga Siiri, La a Israyɛll tʋm n kõo ned n paam paga. Yẽnda kɩɩma rũms tɩ b kõ-a paga.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab kɩtame tɩ no-rɛɛs yiis Israyɛll nebã Ezɩpte, La b kɩt tɩ no-rɛɛs gũ Israyɛll nebã.
Efrayiim nebã maan n waa ne sũ-yikr la sũ-toogo. Bãmb Zu-soabã na n kɩtame tɩ b zɩɩmã Efrayiim nebã sẽn daagã zĩnd d mens zutu. La b kɩt tɩ b yellã zĩnd b mens zutu.
Efrayiim nebã sã n dag n gome. Nebã rigda ne rabeem. Bãmb n dag n so Israyɛlle. La bãmb sẽn waoog Baall n beegã, B kiime

Moasã bãmb yel-wẽnã paasdame, Bãmb dõoga bõn-naandg ne b wanzuri wã, la b maan wẽn-naands b toore. Bõn-kãens fãa yaa tʋʋm-mitb nus tʋʋma. B yeta bãmb wɛɛngẽ yaa: Neb nins sẽn maand maoong ne ninsaalbã, b tõe n moka lolse!
Yaa rẽ n kɩte, tɩ b na n yɩ wa yibeoog wulgu, wa yibeoog meenem sẽn mesgdã, wa wudg sobg sẽn dɩkd zɛɛgẽ, la wa bug-zõos sẽn yit roog võorẽ.
Mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab n yaa yãmb Wẽnnaam. Hal sẽn sɩng Ezɩpte, Yãmb ka mi Wẽnnaam a to, sã n ka maam ye. La fãagd a to ka be sã n ka maam ye
Maam n bãng yãmb we-raoogã pʋga, tẽng sẽn yaa koɛɛng pʋgẽ.
Bãmb paama yamd zĩig n wãb n tɩge. Bãmb sẽn bãng tɩ b wãb n tɩgame, b wuka b mens n yĩm mam yelle.
Mam lebga wa gɩgemd bãmb yĩnga. Mam na n gũusa bãmb wa ãbg sẽn be sor zugu.
Mam na n sega bãmba, wa b sẽn wʋk rũm-toaag kamb t'a zabdẽ. Mam na n pãrsa bãmb yãadã Mam na n wãba bãmb beenẽ wa gɩgem-yãanga, We-rũmsã na n beesa bãmba.
Israyɛll nebã, woto na n yɩɩ yãmb sãoongo, Yãmb sõangd yaool n dag n yaa maam.
Yãmb dĩmã bee yɛɛnẽ moasã? Bɩ a wa sõng yãmb tẽmsã fãa pʋse. Yãmb bʋ-kaoodbã bee yɛɛnẽ? Bʋ-kaoodb nins yãmb sẽn dag n gomd b wɛɛngẽ n yetẽ tɩ b kõ yãmb dĩm ne nanambsã.
Mam kõo yãmb dĩm m sũ-yikrã wakate. La m deeg-a-la m sũ-puugrã wakate.
B gʋlsa Efrayiim nebã kongrã ne b yel-wẽnã n bĩngi.
Bãmb na n namsa wa pag sẽn kũmd rogem. La yaa biig sẽn ka yam, Yẽnda rogem taame, La a ka rat n yi a ma pʋgẽ ye.
Mam na n fãaga bãmb kɩɩm-kulgu, La m na n fãag-b-la ne kũum. Kũum, fo toog bee yɛɛnẽ? Kɩɩm-kulgu, fo sãoong bee yɛɛnẽ? Mam ka leb n tar nimbãan-zoeer ye!
Baa bãmb sẽn womd biis b ba-biisã sʋkã, seobgã na n yii yaanga, Sẽn-Ka-Saab sobg sẽn yit we-raoogã pʋga, n wa kʋɩɩs a koomã ne a bulsã. Sẽn-Ka-Saab n na n wa fã laogã sẽn yaa te-sõama fãa.
B na n ninga Samaari nebã taale, Bala, b kɩɩsa b Wẽnnaamã. La b na n paa tãpẽ. B na n f kʋʋ bãmb kom-bãoonegã, la b weed b pagb nins sẽn tʋtã pʋse.
Israyɛll nebã, lebg-y n wa-y Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa yãmb Wẽnnaamã nengẽ. Bala, yãmb lakame n lʋɩ y kongrã pʋga.
Segl-y goam n lebg n wa Sẽn-Ka-Saab nengẽ, n yeel-y bãmb yaa: Kõ-y-d sugr d beegrã fãa yĩnga. La y reeg bõn-sõamyã nins tõnd sẽn kõt yãmbã. Tõnd na n kõo yãmb la d pẽg yãmba.
Asiiri ka na n fãag tõnd ye. Tõnd ka na n zomb wiidi ye, Tõnd ka na n leb n bool d nus tʋʋmã tɩ d wẽnnaam-dãmb ye. Bala, yaa yãmb nengẽ la kɩɩbsã paamd nimbãan-zoeere.
Mam na n yiisa bãmb ka-tẽebã, Mam na n nong-b-la ne yamleoogo. Bala, mam sũ-puugrã ne-b sɛɛme.
Mam na yɩɩ wa meenem Israyɛll nebã yĩnga. Bãmb na n toba wa tɩ-puudu. La b na n kɩɩ yẽg wa Libã tɩɩse.
A wilã na n tẽeme, la b na n yɩɩ neeb wa oliiv tɩɩse, tɩ b yũ-noogã yɩ wa Libã tɩɩsã yũ-noogo.
Neb nins sẽn zĩ a maasmẽ wã na n lebg n waame. B na n kɩtame tɩ b wom biisi. La b na n toba wa reezẽ tɩɩse. B yʋʋrã na n yii wa Libã tɩɩsã.
Efrayiim nebã, Bõe yõod la mam leb n tar ne wẽn-naandsã? Maam n na n leok yãmb kosgo, la m ges y yelle. Mam na n yɩɩ wa sɩprɛs tɩɩg sẽn tobd wakat fãa wã. Yaa mam nengẽ la yãmb biisã yita.
Ãnda n tar yam, n tõe n wʋm bõn-kãensã võore. La a tõe n bãng-ba? Sẽn-Ka-Saab soayã yaa sõama. Nin-tɩrsã na n kẽna b zutu, la kɩɩsdã na n kẽn n lagsame.
Woto yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab koɛɛg b sẽn kõ a Petuwɛll biig a Zowɛlle.
Kãsem-dãmbã, kelg-y-yã! Tẽngã nebã fãa, yok-y y tʋb n kelge! Rẽ yĩnga, bũmb a woto zoe n zĩnda yãmb zamaanẽ, bɩ yaa y yaab-rãmbã zamaanẽ la a zĩnd yã?
Rɩk-y-yã-a n togs y kambã, tɩ bãmb me wa rɩk-a n togs b kambã, tɩ b kambã me wa rɩk-a n togs zamaan ning sẽn watã!
Bõn-koaadl nins zũnzũyã sẽn bas n ka rɩ wã, sʋ-kitrzĩgnis n dɩ-ba, sʋ-kitrzĩgnisã sẽn bas b rãmb n ka rɩ wã, nesneed n dɩ-ba, nesneedã sẽn bas bũmb ningã, kalwaar n dɩ-a.
Sẽn yũ-b rãam n tuumdẽ wã, nek-y-yã, yãb-y-yã! Yãmb a rã-yũudbã fãa, wiis-y-yã, yãmb sẽn ka na n leb n paam vĩy biis koom n yũ wã yĩnga!
Bala, bu-zẽng n wa n yãmb m tẽngã. A tara pãnga, tɩ b ka tõe n sõd-a n sɛ ye. A tara yẽn wa gɩgemd yẽna, t'a yeerã keglem yaa wa gɩgem-yãang yeere.
A sãama mam reezẽ tɩɩsã, la a sãam m kankamsã zãnga. A fʋka reezẽ tɩɩsã pagd n bas-b pɛɛlg faddd...
Yãb n wiis wa pʋg-paal sẽn sẽgen bot n yãbd a pʋg-sademdẽ sɩda!
Bõn-koaadl kũuni, ne bõn-yũudl kũun ka leb n wat Sẽn-Ka-Saab roogẽ wã ye. Maan-kʋʋdbã sẽn tʋmd Sẽn-Ka-Saab yĩngã bee sũ-sãang pʋga.
Pʋtã fãa sãamame, tẽn-gãongã bee sũ-sãang pʋga. Bala, b sãama koodã, reezẽ rãam ka leb n beẽ ye, kaam ka leb n beẽ ye.
Ka-koaadba, maan-y sũ-sãanga, sẽn send-b reezẽ tɩɩse, wiis-y-yã, bala, bɩle wã ne orzã sãamame, pʋtã bõn-koaadl sãama zãnga.
Reezẽ tɩɩsã kʋɩɩme, tɩ kankamsã wãke. Gernaad tɩɩsã, ne komsã la pom tɩɩsã, ne pʋtã pʋs tɩɩs fãa kʋɩɩme, ninsaalbã kɩdeng sɛɛme.

Maan-kʋʋdba, sẽgn-y bot n yãb n wiisi! Tẽn-kug zĩisẽ tʋmtʋmdba, kelm-y-yã! Yãmb dãmb sẽn tʋmd mam Wẽnnaamã yĩngã, wa-y-yã, yeelg-y bot yʋngã tõre! Bala, b ka leb n wat ne bõn-koaadl kũuni, ne bõn-yũudl kũun tõnd Wẽnnaamã roogẽ ye.
Yãk-y daar no-loeer yĩnga, moon-y tigin-kãseng daare, tigm-y kãsem-dãmbã, ne tẽngã nebã fãa, tigm-y-b Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa yãmb Wẽnnaamã roogẽ, la y kelem n bool Sẽn-Ka-Saabo!
Kayto, ad yaa toog daare! Bala, Sẽn-Ka-Saab daarã kolgdame. Daarã wata wa sãoong sẽn yit Pãng-Soab nengẽ.
Tõnd dɩɩbã sɛ d nifẽ, sũ-noogã ne kɩdengã sɛɛ tõnd Wẽnnaamã roog pʋgẽ!
Bõn-buudã pa b bogdẽ n ka yi ye. Bao wã yaa vɩɩdo, tɩ koodã bĩngr zĩis sãam zãnga, bõn-koaadlã sẽn kʋɩ wã yĩnga.
Rũmsã yãbdame, tɩ niigã zoet n ka mi b sẽn kẽedẽ ye. Bala, b ka leb n tar yamd ye. Baa rũm-bãoonegã namsdame.
Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, yaa yãmb la m boonda! Bala, bugmã rɩɩ we-raoogã yamd zãnga, tɩ bug-witmã rɩ pʋtã pʋsẽ tɩɩsã fãa.
Hal baa weoogã rũms sesd n baooda yãmba, bala, kʋɩlsã koom kʋɩɩme, la bugmã rɩɩ we-raoogã yamd zãnga.
Peeb-y baorg Sɩyõ! Kelm-y mam tãn-sõngã zugu. Bɩ tẽngã nebã fãa rig ne rabeem! Bala, Sẽn-Ka-Saab daarã watame, la a taame n sɛ.

Yaa lik ne lik bida daare, na n yɩɩ sawat sẽn yaa lik tuu daare, ra-kãng wata wa zĩ-yẽegr sẽn pukd tãmsã zutu. Yaa buud sẽn yaa wʋsgo, n tar pãnga, Bu-kãng buud zɩ n zĩndi, la a buud kõn tol n leb n zĩndi, hal baa zamaan ning sẽn watã pʋgẽ ye.

Bu-kãng na n waa wa bugum sẽn dɩta, a taoor yaa bug-witim n dɩtẽ, t'a poorẽ yaa bugum n dɩtẽ. Sẽn deng a waoongã, tẽngã rag n yaa wa Edɛn zẽedã zĩiga, la a loogrã poore, tẽngã sãama zãnga, n lebg we-raoogo. Bũmb ka tõe n zoe n põs-a ye.
Bãmb bʋrgã wẽnda wiid sẽn zoete, bãmb zoeta wa wed-rʋʋdba.
B maanda bʋrg wa saar-dãmba, wa saar-dãmb sẽn yi tãms zut n zoet n sigda. B bʋrgã wẽnda bug-witim bʋrgo. B wata wa tãb-biis sẽn tar pãng sẽn teedg n na n zabe.
Nebã sã n yãnd b sẽn watã, lebga rabeem la rigbu, tɩ nebã fãa nens bendge.
Bãmb zoeta wa gãndaado, b gãensda lals wa zabr pʋgẽ gãndaado. B ned kam fãa teesa tɩrg n kẽnda, n ka bʋdgd n bas a sor ye.
Bãmb ned ba a yembr ka tusd a to ye. Ned kam fãa rɩka a sore. Bãmb wẽdgda pɛɛmã sẽn fɩɩndã sʋk n loogdẽ, la b ka sãeegd n bas taab ye.
Bãmb kẽe tẽngã ne pãnga, n zoet lalsã zut n tũud peem-leesẽ wã n kẽed rotã pʋs wa wagda.
B sã n watẽ, tẽn-gãongã rĩmdame, tɩ saasã miimdẽ, tɩ wĩndgã ne kiuugã lebgd lika, tɩ ãdsã vẽenem ki.

Sẽn-Ka-Saab lʋɩ b tãb-biisã taoor n tãsdẽ, bãmb tãb-biisã sõor yaa kʋʋngo, sẽn sakd-b bãmb noorã tara pãnga. Bala, Sẽn-Ka-Saab daarã yaa ra-kãsenga, la a seka yɛɛsg wʋsgo. Dẽ, ãndã n na n tõog n põs ra-kãnga?
Moasã yɛsa, Sẽn-Ka-Saab yetame: «Lebg-y n wa-y mam nengẽ ne y sũyã fãa, wa-y ne no-loeere, ne yãbr la wiisgu!

Da pãrs-y y fut ye, maneg-y y sũyã, n lebg n wa Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa yãmb Wẽnnaamã nengẽ, bala, b yaa sugr soaba, la nimbãan-zoeer soaba, bãmb sũur ka yikd tao-tao ye, la b yaa nonglem-kãseng soaba, bãmb sã n sɩbge, b sũurã sãamdame.
Ãnda n mi b sã n ka na n tek yam, wall b sã n ka na n ning bark b sã n wa pɩʋʋgdẽ? Wa-y ne bõn-koaadl kũuni, la bõn-yũudl kũuni, n wa kõ Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa yãmb Wẽnnaamã.
Peeb-y baorg Sɩyõ! Yãk-y daar no-loeer yĩnga, moon-y tigin-kãseng daare!
Tigm-y nebã, segl-y tiging sẽn welg toore! Tigm-y kãsem-dãmbã, la y tigim kambã, baa ne kom-peelsã sẽn ket n yẽsemdẽ wã fãa! Bɩ yi-kãad-paalsã yi b rotẽ wã, tɩ pʋg-paalsã me yi b rotẽ!»

Bɩ maan-kʋʋdbã sẽn tʋmd Sẽn-Ka-Saab yĩngã yals tẽn-kugrã ne zãongã sʋk n yãb n yeele: «Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, zoe-y y nebã nimbãanega! Da-y ning-y yãmb nebã yãnde, tɩ b wa lebg yel-bũnd buud a taabã yĩnga, tɩ b yetẽ tɩ bãmb Wẽnnaamã bee yɛɛnẽ ye.»
Sẽn-Ka-Saab nonga b tẽngã ne nonglem-kãsenga. Bãmb zoee b nebã nimbãanega.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab leoka b nebã n yeele: «Mam na n leb n kõo yãmb koodo, la m kõ-y reezẽ rã-paalga, ne kaam, yãmb na n tɩgame. Mam ka na n leb n bas tɩ yãmb paam yãnd buud a taabã taoor ye.

Mam na n diga yãmb nug-rɩtg bɛɛbã tɩ b zãag ne-yã, mam na n dig-b lame n tɩ kẽes tẽn-koɛɛng sẽn yaa vɩ-raoog pʋgẽ, m na n diga b tãb-biis nins sẽn deng taoorã n kẽes ko-kãsengã sẽn be yaangã pʋga, la m dig b tãb-biis nins sẽn pa poorẽ wã n kẽes ko-kãsengã sẽn be nin-taoorã pʋga. Bãmb na n põogame tɩ b yũugã zẽke, b põogrã yũug na n wulumda zĩig zãnga, bãmb sẽn maan yel-bɛdã yĩnga.
Tẽnga, ra zoe rabeem ye, bɩ f maan sũ-noog n kɩdme, bala, Sẽn-Ka-Saab maanda tʋʋm-kãsemse!
We-rũmsi, da zoe-y rabeem ye. Bala, yamd leb n tobda we-raoogẽ wã, la tɩɩsã leb n womda biisi, kankamsã ne reezẽ tɩɩsã wom n zõondame.

Sɩyõ nebã, kɩdm-y-yã, la y maan sũ-noog ne Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa yãmb Wẽnnaamã, bala, bãmb kɩtame tɩ dẽenem saag ni wa sẽn zems a wakate, bãmb sika sa-kẽeng yãmb yĩnga, bãmb kɩtame tɩ dẽenem ne yaoolem saag ni wa pĩndã.
Zeesã na n leb n pida ne koodo, la sĩmsã na n leb n pida ne reezẽ rã-paalga, la kaam.
Mam na n lebsa yãmb y koodã, sʋ-kitrzĩgnisã ne nesneedã la kalwaarã ne zũnzũyã sẽn dɩ wã. Bãmb yaa mam tãb-bi-kʋʋng m sẽn tʋm tɩ b zab ne yãmba.
Yãmb na n dɩɩme n tɩge, la y na n pẽga Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa yãmb Wẽnnaamã yʋʋre, bãmb sẽn maan tʋʋm-kãsems n kõ yãmbã yĩnga.» B yeelame: «Mam nebã kõn tol n leb n paam yãnd ye.»
Yaa woto la y na n bãng tɩ mam bee ne Israyɛlle, la mam yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa yãmb Wẽnnaam, la Wẽnnaam a to ka be ye. Mam yetame: «Mam nebã kõn tol n leb n paam yãnd ye.»
Rẽ zugẽ, mam na n sika m Sɩɩgã ninsaalbã buud fãa zugu: yãmb kom-dibli la y kom-pugli na n yɩɩ no-rɛɛsdba, yãmb nin-kẽembã na n paama zãmsdo, tɩ yãmb kom-bɩɩsã paam vẽnegre.
Wakat-kãnga, mam na n sika m Sɩɩgã baa ne yem-daadã ne yem-pogsã zutu.
Mam na n kɩtame tɩ bãn puk yĩngr ne tẽngã zugu: na n yɩɩ zɩɩm ne bugum, la bug-zõose.
Wĩndgã na n tekame n lebg lika, tɩ kiuugã tek n lebg zɩɩm, tɩ Sẽn-Ka-Saab daarã sẽn yaa ra-kãseng sẽn sek yɛɛsgã yaool n wa.

La yaa neb nins fãa sẽn na n bool Sẽn-Ka-Saab yʋʋrã bal n na n põse. Bala, Sɩyõ tãngã zugu, ne Zeruzalɛm, neb kẽer n na n põs wa Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn dag n yeelã, la nin-bãmb yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn bool-b rãmbã.

Woto yaa a Amoos koeese. Yẽnda yaa Tekoa tẽng rũm-gʋʋnd a yembre. Wẽnnaam vẽnega yẽnda ne bũmb toay-toay sẽn kẽed ne Israyɛll wɛɛngẽ, Zʋʋda rĩm a Oozɩyaas wakate, la a Zoaas biig a Zeroboaam sẽn yaa Israyɛll rĩmã wakate, yʋʋm a yiib sẽn deng tẽn-digimdgã.
A Amoos yeelame: Sẽn-Ka-Saab bee Sɩyõ n tãsdẽ, bãmb bee Zeruzalɛm n zẽkd b koɛɛga. Pe-kɩɩmbã rũms wãbneg zĩis kʋɩɩme, la Karmell tãngã zug lebga ware. Damaas nebã
Ade, Sẽn-Ka-Saab yetame: Damaas yel-kɛg a tãabã yĩnga, m yeel tɩ naasẽ soabã yĩnga, mam sẽn yeelã ka na n vaal ye: Bãmb namsa Galaad nebã, wa b sẽn pãbd ned ne kut rasaare,
Mam na n kɩtame tɩ bugum dɩ rĩm a Azayɛll buudã, la bugmã na n dɩ a Bɛn-Hadaad pãng zĩisã.

Mam na n kaoo Damaas tẽngã kʋɩlemse, la m menes Bikat-Avɛn nebã, la m sãam Bɛt-Edɛn nebã rĩm ning sẽn dɩt-a naamã, Mam na n talla Aram nebã n tɩ kẽes yembd Kɩɩr tẽnga, Yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab n yeele. Filistẽ-dãmbã
Ade, Sẽn-Ka-Saab yetame: Gaaza yel-kɛg a tãabã yĩnga, m yeel tɩ naasẽ soabã yĩnga, mam sẽn yeelã ka na n vaal ye: Bãmb yõga buud tõr nebã, n tɩ kẽes-b yembd Edom.
Woto yĩnga, mam na n kɩtame tɩ bugum sig Gaaza tẽngã zugu, n dɩ a pãng zĩisã
Mam na n menesa Asdood nebã fãa, ne Askelon ned ning sẽn zãad-a naam dasaarã. Mam na n sãama Ekrõ nebã, ne Filistẽ-dãmbã neb nins sẽn kellã. Yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab n yeele. Feniisi nebã

Ade, Sẽn-Ka-Saab yetame: Fenisi nebã yel-kɛg a tãabã yĩnga, m yeel tɩ naasẽ soabã yĩnga, mam sẽn yeelã ka na n vaal ye: Bãmb yõga buud tõr nebã, n tɩ kẽes yembd Edom, la b ka tẽeg kaool ning b sẽn dag n maan ne Israyɛll nebã sẽn yaa b ba-biisã yell ye.
Woto yĩnga, mam na n kɩtame tɩ bugum sig Tɩɩr tẽngã zugu, n dɩ a pãng zĩisã Edom nebã

Ade, Sẽn-Ka-Saab yetame: Edom nebã yel-kɛg a tãabã yĩnga, m yeel tɩ naasẽ soabã yĩnga, mam sẽn yeelã ka na n vaal ye: Bãmb diga Israyɛll nebã sẽn yaa b saam-biisã ne zabr sʋʋga, n ka zoe b nimbãaneg ye. Bãmb ka tol n sik b sũur ne Israyɛll nebã ye, la kisgrã rag n ket n beeme.
Woto yĩnga, mam na n kɩtame tɩ bugum sig Teman zugu, n dɩ Bostra pãng zĩisã. Amo nebã
Ade, Sẽn-Ka-Saab yetame: Amo nebã yel-kɛg a tãabã yĩnga, m yeel tɩ naasẽ soabã yĩnga, mam sẽn yeelã ka na n vaal ye: Bãmb weeda Galaad tẽng pagb nins sẽn tʋtã pʋse, sẽn na yɩl n yalg b soolmã.
Woto yĩnga, mam na n kɩtame tɩ bugum sig Raba zugu, n dɩ a pãng zĩisã. Nebã sẽn na n wa kelem zabrã daarã, la sebgã fugb daare,
B na n yõga Amo nebã rĩm ne a nanambsã n tɩ kẽes yembdo. Yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab n yeele.
Ade, Sẽn-Ka-Saab yetame: Moaab nebã yel-kɛg a tãabã yĩnga, m yeel tɩ naasẽ soabã yĩnga, mam sẽn yeelã ka na n vaal ye: Bãmb yõoga Edom dĩmã kõab bugum n maan goore.
Woto yĩnga, mam na n kɩtame tɩ bugum sig Moaab tẽngã zugu, n dɩ a pãng zĩisã sẽn be Keriyotã, la Moaab nebã na n kii bʋr-kãseng pʋgẽ, ne zabrã bʋrg la bardã peebg pʋgẽ.
La m na n menesa b rĩmã, la m kʋ nanambs nins fãa sẽn be ne yẽnda wã. Yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab n yeele.

Ade, Sẽn-Ka-Saab yetame: Zʋʋda nebã yel-kɛg a tãabã yĩnga, m yeel tɩ naasẽ soabã yĩnga, mam sẽn yeelã ka na n vaal ye: Bala, bãmb zãgsa Sẽn-Ka-Saab tõodã, la b ka sak n deeg bãmb noyã ye. Zʋʋda nebã basame tɩ wẽn-naandsã kẽes-b moogo, yaa wẽn-naands nins bãmb yaab-rãmbã sẽn dag n pʋʋsdã.
Mam na n kɩtame tɩ bugum sig Zʋʋda zugu, la m kɩt tɩ Zeruzalɛm pãng zĩisã rɩ bugum.
Ade, Sẽn-Ka-Saab yetame: Israyɛll nebã yel-kɛg a tãabã yĩnga, m yeel tɩ naasẽ soabã yĩnga, mam sẽn yeelã ka na n vaal ye: Bala, bãmb koosa nin-tɩrg ligd yĩnga, la b koosa naong soabã neooda yĩnga.
Bãmb fãada naong rãmbã paoongo, baa ne tom ning sẽn be b zutẽ wã. B mongda naong rãmb bʋʋm bʋʋd zĩigẽ. Biig ne a ba kẽeda ne pag a yembre, n paoogd mam yʋ-sõngã.
Naong rãmbã sẽn gãneg fut nins ne bãmbã, B tara rẽ n tʋɩt tẽn-kugã fãa zĩisẽ n gãe, la b be b wẽn-naandgã roogẽ, n yũud reezẽ rãamã b sẽn yaoolg nebã tɩ b yao wã.
Mam yaool n sãama Amoor-dãmbã bãmb nifẽ, Amoor-dãmbã rag n zẽk n taa sɛɛdr tɩɩs woglem, tɩ b pãngã tat sɛn tɩɩse. La mam sãama b sẽn wom biis ninsã, la m võ b yẽgã me.
Mam yaool n yiisa yãmb Ezɩpte, n tɛ yãmb we-raoogã pʋgẽ yʋʋm pis-naase, tɩ yãmb tõe n soog Amoor nebã tẽnga.

Mam yãka neb yãmb kom-dibli wã sʋka, n kɩt tɩ b yɩ Wẽnnaam no-rɛɛsdba, la m yãk neb yãmb kom-bɩɩsã sʋka, n kɩt tɩ b yɩ neb sẽn welg toor Wẽnnaam yĩnga. Israyɛll nebã, ka woto sɩda? Yaa maam a Sẽn-Ka-Saab n yeele.
La yãmb kɩtame tɩ neb nins sẽn welg toorã yũ reezẽ rãam, la y yeel m no-rɛɛsdbã tɩ b ra leb n togs pĩnd-n-bãngr goam ye.
Beneere, mam na n neema yãmb zĩig pʋgẽ, wa ned saar sẽn zɩlg ki sẽn tabd moodo.
Sẽn tõe-a zoees ka na n paam zĩig n soond ye. Pãensã rãmb pãng na n lebga zaalem, la gãndaoog kõn tõog n fãag a meng ye
Tãb-tãoodbã kõn tõog n yalse, sẽn tõe-a zoees kõn tõog n põs ye. La wed-rʋʋd kõn tõog n fãag a yõor ye.
Baa sẽn tɩ yaa-a gãndaoog n yɩɩd fãa wã na n zoe n basa a zab-teed badaare. Yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab n yeele.
Israyɛll nebã, yãmb dãmb fãa sẽn yaa buud ning Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yiis Ezɩpt yembdã pʋgẽ wã, kelg-y koɛɛg ning Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yet yãmb wɛɛngẽ!
Dũniyã buud fãa sʋka, yaa yãmb bal la mam yãk yã. Yaa rẽ yĩng n kɩte, tɩ mam na n sok yãmb tʋʋm-beed nins fãa yãmb sẽn maanã võore
Neb a yiib tõe n tũu taab tɩ b ka reng n yẽs ne taab sɩda?
Gɩgemd wat n kelemda weoogẽ, tɩ sã n ka a paama bũmb n yõke? Gɩgem-poll wat n be a põkẽ n kelemdẽ, tɩ sã n ka a yõka bũmbu?
Tãoog tõe n zĩnd tẽng n yõk liuul tɩ sã n ka b ninga bẽdgo? Tãoog ka fisgd tɩ sã n ka bũmb la a yõkɩ ye!
Kũng na wẽ tẽng pʋgẽ tɩ neb pɛleng ka yɩke? Yel-beed tõe n paama tẽng tɩ Sẽn-Ka-Saab zɩ tiiri?
Sẽn-Ka-Saab ka maand bũmbu, tɩ b ka reng n vẽneg-a ne b tʋmtʋmdbã sẽn yaa bãmb no-rɛɛsdbã ye.
Gɩgemd sã n kelme, ãndã n ka na n yɛɛse? Wẽnnaam Sẽn-Ka-Saab sã n gome, ãnda soab n tõe n ka togs bãmb koɛɛgã?
Moon-y Asdood ne Ezɩpt pãng zĩisẽ wã n yeele: «Tigm-y taab Samaari tãmsã zutu, n ges zũnglg ninga, la namsg ning b sẽn namsd nebã Samaari tẽngã pʋgẽ wã.»
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yetame: Bãmb ka mi tɩ maan sɩd ye, bãmb pidsda b pãng zĩisã ne paoong b sẽn deeg ne pãnga.
Bõn-kãens yĩnga, Zu-soab a Wẽnnaam yetame: Bɛ wã na n gũbga tẽngã n sãam a pãng zĩisã, la a fã laogã sẽn be a na-yiyã pʋsẽ wã.

Sẽn-Ka-Saab yetame: Wa gɩgemd sẽn mi n yõk rũnga, tɩ pe-kɩɩm dig-a n deeg kars a yiib bɩ tʋb-bɛkã, Israyɛll nebã sẽn be Samaari wã ne neb nins sẽn be Damaas n gãe b gã-bʋgses zutã me na n paama fãagr a woto!
Kelg-y la y keoog a Zakoob buudã! Zu-soab a Wẽnnaam sẽn yaa Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã n yeele.
Daar ning mam sẽn na n sɩbg Israyɛll nebã b tʋʋm-beedã yĩngã, Mam na n sãama Betɛll tẽn-kugã, la tẽn-kugã yɩɩl na n kao n dʋʋga tẽnga,
Mam na n luba tẽn-bɛdã roto, la m lub tẽn-bãoonegã roto, la m menes rot nins b sẽn nags ne wob-yẽnã, la rot wʋsg na n sãamame. Yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab n yeele.
Samaari pagbã sẽn nob wa Basan nag-wubdsã, n be Samaari tãngã zugã, Kelg-y-yã! Yãmb namsda ka-pãens rãmbã, la y maand nimbãan-dãmbã pãnga, la y yet y sɩdbã tɩ b tall n wa tɩ y yũ.
Zu-soab a Wẽnnaam sõmblmã pʋga, b wẽename n yeele: Wakat n wat yãmb yĩnga, tɩ b na n wa yõg yãmb ne gaagds n yiisi, la b yiis yãmb yagensã ne leoose.
Yãmb ned kam fãa na n tũu tẽngã lalsã võyẽ n yi, la yãmb na n zoe n teesa nug-rɩtg sẽnẽ. Yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab n yeele.
Israyɛll nebã! Wa-y Betɛll Wẽnd doogẽ wã n kɩɩs maam, la y kẽng Gilgall n tɩ kɩɩs maam n paase! Maan-y y maandã yibeoogo, la y wa ne y piig pʋɩɩrã rasem a tãabã daare!
Yõog-y y bark pʋʋsg maandã ne bur sẽn ning rã-bɩlle! Moon-y n togs-y y yamleoog kũunã, tɩ yaa woto la y nonga. Yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab n yeele.
Ad bũmb nins mam sẽn kõ yãmba: Yãmb tẽmsã fãa pʋse, rɩɩb ka be y sẽn na ning y noorẽ ye, rɩɩb ka be zĩig ba a yembr ye. La ne rẽ fãa, yãmb ka lebg n wa mam nengẽ ye. Yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab n yeele.

Kiuug a tãab sẽn deng tigsgã wakate, mam mong-y-la saaga. Mam kɩtame tɩ saag ni tẽng a yembre, n bas a yembre. Tẽng a yembr pʋgẽ, mam kɩtame tɩ saag ni zĩig a yembre, n bas a yembre, la war kẽe zĩig ning sẽn ka paam-a saagã,
Tẽms a yiib wall a tãab neb yeebdame, n dabd tẽng a yembr pʋgẽ, n na n bao koom n yũ, la b lebg n waa ne ko-yũudu. La ne rẽ fãa, yãmb ka lebg n wa mam nengẽ ye. Yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab n yeele.
Mam kɩtame tɩ wãoong ne gãnem sãam y koodã, la m kɩt tɩ zũnzũy sãam y zẽedã ne y reezẽ tɩɩs pʋtã, la y kankamã ne y oliiv tɩɩsã. La ne rẽ fãa, yãmb ka lebg n wa mam nengẽ ye. Yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab n yeele.

Mam kɩtame tɩ bã-loangdg yõk yãmba, wa m sẽn dag n kɩt t'a yõk Ezɩpt nebã. Mam kɩtame tɩ y kom-bɩɩsã pa tãp pʋgẽ, la m kɩt tɩ b rees y wiidã. Mam kɩtame tɩ neb nins sẽn ki yãmb tãb-sikẽ wã yũug zẽk n ta yãmba. La ne rẽ fãa, yãmb ka lebg n wa mam nengẽ ye. Yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab n yeele.
Mam sãama yãmba, wa m sẽn dag n sãam Sodom ne Gomoorã, la yãmb yɩɩ wa raoog b sẽn yiis bugmẽ La ne rẽ fãa, yãmb ka lebg n wa mam nengẽ ye. Yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab n yeele.
Woto yĩnga, Israyɛll nebã, yãmb na n yãnda m sẽn na n sɩbg yãmb to-to! Dẽ wã, segl-y y mens n seg y Wẽnnaamã!
Bala, yaa bãmb n maan tãmsã ne sebgã, la b wilg ninsaal b tagsgo. Bãmb n kɩtd tɩ yibeoog lebg lika. Bãmb tabda tãms nins sẽn yaa lug-lugã zut n kẽnda. Bãmb yʋʋr yaa Zu-soabã sẽn yaa Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã.
Israyɛll nebã, kelg-y sũ-sãang yɩɩll m sẽn yɩɩnd yãmb yĩnga
Israyɛll sẽn yaa wa pʋg-neerã lʋɩɩme, la a kõn tol n yik ye, A lʋɩ n dɩga a meng tẽn-gãongã zugu, tɩ ned ka be sẽn na n doog-a ye.

Bala, ad Zu-soab a Wẽnnaam sẽn yete, Israyɛll buudã wɛɛngẽ: Tẽng ning sẽn dag n tʋmd tãb-biis tusr zabrẽ wã ka leb n tar sẽn yɩɩd tãb-biis koabg ye. La tẽng ning sẽn dag n tʋmd tãb-biis koabgã ka leb n tar sẽn yɩɩd tãb-biis piig ye.
Ad Sẽn-Ka-Saab koɛɛg Israyɛll nebã yĩnga: Bao-y maam n paam n vɩɩmde
Da bao-y maam Betɛll ye, la y ra kẽng Gilgall me ye Ra kẽng-y Bɛɛrseba ye. Bala, b na n yõga Gilgall nebã n kẽng yembdo, la Betɛll na n sãama zãnga,
Bao-y Sẽn-Ka-Saab n paam n vɩɩmde, tɩ b ra wa kɩt tɩ bugum dɩ a Zozɛf buudã, n sãam-a zãnga, tɩ Betɛll ned ba a ye ka tõog n kiis-a ye.
Yãmb kaooda bʋʋd kɛga, n mongd bʋʋm dãmb bʋʋm.

Sẽn-Ka-Saab n naan Pelyaad-dãmbã ne Oriyõ-rãmbã Bãmb n kɩtd tɩ lik lebg vẽenem, la b tõe tɩ wĩndg lebg yʋngo. Bãmb n tõe tɩ ko-kãsengã koom zẽk n kuil saasẽ, n lebg n wa tẽn-gãongã zugu: Bãmb yʋʋr yaa Zu-soaba
Bãmb sãamda gãndaoogo, la b sãamd pãng zĩig me.
Yãmb kisa sẽn togsd-a sɩd bʋʋd zĩigẽ, la sẽn gomd-a ne pʋ-peelem.
Yãmb taba naong soab ne y nao, n deeg a ki ne pãnga. Yãmb mee rot ne kug-peesdse, la y ka na n kẽ b pʋsẽ ye. Yãmb sela reezẽ tɩɩs sẽn yaa sõama, la y ka na n yũ b reezẽ rãam ye.
Bala, mam miime tɩ yãmb beegrã looga nugu, la y yel-wẽnã yaa wʋsgo. Yãmb namsda nin-tɩrga, la y reegd kũuni, n mongd naong soab bʋʋm bʋʋd zĩigẽ.
Woto yĩnga, sẽn tar-b yamã sĩndame, wakat a woto sẽn yaa toogã yĩnga.
Bas-y wẽng n maan sẽn yaa neere, n paam n vɩɩmde, Woto, Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã na n zĩnda ne yãmba, wa y sẽn tagsdã.
Kisg-y wẽng la y nong sẽn yaa neere, la y kao bʋʋd sẽn yaa tɩrg y bʋʋdã zĩisẽ, tɩ daar ninga, Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã na zoe a Zozɛf buudã sẽn ketã nimbãanega.

Woto yĩnga, Wẽnnaam Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã yetame: Zĩigã fãa na n yɩɩ wiisgu. Soayã zutu, nebã na n yeelame: Kayto! Kayto! B na n boola neb nins sẽn be pʋʋgẽ, tɩ b wa naag wiisdbã n wiisi, la b bool neb nins sẽn mi-b kʋʋr yãbrã tɩ b wa yãbe.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yetame: Mam sã n wa pɩʋʋg yãmb sʋkã n looge, reezẽ tɩɩs pʋtã fãa pʋs na n yɩɩ wiisgu.
Kayto! Neb nins sẽn gũud Sẽn-Ka-Saab daarã na paam toogo! Sẽn-Ka-Saab daarã na n nafa yãmb ne bõe? A ka na n yɩ vẽenem ye, a na n yɩɩ lik bida.
Badaar na n yɩɩ wa ned sẽn zoet n na n põs gɩgemd n tɩ seg ãbga, n ta a yir n tik a lalg tɩ waaf kɛ-a.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab daarã ka na n yɩ vẽenem ye. A na n yɩɩ lik daare. Vẽenem kõn tol n zĩnd badaar ye, Na n yɩɩ lik bida daare.
Mam kisa yãmb tigã, mam ka rat n wʋm yãmb tigindã rãamd ye.
Yãmb sã n wa mam nengẽ ne y maand sẽn yõogd bugmã la y bõn-koaadl kũunã, mam ka na n deeg-b ye. Yãmb zems-n-taar maandã ne y rũm-nobdsã, mam ka na n geelg-b ye.
Zãag-y maam ne y yɩɩlã sẽn yaa bʋʋrã, Mam ka na n kelg y kʋlã wẽeb ye.
Kɩt-y tɩ tɩrlem zoe wa ko-bundum, tɩ pʋ-peelmã yɩ wa kʋɩlg koom sẽn ka sɛt ye.
Israyɛll nebã, yãmb sẽn zĩnd we-raoogã pʋg yʋʋm pis-naasã, yãmb maana maand la y wa ne kũun n kõ maam sɩda?
La yãmb yaool n tʋkda a Sikut sẽn yaa y rĩmã ne a Kiyun sẽn yaa y Wẽn-naandgã ãdgã.
Woto yĩnga, mam na n yõga yãmb n kẽes yembdo, tẽng zãrem sẽn yɩɩd Damaase. Soab ning yʋʋr sẽn yaa Zu-soabã sẽn yaa Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã n yeta.
Sẽn vɩ-b Sɩyõ tẽngã pʋg ne bãanã na n paama toogo! Sẽn be-b Samaari tãngã zug tɩ b sũur keemẽ wã, ne tẽn-kãsengã nin-kãsems Israyɛll nebã sẽn kẽnd-b rãmb nengẽ wã na n paama toogo!
Kẽng-y Kalne n tɩ gese, la y yi be n kẽng Hamat sẽn yaa tẽn-kãsengã, la y lebg n kẽ Gat sẽn yaa Filistẽ-dãmbã tẽngã n tɩ gese: Tẽn-bãmb sãoo soolem-kãensã bɩ? Bɩ b soolmã yɩɩda yãmb soolmã?
Yãmb baood n targa toogã daar sẽn watã, la yaool n yaa wẽngã wakat la y kɩtd t'a pẽnegdẽ
Yãmb gãee y gãasã sẽn nags ne wob-yẽnã zutu, ne y goeen-bʋgsã zutu, n wãbd pe-ra-poal ne nag-bi-nobds nemdo,
la y wẽed y kʋla. Yãmb maana yʋʋm-teed wa a Davɩɩde
Yãmb yũuda reezẽ rãam ne zɩɩm mesb laase, la y rɩkda dẽenem biis kaam n ningd y mens zutu, A Zozɛf buudã sãoong ka namsd bãmb ye!
Woto yĩnga, bãmb n na n yɩ pipi b sẽn na n yõg n kẽes yembdo, la neb nins sẽn gãe b gãasẽ wã tig na n sɛɛme.
Zu-soabã sẽn yaa Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã wẽename n yeele: Mam kisa a Zakoob buudã sẽn wukd b mensã, la m kisa a na-yiyã. Mam na n basame tɩ bɛɛbã sãam Samaari tẽngã ne bũmb nins fãa sẽn be a pʋgẽ wã.
La raop piig sã n kell zak a yembr pʋgẽ, b na n kiime.

Ned sã n wa n na n wʋk a roagdb kũum n yi a roogẽ, n na n tɩ yõog bugum, la a wʋk a kõabã n na n yõog bugum, a na n soka ned ning sẽn be roogã yaangã yaa: Ned a to keta fo nengẽ bɩ? La sẽn be-a roogã yaangã na n leokame: Ned ba a yembr ka ket ye. La a na n leb n yeelame: Sĩnd la f ra pʋd Sẽn-Ka-Saab yʋʋr ye!
Gese, Sẽn-Ka-Saab gomdame n yetẽ: Ro-bedr na n lebga raboogo, la ro-bil na n wãame.
Wed-moos tõe n zoee pĩig kugr zug sɩda? Ned me tõe n koo ko-kãsengã pʋg ne niig sɩda? La yaa bõe tɩ yãmb tekd sɩd tɩ lebg zĩrẽ, la y tekd tɩrlem tɩ lebg wẽnga?
Yãmb pẽgda y meng ne Lo-Dabaar sẽn yaa tẽn-bilã. Yãmb yetame: Ka ne tõnd meng pãng la d tõog n zab n deeg Karnayim sẽn yaa tẽng sẽn tar pãngã sɩda?
Maam a Zu-soab a Wẽnnaam sẽn yaa Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã yetame: Israyɛll nebã! Mam na n kɩtame tɩ buud a yembr yik zabr ne yãmba, n nams yãmb sẽn sɩng ne Hamat tẽngã rignoore, n tãag ko-zoetmã zĩ-koɛɛngã.
Ad bũmb ning Zu-soab a Wẽnnaam sẽn wilg maam vẽnegr pʋgẽ: Daar a yembre, moodã sẽn wa n leb n sɩngd yiibã wakate, sʋy n dag n wekde. Rag n yaa rĩmã bɩle tigsg loogr zugẽ.
B sẽn wa n dɩt tẽngã moodã zãnga wakate, mam yeelame: Zu-soab a Wẽnnaam, m yõkd-y-la sɛɛga, tɩ y kõ y nebã sugri! A Zakoob yagensã na n maana wãn n põse? Bãmb sõorã ka waoog ye.
Dẽ, Sẽn-Ka-Saab teka yam, n yeel tɩ yell a woto ka na n zĩnd ye.
Ad bũmb a to Zu-soab a Wẽnnaam sẽn leb n wilg maam: Zu-soab a Wẽnnaam rag n kaooda bʋʋdã ne bugum, la bugmã rag n dɩta ko-kãsengã sẽn be tẽn-gãongã tẽngrã ne pʋtã.
Mam yeelame: Zu-soab a Wẽnnaam, m kot-y lame tɩ y bas woto! A Zakoob yagensã na n maana wãn n põse? Bãmb ka pãng ye.
Dẽ, Wẽnnaam Sẽn-Ka-Saab teka yam, n yeel tɩ yell a woto me ka na n zĩnd ye.
Dẽ poore, ad bũmb a to Zu-soabã sẽn leb n wilg maam: B rag n yasa namd lalg zugu, n zãad makdga.
Zu-soabã soka maam yaa: ‹Amoose, fo nee bõe?› La mam yeelame tɩ m nee makdga. La Sẽn-Ka-Saab yeelame yaa: Mam makda m nebã ne makdga, la m ka na n leb n kõ-b sugr yɛs ye.
A Izak maoong kʋʋb zĩisã na n sãamame, Israyɛll pʋʋsg zĩisã na n lebga raboodo. La m na n sãama a Zeroboaam buudã ne zabr sʋʋga.
A Amatsɩya sẽn yaa Betɛll maan-kʋʋr kãsmã tʋmame tɩ b tɩ yeel Israyɛll dĩm a Zeroboaam, t'a Amoos baood n dat n sãama yãmb Israyɛll buudã sʋka. Tẽngã neb yam yii ne a goamã.
Ad a Amoos sẽn yeele: A Zeroboaam na n paa tãpẽ, La b na n yõga Israyɛll nebã n kẽes yembdo, n zãag-b ne b tẽngã.
A Amatsɩya yeela a Amoos yaa: «Bãngda, zoe n kẽng n tɩ soond Zʋʋda tẽnga, n togs f pĩnd-n-bãngr goamã beenẽ n paamd f noor dɩɩbo,
la f ra togs pĩnd-n-bãngr goam Betɛll kaanẽ ye. Bala, yaa zĩig rĩmã sẽn kẽnd n waoogd Wẽnnaam, la a leb n yaa soolmã zĩ-sõngo.»
La a Amoos leoka a Amatsɩya yaa: «Mam ka no-rɛɛsa, m leb n ka no-rɛɛs biig me ye. Mam yaa rũm-gʋʋnda, la m senda kankamse.
Yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab n yãk maam m sẽn wa n gũud m dũmsã wakate, n yeel maam yaa: ‹Kẽng Israyɛll sẽn yaa mam nebã nengẽ n tɩ yɩ m no-rɛɛsa.
Moasã, foom a Amatsɩya sẽn yet maam tɩ m da togs Wẽnnaam sẽn yeel bũmb ning Israyɛll nebã wɛɛngẽ, ne a Izak buudã wɛɛngẽ wã, kelg Zu-soabã koɛɛga.› »

Bõn-kãng yĩnga, ad Zu-soabã sẽn yeta: ‹Fo pagã na n lebga pʋg-yoodr tẽngã pʋgẽ, fo kom-dibli wã ne f kom-pugli wã na n paa tãpẽ, b na n deesa fo zĩisã n pʋɩ n kõ neb a taaba, fo na n tɩ kii tẽn-zẽnga, la b na n yõga Israyɛll nebã n tɩ kẽes yembdo, n zãag-b ne b tẽngã.›
Ad bũmb ning Zu-soab a Wẽnnaam sẽn wilg maam vẽnegr a to pʋgẽ. Vẽneg-kãng pʋgẽ, mam yãnda peoog sẽn pid ne tɩɩs bi-moaama.

La b soka maam yaa: Amoose, fo nee bõe? La mam yeelame tɩ m nee peoog sẽn pid ne tɩɩs bi-moaama. La Zu-soabã yeela maam yaa: Israyɛll sẽn yaa mam nebã sɛɛb wakat taame. Mam ka na n leb n kõ-b sugr ye.
Badaare, na-yirã pʋgẽ yɩɩlã na n lebga wiisgu. Maam a Zu-soab a Wẽnnaam n yeele. B na n zama kũumã zĩig fãa. B ka na n leb n wʋm bʋrg ye.
Kelg-y-yã, yãmb dãmb sẽn maand nimbãan-nebã pãngã, la y namsd tẽngã ka-pãens-rãmbã,

Yãmb yetame: «Rabʋr la ki-paalgã na n sɛ, tɩ d paam n koosd d koodã? La dabʋr la vʋʋsg daarã na n looge, tɩ d paam n fõgs d bao wã?» Tõnd na n wẽga d la-magdɩ wã, la d tall d zɩslem magdsã n zãmbe, la d rʋg d koosmã raaga.
Tõnd na n daa naong rãmbã ne ligdi, la d koos nin-koamã neooda yĩnga. Tõnd na n koosa baa ne ka-pedsã.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab wẽena ne Israyɛll zu-zẽkr tẽngã n yeele: «Mam ka na n tol n yĩm y tʋʋmd ba a yembr ye.»
Bãmb tʋʋm-wẽnsã yĩnga, mam na n kɩtame tɩ tẽn-gãongã rigimdi. Sũ-sãang na n paama neb nins fãa sẽn be tẽn-kãng pʋgẽ wã A na n zẽkame n lebg n lʋɩ, wa Ezɩpt tẽng Nill kʋɩlgã.
Zu-soab a Wẽnnaam yetame: Badaare, mam na n kɩtame tɩ wĩntoogã kẽ wĩnto-sʋka, la m kɩt tɩ dũniyã lebg lik wĩntoog wakate.

Mam na n teka y tigã tɩ lebg sũ-sãanga, la m tek y yɩɩlã fãa tɩ lebg wiisgu. Mam na n sẽgen-y-la sũ-sãang futu, la m põng y fãa zutã. Mam na n kɩtame tɩ sũ-sãang kẽ tẽngã, wa ned bi-ribl-yend sẽn ki t'a yãbda, la a baoosg na n yɩɩ sũ-toogo.

Zu-soab a Wẽnnaam yeelame yaa: Wakat n wate, tɩ mam na n kɩt tɩ kom kẽ tẽngã, la ka na n yɩɩ rɩɩb kom, wall koom sẽn kae n yũud yĩng ye. Na n yɩɩ Sẽn-Ka-Saab goamã kelgr kom la a ko-yũud n na n yõk-ba.
Bãmb na n yeeb n kẽnga goabg la rɩtgo, ne yaang la taoore, n baood n na n wʋm Sẽn-Ka-Saab goamã, la b ka na n wʋm-a ye.
Badaare, pʋg-sad-neebã ne ra-sãmbã na n kii ko-yũudu.
Bãmb wẽenda ne Samaari wẽn-naan-yoogã n yetẽ: «Tõnd wẽenda ne f wẽn-naandg a Dan, la d wẽend ne Bɛɛrseba wẽn-naandgã!» La b na n lʋɩɩme n ka leb n yik abada ye

Mam yãnda Zu-soabã sẽn yas tẽn-kugrã taoor n yetẽ: Wẽ ra-lugdsã tɩ roogã miime, n lʋɩ n zãb nebã fãa! Mam na n kʋʋ bãmb yagensã ne zabr sʋʋga. Bãmb sʋkã ned ba a yembr ka na n paam n zoe, la sẽn zoet-bã ba a yembr ka na n tõog n põs ye.
Bãmb sã n tɩ kẽ kɩɩm-kulgu, mam na n yiisa bãmb be. Bãmb sã n dʋ yĩngri, mam na n sika bãmb be.
Bãmb sã n tɩ soond Karmell tãngã zugu, mam na n tɩ baoo bãmb be n yõg-ba, Bãmb sã n zoe n tɩ kẽ ko-kãsengã yaang n na n soonde, mam na n kɩtame tɩ wiis kɛ-ba
Baa bãmb bɛɛbã sã n yõg-b n tɩ kẽes yembdo, mam na n kɩtame tɩ b kʋ bãmb ne zabr sʋʋga. Mam na n gũusa bãmba, la ka na n yɩ b manegr yĩng ye, na n yɩ b sãoong yĩnga.
Zu-soab a Wẽnnaam sẽn yaa Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã sɩɩsa tẽngã t'a rigimdi. Sũ-sãang paama neb nins fãa sẽn be a pʋgẽ wã A zẽkdame n lebgd n lʋɩtẽ, wa Ezɩpt Nill kʋɩlgã.
Bãmb tilga b yir saasẽ, la b yɛdg b sa-gãongã tẽngã zugu, b kɩtdame tɩ koom yi ko-kãsengẽ wã, n pid tẽn-gãongã: Bãmb yʋʋr yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saabo.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yetame: Israyɛll nebã, yãmb yɩɩda Kuus nebã la? Ka maam n yiis Israyɛll nebã Ezɩpte, wa m sẽn yiis Filistẽ-dãmbã Kaftoore, la wa m sẽn yiis Siiri nebã Kiirã la?
Maam a Zu-soab a Wẽnnaam geta yel-wẽn-maandbã soolem. M na n kɩtame t'a menem dũniyã zugu, la m ka na n sãam a Zakoob roogã zãng ye. Maam a Sẽn-Ka-Saab n yeele.
Mam na n kõo bɛ wã noore, n yeel-a t'a miim Israyɛll buudã buud a taabã fãa sʋka, wa b sẽn tar goaadg n good koodo, la kugr ba a yembr ka na n lʋɩ tẽng ye.
Yel-wẽn-maandb nins fãa sẽn be mam nebã sʋkã yetame: Ra kɩt-y tɩ toog pẽneg tõnd ye. Ra kɩt-y tɩ toog paam tõnd ye.
Badaare, mam na n lebsa a Davɩɩd soolmã sẽn yaa wa roog sẽn dat n lʋɩ wã n me. Mam na n yẽda a võyã, n lebs n me a raboodã, Mam na n lebs n me-a lame, t'a leb n yɩ wa a sẽn dag n yaa-a soab pĩndã.
Woto, bãmb na n sooga Edom neb nins sẽn kellã, la soolem nins fãa mam sẽn dag n so wã. Maam a Sẽn-Ka-Saab n maand bõn-kãens fãa. Yaa maam n yeele.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yetame: Wakat n wate, tɩ kẽer na n fẽrgdẽ tɩ kẽer pʋgd n tigsdẽ, tɩ kẽer na n send reezẽ tɩɩs tɩ kẽer pʋgd n wobda, tɩ reezẽ rã-paalg na n sodgd tãmsã zutu, la kunkubã fãa zutu.
Mam na n lebsa Israyɛll sẽn yaa mam nebã b zĩigẽ. Bãmb na n lebs n me b tẽmsã sẽn sãamã, n kẽ be n zĩndi. Bãmb na n sela reezẽ tɩɩse, n yũ a reezẽ rãamã, Bãmb na n maana zẽed zĩisi, n dɩ a biisã.
Mam na n zĩniga bãmb tẽms nins mam sẽn kõ bãmbã pʋse, la ned ka na n leb n tõog n yiis bãmb be ye. Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa fo Wẽnnaamã n yeele.

Vẽnegr a Abdyaas sẽn paame. Ad Zu-soab a Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yet Edom soolmã wɛɛngẽ: «Tõnd wʋma koɛɛg Sẽn-Ka-Saab nengẽ, la b tʋma ned bu-zẽmsã nengẽ ne koɛɛga.» Koɛɛgã yetame: «Yik-y-yã! D yik n zab ne Edom soolmã!» D zab ne-a!
Ade, mam na n kɩtame tɩ f lebg bilf bu-zẽmsã fãa sʋka, la nebã na n paooga foom wʋsgo.
Fo tɩtaamã kẽes-f-la moogo, bala, fo bee pĩisã bogdẽ, fo tilga f rotã tãms zutu, la f yetẽ: «Ãnda n tõe n sik maam?»
Baa fo sã n yɩk n kuil yĩngr wa pa-nand-tugri, baa fo tɩʋ f tʋkã ãdsã sʋka, mam na n sika foom be. Yaa maam a Sẽn-Ka-Saab n yeele!
Wagda bɩ fãadb sã n wa fo nengẽ ne yʋngo, bãmb ka na n wã foom sɩda? Ka b sẽn tõe n wʋk bal la b na n wʋke? Reezẽ-woabdb sã n wa fo reezẽ pʋʋgẽ, b na n basa bũmb tɩ ka reezẽ sẽn na n yiisi?
B vɛɛsa a Ezayu yagensã! B zũndga yẽnda arzegsã!

B na n diga foom n yiis f soolmẽ wã: Bala, sẽn maan-b kaool ne foomã zãmbda foom, fo zo-rãmbã n so foom, sẽn naagd-b foom n dɩtẽ wã tũnugda beenẽ n bẽt foom. Bãmb yeta fo wɛɛngẽ: «A ka leb n tar yam ye.»
Maam a Sẽn-Ka-Saab yetame: «Badaare, mam na n menesa Edom soolem yam dãmbã, mam na n menes a Ezayu soolem ning sẽn be tãms sʋkã bãngdbã.
Teman tẽnga, b na n kẽesa fo gãndaadã rabeem, sẽn na yɩl n kʋ neb nins sẽn be a Ezayu soolem ning sẽn be tãms sʋkã, n menes-b fãa!
Wẽng ning fo sẽn maan fo ba-biig a Zakoob yagensã yĩnga, fo na n paama yãnde, la b na n menes-f-la wakat sẽn kõn sa yĩnga.

Daar ning bu-zẽmsã sẽn wa n wʋkd bũmb nins sẽn dag n kõt Zeruzalɛm pãngã n loogdẽ, daar ning sãambã sẽn wa n tũ Zeruzalɛm tẽngã noy n kẽ n maan poeer n pʋɩ-a, tɩ fo sĩnd n getẽ wã, fo me yaa wa bãmb sʋkã ned a yembre.
Da maan sũ-noog f ba-biigã yel-pakr daar ye. Da maan sũ-noog a toogã daar ye. Da kɩdem Zʋʋda nebã sãoong daar ye. Da gom n paoog f ba-biigã b yel-pakrã daar ye.
Da kẽ mam nebã tẽng pʋg b sãoongã daar ye. Bɩ fo me ra yãnd f saam-biisã toog b sãoongã daar n maan sũ-noog ye. La b sãoongã daare, bɩ f ra sɩɩs bũmb ning sẽn dag n kõt-b pãngã ye.
Da yals so-tiisẽ n kʋ sẽn zoet-b n na n põsã ye! Da yõg neb nins sẽn põs-bã n ning b bɛɛbã nugẽ toogã daar ye!»
Bala, Sẽn-Ka-Saab daarã kolgda bu-zẽmsã fãa yĩnga. B na n maana foom wa fo sẽn maanã, b na n dola foom f tʋʋmã.

Edom tẽnga, bãng tɩ fo sẽn yũ mam sũ-puugr bõn-yũudlã m tãn-sõngã zug to-to wã, bu-zẽmsã me na n yũ-a-la a woto wakat fãa. Bãmb na n yũ-a lame, b na n gag-a lame, la na n yɩɩ wa bãmb ka tol n zĩnd ye.
Neb n na n põs n zĩnd Sɩyõ tãngã zugu. Sɩyõ na n leb n lebga zĩ-sõngo, la a Zakoob buudã na n leb n deega b sẽn so wã.

A Zakoob buudã na n lebga wa bugum, la a Zozɛf buudã na n lebga wa bug-witim, t'a Ezayu buudã lebg wa moodo, tɩ b rɩ-a n sãam-a zãnga. A Ezayu buudã ned ba a yembr ka na n põs ye. Yaa maam a Sẽn-Ka-Saab n yeele!
Negɛɛv nebã na n sooga Ezayu soolem ning sẽn be tãms sʋkã, la sẽn be-b kunkub sʋkã na n sooga Filistẽ-dãmbã tẽnga. Bãmb na n sooga Efrayiim ne Samaari tẽngã. La Benzame yagensã na n sooga Galaade.
Israyɛll tãb-biis nins b sẽn dag n yõg n kẽng tẽn-zẽmsã, na n sooga Kana nebã tẽngã, hal n tãag Sarɛpta, la Zeruzalɛm neb nins b sẽn dag n yõg tɩ b be Sefaraadã na n sooga Negɛɛv tẽmsã.
Fãagdb na n dʋʋ Sɩyõ tãngã, n kao a Ezayu soolem ning sẽn be tãms sʋkã neb bʋʋdo. La Sẽn-Ka-Saab n na n dɩ naam.
Daar a yembre, Sẽn-Ka-Saab yeela a Amitayi biig a Zonaas yaa:
«Yik n kẽng Niniiv sẽn yaa tẽn-kãsengã pʋgẽ, n tɩ moon n yeel tẽngã nebã, tɩ b wẽnemã zẽk n taa maam.»

La a Zonaas yikame n na n zoe n kẽng Tarsɩɩse, sẽn na n yɩlẽ n zãag ne Sẽn-Ka-Saabo. La a sẽn ta Zafa tẽnga, a yãnda koom kogl-bedr sẽn dabd Tarsɩɩse, la yẽnda yaoome n kẽ n naag koom koglgã rãmba, n na n kẽng Tarsɩɩs n zãag ne Sẽn-Ka-Saabo.
La b sẽn wa n be ko-kãsengã zugu, Sẽn-Ka-Saab kɩtame tɩ sob-kãseng yik koomã zug n fugda, tɩ ko-pɛmã yikdẽ, hal tɩ koom koglgã rat n wã.

Dẽ, rabeem yõka kogl-rugsdbã, tɩ ned kam fãa kelemd n boond a wẽnde. La bãmb wʋka koglgã pʋgẽ teedã n lobd koomẽ wã, sẽn na n yɩlẽ tɩ koglgã lebg faasga. La rẽ t'a Zonaas ra yikame n sig koglgã tẽngr doogã n gãe n gõe n wẽed gũsum.
Dẽ, koom koglgã taoor soab kolga a Zonaas n sok-a yaa: «Yaa bõe tɩ f gãe n gõe? Fo me yik n bool f Wẽnnaamã, tɩ tõe tɩ b zoe d nimbãanega, tɩ d da ki ye.»
La koglgã pʋg nebã goma ne taab n yeel yaa: «Wa-y tɩ d maan poeer n bãng sẽn yaa ned ning yĩng la yel-kãngã paamd tõndo.» La bãmb maana poeere, la poeerã wilgame tɩ yaa a Zonaase.
Dẽ, bãmb yeela a Zonaas yaa: «Yaa fo yĩng la yel-kãngã sẽn paam tõndã. Dẽ wã, togs tõnd tʋʋmd ning fo sẽn tʋmde! Fo yita yɛɛnẽ? Fo yaa tẽn-bʋg neda? La fo yaa bu-bʋg neda?»
La a Zonaas leoka bãmb n yeel yaa: «Mam yaa Ebre buudã neda, la m pʋʋsda Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa saasẽ Wẽnnaamã. Yaa bãmb n naan ko-kãsengã, la tẽn-gãongã.»
La rabeem-kãseng yõka neb nins sẽn dag n be koglgã pʋgã. Bala, a Zonaas ra yeela bãmb tɩ yẽnda zoetame n na n zãag ne Sẽn-Ka-Saabo. Dẽ, bãmb yeela a Zonaas yaa: «Yaa bõe tɩ fo maand a woto?»
La bãmb leb n soka a Zonaas yaa: «Tõnd na n maana foom bõe n paam tɩ koomã sigi?» Bala, wakat-kãng tɩ ko-pɛmã rag n paamda pãng n paasdẽ.
A Zonaas leok-b lame yaa: «Mam miime tɩ yaa mam yellã yĩng n kɩt tɩ sob-kẽen-kãngã lengd yãmba. Rẽ wã, bɩ y rɩk maam n lob ko-kãsengã pʋgẽ, la koomã na n sigame.»
Koom koglgã pʋg nebã rag n maoodame n dat n ta kʋɩl-koakã, la b ka tõog ye, ko-pɛmã sẽn dag n lengd bãmb wʋsg n yɩɩd pĩndã yĩnga.
Dẽ, bãmb yõka Sẽn-Ka-Saab sɛɛg n yeel yaa: «Tõnd kot-y lame tɩ y ra bas tɩ d ki nin-kãngã yellã yĩng ye. Da rɩk-y pʋ-peen-ned yell n dogl tõnd zug ye. Bala, yaa yãmb a Sẽn-Ka-Saab n maan y raabo.»
Dẽ, bãmb dɩka a Zonaas n lob koomẽ wã. La wakat-kãng bala, sob-kãsengã yõkame, tɩ ko-pɛmã sigi.
Woto, Sẽn-Ka-Saab rabeem kãseng yõk-b lame. Dẽ, bãmb maana maoong n kõ Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, la b maan pʋleng ne bãmba.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab kɩtame tɩ zĩn-bedr wa vel a Zonaase. La yẽnda paa zĩnfã pʋgẽ dasem a tãabo.
Dẽ, a Zonaas zĩnda zĩnfã pʋgẽ n pʋʋs Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa yẽnda Wẽnnaamã n yeel yaa:
«Mam yel-pakrã pʋgẽ, mam kelem n boola Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, la bãmb leoka maam. Mam zĩnda kɩɩm-kulgu, n bool yãmb n kos tɩ y sõng-ma, la yãmb wʋma mam kosgã.
Yãmb loba maam zĩ-zulungẽ, ko-kãsengã sʋka, la ko-wĩis gũbga maam, tɩ ko-pɛmã ne ko-wĩisã wẽed maam.»
Mam da yeta m meng yaa: «Yãmb diga maam tɩ m zãag ne yãmba, la mam yaool n nongẽ lame n leb n yãnd y ro-sõngã.
Koomã lima maam zãnga, la ko-zulungã gũbga maam, la kʋɩl-moodã ra vila m zugã.
La mam sig n taa hal tãmsã yẽgẽ, la kɩɩm-kulg kʋɩlemsã ra paga maam wakat fãa yĩnga. Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa mam Wẽnnaam, yãmb yiisa maam bog-zulungã pʋg vɩɩga.
La mam vɩɩmã sẽn wa n dat n sɛ wã wakate, mam pʋʋsa yãmb a Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, la mam pʋʋsgã zẽk n taa yãmb nengẽ, A ta y ro-sõngã pʋga.
Neb nins sẽn waoogd wẽn-naandsã sẽn ka tar yõodã, zãagda b mens ne yãmb zoodã.
La sã n yaa ne maam, mam na n maana maoong n kõ yãmba, la m pʋd bark pʋʋsg yɩɩl n waoog-yã. La m pids m pʋlengã m sẽn maanã. Bala, yaa yãmb a Sẽn-Ka-Saab n fãagde!»
Dẽ, Sẽn-Ka-Saab goma ne zĩnfã t'a kẽng n tɩ wʋk a Zonaas kʋɩl-koakẽ wã.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab leb n goma ne a Zonaas naoor a yiibẽ soab n yeel-a yaa:
«Yik n kẽng Niniiv sẽn yaa tẽn-kãsengã pʋgẽ, n tɩ togs koɛɛg ning mam sẽn togs foomã.»
Dẽ, a Zonaas yikame n kẽng Niniiv wa Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yeel yẽnda wã. Niniiv tẽngã rag n yaa tẽn-kãseng Wẽnnaam nifẽ. La a yalmã ra tata rasem a tãab kẽnde.
La a Zonaas sɩngame n kẽn daar a yembr Niniiv tẽngã pʋga. La a ra moondame n yetẽ yaa: «Ade, keta rasem pis-naas bala, tɩ Sẽn-Ka-Saab sãam Niniiv tẽngã.»
Dẽ, Niniiv tẽngã neb tẽe Wẽnnaam. La bãmb mooname n yeel nebã fãa tɩ b loe noore. La sẽn sɩng ne kãsma, n tɩ tãag yao-zʋʋga, nebã fãa yeelga sũ-sãang fut n zĩnd tompeglmẽ.
La Niniiv naabã sẽn wʋm kibarã, a yika a naamã geer zug n yeeg a naamã kobre, la a yeelg sũ-sãang fuug n zĩnd tompeglmẽ.

Dẽ poore, Niniiv naabã kɩtame tɩ b moon Niniiv tẽngã pʋg n yeel yaa: «Rĩmã ne a kug-zĩidbã wilgdame tɩ ninsaalbã ra rɩ rɩɩbo, la bɩ rũmsã fãa, sã n yaa rũm-bɛd wall rũm-bãoonego, ra wãb yamdo, la b ra yũ koom me ye.
La bɩ ninsaalbã ne rũmsã fãa yeelg sũ-sãang futu, tɩ ned kam fãa kelem n bool Wẽnnaam ne a sũur fãa, la a wẽnemd n bas a manesem-wẽngã, ne a tʋʋm-wẽnsã a sẽn da maandã!
Bala, ãndã n mi Wẽnnaam sã n ka na n sik b sũuri, tɩ d paam n põse?»
Wẽnnaam yãnda Niniiv nebã yel-manesmã, n mik tɩ b rag n basda b tʋʋm-beedã. Dẽ, Wẽnnaam teka yam ne sɩbgr ning bãmb sẽn dag n dat n sɩbg Niniiv nebã, la b basame n ka sɩbg-b ye.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn maan bũmb ningã ka tol n yɩ a Zonaas noog ye. Dẽ kɩtame t'a Zonaas sũurã yiki.

La a Zonaas pʋʋsa Sẽn-Ka-Saab n yeel yaa: «Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, ka woto la m sẽn da pĩnd n yeel mam sẽn wa n ket n be m tẽngẽ wã sɩda? Yaa rẽ yĩng la m sẽn da zoet n na n kẽng Tarsɩɩsã. Bala, mam miime tɩ yãmb yaa Wẽnnaam, y yaa sugr kõata, la nimbãan-zoɛta, la yãmb sũurã ka yikd tao-tao ye. Y tara nonglem wʋsgo, la yãmb basda sɩbgr ning y sẽn dag n tog n sɩbgã tɩ vaale.
La sẽn lebg woto wã, Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, bɩ y reeg m vɩɩmã. Bala mam sẽn kiid n são m sẽn vɩ.»
La Sẽn-Ka-Saab leoka a Zonaas yaa: «Fo tagsdame tɩ fo tara bʋʋm la f sẽn yikd f sũurã woto wã bɩ?»
Dẽ, a Zonaas yii Niniiv tẽngã pʋga, n kẽng tẽngã yaang n tɩ zĩndi. La a tii sẽok beenẽ n kẽ a maasmẽ n zĩ n gũud bũmb ning sẽn na n paam Niniiv tẽngã.
La Wẽnnaam Sẽn-Ka-Saab kɩtame tɩ tɩɩg yi tẽn-gãongã zug t'a maasmã bui a Zonaase, t'a sũ-pa-noaangã tõe n sɛ. La a Zonaas sũurã yɩɩ noog wʋsg tɩɩgã yĩnga.
La a vẽkembeoog yi-beoog pĩnda, Wẽnnaam kɩtame tɩ zũnzũur wa kẽ tɩɩgã n dɩ-a t'a zelge.
La sõ-bɩɩmd wakate, Wẽnnaam kɩtame tɩ sob-tʋʋlg yi yaang sẽnẽ n wa, la wĩntoogã pãba a Zonaas zugã t'a pãngã sɛ t'a lʋɩ. Dẽ, yẽnda yeelame yaa: «Mam sẽn kiid n são m sẽn vɩ.»
La Wẽnnaam soka a Zonaas yaa: «Dẽ yĩnga, fo sẽn puug f sũur tɩɩgã kũum yĩngã, fo tara bʋʋm sɩda?» La a Zonaas leoka Wẽnnaam n yeel yaa: «M sũurã sẽn puug tɩ m dat n ki wã, m tara bʋʋm.»
La Sẽn-Ka-Saab yeela a Zonaas yaa: «Fo yãbda tɩɩgã nimbãanega, la yaool n ka foom n kɩt t'a yi, la ka foom n kɩt t'a bɩ me ye. Tɩɩgã yii yʋn-yɛnga, n lebg n ki yʋn-yɛnga.

Niniiv yaa tẽn-kãsenga. Neb sẽn vɩ-a pʋgẽ sõor yɩɩda neb tus koabg la pisi, tɩ rũms wʋsg-wʋsg me be beenẽ. La tẽngã nebã ka tol n mi sẽn yaa sõamã ne wẽng n bak ye. Rẽ wã, mam na n yɩ a wãn n ka zoe tẽn-kãngã nimbãanega.»

Ad koɛɛg ning Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn kõ a Miise sẽn yaa Moresɛt tẽng nedã, Zʋʋda rĩm-dãmb a Zotam, ne a Akaaze, la a Ezekɩyaas sẽn wa n dɩt-b naamã wakatã, la ad vẽnegr ning yẽnda sẽn yã sẽn kẽed ne Samaari la Zeruzalɛm wɛɛngẽ wã:
«Nebã fãa, kelg-y-yã! Bɩ dũniyã ne bũmb nins fãa sẽn be a pʋgẽ wã kelg neere! Zu-soab a Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n zĩnda b ro-sõngã pʋg n yɩ kaset soab n ning yãmb taale!
Gese, Sẽn-Ka-Saab yita b zĩigẽ wã, bãmb sigdame n kẽnd dũniyã zĩ-zãonglsã zutu.
Tãmsã yẽnegda bãmb naoã tẽngre, tɩ tẽn-nabdrã pusd wa bugum sẽn dɩt sɩ-ribdu, la wa koom sẽn yi tãng zug n sigda.

La bõn-kãens fãa yaa a Zakoob yagensã beegrã yĩnga, yaa Israyɛll buudã kongrã yĩnga. Yaa ãnda rãmb n kɩt tɩ Zakoob buudã beege? Ka Samaari nebã la! La ãnda rãmb n kɩt tɩ Zʋʋda buudã waoogd wẽn-naandse? Ka Zeruzalɛm nebã la!
Mam na n kɩtame tɩ Samaari tẽngã lebg raboogo, la reezẽ pʋʋgo. M na n kɩtame tɩ Samaari tẽngã kugã bilim n dʋʋg tãn-longã pʋga, la m kɩt tɩ tẽngã meeb yẽbgr puki.

B na n pãba a wẽn-naandsã fãa n wã, n wʋk a paoongã fãa n yõog bugum, mam na n sãama b wẽn-naandsã, bala teedã bãmb sẽn tigmã fãa, yaa ne bãmb yoobã yaood la b rɩk n da. La b na n dɩka bõn-kãens n tɩ yao pʋg-yoaadba.»
Rẽ kɩtame tɩ maam a Miise na n yãb n wiisi, n piid m neooda n kẽn nao-zaal la beelle. Mam na n yãbame n wiis wa we-baaga, m na n yãba wa naneoong kamba.
Samaari sẽn paam sɩbgr ningã sãam-a-la zãnga. La a sãoongã sãag n ta Zʋʋda, a sãag n ta m nebã tẽng dignoorẽ Zeruzalɛm.
Da moon-y kiba-kãng Gat tẽngã pʋg ye, ra yãb-y Ako tẽngã pʋg ye. Mam na n bilma tomẽ Bɛt-Leyafra.
Safɩɩr tẽng nebã, loog-y zaal ne yãnde, Sahanan tẽng nebã ka saagd n na n yi ye. Bɛt-Esɛll tẽng nebã wiisg yĩng kɩtame, tɩ yãmb ka tõe n paam a sõngr ye.
Maarot tẽng nebã maanda yɩɩre, ne b vɩɩmã sẽn na n yɩ-a soaba. Bala, Sẽn-Ka-Saab kɩtame tɩ toog wa, la a taa Zeruzalɛm tẽngã rignoyã.
Lakɩɩs tẽng nebã, sog-y wiidã saar-dãmba, Sɩyõ tẽn-neerã beegr sɩnga ne yãmba, bala, b yãame tɩ yaa yãmb n kɩte, tɩ Israyɛll nebã maan yel-wẽnã.
Yaa rẽ n kɩte, tɩ yãmb ne Moresɛt-Gat tẽng nebã tog n bas taaba. Ade, Akziib rotã na n yɩɩ belgr dot Israyɛll rĩm-dãmbã yĩnga.
Maaresa nebã! Mam na n leb n kɩtame tɩ ned a to wa soog yãmba. Israyɛll ziirã na n loog n taa hal Adulam.
Zʋʋda nebã! Wõrs-y y zoobdã, põng-y y zutã, kõog-y y zutã koɛbla, wa yɩbreng zugu, y kom-nongdsã yĩnga, bala, b na n yõg-b lame n tall n kẽng yembd n zãag ne yãmba.
Toog bee neb nins sẽn tagsd n dat n maan wẽngã zutu. Bãmb gãe b gãagẽ n saagd wẽnga, tɩ beoog sã n vẽeg bɩ b pids-a, bãmb sẽn tar pãn-tõog n tõe n pids-a wã yĩnga.
Bãmb sã n dat ned pʋʋg n deege, b reegd-a lame. La b sã n dat ned roog n deege, b reegd-a lame n sooge. Bãmb maanda ned ne a zak rãmb pãnga, n deegd bũmb nins b sẽn so wã.
Yaa rẽ tɩ Sẽn-Ka-Saab yetẽ yaa: «Ade, mam segendame n na n sɩbg nin-bãmbã rãmba. Yãmb kõn tõog n põse, la y kõn leb n tõog n kẽn ne zu-zẽkr ye, bala, yaa toog wakate.»

Badaare, b na n dɩka yãmb tɩ y lebg yel-bũndi, la b pʋt sũ-sãang yɩɩl yãmb wɛɛngẽ n yetẽ, «Ade, b sãama tõnd zãng fasɩ! B reesda mam nebã zĩisi! Maana a wãn tɩ b wa reesd tõnd zĩisi? B reesa tõnd pʋtã n pʋɩ kɩɩsdba!»
Yaa rẽ tɩ Wẽnnaam nebã sã n wa pʋɩt b zĩisã, yãmb sʋkã ned ba a yembr kõn paam pʋɩɩr ye.
B rag n zʋbsdame n yetẽ: «Da-y zʋbs-y ye, da-y zʋbs-y-yã a woto tɩ wẽnd wa tõnd paoogrã ka na n tol n sɛ ye.
Zakoob yagense, rẽ yĩnga, d tog n goma a woto sɩda? Sẽn-Ka-Saab sũ-marã sɛɛme la? Bãmb minim n maanda a woto sɩda? Rẽ yĩnga, mam goamã ka gom-nood ned ning sẽn kẽnd-a tɩrlem pʋg yĩng sɩda?»
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yetame: «Sẽn nan ka kaoose, yãmb yikame n lebg mam nebã bɛɛba. Bala, neb sã n yi zabr zĩigẽ n wat ne bãane, yãmb yekd-b lame n yeesd b fu-tagdã.
Yãmb digda mam nebã pagba, tɩ ned kam fãa yi n bas a roog a sẽn nonge. La mam sẽn kõ b kambã waoogr ningã, yãmb yiisd-a-la wakat fãa yĩnga.
Yik-y n loog-y tɩ yãmb ka leb n tõe n paam vʋʋsg zĩ-kãngã ye. Yãmb tʋʋm-dẽgdã yĩnga, y na n sãamame, la sãoongã na n yɩɩ kãsenga.»
Ned sã n yik a meng yĩng n yagd zĩrẽ n yeele: «Yãmb sã n kõ maam reezẽ rãam la rã-toos tɩ m yũ, mam na n togsa pĩnd-n-bãngr goam y yĩnga» yaa nin-kãng soabã n tog ne yãmba.

N-yẽe, mam na n tigma yãmb fãa sẽn yaa a Zakoob yagensã, la m tigim Israyɛll bu-kellã. Mam na n tigma bãmb wa piis sẽn be yãgr pʋgẽ, la wa rũms sẽn be b wãbneg zĩigẽ. B na n leb n wʋma neb rãamd tẽngã pʋga.
Sẽn pakd-a sorã na n lʋɩɩ bãmb taoore, la b na n paka sorã n yi be n looge. Bãmb dĩma yiime n be bãmb taoore, la Sẽn-Ka-Saab bee bãmb taoore.
Maam a Miise yetame: «A Zakoob yagensã taoor dãmba, Israyɛll buudã nanambse, m kot-y lame tɩ y kelge! Dẽ yĩnga, ka yãmb n dag n tog n bãng sẽn yaa tɩrg sɩda?
Yãmb yaool n kisa sẽn yaa sõama, la y nong sẽn yaa wẽnga. Yãmb sɩɩda m nebã n yãgsd b gãndã, la y seend b yĩngã nemd n basd kõaba.
Bãmb wãbda mam nebã, Bãmb puunda b gãndã, la b wõrd b kõabã. Bãmb beesd-b-la wa nemd sẽn be rʋkẽ, wa nemd sẽn be bugum dʋkẽ.
Dẽ, bãmb na n wa kelem n boola Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, la b ka na n leok bãmb ye. Badaare, Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n solga b nengã ne bãmba, wẽng ning bãmb sẽn maanã yĩnga.»
Ad Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yet no-rɛɛsdb nins sẽn tudgd mam nebã: «B sã n kõ bãmb tɩ b rɩ, b yetame tɩ yell kae ye. La b sã n ka kõ bãmb tɩ b rɩ, bãmb yikda zabr ne a soabã.

Bõn-kãng yĩng kɩtame, tɩ na n lebg wa yʋng yãmb yĩnga, la y ka na n leb n paam vẽnegr ye. Na n lebga lik bida yãmb yĩnga, tɩ y ka leb n tõe n paam yãab ye. Mam na n kɩtame tɩ zĩigã sobg no-rɛɛsdb-kãens yĩnga, la daarã na n lebga lik b yĩnga.
Bãngdbã fãa na n paama yãnde, la bagbã na n paama paoogre, bãmb fãa na n luda b nemsã, yãndã yĩnga. Bala, Wẽnnaam ka na n leb n leokd-b ye.»
La sã n yaa ne maam a Miise, Wẽnnaam Sɩɩgã pid-m-la ne pãnga, la tɩrlem, ne raoodo, tɩ m tõe n togs a Zakoob yagensã b kongrã, la m wilg Israyɛll nebã b yel-wẽnã.
Zakoob yagensã taoor dãmba, Israyɛll buudã nanambse, m kot-y lame tɩ y kelge! Yãmb dãmb sẽn kis tɩrlem, la y golemd sẽn yaa tɩrgã!
Yãmb daagda zɩɩm n met Sɩyõ, la y maand zãmb n met Zeruzalɛm.

Zeruzalɛm nanambsã reegda kũun n yaool n kao bʋʋdo. Bãmb maan-kʋʋdbã zãmsda nebã n deegd yaoodo, la b no-rɛɛsdbã togsda pĩnd-n-bãngr goamã n deegd wanzuri. Bãmb yaool n tika Sẽn-Ka-Saab n yetẽ yaa: «Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn be tõnd sʋkã yĩnga, yel-beed kõn tol n paam-d ye.»
Woto, yãmb yel-manesmã yĩng kɩtame, tɩ Sɩyõ na n lebg wa pʋʋg b sẽn gudgi. N-yẽe! Zeruzalɛm na n lebga raboogo, tɩ tãng ning Sẽn-Ka-Saab roogã sẽn be-a zugã lebg kãgre.
Wakat n wate, tɩ tãng ning Sẽn-Ka-Saab roogã sẽn tilg a zugã na n lug n yɩɩg tãms taabã, la a na n zẽkame t'a zãntlmã yɩɩg kunkubã zãntlem, La nebã na n zoe n waa beenẽ.

Buud wʋsg na n dabda beenẽ la b yetẽ: «Wa-y tɩ d rʋ Sẽn-Ka-Saab tãngã zugu, a Zakoob Wẽnnaamã roogẽ! Bãmb na n wilga tõnd b soayã, la tõnd na n tũu bãmb so-bugsã. Bala, bãmb tõogã na n yii Sɩyõ, la Sẽn-Ka-Saab gomdã na n yii Zeruzalɛm wa.

Bãmb na n yɩɩ neb wʋsg bʋ-kaooda, bãmb na n yɩɩ buud nins sẽn tar pãngã zab-paasda, baa ne sẽn be-b zĩ-zãrsã. B na n dɩka b zabr sʋʋsã n kud wãgse, la b rɩk b kãnã n kud goeto. Buud kõn tol n leb n yik zabr ne a to ye, la b kõn leb n zãms zabr sẽn zabd to-to ye.
Ned kam fãa na n zĩnda a reezẽ tɩɩg ne a kankang tẽngre, tɩ ned ka be n tõe n kẽes-b rabeem ye. Yaa Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã meng noor n yeele.»
Buud a taabã ned kam fãa kẽnda ne a wẽnnaam yʋʋre, la tõndo, tõnd kẽnda ne Sẽn-Ka-Saab daar fãa, la wakat sẽn ka sɛta.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yetame: «Badaare, mam na n tigma sẽn dag n keoosd-bã, la m tigim sẽn dag n sãeeg-bã, ne m sẽn dag n sɩbg-b rãmbã.
Mam na n kɩtame tɩ sẽn keoosd-bã yɩ bu-kelle, la m kɩt tɩ sẽn sãeeg-bã yɩ buud sẽn tar pãnga. Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n yɩɩ bãmb rĩm Sɩyõ tãngã zugu, sẽn sɩng ne moasã, hal tɩ ta wakat sẽn ka sɛta.
Foom, fo yaa gãsg piisã yĩnga. Sɩyõ tẽn-neer kunkubga, fo yaa pãng zĩiga. Fo na n leb n paama f pĩnd rĩungã. Zeruzalɛm, fo na n leb n lebga soolmã na-tẽnga.»
Moasã, bõe yĩng tɩ f kelemdẽ? Fo ka leb n tar dĩm la? Fo sagendã kiime n bas-f tɩ toog tar-f wa pag sẽn kũmd dogem la?

Zeruzalɛm tẽn-neere, yãbe, la f kũs wa pag sẽn kũmd dogem! Bala, moasã, fo na n yi n basa tẽngã, n tɩ zĩnd weoogẽ, la fo na n kẽnga hal Babilonde. Yaa beenẽ la b na fãag foom, yaa beenẽ la Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n deeg foom f bɛɛbã nugẽ.
Ade, moasã, buud wʋsg tigma taab n na n zab ne foom. Bãmb yetame: «Bɩ Sɩyõ paam paoogre! Bɩ a yɩ bõn-gɛtl tõnd nifẽ!»
Gese, nin-bãmbã ka mi Sẽn-Ka-Saab tagsgã ye, la b ka wʋmd b sẽn saagd n dat n maanã võor ye. Sẽn-Ka-Saab tigma bãmb wa b sẽn kals bɩle n ning zɛɛgẽ,

Sɩyõ tẽn-neere! Yik n tab koodã! Ade, mam na n kɩtame tɩ f yɩɩlã lebg kut yɩɩla, la m kɩt tɩ f nao-bendã lebg zũud nao-bendo, fo na n taba buud wʋsg neb n bedse, n dɩk b zãmbã teed n kõ Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, la b arzegsã n kõ dũniyã fãa soaalã.
Moasã, Zeruzalɛm dãmba, bog-y y yĩnsã! Bɛɛbã gũbga tõndo, la b na n wẽe Israyɛll bʋ-kaoodã yɛgdg ne dasaare.
«Foom Betlehɛm Efrata, baa ne fo sẽn yaa buud sẽn paood Zʋʋda buud wʋsg sʋkã, mam na n kɩtame tɩ naab yi fo pʋgẽ, n soog Israyɛll nebã, La yẽnda yẽgrã sɩnga hal pĩnda, kʋdem-wẽndẽ.
Yaa rẽ n kɩt tɩ Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n bas Israyɛll nebã, hal tɩ pag ning sẽn na n dog-a wã roge. Dẽ poore, yẽnda saam-biisã sẽn kellã, na n lebg n leba Israyɛll nebã nengẽ.

La yẽnda na n yikame n ges a nebã yell ne Sẽn-Ka-Saab pãnga, wa pe-kɩɩm sẽn dɩlgd a piisi. Yẽnda na n gesa b yell ne Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa yẽnda Wẽnnaamã yʋʋr sẽn tar ziirã, la yẽnda nebã nan zĩnda be. Bala, moasã, bãmb na n yɩɩ kãseng dũniyã tɛk fãa.
La yẽnda na n waa ne vɩ-bãane! Asiiri nebã sã n wa yãmb tõnd tẽngã, la b kẽ d na-yiyã pʋse, tõnd na n kɩtame tɩ nanambs a yopoe, ne nin-kãsems a nii zab ne-ba.
Bãmb na n sooga Asiiri tẽngã ne zabr sʋʋga, la a Nimrood tẽngã neb ne munumuni.»
A Zakoob buudã neb nins sẽn kellã na yɩɩ wa meenem sẽn yit Sẽn-Ka-Saab nengẽ buud wʋsg sʋka, la wa saag sẽn madgd moodo. Bãmb ka teeg ninsaal pãnga, la b ka baood baa fɩ ninsaalb nengẽ ye.

A Zakoob buudã neb nins sẽn kellã, sẽn be bu-zẽms sʋk ne buud wʋsg sʋkã na n yɩɩ wa gɩgemd sẽn be we-rũms sʋka. Bãmb na n yɩɩ wa gɩgem-poll sẽn be piis sʋka, n pɩʋʋgd n tabd n tat n gʋsda, tɩ ned ka be n na n fãag-b ye.
Israyɛll nebã! Yik-y n zab-y ne y zabd-n-taasã, la y menes y bɛɛbã zãnga!
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yetame: «Ade, badaare, mam na n menesa y wiidã, la m sãam y saar-dãmbã.
Mam na n menesa y soolmã tẽmsã, la m lub y pãng zĩisã fãa.
Mam na n menesa y tɩtã tʋʋma, la bag-bʋgd kõn leb n zĩnd yãmb sʋk ye.
M na n menesa y bõn-naandsã fãa, la y kug-vigindsã. Yãmb kõn leb n wõgemd n waoog bũmb nins yãmb nus sẽn naanã ye.
Mam na n vigsa a Aseera ra-lugdsã, la m sãam y tẽmsã.
Mam na n doka m sũurã ne bu-zẽms nins sẽn ka kelg maamã ne sũ-yikri, la sũ-puug-kãsenga.»
M kotame tɩ y kelg Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yeta: «Togs-y yẽgengã võore, tɩ tãmsã ne kunkubã kelge!»
Tãmse! Kelg-y Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn bʋʋd ne b nebã. Yãmb sẽn yaa tẽngã yẽbgr sẽn be wakat fãa wã, kelg-y-yã! Bala, maam a Sẽn-Ka-Saab rat n bʋʋ ne m nebã, la m tara yell ne Israyɛlle.
Mam nebã, m maan-y-la bõe? M nams-y-la ne bõe? Leok-y-ma!
Bala, mam yiisa yãmb Ezɩpt tẽnga. Mam fãaga yãmb y yembdã pʋga. Mam tʋma a Moyiis ne a Aarõ, la a Miryam tɩ b wa lʋɩ yãmb taoore.

Mam nebã, m kotame tɩ y tẽeg Moaab rĩm a Balak sẽn dag n sagl a Balaam t'a maan bũmb ningã, la a Bewoor biig a Balaam sẽn leok yẽnda to-to wã. Tẽeg-y bũmb nins sẽn maan yãmb y sẽn wa n na n pɩʋʋg Sitim n kẽng Gilgallã yelle, tɩ yãmb tõe n bãng tɩ maam a Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn maan bũmb ninsã zemsame.

Bõe la mam na n tall n kẽng Sẽn-Ka-Saab taoore? M na n talla bõe n tɩ wõgemd Wẽnnaam sẽn be saasẽ wã taoore? Mam na n waa bãmb taoor ne maand sẽn yõogd bugum bɩ? Bɩ m na n waa bãmb taoor ne nag-bi sẽn tar yʋʋmde?

Mam sã n kõ Sẽn-Ka-Saab pe-raad tusa, wall m kõ-b kaam sẽn yaa wʋsg wa ko-zoetem, bãmb sũur na n yɩɩ noog bɩ? Mam na n dɩka m bi-rẽeng n kõ-b n paam m beegrã sugr bɩ? Mam na n dɩka m bi-roak n kõ-b n paam m yel-wẽnã sugri bɩ?
Ninsaala, b kɩtame tɩ fo bãng sẽn yaa sõamã, Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn dat tɩ f maan bũmb ning bala, yaa tɩ f maan sẽn yaa tɩrga, la f nong maan-neere, la f kẽn ne f Wẽnnaamã ne sik-m-menga.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab koɛɛg moonda tẽnga pʋgẽ, sẽn tar-b yamã zoeta bãmb yʋʋrã. Kelg-y sɩbgr koɛɛga
Dẽ yĩnga, mam na n sakame tɩ nin-wẽnsã tigsd laog b sẽn paam ne zãmbã, la bãmb tar zãmb-makdsã n magd tɩ yikd mam sũurã?
Mam tõe n kõ neb nins sẽn tar-b zãmb makdsã bʋʋm sɩda?
Tẽngã arzegs rãmb maanda wẽnga, tẽnga neb yagda zĩrẽ, bãmb noyã gomda belgr goamã.
Rẽ n kɩte, tɩ mam me na n sɩbg yãmb tɩ y namse, la m sãam yãmb y yel-wẽnã yĩnga.
Yãmb na n dɩɩme, la y kõn tɩg ye, kom na n ket n tara yãmba! Yamb na n kẽgsame, la y kõn yã zĩig n bĩng ye, la bũmb ning fo sẽn bĩngã, mam na n kɩtame tɩ b zab ne yãmb n deeg-a.
Yãmb na n bʋdame, la y kõn kẽeb ye, y na n wõda oliiv kaam, la y kõn paam-a n zɛ ye, y na n wẽka reezẽ biis koom, la kõn yũ a reezẽ rãamã ye.

Nebã sakda a Omri no-tũudsã, la b rɩkd a Akaab roogã rãmb manesmã fãa, tɩ yãmb sakd bãmb saglsã. Woto yĩnga, mam na n basame tɩ y sãame, n kɩt tɩ y lebg bɛɛb laada, la mam nebã paoogr na n lʋɩɩ yãmb zugu.

Toog tara maam, bala, mam yaa wa ned sẽn wa n na n wob tɩ-biisi, sɩpaolg wẽnde, la wa ned sẽn wa reezẽ yiisgu, reezẽ wobr poore. Tɩ reezẽ gĩnd ba a ye ka be sẽn na n dɩ ye, la kankam-dẽems nins mam sẽn nongã ba a ye ka be ye.
Sɩd soab ba a ye ka be tẽngã pʋg ye, la nin-tɩrg ba a ye ka be nebã sʋk ye, bãmb fãa sor n baood n daaga zɩɩm, ned kam fãa rɩgla bẽdg a saam-biig yĩnga.
Bãmb sẽn mi yaa wẽng maaneg bala. Naab ka maand neer tɩ b ka reeg bũmb ye, Bʋ-kaoodã ka kaood bʋʋd t'a ka reeg kũun ye, Nin-kãsemsã wilgda b yão-beedã, la b naagd taab n tʋmd b tʋʋm-beedo.

Bãmb sʋkã neb nins sẽn são-b b taabã yaa wa gõose. La bãmb sʋkã nin-tɩrsã wẽnda gõ-payãndse. Gũudbã sẽn dag n gomd daar ning yellã taame, yaa daar ning fo sẽn na n yals n togs f yɛlã fãa wã. Moasã, bãmb na n paama yãnde.
Da-y kɩs-y sɩd ne a zoa ye, la y ra rɩk y teegr n teeg y taab ye. Baa ne pag ning sẽn gãe gãag a ye zug ne foomã taoore, bɩ y ra yaag y noor ye.
Bala, bi-ribl paoogda a ba, tɩ bi-pugl zabd ne a ma, tɩ bi-pag zabd ne a sɩd ma. La ned kam fãa meng zak rãmb lebga a bɛɛba.
La sã n yaa ne maam, mam na n gũu Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, mam na n yals n gũu Wẽnnaam sẽn yaa mam fãagrã. Mam Wẽnnaamã na n kelga maam.
Mam bɛyã, ra maan sũ-noog mam wɛɛngẽ ye, bala, baa mam sã n lʋɩ, m yikdame. La baa mam sã n zĩ lik pʋgẽ, Sẽn-Ka-Saab yaa mam vẽenem.
Mam sẽn beeg Sẽn-Ka-Saabã yĩnga, mam na n sak n deega b sũ-puugrã, hal tɩ b wa zab n sõng maam, n lebs maam m bʋʋmã. Bãmb na n talla maam n kẽng vẽenemẽ, la m na n yãnda bãmb tɩrlem tʋʋmã.
Mam bɛ wã na n yãndame, la yãnd na n yõk-a lame. Bala, yẽnda rag n yetame: «Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa fo Wẽnnaamã bee yɛ?» B na n taba bãmb wa sor zug begd tɩ mam yãnde.
Daar ning b sẽn na n lebs n me y tẽngã lalsã, badaare, b na n yalga yãmb tẽngã todse.

La badaare, neb na n yii sẽn sɩng ne Asiiri, la Ezɩpt tẽmsã, la sẽn sɩng ne Nill kʋɩlgã n tãag Efrat kʋɩlgã, la sẽn sɩng ne ko-kãsengã noor n tãag a to, sẽn sɩng ne tãng a yembr n tãag a to n wa fo nengẽ.
La dũni wã fãa sẽn kellã na n sãamame, tẽngã nebã tʋʋm-wẽnsã yĩnga.
Dɩk-y y dasaarã n tɛ y nebã, yãmb nebã yaa yãmb n so, Bãmb zĩ b yembr kãgrẽ, tɩ b pʋtã gũbg-ba. Tall-y-b wa pĩndã, n tɩ wãbneg Basan ne Galaad tẽmsã mo-maasẽ wã.
Mam na n wilga bãmb tʋʋm-kãsemse, wa wakat ning mam sẽn dag n yiis bãmb Ezɩpt tẽngã.
Buud a taabã baa ne b pãnga sẽn yaa to-to wã fãa, na n yãnda bõn-kãens tɩ yãnd yõk-ba. Bãmb na n pĩ b noyã, la b tʋbã ka na n leb n wʋm ye.
Bãmb na n moga tẽngã tom wa wiisi, wa tẽngã bõn-vuuds buudã fãa, bãmb na n yii b pãng zĩisẽ wã ne rigbu, n wa yãmb a Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa tõnd Wẽnnaamã nengẽ, la bãmb na n yɛɛsame n zoe yãmba.
Wẽnnaam-bʋg n be n yaa wa yãmba, n kõt bu-kellã sẽn yaa yãmb dẽndã a beegr sugri, la a ka geelgd a kongrã? Yãmb sũ-yikrã ka paad wakat fãa ye. Bala, y sũur noomame tɩ wilg y sõmblem.
Yãmb na n leb n zoee tõnd nimbãanega, la y ka na n leb n geelg tõnd kongrã ye. Yãmb na n loba tõnd yel-wẽnã fãa ko-kãsenga zĩ-zulums pʋga.
Yãmb na n wilga a Zakoob yagensã y nonglem, la y wilg a Abrahaam yagensã y sõmblem, wa y sẽn dag n wẽen ne d yaab-rãmbã kʋdem-wẽndẽ wã.
Seb-kãngã yaa sɩbgr koɛɛg sẽn kẽed ne Niniiv tẽngã wɛɛngẽ. Yaa Sẽn-Ka-Saab n vẽneg Ɛlkoos tẽng rao a Nahum koe-kãngã.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yaa Wẽnnaam sẽn ka rat tɩ b rɩk bãmb waoogrã n kõ Wẽnnaam a to ye. Sẽn-Ka-Saab rokda b sũuri, bãmb sũ-puug-kãsengã pʋga. Bãmb dokda b sũur ne kɩɩsdbã. Bãmb ka basd b bɛɛbã taal ye.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yaa sũ-mar soaba. Bãmb pãngã yaa kãsenga. Bãmb ka basd koangd n ka sɩbg-a ye. Bãmb sã n kẽnda, sob-kãseng n yikdi.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab sã n tãs ko-kãsengã, a kʋɩtame Bãmb kɩtdame tɩ kʋɩlsã fãa kʋɩtẽ, tɩ Basan yam-maasã kʋɩtẽ, tɩ Karmell tãngã lʋgrẽ yamdã zelgdẽ, tɩ Libã tɩ-puudã kʋɩtẽ.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab kẽnda tãmsã zut tɩ b miimdẽ, tɩ kunkubã sirgdẽ. Bãmb tabda tẽn-gãongã t'a wʋgemdedẽ, dũniyã gill fãa ne a nebã rigda bãmb taoore.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab sũurã sã n puugi, ãnda n tõe n põse? Ãnda n tõe n põs bãmb sũ-puugrã? Bãmb sũ-puugrã rɩta wa bugum, tɩ baa pĩig kugã pusd bãmb taoore
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yaa sõngo, bãmb yaa zĩ-lilldg yel-pakr wakate. Bãmb geta sẽn solgd-b bãmb nengẽ wã yelle.
La wa koom sẽn kãagd bũmb fãa to-to n loogdẽ wã, Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n menesa b bɛɛbã zãnga. Bãmb na n dig-b lame n tɩ kʋ-b zãng fasɩ.
Saag-wẽn-bʋs la yãmb saagd ne Sẽn-Ka-Saabo? Bãmb na n menesa b bɛɛbã yel-pakrã ka na n yɩ naoor a yiib ye.
Baa bɛɛbã sã n kal taab wa gõose, la ba b sã n yũu rãam tɩ b nens yilimdẽ, bugum n na n dɩ-b zãng wa mo-koeemse.
Niniiv tẽnga, ned ning sẽn saagd n dat n zab ne Sẽn-Ka-Saabã yii fo pʋgẽ. Ned ning sẽn da saagd n dat n wa ne sãoongã yii fo pʋgẽ.

Ad Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yet Zʋʋda nebã: Baa yãmb bɛɛbã fãa sã n naag taaba, baa b waooglmã ne b pãngã sẽn zem to-to, b na n menemame tɩ bũmb ka kell ye. Mam sẽn bas tɩ b namsd yãmb woto wã, Yaa sẽn na yɩl n da leb n nams yãmb ye.
Moasã, mam na n kaoo yãmb yubl balgrã, la m kao y bãensã.

Niniiv tẽnga, ad Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yet fo wɛɛngẽ: «Fo yʋʋrã na n menema zãnga. Mam na n sãama f raad wẽn-naandsã, ne f kut wẽn-naandsã sẽn be f pʋʋsg roogẽ wã. Mam na n segla f yaoogo, bala, fo ka tar yõod baa bilf ye.»

Zʋʋda nebã, koe-toagsd n be tãmsã zut n watẽ. Yẽnda wata ne koe-noogo, la laafɩ koɛɛga! Dẽ yĩngã, bɩ y maan y tigã, la y pids y pʋlendã! Bala, sãamdã ka na n leb n pɩʋʋg yãmb sʋk ye. Yẽnda pãngã sɛɛ zãnga.
Niniiv rãmba, tãb-biis n wat n na n zab ne yãmba, Bɩ y gũ y tẽngã lalse, la y gũ y soayã! Sẽbg-y y sɛɛga, la y paam daood n yɩ gãndaado.
Bala, Sẽn-Ka-Saab lebsda a Zakoob yagensã b waoogrã, la b lebsd Israyɛll a ziirã. Bala, fãadbã rag n fãa bãmba, n sãam bãmb wa b sẽn kao wila.
Tãb-biisã gãnd yaa miidu, Gãndaadã yera fu-miidu. B saar-dãmbã b sẽn segl zabrã yĩngã pãrda wa bugum, tɩ b kãnã zẽgsdẽ.
Saar-dãmbã zoeta soayã zut ne tʋʋlem, n pɩʋʋmd zĩisã fãa wa bug-vɩlense, la b zoeta ne tʋʋlem wa sa-yãgbo
Niniiv rĩmã tigsda a tãb-bi-gãndaadã, la b kẽndame n lagsdẽ. Zab-zabdbã zoet n wata tẽngã lalg sẽnẽ, la b soonda lalgã poore.
Tẽngã rignoy nins sẽn tees kʋɩlsã sẽnẽ wã pagsame, la na-yirã neb pɛleng yɩkame tɩ b rigda.
B rɩka wẽn-poakã naandã n looge, t'a tʋmtʋmd-pogsã wũusd wa manwala, n pĩisd b yãado.
Niniiv tẽngã lebga wa ko-baoor sẽn wurg t'a koomã raagdẽ, B boonda tãb-biisã sẽn zoetã n yetẽ: «Yals-y-yã! Yals-y-yã!» La bãmb ned ba a yembr ka wẽnemded a poorẽ ye.
B rag n yetame: «Zɛ-y wanzuri wã! Zɛ-y sãnemã!» Tẽngã laogã ka tar tɛk ye. Laog buud toor-toor sẽn tar yõod bee be.
Zɛɛbo! Wãabo! Sãoongo! Nebã fãa raood sɛɛme, tɩ b rũmã pãbd taaba. Bãmb digda ne rabeem, tɩ b nensã bondge.
Gɩgma wã gãag zĩig bee yɛ? Gɩgem-poalã sẽn dag n paamd b rɩɩb ziig ningã bee yɛ? Gɩgem-daoogã ne gɩgem-yãangã sã n da yi n bas gɩgem-bi wã, ned ka be n na n saag n sɩɩs-b ye.
Gɩgem-daoogã rag n yit n yõgd n gʋsdame, n wat n kõt gɩgem-yãangã ne gɩgem-bi wã, gɩgemdã gãag zĩig pida ne rũms a sẽn yõg nemdo.

Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã yetame: «Niniiv tẽnga, mam na n zaba ne foom! Mam na n ninga fo saar-dãmbã bugum, la fo kom-bɩɩsã sẽn yaa wa gɩgem-poalã na n paa tãp pʋgẽ. Fo kõn leb n tõog n fã dũniyã nebã paoong yɛs ye. La b kõn leb n wʋm fo koe-toagsdbã rãamd ye.»
Ade, tẽng ning sẽn daagd-a zɩɩmã na paam toogo! Yẽnda pida ne zãmb la fãabo, la a ka basd a fãabã ye.
Tẽngã pʋga, b wʋmda kalwaas-rãmb sẽn fɩɩnde, ne saar-dãmb nao rãamde, la wiid nao-kida, la zabr saar-dãmb bʋrgo.
Zabrã yikame, Zab-zabdbã sʋʋs pɩndame, tɩ kãnã pɩʋʋmd wa sa-yãgbo. Kũumã rʋra zĩigã fãa, kũumã zama taaba. B sõorã ka tar tɛk ye. Naoor sẽn tabgdẽ fãa yaa kũum.
La rẽ fãa yaa pʋg-yoodrã yoobã yĩnga. Yẽnda maana yoob naoor ka tɛka, la yẽnda rɩka a neermã n belg buud a taabã. Yẽnda maana sɩlem n tus buud a taabã, n kẽes yembd pʋga.
Rẽ n kɩte, tɩ Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã yetẽ yaa: Mam na n zaba ne foom! Mam na n pilga f fuugã n tãag f nengã, tɩ buud a taabã yãnd f sẽn yaa zaalã, tɩ soolem-dãmbã yã f yãndã.
Mam na n vu-f-la begdẽ, n ning f yãnd nebã nifẽ.
Woto, ned ning sẽn yãnd-a foom fãa, a na n loba a neng kɛɛng n yeele: «Niniiv tẽnga, fo sãamame. Ãnda n na n yãb-fo? M na n yãnda bɛlsd yɛɛnẽ n kõ-fo?»
Niniiv tẽnga, fo sãoo No-Amon tẽngã Nill kʋɩlgã sẽn dag n gũbgã la? Ko-kãseng n dag n yaa yẽnda lal-gũbri.
Kuus ne Ezɩpt n dag n kõt yẽnda teegre, la Put ne Libi n dag n sõngd yẽnda zabr wakate.

La ne rẽ fãa, b yõga No-Amon tẽng nebã, n tall-b n tɩ kẽes yembdo. Bãmb bɛɛbã neema bãmb kom-pogdã so-tiisẽ, la b yõg a nanambsã n sẽb ne bãense. Gãndaadã yõga bãmb kãsem-dãmbã, n pʋɩ taab n maan-b yembse.
Niniiv tẽnga, fo me neng na n yilma wa ned sẽn tɩg rãam, la fo na n baoo zĩig sẽn na soonde, sẽn na yɩl n paam n põs f bɛɛbã.
Fo lalsã fãa yaa wa kankang bi-rẽems sẽn bɩ, tɩ b sã n miimd-a bɩ a kankamã lʋɩt sẽn dat-a n dɩ fãa noorẽ.
Ade, fo tãb-biisã yaa nin-saan-pagb gilli. Fo rignoyã pagsa b toore, tɩ f bɛɛbã tũud be n kẽedẽ. Bugum dɩta fo rignoyã kʋɩlen-kũyã.
Niniiv tẽnga, Wi koom n bĩng zabrã yĩnga! Maneg f lalsã n me! Kẽ begdẽ n tab tãndo, La f rɩk f tãn-koeem-wamã!
La baa ne rẽ fãa, bãng tɩ bugum n na n dɩ-fo. Fo na n paa tãpẽ! Bugmã na n dɩ-f-la wa kalwaar sẽn dɩt koodo. Bɩ fo nebã zama taab wa kalwaare! Bɩ b zam taab wa sʋyã!
Niniiv tẽnga, fo lɛɛbdbã sõor dag n lebga wʋsgo, tɩ b sõorã yɩɩd yĩngr ãdse, n yẽnegd wa kalwaar sẽn dɩ bɩle n sɛ n bas n yɩke.
Fo rigno-gũudbã rag n yaa wʋsg wa sʋyã, tɩ fo tʋmtʋmdbã rag n yaa wʋsg wa kalwaare, tɩ zĩig sã n maage, bɩ b rʋʋgd tuud zutu. La sõorã sã n puki, b yɩkdame tɩ ned ka mi b sẽn teesẽ ye.
Asiiri rĩma, fo kombɛɛmbã gõeeme. Fo gãndaadã ka leb n maand rãamd ye! Fo nebã sãeegame n be tãmsã zutu, tɩ ned ka be n na n tigim-b ye.
Fo poglgã ka tar tɩɩm ye, Fo nodrã na n tũu ne f yõore. Neb nins fãa sẽn na n wʋm tɩ b gomd fo yellã na n maana sũ-noogo, bala, ãnda n be tɩ fo ka maan-a wẽnga?
Ad sɩbgr koɛɛg Wẽnnaam no-rɛɛs a Habakuk sẽn deeg vẽnegr pʋgẽ.
B yeelame: «Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, mam na n kelem n boola yãmb n kos sõngr tɩ ta dabʋre, tɩ y yaool n kelg-ma? Mam na n kelem n boola yãmb tɩ y fãag-d ne wõr-taabã tɩ ta dabʋre, tɩ y yaool n fãag-do?
Bõe yĩng tɩ yãmb bas tɩ m yãt tʋʋm-wẽnsã, bõe yĩng tɩ y get tõnd tɩ d be namsg pʋga? Sãoong ne wõr-taabã gũbga maam. Lebga zab taaba, tɩ nokoɛɛmã rãamd zẽkdẽ.
Rẽ kɩtame, tɩ ned ba a yembr ka leb n sakd tõogã ye. Bʋ-tɩrg ka tol n leb n beẽ ye, bala, nin-wẽnsã gũbga nin-tɩrga. Rẽ kɩtame, tɩ bʋ-kɛgã reeg bʋ-tɩrsã zĩiga.»
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yeela b nebã yaa: «Ges-y bu-zẽmsã sʋka, ges-y tɩ y pɛleng yɩke, tɩ yɩ lingr ne-yã. Bala, bũmb n maand yãmb wakate, la b sã n dag n yeel yãmba, yãmb ka na n tẽ ye.
Ade, mam na n kɩtame tɩ Kalde rãmbã sẽn yaa nin-toose, la nin-wẽnsã paam pãnga. Bãmb pɩʋʋgda soolem-kãsemse, n deesd zĩis n soogdẽ, tɩ yaool n ka bãmb dẽnd ye.
Bu-kãng yaa bu-toaaga, la b seka zoeese. Yẽnda viginda a meng tɩrlem ne a naam.
Yẽnda wiidã zoees tʋʋlem yɩɩda ãbga, bãmb zabdame n yɩɩd zaab-noor kata. Bãmb wed-rʋʋdbã yita zĩ-zãrgẽ n fõt n watẽ, b yɩgda wa pa-nand-tugr sẽn fõt n wat n na n dɩk a rɩɩbo.
Kalde rãmbã fãa watame n dat n wõre. Bãmb naka b neng n tees tɩrg bala. Bãmb yõga neb sẽn yaa wʋsg wa bĩisr n maan yembse.
Bu-kãng toog ka be ne rĩm-dãmba, la b laada nanambse. Bãmb ka yɛɛsd tẽms sẽn gũbg ne lals ye. Bãmb zamda tãnd n dʋʋd n deesd tẽn-bãmba.
Bãmb pɩʋʋgd n loogda wa sob-raoogo, b maanda wẽnga, la bãmb pãngã n yaa b Wẽnnaam!»

Mam Wẽnnaam Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, m Pʋ-Peelem-Soaba, ka yãmb n sɩng n be hal kʋdem-wẽndẽ la? Tõnd ka na n ki ye! Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, yãmb n yãk Babilond nebã tɩ b kao tõnd bʋʋdo. Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa m Pĩig Kugri, yãmb n yãk bãmb tɩ b sɩbg tõndo.

Yãmb ninã yaa yɩlem wʋsgo, n ka tõe n ges wẽng ye. Yãmb ka tõe n sak n getẽ tɩ b maand wẽngã ye. La yaa bõe yĩng tɩ y sĩnd n get zãmb dãmbã? Bõe yĩng tɩ yãmb sĩnd n getẽ tɩ nin-wẽng sãamd sẽn yaa-a tɩrg n yɩɩd yẽnda wã?
Yãmb maanda ninsaalbã wa ko-kãsengã pʋgẽ zĩma, y maand-b-la wa bõn-kẽndsã sẽn ka tar soaalã!
Babilond nebã yõgda bãmb fãa wa b sẽn yõgd zĩm ne lɛooga. B vuuga bãmb ne gãmbr n yiisi, n yãgsd bãmb n ningd zũnunsẽ, n maand sũ-noog n kɩdemdẽ.
Rẽ kɩtame, tɩ b maand maand b gãmba wã yĩnga, la b yõogd wisd n kõt b zũnunsã. B yetame tɩ yaa bãmb yĩng la b paam naare, bãmb yĩng la b paam rɩ-nood n dɩtẽ.
Rẽ yĩnga, b na n tara b gãmba wã zukri, la b tar buud a taabã n sãamdẽ tɩ nimbãan-zoeer ka beẽ?
Mam na n dʋʋ m gũubã zĩigẽ, la m na n yalsa lalgã zugu. Mam na n gũume n ges Wẽnnaam sẽn na n yeel maam tɩ bũmb ninga, la mam me sẽn na n leok tɩ bũmb ning m yẽgengã wɛɛngẽ.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab leoka maam n yeele: «Gʋls vẽnegr ning fo sẽn yã wã, gʋls-a vẽeneg kug-wals zutu, t'a kaoreng tõe n yɩ naana.
Bala, yaa vẽnegr sẽn na n wa paam pidsgu, a wakatã sã n ta, ka na n yɩ belgr ye, la a ka na n vaal n ka pids ye. Ba a sã n kaoosdẽ, bɩ f kell n gũ-a, bala, a ka na n pa n ka paam pidsg ye.»
«Gese, bãmb wukda b mense, n ka maand sẽn yaa tɩrg ye, la nin-tɩrg na n vɩɩmda a tẽebã yĩnga.

Hakɩɩka, reezẽ rãam belgda neda, wuk-m-meng soab ka zĩ sɩɩ ye. Bãmb yaaga b noy wa kɩɩm-kulgu, bãmb yaa wa kũum sẽn ka tɩgdã. B kãaga bu-zẽmsã fãa n naag b menga, bãmb tigma buud toay-toayã fãa b nengẽ.»

Bu-bãmb fãa na n wẽneg n yaala bãmba, n dɩk-b tɩ b lebg yel-bũndi. Bãmb na n yetame: «Gese, toog bee ned ning sẽn wʋkd a sẽn ka so zugu, yãmb na n fãa nebã hal tɩ ta dabʋre? Yaa sam bal la a wʋkd n samd a menga!
Yãmb sẽn tar-b rãmb samã na n wa ling-y lame, bãmb na n kɩtame tɩ y rig ne rabeem. Bãmb me na n fãa yãmb paoongã!
Yãmb sẽn fã buud toay-toay paoongã yĩnga, neb nins sẽn ketã na n fãa yãmba. Bala, yãmb daaga zɩɩm, la y maan tẽms a taabã pãnga, n maan tẽmsã ne b nebã fãa wẽnga.»
«Toog bee ned ning sẽn zãmbd a taab n baood yõod a roagdb yĩngã zugu. Yẽnda maanda a woto sẽn na n yɩl n kogl a menga, wa liuul sẽn tɩʋ a tʋk zĩ-zãonglgẽ, tɩ bũmb da wa maan-a ye.
Woto yaa yãnd bal la yãmb bao n na n kõ y buudã. Yãmb sẽn sãam buud wʋsg nebã, yaa yell bal la y rogend y meng zugu.
Baa kugã sẽn be lalsã zutã na n kelmame, tɩ sug-raoogã sẽn be sugrã zugã reesdẽ.»
«Toog bee ned ning sẽn daagd zɩɩm n met tẽngã zugu. Toog bee ned ning sẽn maand zãmb n tilgd tẽngã zugu!»
«Rẽ ka bugum sẽn yit Saasẽ-Pãng-Soabã nengẽ sɩda? Ninsaalbã tʋmdame n namsd b mens zaalem bala, nebã naongã ka tar yõod ye.
Bala, dũni wã na n pida ne Sẽn-Ka-Saab ziirã bãngre, wa ko-kãsengã koom sẽn pid n saalã.»
«Toog bee ned ning sẽn yũnugd a taab rãam, la a yũnugd-b zẽnem tɩ b nens yilimdẽ, t'a tõe n yãnd b yãndã zugu.
Yãmb ka waoogd y mens ye, yãmb paoogda y mense. Bɩ yãmb me yũ n fʋgs y bɛɛla! Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n yũnuga yãmb b sũ-puugrã rãam, tɩ yãmb waoogrã lebg paoogre!

Bala, wẽng ning yãmb sẽn maan Libã wã na n dɩ-y lame. B na n sãama rũms nins sẽn dag n sãamdã, b sẽn daag ninsaalb zɩɩmã yĩnga, b sẽn maan tẽmsã wẽngã yĩnga, yaa b sẽn maan tẽmsã ne b nebã fãa wẽngã yĩnga.»
Wẽn-naandgã yõak sẽn yõgdã yõod bee yɛɛnẽ? Yẽnda yaa kut b sẽn yẽneg bala, la a yaa belgr bũmb bala. Yõak na n maana a wãn n leb n dɩk a teegr n teeg yẽnda, tɩ yaool n yaa wẽn-naands sẽn yaa mugsi?

Toog bee ned ning sẽn gomd-a ne ra-giig n yetẽ: «Yik n yalse!» La a yet kugr sẽn ka gomdã: «Nek n yiki!» Rẽ yĩnga, yẽnda tõe n kõo ned bãngr sɩda? B bolg-a-la ne sãnem la wanzuri bala, la vɩɩm yaool n ka be a pʋgẽ ye.
La Sẽn-Ka-Saab be b ro-sõngã pʋga. Bɩ dũniyã gill yɩ sɩddd... bãmb taoore!
Wẽnnaam no-rɛɛs a Habakuk pʋʋsgo, a yẽgengã wɛɛngẽ:

Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, mam dag n wʋmame tɩ b gomd yãmb tʋʋm-kãsemsã yelle. Yãmb tʋʋm-kãsemsã kẽesa maam dabeem. Maan-y tʋʋm-kãens tõnd zamaanẽ wã. Kɩt-y tɩ tõnd zamaanẽ nebã bãng y tʋʋm-kãsemsã! La y sũ-yikrã pʋga, tẽeg-y y nimbãan-zoeerã yelle!
Wẽnnaam yii Teman n watẽ, Pʋ-Peelem-Soabã yii Paarã tãngã n watẽ. Bãmb vẽenemã sẽn yãgdã luda sa-gãongã, tɩ b waoogrã pid dũniyã gilli.
Bãmb yaa wa vẽenem sẽn yãgde. Vẽenem sẽn yãgd n yit bãmb nugẽ wã, la bãmb pãngã solga beenẽ.
Bã-longds n dengd bãmb taoore, tɩ yĩn-wɩngr pʋgd b poore.
Bãmb yalsame n mag tẽngã, bãmb gesame n kɩt tɩ ninsaalb pɛleng yɩke. Pĩnd zamaanẽ tãmsã miimame. Tɩ kʋdem-wẽndẽ zamaanẽ kunkubã sirgdẽ, zĩ-kãens rag n yaa bãmb so-tũudsi.
Mam neeme tɩ b menesa Kusan tẽng nebã fu-roto, la b zũndga Madiyã nebã rot suga.
Sẽn-Ka-Saabo, yaa ne kʋɩlsã la y yik y sũurã la? Rẽ yĩnga, yaa kʋɩlsã n kɩt tɩ y sũurã yik la? Yãmb sũurã sẽn puugã yaa ne ko-kãsengã la? Yãmb zombda y wiidi, yãmb zombda y tõogr saar-dãmba.
Yãmb rʋʋsa y tãpo, yãmb wẽenegã yaa pɛɛm sẽn yit y noorẽ. Yãmb kɩtdame tɩ kʋɩls pus tẽn-gãongã zug n bundẽ.
Tãmsã yãnda yãmb n digda, Sa-koom kiiga ne pãnga, tɩ b wʋmd bog-zulumsã sẽn kuglumdi, t'a koomã tãoosd n kuiis yĩngri.
Yãmb pɛɛmã sẽn fɩɩnd n loogdẽ wã, tɩ y kãndã sẽn pɩndã fõt n loogdẽ wã, kɩtame tɩ wĩntoogã ne kiuugã pa b zĩigẽ n ka serg ye.
Yãmb sũur puugame n saagd dũniyã, yãmb tabda bu-zẽmsã ne sũ-kãbre.
Yãmb yiime n na n fãag y nebã, Yãmb yi n na n fãaga y nin-tũusdgã. Yãmb sãamda nin-wẽng roog sugri, y sãamd-a-la zãng tɩ bũmb ka kell ye.

Yãmb wẽneg n deega bɛɛbã pɛɛm n kõs b nanambsã zutu. Nanambsã yaool n dag n fõta wa sobg n wat n na n sãam maam. B zoet n watame la b kaasd ne sũ-noogo, tɩ wẽnd wa b sẽn solg n paam nimbãan-ned n sãame.
Yãmb pãrga sor ko-kãsengã pʋg y wiidã yĩnga, y pãrg-a-la ko-pɛmã sẽn tar pãngã sʋka.

Mam sẽn wʋm bʋrgã, mam põaagã bendgame. Bʋrgã kɩtame tɩ m no-bɩmsã rigda, tɩ mam kõabã wãgda, tɩ m naoã gĩin maage. La m dag n yasa sɩɩ n gũudẽ, m dag n gũuda sũ-sãangã daare, m dag n gũuda daar ning tõnd sẽn na n tɩ zab ne sẽn zabd-b ne tõndã.
Bala, kankang ka ningd puud ye. Reezẽ tɩɩs ka womd biis ye. Oliiv tɩɩs ka womd ye, la pʋtã bõn-koaadl me ka womd ye. Rũm-bãooneg ka be wubrẽ ye. Rũm-bɛd ka be yãgrẽ ye.
La baa ne rẽ fãa, mam na n maana sũ-noog ne Sẽn-Ka-Saabo. Mam na n kɩdma ne Wẽnnaam sẽn yaa mam fãagdã.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab sẽn yaa mam Zu-soabã yaa mam pãnga. Bãmb kɩtdame tɩ mam naoã keng wa wals nao. La bãmb n sõngd-m tɩ m kẽnd kunkub zutu. Yaa yɩɩlã naab yɩɩlle. Yɩɩnda ne yʋʋm-teed sẽn tar susi.

Sẽn-Ka-Saab goma ne a Sofoni, a Amo biig a Zoziyaas sẽn wa n dɩt Zʋʋda naamã wakate. A Sofoni yaa a Kusi biiga t'a Kusi yaa a Gedaliya biiga, t'a Gedaliya yaa a Amariya biiga, t'a Amariya yaa a Ezekɩyaas biiga.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yeelame yaa: «Ade, mam na n sãama bõn-vɩɩs nins fãa sẽn be dũniyã zugã.

Mam na n sãama ninsaalbã ne rũmsã fãa, la m sãam liuuli wã sẽn yɩgd yĩngrã fãa, ne zĩmã sẽn be ko-kãsengã pʋgã, mam na n sãama nin-wẽnsã ne b tʋʋm-beedã fãa, la m menes ninsaalbã fãa dũniyã zugu. Yaa maam a Sẽn-Ka-Saab n yeele!»
Mam na n tẽega m nugã n sɩbg Zʋʋda ne Zeruzalɛm nebã, la m na n menesa bũmb ning sẽn ket zĩ-kãngã pʋgẽ, n yaa wẽn-naandg a Baall dẽndã, la m menes a Baall tʋmtʋmdbã sẽn yaa a maan-kʋʋdbã.
Mam na n menesa neb nins fãa sẽn dʋʋd rot zut n wõgemded n waoogd yĩngr ãdsã, la m menes neb nins sẽn wõgemded maam a Sẽn-Ka-Saab taoore, n yaool n wẽend ne tẽn-kugr a Milkom yʋʋrã.
Mam na n menesa neb nins sẽn basd maam a Sẽn-Ka-Saabã, ne neb nins sẽn ka baood maamã la sẽn ka baood-b mam saglgã.
Sĩnd-y sɩɩ Wẽnnaam Sẽn-Ka-Saabã taoore, bala, bãmb daarã kolgame! Sẽn-Ka-Saab seglame n na n maan maoongo, la bãmb welga neb nins bãmb sẽn boolã toore.
Sẽn-Ka-Saab yeelame: Mam maoongã daare, mam na n sɩbga nanambsã, ne na-biisã, la neb nins fãa sẽn yer bu-zẽms futã.
Badaare, mam na n sɩbga neb nins sẽn gãndgd Wẽnd doogã rigno-koakã, la neb nins sẽn pidsd b soaalã roog ne wẽng la zãmbã.
Maam a Sẽn-Ka-Saab yetame: «Badaare, b na n wʋma kelems sẽn yit dignoor ning b sẽn boond tɩ Zĩm Dignoorã sẽnẽ, la b wʋm wiisg sẽn yit Sag-paallã pʋgẽ, ne bʋr-kãseng sẽn yit tãmsã sẽnẽ.
Maktɛɛs tẽng nebã, wiis-y-yã! Bala, Kana tẽngã neb na n sãama zãnga, la lɛɛbdbã fãa na n kiime.
Badaare, mam na n widga fɩtl n vɛɛs Zeruzalɛm, la m na n sɩbga neb nins sẽn zĩ-b bãane, n tagsdẽ tɩ Sẽn-Ka-Saab ka tõe n maan sõama bɩ wẽngã.
B na n zɛɛ bãmb paoongã, la b sãam b rotã, bãmb meta roto, la b ka na n kẽ b pʋsẽ ye, bãmb senda reezẽ tɩɩse, la b ka na n yũ b reezẽ rãamã ye.»
Sẽn-Ka-Saab daarã sẽn yaa ra-kãsengã kolgame, a kolgame, la a wata tao-tao! Sẽn-Ka-Saab daarã rãamd sã n wa zẽkdẽ, baa ne gãndaadã na n wiisa ne sũ-toogo!
Daarã na n yɩɩ sũ-puugr daare, a na n yɩɩ toog la yel-pakr daare, namsg la sãoong daare, yaa lik la lik bida daare, sawad-taok la lik tuu daare.
Badaare, tãb-biis na n peeba bardo, n kaas zabr kaasgo, n zab ne tẽms nins sẽn gũbg ne lalsã, la b zab ne b lalsã gõdsẽ gãs-bɛdã.
Mam na n kẽesa ninsaalbã yel-pakr pʋga, bãmb na n kẽna wa zoense, bala, bãmb beega Sẽn-Ka-Saabo. B zɩɩmã na n daaga zĩig zãng wa tom sẽn yɛdge, la bãmb yãadã na n yʋlma zĩig zãng wa sagdo.

Bãmb wanzuri wã ne b sãnemã, ka na n tõog n fãag-b Sẽn-Ka-Saab sũ-puugrã daar ye. Sẽn-Ka-Saab sũ-yikrã bugum na n dɩɩ dũniyã fãa, bala, na n yɩɩ to-kãseng daare, la Sẽn-Ka-Saab na n sãama dũniyã nebã zãnga.
Buud sẽn ka zoet yãnde, tigm-y taab n tagse,
