A Pilat soka bãmba: B maana bõe sẽn yaa wẽnga? La nebã leb n kelma ne pãng n yɩɩd pĩnda: Ka-y bãmb da-pɩk zugu.
A Pilat sẽn dat n noog nebã sũur yĩnga, a yiisa a Barabaas n base. La yẽnda sẽn kɩt tɩ b pãb a Zeezi ne kalwaase, yẽ rɩka bãmb n kõ nebã tɩ b ka-b da-pɩk zugu.
Sodaasã talla a Zeezi n kẽng zakã pʋgẽ, sẽn dat n togs tɩ sodaasã zakẽ, la bãmb tigma sodaasã fãa sẽn be zĩ-kãngã.
B yeelga a Zeezi fu-miuugu, la b kala gõos wa maanfo, n fõgen bãmb zugu.
Dẽ, sodaasã sɩngame n pʋʋs bãmb n yeele: Zʋɩf-rãmbã dĩma, tõnd pʋʋsda yãmba.
La bãmb wẽe a Zeezi zug ne tãnwĩiga, n tʋbs bãmb kolkoodo, la b yĩgimdame n wõgemd bãmb taoore.
Bãmb sẽn yaal a Zeezi a woto n sɛ, b pidga fu-miuugã n lebs a Zeezi futã n yeelg-ba, la b talla bãmb n na n tɩ ka da-pɩk zugu.
Bãmb modga ned a yembr sẽn yi weoogẽ n loogdẽ t'a tʋk a Zeezi da-pɩkã. A yʋʋr la a Sɩmo, n yaa Sirɛn neda. Yẽnda yaa a Alegsãndr ne a Rufuus ba.
Bãmb talla a Zeezi n kẽng zĩig ning sẽn boond tɩ Golgota, sẽn dat n togs tɩ zu-wang zĩiga.
Bãmb kõo a Zeezi rãam sẽn kalem ne miir la a Zeezi ka yũ ye.
Bãmb kaa a Zeezi da-pɩk zugu, la b pʋɩɩ bãmb futã n maan bãnde, n na n bãng ned kam fãa sẽn na n paam fuug ninga.
Yaa sõ-bɩɩmd wakat la b ka bãmb da-pɩkã zugu.
Gʋlsem ning sẽn wilgd b sẽn dõd bãmb ne bũmb ningã yeta a woto: Zʋɩf-rãmbã rĩmã.
Bãmb kaa fãadb a yiib da-pɩgs zut ne a Zeezi: A yembr b rɩtgo, a to wã b goabga.
[Woto, gʋls-sõng sẽn yet tɩ b lagma bãmb nin‑wẽns sʋkã paam pidsgu.]
Neb nins sẽn loogd be wã tʋʋ bãmba, n gõms b zut n yeele: «N-faa! Yãmb sẽn tõe n sãam wẽnd doogã n lebs n me-a rasem a tãab pʋgẽ wã,
bɩ y fãag y meng n wa n sig da-pɩkã zugu.»
Maan-kʋʋdbã kãsem-dãmbã ne tõog karen-saam-dãmbã me goma ne taab n yaal bãmb n yeele: B fãaga neb a taaba, n yaool n ka tõe n fãag b meng ye.
Bɩ Kiris sẽn yaa Israyɛll dĩmã sig da-pɩkã zug moasã tɩ d yã n tẽ. La neb nins b sẽn ka da-pɩgs zut ne bãmbã me goma bãmb wẽnga.
Sẽn ta wĩnto-sʋka, dũni gill fãa lebga lik bida hal tɩ ta wẽn-kaoore.
La wẽn-kaoor wakate, a Zeezi zẽka b koɛɛg n kelem n yeele: Eloyi! Eloyi! Lama sabaktani? Sẽn dat n togs tɩ: ‹Mam Wẽnnaam! Mam Wẽnnaam! Yaa bõe tɩ yãmb bas maam?›
Neb kẽer sẽn dag n be beenẽ wã sẽn wʋm a woto, b yeelame: Gese, bãmb boonda a Eli.
La bãmb ned a yembr wudgame n dɩk neoodgo, n los miismẽ, n yaag n sel tãnwĩig n kõ bãmb tɩ b yũ, la a yeele: Bas-y tɩ d ges a Eli sã n na wa n sik bãmba.
La a Zeezi zẽka b koɛɛg n kelem ne pãnga, la b kiime.
Wẽnd doogã fu-lilldig sɩnga yĩngr n kẽeg n tãag tẽnga.
Sodaas koabg naabã sẽn dag n yas t'a neng tees a Zeezi wã, a sẽn yã b kũumã sẽn yɩ to-to wã, a yeelame: Hakɩɩka, rao-kãngã yaa Wẽnnaam Bi-ribla.
Pagb kẽer me n dag n yas yɩɩg n getẽ. A Maari sẽn yit Magdala, ne a Maari sẽn yaa a Zak-bil ne a Zooze ma, la a Salome dag n bee bãmb sʋka.
Bãmb dag n tũuda a Zeezi n sõngd bãmb wakat ning b sẽn dag n be Galɩle. Pagb a taab wʋsg da tũu a Zeezi n wa Zeruzalɛm.
Dag n yaa seglg daare, sẽn dat n togs tɩ daar ning sẽn deng vʋʋsg daarã. La wĩndgã sẽn kolg lʋɩɩs yĩnga,
a Zozɛf sẽn yit Arimate waame. Yẽnda yaa kaorengã yɛl bʋ-bʋʋd nebã fãa sẽn waoogd‑a, la a me rag n gũuda Wẽnnaam soolem waoongo. Yẽnda maana raood n kẽng a Pilat nengẽ n tɩ kos a Zeezi kũumã.
A Pilat sẽn wʋm t'a Zeezi zoe n kiime, a yɛɛsame, la a kɩtame tɩ b bool sodaas koabg naabã t'a wa, t'a sok-a n na n bãng b sã n kii sẽn kaoose.
Sodaas koabg naabã sẽn wilg yẽnda yellã sẽn yɩ to-to wã, a kõo a Zozɛf a Zeezi kũumã.
La a Zozɛf raa lẽ peen-peelse, n sik a Zeezi kũumã da-pɩkã zugu, n vil-b ne pɛɛlã n gãneg-b yaoog sẽn tuk kugr zug pʋgẽ, la a bilma kugr n lud yaoogã noore.
A Maari sẽn yit Magdala ne a Zooze ma a Maari rag n geta zĩig ning b sẽn gãneg bãmbã.
Vʋʋsg daarã sẽn looge, a Maari sẽn yit Magdala ne a Zak ma a Maari, la a Salome raa tɩdar sẽn tar yũ-noogo, n na n tɩ yug a Zeezi kũumã.
Dimaasã daar yibeoog pĩnda, bãmb taa yaoogẽ wã sõ-pukr wakate.
Bãmb goma ne taab n yeel tɩ ãndã n na n lak kugrã n bas yaoogã noor n kõ-ba.
La bãmb sẽn zẽk b nens n gese, b yãame tɩ b bilga kugrã sẽn yaa bedr wʋsgã n bas yaoogã noore.
Bãmb sẽn kẽ yaoogẽ wã, b yãnda bi-bɩɩg t'a zĩ rɩtgo n yer fu-pɛɛlga, la b yɛɛsame.
Yẽnda yeela bãmba: Da yɛɛs-y ye. Yãmb baooda Nazarɛt dao a Zeezi b sẽn ka da-pɩkã zugã. Bãmb vʋʋgame. Bãmb ka be ka ye. Ad zĩig ning b sẽn dag n gãneg bãmbã.
La y kẽng n tɩ yeel b karen-biisã ne a Pɩyɛɛr t'a Zeezi na n denga yãmb taoor n kẽng Galɩle. Yaa beenẽ la yãmb na n yã bãmb wa b sẽn da yeel yãmbã.
Pagbã yii yaoogẽ wã n zoe ne yɛɛsg la rigbu. La yɛɛsgã yĩnga, bãmb ka togs ned tɩ bũmb ye.
[A Zeezi sẽn vʋʋg dimaas daar yibeoogã, b reng n puka b meng ne a Maari sẽn yit Magdala, soab ningã bãmb sẽn dig zĩn-dãmb a yopoe tɩ yi n basã.
La yẽnda kẽngame n tɩ togs neb nins sẽn dag n be ne a Zeezi wã la sẽn zĩ ne sũ-sãams la nintãmã.
Bãmb sẽn wʋm t'a Zeezi vɩɩme, la tɩ pagã yãnd-b lame, bãmb ka tẽ-a ye.
Dẽ poore, a Zeezi puka b meng ne bãmb neb a yiib sẽn dag n be sorẽ n kẽnd weoogẽ, la yɩɩ ne wẽneg a to.
Bãmb me lebg n waa n togsa b taabã, la b kell n ka tẽ bãmb me ye.
A Zeezi yaool n puka b meng ne karen-biis piig la a yembrã, dẽ tɩ b zĩ n dɩtame. La a Zeezi zab-b lame, b ka-tẽebã la b sũ-riglmã yĩnga. Bala, b ka tẽ neb nins sẽn yã bãmb b vʋʋgrã zugẽ wã ye.
La a Zeezi yeela bãmb yaa: Saag-y dũni tɛk fãa n moon nebã fãa koe-noogã.
Ned ning fãa sẽn na n tẽ, tɩ b lis-a, a na paam fãagre. La ned ning fãa sẽn kõn tẽ na kong bʋʋm.
Ad bãn nins sẽn na n tũ neb nins sẽn na n tẽ wã: ne mam yʋʋre, bãmb na n diga zĩn-dãmba la b gom gom-zẽmse.
Bãmb na n yõga wiisi, la b sã n yũ bũmb sẽn yaa zẽnem, a kõn zab-b ye. Bãmb na n tika bãad-rãmb ne b nusi, la b na n paama maagre.
Zu-soab a Zeezi sẽn gom woto n sɛ, dẽ Wẽnnaam zẽka bãmb n kẽng arzãna, la bãmb zĩnda Wẽnnaam nug‑rɩtgo.
La bãmb karen-biisã kẽngame n moon koɛɛgã zĩig fãa. Zu-soabã tʋma ne bãmba, n maan bãn n tũnug koɛɛgã n wilg t'a yaa sɩda.]
Neb wʋsg makame n gʋls bũmb nins sẽn maan tõnd sʋkã.
B sẽn gʋlsã zemsa wa neb nins sẽn dag n yãnd yellã hal a sɩngrẽ sẽn togs tõndã, la b lebg koe-noogã moaandbã.
Teofill sõngo, mam sẽn fees n bao n bãng fãa neb nins sẽn bils maamã nengẽ wã, mam tagsame tɩ yaa neer tɩ mam me gʋls yãmb n wilg yɛlã sẽn pʋg taab to-to,
tɩ yãmb tõe n deeg tɩ bũmb nins b sẽn dag n zãms yãmbã yaa sɩda.

Wakat ning a Erood sẽn dag n yaa Zʋʋde rĩmã, maan-kʋʋd a ye n dag n be tɩ b boond t'a Zakari. Yẽnda yaa maan-kʋʋd a Abiya sull a ye neda. A pagã yaa maan-kʋʋd kãsem a Aarõ yagenga, la a yʋʋr la a Elizabɛte.
Bãmb b yiibã fãa dag n yaa nin-tɩrs Wẽnnaam nifẽ, la b da sakda Zu-soabã tõodã la b noyã fãa sõama.
La b rag n ka tar biig ye. Bala, a Elizabɛt da yaa kiiri, la b yiibã fãa da kʋʋlame.
Daar a yembre, a Zakari buudã sẽn da tog n ges maoongã yelle, a Zakari dag n maanda maan-kʋʋr tʋʋmdã Wẽnnaam taoore.
Bala, b dag n maana bãnde, wa sẽn zems maan-kʋʋdbã miningu, n yãk yẽnda t'a kẽ Zu-soabã roogẽ wã n yõog wisdã.
La neb kʋʋngã dag n bee yɩng wisdã yõogr wakat n pʋʋsdẽ.
La Zu-soabã malɛɛk puka a meng ne a Zakari, n yas wisdã yõogr tẽn-kugrã rɩtgo.
La a Zakari sẽn yã malɛɛkã, a yɛɛsame, tɩ rabeem yõk-a.
Malɛɛkã yeela yẽnda yaa: Zakari, da zoe rabeem ye, bala, Wẽnnaam leoka fo pʋʋsgo. Fo pag a Elizabɛt na n doga bi-ribl n kõ-fo. La fo na n pʋda a yʋʋr t'a Zã.
Fo na n paama sũ-noog n kɩdme, la neb wʋsg na n maana sũ-noog a rogmã yĩnga.
Bala, yẽnda na n yɩɩ nin-kãseng Zu-soabã nifẽ. Yẽnda kõn yũ reezẽ rãam wall bõn-yũudl sẽn yilimd neng ye. Sɩɩg-sõng na n pida yẽnda a ma sẽn na n dog-a wakat bala.
A na n kɩtame tɩ Israyɛll kamb wʋsg lebg n wa Zu-soabã sẽn yaa bãmb Wẽnnaamã nengẽ.

Yẽnda na n kẽna Wẽnnaam taoor ne sɩɩg ning la pãng ning a Eli sẽn dag n tarã, n kɩt tɩ ba-rãmbã paam zems-n-taar ne b kamba, n kɩt tɩ kɩɩsdbã paam yam n lebg nin-tɩrse. La a na n sõnga nebã tɩ b segl n sa Zu-soabã yĩnga.
A Zakari soka malɛɛkã yaa: «Bõe n na n kɩt tɩ mam bãng bõn-kãnga? Bala, mam yaa nin-kẽema, la m pagã me yʋʋm ka paood ye.»
La malɛɛkã leoka yẽnda yaa: «Mam yaa a Gabriyɛlle, n be Wẽnnaam taoore. B tʋma maam tɩ m wa n gom ne foom la m togs-f koe-no-kãnga.
Gese, fo na n lebga muka, la fo kõn tõog n gome, hal tɩ ta wakat ning bõn-kãngã sẽn na n paam pidsgã, fo sẽn ka tẽ mam goamã, tɩ b yaool n na n paam pidsgu, b wakat sã n ta wã yĩnga. »
Wakat-kãnga, nebã da gũuda a Zakari, la a sẽn kaoosd wẽnd doogẽ wã yɛɛsa bãmba.
La a sẽn yi, a ka tõog n gom ne nebã ye. La b bãngame t'a yãnda yãab wẽnd doogẽ wã. La a sɩngame n bils bãmb ne magbo, la a ket n yaa muka.
La a Zakari tʋʋmdã rasem sõor sẽn pidi, a kuila a yiri.
La wakat bilf sẽn paase, a pag a Elizabɛt rɩka pʋga. La yẽnda soondame hal tɩ ta kiis a nu.
La a yeelame yaa: Ad bũmb ning Zu-soabã sẽn maan n kõ maam, n zems wakat ning bãmb sẽn yãk yam n na n yiis bũmb ning sẽn dag n yaa mam yãnd nebã sʋkã.
Kiis a yoob soabã wakate, Wẽnnaam tʋma malɛɛk a Gabriyɛlle, Galɩle tẽng a yembr sẽn boond tɩ Nazarɛte,
pa-kuil a yembr nengẽ, b sẽn da rɩk n kõ a Davɩɩd yageng a Zozɛfe. Pʋg-sadã yʋʋr la a Maari.
Malɛɛkã waa yẽnda nengẽ n yeel-a yaa: Mam pʋʋsda foom, ned ning Wẽnnaam sẽn ning barkã. Zu-soabã bee ne foom.
Gom kãens namsa a Maari t'a sokd a meng tɩ pʋʋs-kãngã võor yaa bõe?
Malɛɛkã yeel-a lame yaa: Maari, da zoe rabeem ye. Bala, fo paama bark Wẽnnaam nifẽ.
Gese, fo na n dɩka pʋga, n dog bi-ribla, la f na n pʋda a yʋʋr t'a Zeezi.
Yẽnda na n yɩɩ nin-kãsenga, la b na n boond-a lame tɩ Sẽn-Ka-To Bi-ribla. Zu-soab a Wẽnnaam na n kõo yẽnda a yaab a Davɩɩd naam.
Yẽnda na n sooga a Zakoob buudã wakat sẽn kõn sa, la a naamã kõn zĩnd saab wakat ye.
A Maari soka malɛɛkã tɩ bõn-kãng na n yɩɩ wãn n yɩ tɩ yẽnda nan ka mi raoa?
La malɛɛkã leok-a lame yaa: Sɩɩg-sõng na n waa fo zugu, la Wẽn-kẽemdã pãngã na n luda foom ne b maasem. Yaa woto yĩng la b na n bool bi-sõng ning fo sẽn na n dogã tɩ Wẽnnaam Bi-ribla.
Ad fo kẽem a Elizabɛt me rɩka pʋg a kʋʋlem wakate, n na n dog bi-ribla. B sẽn dag n boond yẽnda tɩ kiirã, a tara kiis a yoob pʋg moasã.
Bala, bũmb ka be Wẽnnaam sẽn ka tõe ye.
Dẽ, a Maari yeelame yaa: Mam yaa Zu-soabã tʋmtʋmd poaka. Bɩ yãmb sẽn yeel bũmb ningã yɩ. La malɛɛkã loogame n bas-a.
Da-kãens pʋgẽ, a Maari yikame n kẽng Zʋʋde tẽng a yembr sẽn be tãmsã sẽnẽ wã tao-tao.
A Maari kẽe a Zakari zakẽ, n pʋʋs a Elizabɛte.
A Elizabɛt sẽn wʋm a Maari pʋʋsgã bala, biigã sẽn be yẽnda pʋgẽ wã virsame, la a Elizabɛt pida ne Sɩɩg-sõngo.
A zẽka a koɛɛg n yeele: Fo tara Wẽnnaam bark n yɩɩd pagbã fãa. La biigã sẽn be fo pʋgẽ wã me tara barka.
Maana a wãn tɩ mam wa paam tɩ m Zu-soabã ma wat m nengẽ?
Bala, ade, fo pʋʋsmã sẽn kẽ mam tʋbrẽ wã yee, la biigã sẽn be mam pʋgẽ wã sẽn virs ne sũ-noogo.
Bark bee pag ning sẽn tẽ tɩ Zu-soabã sẽn yeel yẽnda wã na n paama pidsgã zugu.
La a Maari yeelame yaa: Mam sɩɩgã pẽgda Zu-soabã,
la mam sũur pida ne sũ-noogo, mam fãagd a Wẽnnaam yĩnga.
Bala, bãmb gesa b tʋmtʋmd-poakã a sik-m-mengã pʋgẽ. Bala, sẽn sɩng ne moasã, ad zamaan fãa neb na n yeelame tɩ bark bee mam zugu.
Bala, Pãng‑Soabã maana bõn-kãsems n kõ maam. Bãmb yʋʋr yaa sõmblem.
«Bãmb nimbãan-zoeerã paada neb nins sẽn zoet bãmbã zutu, zamaan woo zamaane.»
Bãmb wilga b nug pãnga. Bãmb sãeega neb nins sẽn dag n tar wuk-m-meng tagsd b sũyã pʋsẽ wã.
Bãmb deega pãens rãmbã naam n bas-ba, la b zẽk sik-m-mens rãmbã.
Bãmb tɩgsa kom sẽn tar b rãmbã ne arzegse, la b kɩt tɩ arzegsã rãmb loog zaalem.
Bãmb sõnga b tʋmtʋmd a Israyɛlle, la b tẽeg b nimbãan‑zoeerã,
wa b sẽn dag n yeel tõnd yaab-rãmbã tɩ b na n maana a Abrahaam ne a yagensã neer wakat fãa wã.
A Maari paa ne a Elizabɛt sẽn kolg kiis a tãabo, n yaool n lebg n kuil a yiri.
A Elizabɛt rogem wakat taame. La a roga bi-ribla.
Yẽnda yagsã ne a roagdbã wʋmame tɩ Zu-soabã puka b nimbãan-zoeer ne yẽnda, la b lagma ne-a n paam sũ-noogo.
Rogmã rasem a nii daare, bãmb waa ne bi-bilfã n na n kẽes bãongo, la b da rat n pʋda a yʋʋr t'a Zakari wa a baaba.
La a ma wã gomame n yeel tɩ ayo! T'a yʋʋr na n yɩɩ a Zã.
Nebã yeela a Elizabɛt tɩ yẽnda roagdbã sʋka, ned ka be n tar yʋ-kãng ye.
La bãmb bilsa biigã baaba ne nus n dat n bãng a sẽn dat tɩ b pʋd biigã yʋʋr ninga.
A Zakari kosa walga, n gʋls tɩ biigã yʋʋr la a Zã. La nebã fãa yɛɛsame.
Wakat-kãng bala, a Zakari zelemd lakame t'a sɩng n gomd n pẽgd Wẽnnaam.
Rabeem yõka b yagsã fãa. La koe-kãng saaga Zʋʋde tẽmsã fãa sẽn be tãmsã sʋkã. Nebã dag n gomda bõn-kãng yell ne taaba.
Neb nins fãa sẽn wʋm gomdã da tagsda a yelle, la b sokdẽ tɩ bi-kãngã na n yɩɩ bõe biiga? Bala, Zu-soabã pãng dag n bee ne-a.
Biigã ba a Zakari pida ne Sɩɩg-sõngo, n gom pĩnd-n-bãngr goam n yeele:
Pẽgr Zu-soabã sẽn yaa Israyɛll nebã Wẽnnaam, bãmb sẽn wa n ges b nebã n fãag-bã yĩnga,
la bãmb sẽn kõ tõnd fãagd sẽn tar pãnga, sẽn yit a Davɩɩd sẽn yaa bãmb tʋmtʋmdã buud pʋgẽ
wa bãmb sẽn dag n gom ne b no-rɛɛs-sõamyã noy hal wakat sẽn kaoose,
tɩ b na n fãaga tõnd n yiis d bɛɛbã la neb nins fãa sẽn kis-b tõndã nusẽ wã.
Woto, bãmb zoee tõnd yaab-rãmbã nimbãanega, n tẽeg bãmb kãab-sõngã yelle,
wa bãmb sẽn dag n kãabe, n wẽen n yeel tõnd yaab a Abrahaam
tɩ b na n fãaga tõnd n yiis d bɛɛbã nusẽ, la b kõ tõnd pãn-tõog tɩ pʋʋs bãmb ne sõmblem la tɩrlem bãmb taoor hal tõnd vɩɩmã tɛka, tɩ rabeem kaẽ ye.
La foom a bi-bilfã, b na n boola foom tɩ Sẽn‑Ka‑To no-rɛɛsa. Bala, fo na n lʋɩɩ Zu-soabã taoore n maneg bãmb soayã,
la f kɩt tɩ nebã bãng tɩ yaa ne yel‑wẽnã sugr kosg la b na n paam fãagre,
tõnd Wẽnnaamã nimbãan-zoeerã sẽn yaa kãsengã yĩnga. Yaa nimbãan-zoeerã yĩng la sõorã sẽn pukdã na n wa tõnd nengẽ,
n kõ neb nins sẽn zĩ lik pʋgẽ la kũum maasmẽ wã vẽenem, la a tɛ tõnd tɩ d tũ laafɩ sore.
La biigã bɩtame t'a yam paasdẽ. La a paa weoogẽ wã hal tɩ ta daar ning a sẽn puk a meng ne Israyɛll nebã.
Wakat-kãnga, rĩm a Sezaar Ogust yiisa tõog n yeel tɩ b sõd dũniyã nebã fãa.
Sõd-kãng sẽn yɩ dẽenem soabã zĩnda Siiri Gʋvɛrneer a Kiriniyuus zamaanẽ.
Ned kam fãa dag n kuiisa a meng tẽngẽ tɩ b tɩ sõd-a.
A Zozɛf me yii Nazarɛt sẽn be Galɩle soolmẽ n kẽng a Davɩɩd tẽngẽ wã sẽn boond tɩ Betlehɛm n be Zʋʋde soolmẽ, yẽ sẽn yaa a Davɩɩd buud la a yagengã yĩnga.
Yẽnda kẽnga be ne a pʋg-bil a Maari tɩ b sõd-a. La a Maari da tʋtame.
La bãmb sẽn be be, a Maari rogem wakat taame.
La yẽnda roga a pipi biigã, n vil-a ne peend n gãneg rũms rɩɩb koglg pʋgẽ, weer sẽn ka be sik-zĩigẽ wã yĩnga.
La tẽn-kãng pʋgẽ, pe-kɩɩmb n dag n be we-kɛɛng ne yʋng n gũud b piisi.
Zu-soabã malɛɛk puka a meng ne bãmba, la Zu-soabã ziir vẽenem yãgame n gũbg bãmba. Dabeem kãseng yõka bãmba.
La malɛɛkã yeel-b lame yaa: «Da zoe-y rabeem ye. Bala, mam togsda yãmb koe-noog sẽn na n wa ne sũ-no-kãseng nebã fãa yĩnga.
Fãagd la b rog yãmb yĩng dũndã, a Davɩɩd tẽngẽ wã. Bãmb la Kirisã, Zu-soabã.
Ad bãnd ning sẽn na n kɩt tɩ yãmb bãng bãmba: Yãmb na n yãnda bi-pɛɛlg sẽn vil ne peend n gãe rũms rɩɩb koglgẽ.»
La zĩig pʋgẽ bala, malegs wʋsg yii arzãn n wa n paas malɛɛkã n pẽgd Wẽnnaam n yetẽ:
«Wẽnnaam sẽn be hal saasẽ-saasẽ wã paam pẽgre! La laafɩ zĩnd dũniyã zugu, neb nins bãmb sẽn nongã sʋka.»
Malegsã sẽn bas bãmb n leb n leb arzãna, pe-kɩɩmbã yeela taab yaa: «Wa-y tɩ d kẽng Betlehɛm n tɩ ges bũmb ning sẽn maan tɩ Zu-soabã togs tõndã.»
Bãmb kẽnga tao-tao n tɩ yã a Maari ne a Zozɛfe, la bi-pɛɛlgã sẽn gãe rũms rɩɩb koglgẽ wã.
Bãmb sẽn yã bi-pɛɛlgã, b togsa bũmb nins fãa b sẽn dag n gom ne bãmb biigã wɛɛngẽ wã.
Yellã linga neb nins fãa sẽn wʋm bũmb nins pe-kɩɩmbã sẽn togsd bãmbã.
A Maari bĩnga gom-kãens fãa a sũurẽ n tagsd b yelle.
Pe-kɩɩmbã lebgame, n waoogd Wẽnnaam la b pẽgd bãmba, bũmb nins fãa bãmb sẽn wʋme, la b sẽn yã tɩ sɩd yaa wa malɛɛkã sẽn dag n togs bãmbã yĩnga.
La rasem a nii daarã sẽn yaa biigã bãong kẽesg daarã sẽn ta, b pʋda a yʋʋr t'a Zeezi, wala malɛɛkã sẽn dag n yeel sẽn deng a ma sẽn na n dɩk a pʋgã.
La a Maari ne biigã yɩlgr wakat sẽn pidi, wa sẽn zems ne a Moyiis tõogã, yẽnda ne a Zozɛf talla biigã n kẽng Zeruzalɛm n na n tɩ kõ Zu-soabã.
Bãmb maana wa sẽn gʋls Zu-soabã tõog pʋgẽ wã. A yetame: «Bi-ribl fãa sẽn yaa a ma bi‑rẽenga, b tog n dɩk‑a lame n kõ Zu-soabã.»
La b maana wal a yiib bɩ manwan-bi a yiib maoongo, wa sẽn gʋls Zu-soabã tõog pʋgẽ wã.
La mik rao a yembr n dag n be Zeruzalɛm n boond t'a Sɩmyõ. Rao-kãng dag n yaa nin-tɩrga, la a sakda Wẽnnaam. Yẽnda dag n gũuda Israyɛll belsgo, la Sɩɩg-sõng dag n bee a zugu.
Sɩɩg-sõng dag n wilg-a lame t'a kõn ki, hal t'a yã Kirisã, Zu-soabã sẽn na n tʋmã.
Sɩɩg-sõng kɩtame t'a Sɩmyõ kẽng wẽnd doogẽ wã. La a Zeezi ba wã ne b ma wã sẽn tall bãmb n wa n na n pids bũmb ning tõogã sẽn yetã,
a Sɩmyõ deega biigã a nusẽ, n pẽg Wẽnnaam n yeele:
Zu-soaba! Moasã, yãmb basa y tʋmtʋmdã t'a loogd ne laafɩ. Wa yãmb sẽn dag n yeelã,
mam nin yãnda fãagr ning yãmb sẽn kõ tõndã,
fãagr y sẽn segl nebã fãa nifẽ wã.
A yaa vẽenem sẽn vẽnegd bu-zẽmse, la a yaa Israyɛll sẽn yaa yãmb nebã ziiri.
B sẽn gom a Zeezi yell a woto wã yɛɛsa b ba ne b ma.
A Sɩmyõ ning-b-la barka, la a yeel a Zeezi ma a Maari yaa: Ad bi-kãngã waa Israyɛll neb wʋsg lʋɩɩse la b yikr yĩnga, la a na n yɩɩ bãnd neb sẽn na n zãgse.
A na n puka neb wʋsg sũy pʋsẽ yɛla, la sũ-sãang sẽn wẽnd sʋʋg sẽn kõs ned n na n paam foom.
Wẽnnaam no-rɛɛs-poak a ye n dag n be be. A yʋʋr la a Ãnde, a Fanuwɛll bi-pugla, n yaa a Azɛɛr buudu. A ra kʋʋla wʋsgo. A zĩnda ne a sɩdã yʋʋm a yopoe a pʋg-sademd wakate,
n lebg pʋg‑kõore, n kell n paa a woto. La baa ne a sẽn tar yʋʋm pis-nii la a naasã, a dag n ka yit wẽnd doogẽ wã ye. A dag n maanda Wẽnnaam tʋʋmd wĩntoog ne yʋngo, ne no-loeer la pʋʋsgo.
Yẽnda me waa wẽnd doogẽ wã wakat-kãng bala. Yẽnda dag n pẽgda Wẽnnaam la a gomd biigã yell ne neb nins sẽn dag n gũud Zeruzalɛm fãagrã a Zeezi yelle.
La bãmb sẽn pids bũmb fãa wa sẽn zems Zu-soabã tõogo, a Zozɛf ne a Maari leb n leba b tẽngẽ, Nazarɛte.
Biigã rag n bɩtame, la a pãng paasdame, la a da pida ne yam, la Wẽnnaam barkã da bee a zugu.
A Zeezi ba-rãmbã dag n kẽngda Zeruzalɛm yʋʋmd fãa, Pakã tigr yĩnga.
A Zeezi sẽn ta yʋʋm piig la a yiibu, b kẽnga Zeruzalɛm wa sẽn zems tigrã miningu.
La tigrã sẽn sa tɩ bãmb lebg n kuiisẽ, biig a Zeezi paa Zeruzalɛm, la b ba-rãmbã ka bãng ye.
Bãmb sẽn dag n tags t'a Zeezi bee b kẽnd-n-taasã nengẽ wã yĩnga, b kẽna daar a ye kẽnde, n yaool n gẽes a Zeezi b mitinsã sʋka.
La b ka yãnd-b ye. La b lebg n lebda Zeruzalɛm la b gẽesd a Zeezi.
Rasem a tãab daarã, bãmb yãnda a Zeezi wẽnd doogẽ wã tɩ b zĩ karen-saam-dãmbã sʋk n kelgd-b la b sogsd-b sokdse.
A Zeezi bãngrã ne b leokdsã linga neb nins fãa sẽn da wʋmd bãmbã.
A Zeezi ba-rãmbã sẽn yãnd-bã, b yɛɛsame. A Zeezi ma wã yeel-b lame yaa: M biiga, yaa bõe tɩ fo maan tõnd a woto? Gese, maam ne f baaba baoo foom ne sũ-sãanga.
A Zeezi yeel-b lame yaa: Bõe yĩng tɩ yãmb da baood maam? Yãmb ka mi tɩ mam maanda tʋʋmd m ba wã roogẽ la?
La bãmb ka wʋm bũmb ning a Zeezi sẽn da gomd ne bãmbã võor ye.
Dẽ poore, a Zeezi tũu bãmb n leb Nazarɛte, la b saka bãmb noore. Bãmb ma wã dag n bĩngda bõn-kãens fãa a sũurẽ.
A Zeezi rag n bɩtame, tɩ b yamã paasdẽ, la b paama Wẽnnaam barka la ninsaalb rẽnd me.

Rĩm a Sezaar Tɩbɛɛr sẽn deeg naam tɩ yʋʋm piig la nuunẽ, t'a Pilat dag n yaa Zʋʋde soolem Gʋvɛrneere, t'a Erood yaa Galɩle rĩmã, t'a biig a Filip ya Yitʋʋre ne Tarkonit soolem dĩmã, t'a Lizanyaas yaa Abilɛn soolem dĩma,
t'a Ãnd ne a Kayiif yaa maan-kʋʋdbã kãsem-dãmba, Wẽnnaam goma ne a Zakari biig a Zã weoogẽ wã.
La a Zã saaga tẽms nins fãa sẽn pẽ Zʋrdẽ wã, n moondẽ n yet nebã tɩ b tek yam n deeg lisgu, n paam b yel-wẽnã sugri.
Yɩɩ wa sẽn gʋls Wẽnnaam no-rɛɛs a Ezayi sebrã pʋgẽ wã: Yaa ned ning koɛɛg sẽn kelemd we-rasempʋɩɩgẽ wã, n yetẽ tɩ: «Maneg-y Zu-soabã sore! Rems-y bãmb so-bugsã tɩ yɩ tɩrse!
Londã fãa na n pidsame! Tãmsã ne kunkubã fãa na n sarmame! So-golemsã na n lebga tɩrse, la b na n kõo so-rʋdã!
La ninsaal buud fãa na n yãa fãagr ning Wẽnnaam sẽn kõtã.»
Dẽ, a Zã rag n yeta neb kʋʋngã sẽn wat yẽnda nengẽ t'a lis-bã yaa: Wag-toos buudu, ãndã n wilg yãmb tɩ y zoe sũ-puugr sẽn watã?

Woto yĩnga, bɩ y wom biis sẽn zemsd ne neb sẽn tek yam n kos sugri, la y da tags y sũyã pʋs t'a Abrahaam sẽn yaa yãmb yaabã sekame ye. Bala, mam yeta yãmb tɩ Wẽnnaam tõe n dɩka kug-kãensã n kɩt tɩ b lebg a Abrahaam yagense.
Larã zoe n bee tɩɩsã yẽgẽ moasã. Dẽ, b na n keega tɩɩg ning fãa sẽn ka womd bi-sõama, n lob bugmẽ.
Neb kʋʋngã soka a Zã yaa: Woto wã, bõe la tõnd tog n maane?
A Zã leok-b lame n yeele: Bɩ ned ning sẽn tar fu-yerdɩ a yiib yãk a ye n kõ sẽn ka tar-a, la ned ning sẽn tar n dɩtẽ me maan a woto.
Yaood dɛɛgdbã me waame n dat t'a lis-ba. B soka a Zã yaa: Karen-saamba, tõnd tog n maana bõe?
Yẽnda leok-b lame n yeele: Da reeg-y yaood n yɩɩd b sẽn kõ yãmb noor tɩ y reegã baa bilfu.
Sodaas me soka a Zã tɩ la bãmb yẽ tog n maana bõe? Yẽnda leoka bãmb n yeele: Da maan-y ned pãng ye, la y da rõd neb zaalem ye, la y maan sũ-noog ne y yaoodã.
Nebã da yas n gũudame, la b fãa da sokda b mens n dat n bãng sãnde ka a Zã la Kirisã.
A Zã leoka bãmb fãa n yeele: Mam lisda yãmb koomẽ. La ned a ye n wata, n tar pãng n yɩɩd maam. Mam pʋs n pa zems tɩ lood bãmb neooda sẽbds ye. Bãmb na n lisa yãmb ne Sɩɩg-sõngo, la ne bugum.
Bãmb zãada b kaorgo. Bãmb na n pɩɩsa b zɛɛga, n wʋk ki wã n sui b baoorẽ. La b na n yõoga wudgã ne bugum sẽn ka kiida.
A Zã sagla nebã ne sagls a taab wʋsgo, n moon bãmb koe-noogã.
La a Zã sẽn wilg Erood sẽn yaa Gʋvɛrneerã t'a sẽn maan ne a ba-biig a Filip pag a Eroodyaadã, ne tʋʋm wẽnsã fãa a sẽn maanã ka zemse,
A Erood leb n maana tʋʋm wẽng a to n paase, n yõk a Zã n sui bi-bees roogo.
Nebã fãa sẽn paam koom lisgu, a Zeezi me paama lisgu. La bãmb sẽn pʋʋsd wakate, yĩngr pakame,
la Sɩɩg-sõng rɩka manwall wẽneg n sig bãmb zugu. Koɛɛg zĩnda saasẽ n yeele: Fo yaa mam bi-ribl-nongr sẽn ta mam yam zãnga.
A Zeezi sẽn wa n na n sɩng b tʋʋmdã, rẽ tɩ b rag n tara yʋʋm pis-tã sẽnẽ. Bãmb da yaa a Zozɛf biig wa nebã sẽn dag n tagsdã. A Zozɛf rag n yaa a Heli biiga,
sẽn yaa a Matat biiga, sẽn yaa a Leevi biiga, sẽn yaa a Melki biiga, sẽn yaa a Yanayi biiga, sẽn yaa a Zozɛf biiga,
sẽn yaa a Matatyaas biiga, sẽn yaa a Amoos biiga, sẽn yaa a Nahum biiga, sẽn yaa a Esli biiga, sẽn yaa a Nagayi biiga,
sẽn yaa a Maat biiga, sẽn yaa a Matatyaas biiga, sẽn yaa a Semeyin biiga, sẽn yaa a Yosɛk biiga, sẽn yaa a Zoda biiga,
sẽn yaa a Zoaana biiga, sẽn yaa a Reeza biiga, sẽn yaa a Zorobabɛll biiga, sẽn yaa a Salatiyɛll biiga, sẽn yaa a Neeri biiga,
sẽn yaa a Melki biiga, sẽn yaa a Adi biiga, sẽn yaa a Kozam biiga, sẽn yaa a Elmadam biiga, sẽn yaa a Ɛɛr biiga,
sẽn yaa a Zeezi biiga, sẽn yaa a Eliyezɛɛr biiga, sẽn yaa a Zorim biiga, sẽn yaa a Matat biiga, sẽn yaa a Leevi biiga,
sẽn yaa a Sɩmyõ biiga, sẽn yaa a Zʋʋda biiga, sẽn yaa a Zozɛf biiga, sẽn yaa a Zonam biiga, sẽn yaa a Eliyakim biiga,
sẽn yaa a Meleya biiga, sẽn yaa a Mena biiga, sẽn yaa a Matata biiga, sẽn yaa a Natam biiga, sẽn yaa a Davɩɩd biiga,
sẽn yaa a Ezayi biiga, sẽn yaa a Zobɛɛd biiga, sẽn yaa a Booz biiga, sẽn yaa a Sala biiga, sẽn yaa a Nasõ biiga,
sẽn yaa a Aminadaab biiga, sẽn yaa a Admin biiga, sẽn yaa a Arni biiga, sẽn yaa a Ɛsrom biiga, sẽn yaa a Farɛɛs biiga, sẽn yaa a Zʋʋda biiga,
sẽn yaa a Zakoob biiga, sẽn yaa a Izak biiga, sẽn yaa a Abrahaam biiga, sẽn yaa a Taara biiga, sẽn yaa a Nakoor biiga,
sẽn yaa a Seruk biiga, sẽn yaa a Reyu biiga, sẽn yaa a Falɛk biiga, sẽn yaa a Ebɛɛr biiga, sẽn yaa a Sala biiga,
sẽn yaa a Kayinam biiga, sẽn yaa a Arfaksaad biiga, sẽn yaa a Sɛm biiga, sẽn yaa a Nowe biiga, sẽn yaa a Lemek biiga,
sẽn yaa a Matusala biiga, sẽn yaa a Henok biiga, sẽn yaa a Zarɛɛd biiga, sẽn yaa a Maleleyɛll biiga, sẽn yaa a Kayinam biiga,
sẽn yaa a Enoos biiga, sẽn yaa a Sɛt biiga, sẽn yaa a Ãdem biiga, sẽn yaa Wẽnnaam biigã.
A Zeezi sẽn pid ne Sɩɩg-sõngo, bãmb yii Zʋrdẽ n lebg n wa, la Sɩɩgã talla bãmb n kẽng weoogẽ.
La Sʋtãanã maka bãmb beenẽ dasem pis-naase. La dasem kãens pʋgẽ, bãmb ka tol n dɩ bũmb ye. La rẽ sẽn looge, kom yaool n yõka bãmba.
Dẽ, sʋtãanã yeela bãmb yaa: «Yãmb sã n yaa Wẽnnaam Bi-ribla, bɩ y yeel kug-kãensã tɩ b lebg buri.»
La a Zeezi leoka yẽnda: «A gʋlsame: «Ninsaal kõn vɩ ne rɩɩb bal ye.»
Rõatã talla bãmb n dʋ yĩngr n paase, n wilg bãmb dũniyã soolem dãmbã nif kamsg pʋgẽ,
n yeel-b yaa: «Mam na n kõo yãmb dũni naamã fãa, ne soolem kãensã ziirã, bala, b kõ-a-la maam, la mam kõt-a la m sẽn dat a soaba.
Dẽ, yãmb sã n wõgemd mam taoore, a fãa na n lebga yãmb n so.»
A Zeezi leok-a lame n yeele: B gʋlsame: «Waoog Zu-soaba, fo Wẽnnaam, la f pʋʋs bãmb b yembr bala.»
Rõatã leb n talla a Zeezi yɛs n kẽng Zeruzalɛm, n yals bãmb wẽnd doogã zug n yeel-ba: Yãmb sã n yaa Wẽnnaam Bi-ribla, bɩ y yɩk ka n tiimd tẽnga.
Bala, b gʋlsame: ‹Bãmb na n yeela b malegsã tɩ b gũ yãmba,
la malegsã na n zãa yãmb ne b nusi, sẽn na n yɩl tɩ yãmb naoor da wa n lak kugr ye.› »
A Zeezi leoka yẽnda tɩ b gʋlsame: «Ra mak Zu-soaba, fo Wẽnnaamã ye.»
Rõatã sẽn mak a Zeezi ne makr buud toor-toor n sɛ, a loogame n bas bãmba, hal tɩ ta a sẽn na n leb n paam weer a to n mak-ba.
A Zeezi lebg n leba Galɩle ne Sɩɩg-sõngã pãnga. La bãmb yʋʋrã saaga soolmã fãa.
A Zeezi dag n zãmsda nebã karen-dot pʋse, la nebã fãa rag n pẽgda bãmba.
A Zeezi kẽnga Nazarɛte, tẽng ning b sẽn dag n wub bãmbã. La vʋʋsg daare, bãmb kẽe karen-doogẽ wã wa bãmb sẽn minim n maandẽ wã. Bãmb yikame n na n karem.
La b kõo bãmb Wẽnnaam no-rɛɛs a Ezayi sebre. Bãmb laka sebrã, n yãnd zĩig ning b sẽn da gʋls n yeel tɩ:

«Zu-soabã Sɩɩg bee mam zugu, bala, b kõ maam pãng tɩ m togs koe-noogã naong rãmb sʋka. Bãmb tʋma maam tɩ m tɩ moon yembsã yolsg koɛɛga, la m moon n togs zoensã, tɩ b na n leb n paama b nini, la m kɩt tɩ neb nins b sẽn namsdã loog ne lohorem,
la m moon bark yʋʋmd Zu-soabã sẽn kõtã.»
A Zeezi pila sebrã n kɩs tʋmtʋmdã la b zĩndi. Nebã fãa sẽn be karen-doogẽ wã dag n geta bãmba.
A Zeezi sɩngame n gom ne-b n yeele: «Gʋls-sõng‑kãngã yãmb sẽn wʋm moas-moasã wã paama pidsg rũndã.»
La nebã fãa dag n kɩta bãmb kaset n pẽgd bãmba, gom-sõamy nins sẽn dag n yit bãmb noorẽ wã yĩnga. La bãmb dag n yetame: «Bãmb ka a Zozɛf biigã wɛ?»
A Zeezi yeel-b lame yaa: Mam miime tɩ yãmb na n wẽe maam yel-bũn‑kãnga: «Tɩpa, tɩp f meng f toor n sãooge, la bɩ y maan bũmb nins fãa yãmb sẽn maan Kapɛrnaom tɩ tõnd wʋma, y tẽngẽ ka.»
A Zeezi leb n yeel-b lame yaa: «Sɩda, mam yeta yãmb tɩ Wẽnnaam no-rɛɛs baa a yembr zɩ n paam tɩ b reeg-a sõama a meng tẽngẽ ye.
Mam yeta yãmb sɩd t'a Eli wakate, yĩngr sẽn pag tɩ saag ka ni yʋʋm a tãab la kiis a yoobe, tɩ kom kãseng kẽ tẽngã fãa wã, pʋg‑kõap wʋsg n dag n be Israyɛlle.
Baoosgo, Wẽnnaam ka tʋm a Eli pʋg‑kõor baa a yembr nengẽ, sã n ka Sɩdõ soolem pʋg‑kõor a yembr sẽn dag n be Sarɛpta nengẽ bala.
La Wẽnnaam no-rɛɛs a Eliize wakate, yĩn-gãong bãas sẽn tar b rãmbã me rag n yaa wʋsg Israyɛlle. La baoosgo, baa a yembr bãmb sʋkã ka paam yɩlgr ye, sã n ka Siiri rao a Naama bala.»
Nebã fãa sẽn dag n be karen-doogẽ wã sẽn wʋm gom kãensã, b sũyã puugame.
Dẽ, bãmb yikame n veo a Zeezi n yiis tẽngã, n tall-b n tɩ ta tãng ning bãmb tẽngã sẽn tiẽ wã zugu, n na n tus bãmb tɩ b yi tãngã zug n lʋɩ.
La a Zeezi tũu bãmb sʋk bal n looge.
A Zeezi kẽnga Kapɛrnaom, Galɩle tẽng a ye, la bãmb dag n zãmsda nebã vʋʋsg daare.
La bãmb zãmsgã yɛɛsa nebã. Bala, bãmb dag n zãmsda ne noore.
Dao a yembr n dag n be karen-doogẽ wã tɩ zĩn-dẽgd tar-a.
A kelma ne pãng n yeele: «Hey! Nazarɛt dao a Zeezi, yãmb data tõnd ne bõe? Yãmb waame n na n sãam tõnd la? Mam mii yãmb sẽn yaa ned ninga. Yãmb yaa Wẽnnaam sõmblem soaba.»
A Zeezi tãsa yẽnda n yeel-a: «Sĩndi, la f yi n bas raoã.» Zĩnã luba raoã nebã sʋka, la a yi n bas-a n ka maan-a wẽng baa bilfu.
Nebã fãa yɛɛsame n gomd ne taab n yetẽ tɩ koe-kãngã yaa bõe koɛɛga? Bãmb tara noor la pãnga, tɩ b sã n yeel zĩn-dãmb nins sẽn yaa rẽgdã tɩ b yi, b yitame.
La a Zeezi yʋʋrã dag n saagda soolmã fãa.
A Zeezi sẽn yi karen-doogẽ wã, b kẽnga a Sɩmo yiri. A Sɩmo reem-poakã yĩns rag n wɩnga hal wʋsgo, la b kosa a Zeezi tɩ b maag-a.
A Zeezi sulga a zugẽ n tãs yĩn-wɩngrã, la a yĩn-wɩngrã sigame. La wakat-kãng bala, a yikame n maan-b sãando.
Wĩndg sẽn kẽ, neb nins fãa sẽn dag n tar‑b bãad-dãmba, bãas buud toay-toay sẽn tare, tall-b lame n wa a Zeezi nengẽ. A Zeezi tika bãmb ned kam fãa ne b nusi, n maag-ba.
Zĩn-dãmb me dag n yit n basda neb wʋsgo, la b kelemdẽ n yetẽ: «Yãmb yaa Wẽnnaam Bi-ribla.» La a Zeezi dag n tãsda bãmba, n gɩdgd-b tɩ b ra gom ye. Bala, zĩn-dãmbã rag n miime t'a Zeezi yaa Kirisã.
Beoogã sẽn vẽege, bãmb yiime n kẽng zĩig sẽn yaa we-rasempʋɩɩga. Neb kʋʋngã sɩngame n gẽesd bãmba, n wa n ta bãmb nengẽ. Bãmb dag n datame n gɩdg a Zeezi tɩ b ra loog n bas-b ye.
La a Zeezi yeel-b lame: «Yaa tɩlɛ tɩ mam moon Wẽnnaam soolem koe-noogã tẽms a taabã me. Bala, yaa bõn-kãng yĩng la b sẽn tʋm maamã.»
La a Zeezi dag n moonda koe-noogã Galɩle karen-dotã pʋse.
Neb kʋʋngã sẽn dag n gũbg a Zeezi n pẽdgd taab n dat n wʋm Wẽnnaam goamã, tɩ bãmb yaool n dag n be Zenezarɛt ko‑kãsengã noorã,
bãmb yãnda koom kogend a yiib sẽn be koomã noore, zĩm-yõagdb sẽn dag n sig n bas n pegsd b zĩm-gãmba.
A Zeezi kẽe koglg a yembr sẽn dag n yaa a Sɩmo rẽnda, n kos-a t'a zãag bilf ne kʋɩl-koakã. La a Zeezi zĩnda koom koglgẽ wã n pa be n zãmsd neb kʋʋngã.
A Zeezi sẽn gom n sɛ, b yeela a Sɩmo yaa: «Kẽng-y koomã sʋk n tɩ y lob y zĩm-gãmbã wã n yõg zĩma.»
A Sɩmo leoka bãmba: «Karen-saamba, tõnd tʋma yʋngã tõr n ka tol n yõk bũmb ye. La yãmb sẽn yeelã yĩnga, m na n loba zĩm-gãmbã wã.»
Bãmb sẽn lobã, b yõga zĩm wʋsgo, la b zĩm-gãmba wã rag n pãrsdame.
Bãmb kamsa b tũud-n-taasã sẽn dag n be koglg a to wã pʋgẽ wã tɩ b wa n sõng-ba. B waame la b pidsa koom-kogend a yiibã hal tɩ b rat n lisi.
A Sɩmo Pɩyɛɛr sẽn yã woto, a wõgemda a Zeezi taoor n yeele: «Zu-soaba, zãag-y y meng ne maam. Bala, mam yaa yel-wẽn maanda.»
Bala, rabeem wʋsg dag n yõka yẽnda ne neb nins sẽn dag n be ne yẽnda wã, zĩmã bãmb sẽn yõgã waooglem yĩnga.
La yɩɩ woto me ne a Zebde kom-dibli a Zak ne a Zã sẽn yaa a Sɩmo tũud-n-taasã. La a Zeezi yeela a Sɩmo yaa: «Da zoe rabeem ye. Sẽn sɩng ne moasã, fo na n yɩɩ nin-baooda.»
Dẽ, bãmb lebg n talla kogendã n wa kʋɩl-koakẽ wã, n bas fãa la b tũ a Zeezi.

A Zeezi rag n bee tẽng a yembr pʋgẽ, la rao a ye n be beenẽ tɩ yĩn-gãong bãag tar-a. A sẽn yãnd a Zeezi, a lʋɩɩme n fõgen a neng tẽnga, n bõos bãmb a woto: «Zu-soaba, yãmb sã n data, yãmb tõe n kɩtame tɩ mam lebg yɩlemde.»
A Zeezi tẽega b nug n sɩɩs-a n yeele: «Mam datame, lebg yɩlemde.» Tao-tao bala, yĩn-gãong bãagã loog n bas-a lame.

Dẽ, a Zeezi keooga yẽnda t'a ra gom bõn-kãng ne ned ye. La b yeel-a yaa: «Kẽng n tɩ wilg f meng maan-kʋʋdã, la f maan maoong wa sẽn zems a Moyiis sẽn yeelã, f yɩlgrã yĩnga, t'a tõe n yɩ kaset bãmb yĩnga.»
A Zeezi yʋʋrã rag n saagd n yɩɩda pĩnda. Neb kʋʋng wʋsg tigma taab n na n kelg-ba, la b tõe n paam tɩ b maag b bãasã.
La a Zeezi rag n kẽngda we-rasempʋɩɩsẽ, n tɩgd n pʋʋsdẽ.

Daar a yembre, a Zeezi rag n zãmsda nebã. Fariizẽ-dãmb ne tõog karen-saam-dãmb n dag yi Galɩle tẽmsã fãa ne Zʋʋde, la ne Zeruzalɛm n wa n zĩ be. La Zu-soabã pãng rag n bee ne a Zeezi tɩ bãmb maagd bãad-dãmba.
La ade, neb n tʋk ned sẽn ki bogre, ne gãaga, n dag n baood n na n kẽes-a, n sik-a a Zeezi taoore.
La nebã sẽn yaa wʋsg tɩ bãmb ka mi b sẽn na n tũ zĩig ning n kẽes-a wã yĩnga, bãmb dʋʋ roogã zugu, n maan võore, n sik ki-bogrã ne a gãagã a Zeezi taoor nebã sʋka.
A Zeezi sẽn yã b tẽebã, b yeela raoã yaa: «Fo paama f yel-wẽnã sugri.»
Tõog karen-saam-dãmbã ne Fariizẽ-dãmbã sɩngame n tagsdẽ n yetẽ yaa: «Yaa yɛ ned la yõwã n paoogd Wẽnnaam a woto? Sã n ka Wẽnnaam b yembre, ãndã n tõe n kõ yel-wẽn sugri?»
A Zeezi bãnga bãmb tagsdã, n gom ne-b n sok-b yaa: «Bõe yĩng tɩ yãmb tagsd a woto y sũyã pʋse?
Bʋg yeelg n yaa naana n yɩɩda? Fo paama f yel-wẽnã sugrã» bɩ, bɩ «yik n kẽnã»?
La sẽn na n yɩlẽ tɩ Yãmb bãng tɩ Ninsaal Bi‑riblã tara noor dũni ka tɩ kõ yel‑wẽnã sugrã, bãmb yeela Ki‑bogrã yaa: «Yik n dɩk f gãagã n kuili.»
La wakat-kãng bala, a yika bãmb taoore, n dɩk gãag ning yẽnda sẽn dag n gãe a zugã, n loog n kuiis a yir la a pẽgd Wẽnnaam.
Bãmb fãa rag n yɛɛsame, la b waoogd Wẽnnaam. La rabeem yõka bãmb tɩ b yeel yaa: «Tõnd yãnda bõn-bãnd rũndã.»
Dẽ poore, a Zeezi yiime, la b yãnda yaood-dɛɛgd sẽn zĩ a tʋʋm zĩigẽ, t'a yʋʋr la a Leevi. A Zeezi yeela yẽnda: «Wa tũ maam.»
A Leevi basa fãa n yik n tũ a Zeezi.
A Leevi maana tigr kãseng a yiri, a Zeezi yĩnga. La yaood-dɛɛgdb wʋsg ne neb a taab n dag n be be n zĩ n dɩt ne bãmba.
Fariizẽ-dãmbã ne bãmb tõog karen-saam-dãmbã rag n yẽgemdame n yet a Zeezi karen-biisã yaa: «Bõe yĩng tɩ yãmb dɩtẽ la y yũud ne yaood dɛɛgdbã la yel-wẽn maandbã?»
A Zeezi leoka bãmb yaa: «Ka neb nins sẽn tar laafɩ wã n baood tɩp ye: yaa bãad-dãmbã.
Mam ka wa n na n bool nin-tɩrs tɩ b wa tek yam n kos sugr ye, yaa yel-wẽn maandbã. »
Bãmb yeela a Zeezi yaa: «A Zã karen-biisã ne Fariizẽ-dãmbã karen-biis loeta noor naoor wʋsg n pʋʋsdẽ, tɩ yãmb karen-biisã yaool n dɩtẽ la b yũuda.»
A Zeezi leoka bãmb yaa: «Yãmb tõe n modga pʋg-paal sɩd tũud-n-taas tɩ b loe noor wakat ning pʋg-paal sɩdã sẽn ket n be bãmb sʋk sɩda?
Day n wat tɩ b na n yiis pʋg-paal sɩdã n bas-ba. Dẽ, da-kãense, b na yaool n loe noore.»
A Zeezi wẽe bãmb yel-bũnd me n yeele: Ned kõn kẽeg fu-paalg n yãk a peend n na n lisg fu-kʋdg ye. Sã n ka rẽ, yẽnda n kẽeg fu-paalga, la peendã yẽnda sẽn yãkã ka zemsd ne fu-kʋdgã ye.
La ned ka suiid reezẽ rãam paalg ko-wao-kʋdẽ ye. Sã n ka rẽ, reezẽ rãam paalgã na n kɩtame tɩ ko-waoosã pusi. Reezẽ rãamã na raage, la ko-waoosã na sãame.
La b tog n suii reezẽ rã‑paalg ko-wao-paals pʋse.
La ned sã n yũ reezẽ rã-kʋdgo, a ka leb n dat reezẽ rã‑paalg ye. Bala, a yetame tɩ reezẽ rãam kʋdgã yaa noogo.
Zʋɩf-rãmbã vʋʋsg daar a yembre, a Zeezi dag n pɩʋʋgda pʋto. Bãmb karen-biisã rag n yãgsda kood n tẽgd n wãbdẽ.
Fariizẽ-dãmbã kẽer soka bãmb yaa: «Yaa bõe tɩ yãmb maand bũmb ning noor sẽn ka kõ tɩ maan vʋʋsg daare?»
A Zeezi leok-b lame yaa: Yãmb ka karem bũmb ning a Davɩɩd sẽn maan kom sẽn tar yẽnda ne a tũud-n-taasã wakat la?
Yẽnda sẽn kẽ Wẽnnaam doogẽ wã to‑to n deeg kaset bur paadmã n wãb la a kõ a tũud-n-taasã, baa ne ned sẽn ka tar noor tɩ rɩ, sã n ka maan-kʋʋdbã balã la?
La a Zeezi yeela bãmb yaa: «Ninsaal Bi-riblã yaa vʋʋsg daarã Zu‑soaba.»
Zʋɩf-rãmbã vʋʋsg daar a to, a Zeezi kẽe karen-doogẽ wã n zãmsd nebã. Dao n dag n be beenẽ t'a nug‑rɩtg ki.
Tõog karen-saam-dãmbã ne Fariizẽ-dãmbã dag n gũusda a Zeezi n dat n ges b sã n na n maaga ned vʋʋsg daarã. Dag n yaa sẽn na n yɩl n paam bũmb n dõd a Zeezi.
La a Zeezi dag n mii b tagsdã. Dẽ, b yeela rao ninga nug sẽn ki wã yaa: «Yik n yals sʋk ka. Yẽnda yik n yaasa yĩngri.»
Dẽ, a Zeezi yeela bãmb yaa: «Mam sokda yãmba, noor beeme tɩ maan neer vʋʋsgã daar bɩ, bɩ tɩ maan wẽnga? Tɩ fãag ned bɩɩ, bɩ tɩ kʋ-a?»
Dẽ, a Zeezi wẽnemd n gesa bãmb fãa n yeel raoã t'a tẽeg a nugã. Yẽnda tẽegame la a nugã vʋʋgame.
Bãmb sũyã puuga wʋsg tɩ b yẽsd ne taab n baood b sẽn na n maan a Zeezi bũmb ninga.
Wakat-kãnga, a Zeezi kẽnga tãng zug n na n tɩ pʋʋse. La bãmb pʋʋsa Wẽnnaam yʋngã tɛk fãa.
La beoogã sẽn vẽege, bãmb boola b karen-biisã n tũus bãmb piig la a yiibu, n bool-b tɩ tẽn-tʋmdbã.
Yaa a Sɩmo bãmb sẽn pʋd a yʋʋr t'a Pɩyɛɛrã, ne a ba-biiga Ãndere, a Zak ne a Zã, la a Filip ne a Bartelemi,
a Matye la a Toma, la a Alfe biig a Zak ne a Sɩmo b sẽn boond tɩ Zelote,
la a Zak biig a Zʋʋdaase, ne a Zʋdaas Iskaryo sẽn lebg zãmb soabã.
A Zeezi yii ne b karen-biisã tãngã zug n sig n yaas tẽnga. Bãmb karen-bi wʋsgã dag n bee be ne neb kʋʋng wʋsg sẽn yi Zʋʋde soolem fãa, la Zeruzalɛm la Tɩɩr tẽn-kɩremse ne Sɩdõ.
Bãmb dag n waame n na n kelg a Zeezi, la b paam tɩ b yiis b bãasã n maag-ba. Zĩn-dẽgd sẽn dag n namsd-b rãmbã paama maagre.
La neb kʋʋngã fãa rag n baood n sɩɩsa a Zeezi. Bala, pãng n dag n yit a Zeezi nengẽ n maagd bãmb fãa.
Dẽ, a Zeezi zẽka b neng n ges b karen-biisã n yeel yaa: bark bee yãmb sẽn yaa naong rãmba zutu, bala, Wẽnnaam soolem yaa yãmb dẽnda.
Bark bee yãmb kom sẽn tar moasã wã zutu, bala, yãmb na n tɩgame. Bark bee yãmb sẽn yãbd moasã wã zutu, bala, yãmb na la.
Bark bee yãmb zutu, nebã sẽn na n kisg yãmba, la b bak yãmb toore, la b tʋʋd yãmba, la b tõdg yãmb yʋʋrã, n geelg-a wa bõn-wẽng Ninsaal Bi-riblã yĩnga.
Bɩ y maan sũ-noog da-kãng n kɩdme, tɩ bõe yãmb keoor na n yɩɩ kãseng arzãn pʋgẽ. Bala, bãmb ba-rãmb dag n maanda Wẽnnaam no-rɛɛsdbã me a woto.
La yãmb sẽn yaa arzegs rãmba, yãmb na paam toogo, bala, yãmb tara y belsgo.
Yãmb sẽn dɩt n tɩgd moasã wã, yãmb na paam toogo, bala, kom na n yõka yãmba. Yãmb sẽn laad moasã wã, yãmb na paam toogo, bala, yãmb na n paama sũ-sãang la nintãm.
Yãmb na paam toogo, nebã fãa sã n pẽgd yãmba, bala, ba-rãmbã rag n maanda belgr no-rɛɛsdbã a woto.
La mam yeta yãmba, yãmb sẽn kelgd maamã, tɩ y nong y bɛɛbã, la y maan neb nins sẽn kis yãmbã neere.
Ning-y neb nins sẽn kãabd yãmb wẽngã zut barka, la y pʋʋs neb nins sẽn maand yãmb wẽngã yĩnga.
Ned sã n wẽ fo yegd pɛka, bɩ f wẽnemd a to wã me n kõ-a. Ned sã n deeg fo fu-bedre, bɩ f bas-a t'a reeg f fu-bilã me.
Ned ning fãa sẽn kos foom bũmb bɩ f kõ-a, la ned sã n dɩk fo paoongo, bɩ f ra sok-a ye.
Bũmb ningã yãmb sẽn dat tɩ nebã maan yãmbã, bɩ yãmb me maan bãmb me a woto.
Yãmb sã nong neb nins sẽn nong yãmbã bala, bõe bark la yãmb na n paame? Yel-wẽn maandbã me nonga neb nins sẽn nong bãmbã me.
La yãmb sã n maand neb nins sẽn maand yãmb neerã bal neere, bõe bark la yãmb na n paame? Yel-wẽn maandbã me maanda a woto.
La yãmb sã n pengd neb nins yãmb sẽn tẽed tɩ b na n paam n lebsa yãmbã bala, bõe bark la yãmb na n paame? Yel-wẽn maandbã me pengda taaba, tɩ b tõe n leb n deeg sẽn zem a woto me.

La yãmba, nong-y bɛɛbã. Maan-y-b neere, la y peng n da tẽed tɩ b na lebs-y ye. La yãmb keoor na n yɩɩ kãsenga, la yãmb na n yɩɩ Wẽnnaam sẽn be saasẽ-saasẽ wã kamba. Bala, bãmb yaa sõama zɩ-beoog rãmbã ne nin-wẽnsã yĩnga.
Bɩ y yɩ nimbãan-zoɛtba, wa yãmb ba wã sẽn yaa nimbãan-zoɛtã.
Da bʋ-y ned bʋʋd ye, la b kõn bʋ yãmb bʋʋd ye. Da kao-y ned bʋʋd ye, la b kõn kao yãmb bʋʋd ye. Maan-y sugri, la b na maan yãmb me sugri.
Bɩ y kõ la b na kõ yãmba. B na n maka sõama n kõ yãmba, n dĩ, n yegse, n ning tɩ sudgi. Bala, ne makdg ning yãmb sẽn makd n kõt nebã, Wẽnnaam na n maka ne rẽnda n kõ yãmba.
A Zeezi wẽe bãmb yel-bũnd me n yeele: Zoang tõe n tɛɛ zoang sɩda? Bãmb b yiibã fãa kõn lʋɩ bokẽ sɩda?
Karen-biig ka yɩɩd a karen-saamb ye. La karen-biig fãa sẽn paam zãmsg n taas lebga wa a karen-saamba.
Yaa bõe tɩ fo get moogã sẽn be f ba-biigã nifẽ wã, n yaool n ka ne sug-raoogã sẽn be fo mengã rẽndẽ wã?

Fo sẽn ka ne sug-raoogã sẽn be fo nifẽ wã, fo na n yɩɩ a wãn n yeel f ba-biigã t'a bas tɩ f yãk moogã sẽn be a nifẽ wã? Zãmb soaba, deng n yãk sug-raoogã sẽn be fo nifẽ wã, la rẽ, fo na n yãnda sõama n tõog n yãk moogã sẽn be f ba-biigã nifẽ wã.
Tɩ-sõng ka be n womd bi-wẽns ye, la tɩ-wẽng me ka be n womd bi-sõama ye.
Bala, b bãngda tɩɩg fãa a biisẽ. B ka wobd kankam gõaag zug ye, la b ka kaood sib kɛglg zug ye.
Nin-sõng yiisda bõn-sõng a laog-sõngã bĩngr zĩigẽ sẽn be a sũurẽ, la nin-wẽng yiisda wẽng a laog-wẽngã bĩngr zĩigẽ sẽn be a sũurẽ. Bala, yaa bũmb ning sẽn pid sũurã n yit noorẽ wã.
Bõe yĩng tɩ yãmb boond maam tɩ Zu-soaba! Zu-soaba! La y ka maand mam sẽn yet yãmb bũmb ninsã?
Ned ning fãa sẽn wat mam nengẽ n kelgd mam goamã n sakdẽ, mam na n wilga yãmb yẽnda sẽn wẽnd ned ninga.

Yẽnda wẽnda wa rao sẽn yik n na n me a roogo. Yẽnda tuu bog-zulunga, n yẽbg roogã kugr zugu. La ko-kãseng sẽn wa, ko-zoetmã zoeeme n wẽ roogã, la a ka tõog n miim-a ye, roogã meebã sẽn dag n yaa sõama wã yĩnga.
La ned ning sẽn wʋmd n ka sakdẽ wã, wẽnda wa rao a yembr sẽn me a roog tom zugu, n ka tuk bok ye. Ko-zoetmã zoee n wẽe roogã, la tao-tao bala, a lʋɩɩme, la ro-kãngã sãoongã yɩɩ kãsenga.
A Zeezi sẽn gom gom-kãense ne neb nins sẽn dag n kelgd bãmbã n sɛ, b kẽnga Kapɛrnaom.
Sodaas koabg naab a ye n dag n tar a tʋmtʋmd‑nongr sẽn gãe ne bãag n kolg kũum.
Yẽnda sẽn wʋm tɩ b gomd a Zeezi yelle, a tʋma Zʋɩf-rãmbã kãsem-dãmb bãmb nengẽ tɩ b tɩ kos-b tɩ b wa n fãag a tʋmtʋmdã.
Bãmb sẽn ta a Zeezi nengẽ, b bõosa bãmb ne pẽdgr n yeele: «Rao-kãngã zemsame tɩ y maan a sẽn kotã n kõ-a.
Bala, yẽnda nonga tõnd buudã, la yaa yẽnda n me tõnd karen-doogã.»
Dẽ, a Zeezi dag n tũuda bãmb n dabda, la b sẽn kolg yirã, sodaas koabg naabã tʋma a zo-rãmb tɩ b tɩ yeel a Zeezi yaa: «Zu-soaba, da nams-y y meng a woto ye. Bala, mam ka zems tɩ yãmb kẽ mam zakẽ ye.
Yaa woto yĩng me n kɩt tɩ mam ka tags tɩ mam zemsame tɩ wa yãmb nengẽ m toorã. Yãmb ye n gom bala, la mam tʋmtʋmdã na n paama laafɩ.
Bala, neb sẽn yɩɩd maam n so maam, tɩ mam me so sodaase. Mam sã n yeel a yembr t'a kẽnge, a kẽngdame, la m sã n yeel a to t'a wa, a watame. Mam sã n yeel m tʋmtʋmd t'a maan woto, a maandame.»
Dẽ, a Zeezi sẽn wʋm gom-kãensã wã, a yɛɛsa bãmba. La b wẽnemdame n yeel neb kʋʋngã sẽn da pʋgd bãmbã yaa: «Mam yeta yãmb tɩ hal baa Israyɛll pʋgẽ, mam nan ka yã tẽ-kãseng a woto ye.»
La b sẽn tʋm-b rãmbã sẽn lebg n ta yiri, b mikame tɩ tʋmtʋmda paama laafɩ.
Dẽ poore, a Zeezi kẽnga tẽng a yembr sẽn boond tɩ Nayin. Bãmb karen-biisã ne neb wʋsg dag n tũuda bãmba.
A Zeezi sẽn wa n kolg tẽngã noore, mikame tɩ neb n dag n tʋk kũum n dabd mumbu. Yẽnda dag n yaa pag a yembr sẽn yaa pʋg‑kõor bi-ribl yende. La tẽngã neb wʋsg rag n yãagda pagã.
Zu-soabã yãnda pagã, t'a nimbãaneg yõk-b tɩ b yeel-a yaa: «Ra yãb ye!»
A Zeezi kolgame n tik pãndarã, la neb nins sẽn dag n tʋk-a wã yalsame. A Zeezi yeelame yaa: «Bi-bɩɩga, mam yeta foom tɩ f yiki.»
La sẽn ki-a wã yikame n zĩnd n sɩng n gomda, t'a Zeezi lebs-a a ma.
Nebã fãa yɛɛsame n pẽgd Wẽnnaam n yetẽ: «Wẽnnaam no-rɛɛs kãseng puka tõnd sʋka, la Wẽnnaam waa n gesa b nebã.»
Nebã sẽn gom a Zeezi yell woto wã, saaga Zʋʋde soolmã fãa ne a tẽn-kɩremsã.
A Zã karen-biisã togsa yẽnda bõn-kãens fãa.
A Zã boola a karen-biis a yiib n tʋm-b tɩ b tɩ sok Zu-soabã n gese, yaa bãmb la sẽn tog n wa-a wã bɩ, bɩ bãmb tog n gũu ned a to?
Raopã sẽn ta a Zeezi nengẽ, b yeelame yaa: «A Zãmbatiis tʋma tõnd yãmb nengẽ tɩ d wa sok n gese, yaa yãmb la sẽn tog n wa-a wã bɩ, bɩ tõnd tog n gũu ned a to?»
Wakat-kãng bala, a Zeezi maaga bãad-dãmb wʋsgo, koms-rãmba, la sɩ-wẽns sẽn tar-b rãmba, la b pugs zoens wʋsg nini.

La a Zeezi leok-b lame n yeele: Kẽng-y n tɩ togs-y-yã a Zã bũmb nins yãmb sẽn yã la y wʋmã: «Zoens nin pugsdame, põe kẽndame, wãoob paamda maagre, wʋms wʋmdame, kũum vʋʋgdame, koe-noogã moonda naong rãmb sʋka.
La bark bee ned ning mam sẽn kõn yɩ kug-lakdg a yĩngã zugu.»
A Zã sẽn tʋm-b rãmbã sẽn looge, a Zeezi sɩngame n gom ne neb kʋʋngã a Zã yell n yeele: Yãmb kẽng n tɩ gesa bõe we-rasempʋɩɩgẽ wã? Tãnwĩig sobg sẽn miimda?
La bõe la yãmb sẽn kẽng n tɩ gesã? Rao sẽn yer waoogr futu? Ad neb nins sẽn yer fu-bʋgsã, la b vɩ bõn neeb sʋkã bee rĩm-dãmb zagsẽ.
La bõe la yãmb sẽn kẽng n tɩ gesã? Wẽnnaam no-rɛɛsa? Mam yeta yãmb tɩ n-yẽe, la a pʋs n yɩɩda Wẽnnaam no-rɛɛsa.
Yaa yẽnda yell la b sẽn gʋls n yeel tɩ: «Gese, mam tʋmda m koe-toagsd t'a reng fo taoor n segl f waoongã.»
Mam yeta yãmb tɩ pagb sẽn dog b rãmbã sʋka, baa a yembr ka be sẽn yaa-a kãseng n yɩɩd a Zã ye. La baoosgo, sẽn yaa-a yao-zʋʋg Wẽnnaam soolmẽ wã yaa kãseng n yɩɩd a Zã.
Nebã fãa ne yaood dɛɛgdbã sẽn wʋm a Zã goamã, b reega a Zã lisgã, n wilg tɩ Wẽnnaam yaa tɩrga.
La Fariizẽ-dãmbã ne tõog karen-saam-dãmbã sẽn zãgs t'a Zã kõn lis bãmbã, b tõdga bũmb ning Wẽnnaam sẽn dag n seglg bãmb yĩngã.
Dẽ, a Zeezi kẽnga taoor n yeele: «Mam na n mamsa zamaan‑kãngã neb ne bõe? La b wẽnda ãnda?
Bãmb wẽnda kamb sẽn zĩ raagẽ n boond taab n yetẽ yaa: ‹Tõnd peeba wɩɩg yãmb yĩnga, la yãmb ka sao ye. Tõnd yɩɩla kʋʋr yɩɩla, la yãmb ka yãb ye.›
Bala, a Zãmbatiis waame n ka wãbd buri, la a ka yũud reezẽ rãam ye, tɩ yãmb yetẽ tɩ zĩn n tar-a.
Ninsaal bi-riblã sẽn wa wã, b rɩtame la b yũuda, tɩ yãmb yetẽ tɩ rao-kãngã yaa yão-be-neda, la rã-yũuda, la yaood dɛɛgdbã ne yel-wẽn maandbã zoa.
La Wẽnnaam kambã sẽn deegd Wẽnnaam yamã kɩta kaset t'a yaa yam.»
Fariizẽ a yembr bõosa a Zeezi tɩ b wa n dɩ ne yẽnda. A Zeezi kẽe Fariizẽ wã yir n zĩnd n na dɩ.
La gese, pag a ye n dag n be tẽngã pʋgẽ n yaa yel-wẽn maanda. Yẽnda bãngame t'a Zeezi zĩi Fariizẽ wã zakẽ n dɩtẽ. Yẽnda talla albatr tʋk sẽn pid ne tɩdare,
n wa n yals a Zeezi poorẽ, b naoã sɛɛgẽ. A dag n yãbdame, n sɩng n madgd a Zeezi naoã ne a nintãmã, la a rag n yẽesd-b ne a zoobdã, n mogsd bãmb naoã la a zãgsd-b ne tɩdarã.

Fariizẽ ning sẽn bool a Zeezi wã sẽn yã woto, a tagsa a sũurẽ n yeele: «Rao-kãngã sã n dag n yaẽ Wẽnnaam no-rɛɛsa, b rag n na bãngẽ pag ning sẽn sɩɩsd bãmbã sẽn yaa ned ninga, la a sẽn yaa bũmb ninga: yel-wẽn maand bala.»
A Zeezi goma ne a Sɩmo n yeel-a yaa: «Sɩmo, mam dat n togsa foom bũmbu.» T'a leoke: «Karen-saamba, togs-y-yã.»
A Zeezi yeela yẽnda yaa: «Ned a ye n dag n be tɩ neb a yiib tar yẽnda samde. A yembrã rag n tara deniye kobs-nu samde, t'a to wã tar pis-nu.
La bãmb sẽn dag n ka tar n na yao wã yĩnga, yẽnda basa b yiibã fãa samã taale. Bãmb b yiibã sʋka, bʋg n na n nong yẽnda n yɩɩda?»
A Sɩmo leokame: «Mam tagsdame tɩ yaa ned ning sẽn dag n tara sam-kẽeng tɩ b bas-a taalã.» A Zeezi yeela yẽnda: «Fo togsa sɩda.»
Dẽ, a Zeezi wẽnemda paga sẽnẽ n yeel a Sɩmo yaa: «Fo nee pʋg-kãngã? Mam kẽe fo zakẽ, la fo ka kõ maam koom tɩ m waas m nao ye. La yẽnda, a madga mam nao ne a nintãm, n yẽes-b ne a zoobdo.
Fo ka mok maam ye, la hal mam sẽn kẽ wã tɛka, yẽnda mogsda mam nao n ka basdẽ ye.
Fo ka sõog mam zug kaam ye, la yẽnda, a waala mam nao ne tɩdare.
Yaa woto yĩnga, mam yeta foom tɩ yẽnda paama a yel-wẽnã sẽn yaa wʋsgã sugri. Bala, yẽnda wilga a nonglem kãsenga. La ned ning b sẽn kõt sugr bũmb bilf yĩng nonglem yaa bilfu.»
La a Zeezi yeela pagã yaa: «Fo paama f yel-wẽnã sugri.»
Neb nins sẽn dag n zĩ ne bãmb n dɩtẽ wã sɩngame n tags b sũyẽ wã a woto: «Dao-kãngã yaa ãndã n kõt baa yel-wẽnã sugri?»
La a Zeezi yeela pagã yaa: «Fo tẽeb n fãag foom. Kẽng ne bãane.
Dẽ poore, a Zeezi rag n kẽnda tẽn-bɛd la tẽn-bãooneg pʋse, n moondẽ la b togsd Wẽnnaam soolem koe-noogã. Karen-biis piig la a yiibã rag n bee ne bãmba,
n paas pagb kẽere, a Zeezi sẽn dig sɩ-wẽns sẽn dag n be ne-bã, la b maag-b n yiis b bãasã: Yaa a Maari sẽn yit Magdala, soab ning a Zeezi sẽn dig zĩn-dãmb a yopoe tɩ b yi n bas-a wã,
a Erood ligd gɛt a Suuza pag a Zan n paas a Suzan, la pagb a taab wʋsg sẽn dag n yãkd b paoong n sõngd a Zeezi ne b karen-biisã.
Neb kʋʋng wʋsg tigma taaba, la neb yii tẽms toay-toay n wa bãmb nengẽ. A Zeezi tãoo yel‑bũn-kãngã:
Bʋt a yembr n yi n na n tɩ bʋd a bõn-buudu, la yẽnda sẽn fẽrgd bõn-buudã, kẽer lʋɩɩ sor kɩrenga. Neb n taba bãmba, la liuuli rɩ-b lame.
Kẽer lʋɩɩ kugr zugu. La b sẽn yi, b kʋɩɩme, maasr sẽn ka be wã yĩnga.
Kẽer me lʋɩɩ gõos sʋka. La gõosã naaga bãmb n yi n dɩ-ba.
La kẽer lʋɩɩ zĩ-sõngẽ, n yi n wom biis tɩ ta koabg-koabga.» A Zeezi sẽn gom a woto, b zẽka b koɛɛg n yeele: «Ned ning sẽn tar-a tʋb n tõe n wʋm bɩ a wʋme.»
A Zeezi karen-biisã soka bãmb yel-bũndã võore.

A Zeezi leoka bãmb n yeel yaa: «B kõo yãmb tɩ y bãng Wẽnnaam soolem yel-soalmã. La ne neb a taabã, b togsda bãmb bõn-kãens ne yel‑bũnã, sẽn na n yɩl tɩ bãmb sẽn getã, bɩ b ra yã ye, la tɩ b sẽn wʋmdã, b kõn wʋm a võor ye.»
«Yel-bũndã võor la a woto: bõn-buudã yaa Wẽnnaam goamã.
Sẽn be-b sor kɩrengã yaa neb nins sẽn wʋm koɛɛgã, tɩ Sʋtãanã wat n yiisd koɛɛgã sẽn dag n be b sũyẽ wã, sẽn na n yɩl tɩ b ra tẽ n paam fãagrã.
Sẽn be-b kugrã zugã yaa neb nins sẽn wʋmd koɛɛgã n deegd-a ne sũ-noogã. La b ka tar yẽgen ye. Bãmb tẽeda wakat bilf bala, la makr wakate, bãmb basda tẽebã.
Bõn-buudã sẽn lʋɩ gõosã sʋkã, yaa neb nins sẽn wʋmd koɛɛgã n sɛ n looge, tɩ yɩɩre, la arzegse, la dũniyã sũ-noogã rɩ koɛɛgã t'a ka womd biis tɩ bɩ ye.
Zĩ-sõngã, yaa neb nins sẽn wʋmd koɛɛgã ne sũur sẽn yaa sõama la tɩrga, n talld-a, n yalsd kãenkãe, n womd biisã.»
Ned ka yõgend fɩtl n fõgn-a ne peoogo, wall a ning-a gãag tẽngr ye. B rogend-a-la fɩtl doagendgã zug tɩ neb nins sẽn kẽedã tõe n yãnd vẽenemã.
Bala, bũmb ka be sẽn lud sẽn kõn puk ye, la bũmb ka be sẽn solg sẽn kõn vẽneg ye.
Dẽ, bɩ y gũus ne yãmb sẽn kelgd to-to wã. Bala, b na n kõo ned ning sẽn tar‑a, la ned ning sẽn ka tar‑a, b na n deega baa bũmb ning yẽnda sẽn tagsd t'a tarame wã n bas-a.
A Zeezi ma ne b ma-bi-raop waa bãmb nengẽ, la neb kʋʋngã yĩnga, b ka tõog n ta a Zeezi ye.
Nebã yeela a Zeezi yaa: «Yãmb ma wã bee yɩng ne b ma-bi-raopã n dat n yãnd-yã.»
La a Zeezi leoka bãmb n yeele: «Mam ma ne m ma-bi-raop yaa neb nins sẽn kelgd Wẽnnaam goamã n sakdẽ wã.»
Daar a ye, a Zeezi kẽe koom-koglg ne b karen-biisã, n yeel-b tɩ b wa tɩ b kẽng ko-kãsengã rʋʋnde. La b loogame.
La bãmb sẽn dugsd koglgã wakate, a Zeezi gũsame. La sob-kãseng yika koomã zugu, tɩ koom-koglgã rag n pid ne koom, tɩ lebg yel-pakr ne-ba.
Karen-biisã kolgame n nek a Zeezi n yeel‑a yaa: «Karen-saamba! Karen-saamba! Tõnd na n kiime!» A Zeezi nekame, n tãs sobgã ne ko-pɛmã, la b yõkame, la zĩigã lebga sɩddd...
Dẽ, bãmb soka b karen-biisã yaa: «Yãmb tẽebã bee yɛ?» La rabeem yõka bãmb tɩ b yɛɛs n sok taab tɩ nin-kãngã yaa yɛ neda? Bala, baa sobgã ne ko-pɛma sakda bãmb noore.
Bãmb taa Geraaza rãmbã tẽnga, tẽng sẽn teesd Galɩle.
La a Zeezi sẽn sig tẽnga, tẽngã rao a ye zĩn-dãmb wʋsg sẽn tar waa n sega bãmba. Hal daar zãra, a ka leb n yeelgd fut ye, la a rag n ka gãe yir ye, yaa yaadẽ.
A sẽn yãnda a Zeezi, a kelmame n wõgemd bãmb taoor n zẽk a koɛɛg n yeele: «Wẽnnaam sẽn be saasẽ-saasẽ bi-ribl a Zeezi, yãmb data maam ne bõe? Mam bõosd-y lame tɩ y ra nams maam ye.»

Bala, a Zeezi rag n yeta zĩn-dẽgdã sẽn dag n kẽ yẽnda hal daar zãrã t'a yi n bas raoã. B rag n sẽbda yẽnda ne bãense, n balg a naoã ne kutu, la a rag n kaooda a sẽbdsã. La zĩnã rag n talld-a lame n kẽngd we-rasempʋɩɩsẽ.
A Zeezi soka yẽnda t'a yʋʋr la a bõe. T'a leok t'a tusa. Bala, zĩn-dãmb wʋsg n dag n kẽ yẽnda.
La zĩn-dãmbã bõosa a Zeezi tɩ b ra rig-b tɩ b kẽng zĩ-zulungẽ wã ye.
Kurkuy wʋsg n dag n be tãngã zug n wãbdẽ, la zĩn-dãmbã bõosa a Zeezi tɩ b kõ bãmb noor tɩ b tɩ kẽ kurkuyã. La a Zeezi kõ-b lame.
Zĩn-dãmbã yii n basa raoã n tɩ kẽ kurkuyã, la kurkuyã wudga tãngã sigdgẽ, n bilim n lʋɩ koomẽ wã, la koomã rɩ-b lame.
Neb nins sẽn dag n gũud kurkuyã sẽn yã bũmb ning sẽn maanã, b zoee n tɩ togsa koɛɛgã tẽnga pʋgẽ la pʋtẽ wã me.
Nebã kẽngame n na n tɩ ges bũmb ning sẽn maanã. Bãmb waa a Zeezi nengẽ, la b yãnda rao ning zĩn-dãmbã sẽn yi n basã t'a zĩ a Zeezi sɛɛgẽ, n yer futu, n mi a nenga. La rabeem yõka bãmba.
Neb nins sẽn yã bũmb ning sẽn maanã togsa bãmb rao ning zĩnã sẽn dag n tarã sẽn paam yolsg to-to.
Geraaza soolmã nebã fãa kosa a Zeezi tɩ b zãag n bas bãmba. Bala, rabeem kãseng n dag n yõk bãmba. A Zeezi kẽe koom-koglgã n na n lebg n lebe.
Rao ning zĩn-dãmbã sẽn yi n basã bõosa a Zeezi ne pẽdgr n dat n pa ne bãmba. La a Zeezi kuils-a lame n yeele:
«Lebg n kuil f yir n tɩ wilg bũmb nins fãa Wẽnnaam sẽn maan n kõ foomã.» Raoã loogame n tɩ moon bũmb nins fãa a Zeezi sẽn maan n kõ yẽnda wã tẽngã fãa pʋgẽ.
A Zeezi sẽn leb rʋʋndã, neb kʋʋng reega bãmba, bala, b fãa rag n gũuda bãmba.
La gese, dao a yembr yʋʋr sẽn boond t'a Zayiruusi, n yaa karen-doog naab waame n wõgemd a Zeezi taoor n bõos bãmb tɩ b wa yẽnda yirã.
Bala, yẽnda rag n tara a bi-pugl yende, a yʋʋm sẽn kolg piig la yiibu, n gãe n dat n ki. A Zeezi sẽn dabd be wakate, neb kʋʋngã dag n dɩdga bãmb hal wʋsgo.
La pag a ye n dag n be be tɩ bãag tar-a, t'a zɩɩm yit hal yʋʋm piig la a yiibu. Yẽnda rɩka a sẽn dag n tarã fãa n kõ tɩpdba, la b baa a yembr ka tõog t'a paam laafɩ ye.
Yẽnda kolga a Zeezi poorẽ, n sɩɩs bãmb fuugã noore. La wakat-kãng bala, zɩɩmã sẽn dag n yitã yõkame.
La a Zeezi sokame: «Yaa ãndã n sɩɩs maamã?» Ned fãa sẽn kɩɩsd tɩ ka yẽnda wã, a Pɩyɛɛr yeelame: «Karen-saamba, neb kʋʋngã gũbga yãmb n dɩdgd yãmba. »
La a Zeezi leokame n yeele: «Ned n sɩɩs maam. Bala, mam bãngame tɩ pãng n yi mam nengẽ.»
Pagã sẽn yã t'a yellã pukame, a waa n yĩgimda a Zeezi taoor ne rigbu, nebã fãa nifẽ, n togs bũmb ning yĩng sẽn kɩt tɩ yẽnda sɩɩs a Zeezi wã, la yẽnda sẽn paam laafɩ zĩig pʋgẽ to-to.
A Zeezi yeel-a lame: «M bi-pugla, fo tẽeb n fãag foom, kẽng ne bãane.»
A Zeezi sẽn ket n gomdã, ned n yi karen-doog naabã yir n wa n yeel-a: «Da leb n nams-y karen-saamb ye: Yãmb bi-puglã kiime.»
La a Zeezi sẽn wʋme, b yeela karen-doog naabã yaa: «Da maan dabeem ye. Tẽ bala, la biigã na n põsame.»
La a Zeezi sẽn ta yirã, bãmb ka sak tɩ ned tũ bãmb n kẽ, sã n ka a Pɩyɛɛr ne a Zã, la a Zak ne biigã ba la a ma bala.
Nebã fãa rag n yãbdame n wiisd biigã yĩnga. Dẽ, a Zeezi yeel-b lame «Ra yãb‑y tɩ biigã ka ki ye, a gõeeme.»
Nebã sẽn dag n mi tɩ biigã kiime wã, b yaala a Zeezi.
La a Zeezi gãda biigã nugu, n zẽk b koɛɛg n yeele: «M biiga, yiki.»
La a sɩɩgã lebg n waame, la wakat-kãng bala, a yikame. La a Zeezi yeelame tɩ b kõ biiga rɩɩb t'a rɩ.
Bi-puglã ba-rãmb yɛɛsame, la a Zeezi keooga bãmb tɩ b ra togs ned bũmb ning sẽn maanã ye.
A Zeezi boola karen-biis piig la a yiibã n kõ-b pãnga la noor tɩ b rig zĩn-dãmba, la b maag bãad-dãmba.
A Zeezi tʋma bãmb tɩ b tɩ moon Wẽnnaam soolem koɛɛga, la b maag bãad-dãmba.
A Zeezi yeel-b lame yaa: «Da rɩk-y bũmb y kẽnda yĩng ye. Da zɩ-y dasaar bɩ korgo, buri wall ligd ye. La y ra zɩ fut a yiib‑yiib ye.
Yãmb sẽn sig zak ning pʋgẽ, bɩ y pa be n tãag y sẽn na n yi be n looge.
La zĩig ning fãa nebã sẽn ka reeg yãmba, y sã n wa n yit tẽn-kãngã, bɩ y pĩms y naoã tom tɩ yɩ kaset b yĩnga.»
A Zeezi karen-biisã loogame n kẽng tẽng‑tẽnga, n moond koe-noogã, la b maagd neb zĩiga fãa.
A Erood sẽn yaa Gʋvɛrneerã dag n wʋma bũmb nins fãa sẽn dag n maandã, la a rag n ka mi yẽnda sẽn na n tags tɩ bũmb ning ye. Bala, neb kẽer dag n yetame t'a Zã vʋʋgame n yi kũum sʋka,
tɩ kẽer yetẽ tɩ Wẽnnaam no-rɛɛsdbã sẽn zĩnd pĩndã ned a ye n vʋʋge.
La a Erood yeelame: «Mam kɩtame tɩ b fiuug a Zã zugu. Dẽ, ned ning mam sẽn wʋmd tɩ b gomd a yell woto wã yaa ãnda soaba?» La yẽnda rag n baoodame n dat n yãnd a Zeezi.
Tẽn-tʋmdbã sẽn lebg n wa, b togsa a Zeezi bũmb nins fãa bãmb sẽn maanã. A Zeezi peega bãmb n yi kɛɛng n kẽng tẽng a yembr sẽn boond tɩ Betsayɩda sẽnẽ.
La neb kʋʋngã bãngame n pʋg bãmba. A Zeezi reeg-b lame n gom ne-b Wẽnnaam soolem yelle, la b maag neb nins sẽn dag n dat maagrã me.

Wĩndgã sẽn kɩlle, karen-biis piig la a yiibã kolgame n yeel a Zeezi yaa: Kɩt-y tɩ neb kʋʋngã loog n kẽng tẽn-bãoonegẽ wã ne pʋtã sẽn pẽ ka wã n tɩ paam gãag zĩisi, la b paam dɩɩbo. Bala, tõnd sẽn beẽ wã yaa we-rasempʋɩɩga.

A Zeezi yeela karen-biisã tɩ bãmb mensã kõ nebã rɩɩb tɩ b rɩ. La b leokame n yeele: Tõnd ka tar sẽn yɩɩd bur a nu ne zĩm a yiib ye. Sã n ka tɩ tõnd mens na n kẽngame n tɩ ra rɩɩb nin-kãensã fãa yĩnga.
La nebã sẽn dag n be be wã kolga raop tus a nu. A Zeezi yeela b karen-biisã tɩ b kɩt tɩ nebã zĩnd sull-sulli, neb pis-nunu.
Karen-biisã maana a woto n kɩt tɩ b fãa zĩndi.
A Zeezi reega bur a nu wã ne zĩm a yiibã n nak n ges yĩngr n ning-b barka, n yaool n kao burã ne zĩmã n kõ karen-biisã tɩ b pʋɩ neb kʋʋngã.
Bãmb fãa rɩɩme n tɩge, la b wʋka gɩrsã sẽn kellã n pid pet piig la a yiibu. Bur a nu ne zĩm a yiibu.
Daar a ye, a Zeezi rag n bee zĩig neb sẽn ka be, n pʋʋsdẽ, la karen-biisã rag n bee ne bãmba. A Zeezi soka b karen-biisã yaa: Neb kʋʋngã yetame tɩ mam yaa ãnda?
Bãmb leokame tɩ kẽer yetame t'a Zãmbatiisi, tɩ kẽer yetẽ t'a Eli, tɩ kẽer yetẽ tɩ Wẽnnaam no-rɛɛsdbã sẽn zĩnd pĩndã ned a ye sẽn vʋʋge.
La a Zeezi soka bãmb yaa: La yãmba, yãmb yetame tɩ mam yaa ãnda? A Pɩyɛɛr leokame: «Yãmb yaa Kiris sẽn yi Wẽnnaam nengẽ.»
A Zeezi keooga bãmb neere, n yeel-b tɩ b ra saag n togs ned yõwã ye.
A Zeezi gomame n paas n yeel tɩ yaa tɩlɛ tɩ Ninsaal Bi-riblã nams wʋsgo, tɩ kãsem-dãmbã ne maan-kʋʋdbã kãsem-dãmbã la tõog karen-saam-dãmbã kɩɩs bãmba n kʋ-ba, la tɩ rasem a tãab daare bãmb na vʋʋge.
Dẽ, a Zeezi yeela b fãa yaa: ned sã n dat n tũ maam, bɩ a kɩɩs a mengã ratem, n tʋk a da-pɩk daar fãa n pʋg maam.
Sɩd me, ned ning fãa sẽn dat n kogl a vɩɩm, a vɩɩm na sãame. La ned ning sẽn na n bas a vɩɩm mam yĩnga, a na n leb n paam-a lame.
Ned sã n paam dũni bũmb fãa, n yaool n menem wall a sãam a menga, a yõod bee yɛ ne-a?
Sɩd me, ned sã n zoe mam yãnde, la mam goamã yãnde, Ninsaal Bi-riblã sã n wa n wa ne b ziirã, la b ba wã ziiri, ne malegs-sõamyã, b na n zoee yẽnda me yãnde.
Mam yeta yãmb sɩd-sɩd tɩ neb nins sẽn be ka wã kẽer ka na n ki hal tɩ b yãnd Wẽnnaam soolmã.
Sẽn kolg rasem a nii, a Zeezi sẽn gom gom-kãensã zugẽ, bãmb peega a Pɩyɛɛr ne a Zã la a Zak n dʋ tãngã zug n na n pʋʋse.
La bãmb sẽn pʋʋsd wakate, b nengã yalẽ tedgame, la bãmb futã lebga peels n pɩnda.
La gese, raop a yiib n wa n gom ne a Zeezi. Dag n yaa a Moyiis ne a Eli,
n puk b meng ne ziiri, n gomd ne a Zeezi b kũumã b sẽn na n ki Zeruzalɛmã yelle.
Gõeem rag n namsda a Pɩyɛɛr ne a tũud-n-taasã, la bãmb neendame n yãnd a Zeezi ziirã ne raop a yiibã sẽn da be ne bãmbã.

Wakat ning raopã sẽn bas a Zeezi n loogdẽ wã, a Pɩyɛɛr yeela a Zeezi yaa: «Karen-saamba, yaa sõama tɩ tõnd pa ka. D tilg fu-rot a tãabo: a yembr yãmb yĩnga, a yembr a Moyiis yĩnga, a yembr a Eli yĩnga.» Yẽnda rag n ka mi a sẽn gomd bũmb ningã ye.
La yẽnda sẽn gomd a woto, sawadg waa n luda bãmba, la a Moyiis rãmb sẽn kẽed sawadgẽ wã, rabeem yõka bãmba.
La koɛɛg yii sawadgẽ wã n yeele: Ada yaa mam Bi-ribl mam sẽn yãke, bɩ y kelg-a.
La koɛɛgã sẽn gom a woto n sɛ, a Zeezi rag n yɛsa b yembre. Karen-biisã kell n sĩndame n ka togs ned bũmb ning bãmb sẽn yã wã da-kãens ye.
Vẽkembeoogo, bãmb sẽn yi tãngã zug n sigi, neb kʋʋng wʋsg waa n sega a Zeezi.
La gese, neb kʋʋngã sʋka, dao a ye n zĩnd be n zẽk a koɛɛg n yeele: Karen-saamba, m kot-y lame tɩ y ges m bi-riblã. Bala, yaa m bi-yende.
Zĩn n kẽed-a, la a sã n kẽ-a bala, a kelemdame, la zĩnã kɩtdame t'a sobg n gʋɩgsdẽ, tɩ tãntãn-puudã yita. A sã n na n wa n yi n bas biigã, rẽ t'a nams-a-la wʋsgo, n pogl-a.
Mam bõosa yãmb karen-biisã tɩ b rig-a, la b ka tõog ye.
A Zeezi yeelame yaa: Neb sẽn ka tẽebo, la sẽn yaa nin-wẽnse, mam na n paa ne yãmb la m maan sũ-mar ne yãmb tɩ ta wakat bʋgo? Tall f biigã n wa ne ka.
La biigã sẽn kolgdã, zĩnã lub-a-la tẽnga, n nams-a wʋsgo. La a Zeezi lenga zĩn-dẽgdã, n maag biigã n kɩs-a a ba.
La nebã fãa yɛɛsame, b sẽn yã Wẽnnaam pãn-kãsengã yĩngã. Nebã sẽn ket n tagsd bũmb nins fãa a Zeezi sẽn maanã yell ne yɛɛsgo, a Zeezi yeela b karen-biisã yaa:
Yãmba, yok-y y tʋb n kelg gom-kãensã sõama: b na n yõka Ninsaal Bi-riblã n kõ nebã.
La karen-biisã rag n ka wʋmd gom-kãng võor ye. A rag n solga ne bãmba, sẽn na n yɩlg tɩ b ra bãng a võorã ye. La b rag n yɛɛsdame n ka rat n sok a Zeezi bõn-kãng wɛɛngẽ ye.
Nokoeemd yika bãmb sʋka, tɩ b rat n bãng sẽn yaa-a kãseng n yɩɩd bãmb sʋkã.
A Zeezi sẽn mi bãmb sũyã tagsgã, b peega bi-bilf n zĩnig-a b sɛɛgẽ

n yeel karen-biisã yaa: «Ned ning fãa sẽn na n deeg bi-bilf‑kãngã mam yʋʋrã yĩnga, yaa mam mengã la a reeg yã. La ned ning fãa sẽn deeg maam, a reegda sẽn tʋmã maamã. Bala, ned ning sẽn yaa-a yao-zʋʋg yãmb sʋkã, yaa yẽnda soab n yaa kãsenga.»
A Zã gomame n yeele: «Karen-saamba, tõnd yãnda rao sẽn digd zĩn-dãmb ne yãmb yʋʋre, la tõnd gɩdg-a lame, a sẽn ka naag tõnd n tũud yãmbã yĩnga.»
A Zeezi leok-a lame n yeele: «Ra gɩdg-y-yã-a ye. Bala, ned sã n ka kis yãmba, a bee ne yãmba.»
Wakat ning b sẽn tog n zẽk a Zeezi tɩ b kẽng arzãnã sẽn kolge, bãmb tolg n yãka yam n na n kẽng Zeruzalɛm.
B tʋma neb tɩ b reng bãmb taoore. La b kẽngame n tɩ kẽ Samaari n na n segl bũmb fãa a Zeezi yĩnga.
La nebã ka reeg a Zeezi ye, bãmb sẽn dag n dabd Zeruzalɛmã yĩnga.
Bãmb karen-biis a Zak ne a Zã sẽn yã woto, b yeelame yaa: «Zu-soaba, yãmb datame tɩ d kɩt tɩ bugum yi yĩngr n sig n dɩ-b bɩ?»
La a Zeezi wẽnemdame n leng bãmb [n yeele: «Yãmb ka mi sɩɩg ning sẽn tar yãmbã ye.
Bala, Ninsaal Bi-riblã ka wa tɩ sãam ninsaalbã vɩɩm ye, la yaa tɩ fãag-ba.»] La bãmb kẽnga tẽng a to.
Bãmb sẽn be sorẽ n dabda, ned n yeel a Zeezi yaa: «Mam na n tũu yãmb n kẽng zĩig ning fãa yãmb sẽn na n kẽngẽ».
A Zeezi leok-a lame: «Waas tara bogdo, la liuuli sẽn yɩgdã tara tʋgdo, la Ninsaal Bi-riblã ka tar zĩig sẽn na n gãneg a zug ye.»
A Zeezi yeela ned a to: «Tũ maam.» La yẽnda leoka a Zeezi yaa: «bas-y-m nand tɩ m tɩ mum m ba la m wa.»
La a Zeezi leok-a lame n yeele: «Bas kũumã tɩ b mum b kũum, la foom, kẽng n moon Wẽnnaam soolem koɛɛgã.»
Ned a to leb n yeelame: «Zu-soaba mam na n tũu yãmba, la, sak-y tɩ m deng n tɩ pʋʋs m zakã rãmb wẽnd-na-taas la m wa.»
A Zeezi leoka yẽnda yaa: «Ned sã n gãd wãk rũng sẽn tata, la a rat n wẽnemd n ges a poorẽ, yẽnda ka zems ne Wẽnnaam soolmã ye.»
Rẽ poore, Zu-soabã leb n yãka neb pis-yopoe la a yiib a taaba, n tʋm bãmb yiib‑yiib tɩ b reng bãmb taoor n kẽng tẽng fãa la zĩig ning fãa bãmb meng sẽn tog n kẽngã.
A Zeezi yeela bãmb yaa: «Tigsgã yaa wʋsgo la tʋmtʋmdbã sõor paoodame. Kos-y tigsgã soab tɩ b tʋm tʋmtʋmdb b tigsgẽ wã.
Kẽng-y-yã! Ade, mam tʋmda yãmb wa piis digd-n-yĩids sʋka.
Da zã-y ligd korgo, wall yolgo, wall neooda ye, la y ra yals n pʋʋs ned sor zug ye.
Yãmb sã n na n kẽ yir fãa, bɩ y pʋʋs-b a woto: ‹Bɩ laafɩ zĩnd yi-kãngã pʋga.›
La laafɩ ned sã n be beenẽ, yãmb laafɩ wã na n siga a zugu. La laafɩ ned sã n ka be, bɩ y loog ne y laafɩ pʋʋsem.
Pa-y yi-yɛnga, n dɩtẽ la y yũud bũmb ning b sẽn na n kõ yãmbã. Bala, tʋmtʋmd toga ne a yaoodo. Da tegs-y yiy ye.
Tẽng ning fãa yãmb sẽn na n kẽ tɩ b reeg yãmba, bɩ y rɩ bũmb nins b sẽn na n kõ yãmbã.
Maag-y bãad-rãmb nins sẽn be beenẽ wã, la y yeel-b tɩ Wẽnnaam soolmã kolga bãmba.
Tẽng ning fãa yãmb sẽn na n kẽ tɩ b ka reeg yãmba, kẽng-y tẽngã soay zut n yeele:
‹Yãmb tẽngã wubsg meng sẽn bol tõnd naoã, tõnd pĩmsd-a lame n basd ne yãmba. La baoosgo, bãng-y tɩ Wẽnnaam soolmã pẽnegame.›
Mam yeta yãmb tɩ da-kãnga, Sodom sɩbgrã toolem kõn ta tẽng‑kãng rẽndã ye.»

«Korazin, fo na paam toogo! Betsayɩda, fo na paam toogo! Bala, bõn-bãn nins sẽn maan yãmb sʋkã sã n dag n maanẽ Tɩɩr ne Sɩdõ, yaa hal daar zãr la b da na n yeelg boto, la b yug b zug tompeglem n kos sugri.
Dẽ n kɩt tɩ bʋʋdã daare, Tɩɩr ne Sɩdõ sɩbgr kõn ta yãmb dẽndã ye.
La foom, Kapɛrnaom, b na n zẽka foom n taas saasẽ bɩ? Ayo! B na n sigsa foom hal n taas kɩɩm-kulgu.
Ned ning sẽn kelgd yãmb kelgda maam. La ned ning sẽn zãgsd yãmb zãgsda maam. La sẽn zãgsd-a maam zãgsda sẽn tʋm-a maamã.»
Neb pis-yopoe la a yiibã lebg n waa ne sũ-noog n yeele: «Zu-soaba, baa zĩn-dãmbã mens sakda tõnd noor yãmb yʋʋrã yĩnga.»
A Zeezi yeel-b lame: «Mam dag n nee a Sʋtãan sẽn yi yĩngr n lʋɩt wa sa-yãgbo.
La ade, mam kõo yãmb pãng tɩ y tab wiis la namse, la bɛyã pãngã fãa, la baa fʋɩ kõn tõog n maan yãmb wẽng ye.
Baoosgo, da maan-y sũ-noog zĩn-dãmbã sẽn sakd yãmbã yĩng ye. Maan-y sũ-noogo, yãmb yʋyã sẽn gʋls arzãn pʋgẽ wã yĩnga.»

Wakat-kãng bala, Sɩɩg-sõng kɩtame t'a Zeezi paam sũ-no-kãseng n yeele: «M ba sẽn yaa arzãn la tẽng Zu-soaba, mam pẽgda yãmba, yãmb sẽn solg bõn-kãens ne yam-dãmba, la yẽesem-dãmbã, n yaool n vẽneg-b ne kom-bãoonegã yĩnga. N‑yẽe, m ba, yaa yãmb n dat tɩ yɩ a woto.

M ba kõo maam bũmbã fãa, la ned baa a yembr ka mi Bi-riblã sẽn yaa a soaba, sã n ka a ba wã ye. La ned baa a yembr ka mi ba wã sẽn yaa a soaba, sã n ka Bi-riblã bala, la ned ning Bi-riblã sẽn dat n vẽneg bãmb ne-a wã ye.»
A Zeezi wẽnemdame n gom ne b karen-biisã b yeyn-yeyn n yeel-b yaa: «Bark bee neb nins nin sẽn yãt bũmb nins yãmb sẽn yãtã zutu.
Bala, mam yeta yãmb tɩ Wẽnnaam no-rɛɛsdb wʋsgo, la rĩm-dãmb dag n dat n yãnda bũmb nins yãmb sẽn yãtã la b ka yãnd ye. B rag n dat n wʋma bũmb nins yãmb sẽn wʋmdã la b ka wʋm ye.»
La gese, tõog karen-saamb a yembr yikame n na n mak a Zeezi n yeele: «Karen-saamba, bõe la mam tog n maan n paam vɩɩm sẽn kõn sa wã tɩ yɩ m pʋɩɩre?»
A Zeezi sok-a lame: «Bõe la b gʋls tõodã sebrã pʋgẽ, bõe la fo karemd be?»
A leokame n yeele: «Nong Zu-soabã fo Wẽnnaamã ne f sũur fãa, ne f yalẽ fãa la ne f pãngã fãa, la f yamã fãa, la f nong f to wa f menga.»
A Zeezi leok-a lame yaa: «Fo leokrã yaa sõama. Maan a woto, tɩ f na vɩɩmde.»
La yẽnda sẽn dat n wilg t'a yaa tɩrga, a soka a Zeezi yaa: «Ãnda la mam to?»
Dẽ, a Zeezi leb n gomame n yeele: Dao n dag n yi Zeruzalɛm n dabd Zeriko. A tɩ lʋɩɩ fãadb sʋka, tɩ b rees a sẽn tarã, n pãb-a hal t'a kolg kũum, tɩ b bas-a n looge.
Mikame tɩ maan-kʋʋd n dag n dɩk so-kãnga. A yãnda raoã, la a gilg n loog n bas-a lame.
Woto me, Leevi ned a yembr taa zĩ-kãngã. A yãnda raoã, la a gilg n loog n bas-a lame.
La Samaari ned a yembr sẽn dag n togd sor taa raoã sɛɛgẽ n yãnd-a, t'a nimbãaneg yõk-a.
A kolga raoã, n tɩbs a noadã ne kaam la reezẽ rãam, la a vil-b ne pɛɛla. Rẽ sẽn sa, a rɩk-a lame n zombg a meng bõn-zoambdga, n tall-a n kẽng sik zĩigẽ n tɩ ges a yelle.
Vẽkembeoogo, a yãka deniye a yiib n kɩs sik zĩigã soab n yeel-a t'a yõdg n ges bãadã yelle, la t'a ligd sã n kẽ, a lebgre a meng na lebs-a.
Bãmb b tãabã sʋka, bʋg n wẽnda a yaa ned ning sẽn lʋɩ-a fãadbã sʋkã to?
Tõog karen-saambã leokame tɩ yaa ned ning sẽn zoe-a yẽnda nimbãanegã. La a Zeezi yeel-a lame t'a me kẽng n tɩ maan a woto.
A Zeezi sẽn kẽnd ne b karen-biisã, b taa tẽng a yembre, la pag sẽn boond t'a Mart sika bãmb a yiri.
A dag n tara ma-bi-poak sẽn boond t'a Maari. La a Maari zĩnda Zu-soabã sɛɛgẽ n kelgd bãmb goamã.
Rɩɩbã seglg yɛl toay-toayã dag n sooga a Mart tagsgã. A waame n yeel yaa: Zu-soaba, mam ma-bi-poakã sẽn bas maam m yembr tɩ m get seglgã yellã ka namsd yãmba? Dẽ wã yaa, yeel-y-yã-a t'a sõng-ma.
Zu-soabã yeela a Mart yaa: Marte! Marte! Fo maanda yɩɩre, n sidgd ne bũmb wʋsgo.
Bũmb a yembr tãa n yaa tɩlɛ. A Maari yãka pʋɩ-sõng b sẽn kõn deeg n bas-a ye.
Daar a yembre, a Zeezi da bee zĩig a ye n pʋʋsdẽ. Bãmb sẽn pʋʋs n sɛ, b karen-biig a yembr yeela bãmb yaa: Zu-soaba, zãms-y tõnd pʋʋsgo, wa a Zã sẽn zãms b karen-biisã.
A Zeezi yeela bãmb yaa: Yãmb sã n pʋʋsdẽ, bɩ y yeele: Tõnd ba! Bɩ yãmb yʋʋrã yɩ ne waoogre, tɩ yãmb soolmã wa.
Kõ-y tõnd d daar o daar dɩɩbã daar fãa.
Kõ-y tõnd d beegrã sugri, tɩ tõnd me kõta neb nins fãa sẽn beegd tõndã sugri, la y ra bas tõnd tɩ d kẽ makr pʋgẽ ye.
A Zeezi leb n yeela bãmb a woto: Ãnda yãmb sʋkã n na n tar a zoa, t'a wa a nengẽ yʋn-sʋka, n yeel-a tɩ «m zoa, peng-m bur a tãab
tɩ m zoa n yi sor n wa n sig-m tɩ m ka tar bũmb sẽn na kõ-a t'a rɩ ye.»
A zoa wã sã n pa pʋgẽ n leok-a n yeele: «Ra nams maam tɩ rignoorã zoe n pagame, maam ne m kambã zoee n kẽe gãaga, mam ka leb n tõe n yik n kõ foom bur ye.»
Mam yeta yãmb tɩ baa a sã n ka na n yik n kõ-a burã, a sẽn yaa yẽnda zoa wã yĩnga, a na yik n kõ-a bũmb nins fãa a sẽn datã, a pẽdgrã yĩnga.
La maam, mam yeta yãmb tɩ y kose la b na kõ yãmba, tɩ y bao la y na yã, tɩ y kabse, la b na pak tɩ y kẽ.
Bala, ned ning fãa sẽn kot deegdame. Ned ning sẽn baood yãtame, la b pakdame tɩ sẽn kabsd-a kẽ.
Yãmb sẽn yaa ba-rãmbã, ãndã yãmb sʋkã bi-ribl n na n kos-a bur t'a kõ-a kugri,
wall a kos-a zĩnf t'a kõ-a waaf tɩ ka zĩnfu, wall a kos-a gell t'a kõ-a nanga?
Sã n yaa tɩ yãmb sẽn yaa nin-wẽnsã miime tɩ kõ y kambã bõn-sõamyã, yãmb ba sẽn be arzãnã n mi n yɩɩda, n na n kõ neb nins sẽn kot bãmbã Sɩɩg-sõngo.
A Zeezi dag n digda zĩn sẽn yaa muka. Zĩnã sẽn yi, mukã gomame, la neb kʋʋngã yɛɛsame.
La neb kẽer yeelame tɩ yaa ne zĩn-dãmbã naab a Belzebull pãng la a Zeezi digd zĩn-dãmbã.
La neb kẽer sẽn dat n mak bãmbã kosa bãmb tɩ b wa ne bãnd sẽn yit arzãna.
La a Zeezi sẽn mi b tagsgã yeel-b lame yaa: soolem ning fãa neb sẽn welg taab n gõdg n zabd ne taaba, a na sãame, la rotã na n lʋɩt n yẽegda taaba.
La sã n yaa tɩ Sʋtãanã welgame n gõdg n zabd ne a menga, a soolmã na n yɩɩ a wãn n yalse? Bõe yĩnga, yãmb yetame tɩ yaa ne a Belzebull pãng la mam digd zĩn-dãmbã.
La sã n yaa tɩ mam digda zĩn-dãmbã ne a Belzebull pãnga, yaa ne ãnda soab pãng la yãmb kambã rigd-ba? Rẽndã n kɩt tɩ bãmb mensã na n yɩ yãmb bʋ-kaoodba.
La sã n yaa ne Wẽnnaam pãngã la mam digd zĩn-dãmbã, rẽnd Wẽnnaam soolem taa yãmb nengẽ.
Pãng soab sẽn raoolem a meng sõama sã n gũud a zaka, bũmb kõn sɩɩs a paoongã ye.
La ned pãng sẽn yɩɩd yẽnda sã n wa n tõog-a, a reegda a zab-teedã fãa a sẽn dag n teegã, la a wʋk a teedã n pʋɩ nebã.
Sẽn ka be-a ne maam kisa maam, la sẽn ka naagd-a maam n tigsdẽ sãeegdame.
Sɩɩg sẽn yaa rẽgd sã n yi n bas neda, a saagda zĩ-pɛɛlã n baood vʋʋsgo. La a sẽn ka yãt vʋʋsgã yĩnga, a yetame t'a na n lebg n leba a yir ning a sẽn dag n yi n basã.
La a sã n ta, a mikdame tɩ yirã pɩɩsame n maneg n nagse.
Dẽ, a kẽngdame n tɩ peeg sɩɩs a yopoe a taab sẽn yaa wẽns n yɩɩd yẽnda. B wat n kẽe be n zĩndi, la rao-kãng vɩɩmã lebgda wẽng n yɩɩd pipi wã.
A Zeezi sẽn gom a woto, pag n zĩnd nebã sʋk n zẽk a koɛɛg n yeel tɩ pag ning sẽn zã-a a Zeezi pʋgã, la a yẽsem bãmbã yaa ned sẽn tar barka.
La a Zeezi leokame n yeel tɩ yaa neb nins sẽn kelgd Wẽnnaam goamã n sakdẽ wã n tar barkã.
Nebã sẽn tigsd taab n lebgd kʋʋngã, a Zeezi yeelame yaa: Zamaan‑kãngã neb yaa nin-wẽnse. B baooda bãnde, la b kõn kõ bãmb bãnd a to tɩ ka a Zonaas rẽndã ye.
Bala, a wa a Zonaas sẽn yɩ bãnd Niniiv nebã yĩngã, Ninsaal Bi-riblã me na n yɩɩ bãnd zamaan‑kãngã nebã yĩnga.
Bʋʋdã wakate, rĩm-poak ning sẽn dag n yi wĩndg goabgã na n yikame n kao zamaan‑kãngã nebã bʋʋdo. Bala, a yii tẽngã satmẽ n na n wa n kelg a Salmo yam goamã. La gese, sẽn be-a ka wã yɩɩda a Salmo.
Bʋʋdã wakate, Niniiv nebã na n yika ne zamaan‑kãngã nebã n kao b bʋʋdo. Bala, a Zonaas sẽn moon bãmb koɛɛgã, b kosa sugri. La gese, sẽn be-a ka wã yɩɩda a Zonaase.
Ned kõn yõgen fɩtl n bao zĩig n solg-a, wall a fõgen-a ne peoog ye. Ayo! A dogend-a-la fɩtl doagendg zugu, tɩ neb nins sẽn kẽedã na yã vẽenem.
Fo nifã yaa f yĩngã fɩtla. Fo nif sã n yaa sõama, fo yĩngã tõr tara vẽenem. La a sã n ka sõama, fo yĩngã tõr me bee lik pʋgẽ.
Gũus f menga, tɩ vẽenem ning sẽn be fo pʋgẽ wã da wa n lebg lik ye.
Dẽ, fo yĩngã tõr sã n tar vẽenem, tɩ lik baa bilf ka be zĩig baa a ye, a na n paama vẽenem sõama wa wakat ning fɩtl sẽn yãgd ne a pãngã fãa n vẽnegd foomã.
A Zeezi sẽn gomdã, Fariizẽ a yembr bõosa bãmb tɩ b wa n dɩ ne yẽnda. A Zeezi kẽeme n zĩnd n na n dɩ.
Fariizẽ wã sẽn yã t'a Zeezi ka waas n yaool n na n dɩ wã, ling-a lame.
La Zu-soabã yeel-a lame yaa: Yãmb Fariizẽ-dãmbã, yãmb nedgda wamã ne laasã poaya, la yãmb pʋsã pida ne fãab la wẽnga.
Ka-yam-dãmba, ka sẽn maan-a yɩngã n maan pʋgẽ wã me la?
Kõ-y naong rãmbã ne y sũyã fãa, la bũmbã fãa na n yɩɩ yolgemd yãmb yĩnga.

Yãmb Fariizẽ-dãmbã na n paama toogo! Bala, yãmb yaooda mant ne ru la zẽ-vãad buudã fãa piig pʋɩyã, n yaool n basd tɩrlem la Wẽnnaam nonglem. Yaool n yaa bõn-kãensã la yãmb tog n maane, la y ra bas sẽn ketã me ye.
Yãmb Fariizẽ-dãmbã, y na paam toogo! Bala, yãmb nonga pipi zaoog karen-dotẽ wã, la y nong nebã sẽn pʋʋsd yãmb daasẽ wã.
Yãmb na paam toogo! Bala, yãmb yaa wa yaado, bũmb sẽn ka wilgd b zĩiga, tɩ neb tabd n ka miẽ ye.
Tõog karen-saamb a yembr goma ne bãmb n yeele: Karen-saamba, yãmb sẽn gomd a woto wã, yãmb paoogda tõnd me.
A Zeezi leokame n yeele: Yãmb tõog karen-saam-dãmbã me na n paama toogo! Bala, yãmb dɩkda zɩɩbo, a tʋkr sẽn yaa toog n tʋkd nebã, tɩ yãmb mensã yaool n ka sɩɩsd-b ne y nug-bil ye.
Yãmb na paam toogo! Bala, yãmb meta Wẽnnaam no-rɛɛsdbã yaado, tɩ yaool n yaa yãmb ba-rãmbã n kʋ-ba.
Woto, yãmb yaa kaset rãmba, la y wilgdame tɩ yãmb saka y ba-rãmbã sẽn tʋmã. Bãmb n kʋ Wẽnnaam no-rɛɛsdbã, tɩ yãmb met b yaadã.
Yaa rẽndã n kɩt tɩ Wẽnnaam yamã yetẽ yaa: Mam na n tʋma no-rɛɛsdb la tẽn-tʋmdb b nengẽ. Bãmb na n kʋʋ kẽere, la b nams kẽere,
tɩ m tõe n sok zamaan‑kãngã nebã m no-rɛɛsdb nins fãa b sẽn kʋ hal dũni sɩngr tɩ ta moasã wã zɩɩm,
sẽn sɩng ne a Abɛll zɩɩm tɩ ta a Zakari b sẽn kʋ tẽn-kugrã ne wẽnd doogã sʋkã zɩɩm. N-yẽe! Mam yeta yãmb tɩ b na n soka zamaan‑kãngã nebã bõn-kãnga.
Yãmb tõog karen-saam-dãmbã, yãmb na paam toogo! Bala, yãmb feooga bãngr kʋɩlen-bilã. Yãmb mens ka rat n kẽ ye, la y gɩdgda neb nins sẽn dat n kẽ wã tɩ b ka tõe n kẽ ye.
Bãmb sẽn yi be, tõog karen-saam-dãmbã ne Fariizẽ-dãmbã pẽdga bãmb wʋsgo, n sogs-b tɩ b gom bũmb wʋsg yelle,
n bẽt bãmba, n dat n paam gomd sẽn yi bãmb noorẽ n yõk-ba.
Wakat-kãnga, neb tus‑tusa tigma taaba, n sẽbg taaba, tɩ yaa wa b na n fẽda taaba. A Zeezi deng n goma ne b karen-biisã n yeel-b yaa: Gũus-y y mens ne Fariizẽ-dãmbã rã-bɩllã sẽn yaa zãmbã.
Bũmb ka be sẽn ludi, sẽn kõn puk ye. La bũmb ka be sẽn solge, b sẽn kõn bãng ye.
Yaa woto yĩng tɩ bũmb ning fãa yãmb sẽn na gom lik bida pʋgẽ, b na n wʋm-a-la vẽenemẽ. La bũmb nins yãmb sẽn na n walem tʋbẽ, rot pʋsẽ, b na n moon-b-la rot zutu.
M zo-rãmba, mam yeta yãmb tɩ y ra zoe neb nins sẽn kʋʋd yĩngã n yaool n ka tõe n maan bũmb a to n paasã ye.
Mam na n wilga yãmb y sẽn tog n zoe a soaba. Zoe-y soab ning sẽn tõe n kʋ, la b tõe n kẽes bug-tẽngẽ me wã. N-yẽe! Mam yeta yãmb tɩ yaa soab‑kãng la yãmb tog n zoe.
B ka koosd yirs a nu su a yiib sɩda? Baoosgo, Wẽnnaam ka yĩmd b baa a yembr yell ye.
Baa yãmb zugã zoobd fãa sõdame. Dẽ yĩngã, bɩ y ra zoe rabeem ye. Yãmb bee yõod n yɩɩd yirs wʋsgo.
Mam yeta yãmb tɩ ned ning fãa sẽn na n kɩs kaset nebã taoor t'a yaa mam neda, Ninsaal Bi-riblã me na n kɩsa kaset Wẽnnaam malegsã taoor tɩ soab‑kãng yaa bãmb neda.
La ned ning fãa sẽn na n kɩɩs nebã taoor t'a ka mi maam, Ninsaal Bi-riblã me na n kɩɩsa Wẽnnaam malegsã taoor tɩ bãmb ka mi-a ye.
Ned ning fãa sẽn gomã Ninsaal Bi-riblã wẽng tõe n paama sugri. La ned ning sẽn na n paoog-a Sɩɩg-sõng kõn tol n paam sugr ye.
B sã n tall yãmb n kẽng karen-dotẽ wall bʋ-kaoodbã la pãn-soaadbã taoore, bɩ y da maan yɩɩr ne yãmb sẽn na n gom to-to n yiis y menga, wall y sẽn na n yet tɩ bũmb ning ye.
Bala, wakat-kãng bala, Sɩɩg-sõng na n wilga yãmb bũmb ning y sẽn tog n yeelã.
Ned a yembr zĩnda kʋʋngã sʋk n yeel a Zeezi yaa: Karen-saamba, yeel-y m ba-biigã t'a pʋɩ tõnd dogem pʋɩɩrã n yãk m dẽnd n kõ-ma.
A Zeezi leok-a lame yaa: Daoa, ãndã n yãk maam tɩ m yɩ yãmb bʋ-kaooda, wall y te-pʋɩta?
Dẽ, a Zeezi yeela nebã yaa: Gũus-y y mens ne rat wʋsgã. Bala, hal baa naar pʋgẽ, ninsaal vɩɩmã ka tũud ne bũmb nins a sẽn tarã ye.
La a Zeezi wẽe bãmb yel-bũnd n yeele: Arzɛk soab a yembr pʋt n dag n sak sõama.
La a da tagsda a sũurẽ n yetẽ yaa: Mam na n maana a wãna? Bala, mam ka tar zĩig n na n bĩng m koodã ye.
A yeelame yaa: «Ad bũmb ning mam sẽn na n maane: Mam na n wãa m baoã n lebs n me sẽn yaa bɛd n yɩɩda, n bĩng m koodã fãa ne m teedã be.
La mam a n yeela m meng yaa: Fo tara paoong wʋsg sẽn sekd yʋʋm wʋsg yĩnga. Bɩ f vʋʋse, n dɩ la f yũ, la f maan sũ-noogo.»
La Wẽnnaam yeela yẽnda yaa: «Yalma! Yʋn-kãngã bala, mam na n deega fo vɩɩmã. La bũmb nins fo sẽn seglã na n yɩɩ ãnda rẽnda?»
Yaa a woto ne ned ning fãa sẽn tigsd paoong a meng yĩnga, n yaool n ka tar Wẽnnaam arzegsã.
Dẽ poore, a Zeezi yeela b karen-biisã yaa: Yaa woto yĩng tɩ mam yet yãmb tɩ y ra maan yɩɩr ne y vɩɩmã yelle, yãmb sẽn na n dɩ bũmb ninga, wall ne y yĩngã yelle, y sẽn na n yeelg bũmb ning ye.
Bala, vɩɩm yɩɩda rɩɩbo, la yĩng yɩɩda futu.
Ges-y gãabdã! B ka bʋta, b ka tigsda, b ka tar pilgu, wall baoor ye. La Wẽnnaam rɩlgd-b lame. Yãmb ka be yõod n yɩɩd bõn-yɩgdɩ wã sɩda?
Ãndã yãmb sʋkã n tõe n paas a vɩɩmã woglem kãntɩɩg a yembre, a sẽn maand yɩɩr yĩnga?
Dẽ, yãmb sã n ka tõe n maan bũmb sẽn yaa bilf n yɩɩda, bõe yĩng tɩ yãmb maand yɩɩr ne bũmb nins sẽn ketã?
Ges-y rulg-lɛlem sẽn bɩt to-to. B ka tʋmda, la b ka wĩid lamdo. Baoosgo, mam yeta yãmb t'a Salmo mengã ne a naamã fãa ka tõog n maneg a meng ne fut n yɩ neer wa rulg-lelemd a yembr ye.
Yãmb tẽeb bilf rãmba, sã n yaa tɩ Wẽnnaam nagsa mood sẽn be weoogẽ rũndã, tɩ b na n tugl-b bugum beoogã a woto, bãmb kõn ges yãmb fut yell n yɩɩda?
Dẽ wã, bɩ y da nams y mens n baood y sẽn na n dɩ bũmb ninga, wall y sẽn na n yũ bũmb ning ye.
Bala, yaa dũni neb nins sẽn ka pʋʋsd Wẽnnaamã n baood bõn-kãense. Yãmb ba wã miime tɩ yãmb dat-b lame.
Bas-y rẽ la y bao Wẽnnaam soolmã, la b na n kõo yãmb bõn-kãensã n paase.
Mam piisi, da zoe-y dabeem ye. Bala, a taa yãmb ba wã yam tɩ b kõ yãmb b soolmã.
Koos-y yãmb sẽn tarã n dɩk a ligdã n kõ naong rãmba. Bao-y kord sẽn ka sãamda, la paoong sẽn ka sɛt arzãn pʋga, zĩig ning wagdr sẽn ka kolgdã, la mogd sẽn ka sãamda.
Bala, yãmb paoong sẽn beẽ wã, yãmb sũurã me na n zĩnda be.
Bɩ y sẽb y sees sẽbdse, la y yõgen y fɩtl-dãmba,
la y yɩ wa neb sẽn gũud tɩ b zu-soab yi pʋg-peegr tigr n lebg n wa, t'a sã n ta bal n wẽ bɩ b pak t'a kẽ.
Bark bee tʋmtʋmd kãens zutu, b zu-soabã sẽn na n wa n ta n mik tɩ b neeme. Mam yeta yãmb sɩd-sɩd tɩ b zu-soabã na n sẽba a sẽbdga, n kɩt tɩ b zĩnd rɩɩb zĩigẽ, t'a wa n kõ-b rɩɩbo.
Yẽnda wat yʋn-sʋk tɩ yaa no-kɛlenga, a sã n wa n mik tɩ b ka gõe, b sũur na yɩ noogo.
Bãng-y neer tɩ roog soab sã n dag n miẽ wakat ning wagdr sẽn na n wa, a rag n na n neendame n ka bas t'a poog a roogã ye.
Bɩ yãmb me segl n sɛ. Bala, Ninsaal Bi-riblã na n waa wakat ning yãmb sẽn ka tagsd tɩ b na n waame wã.
Dẽ, a Pɩyɛɛr soka a Zeezi yaa: Zu-soaba, yaa tõnd bal la yãmb wẽ yel-bũn‑kãngã bɩ, bɩ yaa nebã fãa?
T'a Zeezi leok yaa: Dẽ, ãndã n yaa tʋmtʋmd sẽn maand sɩda la a tar yam, t'a zu-soabã yeel-a t'a ges a tʋmtʋmdbã yelle, n kõt-b rɩɩb wakat fãa sẽn zemse?
Tʋmtʋmd‑kãng zu-soabã sã n wa n mik t'a maanda a woto, tʋmtʋmdã sũur na yɩ noogo.
Mam yeta yãmb sɩd-sɩd t'a zu-soabã na n kɩtame tɩ yẽnda ges a arzegsã fãa yelle.
La tʋmtʋmd‑kãng sã n yeel a sũurẽ t'a zu-soabã kaoosda waoongo, n sɩng n pãbd tʋmtʋmd daopã la tʋmtʋmd‑pogsã, n dɩtẽ la a yũud n gãeemdẽ,
tʋmtʋmd‑kãng zu-soabã na n waa daar ning yẽnda sẽn ka gũud-a, la wakat ning a sẽn ka mi. A zu-soabã na n sɩbga yẽnda sõama, n kɩt tɩ bũmb nins sẽn paamd neb nins sẽn ka maand sɩdã paam yẽnda me.
Tʋmtʋmd ning sẽn mi‑a a zu-soab raabo, n yaool n ka segl bũmbu, la a ka maan a zu-soabã sẽn datã, b na n pãb-a la wʋsgo.

La ned ning sẽn ka mi‑a zu-soabã raabo, n maan tʋʋmd sẽn tog ne sɩbgre, b na n pãba yẽnda bilfu. B sã n kõ ned bũmb wʋsgo, b na n sok-a-la bũmb wʋsgo. La b sã n gũnug ned bũmb wʋsgo, b na n sok-a-la wʋsg n yɩɩda.
Mam waame n na n lob bugum dũni zugu. La mam nonga a sã n dag n zoe n widgẽ!
La lisg n be mam sẽn tog n deege, la a yellã na n namsa maam hal t'a wa n pidsi.
Yãmb tẽedame tɩ mam waame tɩ laafɩ na zĩnd tẽng zugu? Mam yeta yãmb tɩ ayo. La yaa tɩ welgr na zĩndi.
Bala, sẽn sɩng ne moasã, neb a nu sẽn be zak a yembr pʋg na n welga taaba, tɩ tãabã kɩɩs yiibã, tɩ yiibã kɩɩs tãabã.
Ba na n welga ne a bi-ribla, tɩ bi-ribl welg ne a ba. Ma na n welga ne a bi-pugla, tɩ bi-pugl welg ne a ma. Sɩd‑ma na n welga ne a bi-paga, tɩ bi-pag welg ne a sɩd‑ma.
A Zeezi leb n yeela neb kʋʋngã yaa: Yãmb sã n yãnd sawadg sẽn yikd nin-taoore, tao-tao bala, yãmb yetame tɩ saagã na n niime, la a yɩta a woto.
La yãmb sã n yãnd tɩ sobg yita wĩndg goabga, yãmb yetame tɩ zĩigã na n yɩɩ tʋʋlgo, la a yɩta a woto.
Zãmb-dãmba, yãmb mii tẽng yɛla, la yĩngr yɛl sẽn yaa to-to. Bõe tɩ yãmb ka mi moasã wakatã yɛl n welge?
La yaa bõe tɩ yãmb ka tõe n bãng sẽn yaa tɩrg y toor n bake?

Fo sã n dabd bʋʋd zĩigẽ ne f zabd-n-taaga, bɩ f modg n maneg f yellã ne-a, yãmb sẽn ket sorã zug wakate, tɩ yẽnda ra wa tall foom n kẽng bʋ-kaoodbã taoore, tɩ bʋ-kaoodbã yõk foom n kõ bi-bees roog gũud t'a kẽes-f bi-bees roog ye.
Mam yet-f lame tɩ fo kõn yi be hal tɩ f yao a samdã yaoolem lagf ye.
Wakat-kãnga, neb kẽer waa n togsa a Zeezi bũmb ning sẽn maan Galɩle nebã, a Pilat sẽn daag b zɩɩm n kalem ne b maandã zɩɩmã.
A Zeezi leoka bãmb n yeele: «Yãmb tẽedame tɩ Galɩle nin-kãens sẽn nams a woto wã, b yaa yel-wẽn maandb n yɩɩd Galɩle neb a taabã la?
Ayo! Mam yeta yãmb tɩ ayo. Yãmb sã n ka tek yam n kos sugri, yãmb fãa na n sãama a woto me.
Wall neb piig la a nii Siloe gãosgã sẽn lʋɩ n bʋʋg-b n kʋ-bã, yãmb tagsdame tɩ bãmb yaa bɛɛgdb n yɩɩd Zeruzalɛm neb a taabã la?
Ayo! Mam yeta yãmb tɩ ayo. Yãmb sã n ka tek yam n kos sugri, yãmb fãa me na n sãama a woto.»
A Zeezi wẽe yel-bũn‑kãngã me: Ned n dag n tar kankang sẽn sel a reezẽ tɩɩs pʋʋgẽ. A waame n na n yãgs biisi, la a ka yã ye.
Dẽ, a yeela pʋʋgã koaad yaa: «Yʋʋm a tãab moasã la mam wat n dat kankangã biisi, la m ka yãt ye. Keeg-a! Bõe yĩng t'a yãmb zĩigã zaalem?»
Reezẽ tɩɩs pʋʋgã koaad leokame n yeele: «M soaala, leb n bas-y-yã-a roandã yɛsa. Ka ne rẽ, mam na n tuume n gilg-a la m ning-a birga.
Daar ninga, a na wom biisi. La a sã n ka wome, bɩ y keeg-a.»
Zʋɩf-rãmbã vʋʋsg daar a yembre, a Zeezi dag n zãmsda neb karen-doog a yembr pʋgẽ.
La pag a yembr n dag n be be, tɩ zĩn kɩt t'a lebg koams hal yʋʋm piig la a nii. A dag n zõrame n ka tõe n doog baa bilf ye.
A Zeezi yãnd-a lame n gom ne-a n yeele: Paga, fo paama yolsg ne f komsmã.
Bãmb tika yẽnda ne b nusi. Wakat-kãng bala, a roogame n kõ Wẽnnaam waoogre.

La karen-doogã naab sũur sãama ne a Zeezi sẽn maan bõn-bãnd vʋʋsg daarã, la a yeela nebã yaa: Dasem a yoob n be tʋʋm yĩnga. Wa-y da-kãens tɩ b maag-yã, tɩ da yɩt tõnd vʋʋsg daarã ye. Zu-soabã leok-a lame n yeele:
Zãmb rãmba, yãmb ned kam fãa ka lokd a naaf a rɩɩb koglgẽ n tall n tɩ yũnug vʋʋsg daarã sɩda?
La pʋg‑kãngã sẽn yaa a Abrahaam bi-pugla, t'a Sʋtãan loe-a hal yʋʋm piig la a nii wã, d ka tog n lok-a vʋʋsg daare?
A Zeezi sẽn gom a woto, yãnd yõka b bɛɛbã fãa, la neb kʋʋngã maanda sũ-noog bũmb nins fãa a Zeezi sẽn maan tɩ be ziirã yĩnga.
A Zeezi leb n yeelame yaa: Wẽnnaam soolmã wẽnda bõe, la m na n mams-a-la ne bõe?
A wẽnda wa siin-bil ned sẽn dɩk n lob a zẽed zĩigẽ. A yitame n lebg tɩɩga, la yĩngr liuuli vɩɩ a wilẽ wã.
B leb n yeelame: Mam na n mamsa Wẽnnaam soolmã ne bõe?
A wẽnda rã-bɩll pag sẽn dɩk n ning zom wam a tãabo, hal tɩ zom-nagdgã fãa wuki.
A Zeezi da pɩʋʋgda tẽn-bɛd la tẽn-bãoonego, n zãmsd nebã la b dabd Zeruzalɛm.
