Ned n sok bãmb yaa: Zu-soaba, yaa neb bilf bal n na n paam fãagre? A Zeezi leoka bãmb n yeele:
Nang-y pãng n tũ digno-sẽkã n kẽ. Bala, mam yeta yãmb tɩ neb wʋsg na n baoome tɩ kẽ la b ka na n tõog ye.
Yirã soab sã n yik n pag rignoorã, tɩ yãmb pa yɩng n sɩng n kabsdẽ, la y yet Zu-soabã tɩ b pak tɩ y kẽ, b na n leoka yãmb tɩ b ka mi yãmb sẽn yitẽ ye.
Dẽ, yãmb na n sɩngame n yeele: «Tõnd dɩɩ ne yãmba, la d yũ ne yãmba, la yãmb zãmsa neb tõnd soayã zutu.»
La b na n leoka yãmb n yeele: «Mam ka mi yãmb sẽn yitẽ ye. Zãag-y ne maam, yãmb fãa sẽn tʋmd ka-tɩrlem tʋʋmã.»
Yãmb sã n yãnd a Abrahaam, la a Izake, la a Zakoob ne Wẽnnaam no-rɛɛsdbã fãa Wẽnnaam soolmã pʋgẽ, tɩ b yaool n lob yãmb yɩnga, nintãm ne yẽn wãbr na zĩnd be.
Neb na n yii yaang la taoore, dɩtg la goabga, n zĩnd n dɩ Wẽnnaam soolmã pʋgẽ.
La gese, poorẽ dãmb n be n na n yɩ dẽenem dãmba, tɩ dẽenem dãmb me na n yɩ poorẽ dãmba.
Wakat-kãnga, Fariizẽ-dãmbã kẽer waa n yeela a Zeezi yaa: Kẽng n looge! Yi ka, bala, a Erood dat n kʋʋ foom.
A Zeezi yeela bãmb yaa: Kẽng n tɩ yeel-y sɩlem‑soabã tɩ mam digda zĩn-dãmba, la m maagd bãad-dãmb rũndã la beoogo. La ra-yɩt na n yɩɩ baoosg daar ne maam.
La yaa tɩlɛ tɩ mam kẽn dũndã, la beoogo, la ra‑yɩta. Bala, a ka zems tɩ Wẽnnaam no-rɛɛs ki zĩig a to tɩ ka Zeruzalɛm ye.

Zeruzalɛm! Zeruzalɛm! Fo sẽn kʋʋd Wẽnnaam no-rɛɛsdba, la f lobd neb nins Wẽnnaam sẽn tʋm fo nengẽ wã kugã, naoor a wãn la mam dag n tʋlg n tigs fo kambã wa no-yãang sẽn põgended a kamb a pɩgsẽ? La yãmb ka tʋlg ye.
Gese, b na n basa yãmb ne y roogã. La mam yeta yãmb tɩ yãmb ka na n leb n yãnd maam yɛsa, hal tɩ ta daar ning yãmb sẽn na n yeel tɩ: «Bark bee ned ning sẽn wat ne Zu-soabã yʋʋrã zugu.»
Daar a yembre, a Zeezi kẽe Fariizẽ-dãmbã naab a yembr zakẽ n na n dɩ, la Fariizẽ-dãmbã dag n gũusda bãmba.
La ade, rao a ye bã-moatg sẽn tar n dag n be bãmb taoore.
A Zeezi goma ne tõog karen-saam-dãmbã la Fariizẽ-dãmbã n yeele: Dẽ yĩnga, noor beeme tɩ maag ned vʋʋsg daare?
Bãmb kell n sĩndame. Dẽ, a Zeezi peega bãadã, n maag-a, la b kuils-a.
La a Zeezi yeel-b lame yaa: Ãnda yãmb sʋkã bi-ribl bɩ a naaf n na n lʋɩ bulgẽ vʋʋsg daar t'a ka yiis-a tao-tao?
La b ka tõog n leok gom‑kãng ye.
Rẽ poore, a Zeezi goma ne neb nins b sẽn bool rɩɩbã yĩngã n wẽ-b yel-bũndi. Bala, bãmb yãame tɩ nin-kãens baooda naam zĩndg zĩisi. B yeel-b lame yaa:
Ned sã n bool foom yi-kãadem tigrẽ, bɩ f ra tɩ zĩnd naam zĩndg zĩigẽ ye. Bala, tõeeme t'a boola ned sẽn yɩɩd foom.
Sã n yɩ a woto, sẽn bool-a foom ne yẽnda wã na n waa n yeela foom tɩ f yik n bas zĩig n kõ-a, fo na n yaool n tɩ zĩnda poorẽ zaoogã zugu, la f na n yãnda yãnde.

B sã n bool foom, kẽng n tɩ zĩnd poorẽ zaoogã zugu, tɩ ned ning sẽn bool-a foomã sã n wa bɩ a yeel foom yaa: «M zoa, wa taoor ka!» Woto na n yɩɩ fo waoogr neb nins fãa sẽn zĩ ne foom n dɩtẽ wã taoore.
Sɩd me, b na n sika ned ning fãa sẽn zẽkd a menga, la b na n zẽka ned ning fãa sẽn sikd a menga.

La a Zeezi yeela ned ning sẽn bool-a bãmb tɩ b wa n dɩ wã yaa: Fo sã n na n bool neb tɩ b wa n dɩ ne foom, tɩ yaa wĩntoog bɩ yʋngo, da bool f zo-rãmba, wall f ba-biisi, wall f buudu, wall f yags nins sẽn yaa arzegs rãmbã, tɩ bãmb me da wa n bool foom ye. Rẽ na n yɩɩ lebsgo.
Fo sã n na n bool neb tɩ b wa n dɩ ne foom, bool naong rãmba, la koms-rãmba, la wobse, la zoense,
la fo na n paama sũ-noogo, b sẽn ka tar n na n kõ foom n lebsã yĩnga. Bala, nin-tɩrsã vʋʋgr wakate, fo na n paama keoore.
Neb nins sẽn dag n zĩ n dɩtẽ wã sẽn wʋm a Zeezi gom kãensã, b ned a yembr yeelame yaa: Bark bee ned ning sẽn na n naag-a n dɩ Wẽnnaam soolmẽ wã zugu!
La a Zeezi leoka yẽnda n yeele: Dao a yembr n dag n segl rɩɩb n bool neb wʋsg tɩ b wa rɩ.
Dɩɩbã wakate, a tʋma a tʋmtʋmd t'a tɩ yeel neb nins a sẽn boolã tɩ b wa tɩ bũmbã fãa zoe n segl n sɛɛme.
La bãmb ned kam fãa sɩng n padmame. Pipi soabã yeelame tɩ yẽnda raa pʋʋgo, la yaa tɩlɛ tɩ yẽnda kẽng n tɩ gese, la a kotame tɩ b bas-a taale.
A to yeelame tɩ yẽnda raa nag-koods piiga, la yẽnda na n mak-b lame n gese, la a kotame tɩ b bas-a taale.
Ned a to yeelame tɩ yẽnda nan peega a pʋg-paala, la rẽ n kɩt tɩ yẽnda ka na n tõog n wa ye.
Tʋmtʋmdã lebgame n tɩ togs a soaalã bõn-kãense. A soaalã sũur yĩigame t'a yeel a tʋmtʋmdã t'a kẽng raasẽ wã, la tẽngã soayã zut tao-tao, n wa ne naong rãmba, la koms-rãmba, la zoense, la wobsã be.
Tʋmtʋmdã yeelame tɩ yẽnda maana a soaalã sẽn yeelã, la vɩʋʋg ket n beeme.
La soaalã yeela tʋmtʋmdã yaa: Rɩk soayã, la f yeg yãgã n modg nebã tɩ b wa kẽ hal tɩ mam yirã pid ne nebã.
Bala, mam yeta yãmb tɩ neb nins mam sẽn dag n boolã, bãmb ned baa a yembr kõn lemb mam dɩɩbã ye.
Neb kʋʋng wʋsg dag n tũuda a Zeezi sorã zugu. A Zeezi wẽnemdame n yeel-b yaa:
Ned sã n wat mam nengẽ, n ka kis a ba la a ma, la a paga, la a kamba, la a ba-bi-raopa, la a ba-bi-pogse, la baa ne a mengã vɩɩm, a ka tõe n yɩ mam karen-biig ye.
La ned ning fãa sẽn kõn dɩk a da-pɩk n tũ maam, ka tõe n yɩ mam karen-biig ye.
Bala, ãndã n be yãmb sʋkã n dat n me gãosgo, n ka reng n zĩnd n geel ligd ning fãa a sẽn tog n yiis tʋʋmdã yĩnga, n bãng a sã n tara sẽn sek tɩ me-a n sa?
Sã n ka rẽ, a sã n yẽbg roogã n sa, n yaool n ka tõe n baas-a, neb nins fãa sẽn na n yãnd‑a wã na n yaala yẽnda n yeele:
Rao‑kãngã sɩnga gãosg meeb la a ka tõog n baas ye.
Wall rĩm bʋg n be n dat n tɩ zab ne rĩm a to, n ka reng n zĩnd n mag n gese, yẽnda ne a nebã tus piigã sã n tara pãn-tõog tɩ kẽng n seg rĩm a to wã sẽn wat ne neb tus pisi wã?
Rĩm a to wã sẽn ket n be yɩɩga, a na n tʋma neb a nengẽ tɩ b tɩ yẽs laafɩ yẽsg ne-a.
Woto me, yãmb ned ning fãa sẽn ka basd bũmb nins fãa a sẽn tarã ka tõe n yɩ mam karen-biig ye.
Yamsem yaa bõn-sõngo. La yamsem sã n lebg poada, bõe la b na n ning-a t'a leb n paam noosem?
A ka yõod tãnd yĩnga, wall birg yĩng ye. B lobd-a la yɩnga. Bɩ sẽn tar-a tʋb n wʋmdẽ wʋme!
Yaood-dɛɛgdbã fãa ne yel-wẽn maandbã fãa kolga a Zeezi n na n kelg-ba.
La Fariizẽ-dãmbã la tõog karen-saam-dãmbã da yẽgemdame n yetẽ tɩ rao-kãngã reegda yel-wẽn maandba la b rɩt ne-ba.
La a Zeezi wẽe bãmb yel-bũn‑kãngã n yeele:
Nin-bʋg n be yãmb sʋkã n na n tar piis koabga, t'a yembr meneme, t'a ka bas pis-wɛ la a wɛ wã weoogẽ wã n kẽng n tɩ gẽes peosg ning sẽn menem-a wã hal n yãnd-a?
La yẽnda sã n yãnd-a, a na n palg-a-la a bãgdẽ ne sũ-noogo.
La yẽnda sã n lebg n ta yiri, a boonda a zo-rãmbã ne a yagsã a yir n yeel-b yaa: «Naag-y maam n maan sũ-noogo, bala, mam yãnda m peosgã sẽn dag n menemã.»
Woto me, mam yeta yãmb tɩ sũ-noog na n zĩnda arzãn pʋgẽ, yel-wẽn maand a yembr sẽn tek yam n kos sugr yĩnga, n yɩɩd nin-tɩrs pis-wɛ la a wɛ sẽn ka baood sugr kosgã yĩnga.
Walla, pʋg bʋg n na n tar ligd piiga, t'a yembr menem t'a ka yõgen fɩtla, n pɩɩs roogã la a gẽes-a neer hal n yãnd-a?
La a sã n yãnd-a, a boonda a zo-rãmbã ne a yagsã a yir n yeel-b yaa: Naag-y maam n maan sũ-noogo, bala, mam yãnda m lagfã sẽn dag n menemã.
Woto me, mam yeta yãmb tɩ yel-wẽn maand a yembr sã n tek yam n kos sugri, sũ-noog na n zĩnda Wẽnnaam malegsã sʋka.
A Zeezi leb n yeelame yaa: Rao n dag n tar kom-dibli a yiibu.
La yao wã yeela a ba wã yaa: «M ba, pʋɩ-y y paoongã n yãk m pʋɩɩr n kõ-ma.» La ba wã pʋɩ-b-la a paoongã.
Rasem bilf zugẽ, yao wã tigsa a sẽn da tarã fãa n kẽng tẽn-zãrgẽ, n tɩ sãam a paoongã be ne tʋʋm-dẽgd maanego.
La yẽnda sẽn sãam a paoongã fãa n sa, kom kãseng n kẽ tẽn-kãngã, la komã sɩngame n nams-a.
Yẽnda kẽng n tɩ noka tẽnga ned a yembre, t'a tʋm yẽnda a pʋtẽ t'a tɩ gũ kurkuyã.
Yẽnda dag n datẽ-la zãbnã kurkuyã sẽn da rɩtã n dɩ n pid a pʋga, la ned ka kõt yẽnda ye.
Yẽnda tagsa a sũurẽ n yeele: «M baaba tʋmtʋmdbã waooga, la b tara rɩɩb n dɩt n tɩgd n kelldẽ, tɩ kom kʋʋd maam ka.
Mam na n yikame n kẽng m baaba nengẽ n tɩ yeel-b yaa: M ba, mam beega Wẽnnaam la m beeg yãmba.
Mam ka leb n zems tɩ b bool maam tɩ yãmb biig ye. Ges-y maam wa yãmb tʋmtʋmd a yembre.»
La a yikame n kẽng a ba wã nengẽ. La yẽnda sẽn ket n be yɩɩga, a ba wã yãnd-a lame t'a nimbãanega yõk-a. A ba wã wudgame n tɩ mobg-a n mok-a.
Biigã yeela a ba wã yaa: «M ba, mam beega Wẽnnaam la m beeg yãmba. Mam ka leb n zems tɩ b bool maam tɩ y biig ye.»
La a ba wã yeela a tʋmtʋmdbã yaa: «Wa-y ne fuug ning sẽn yaa-a neer n yɩɩdã tao-tao n yeelg-a. Ning-y-yã-a nug-bilã nugbĩnga, la y wid-a neooda.
Wa-y ne nag-bi-noabdgã, n kʋ-a tɩ d rɩ la d maan sũ-noogo.
Bala, mam bi-ribl‑kãngã rag n kiime, la a leb n vʋʋgame. A rag n menemame, la d leb n yãnd-a lame.» La bãmb sɩngame n kɩdemdẽ.
La bi-ribl kãsengã rag n bee pʋtẽ. La yẽnda sẽn lebg n watẽ n kolg yiri, a wʋma yʋʋmb ne saoog rãamde.
Yẽnda boola tʋmtʋmd a yembr n sok-a bũmb ning sẽn maandã võore.
Tʋmtʋmdã yeela yẽnda yaa: «Yãmb yao wã lebg n waame, tɩ yãmb ba wã kʋ nag-bi-noabdgã, a sẽn lebg n wa ne laafɩ wã yĩnga.»
Yẽnda sũurã puugame t'a ka sak n na n kẽ ye. A baaba wã yiime n na n bool-a t'a wa n kẽ.
Dẽ, a leoka a ba wã yaa: «Ade, yaa yʋʋm wʋsg la mam tʋmd n kõt yãmba. Mam nan ka kɩɩs yãmb noor ye. La maam yẽ, yãmb zɩɩ n kõ maam baa bull tɩ m maan sũ-noog ne m zo-rãmb ye.
La yãmb bi-kãngã, sẽn sãam-a yãmb paoongã ne pʋg-yoaadbã sẽn lebg n wa wã, yãmb kʋʋ nag-bi-noabdgã n kõ-a.»
A ba wã yeel-a lame yaa: «M biiga, fo bee ne maam daar fãa, la bũmb nins fãa mam sẽn tarã yaa foom n so.
La a zemsame tɩ tõnd maan sũ-noog n kɩdem. Bala fo yao wã fo sẽn ne wã rag n kiime, la a leb n vʋʋgame. A rag n menemame, la m leb n yãnd-a lame.»
A Zeezi yeela b karen-biisã me yaa: Arzɛk soab a yembr n dag n be n tar a tʋʋm taoor soaba, la b togs-a lame t'a tʋmtʋmdã sãamda yẽnda paoongã.
Yẽnda boola tʋʋmã taoor soab n yeel-a yaa: «Bõe tɩ b gomd fo yell a woto tɩ mam wʋmdẽ? Wilg maam fo tʋʋmã sẽn yɩ to-to. Bala, fo ka na n leb n yɩ mam tʋʋmã taoor soab ye.»
Tʋʋmã taoor soab tagsa a sũurẽ n yeele: «Mam zu-soabã sẽn dat n yiis maam tʋʋmdẽ wã, mam na n maana bõe? Koobo? Mam ka tar pãng n na n ko ye, la bõsg yaa yãnd ne maam.
Mam mii m sẽn na n maanega, tɩ b sã n wa n yiis maam m tʋʋmdẽ wã, bɩ neb deeg maam b yiyã.»
Dẽ, yẽnda kɩtame tɩ b bool a zu-soaba sam-dãmbã yembr-yembre, n yeel pipi soabã yaa: «Fo tara mam zu-soaba samd wãna?»
T'a leok tɩ kaam rʋg-bɛd koabga. La a yeela yẽnda t'a reeg a sebrã n zĩnd tao-tao n gʋls tɩ pis-nu.
Yẽnda leb n soka a to yaa: «La fo yẽ samdã yaa wãna?» Tɩ yẽnda leok tɩ kood yond kobs-nu. La a yeela yẽnda t'a reeg a sebrã n gʋls tɩ kobs-naase.
La a zu-soaba pẽga a tʋʋmã taoor soab sẽn ka tɩrgã, a sẽn maan yamã yĩnga. Bala, dũni‑kãnga neb maanda yam ne taaba, n yɩɩd vẽenem kambã.
La mam yeta yãmb tɩ y rɩk dũni paoongã n bao zo-rãmba, tɩ paoongã sã n wa n sɛ n bas yãmba, bɩ Wẽnnaam reeg yãmb yiy sẽn paad wakat sẽn kõn sa wã pʋgẽ.
Ned ning sẽn maand sɩd bõn-bãooneg pʋse, a maanda sɩd bõn-kãsems pʋse. La ned ning sẽn ka maand sɩd bõn-bãooneg pʋs ka na n maan sɩd bõn-kãsems pʋs me ye.
Dẽ, yãmb sã n ka maan sɩd ne dũniyã arzegse, ãndã n na n dɩk paoong sɩd-sɩd n gũnug yãmba?
La yãmb sã n ka maan sɩd ne ned a to paoongo, ãndã n na n kõ yãmb y meng rẽnda?
Tʋmtʋmd baa a ye ka be n tõe n sak zu-soben-dãmb a yiib ye. Bala, yẽnda na n kisga a yembr la a nong a to wã, wall a waoog a yembr la a paoog a to wã. Yãmb ka tõe n sak Wẽnnaam la ligd me ye.
Fariizẽ-dãmbã sẽn da nong ligdã rag n kelgda bõn-kãensã fãa la b rag n yaanda a Zeezi.
A Zeezi yeel-b lame yaa: yãmb yaa neb sẽn wilgd nebã tɩ y yaa tɩrse. La Wẽnnaam mii yãmb sũyã. Bala, bũmb ning nebã sẽn pẽgd wʋsgã yaa bõn-wẽng Wẽnnaam nifẽ.
Hal tɩ ta a Zã wakate, dag n yaa tõogã ne no-rɛɛsdbã wakate. La sẽn sɩng ne a Zã wakatã, b moonda Wẽnnaam soolem koe-noogã, la ned kam fãa nangda pãng n dat n kẽ be.
Yĩngr la tẽng loogr yaa naana n yɩɩd tõogã kargr a yembr menengo.
Ned ning fãa sẽn dig a pag la a rɩk a to, maanda yoobo. La ned ning fãa sẽn dɩk pag a sɩd sẽn dig maanda yoobo.
Rao a ye n dag n be n yaa arzɛk soaba, n yeelgd fu-sõama sẽn yaa neeba. La daar fãa, a tara bũmb fãa tɩ seke, t'a vɩɩmã ya noog wʋsgo.
Naong soab a yembr sẽn boond t'a Lazaar dag n gãee arzɛk soabã zak noore. La a yĩngã fãa da pida ne noada.
A rag n nongẽ lame n paam rɩ-zeremsã sẽn yit arzɛk soaba taabl zug n lʋɩtẽ wã n dɩ. La sẽn paase, baasã wat n lelemda a noadã.
Naong soabã wa n kiime. La malegsã talla yẽnda n kẽng a Abrahaam nengẽ. La arzɛk soabã me wa n kiime, la b mum-a lame.
Kɩɩm-kulg pʋgẽ, yẽnda nak n gesame. La a namsgã pʋgẽ, a tool n yãnda a Abrahaam yɩɩga, t'a Lazaar be ne-a.
Yẽnda zẽka a koɛɛg n yeel: «M ba a Abrahaam! Zoe-y mam nimbãanega, n tʋm a Lazaar t'a tẽk a nug-bil koomẽ n wa n wʋlg m zelemdã. Bala, mam namsda wʋsg bug-kãngã pʋgẽ.»
A Abrahaam leoka yẽnda n yeele: «M biiga, bɩ f tẽeg tɩ fo paama arzegs f vɩɩmã wakate, la t'a Lazaar paama toodo. La moasã, yẽnda paamda belsg ka, tɩ fo be toog pʋgẽ.
La rẽ fãa sẽn yãk a toogo, bog-kãseng n be tõnd ne yãmb sʋka, sẽn na n yɩl tɩ neb nins sẽn dat n yi ka n wa yãmb nengẽ wã ra tõog ye, la tɩ sẽn be-b yãmb nengẽ wã me ra tõog n wa tõnd nengẽ ye.»
Arzɛk soabã yeelame yaa: «Sã n yaa a woto, m ba, mam kota yãmb tɩ y tʋm a Lazaar mam ba wã yiri.
Bala mam tara ba-bi-raop a nu. Bɩ a kẽng n tɩ kɩs bãmb kaset tɩ b ra wa n wa zĩ-kãngã sẽn yaa namsg zĩigã ye.»
A Abrahaam leokame tɩ b tara a Moyiis ne Wẽnnaam no-rɛɛsdbã, la b kelg bãmba.
La arzɛk soabã yeelame yaa: «Ayo, m ba a Abrahaam! La ned sẽn ki sã n vʋʋg n kẽng bãmb nengẽ, b na n teka yam n kos sugri.»
La Abrahaam leoka yẽnda yaa: «Bãmb sã n ka kelg a Moyiis ne Wẽnnaam no-rɛɛsdbã, baa ned sẽn ki sã n vʋʋge, b kõn tẽ-a ye.» A Lazaar ne arzɛk soabã.
A Zeezi yeela b karen-biisã yaa: Bũmb nins sẽn wat ne lʋɩɩsã ka tõe n ka wa ye. La ned ning sẽn na n wa-a ne-bã na paam toogo.
B sẽn na n loe ned kokor ne neer kugr n lob-a ko-kãsengã pʋg n são a yĩnga, n yɩɩd a sẽn na n kɩt tɩ kom-bãooneg kãens ned a yembr lʋɩ.
Gũus-y y mense. Fo ba-biig sã n maan yel-wẽnde, bɩ f leng-a, la a sã n kos sugri, bɩ f kõ-a.
La a sã n beeg foom naoor a yopoe daar a yembre, n lebg n wa fo nengẽ naoor a yopoe n yet t'a kota sugri, bɩ f kõ-a sugri.
Tẽn-tʋmdbã yeela Zu-soabã yaa: Paas-y d tẽebã.
La Zu-soabã yeelame yaa: «Yãmb sã n dag n tarẽ tẽeb sẽn zem siin-bila, yãmb na n yeela wom-sɛ-kãngã t'a vik n tɩ sel ko-kãsengã pʋga, la a na n saka yãmba.»
Ãnda n be yãmb sʋkã n tar tʋmtʋmd sẽn kood wall sẽn gũud rũmsi, t'a sã n yi weoog n lebg n wa bɩ a yeel tʋmtʋmdã: kell n wa zĩnd n dɩ?
Yẽnda ka na n yeel tʋmtʋmdã tɩ: «Segl dɩɩb n kõ-ma, ning fuug n tall rɩɩbã n wa n kõ-m tɩ m dɩ la m yũ. Rẽ poore fo na yaool n dɩ la f yũ.»
Yẽnda na n pʋʋsa tʋmtʋmd-kãng barka, a sẽn maan bũmb ningã b sẽn yeel-a t'a maanã yĩng sɩda?
Woto me, yãmb sã n maan bũmb nins fãa b sẽn yeel yãmb tɩ y maanã, bɩ y yeele: Tõnd yaa tʋmtʋmdb sẽn ka yõod ye, d maana tʋʋmd ningã tõnd sẽn da tog n maanã bala.
A Zeezi sẽn wa n dabd Zeruzalɛm, bãmb da tũuda Samaari soolem ne Galɩle sʋka.
Bãmb sẽn kẽed tẽn-bil a yembr pʋga, neb piig yĩn-gãong bãas sẽn tar waa n sega bãmba. Bãmb yaasa yɩɩg n zẽk b koees n yeele:
Zeezi, Zu-soaba, zoe-y tõnd nimbãanega.
A Zeezi sẽn yãnd-bã, b yeel-b lame tɩ b kẽng n tɩ wilg b mens maan-kʋʋdbã. La bãmb sẽn dabd be wakate, bãmb kell n lebga yɩlma.
Bãmb sʋka ned a yembr sẽn yã t'a paama maagre, yẽ lebg n pʋga a nao, n zẽk a koɛɛg n pẽgd Wẽnnaam.
Yẽnda wõgemda a Zeezi taoore, n fõgen a neng tẽnga, n pʋʋs bãmb barka. A dag n yaa Samaari neda.
A Zeezi gomame n yeel yaa: «Bãmb piiga fãa ka lebg yɩlma sɩda? La neb a wɛ wã bee yɛ?
Yaa sãan-kãngã bal n lebg n wa n na n kõ Wẽnnaam waoogre?
Dẽ a Zeezi yeel-a lame yaa: yik n looge. Fo tẽeb n fãag foom.»
Fariizẽ-dãmbã soka a Zeezi n dat n bãng Wẽnnaam soolmã sẽn na n wa wakat ninga. A Zeezi leok-b lame yaa: Wẽnnaam soolmã ka wate, n yaa wa bũmb ned sẽn tõe n gẽnes ye.
B ka na n yeel tɩ ges-y-yã! Wẽnnaam soolem bee ka wall a bee ka sẽnẽ ye. Bala, ad-y Wẽnnaam soolmã bee yãmb sʋka.
La a Zeezi yeela b karen-biisã yaa: Wakat n wat tɩ yãmb na n dat n yãnd Ninsaal Bi-riblã rayã daar a yembr la yãmb kõn yã ye.
B na n yeela yãmb tɩ b bee ka, wala b bee ka sẽnẽ. Da kẽng-y be ye, la y ra babs-b ye.
A wa sa-yãgb sẽn yit kɩreng a yembr n yãg n tɩ ta kɩreng a to wã, Ninsaal Bi-riblã me na n yɩɩ a woto b waoongã daare.
La yaa tɩlɛ tɩ bãmb deng n nams wʋsgo, la tɩ zamaan‑kãnga nebã zãgs bãmba.
Bũmb ning sẽn zĩnd a Nowe wakatã na n zĩnda Ninsaal Bi-riblã waoongã wakat me.
Nebã rag n dɩtame la b yũuda, la b kẽed kãadem, la b kõt b kamb sɩdba, hal tɩ ta daar ningã a Nowe sẽn kẽ koom koglgẽ wã. Sa-kẽengã wa n sãama bãmb fãa.
A na n yɩɩ wa a Lot wakatã. Nebã rag n dɩtame la b yũuda, n daadẽ la b koosdẽ, n bʋtẽ la b metẽ.
La daar ning a Lot sẽn yi Sodom tẽngã, bugum yii yĩngr n ni wa saaga, ne kidbri n sãam bãmb fãa.
Na n yɩɩ a woto me daar ning Ninsaal Bi-riblã sẽn na n puk b mengã.
Badaare, bɩ ned ning sẽn be roog zug t'a teed be roogã pʋg ra sig n dɩgs-b ye. La bɩ ned ning sẽn be pʋtẽ da lebg n leb poorẽ me ye.
Tẽeg-y-yã a Lot pagã yelle.
Ned ning sẽn na n bao tɩ gũ a vɩɩm, a na n menes-a lame, la ned ning sẽn na n bas a vɩɩm na n paam-a lame.
Mam yeta yãmb tɩ baraar yʋngo, neb a yiib sẽn na n gõe gãag a yembr zugu, b na n dɩka a ye, n bas a ye.
Pagb a yiib sẽn na n werd neerẽ ne taaba, b na n dɩka a yembr n bas a ye.
[Raop a yiib sẽn na n be pʋʋgẽ, b na n dɩka a yembr la b bas a ye.]
Karen-biisã soka a Zeezi yaa: «Zu-soaba, na n yɩɩ zĩ-bʋgo? La a Zeezi leokame tɩ dɩgr sẽn be zĩig ninga, yɩbrend tigimda beenẽ.» Pagb a yiib sẽn werd neerẽ.
A Zeezi wẽe bãmb yel-bũnd n na n wilg-b tɩ b tog n pʋʋsa wakat fãa n da yɛ ye.
A Zeezi yeelame: Bʋ-kaood a ye n dag n be tẽng a yembr pʋgẽ n ka zoet Wẽnnaam, la a ka zoet ned baa a yembr nif ye.
Pʋg‑kõor a ye me n dag n be tẽn-kãng pʋga, n wat n yet bʋ-kaoodã yaa: ‹Bʋ‑y maam ne m bʋʋd‑n‑taaga bʋʋd tɩrga, n kõ‑ma.›
Bʋ-kaoodã zãgsame n kaoos t'a ka na n sõng-a ye. La a yaool n wa tagsa a sũurẽ n yeele: «Baa ne mam sẽn ka zoet Wẽnnaamã, la m ka zoet ned nifã,
pʋg‑kõ-kãngã sẽn pẽdgd maamã yĩnga, m na bʋ a bʋʋdã n kõ‑a bʋʋm t'a ra leb n wat n pẽdgd maam woto daar fãa ye.»
Zu-soabã leb n yeelame yɛsa: Kelg-y bʋ-kaood-wẽngã sẽn yeelã.
Dẽ, Wẽnnaam kõn sõng bãmb nin-tũusdsã sẽn zẽkd b koees wĩndg la yʋng n kot bãmbã sɩda? B na kaoos n sõng-ba?
Mam yeta yãmb tɩ b na n sõnga bãmb tao-tao. La Ninsaal Bi-riblã sã n wa, b na n yãnda tẽeb tẽng zugu?
A Zeezi leb n wẽe yel-bũn-kãngã neb kẽer yĩnga, b sẽn da tẽed tɩ b yaa tɩrse, la b paoogd neb a taabã yĩnga, n yeele:
Daop a yiib n dag n kẽng wẽnd doogẽ n na n tɩ pʋʋse. A yembrã yaa Fariizẽ neda, la a to wã yaa yaood dɛɛgda.
Fariizẽ nedã yalsa yĩngr n pʋʋs a sũurẽ a woto: «Mam Wẽnnaam, m pʋʋsda yãmb bark mam sẽn ka wẽnd wa neb a taabã sẽn yaa wagda la nin-wẽnse, la yoaadbã, la m ka wẽnd baa yaood-deegd-kãnga wã yĩnga.
Mam loeta noor naoor a yiib rasem a yopoe pʋgẽ, mam yãkda m sẽn tarã piig pʋɩɩr n kõtẽ.»
Yaood-dɛɛgdã yalsa yɩɩga, n pʋs n ka saagd n na n doog a neng yĩngr ye. La a ra pĩisda a yãoog n yetẽ: «Mam Wẽnnaam! Zoe-y mam nimbãaneg tɩ m yaa yel-wẽn-maanda.»
Mam yeta yãmb tɩ rao-kãng lebg n kuila a yir ne tɩrlem. La Fariizẽ nedã ka paam ye. Bala, b na n sika ned ning sẽn zẽkd a menga, la b na zẽka ned ning sẽn sikd a menga.
Neb n dag n talld hal baa kom-peels n wat a Zeezi nengẽ tɩ b sɩɩs-ba. La karen-biisã sẽn yã bõn-kãnga, b sɩngame n lengd neb nins sẽn tall-b kambã n wa wã.
La a Zeezi kɩtame tɩ b wa ne kambã, la b yeele: Bas-y kom-bãoonegã tɩ b wa mam nengẽ la y ra gɩdg-b ye. Bala, Wẽnnaam soolmã yaa neb nins sẽn wẽnd-b bãmbã yĩnga.
Sɩd-sɩdã, mam yeta yãmb tɩ ned ning fãa sẽn ka reegd Wẽnnaam soolmã wa bi-bilf ka na kẽ be ye.
Naab a yembr soka a Zeezi yaa: «Karen-saam-sõngo, bõe la mam tog n maan n paam vɩɩm sẽn kõn sa?»
A Zeezi yeel-a lame yaa: «Bõe yĩng tɩ f boond maam tɩ nin-sõngo? Ned kae n yaa sõama tɩ sã n ka Wẽnnaam b yembr bal ye.
Fo mii tõodã: ‹Da yo ye, da kʋ ye, da zu ye, da kɩs kaset zĩrẽ ye, waoog f ba la f ma›. »
Raoã yeelame tɩ yẽnda saka bõn-kãensã fãa hal sẽn sɩng a yãadem wakate.
A Zeezi sẽn wʋm woto, b yeel-a lame yaa: Bũmb a ye n ket n paoog foom. Koos fo sẽn tarã fãa n pʋɩ naong rãmbã, la f na n paama paoong arzãna. La f wa tũ maam.
Yẽnda sẽn wʋm bõn-kãnga, a sũurã sãama hal wʋsgo, bala yẽnda ra tara arzegs wʋsgo.
A Zeezi sẽn yã [t'a sũurã sãama wʋsgã], b yeelame: Ad na n yɩɩ toog ne neb nins sẽn tar arzegsã tɩ kẽ Wẽnnaam soolmẽ.
Bala, yʋgemd sẽn na n tũ fu-pĩim yõorẽ n loog yaa naana n yɩɩd arzɛk soab sẽn na n kẽ Wẽnnaam soolmẽ.
Neb nins sẽn da kelgd bãmbã yeelame tɩ rẽ, ãndã n tõe n paam fãagre.
La a Zeezi leokame tɩ ninsaalbã sẽn ka tõe bũmb ningã, Wẽnnaam tõeeme.
La a Pɩyɛɛr yeelame yaa: Ade, tõnd basa d sẽn tarã n tũ yãmba.
La a Zeezi yeela bãmb yaa: Sɩd-sɩdã, mam yeta yãmba, tɩ ned ka be sẽn na n bas a yiri, a paga, a buudu, wall a kamba, Wẽnnaam soolmã yĩnga,
n ka reeg wʋsg n yɩɩd a woto zamaan‑kãngã pʋgẽ, la a paam vɩɩm sẽn kõn sa zamaan ning sẽn watã pʋgẽ ye.
A Zeezi peega karen-biis piig la a yiibã kɛɛng n yeel-b yaa: Ade, tõnd dabda Zeruzalɛm, la bũmb ning fãa Wẽnnaam no-rɛɛsdbã sẽn da gʋls Ninsaal Bi-riblã yell wɛɛngẽ wã na n pidsame.
Bala, b na n yõka bãmb n kõ bu-zẽmsã. Bu-zẽmsã na n yaala bãmba, n gom bãmb wẽnga, n tʋbs bãmb kolkoodo.
La b na n pãba bãmb ne kalwaase, n yaool n kʋ-ba. La rasem a tãabẽ daarã, bãmb na n vʋʋgame.
La karen-biisã ka wʋm b gomdã võor baa bilf ye. Gom-kãensã rag n solga ne bãmba, la b rag n ka mi gom‑kãng sẽn dat n yɛɛlg ye.
A Zeezi sẽn kolg Zeriko, zoang a ye n da zĩ sorã kɩreng n bõsdẽ.
Yẽnda wʋma kʋʋngã sẽn loogdã rãamde, a sokame n na n bãng sẽn yaa bũmb ninga.
La b togsa yẽnda tɩ yaa Nazarɛt dao a Zeezi n dag n loogde.
La a kelmame n yeele: «Zeezi, a Davɩɩd Bi-ribla, zoe-y mam nimbãanega!»
Neb nins sẽn dag n kẽnd taoorã lenga yẽnda n dat t'a sĩndi. La a kelmame n yɩɩd pĩnda n yeel tɩ: «Davɩɩd bi-ribla, zoe-y mam nimbãanega.»
A Zeezi yalsame n yeel tɩ b tall-a n wa. La a sẽn kolge, a Zeezi sok-a lame:
Bõe la fo rat tɩ m maan n kõ-fo? Yẽnda leokame tɩ: «Zu-soaba, m dat n leb n paama m ninã.»
La a Zeezi yeela yẽnda: Leb n paam f nini. Fo tẽeb n fãag-fo.
Wakat-kãng bala, a ninã pukame t'a tũ a Zeezi la a waoogd Wẽnnaam. Nebã fãa sẽn yã rẽnda wã, b pẽga Wẽnnaam.
A Zeezi kẽe Zeriko, n pɩʋʋgd tẽngã,
la rao a ye n da be be t'a yʋʋr boond t'a Zaase, a yaa arzɛk soaba, n yaa yaood dɛɛgdbã naaba.
Yẽnda rag n baood n yãnda a Zeezi n bãng b sẽn yaa a soaba, la neb kʋʋngã yĩnga, a rag n ka tõe n yãnd-b ye, bala yẽnda yaa rao-koɛɛga.
Dẽ, yẽnda wudgame n kẽng taoor n tɩ rʋ wom-sɛɛg n na n ges a Zeezi, bala b rag n tog n tũu beenẽ n looge.
La a Zeezi sẽn ta zĩ-kãngã, bãmb nak n gesame n yeel a Zaase yaa: Zaase, sig tao-tao, bala mam tog n siga fo yirã rũndã.
A Zaase siga tao-tao n deeg a Zeezi ne sũ-noogo.
Nebã sẽn yã rẽ, bãmb fãa yẽgmame n yetẽ t'a Zeezi tɩ siga yel-wẽn-maand yiri.
La a Zaase yalsa Zu-soabã taoor n yeel-b yaa: Ade, Zu-soaba, mam na n yãka m paoongã pʋɩ-sʋk n kõ naong rãmba. La mam sã n dag n zãmba ned n deeg a bũmbu, m na n lebsa yẽnda naoor a naase.
A Zeezi yeela yẽnda yaa: «Fãagr waa yi-kãngã pʋg rũndã. Bala, nin-kãngã me yaa a Abrahaam yagenga.
Bala Ninsaal Bi-riblã waame n na n bao la fãag bũmb nins sẽn dag n menemã.
La nebã sẽn kelg gom-kãense, a Zeezi leb n wẽe bãmb yel-bũndi, bala, bãmb da kolga Zeruzalɛm. La nebã rag n tagsdame tɩ Wẽnnaam soolmã na n puka wakat-kãng bala.
Dẽ, a Zeezi yeelame yaa: «Na-biig a yembr n da yi n kẽng tẽng sẽn zãr n na n tɩ reeg naam la a wa.
Yẽnda boola a tʋmtʋmdb piig n kõ-b mind piig n yeel-b tɩ b yõdg n leeb n paam yõod hal tɩ yẽnda lebg n wa.
La a soolmã nebã rag n kisa yẽnda, la b tʋma neb tɩ b pʋgl-a n tɩ yeel yaa: ‹Tõnd ka rat tɩ rao-kãngã soog tõnd ye.›
La yẽnda sẽn deeg naamã n lebg n wa, a kɩtame tɩ b bool tʋmtʋmdb nins yẽnda sẽn da kõ ligdã tɩ b wa, tɩ yẽnda bãng ned kam fãa sẽn leeb n paam yõod to-to.
Pipi soabã waa n yeelame yaa: ‹Zu-soaba yãmb minnã paama yõod min piiga.›
A yeela yẽnda yaa: ‹Be neere, tʋmtʋmd-sõngo, fo sẽn maan sɩd ne bũmb bilfã yĩnga, bɩ f soog tẽms piiga.›
La yiib soabã waame n yeele: ‹Zu-soaba, yãmb minnã doga min a nu.›
A yeela yẽnda yaa: ‹Fo me soog tẽms a nu.›
A to n waa n yeele: ‹Zu-soaba, ad yãmb minnã! Mam dag n vil-a-la ne peend n bĩngi,
bala, mam dag n zoeta yãmba, yãmb sẽn yaa nin-toaagã yĩnga. Yãmb dɩkda bũmb ning y sẽn ka rɩgle, la y tigsd bũmb ning yãmb sẽn ka bʋd ye.›

Naabã yeela tʋmtʋmd‑kãng yaa: ‹Tʋmtʋmd-wẽnga, mam na n dɩka fo mengã goam n kao fo bʋʋdo. Fo rag n miime tɩ mam yaa nin-toaaga, tɩ mam dɩkda bũmb ning mam sẽn ka rɩgle, la m tigsd bũmb ning mam sẽn ka bʋd ye,
dẽ, bõe yĩng tɩ fo ka bĩng mam ligdã bãnkẽ tɩ mam sã n lebg n wa bɩ m deeg-a ne yõodo?›
La a yeela neb nins sẽn da be be wã tɩ b reeg min a yembrã a sẽn tarã n kõ ned ning sẽn tar-a min piigã.
Bãmb yeela yẽnda yaa: ‹Zu-soaba, yẽnda tara min piiga.›
Mam yeta yãmb tɩ b na kõo ned ning sẽn tarã, la ned ning sẽn ka tarã, b na n deega baa bũmb bilf ning yẽnda sẽn tarã.
La sẽn keta, tall-y mam bɛɛbã sẽn da ka rat tɩ mam soog-bã n wa ne ka. Kood-y-b mam nifẽ ka.»
A Zeezi sẽn gom a woto n sɛ, bãmb lʋɩɩ nebã taoor tɩ b rabd Zeruzalɛm.
La bãmb sẽn kolg Bɛtfaaze ne Betani sẽn be tãng ning sẽn boond tɩ oliiv tɩɩs tãngã sẽnẽ, a Zeezi tʋma b karen-biis a yiib,
n yeel-b yaa: Kẽng-y tẽng ning sẽn be taoorã, y sã n ta be, y na n yãnda bõn-bil b sẽn loe, tɩ ned nan ka zomb-a ye. Lok-y-yã-a, n wa ne ka.
Ned sã n sok yãmb tɩ bõe yĩng tɩ y lokd-a, bɩ y yeel-a tɩ yaa Zu-soabã n dat-a.
Neb nins b sẽn da tʋmã kẽngame n tɩ mik tɩ yaa wa a Zeezi sẽn da yeel bãmbã bala.
La bãmb sẽn lokd bõn-bilã, a soaadbã soka bãmb tɩ yaa bõe tɩ b lokd bõn-bilã.
B leokame tɩ Zu-soabã dat-a lame.
La b talla bõn-bilã n wa a Zeezi nengẽ, n paal b fut a poorã n kɩt t'a Zeezi zombe.
La bãmb sã n kẽngdẽ, nebã yɛɛta b futã sorã zugu.
Bãmb sẽn kolgd Zeruzalɛm, oliiv tɩɩs tãngã sigdg sẽnẽ, bãmb karen-bi-kʋʋngã fãa sɩngame n zẽk b koees n pẽg Wẽnnaam ne sũ-noogo, bõn-bãnã fãa bãmb sẽn yã wã yĩnga.
Nebã da yetame tɩ yaa: Wẽnd na bark rĩm ning sẽn wat ne Zu-soabã yʋʋrã! Laafɩ bee arzãna, la ziir bee hal yĩngri.
Fariizẽ-dãmbã kẽer sẽn dag n be neb kʋʋngã sʋk yeela a Zeezi tɩ b leng b karen-biisã tɩ b sĩndi.
A Zeezi leokame yaa: Mam yeta yãmb tɩ b sã n sĩndi, kugã na n kelmame!
Bãmb sẽn kolg Zeruzalɛm, a Zeezi sẽn yã tẽngã, b yãba a yĩng n yeele:
Fo me sã n da bãngẽ bũmb ning sẽn wat ne fo laafɩ wã rũndã! La moasã b solga ne foom.
Wakat n wat tɩ fo bɛɛba na n me bõn-yood n gilg foom. B na n gũbga foom n dɩdg-f zĩiga fãa.
B na n sarma foom ne f kambã sẽn be fo pʋgẽ wã, la b kõn bas kugr baa yembr kugr a to zug fo pʋgẽ ye, fo sẽn ka bãng wakat ning fo fãagrã sẽn wa wã yĩnga.
A Zeezi kẽe wẽnd doogẽ wã n sɩng n dig koaasdbã,
n yeel-b yaa: A gʋlsame tɩ: «Mam doogã na n yɩɩ pʋʋsg roogo, la yãmba, y maan-a lame t'a lebg wagda geongo.»
A Zeezi da zãmsda nebã daar fãa wẽnd doogã pʋgẽ. La maan-kʋʋdbã kãsem-dãmba ne gʋlsdbã la tẽngã kãsem-dãmb dag n baood n na n kʋʋ bãmba.
La bãmb da ka mi b sẽn na n maan to-to ye, tɩ bõe nebã fãa rag n yong n kelgda a Zeezi.
Daar a yembre, a Zeezi sẽn zãmsd nebã wẽnd doogẽ wã la b moond koe-noogã, maan-kʋʋdbã kãsem-dãmbã, la gʋlsdbã ne kãsem-dãmbã waame.
La b yeela a Zeezi yaa: «Togs-y tõndo: Yaa ne no-bʋg la yãmb maand bõn-kãensã, wall ãnd n kõ yãmb no-kãnga.»
A Zeezi leok-b lame yaa: «Mam me na n soka yãmb sokre.
Togs-y maam: A Zã lisgã yii arzãn bɩ, bɩ yaa ninsaalb nengẽ?»
La bãmb yẽsa ne taab n yeele: «Tõnd sã n yeel t'a yii arzãna, b na n yeelame tɩ la yaa bõe tɩ tõnd ka tẽ a Zã,
la tõnd sã n yet t'a yii ninsaalb nengẽ, nebã fãa na n loba tõnd kuga, bala nebã tẽeda hakɩɩk t'a Zã yaa Wẽnnaam no-rɛɛsa.»
Dẽ bãmb leokame tɩ b ka mi lis-kãng sẽn yi zĩig ning ye.
A Zeezi yeel-b lame yaa: «Mam me ka na n togs yãmb mam sẽn paam noorã zĩig ning n maand bõn-kãensã ye.»
La a Zeezi sɩngame n wẽ nebã yel-bũn‑kãngã n yeele: Dao a ye n da sel reezẽ tɩɩs pʋʋgo, n dɩk-a n peng reezẽ tɩɩs pʋʋg koaadba, la a yi n tog sor n na n tɩ kaoose.
La bõn-bɩʋʋng sẽn ta, a tʋma tʋmtʋmd reezẽ tɩ‑koaadbã nengẽ tɩ b kɩs-a reezẽ tɩɩs biis t'a wa n kõ-a. La reezẽ tɩ‑koaadbã pãba yẽnda n lebs-a t'a kuil nug-zaala.
Yẽnda leb n tʋma tʋmtʋmd a to yɛsa. La koaadbã pãba yẽnda n paoog-a n lebs-a t'a kuil nug-zaala.
Yẽnda leb n tʋma tãabẽ soaba, la b pogla yẽnda n dig-a.
La reezẽ tɩɩs pʋʋgã soab yeelame yaa: «Mam na n maana bõe? Mam na n tʋma m bi-ribl-nongrã tɩ tõeeme tɩ b waoog-a.»
La reezẽ tɩ‑koaadbã sẽn yã biigã, b yẽsa ne taab n yeele: «Yaa yõwã n na n soog a ba wã paoongã bɩ d kʋ‑a tɩ arzɛkã lebg tõnd dẽnda.»
La b yõka yẽnda n yiis reezẽ tɩɩs pʋʋgẽ wã n kʋ-a. Moasã reezẽ tɩɩs pʋʋgã soab na n maan-b-la bõe?
A na n waame, n sãam koaadb-kãense, la a rɩk pʋʋgã n peng koaadb a taaba. La nebã sẽn wʋm bõn-kãnga, b yeelame tɩ: Bɩ ra yɩ a woto ye.
La a Zeezi gesa bãmb n yeel yaa: Gʋlsg sõngã sẽn yeel tɩ: «Kugr ning tãn-metbã sẽn zãgsã lebga roogã pãng kugri, a soakã zĩigẽ wã» võor yaa bõe?
Ned ning sẽn na n lʋɩ-a kug-kãngã zug na n tõtmame, la kug-kãngã sẽn na n lʋɩ ned ning zugu, a na n beds-a lame.
Maan-kʋʋdbã kãsem-dãmb ne tõog karen-saam-dãmbã baoome tɩ yõk a Zeezi wakat-kãng bala, la bãmb zoee nebã. B rag n bãngame tɩ yaa bãmb yĩng la a Zeezi sẽn wẽ yel-bũn‑kãngã wã.
Bãmb sɩngame n gũusd a Zeezi, sẽn na yɩl n paam a Zeezi gomd n bẽd-b n yõk n tɩ kɩs pãn-soaadbã ne Gʋvɛrneerã sẽn so noorã.
Nin-kãens soka a Zeezi a woto: Karen-saamba, tõnd miime tɩ yãmb gomda tɩrlem la y zãmsd nebã ne tɩrlem, la tɩ yãmb ka tũusd neb ye. La yãmb zãmsda nebã Wẽnnaam sor wa sẽn zems sɩdã.
Tõnd tara noor tɩ yao rĩm a Sezaar yõor yaood bɩ? Bɩ d ka tare?
La a Zeezi sẽn bãng bãmb sɩlmã leok-b lame yaa:
Wilg-y maam lagfo. Maasmã ne gʋlsmã sẽn be a zugã yaa ãndã rẽnda? Tɩ b leok tɩ rĩm a Sezaare.
Dẽ, a Zeezi yeela bãmb yaa: Rẽ wã, kõ-y rĩm a Sezaar bũmb ning sẽn yaa rĩm a Sezaar dẽnda, la y kõ Wẽnnaam bũmb ning sẽn yaa Wẽnnaam dẽnda.
Bãmb ka tõog n yõk a Zeezi b gomd baa a yembr pʋgẽ nebã taoor ye. La a Zeezi leokrã yɛɛs-b lame tɩ b sĩndi.
Saduusẽ-dãmbã sẽn yet tɩ kũum vʋʋgr ka be wã neb kẽer kolgame n sok a Zeezi a woto:
«Karen-saamba, a Moyiis dag n gʋlsame n yeel tõnd tɩ: Ned ba-biig sã n tar pag n ki n bas-a n ka paam biiga, bɩ yẽnda peeg pagã n dog kamb a ba-biigã yĩnga.»
La raop a yopoe n dag n be n yaa ba-biisi. La kãsma peega paga la a kiime n ka paam biig ye.
La yiib soabã reega pʋg‑kõorã, n ki n bas-a tɩ tãab soaba reeg-a.
La a yɩɩ woto ne bãmb b yopoe wã fãa, b kiime n ka paam kamb ye.
La pagã me yaool n kiime.
Kũum vʋʋgr daare, bãmb sʋkã, yẽnda na n yɩɩ ãndã soab paga? Bala yẽnda sẽn dag n zĩnd ne neb a yopoe wã fãa la?
A Zeezi leoka bãmb yaa: «Dũni‑kãnga nebã peegda pagba, tɩ pagbã kuiis sɩdba,
la neb nins b sẽn na n mik tɩ b zemsame tɩ zĩnd dũni ning sẽn watã pʋgẽ wã la tɩ vʋʋg n bas kũumã ka na n leb n peeg pagba, wala kuil sɩdb ye.
Bãmb ka tõe n leb n ki yɛs ye, bala, b na n yɩɩ wa malegse, la b na n yɩɩ Wẽnnaam kamba, bãmb sẽn vʋʋg n bas kũumã yĩnga.
Zĩig ning b sẽn gomd tuugã bugmã sẽn be a zugã yellã, a Moyiis wilgame tɩ kũum vʋʋgdame, yẽnda sẽn boond Zu-soabã t'a Abrahaam ne a Izak la a Zakoob Wẽnnaamã.
La Wẽnnaam ka kũum Wẽnnaam ye, b yaa nin-vɩɩs Wẽnnaam. Bala ne bãmba nebã fãa vɩɩme.»
Gʋlsdb kẽer leokame yaa: «Karen-saamba, yãmb goma sõama.»
La bãmb ka saag n leb n sok a Zeezi sokr a to yɛs ye.
A Zeezi sok-b lame yaa: «B tõe n yɩɩ a wãn n yeel tɩ Kiris yaa a Davɩɩd yagenga?
A Davɩɩd meng yeela yɩɩn-sõamyã sebr pʋgẽ tɩ: ‹Zu-soabã yeela mam Zu-soabã yaa: Zĩnd mam dɩtgo,
hal tɩ m kɩt tɩ f bɛɛbã yɩ fo nao roagendga.»
Dẽ, a Davɩɩd boonda bãmb tɩ Zu-soaba, woto bãmb na n yɩɩ a wãn n yaa a yagenga?› »
La nebã fãa sẽn kelgd a Zeezi, bãmb yeela b karen-biisã yaa:
Gũus-y y mens ne gʋlsdbã sẽn nong n gõod ne fu-wogdo, n nongẽ tɩ nebã pʋʋsd bãmb raasẽ, la b baood n zĩnd waoogr goeels zut karen-dotẽ, la rɩɩb zĩisẽ wã.
Bãmb deesda pʋg‑kõapã paoong zãnga, la b pʋʋsd pʋʋs-wogd nebã nin gesg yĩnga. Bãmb na n paama sɩbgr sẽn yaa toog n yɩɩda.
A Zeezi zẽka b neng n ges arzegsã rãmb sẽn da ningd b kũunã ligdã ningr zĩigẽ.
Bãmb yãnda pʋg‑kõor a yembr me sẽn yaa naong soab t'a ningd tãma a yiib beenẽ.
La a Zeezi yeelame yaa: Mam yeta yãmb sɩd-sɩd tɩ pʋg‑kõ-kãngã sẽn yaa naong soabã ningame n yɩɩd neb a taabã fãa.
Bala, nin-kãensã ned kam fãa tʋm n yãka a paoong a sẽn tar tɩ loogã pʋgẽ n ning ligdã ningr zĩigẽ, la pʋg‑kõorã ninga a sẽn tarã fãa, hal baa a rɩɩbã ligd zãnga.
La neb kẽer sẽn dag n gomd wẽnd doogã yell n wilgd tɩ b nags-a-la ne kug-neebã, la teedã neb sẽn tall n wa n kõ Wẽnnaamã, a Zeezi yeelame yaa:
Day n wate, tɩ bũmb ningã yãmb sẽn ne wã, kugr baa a yembr kõn pa a to zug b sẽn kõn leeb n lub ye.
Bãmb soka a Zeezi yaa: Karen-saamba, dẽ, bõn-kãens na n waa dabʋre, la bõe bãnd n na n wilg bõn-kãens waoongo?
A Zeezi leokame yaa: Gũus-y tɩ ned ra belg yãmb n tõog ye. Bala, neb wʋsg n na n dɩk mam yʋʋr n wa n yeel tɩ bãmb la Kirisi, la tɩ wakat kolgame. Da tũ-y-b ye.
La yãmb sã n wa wʋm tɩ b gomd zabre, la tẽn-dãmbg yelle, bɩ y ra zoe rabeem ye. Bala, bõn-kãens tog n deng n waame, la ka dũniyã saab nand ye.
Dẽ, a Zeezi yeel-b lame: Tẽng a yembr na n yika zabr ne tẽng a to, la rĩung a yembr na n yika ne rĩung a to.
Tẽn-digimdg kãsems na n zĩndame, la bã-longds ne kom na n zĩnda zĩig-zĩiga, la yel-kãsems sẽn kẽesd rabeem ne bõn-bãn sẽn yit yĩngr na n zĩndame.

La sẽn deng bõn-kãens fãa, b na n yõga yãmba, n nams-yã. B na n yõga yãmb n tall n kẽng karen-dotẽ, b na n kẽesa yãmb bi-bees roto, b na n tall-y lame n kẽng rĩm-dãmb ne Gʋvɛrneer dãmb taoor mam yʋʋrã yĩnga.
Na n tũu ne rẽnda tɩ yãmb kɩs bãmb mam kaseto.
Dẽ wã, ning-y y yamẽ, n da reng n tags y sẽn na n tɩ gom bũmb ning n fãag y meng ye.
Bala, mam na n ninga goam y noorẽ, la m kõ-y yam, la yãmb bɛɛbã fãa baa a yembr kõn tõog n kɩɩs wall b wẽ nokoeemd ye.
Baa yãmb ba-rãmba, la y ba-biisi, la y roagdba, la y zo-rãmb mens na n yõga yãmb n kɩse, la b na n kʋʋ yãmb neb kẽere.
Nebã fãa na n kisga yãmb mam yʋʋrã yĩnga.
La yãmb zug zoobg baa a yembr kõn menem ye.
Yãmb sã n yals kãenkãe, y na n fãaga y mense.
Dẽ, yãmb sã n wa n yãnd sodaas sẽn gũbg Zeruzalɛm, bɩ y bãng t'a sãoongã kolgame.
Dẽ, bɩ neb nins sẽn na n be Zʋʋde wã zoe n dʋ tãmse, tɩ neb nins sẽn be Zeruzalɛm tẽngã pʋgẽ wã zoe n yi, la tɩ neb nins sẽn na n be-b wetẽ da kẽ tẽngã pʋgẽ ye.
Bala, ra-kãens na n yɩɩ sũ-dokr rayã, tɩ bũmb nins fãa b sẽn gʋlsã na paam pidsgu.
Pagb nins sẽn tʋtã, la sẽn yẽsemd kamb ra-kãens daarã na n paama toogo. Bala, to-kãseng n na n zĩnd soolmã pʋgẽ, la Wẽnnaam sũ-puugr na n lʋɩɩ nin-kãens zutu.
Zabr sʋʋg n na n kʋ bãmba, la b na n yõga bãmb n maan yembse, n tall n kẽng buudã fãa sʋka. La bu-zẽms na n sooga Zeruzalɛm ne pãng hal tɩ b wakatã pidi.
Bãn na n zĩnda wĩndgẽ, la kiuugẽ, la ãdsẽ, la tẽngã zugu, ko-kãsengã bʋrgã, la a ko-pɛmã na n yɛɛsa buud toay-toayã tɩ b ka mi b sẽn na n maan bũmb ning ye.
Rabeem na n kʋʋ ninsaalba, bãmb sẽn gũud bũmb ning sẽn na n wa dũni zugã yĩngã. Bala, yĩngr pãens na n digimdame.
Dẽ, b na n yãnda Ninsaal Bi-riblã sẽn zao sawadg n wat ne pãnga, la ne ziiri.
La bõn-kãens sã n sɩng n watẽ, bɩ y roog la y nak n gese, bala, yãmb fãagrã kolgame.
La a Zeezi wẽe bãmb yel-bũnd n yeele: «Ges-y kankanga, la tɩɩsã fãa.
Yãmb sã n yãnd b sẽn tobdã, yãmb mens miime tɩ sigr zoe n kolgame.
Woto me, yãmb me sã n wa n yãnd tɩ bõn‑kãensã maandame, bɩ y bãng tɩ Wẽnnaam soolmã kolgame.
Sɩd-sɩdã, mam yeta yãmb tɩ neb nins sẽn vɩ moasã wã fãa kõn ki tɩ bõn-kãensã ka pids ye.
Yĩngr la tẽng na looge, la mam goamã kõn tol n loog ye.
Gũus-y y mens tɩ rɩ-n-tɩk wall rã-tɩgre, la vɩɩmã yɛl yɩɩr da wa n zɩsg yãmb sũyã ye, la tɩ ra-kãng ra wa n ling yãmb
wa zĩm-gãmbre, bala, ra-kãng na n waa n linga neb nins fãa sẽn be tẽn-gãongã fãa zugã.
Dẽ yĩnga, bɩ y neend la y pʋʋs wakat fãa, tɩ yãmb tõe n paam pãng n põs bũmb nins fãa sẽn tog n wa wã, la y tõog n yals Ninsaal Bi-riblã taoore.»
A Zeezi rag n zãmsda nebã wẽnd doogẽ wã wĩndga, la yʋngo, bãmb kẽnd n gãee tãng ning b sẽn boond tɩ oliiv tɩɩs tãngã zugu.
La nebã fãa kẽngda bãmb nengẽ wẽnd doogẽ wã, sẽn sɩng ne yibeoogo, n na n tɩ kelg bãmba.
Bur sẽn ka rã-bɩll tigri, b sẽn boond tɩ Pakã da kolgame.
Maan-kʋʋdbã kãsem-dãmba ne tõog karen-saam-dãmbã dag n baooda b sẽn na n maan to-to n kʋ a Zeezi. Bala, b rag n zoeta nebã.
La a Sʋtãan kẽe a Zʋdaase, b sẽn boond tɩ Iskaryo, sẽn dag n yaa neb piig la a yiibã ned a yembrã.
La a Zʋdaas kẽngame n tɩ yẽs ne maan-kʋʋdbã kãsem-dãmbã la ne wẽnd-doog gũudbã kãsem-dãmbã, n bao a sẽn na n tũ sor ning n yõk a Zeezi n kõ-ba.
Bãmb sũyã yɩɩ noogo, tɩ b sar tɩ bãmb na n kõo a Zʋdaas ligdi.
La yẽnda sakame, n sɩng n baood weer ning yẽnda sẽn na n yõk a Zeezi n kõ-ba, tɩ kʋʋngã ka bãng ye.
Bur sẽn ka rã-bɩllã raare, daar ning b sẽn da tog n kʋ Pakã pe-bilã taame.
La a Zeezi tʋma a Pɩyɛɛr ne a Zã n yeel-b yaa: Kẽng-y n tɩ segl-y Zʋɩf-rãmbã Pakã rɩɩb tõnd yĩng tɩ d rɩ-a.
Bãmb soka a Zeezi tɩ yɛɛnẽ la bãmb dat tɩ b tɩ segl Pakã.
A Zeezi leok-b lame yaa: Ade, yãmb sã n kẽ tẽngã pʋgẽ, yãmb na n sega rao sẽn tʋk koom ne yʋʋre. Tũ-y-yã-a n kẽ yir ning a sẽn na n kẽ wã.
Yeel-y yirã soab yaa: «Karen-saamb sokdame tɩ roog ning bãmb sẽn na n dɩ Pakã tigr ne b karen-biisã bee yɛ?»
La yẽnda na n wilga yãmb do-pʋg sẽn yaa yalenga, n be roog zugu, tɩ teedã fãa be be, yaa be la y na n segl Pakã.
Bãmb kẽngame, n tɩ mik tɩ bũmba fãa yaa wa a Zeezi sẽn dag n yeel bãmbã, la b segla Pakã.
Wakat sẽn ta, a Zeezi zĩnda ne tẽn-tʋmdbã n na n dɩ.
A Zeezi yeel-b lame yaa: Mam tʋlga ne m sũur fãa n dɩ Pak‑kãngã ne yãmba, sẽn deng m namsgã.
Bala, mam yeta yãmb tɩ mam kõn leb n dɩ-a yɛsa, hal t'a pids Wẽnnaam soolem pʋgẽ.
A Zeezi rɩka bõn-yũudlã n ning bark n yeele: Deeg-y bõn-yũudl-kãngã n pʋɩ ne taaba.
Bala, mam yeta yãmb tɩ sẽn sɩng ne moasã, mam kõn leb n yũ reezẽ tɩɩs koom yɛsa, hal tɩ Wẽnnaam soolmã wa.
Dẽ poore, a Zeezi rɩka bur n ning bark n yaool n kao-a n kõ karen-biisã n yeele: Ad‑a yaa mam yĩnga, b sẽn kõ yãmb yĩnga. [Bɩ y maand bõn-kãngã n tẽegd mam yelle.
Woto me, bãmb sẽn dɩ n sɛ, a Zeezi rɩka bõn-yũudlã n kõ-b n yeele: Bõn-yũudl‑kãngã yaa kãab‑paalgã sẽn maan ne mam zɩɩmã sẽn daag yãmb yĩngã.]
Baoosgo, ade, ned ning sẽn zãmbd-a maamã naaga maam ka n dɩtẽ.
Ninsaal Bi-riblã na n kii wa Wẽnnaam sẽn yãk yam to-to wã. La ned ning sẽn na n zãmb-a bãmbã na n paama toogo.
La karen-biisã sɩngame n sokd taab n dat n bãng ned ning sẽn be‑a bãmb sʋkã n na n maan yel-kãngã.
Karen-biisã wẽe nokoeemd ne taab wʋsg n dat n bãng ned ning b sẽn tog n ges wa kãsem bãmb sʋkã.
A Zeezi yeel-b lame: Soolem dĩm-dãmbã soo nebã ne pãnga, la sẽn tar-b noor ne nebã kɩtdame tɩ b boond bãmb tɩ tʋʋm‑neer maandba.
La a ka a woto ne yãmb ye. Sẽn yaa-a kãseng n yɩɩd yãmb sʋka, bɩ a yɩ wa yao-zʋʋga, tɩ ned ning sẽn yaa-a taoor soab yɩ wa tʋmtʋmda.
Bala, ned ning sẽn zĩ n dɩtẽ wã la kãseng n yɩɩd bɩ, bɩ yaa ned ning sẽn kɩt-a rɩɩbã? La baoosgo, mam bee yãmb sʋk wa rɩ-kɩta.
Yãmba, yãmb yaa neb sẽn kell n modg n pa ne maam m makrã pʋgẽ.
Yaa rẽnd n kɩt tɩ mam kõt yãmb soolmã, wa m ba sẽn kõ-a maamã,
tɩ yãmb tõe n zĩnd ne maam m soolmã pʋgẽ n dɩ la y yũ, la y zaoond gɛy zut n kao Israyɛll buud piig la a yiibã bʋʋdo.
Zu-soabã yeelame yaa: Sɩmo! Sɩmo a Sʋtãan kosame n na n yelg yãmb wa b sẽn yelgd koodo.
La mam pʋʋsa fo yĩnga, tɩ f tẽebã ra wa paoog ye. La fo sã n lebg n wa mam nengẽ, bɩ f paas f ba-biisã raoodo.
A Pɩyɛɛr yeelame yaa: Zu-soaba, mam seglame n sɛ tɩ kẽ bi-bees roog ne yãmba, wall tɩ ki ne yãmba.
La a Zeezi yeel-a lame yaa: Pɩyɛɛre, mam yeta foom tɩ rũndã, no-raoog kõn kelem tɩ fo ka kɩɩs noor a tãab tɩ f ka mi maam ye.
A Zeezi leb n yeela b karen-biisã yaa: Mam sẽn tʋm yãmb tɩ y ka zɩ ligdi wall korgo, wall neooda wã, bũmb paooga yãmba? B leokame tɩ baa fɩ.
La a Zeezi yeel-b lame: Moasã, ka leb n yaa a woto ye. Bɩ ned ning sẽn tar ligd korg rɩk-a, tɩ ned ning me sẽn tar korg rɩke. La ned ning sẽn ka tar zabr sʋʋga, bɩ a koos a fuug n da a yembre.
Bala, mam yeta yãmb tɩ bũmb ning b sẽn gʋls n yeel tɩ «b naaga bãmb ne tʋʋm-wẽns maandbã» tog n pidsa mam zugu. La bũmb ning sẽn gʋls n gomd mam yellã kolga pidsgu.
Karen-biisã yeela a Zeezi tɩ ad zabr sʋʋs a yiibu. La a Zeezi yeel-b lame tɩ rẽ sekame.
A Zeezi yiime n kẽng oliiv tɩɩs tãngẽ wã, wa bãmb sẽn minim n maandẽ wã. La karen-biisã tũu bãmba.
Bãmb sẽn ta zĩ-kãngã, a Zeezi yeela b karen-biisã tɩ b pʋʋs n da wa n lʋɩ makr pʋgẽ ye.
La bãmb zãag n basa karen-biisã, sẽn zems kugr lobgre, n tɩ yĩgimd n pʋʋs
n yeel yaa: M ba, yãmb sã n data, bɩ y zãag bõn-yũudl‑kãngã ne maam. Baoosgo, bɩ y ra maan mam sẽn datã ye, maan-y y raabo.
Dẽ, malɛɛk yii arzãn n puk a meng ne bãmb n paas bãmb pãnga.
La Sũ-sãoon-kãseng yõka a Zeezi, la bãmb pʋʋsa ne pãng n yɩɩd pĩnda, la b tʋʋlgã lebga wa zɩ-pɛla, n lasd tẽnga.
Bãmb basa b pʋʋsgã n yik n wa b karen-biisã nengẽ n mik tɩ b gõeeme, sũ-sãangã yĩnga.
La a Zeezi yeel-b lame yaa: Bõe yĩng tɩ yãmb gõe? Yik-y n pʋʋs-y n da wa n lʋɩ makr pʋgẽ ye.
Bãmb sẽn dag n nan ket n gomda, ad neb kʋʋng sẽn be taabẽ! La ned ning b sẽn boond t'a Zʋdaase, n yaa karen-biis piig la yiibã ned a yembrã dag n lʋɩɩ bãmb taoore. Yẽnda kolga a Zeezi n mok-ba.
A Zeezi yeela yẽnda yaa: «Zʋdaase, yaa ne mokr la fo na n yõk Ninsaal Bi-riblã n kõ la?»
Neb nins sẽn dag n be ne a Zeezi wã yãnda bũmb ning sẽn na n maanã, la b soka a Zeezi yaa: Zu-soaba, d kɛ-b ne sʋʋse?
Karen-biisã ned a yembr kɛɛ maan-kʋʋdbã kãsem tʋmtʋmd n fiuug a dɩtg tʋbre.
La a Zeezi gomame n yeel yaa: Bas-y-yã a woto. La a Zeezi tika raoã tʋbr n maag-a.
Dẽ poore, a Zeezi yeela maan-kʋʋdbã kãsem-dãmbã, ne wẽnd-doog gũudbã nanambsã la kãsem-dãmbã sẽn dag n na n yõk bãmbã yaa: Yãmb waa mam nengẽ ne sʋʋse la ne rasab wa m yaa fãada.
Mam dag n bee wẽnd doogẽ wã daar fãa ne yãmba, la y ka yõkd maam ye. La wakat-kãngã yaa yãmb rẽnda, la likã pãng wakate.
B yõka a Zeezi n tall-b n kẽng maan-kʋʋdbã kãsem yiri. A Pɩyɛɛr dag n pʋgda yɩɩg-yɩɩga.
Nebã yõgna bugum zaka sʋka, n zĩndi. La a Pɩyɛɛr zĩnda ne bãmba.
Tʋmtʋmd-poak a yembr sẽn yã a Pɩyɛɛr t'a zĩ bugmã vẽenemẽ, a ges-a-la kuii n yeele: Rao-kãngã me rag n bee ne a Zeezi.
La a Pɩyɛɛr kɩɩsame n yeele: Paga, mam ka mi a Zeezi ye.
Sẽn yɩ bilfu, ned a to yãnda a Pɩyɛɛr n yeele: Fo me yaa bãmb ned a yembre. La a Pɩyɛɛr yeela raoã yaa: Mam ka bãmb ned ye.
Sẽn zems lɛɛr a yembr rẽ zugẽ, ned a to leb n yeelame: Hakɩɩka! Rao-kãngã rag n bee ne bãmba. Bala, yẽnda yaa Galɩle neda.
A Pɩyɛɛr leokame: Hey! Mam ka mi bũmb ning fo sẽn gomd a yellã ye. Wakat-kãng bala, yẽnda sẽn ket n gomda, no-raoog kelmame.
Zu-soabã wẽnemdame n ges a Pɩyɛɛre. La a Pɩyɛɛr tẽega gomd ning bãmb sẽn dag n yeel yẽnda wã: Sẽn deng no-raoog sẽn na n kelem rũndã, fo na n kɩɩsa naoor a tãab tɩ f ka mi maam ye.
A Pɩyɛɛr yii yɩng n yãb ne sũ-sãang wʋsgo.
Raop nins sẽn da gũud a Zeezi wã yaala bãmba, n pãb-ba.
Bãmb da loeta a Zeezi nengã ne peend n yet-b yaa: «Bãng-bãnge, ãnd n wẽ yãmbã?»
La bãmb tʋʋ a Zeezi ne tʋy a taab wʋsgo.
La beoogã sẽn vẽege, tẽngã nin-kẽembã sull ne maan-kʋʋdbã kãsem-dãmb la tõog karen-saam-dãmbã tigma taab n kɩt tɩ b tall a Zeezi n wa bãmb kaoreng yɛl bʋ-bʋʋdbã taoore.
B yeela a Zeezi yaa: Yãmb sã n yaa Kirisã, bɩ y yeel tõndo. A Zeezi leok-b lame n yeele: Mam sã n yeel yãmba, y kõn tẽ maam ye.
La m sã n sok yãmb bũmbu, y kõn leok-m ye.
Sẽn sɩng moasã, Ninsaal Bi-riblã na n zĩnda pãng soab a Wẽnnaam rɩtgo.
Bãmb fãa sokame: Rẽnd yãmb yaa Wẽnnaam biig wɛ? La a Zeezi leok-b lame: Yaa wa yãmb sẽn yeelã: «Mam yaa woto.»
Dẽ, bãmb yeelame: Yaa bõe kaset la tõnd leb n baoodẽ? Tõnd mens wʋma bãmb noor goamã.
Bãmb fãa yikame n tall a Zeezi n kẽng a Pilat taoore.
B sɩngame n dõd a Zeezi n yeel yaa: Tõnd yãnda rao-kãngã t'a rãmbd tõnd tẽngã n yetẽ tɩ b ra yao a rĩm a Sezaar yõor yaood ye. La a yetẽ tɩ yẽnda menga yaa Kirisã, la rĩmã.
A Pilat soka a Zeezi a woto: Yãmb yaa Zʋɩf-rãmbã rĩmã? T'a Zeezi leok-a: Yaa wa yãmb sẽn yeelã.
A Pilat yeela maan-kʋʋdbã kãsem-dãmb ne neb kʋʋngã yaa: «Mam ka ne yell nin-kãngã zug sẽn zems tɩ b sɩbg-a ye.»
La nebã kẽnga taoor n kell n yeel yaa: «Zãmsgã bãmb sẽn sɩng Galɩle n zãms nebã Zʋʋde fãa hal tɩ ta ka wã wata ne rãmbg nebã sʋka.»
A Pilat sẽn wʋm bõn-kãnga, yẽnda sokame n dat n bãng raoã sã n yaa Galɩle neda.
La a Pilat sẽn wʋm t'a Zeezi yaa a Erood soolmã neda, a tʋma bãmb a nengẽ. A Erood me rag n bee Zeruzalɛm wakat‑kãnga.

A Erood sẽn yãnd a Zeezi, a paama sũ-no-kãsenga, bala, yẽnda rag n wʋmame tɩ b gomd b yelle, la hal daar zãra, yẽnda rag n dat n yãnda a Zeezi. La a rag n tẽedame t'a Zeezi na n maana bõn-bãnd t'a yãnde.
A Erood soka bãmb bũmb wʋsgo, la a Zeezi ka leok yẽnda tɩ bũmb ye.
Maan-kʋʋdbã kãsem-dãmbã ne tõog karen-saam-dãmbã yalsa be n dõt a Zeezi ne b pãngã tɛka.
Erood ne a sodaasã paooga a Zeezi, n yaal-ba, n yeelg-b fu-neere, la a lebs-b a Pilat nengẽ.
Badaar bala, a Pilat ne a Erood sẽn dag n yaa beemã lebga zoodo.
A Pilat tigma maan-kʋʋdbã kãsem-dãmbã la nanambse, ne nebã

n yeel-b yaa: Yãmb talla rao-kãngã n wa mam nengẽ n yeel t'a yaa tẽn-dãmbda. Ade, mam sok-a-la yãmb nifẽ, la mam ka yã yell nin-kãngã nengẽ sẽn zems tɩ b sɩbg-a ye, mam ka yã tʋʋm-wẽns nins yãmb sẽn dõt-a wã ba a yembr a zug ye.
A Erood me ka yã bõn-wẽng ne-a ye. Bala, bãmb lebs n tʋm-a-la tõnd nengẽ. Ade, rao-kãngã ka maan bũmb sẽn tog ne kũum ye.
Dẽ, mam na n kɩtame tɩ b sɩbg-a-la m bas-a.
[Tigr fãa, rag n yaa tɩlɛ t'a Pilat yiis bi-bɛɛg a ye n bas n kõ nebã].
Bãmb fãa naaga taab n kelem n yeel tɩ b kʋ rao-kãngã la b yiis a Barabaas n kõ-ba.
B rag n kẽesa a Barabaas bi-bees roogẽ tẽn-dãmbg sẽn dag n zĩnd tẽngã pʋgẽ wã poorẽ, la a sẽn kʋ ned yĩnga.
A Pilat leb n goma ne nebã, n dat n bas a Zeezi.
La nebã rag n kelemdame n yetẽ: Ka-y bãmb da-pɩk zugu! Ka-y bãmb da-pɩk zugu!
A Pilat leb n yeela bãmb naoor a tãab soab yaa: La bãmb maana bõe sẽn yaa wẽnga? Mam ka yã bũmb b sẽn maane, n tog kʋʋb ye. Dẽ wã mam na n kɩtame tɩ b sɩbg-ba la m bas-ba.
La nebã zẽka b koees wʋsg n kos tɩ b ka a Zeezi da-pɩk zugu. La b kelemsã tõogame t'a Pilat tũ b sẽn datã.
A Pilat kaoo bʋʋdã tɩ yɩ wa nebã sẽn kosã.
Yẽnda basa ned ningã nebã sẽn kosã, a soab b sẽn dag n kẽes bi-bees roog tẽn-dãmbgo, la nin-kʋʋr yĩngã. La a rɩk a Zeezi n kɩs-b tɩ b maan b sẽn dat ne-ba.
La bãmb sẽn tall a Zeezi n loogdẽ, bãmb yõka dao a yembr sẽn yi weoogẽ n kuiisẽ. A yʋʋr la a Sɩmo. B kɩtame t'a tʋk da-pɩkã n pʋg a Zeezi.
Neb kʋʋng wʋsgo, raop la pagb dag n pʋgda a Zeezi. La pagbã dag n yãbdame, n wiisdẽ, n pĩisd b gɛy a Zeezi yĩnga.
A Zeezi wẽnegame n yeel pagbã yaa: Zeruzalɛm pagba, da yãb-y mam yĩng ye. Yãb-y y mense, la y kamb yĩnga.
Bala, bãng-y tɩ ray n wate, tɩ b na n yeel tɩ pʋg-kiyã la sẽn ka tol n dog-bã, la sẽn ka yẽsem-b kambã n tar sũ-noogo.
La nebã na n sɩng n yeela tãmsã tɩ b sirg n zãb-ba, la b yeel kunkuba tɩ b lill bãmba.
Bala, b sã n maand ra-maas a woto, b na n maana ra-koeemsã wãn-wãna?
B rag tara nin-wẽns a yiib n kẽnd n na tɩ lagem ne a Zeezi n kʋ.
La bãmb sẽn ta zĩig ning b sẽn boond tɩ zu-wangã, b kaa a Zeezi da-pɩkã zug be, ne nin-wẽns a yiibã: A yembr b rɩtgo, a to wã b goabga.
A Zeezi yeelame yaa: «M ba, kõ-y-b sugri, tɩ b ka mi bũmb ningã b sẽn maandã ye.» La bãmb maana bãnd n pʋɩ a Zeezi futã ne taaba.
Nebã rag yasa be n getẽ. La tẽngã nanambsã rag n yaanda a Zeezi n yetẽ: «B fãaga neb a taaba, bãmb sã n yaa Kirisã, Wẽnnaam sẽn yãk a soabã, bɩ b fãag b menga.»
Sodaasã me kolgame n yaal a Zeezi, la b kõ-b reezẽ rã‑miisga,
n yeel a Zeezi yaa: «Yãmb sã n yaa Zʋɩf-rãmbã rĩmã, bɩ y fãag y meng y toore.»
B rag n gʋlsa a woto bãmb zugẽ: Nin-kãngã yaa Zʋɩf-rãmbã rĩmã.
Nin-wẽnsã sẽn dag n be da-pɩgsã zutã ned a yembr tʋʋsa a Zeezi n yeel-b tɩ ka bãmb la Kirisã la? Tɩ b fãag b meng la b fãag bãmba.
La a to wã lenga yẽnda n yeel-a yaa: «Fo ka zoet Wẽnnaam la? Fo sɩbgrã sẽn yaa a yembr ne bãmb sɩbgrã?
Tõnd yẽ sɩbgrã zemsame. Bala, tõnd deegda sẽn zems d tʋʋmã. La nin-kãngã ka maan bũmb sẽn yaa wẽng ye.»
La a yeela a Zeezi yaa: Yãmb sã n wa n deeg y naamã, bɩ y tẽeg mam yelle.
A Zeezi leok-a lame yaa: «Mam yeta foom sɩd-sɩd tɩ rũndã bala, fo na n zĩnda ne maam Paradi pʋga.»
Rẽ tɩ rag n zoe n kolga wĩnto-sʋka, la zĩiga fãa lebga lik bida hal tɩ ta wẽn-kaoore.
Wĩntoogã sobgame, la fu-lilldgã sẽn be wẽnd doogẽ wã pãrga pʋɩ-sʋka.
La a Zeezi zẽka b koɛɛg n yeel yaa. M ba, m basda m sɩɩgã yãmb nugẽ. La a Zeezi sẽn gom a woto n sɛ, b kiime.
Sodaas koabg naabã sẽn yã bũmb ning sẽn maana, a waooga Wẽnnaam n yeel tɩ: Hakɩɩka rao-kãngã rag n yaa nin-tɩrga.
La neb kʋʋngã sẽn da wa n na n ges bõn-kãngã sẽn yã bũmb nins sẽn maanã, b lebgdame la b pĩisd b yãado.
Neb nins fãa sẽn dag n mi a Zeezi wã, ne pagb nins sẽn yi Galɩle n yãag bãmbã dag n yasa yɩɩg n get bũmb nins sẽn maandã.
Kaorengã yɛl-bʋ-kaood a ye n da be t'a yʋʋr boond t'a Zozɛf n yaa nin-sõngo la nin-tɩrga.
A rag n ka lagem ne bʋ-kaoodb a taabã n yãk yamã la a maan b sẽn maan bũmb ningã ye. A rag n yaa Arimate sẽn yaa Zʋɩf-rãmbã tẽng neda. La a rag n gũuda Wẽnnaam soolmã waoongo.
A kẽnga a pilat nengẽ n tɩ kos a Zeezi kũumã.
Yẽnda sika kũumã, da-pɩkã zugu, n vil-a ne lẽ peend n tɩ gãneg yaoogẽ sẽn tu kugr zugu, kũum sẽn nan ka mumẽ ye.
Badaar dag n yaa seglg daare, la vʋʋsg daarã da rat n sɩngame.
La pagbã sẽn da yi Galɩle n yãag a Zeezi wã tũu a Zozɛf n wa yã yaoogã la b sẽn gãneg a Zeezi kũumã be to-to.
La b lebgame n tɩ to tɩdar zom la b maan tɩdar kaam. La bãmb vʋʋsa vʋʋsg daarã wa sẽn zems a Moyiis tõogã. Yaoog sẽn tuk pĩigẽ.
Dimaas daar yibeoog pĩnda, pagbã talla tɩdar-dambã b sẽn dag n seglã n kẽng yaoogẽ wã.
B mikame tɩ b bilga kugrã n bas yaoogã noore.
Bãmb kẽeme la b ka yã Zu-soab a Zeezi kũumã ye
Bãmb sẽn dag n ka mi b sẽn tagsd tɩ bũmb ningã, ade, raop a yiib sẽn yer fut sẽn pɩnd puka b meng ne bãmba.
Rabeem yõka bãmb tɩ b yĩgimd n sulg b nens tẽnga. La raopã yeel-b lame yaa: Yaa bõe tɩ yãmb baood nin-vɩɩg kũum sʋka?
[Bãmb ka be ka ye, b vʋʋgame.] Tẽeg-y bũmb ning bãmb sẽn dag n gom ne yãmb b sẽn da ket n be Galɩle wã.
B yeelame tɩ yaa tɩlɛ tɩ b zãmb Ninsaal Bi-riblã n yõk n kõ yel-wẽn maandbã tɩ b ka-b da-pɩk zugu, la tɩ rasem a tãab daare bãmb na n vʋʋgame.
La pagbã tẽega a Zeezi goamã.
La bãmb yii yaoogẽ wã n kẽng n tɩ togs karen-biis piig la a yembrã ne neb a taabã fãa bõn-kãens fãa.
Da yaa a Maari sẽn yit Magdala, ne a Zan la a Zak ma a Maari, n paas pagb a taab sẽn da be ne bãmbã n tɩ togs tʋmtʋmdbã bõn-kãnga.
La tʋmtʋmdbã tagsame tɩ pagbã sẽn dag n gomdã yaa zʋbsgo, la b ka tẽ-b ye.
La a Pɩyɛɛr yikame n wudg n kẽng yaoogẽ wã. Yẽnda sẽn zõonde, a ka yã bũmb tɩ sã n ka pɛɛlã sẽn dʋr tẽngã. La bũmb ning sẽn maanã yɛɛsa yẽ, la a lebg n leba a yiri.
La mikame tɩ badaare, karen-biis a yiib n da rabd tẽn-bil a yembr sẽn boond tɩ Emayuusi, n zems kɩlometr piig la a yembr ne Zeruzalɛm.
Bãmb da gomda bũmb nins fãa sẽn maanã yell ne taaba.
La bãmb sẽn gomd n kɩɩsd taaba, a Zeezi meng waame n kẽn ne bãmba.
La bãmb yam ludame tɩ b ka bãng a Zeezi ye.
A Zeezi soka bãmb tɩ yaa bõe yell la b gomd ne taab la b kẽnda. La b yalsame tɩ b nensã gãnem.
La bãmb ned a yembr sẽn boond t'a Keleopaas soka a Zeezi yaa: Yãmb y yembr bal n be Zeruzalɛm n ka bãng bũmb ning sẽn maan be rasmã noorã?
A Zeezi soka bãmb tɩ yaa bõe yelle. La b leoka bãmb yaa: Yell ning sẽn paam Nazarɛt dao a Zeezi wã. Sẽn da yaa Wẽnnaam no-rɛɛs sẽn tar pãng ne b tʋʋmã la b goamã, Wẽnnaam la nebã fãa taoorã.
Tɩ tõnd maan-kʋʋdbã kãsem-dãmb ne tõnd nanambsã sẽn yɩ to-to n yõk bãmb n kɩs tɩ b kao b bʋʋd n yeel tɩ b zemsa kũumã, n ka-b da-pɩk zugã.
Tõnd da tẽedame tɩ yaa bãmb n na n fãag Israyɛlle, la sẽn paas rẽ fãa, ad yaa rasem a tãab rũndã la bõn-kãens maan yã.
Yaa sɩd tɩ pagb kẽer sẽn be tõnd sʋk yɛɛsa tõnd wʋsgo. B kẽnga yaoogẽ wã yibeoogẽ pĩnda,
n tɩ ka yã a Zeezi kũumã ye. B waa n yeelame tɩ malegs n puk b mens ne bãmba, n yeel bãmb t'a Zeezi vɩɩme.
La neb kẽer sẽn da be ne tõndã kẽnga yaoogẽ wã n tɩ mik tɩ bũmbã fãa yaa wa pagbã sẽn dag togsã bala. La bãmb ka yãnd a Zeezi ye.
Dẽ, a Zeezi yeel-b lame yaa: Neb yam sẽn ka weke, yãmb ka tẽed bũmb nins fãa Wẽnnaam no-rɛɛsdbã sẽn togsã tao-tao ye!
Dẽ yĩnga, Kiris rag n ka tog n nams a woto n yaool n deeg b naamã sɩda?
A Zeezi bilga bãmb bũmb nins sẽn be gʋls-sõamyã fãa pʋgẽ n gomd bãmb yellã, sẽn sɩng ne a Moyiis tɩ ta Wẽnnaam no-rɛɛsdbã fãa.
La b sẽn kolg tẽn-bil ning bãmb sẽn dag n dabdã, a Zeezi maana wa bãmb dat n taa taoore.
La karen-biis a yiibã pẽdga bãmb n yeel tɩ b pa ne bãmba, bala, yʋng kolgame la wĩndgã dat n kẽeme. A Zeezi kẽe n siga ne bãmba.
A Zeezi sẽn zĩ ne bãmb n na n dɩ, b rɩka burã n pʋʋs Wẽnnaam bark n kao-a n kõ bãmba.
Dẽ, karen-biisã yamã vẽnegame tɩ b bãng tɩ yaa a Zeezi, la a Zeezi menema bãmb taoor bala.
La bãmb goma ne taab n yeel yaa: Bãmb sẽn dag n gomd ne tõnd sorã zug la b bilgd tõnd gʋls-sõamyã, tõnd ka paam sũ-no-kãseng sɩda?
La bãmb yika wakat-kãng bal n leb Zeruzalɛm n tɩ yã karen-biis piig la a yembrã ne b tũud-n-taas sẽn tigim taaba,
la b yeela bãmb tɩ hakɩɩka! Zu-soabã vʋʋgame la b vẽnega b meng ne a Sɩmo.
Bãmb me togsa bũmb ning sẽn maan bãmb sorã zugã, la bãmb sẽn bãng a Zeezi to-to b sẽn wa n kaood burã.
Bãmb sẽn dag n ket n gomd a woto, a Zeezi meng puka bãmb sʋk [n yeel-b yaa: Bɩ laafɩ zĩnd ne yãmba].
Dabeem yõka bãmb la b yɛɛsame n tẽed tɩ b yãnda kɩɩma.
La a Zeezi yeel-b lame yaa: Bõe yĩng tɩ yãmb yɛɛsdẽ, la yaa bõe tɩ y sãmbd y sũyã pʋsẽ a woto?
Ges-y mam nusã ne m naoã. Yaa maam bala, Sɩɩs-y maam n gese. Kɩɩm ka tar nemd wall kõab wa mam sẽn tarã ye.
A Zeezi sẽn gom a woto, b wilga karen-biisã b nusã la b naoã.
Karen-biisã sẽn ket n ka tẽeda, b sũ-noogã yĩnga, la sẽn yaa lingr ne bãmbã, a Zeezi sok-b lame b sã n tara rɩɩb be sẽn na rɩ.
Bãmb kõo a Zeezi zĩm-sẽedgo ne sɩɩd bilfu.
A Zeezi reeg-a lame n dɩ bãmb nifẽ.

Dẽ poore, a Zeezi yeel-b lame yaa: «Yaa woto la mam sẽn da togs yãmb mam sẽn dag n ket n be ne yãmbã: Ra yaa tɩlɛ tɩ bũmb nins fãa sẽn gʋls a Moyiis tõogã pʋgẽ, la Wẽnnaam no-rɛɛsdbã sɛb pʋsẽ, la yɩɩn-sõamyã pʋgẽ n gomd mam yellã paam pidsgu.»
Dẽ, a Zeezi vẽnega b yamã tɩ b tõog n wʋm Wẽnnaam gʋls sõamyã võore.
La a Zeezi yeel-b lame yaa: Woto, b gʋlsame n yeel tɩ Kirisã tog n namsame, la b na n vʋʋg n basa kũum rasem a tãab daare.
La tɩ sẽn sɩng ne Zeruzalɛm, b na n moona yam tekr koɛɛg buudã fãa sʋk ne bãmb yʋʋr tɩ b tõe n paam yel-wẽnã sugri.
Yãmb yaa bõn-kãng kaset-dãmba.
La ade, mam na n tʋma yãmb bũmb ningã m ba sẽn dag n kãabã. Pa-y Zeruzalɛm hal tɩ y wa pid ne pãng sẽn yit yĩngri.
La a Zeezi peega bãmb n kẽng Betani sẽnẽ, la b zẽka b nus n ning karen-biisã zut barka.
La barkã ningr wakate, a Zeezi basa karen-biisã n zẽk n kẽng arzãna.
La karen-biisã waooga a Zeezi, la b leb Zeruzalɛm ne sũ-no-kãsenga.
La bãmb bee wẽnd doogã pʋg wakat fãa n pẽgd Wẽnnaam.
Hal sɩngr wẽndẽ, gomdã dag n beeme, la gomdã dag n bee ne Wẽnnaam, la gomdã yaa Wẽnnaam.
Bãmb dag n bee ne Wẽnnaam hal sɩngr wẽndẽ.
B naana bũmb fãa ne bãmba, la bũmb ka be sẽn naane, tɩ ka yɩ ne bãmb ye.
Vɩɩm dag n bee bãmb pʋgẽ, la vɩɩmã dag n yaa vẽenem ninsaalbã yĩnga.
Vẽenemã yãga lik pʋgẽ, la likã ka reeg-a ye.
Dao a yembr la Wẽnnaam tʋm t'a wa. A yʋʋr la a Zã.
Dao‑kãng waame n yaa kaset kɩta, n na n kɩs vẽenemã kaseto, tɩ nebã fãa tõe n tẽ yẽnda yĩnga.
Dag n ka yẽnda la vẽenemã ye, la a waame n na n kɩs vẽenemã kaseto.
Vẽen-kãng yaa sɩd vẽenem, n wa dũni pʋgẽ n vẽnegd ned fãa.
Gomdã dag n bee dũni pʋgẽ. B naana dũni wã ne bãmba, la dũni ka bãng bãmb ye.
Bãmb waa b meng nebẽ, la b nebã ka reeg bãmb ye.
La neb nins fãa sẽn deeg bãmba, la neb nins sẽn tẽed bãmb yʋʋrã, b kõo bãmb noor tɩ b lebg Wẽnnaam kamba.
Ka kamb b sẽn dog ne zɩɩm, wall ne yĩng ratem, wall ne ninsaal datem ye, yaa Wẽnnaam sẽn doge.
B kɩtame tɩ gomdã rɩk yĩng n zĩnd tõnd sʋka. Tõnd gesa bãmb ziiri, Bi-ribl sẽn ka to ziir a sẽn deeg a ba nengẽ, la b pida ne bark la sɩda.
A Zã kɩsa bãmb kaset n yeele: Yaa soab ning mam sẽn gom a yell n yeel tɩ ned ning sẽn pʋgend maam n watẽ wã yɩɩda maam, bala, b renga maam n beẽ wã.
La tõnd fãa paama bãmb yalẽ wã, n deegd bãmb barkã n paasd wakat fãa.
Bala, b tũnuga a Moyiis n kõ tõogã, la barkã ne sɩdã tũnuga a Zeezi Kiris n wa.
Ned baa a yembr nan ka yã Wẽnnaam ye. Wẽnnaam sẽn yaa Bi-ribl‑yend sẽn ka to, n be ba a Wẽnnaam nengẽ wã n kɩt tɩ nebã bãng bãmba.
Ad kaset ning a Zã sẽn kɩs wakat ning Zʋɩf-rãmbã sẽn tʋm maan-kʋʋdbã ne Leevi rãmbã tɩ b yi Zeruzalɛm n wa n sok yẽnda wã: «Fo yaa ãnda soabã?»
Yẽnda vẽnegame n togsame n ka kɩɩs ye. A yeelame: «Mam ka Kirisã ye.»
Bãmb leb n sok-a lame dẽ wã, fo yaa ãnda? fo yaa a Eli bɩ? T'a leoke: «Mam ka a Eli ye.» La b sok-a lame: «La yaa foom la Wẽnnaam no-rɛɛsã bɩ?» T'a leok tɩ ayo.
La b leb n yeelame yaa: «Foom la ãnda, tɩ tõnd tõe n tɩ leok neb nins sẽn tʋm-b tõndã! Fo mengã yetame tɩ fo yaa ãnda?»
A Zã yeelame: Mam yaa soab ning sẽn kelemd we-rasempʋɩɩgẽ n yetẽ: «Rems‑y Zu-soabã sor tɩ yɩ tɩrga, wa Wẽnnaam no-rɛɛs a Ezayi sẽn yeelã.»
B sẽn dag n tʋm b rãmbã yaa Fariizẽ-dãmbã.
B sok-a lame yaa: «Bõe yĩng tɩ fo lisd nebã, fo sã n ka Kiris bɩ a Eli bɩ Wẽnnaam no-rɛɛsã?»
A Zã leokame n yeele: «Maam, mam lisda yãmb koomẽ. La yãmb sʋkã, ned a yembr n be beenẽ yãmb sẽn ka mi ye.
Soab‑kãng pʋgenda maam, la mam ka zems tɩ lood bãmb neooda loets ye.»
Gom-kãens goma Betani, Zʋrdẽ rʋʋnde, zĩig ning a Zã sẽn dag n lisd nebã.
Vẽkembeoogo, a Zã yãnda a Zeezi sẽn wat yẽnda nengẽ, n yeele: «Ad Wẽnnaam pe-bilã, sẽn yiisd-a dũni yel-wẽnã.»
Yaa bãmb yell la mam dag n gom ne yãmb n yeel tɩ dao n pʋgend maam, la b yɩɩda maam, bala, b renga maam n beẽ wã.
La mam dag n ka mi bãmb ye, la mam waa n lisda nebã koomẽ tɩ bãmb tõe n vẽneg b meng ne Israyɛll nebã.
A Zã leb n kɩsa kaset n yeele: «Mam yãnda Sɩɩg-sõng sẽn yi arzãn n sig wa wall n pa bãmb zugu.»

La mam dag n ka mi bãmb ye. La sẽn tʋm-a maam tɩ m wa n lis nebã koomẽ wã yeela maam yaa: «Fo sẽn na n yãnd ned ning tɩ Sɩɩg-sõng sig n pa a soab zugã, bɩ f bãng tɩ yaa yẽnda n lisd nebã Sɩɩg-sõng pʋgẽ.»
Maam, mam yãame, la mam kɩsa kaset tɩ yaa bãmb la Wẽnnaam Bi-riblã.
Vẽkembeoogo, a Zã rag n leb n bee be ne a karen-biis a yiibu.
A dag n geta a Zeezi sẽn loogd n yeele: «Ad Wẽnnaam pe-bilã.»
Karen-biis a yiibã wʋma gom-kãense, la b pʋgla a Zeezi.
A Zeezi wẽnegame n mik tɩ b pʋgda bãmba, la b sok-b lame: «Yãmb baooda bõe?» B leoka a Zeezi n yeele: «Rabbi, sẽn dat n yeel tɩ karen-saamba, yãmb yir yaa yɛ?»
A Zeezi yeela bãmb yaa: «Wa-y tɩ y na yã.» B kẽngame n tɩ yã zĩig ning a Zeezi sẽn be wã, la b paa ne bãmb da-kãnga. Dag n yaa zaabr wakat a naas sẽnẽ.
Neb a yiibã sẽn wʋm a Zã goam n pʋgl a Zeezi wã, a yembr bãmb sʋk la a Ãndere, a Sɩmo Pɩyɛɛr ba-biiga.
A Ãndere reng n yãnda a meng ba-biig a Sɩmo n yeel-a: «Tõnd yãnda Mesi wã, sẽn dat n togs tɩ ‹Kirisã.›»
Yẽnda talla a Sɩmo n wa a Zeezi nengẽ. A Zeezi ges-a lame n yeele: Foom la a Sɩmo, a Zonaas bi-ribla. B na n boonda foom t'a Sefaase, sẽn dat n yeel tɩ Pɩyɛɛr (wall kugri).
Vẽkembeoogo, a Zeezi yãka yam n na n kẽng Galɩle. Bãmb yãnda a Filip n yeel-a t'a tũ bãmba.
A Filip dag n yaa Betsayɩda sẽn yaa a Ãndere ne a Pɩyɛɛr tẽngã neda.
A Filip yãnda a Natanayɛll n yeel-a yaa: «Dao ning a Moyiis tõogã ne Wẽnnaam no-rɛɛsdbã sẽn gom a yellã, tõnd yãnd-a lame. Yaa Nazarɛt dao a Zeezi, a Zozɛf bi-riblã.»
A Natanayɛll soka yẽnda yaa: «Dẽ yĩnga, bõn-sõng tõe n yii Nazarɛt sɩda?» A Filip yeel-a lame: «Wa n gese.»
A Zeezi sẽn yãnda a Natanayɛll t'a wat bãmb nengẽ wã, b goma a yell n yeele: «Ad Israyɛll ned sɩd-sɩda, zãmb sẽn ka be a pʋgẽ ye.»
A Natanayɛll soka bãmb yaa: «Yãmb bãnga maam yɛɛnẽ?» A Zeezi leok-a lame n yeele: «Sẽn deng a Filip sẽn na n bool foomã, fo sẽn dag n be kankangã tẽngrã, mam yãnda foom.»
Dẽ, a Natanayɛll yeelame yaa: «Karen-saamba, yãmb la Wẽnnaam Bi-riblã! Yãmb la Israyɛll Rĩmã!»
A Zeezi leok-a lame n yeele: «Mam sẽn yeel tɩ mam yãnda foom kankangã tẽngrã yĩnga, fo tẽedame. La fo na n yãnda bõn-kãsems sẽn yɩɩd a woto.
Sɩd-sɩda, mam yeta yãmb tɩ yãmb na n yãnda arzãn sẽn pake, la Wẽnnaam malegs sẽn dʋʋd la b sigd ninsaal Bi-riblã zugẽ.»
Dasem a tãab rẽnda zugẽ, yi-kãadem n zĩnd Galɩle Kana. A Zeezi ma rag n bee be.
La b boola a Zeezi me ne b karen-biisã tɩ b wa yi-kãadmã.
La reezẽ rãamã sẽn paooge, a Zeezi ma wã yeela lame: «Nebã ka leb n tar reezẽ rãam ye.»
A Zeezi leoka lame: «Paga, bõe n be maam ne fo sʋka? Mam wakatã nan ka ta ye.»
Bãmb ma wã yeela tʋmtʋmdbã tɩ b maan bũmb ning fãa a Zeezi sẽn na n yeel-b tɩ b maane.
Sĩms a yoob sẽn pees ne kug n dag n be be, tɩ b ningd koom tɩ Zʋɩf-rãmbã tar n yɩlgd‑b mens wa sẽn zems bãmb miningu, la a yembr fãa tõe n deega ko-yʋy a naas bɩ a nu koom.
A Zeezi yeel-b lame tɩ b pids sĩmsã ne koom, la b pids-b la pal-pale.
La a Zeezi yeel-b lame: «Toog‑y moasã n tɩ kõ ned ning sẽn get-a rɩɩbã pʋɩɩb yellã.» La b tallame n tɩ kɩs-a.
Sẽn get-a rɩɩbã pʋɩɩb yellã fʋrga koomã sẽn tedg n lebg reezẽ rãamã. Yẽnda rag n ka mi reezẽ‑rã‑kãng sẽn yitẽ ye, la tʋmtʋmdb nins sẽn wi-b koomã rag n miime.

A boola pʋg-paalã sɩd n yeel-a: «Ned fãa rengd n kõo nebã reezẽ rã‑sõngã, tɩ nebã nens sã n wa n yuusdẽ, bɩ a yaool n kõ-b reezẽ rãam ning sẽn ka-a sõama zãngã. La foom, fo bĩnga reezẽ rã‑sõngã hal tɩ ta moasã.»
Bõn-bãnã a Zeezi sẽn maanã sɩnga a woto Galɩle Kana. Bãmb wilga b ziiri, la bãmb karen-biisã tẽe bãmba.
Rẽ poore, bãmb kẽnga Kapɛrnaom ne b ma wã, la b ma-bi-raopã, ne b karen-biisã, tɩ b tɩ zĩnd be rasem bilf bala.
Zʋɩf-rãmbã Pakã tigr dag n kolgame, la a Zeezi kẽnga Zeruzalɛm.
Bãmb tɩ yãame tɩ neb n dag n zĩ wẽnd doogã zakẽ n koosd niigi, piisi, la manwalla.
A Zeezi rɩka wĩy n kal n maan kaase, n dig bãmb fãa tɩ b yi wẽnd doogã zakẽ, la b riga piisã ne niigã, la b sãeeg ligd tɛkdbã ligdi, la b leeb taabl-dãmbã,
la b yeel man-wal koaasdbã yaa: «Yiis-y yõwã kaanẽ. Da rɩk-y mam ba wã roog tɩ yɩ leebg zĩig ye.»
Bãmb karen-biisã tẽegame t'a gʋlsame: «Yãmb roogã nonglem na n sooga maam zãnga.»
Zʋɩf-rãmbã goma ne a Zeezi n yeele: «Bõe bãnd la yãmb na n wilg tõndo, n wilg tɩ yãmb tara noor tɩ maan bõn-kãnga?»
A Zeezi leoka bãmb n yeele: «Sãam-y wẽnd do-kãngã, la rasem a tãab pʋgẽ, mam na lebs-a n me.»
Dẽ, Zʋɩf-rãmbã yeela bãmb yaa: Yaa yʋʋm pis-naas la a yoob pʋgẽ la b rɩk n tõog n me wẽnd do-kãngã n sa, tɩ fo na n wa n lebs-a n me rasem a tãab pʋgẽ?
La a Zeezi dag n gomda b yĩngã sẽn yaa wẽnd doogã yelle.
Bãmb sẽn wa n vʋʋg n bas kũumã, b karen-biisã tẽegame t'a Zeezi dag n yeela a woto, la b tẽe Wẽnnaam gʋls-sõamyã ne gomd ning a Zeezi sẽn dag n gomã.
Bãmb sẽn dag n be Zeruzalɛm Pakã tigrã wakatã, neb wʋsg tẽe bãmb yʋʋrã, b sẽn yã bãnã bãmb sẽn dag n maandã yĩnga,
la sã n yaa ne a Zeezi, bãmb ka bas yard ne-b ye. Bala, bãmb dag n mi-b-la fãa,
la bãmb dag n ka baood tɩ ned kɩs a to kaset ye, bala, bãmb mengã mii bũmb ning sẽn be ninsaal pʋgẽ.
Rao a yembr n dag n be Fariizẽ-dãmbã sʋka, n ya Zʋɩf-rãmbã naaba, t'a yʋʋr boondẽ t'a Nikodɛm.
Yẽnda waa a Zeezi nengẽ ne yʋng n yeel-b yaa: Karen-saamba, tõnd miime tɩ yãmb yaa karen-saamb Wẽnnaam sẽn tʋme. Bala, ned ka tõe n maan bõn-bãn nins yãmb sẽn maandã, tɩ sã n ka Wẽnnaam n be ne-a ye.
A Zeezi leok-a lame n yeele: «Mam yeta foom sɩd-sɩd tɩ ned sã n ka leb n dog yɛsa, a ka tõe n yãnd Wẽnnaam soolmã ye.»
A Nikodɛm yeela bãmba: «Ned sẽn kʋʋl na n yɩɩ a wãn n leb n doge? A tõe n leb n kẽe a ma pʋgẽ yɛs n dog sɩda?»
A Zeezi leoka yẽnda n yeele: «Mam yeta foom sɩd-sɩd tɩ ned sã n ka rog ne koom la ne Sɩɩg-sõngo, a ka tõe n kẽ Wẽnnaam soolmẽ wã ye.
Bũmb ning yĩng sẽn dog yaa yĩnga, la bũmb ning Sɩɩg-sõng sẽn dog yaa sɩɩga.
Da sak tɩ mam sẽn yeel tɩ fo tog n leb n dogame wã yɛɛs foom ye.
Sobg fugd n teesd a sẽn datẽ. Fo wʋmda a rãamdã, la fo ka mi a sẽn yitẽ, la a sẽn dabdẽ me ye. Yaa woto me ne ned ning Sɩɩg-sõng sẽn doge.»
A Nikodɛm leb n gomame n yeele: «Bõn-kãng tõe n maana wãn n yɩ?»
A Zeezi leoka yẽnda: «Fo yaa Israyɛll karen-saam-kãsenga, n yaool n ka mi rẽnda?
Mam yeta foom sɩd-sɩda, tɩ tõnd yeta d sẽn mi, la tõnd kɩta bũmb nins d sẽn yã wã kaseto, la yãmb ka tẽ tõnd kasetã ye.
Mam sã n gom ne yãmb dũni bũmb yɛl tɩ yãmb ka tẽeda, yãmb na n yɩɩ a wãn n tẽ, mam sã n gom ne yãmb saasẽ yɛl yelle?
Ned baa a yembr ka rʋ saasẽ ye, sã n ka sẽn yi-a arzãn n wa wã: ‹yaa Ninsaal Bi-riblã.›
A wa a Moyiis sẽn zẽk zũud waafã we-rasempʋɩɩgẽ woto me yaa tɩlɛ tɩ b zẽk Ninsaal Bi-riblã,
tɩ ned ning fãa sẽn tẽed‑b bãmb na paam vɩɩm sẽn kõn sa.
Bala, Wẽnnaam nonga dũniyã wʋsgo, hal tɩ b kõ b Bi-ribl yendã, tɩ ned ning fãa sẽn na tẽ bãmb kõn sãam ye, la a na paam vɩɩm sẽn kõn sa.
Sɩd me, Wẽnnaam ka tʋm b Bi-riblã dũniyã zug tɩ b kao ninsaalbã bʋʋd ye, la yaa tɩ nebã na paam fãagr bãmb maasem yĩnga.
B ka na n kao ned ning sẽn tẽedã bʋʋd ye. La ned ning sẽn ka tẽedã, buud zoe kaoome, a sẽn ka tẽ Wẽnnaam Bi-ribl yendã yʋʋr yĩngã.
Bũmb ning sẽn wat ne bʋʋdã la a woto: vẽenem waa dũniyã zugu, la ninsaalbã nonga likã n yɩɩd vẽenemã, b tʋʋmã sẽn yaa wẽnsã yĩnga.
Bala, ned ning fãa sẽn maand wẽng kisa vẽenem, n ka wat vẽenemẽ ye, t'a tʋʋm-wẽnsã na n wa puki.
La ned ning sẽn maand sɩd wata vẽenemẽ, tɩ nebã tõe n bãng t'a tʋʋmã tʋmda Wẽnnaam sakr pʋgẽ.»
Dẽ poore, a Zeezi kẽnga Zʋʋde soolmẽ ne b karen-biisã, n pa be rasem bilf ne bãmba, la b lisd nebã.
A Zã me dag n bee Eno, zĩig sẽn pẽ ne Salim n lisd nebã, bala, koom dag n bee be wʋsgo. Nebã dag n kẽnda be t'a lisd-ba.
Bala, b dag nan ka sui a Zã bi-bees roogẽ ye.
La a Zã karen-biis kẽer wẽe no-koeemd ne Zʋɩf a yembre, yɩlg-m-mengã poorẽ.
Dẽ, bãmb kẽnga a Zã nengẽ n tɩ yeel-a: «Karen-saamba, ned ning sẽn dag n be ne yãmb Zʋrdẽ rʋʋndã, tɩ yãmb kɩs a kasetã, ad a lisda nebã, la nebã fãa dabda a nengẽ.»
A Zã leokame n yeele: «Ninsaal ka tõe n deeg bũmb baa fʋɩ, tɩ sã n ka sẽn yi arzãnã n kõ-a ye.
Yãmb mens yaa kaset dãmb tɩ mam yeelame tɩ mam ka Kirisã ye, la tɩ yaa bãmb n tʋm maam tɩ m deng b taoore.
Yaa pag sɩd n so-a. La pʋg-sɩdã zoa bee ne-a n kelgd-a, la a sã n wʋm pʋg-sɩdã koɛɛga, a sũur yaa noogo. Sũ-no-kãng sẽn yaa mam dẽndã pida zãnga.
Yaa tɩlay tɩ Bãmb tʋʋmdã lebgd kãseng n paasdẽ, tɩ mam dẽndã tar boogre.»
Sẽn yi-a yĩngr n wa wã yɩɩda nebã fãa. Sẽn yaa-a tẽng zug ka ned yaa tẽng bũmbu, la a gomda tẽng bũmb yɛla. Sẽn yi-a arzãnã yɩɩda nebã fãa.
Bãmb togsda bũmb nins b sẽn yã la b wʋme, la ned baa a yembr ka tẽed bãmb kasetã ye.
Ned sã n deeg bãmb kasetã, a soabã wilgdame tɩ Wẽnnaam yaa sɩd soaba.
Soab ning Wẽnnaam sẽn tʋmã togsda Wẽnnaam goamã, bala, Wẽnnaam kõta a soab bãmb Sɩɩgã tɩ seke.
Ba wã nonga Bi-riblã, n dɩk bũmba fãa n ning a nugẽ.
Ned ning sẽn tẽed-a Bi-riblã tara vɩɩm sẽn kõn sa. La ned ning sẽn kɩɩsd-a Bi-riblã kõn paam vɩ-kãng ye, la Wẽnnaam sũ-puugrã na n ta-a lame.
Zu-soabã bãngame tɩ Fariizẽ-dãmbã wʋmame tɩ bãmb paama karen-biis n yɩɩd a Zã, la b lisd-ba.
Baoosgo, a Zeezi dag n ka lisd nebã b toor ye, dag n yaa b karen-biisã.
Dẽ, bãmb yii Zʋʋde n na n kẽng Galɩle.
Yaool n dag n yaa tɩlɛ tɩ bãmb pɩʋʋg Samaari soolem.
Dẽ, bãmb taa Samaari tẽng a yembr sẽn boond tɩ Sɩkaare, pʋʋg ning a Zakoob sẽn dag n kõ a bi-ribl a Zozɛfã sɛɛgẽ.
A Zakoob bulgã dag n bee be. Kẽndã yaams yĩnga, a Zeezi zĩnda bulgã noore. Dẽ tɩ yaa wĩnto-sʋk sẽnẽ.
Samaari pag a yembr n wa n na n yãk koom. A Zeezi yeela lame «Kõ-m koom tɩ b yũ wɛ.»
Bala, bãmb karen-biisã dag n kẽnga tẽngã pʋgẽ n na n tɩ ra rɩɩbo.
Samaari pagã yeela bãmb yaa: «Yɩta a wãn tɩ yãmb sẽn yaa Zʋɩfã kot maam a Samaari nin‑paga koom n na n yũ?» (Sɩd me, Zʋɩf-rãmbã rag n ka baood n na n paam lagem-n-taar ne Samaari rãmbã ye.)
A Zeezi leok-a lame n yeele: «Fo sã n dag n miẽ Wẽnnaam kũunã, la f mi ned ning sẽn kot-a foom koomã n na n yũ wã, yaa foom n dag n na n kos-a, la a rag n na n kõo foom ko-bundga.»
La pagã yeela bãmb yaa: «M kẽem sõngo, yãmb ka tar baa fɩ n na n toog koomã bulgẽ wã ye, tɩ bulgã yaool n zulmẽ. Dẽ, yãmb na n yãnda ko-bund-kãng yɛɛnẽ?»
Yãmb yɩɩda tõnd yaab a Zakoob sẽn kõ-a tõnd bul‑kãngã wã la? Bãmb meng yũu a koom, tɩ b kom-dibli ne b rũm-bãgã me yũ.
A Zeezi leok-a lame n yeele: Ned ning fãa sẽn yũud ko-kãngã, ko-yũud na n leb n yõka.
La ned ning fãa sẽn na n yũ koom ning mam sẽn na n kõ-a wã ye, ko-yũud kõn leb n yõka ye: la koom ning mam sẽn na n kõ-a wã na n lebga ko-bundg sẽn na n buli, hal tɩ ta vɩɩm sẽn kõn sa wã pʋgẽ.
Pagã yeela bãmba: «M kẽem sõngo, kõ-y maam ko-kãnga, tɩ ko-yũud da leb n yõk maam, tɩ m leb n wat ka n yãkd koomã ye.»
A Zeezi yeel-a lame: «kẽng n tɩ bool f sɩdã, la f lebg n wa ka.»
Pagã leokame: «Mam ka tar sɩd ye.» A Zeezi yeel-a lame yaa: «Fo maana neere, fo sẽn yeel tɩ f ka tar sɩdã.
Bala, fo talla sɩdb a nu, la fo sẽn tar a soab moasã wã ka fo sɩd ye. Fo togsa sɩd yellã pʋgẽ.»
Pagã yeela bãmb yaa: «M kẽem sõngo, mam neeme tɩ yãmb yaa Wẽnnaam no-rɛɛsa.
Tõnd ba-rãmbã dag n pʋʋsda tãn-kãngã zugu. La yãmb Zʋɩf-rãmbã yetame tɩ zĩig ning b sẽn tog n pʋʋsã yaa Zeruzalɛm.»
A Zeezi yeel-a lame yaa: «Paga, tẽ mam goamã! Wakat n wat tɩ ka tãn-kãngã zug wall Zeruzalɛm la yãmb na n pʋʋs y ba wã ye.
Yãmb pʋʋsda y sẽn ka mi. Tõnd pʋʋsda d sẽn mi, bala, fãagrã yita Zʋɩf-rãmbã nengẽ.
La wakat watame, la yaa moasã, tɩ tõnd ba wã waoogdb sɩd-sɩdã na n waoog bãmb ne b sɩɩse la ne sɩda. Bala, yaa waoogdb a woto buud la tõnd ba wã baooda.
Wẽnnaam yaa Sɩɩga, la yaa tɩlɛ tɩ neb nins sẽn pʋʋsd bãmbã na pʋʋs ne b sɩɩse, la ne sɩda.»
Pagã yeela bãmb yaa: «Mam miime tɩ Mesi wã, soab ning b sẽn boond tɩ Kirisã na n waame. B sã n wa, b na n wilga tõnd bũmba fãa.»
A Zeezi yeela yẽnda: «Maam, soab ning sẽn gomd ne foomã, yaa maam la bãmba.»
Dẽ, bãmb karen-biisã lebg n waa wakat-kãnga, la a yɛɛsa bãmb tɩ yã a Zeezi sẽn gomd ne pag, la bãmb ned baa a yembr ka sok bãmb b sẽn kot pagã bũmb ninga, wall b sẽn gomd ne-a bũmb ning yell ye.
Dẽ, pagã basa a yʋʋrã be, n kẽng tẽngã pʋgẽ n tɩ yeel nebã yaa:
Wa-y n ges-y rao sẽn togs maam bũmb nins fãa mam sẽn maanã! Dẽ yĩnga, ka na n yɩ Kirisã?
Nebã yii tẽngã n kẽng a Zeezi nengẽ.
Wakat-kãnga, a Zeezi karen-biisã dag n bõosda bãmb n yetẽ tɩ: «Karen-saamba, dɩ-y-yã.»
La a Zeezi leoka bãmb yaa: «Mam tara rɩɩb yãmb sẽn ka mi, n na n dɩ.»
Dẽ, karen-biisã goma ne taab n yeel tɩ daar ninga ned n tall rɩɩb n wa n kõ-ba.
A Zeezi yeela bãmb yaa: «Mam rɩɩbã, yaa tɩ maan sẽn tʋm-a maamã raabo, la m baas tʋʋmd ning b sẽn kõ maam tɩ m maanã.
Yãmb ka mi n yetẽ tɩ keta kiis a naas tɩ tigsg wakat ta wɛ? Ade, mam yeta yãmb tɩ y zẽk y nens n ges pʋtã sẽn pelg n dat tigsgã.
Sẽn tigsd-a wã zoe n deegda a tʋʋm yaoodo, la a tigsda koodã wakat sẽn kõn sa yĩnga. Woto, sẽn bʋt-a wã ne sẽn tigsd-a wã naagda taab n kɩdme.
Yel-bũnd ning sẽn yet tɩ ned a yembr n bʋt tɩ ned a to tigsã, yaa sɩda.
Mam tʋma yãmb tɩ y tɩ n tigs pʋʋg yãmb sẽn ka tʋmẽ ye. Neb a taab n tʋme, tɩ yãmb wa n kẽ n dɩt a yõodo.
Samaari tẽn-kãng neb wʋsg tẽe a Zeezi, pagã kaset yĩnga, a sẽn yeel t'a Zeezi togsa yẽnda bũmb nins fãa yẽ sẽn maanã yĩnga.
La Samaari nebã sẽn yã a Zeezi, b kos-b lame tɩ b pa ne bãmba. La a Zeezi paa be rasem a yiibu.
Neb nins sẽn tẽ a Zeezi b goamã yĩngã sõor n yɩɩda, la b yeela pagã yaa:
«Ka leb n yaa fo goamã yĩng la tõnd sẽn tẽed a Zeezi wã ye. Bala, tõnd mensã wʋma b goamã, la tõnd miime tɩ sɩd yaa bãmb la dũni fãagdã.»
Dasem a yiib-kãens zugẽ, a Zeezi yii be n na n kẽng Galɩle,
bala, bãmb mengã dag n kɩsa kaset tɩ Wẽnnaam no-rɛɛs ka paamd waoogr a meng ba-yirẽ ye.
Bãmb sẽn ta Galɩle, Galɩle nebã reega bãmba, b sẽn dag n yãnd bũmb nins fãa bãmb sẽn maan Zeruzalɛm, tigrã wakatã yĩngã. Bala, bãmb me dag n kẽnga tigrã.
Dẽ, a Zeezi leba Galɩle Kana, tẽng ning bãmb sẽn dag n tek koom tɩ lebg reezẽ rãamã. Rĩma tʋmtʋmd-kãseng a yembr n dag n be Kapɛrnaom, t'a bi-ribl ka keem ye.
A wʋmame t'a Zeezi yii Zʋʋde n wa Galɩle, la a kẽnga bãmb nengẽ n tɩ bõos-b tɩ b wa n maag a biigã sẽn dag n kolg kũum.
A Zeezi yeel-a lame yaa: Yãmb sã n ka yãt bõn-bãn la bõn-yɛɛsdse, yãmb ka na n tol n tẽ ye.
Rĩmã tʋmtʋmd-kãsengã yeela bãmb yaa: «Zu‑soaba, wa‑y tao-tao tɩ m biigã ra wa ki ye.»
A Zeezi yeel-a lame: «Kẽng tɩ f biigã vɩɩme.» Dao wã tẽe gomd ning a Zeezi sẽn yeelã, la a loogame.
A sẽn be sorẽ n kuiisẽ, a tʋmtʋmdbã seg-a lame n yeel-a: «Yãmb biigã vɩɩme.»
Tʋmtʋmd-kãsengã soka bãmb n na n bãng wakat ning biigã sẽn sɩng n sãoogã. La b yeel-a lame tɩ yaa zaamẽ wĩnto-sʋk sẽn loog lɛɛr a yembr la a yĩn-wɩngrã sig yã.
Biigã ba bãngame tɩ yaa wakat-kãng bal la a Zeezi yeel yẽnda t'a bi-riblã vɩɩme wã. La yẽnda ne a yirã rãmb fãa tẽe a Zeezi.
A Zeezi leb n maana bõn-bãn‑kãnga, a yiib soaba, b sẽn yi Zʋʋde n wa Galɩle wã poorẽ.
Dẽ poore, Zʋɩf-rãmbã tigr n zĩndi, la a Zeezi kẽnga Zeruzalɛm.
Bãk a ye n dag n be Zeruzalɛm, piisã dignoor sɛɛgẽ, tɩ b boond ne Ebre goam tɩ Betɛsda, la zãn a nu n dag n be be.
Bãad-dãmb wʋsg n dag n gãe zãnã tẽngre: zoense, wobse, ki-boaga. [B dag n bee be n gũud koomã rãmbgo.
Bala, malɛɛk n sigd bãkã pʋgẽ wakat wakat n dãmbd koomã. La koomã sã n dãmb n sa, ned ning sẽn yɩ-a pipi n lʋɩ koomẽ wã paamda maagre, baa bãagã sẽn yaa bũmb ninga.]
Dao a yembr n dag n be beenẽ n ka keemẽ, la a bãagã taa yʋʋm pis-tã la a nii.
A Zeezi yãnda a sẽn gãe, la b sẽn mi t'a bee be hal daar zãrã, b sok-a lame yaa: «Fo rat n paama laafɩ bɩ?»
Bãadã leoka bãmb yaa: «Zu‑soaba, mam ka tar ned sẽn na n kẽes maam bãkẽ wã koomã lengr wakat ye. La mam sã n dabd be, ned n dengd maam n lʋɩ be.»
A Zeezi yeel-a lame yaa: «Yik n dɩk f gãagã n kẽne.»
Wakat-kãng bala, dao wã paama laafɩ. A rɩka a gãag n sɩng kẽna.
Badaar dag n yaa Zʋɩf-rãmbã vʋʋsg daare. Dẽ, Zʋɩf-rãmbã yeela rao ning sẽn paam-a maagrã yaa: «Yaa vʋʋsg daare, fo ka tar noor tɩ tʋk f gãagã ye.»
La a leoka bãmba: «Ned ning sẽn kõ-a maam laafɩ wã yeela maam tɩ m rɩk m gãagã n kẽne.»
Zʋɩf-rãmbã soka dao wã tɩ yaa ãnda soab n yeel foom tɩ f rɩk f gãagã n kẽna?»
La rao ning sẽn paam-a maagrã dag n ka mi sẽn yaa ned ning ye. Bala, a Zeezi dag n kẽe nebã sẽn dag n be beenẽ wã sʋk n meneme.
Dẽ poore, a Zeezi yãnda raoã wẽnd doogẽ wã n yeel-a: Gese, fo paama laafɩ. Da leb n maan yel-wẽn ye, tɩ yell sẽn yɩɩd a woto da wa n paam foom ye.
Raoã kẽngame n tɩ yeel Zʋɩf-rãmbã tɩ yaa a Zeezi la sẽn maag yẽnda wã.
Rẽnda n kɩt tɩ Zʋɩf-rãmbã rag n namsd a Zeezi, b sẽn maand bõn-kãng vʋʋsg daarã yĩngã.
La a Zeezi leoka bãmb n yeele: M ba tʋmda hal tɩ ta moasã. Mam me tʋmdame.

Gom-kãng yĩnga, Zʋɩf-rãmbã rag n baooda a Zeezi n yɩɩd pĩnd n dat n kʋ. Ka b sẽn kɩɩs bãmb vʋʋsg daar tõogã yĩng bal ye, la yaa b sẽn boond Wẽnnaam tɩ b meng ba, n wilgd tɩ bãmb ne Wẽnnaam yaa yembrã yĩnga.

Dẽ, a Zeezi leoka bãmb n yeele: Mam yeta yãmb sɩd-sɩd tɩ Bi-riblã ka tõe n maan baa fɩ a toor ye, yaa bũmb nins a ba sẽn maand t'a yãtẽ wã bal la a maanda. Bũmb nins fãa ba wã sẽn maanda, Bi-riblã me maanda rẽ me.
Bala, ba wã nonga Bi-riblã, n wilgd-a bũmb nins fãa b sẽn maandã, la b na n leb n wilg-a-la tʋʋm sẽn yaa kãsems n yɩɩd a woto, tɩ yãmb yɛɛse.
Sɩd me, a wa ba wã sẽn vʋʋgd kũum, n kɩtdẽ tɩ b leb n vɩ wã, woto me, Bi-riblã kɩtdame tɩ bãmb sẽn dat t'a soab vɩɩmdã vɩɩmde.
Sẽn paase, ba wã ka kaood ned baa a yembr bʋʋd ye, b basa bʋʋdã fãa ne Bi-riblã,
tɩ nebã fãa na waoog-a wa b sẽn waoogd ba wã. Ned ning sẽn ka waoogd Bi-riblã ka waoogd ned ning sẽn tʋm-a wã me ye.
Mam yeta yãmb sɩd-sɩd tɩ ned ning fãa sẽn kelgd mam goamã, la a tẽed sẽn tʋm-a maamã a tara vɩɩm sẽn kõn sa. B ka na n sɩbg-a ye. A yii kũumẽ n kẽ vɩɩmẽ.
Mam yeta yãmb sɩd-sɩd tɩ wakat watame, la yaa moasã bala, tɩ sẽn ki-bã na n wʋm Wẽnnaam Bi-riblã koɛɛga. La neb nins sẽn wʋm-bã na n vɩɩmdame.
Sɩd me, a wa vɩɩmã sẽn be ba wã nugẽ wã, ba wã kõo Bi-riblã pãn-tõog tɩ b tar vɩɩmã b nugẽ,
la b kõ-a-la noor tɩ kao bʋʋdo, bala, a yaa Ninsaal Bi-ribla.
Da sak-y tɩ rẽ yɛɛs yãmb ye. Bala, wakat n wat tɩ neb nins fãa sẽn be yaadẽ na n wʋm bãmb koɛɛga.
Neb nins sẽn maan neerã na n yiime n paam vʋʋgr la vɩɩm. Neb nins sẽn maan wẽngã na n yiime n paam vʋʋgr la bʋʋdo.
Mam ka tõe n maan baa fɩ m toor ye. Mam bʋʋda bʋʋdã n zemsd m sẽn wʋmdã, la mam bʋʋdã yaa tɩrga, bala, mam ka baood tɩ maan m daab ye, la yaa sẽn tʋm-a maamã raabo.
Sã n yaa maam n kɩt m meng kaseto, mam kasetã ka sɩd ye.
Yaa ned a to n kɩt mam kaseto, la mam miime tɩ kaset ning a soab sẽn kɩt mam wɛɛngẽ wã yaa sɩda.
Yãmb tʋma koe-toagsedb a Zã nengẽ, la a Zã kɩsa sɩdã kaseto.
Ne maam, mam kasetã ka yit ninsaal nengẽ ye, la mam gomda a woto tɩ yãmb tõe n paam fãagre.
A Zã dag n yaa fɩtl sẽn wita, n yãgda, la yãmb tʋlgame n maan sũ-noog wakat bilf bal yẽnda vẽenemẽ wã.
La maam, mam tara kaset sẽn yɩɩd a Zã rẽndã. Bala, tʋʋm nins m ba sẽn kõ maam tɩ m maana, tʋʋm-kãens meng mam sẽn maandã n kɩt mam kaseto, n wilgdẽ tɩ m ba n tʋm maam.
La m ba sẽn tʋm maamã, bãmb meng kɩsa mam kaseto. Yãmb zɩ n wʋm b koɛɛga, wall y yãnd b neng ye,
la bãmb goamã ka be yãmb pʋgẽ ye, yãmb sẽn ka tẽed bãmb sẽn tʋm a soabã yĩnga.
Yãmb feesda Wẽnnaam gʋls-sõamyã pʋse, bala, yãmb sẽn tẽed tɩ yãmb na n paama vɩɩm sẽn kõn sɛ, b maasem yĩngã. Yaa gʋls-sõamy-kãens n kɩt mam kaseto.
La yãmb yaool n ka rat n wa mam nengẽ n paam vɩɩmã ye.
Mam ka reegd ziir sẽn yit ninsaalb nengẽ ye.
La mam mii yãmba: Wẽnnaam nonglmã ka be yãmb pʋsẽ ye.
Mam waa m ba yʋʋr yĩnga, la yãmb ka reegd maam ye. Ned a to sã n wa ne a meng yʋʋre, yãmb deegda yẽnda.
Yãmb sẽn paamd pẽgr taab nengẽ, la y ka baood pẽgr sẽn yit Wẽnnaam b yembr tãa nengẽ wã, yãmb tõe n yɩɩ wãn n tẽ?
Da tags-y tɩ mam na n yeela m ba tɩ yãmb ka maan neer ye. Sẽn na n yeel-a tɩ yãmb beegame wã, yaa a Moyiisi, yãmb teegr sẽn be ne a soabã.
Bala, yãmb sã n dag n tẽedẽ a Moyiisi, yãmb dag n na tẽ maam, bala, a gʋlsame n gom mam yelle.
La yãmb sã n ka tẽed bũmb nins a sẽn gʋlsã, yãmb na n tẽe mam goamã wãn-wãna?
Rẽnda poore, a Zeezi kẽnga Galɩle ko-kãsengã sẽn boond tɩ Tiberyaad rʋʋnde.
Neb kʋʋng dag n pʋgda bãmba, b sẽn yãt bõn-bãn nins a Zeezi sẽn maand n maagd bãad-dãmbã yĩnga.
A Zeezi rʋʋ tãngã n zĩnd be ne b karen-biisã.
La Zʋɩf-rãmbã tigr b sẽn boond tɩ Pakã dag n kolgame.
A Zeezi zẽka b nenga, la b yãnda neb kʋʋng sẽn wat bãmb nengẽ, la b yeela a Filip yaa: «Tõnd na n daa bur yɛɛnẽ tɩ nin-kãensã paam rɩɩbo?»
A Zeezi goma a woto n na n mak a Filip n gese. Bala, b meng rag n mii b sẽn na n maan bũmb ninga.
A Filip leoka bãmb n yeel tɩ deniye kobsi bur ka tõe n sek tɩ ned fãa paam bur-gɩrg ye.
A Zeezi karen-biig a yembre, a Sɩmo Pɩyɛɛr ba-biig a Ãndere yeela bãmb yaa:
Bi-ribl bil n be ka n tar Oorz bur a nu ne zĩm a yiibu. La rẽnda yaa bõe ne neb sõor a woto?
A Zeezi yeelame: «Kɩt-y tɩ nebã zĩndi.» Mood n dag n be zĩ-kãng wʋsgo. Dẽ, nebã zĩndame, la raopã sõor tata tus a nu.
A Zeezi deega burã, n pʋʋs Wẽnnaam barka, n pʋɩ neb nins sẽn dag n be-b be wã. B maana a woto me ne zĩmã, tɩ ned fãa deeg a sẽn dat tɛka.
Nebã sẽn dɩ n tɩge, a Zeezi yeela b karen-biisã tɩ b wʋk rɩ-zersã sẽn kellã, tɩ bũmb baa a yembr da pa n sãam ye.
Dẽ, b wʋka Oorz bur a nu wã gɩrsã, nebã sẽn dɩ tɩ kellã, n pids pet piig la a yiibu.
Nin-kãens sẽn yã bõn-bãn nins a Zeezi sẽn maanã, b yeelame yaa: «Sɩd yaa bãmb la Wẽnnaam no-rɛɛs ning sẽn da tog n wa-a dũni pʋgẽ wã.»
A Zeezi sẽn mi tɩ nebã na n waa n yõka bãmb n tɩ maan b rĩmã yĩnga, b yii be n leb n dʋ tãngã zug b yembre.
Zaabr sẽn ta, a Zeezi karen-biisã sigame n ta ko-kãsengã noore.
Bãmb kẽe koom koglg pʋgẽ n na n kẽng Kapɛrnaom, ko-kãsengã rʋʋnd a to wã. Zĩigã rag n zoe n sobga zãnga, la a Zeezi dag n ka wa b nengẽ ye.
Sebg n dag n fugd ne pãng hal wʋsgo, la ko-pɛmã dag n zẽkdame.
Karen-biisã sẽn dugs koglgã n zãag sẽn zems kɩlo a nu bɩ a yoobe, b yãnda a Zeezi sẽn kẽnd ko-kãsengã zug n kolgd koom-koglgã. La rabeem yõk-b lame.
La a Zeezi yeel-b lame: «Da maan‑y rabeem ye yaa maam.»
Karen-biisã dag n dat n dɩka a Zeezi ne koom-koglgã, la tao-tao bala, koom-koglgã rʋʋga tẽnga. Bala, b taa b sẽn dag n dabdẽ wã. Koom-koglg sobg sẽn lengda.

Vẽkembeoogo, neb kʋʋngã sẽn dag n yals ko-kãsengã rʋʋndã tẽegame tɩ dag n yaa koom-koglg a yembr tãa n dag n be be, la t'a Zeezi dag n ka kẽ kogl-kãng ne b karen-biisã ye, la tɩ karen-biisã b yeyn-yeyn n looge.
La koom-kogend a taab yii Tiberyaad n wa n yals zĩig sẽn pẽ ne zĩig ning a Zeezi sẽn ning burã bark n kõ neb kʋʋngã tɩ b wãbã.
La kʋʋngã sẽn yã t'a Zeezi bɩ b karen-biisã ka be be wã, b mensã kẽe koom-kogendẽ wã n kẽng Kapɛrnaom n na n tɩ bao a Zeezi.
B yãnda a Zeezi ko-kãsengã rʋʋnd a to wã, n sok-b yaa: «Karen-saamba, yãmb waa ka rabʋre?»
A Zeezi leoka bãmb n yeele: «Mam yeta yãmb sɩd-sɩd tɩ yãmb sẽn baood maamã, ka bõn-bãnã yãmb sẽn yã wã yĩng ye, la yaa yãmb sẽn wãb burã n tɩgã yĩnga.
Da tʋm-y rɩɩb sẽn sãamdã yĩng ye. Tʋm-y rɩɩb ning sẽn paad vɩɩm sẽn kõn sa wã yĩnga: Ninsaal Bi-riblã n na n kõ-a yãmba. Bala, yaa ba a Wẽnnaam n yãk yẽnda.»
Nebã soka a Zeezi yaa: «Bõe la tõnd na n maan n tʋm Wẽnnaam tʋʋmdã?»
A Zeezi leoka bãmb n yeele: «Wẽnnaam tʋʋmde, yaa tɩ yãmb tẽ a soab ning bãmb sẽn tʋmã.»
La b yeela a Zeezi yaa: «Bõe bõn-bãnd la yãmb maand tɩ tõnd na n yãnd n tẽ yãmba? Bõe tʋʋm la yãmb tʋmda?»
Tõnd ba-rãmbã dɩɩ man we-rasempʋɩɩgã pʋgẽ wa b sẽn gʋls n yeel tɩ: «A Moyiis kõo bãmb bur sẽn yit arzãn tɩ b wãbe.»
A Zeezi yeela bãmb yaa: «Mam yeta yãmb sɩd-sɩd tɩ ka a Moyiis n kõ yãmb bur sẽn yi arzãnã ye, la yaa m ba n kõt yãmb bur sɩd-sɩd sẽn yi arzãnã.
Bala, Wẽnnaam burã, yaa soab ning sẽn yit-a arzãn n sigda, n kõt dũni neb vɩɩmã.»
La nebã yeela a Zeezi yaa: Zu-soaba, kõt-y tõnd bur kãng daar fãa.
A Zeezi yeela bãmb yaa: Maam la bur sẽn kõt vɩɩmã. Ned ning fãa sẽn wat-a mam nengẽ, Kom kõn leb n yõk yẽnda ye, la ned ning fãa sẽn tẽed-a maam, ko-yũud kõn leb n yõk yẽnda abada.
La mam yeela yãmb tɩ yãmb yãnda maam la y ka tẽed ye.
